sections.label: Invocation
sections.name: जो सुमिरत सिधि होइ गन नायक करिबर बदन

verses.sa:
वर्णानामर्थसंघानां रसानां छन्दसामपि ।
मङ्गलानां च कर्त्तारौ वन्दे वाणीविनायकौ ॥
verses.tr:
varṇānāmarthasaṃghānāṃ rasānāṃ chandasāmapi
maṅgalānāṃ ca karttārau vande vāṇīvināyakau
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
भवानीशङ्करौ वन्दे श्रद्धाविश्वासरूपिणौ ।
याभ्यां विना न पश्यन्ति सिद्धाःस्वान्तःस्थमीश्वरम् ॥
verses.tr:
bhavānīśaṅkarau vande śraddhāviśvāsarūpiṇau
yābhyāṃ vinā na paśyanti siddhāḥsvāntaḥsthamīśvaram

verses.sa:
वन्दे बोधमयं नित्यं गुरुं शङ्कररूपिणम् ।
यमाश्रितो हि वक्रोऽपि चन्द्रः सर्वत्र वन्द्यते ॥
verses.tr:
vande bodhamayaṃ nityaṃ guruṃ śaṅkararūpiṇam
yamāśrito hi vakro'pi candraḥ sarvatra vandyate

verses.sa:
सीतारामगुणग्रामपुण्यारण्यविहारिणौ ।
वन्दे विशुद्धविज्ञानौ कबीश्वरकपीश्वरौ ॥
verses.tr:
sītārāmaguṇagrāmapuṇyāraṇyavihāriṇau
vande viśuddhavijñānau kabīśvarakapīśvarau

verses.sa:
उद्भवस्थितिसंहारकारिणीं क्लेशहारिणीम् ।
सर्वश्रेयस्करीं सीतां नतोऽहं रामवल्लभाम् ॥
verses.tr:
udbhavasthitisaṃhārakāriṇīṃ kleśahāriṇīm
sarvaśreyaskarīṃ sītāṃ nato'haṃ rāmavallabhām

verses.sa:
यन्मायावशवर्तिं विश्वमखिलं ब्रह्मादिदेवासुरा ।
यत्सत्वादमृषैव भाति सकलं रज्जौ यथाहेर्भ्रमः ।
यत्पादप्लवमेकमेव हि भवाम्भोधेस्तितीर्षावतां ।
वन्देऽहं तमशेषकारणपरं रामाख्यमीशं हरिम् ॥
verses.tr:
yanmāyāvaśavartiṃ viśvamakhilaṃ brahmādidevāsurā
yatsatvādamṛṣaiva bhāti sakalaṃ rajjau yathāherbhramaḥ
yatpādaplavamekameva hi bhavāmbhodhestitīrṣāvatāṃ
vande'haṃ tamaśeṣakāraṇaparaṃ rāmākhyamīśaṃ harim

verses.sa:
नानापुराणनिगमागमसम्मतं यद् ।
रामायणे निगदितं क्वचिदन्यतोऽपि ।
स्वान्तःसुखाय तुलसी रघुनाथगाथा- ।
भाषानिबन्धमतिमञ्जुलमातनोति ॥
verses.tr:
nānāpurāṇanigamāgamasammataṃ yad
rāmāyaṇe nigaditaṃ kvacidanyato'pi
svāntaḥsukhāya tulasī raghunāthagāthā-
bhāṣānibandhamatimañjulamātanoti

verses.sa:
जो सुमिरत सिधि होइ गन नायक करिबर बदन ।
करउ अनुग्रह सोइ बुद्धि रासि सुभ गुन सदन ॥
verses.tr:
jo sumirat sidhi hoi gan nāyak karibar badan
karau anugrah soi buddhi rāsi subh gun sadan
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
मूक होइ बाचाल पंगु चढइ गिरिबर गहन ।
जासु कृपाँ सो दयाल द्रवउ सकल कलि मल दहन ॥
verses.tr:
mūk hoi bācāl paṃgu caḍhai giribar gahan
jāsu kṛpām̐ so dayāl dravau sakal kali mal dahan

verses.sa:
नील सरोरुह स्याम तरुन अरुन बारिज नयन ।
करउ सो मम उर धाम सदा छीरसागर सयन ॥
verses.tr:
nīl saroruh syām tarun arun bārij nayan
karau so mam ur dhām sadā chīrasāgar sayan

verses.sa:
कुंद इंदु सम देह उमा रमन करुना अयन ।
जाहि दीन पर नेह करउ कृपा मर्दन मयन ॥
verses.tr:
kuṃd iṃdu sam deh umā raman karunā ayan
jāhi dīn par neh karau kṛpā mardan mayan

verses.sa:
बंदउ गुरु पद कंज कृपा सिंधु नररूप हरि ।
महामोह तम पुंज जासु बचन रबि कर निकर ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdau guru pad kaṃj kṛpā siṃdhu nararūp hari
mahāmoh tam puṃj jāsu bacan rabi kar nikar

trans: I REVERENCE Sderada and Ganes, the inventors of the alphabet and of phraseology, of the poetic modes and of metre. I reverence Bhavani and Sankara, the incarnations of faith and hope, without whom not even the just can see God, the Great Spirit. I reverence, as the incarnation of Sankara, the all-wise Guru, through whom even the crescent moon is everywhere honoured. I reverence the king of bards and the monkey king, of pure intelligence, who ever lingered with delight in the holy forest land of Rama and Sita’s infinite perfection. I bow before Sita, the beloved of Rama; the queen of birth, of life and death; the destroyer of sorrow; the cause of happiness.

I reverence, under his name RAMA, the lord Hari; supreme over all causes; to whose illusive power are subject the whole universe and every supernatural being from Brahma downwards; by whose light truthis made manifest, as when what appeared to bea snake turns out a rope; and by whose feet as by a bark those who will may pass safely over the ocean of existence.

In accord with all the Purdnasand diiferent sacred texts, and with what has been recorded in the Ramayana (of Valmiki) and elsewhere, I, Tulsi, to gratify my own heart's desire, have composed these lays of Raghunath in most choice and elegant modern speech.

O Ganes, of the grand elephant head; the mention of whose name ensures success, be gracious to me, accumulation of wisdom, storehouse of all good qualities Thou, too, by whose favour the dumb becomes eloquent, and the lame can climb the vastest mountain, be favourable to me, O thou that consumest as a tire all the impurities of this iron age. Take up thy abode also in my heart, O thou that slumberest on the milky ocean, with body dark as the lotus, and eyes bright as a budding water-lily. O spouse of Uma, clear of hue as the jasmine or the moon; home of compassion, who showest pity to the humble; show pity upon me, O destroyer of Kamadeva. I reverence the lotus feet of my master, that ocean of benevolence. Hari incarnate, whose words are like a flood of sunlight on the darkness of ignorance and infatuation.

sections.label: Doha 1
sections.name: जथा सुअंजन अंजि दृग साधक सिद्ध सुजान

verses.sa:
बंदउ गुरु पद पदुम परागा ।
सुरुचि सुबास सरस अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdau guru pad padum parāgā
suruci subās saras anurāgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अमिय मूरिमय चूरन चारू ।
समन सकल भव रुज परिवारू ॥
verses.tr:
amiya mūrimaya cūran cārū
saman sakal bhav ruj parivārū

verses.sa:
सुकृति संभु तन बिमल बिभूती ।
मंजुल मंगल मोद प्रसूती ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛti saṃbhu tan bimal bibhūtī
maṃjul maṃgal mod prasūtī

verses.sa:
जन मन मंजु मुकुर मल हरनी ।
किएँ तिलक गुन गन बस करनी ॥
verses.tr:
jan man maṃju mukur mal haranī
kiem̐ tilak gun gan bas karanī

verses.sa:
श्रीगुर पद नख मनि गन जोती ।
सुमिरत दिब्य द्रृष्टि हियँ होती ॥
verses.tr:
śrīgur pad nakh mani gan jotī
sumirat dibya drṛṣṭi hiyam̐ hotī

verses.sa:
दलन मोह तम सो सप्रकासू ।
बड़े भाग उर आवइ जासू ॥
verses.tr:
dalan moh tam so saprakāsū
bar̤e bhāg ur āvai jāsū

verses.sa:
उघरहिं बिमल बिलोचन ही के ।
मिटहिं दोष दुख भव रजनी के ॥
verses.tr:
ugharahiṃ bimal bilocan hī ke
miṭahiṃ doṣ dukh bhav rajanī ke

verses.sa:
सूझहिं राम चरित मनि मानिक ।
गुपुत प्रगट जहँ जो जेहि खानिक ॥
verses.tr:
sūjhahiṃ rām carit mani mānik
guput pragaṭ jaham̐ jo jehi khānik

verses.sa:
जथा सुअंजन अंजि दृग साधक सिद्ध सुजान ।
कौतुक देखत सैल बन भूतल भूरि निधान ॥
verses.tr:
jathā suaṃjan aṃji dṛg sādhak siddh sujān
kautuk dekhat sail ban bhūtal bhūri nidhān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I reverence the pollen-like dust of the lotus feet of my master, bright fragrant, sweet. and delicious; pure extract of the root of ambrosia, potent to disperse all the attendant ills of life; like the holy ashes on the divine body of Sambhu, beautiful, auspicious, ecstatic. Applied to the forehead as a tilak, it cleanses from defilement the fair mirror of the human mind and gives it the mastery of all good. By recalling the lustre of the nails of the reverend guru’s feet, a divine splendour illamines the soul, dispersing the shades of error with its sun-like glory. How blessed he who takes it to his heart The mental vision brightens and expands, the night” of the world with sinand pain fades away, the actions of R^ma?, like diamonds and rubies, whether obvious or obscure, all alike become clear, in whichever direction the mine is explored..

By applying this collyrium as it were to the eyes, the student acquires both holiness and wisdom, and is able to understand his sportive career when on earth—on mountain, or in forest—and all the treasures of his grace.

sections.label: Doha 2
sections.name: सुनि समुझहिं जन मुदित मन मज्जहिं अति अनुराग

verses.sa:
गुरु पद रज मृदु मंजुल अंजन ।
नयन अमिअ दृग दोष बिभंजन ॥
verses.tr:
guru pad raj mṛdu maṃjul aṃjan
nayan amia dṛg doṣ bibhaṃjan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहिं करि बिमल बिबेक बिलोचन ।
बरनउँ राम चरित भव मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ kari bimal bibek bilocan
baranaum̐ rām carit bhav mocan

verses.sa:
बंदउँ प्रथम महीसुर चरना ।
मोह जनित संसय सब हरना ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ pratham mahīsur caranā
moh janit saṃsaya sab haranā

verses.sa:
सुजन समाज सकल गुन खानी ।
करउँ प्रनाम सप्रेम सुबानी ॥
verses.tr:
sujan samāj sakal gun khānī
karaum̐ pranām saprem subānī

verses.sa:
साधु चरित सुभ चरित कपासू ।
निरस बिसद गुनमय फल जासू ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu carit subh carit kapāsū
niras bisad gunamaya phal jāsū

verses.sa:
जो सहि दुख परछिद्र दुरावा ।
बंदनीय जेहिं जग जस पावा ॥
verses.tr:
jo sahi dukh parachidr durāvā
baṃdanīya jehiṃ jag jas pāvā

verses.sa:
मुद मंगलमय संत समाजू ।
जो जग जंगम तीरथराजू ॥
verses.tr:
mud maṃgalamaya saṃt samājū
jo jag jaṃgam tīratharājū

verses.sa:
राम भक्ति जहँ सुरसरि धारा ।
सरसइ ब्रह्म बिचार प्रचारा ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhakti jaham̐ surasari dhārā
sarasai brahm bicār pracārā

verses.sa:
बिधि निषेधमय कलि मल हरनी ।
करम कथा रबिनंदनि बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi niṣedhamaya kali mal haranī
karam kathā rabinaṃdani baranī

verses.sa:
हरि हर कथा बिराजति बेनी ।
सुनत सकल मुद मंगल देनी ॥
verses.tr:
hari har kathā birājati benī
sunat sakal mud maṃgal denī

verses.sa:
बटु बिस्वास अचल निज धरमा ।
तीरथराज समाज सुकरमा ॥
verses.tr:
baṭu bisvās acal nij dharamā
tīratharāj samāj sukaramā

verses.sa:
सबहिं सुलभ सब दिन सब देसा ।
सेवत सादर समन कलेसा ॥
verses.tr:
sabahiṃ sulabh sab din sab desā
sevat sādar saman kalesā

verses.sa:
अकथ अलौकिक तीरथराऊ ।
देइ सद्य फल प्रगट प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
akath alaukik tīratharāū
dei sadya phal pragaṭ prabhāū

verses.sa:
सुनि समुझहिं जन मुदित मन मज्जहिं अति अनुराग ।
लहहिं चारि फल अछत तनु साधु समाज प्रयाग ॥
verses.tr:
suni samujhahiṃ jan mudit man majjahiṃ ati anurāg
lahahiṃ cāri phal achat tanu sādhu samāj prayāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The dast of the guru’s feet is a soft and charming collyrium, like ambrosia for the eyes, to remove every defect of vision. With thishaving purified the eyes of my understanding, I proceed to relate the actions of Rama, the redeemer of the world. First [ reverence the feet of the great Brahman saints, potent to remove the doubts. engen-dered by error. In my heart, as with my voice, I reverence the whole body of the faithful, mines of perfection; whose good deeds resemble the produce of the cotton plant in its austerity, purity, and manifold usefulness, and in its hiding the defects even of those hy whom it has been most roughly treated: reverence to the saints, whatever the age or clime in which their glory was consummated. Their congregation is all joy and felicity, like the great tirtha Praydg endowed with motion: for faith in Rama is as the stream of the Ganges; contemplation on Brahma as the

- Sarasvati; and ritual, dealing with precepts and prohibitions for the purification of this iron age, as the sun-god's daughter, the Jamuna. Theanited flood of the Tribeni is represented by the legends of Hari and of Hara, filling all that hear with delight: the sacred fig-tree, by faith firm in its own traditions; and Prayag itself, by the assembly of the virtuous. Easy of access to all, on any day, ut any place, curing all the ills of pious devotees, is this unspeakable, spiritual chief tirtha, of manifest virtue and yielding immediate fruit.
At this Praydg of holy men, whoever hears and under-

sections.label: Doha 3
sections.name: बंदउँ संत समान चित हित अनहित नहिं कोइ

verses.sa:
मज्जन फल पेखिअ ततकाला ।
काक होहिं पिक बकउ मराला ॥
verses.tr:
majjan phal pekhia tatakālā
kāk hohiṃ pik bakau marālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि आचरज करै जनि कोई ।
सतसंगति महिमा नहिं गोई ॥
verses.tr:
suni ācaraj karai jani koī
satasaṃgati mahimā nahiṃ goī

verses.sa:
बालमीक नारद घटजोनी ।
निज निज मुखनि कही निज होनी ॥
verses.tr:
bālamīk nārad ghaṭajonī
nij nij mukhani kahī nij honī

verses.sa:
जलचर थलचर नभचर नाना ।
जे जड़ चेतन जीव जहाना ॥
verses.tr:
jalacar thalacar nabhacar nānā
je jar̤ cetan jīv jahānā

verses.sa:
मति कीरति गति भूति भलाई ।
जब जेहिं जतन जहाँ जेहिं पाई ॥
verses.tr:
mati kīrati gati bhūti bhalāī
jab jehiṃ jatan jahām̐ jehiṃ pāī

verses.sa:
सो जानब सतसंग प्रभाऊ ।
लोकहुँ बेद न आन उपाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
so jānab satasaṃg prabhāū
lokahum̐ bed na ān upāū

verses.sa:
बिनु सतसंग बिबेक न होई ।
राम कृपा बिनु सुलभ न सोई ॥
verses.tr:
binu satasaṃg bibek na hoī
rām kṛpā binu sulabh na soī

verses.sa:
सतसंगत मुद मंगल मूला ।
सोइ फल सिधि सब साधन फूला ॥
verses.tr:
satasaṃgat mud maṃgal mūlā
soi phal sidhi sab sādhan phūlā

verses.sa:
सठ सुधरहिं सतसंगति पाई ।
पारस परस कुधात सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
saṭh sudharahiṃ satasaṃgati pāī
pāras paras kudhāt suhāī

verses.sa:
बिधि बस सुजन कुसंगत परहीं ।
फनि मनि सम निज गुन अनुसरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi bas sujan kusaṃgat parahīṃ
phani mani sam nij gun anusarahīṃ

verses.sa:
बिधि हरि हर कबि कोबिद बानी ।
कहत साधु महिमा सकुचानी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi hari har kabi kobid bānī
kahat sādhu mahimā sakucānī

verses.sa:
सो मो सन कहि जात न कैसें ।
साक बनिक मनि गुन गन जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
so mo san kahi jāt na kaiseṃ
sāk banik mani gun gan jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
बंदउँ संत समान चित हित अनहित नहिं कोइ ।
अंजलि गत सुभ सुमन जिमि सम सुगंध कर दोइ ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ saṃt samān cit hit anahit nahiṃ koi
aṃjali gat subh suman jimi sam sugaṃdh kar doi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
संत सरल चित जगत हित जानि सुभाउ सनेहु ।
बालबिनय सुनि करि कृपा राम चरन रति देहु ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt saral cit jagat hit jāni subhāu sanehu
bālabinaya suni kari kṛpā rām caran rati dehu

trans: stands, and in spirit devoutly bathes, receives even in this life all four rewards.
In an instant behold the result or the immersion; the

crow becomes a parrot and the goose a swan. Iuet no one marvel at hearing this, for the influence of good company is no mystery. Valmiki, Narad and the jar-born Agastya have told its effect upon themselves. Whatever moves in the water, or on the earth, or in the air; every creature in the world, whether animate or inanimate, that has attained to knowledge, or glory, or salvation, or power, or virtue, by any work, at any time or place, has triumphed through association with the good; neither the world nor the Veda knows of any other expedient. Intercourse with the good is attainable only by the blessing of Rama and without it wisdom is impossible: it is the-root of all joy and felicity; its flowers are good works and its fruit perfection. By it the wicked are reformed: as when by the touch of the philosopher’s stone a vile metal becomes gold. If by mischance a good man falls into evil company, like the gem in a serpent’s head, he still retains his virtue. Brahma, Vishnu, Mahadeva, the wisest of the poets, all have failed to expound the pre-eminence of a saint: for me to tell it is, as it were, for a costermonger to expatiate on the merits of a set of jewels.

I reverence the saints of equable temperament, who regard neither friend nor foe, like a gracious flower which sheds its fragrance alike on both infolding hands. Ye saints, whose upright intention, whose catholic charity, and whose ready sympathy I acknowledge, hear my child-like prayer, be gracious to me and inspire me with devotion to the feet of Rama.

sections.label: Doha 4
sections.name: उदासीन अरि मीत हित सुनत जरहिं खल रीति

verses.sa:
बहुरि बंदि खल गन सतिभाएँ ।
जे बिनु काज दाहिनेहु बाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri baṃdi khal gan satibhāem̐
je binu kāj dāhinehu bāem̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पर हित हानि लाभ जिन्ह केरें ।
उजरें हरष बिषाद बसेरें ॥
verses.tr:
par hit hāni lābh jinh kereṃ
ujareṃ haraṣ biṣād basereṃ

verses.sa:
हरि हर जस राकेस राहु से ।
पर अकाज भट सहसबाहु से ॥
verses.tr:
hari har jas rākes rāhu se
par akāj bhaṭ sahasabāhu se

verses.sa:
जे पर दोष लखहिं सहसाखी ।
पर हित घृत जिन्ह के मन माखी ॥
verses.tr:
je par doṣ lakhahiṃ sahasākhī
par hit ghṛt jinh ke man mākhī

verses.sa:
तेज कृसानु रोष महिषेसा ।
अघ अवगुन धन धनी धनेसा ॥
verses.tr:
tej kṛsānu roṣ mahiṣesā
agh avagun dhan dhanī dhanesā

verses.sa:
उदय केत सम हित सबही के ।
कुंभकरन सम सोवत नीके ॥
verses.tr:
udaya ket sam hit sabahī ke
kuṃbhakaran sam sovat nīke

verses.sa:
पर अकाजु लगि तनु परिहरहीं ।
जिमि हिम उपल कृषी दलि गरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
par akāju lagi tanu pariharahīṃ
jimi him upal kṛṣī dali garahīṃ

verses.sa:
बंदउँ खल जस सेष सरोषा ।
सहस बदन बरनइ पर दोषा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ khal jas seṣ saroṣā
sahas badan baranai par doṣā

verses.sa:
पुनि प्रनवउँ पृथुराज समाना ।
पर अघ सुनइ सहस दस काना ॥
verses.tr:
puni pranavaum̐ pṛthurāj samānā
par agh sunai sahas das kānā

verses.sa:
बहुरि सक्र सम बिनवउँ तेही ।
संतत सुरानीक हित जेही ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri sakr sam binavaum̐ tehī
saṃtat surānīk hit jehī

verses.sa:
बचन बज्र जेहि सदा पिआरा ।
सहस नयन पर दोष निहारा ॥
verses.tr:
bacan bajr jehi sadā piārā
sahas nayan par doṣ nihārā

verses.sa:
उदासीन अरि मीत हित सुनत जरहिं खल रीति ।
जानि पानि जुग जोरि जन बिनती करइ सप्रीति ॥
verses.tr:
udāsīn ari mīt hit sunat jarahiṃ khal rīti
jāni pāni jug jori jan binatī karai saprīti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again, I would propitiate those wretches who without

cause delight to vex the righteous; with whom a neighbour's loss is gain; who rejoice in desolation and weep over pros perity; who are as an eclipse to the full-moon glory of Hari and Hara; who become as a giant with a thousand arms to work another’s woe; who have a thousand eyes to detect a neighbour's faults but, like flies on git, settle on his good points only to spoil them; quick as fire, implacable as the god of hell '; rich in crime and sin as Kuver is in gold; like un eclipse for the clouding of friendship, and as dead asleep as Kumbha-karn to everything good; if they can do any injury, as ready to sacrifice themselves as huilstones, that melt after destroying a crop; spiteful as the great serpent with a thousand tongues; and like Prithurej, with a thousand ears, to tell and hear of others’ faults; like the thousand-eyed Indra, too, ever delighting in much strong. drink and in a voice of thunder.
I know when they hear of philosophers, who regard friend or foe as friends, they are enraged; but I clasp my hands and entreat them piteously.

sections.label: Doha 5
sections.name: भलो भलाइहि पै लहइ लहइ निचाइहि नीचु

verses.sa:
मैं अपनी दिसि कीन्ह निहोरा ।
तिन्ह निज ओर न लाउब भोरा ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ apanī disi kīnh nihorā
tinh nij or na lāub bhorā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बायस पलिअहिं अति अनुरागा ।
होहिं निरामिष कबहुँ कि कागा ॥
verses.tr:
bāyas paliahiṃ ati anurāgā
hohiṃ nirāmiṣ kabahum̐ ki kāgā

verses.sa:
बंदउँ संत असज्जन चरना ।
दुखप्रद उभय बीच कछु बरना ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ saṃt asajjan caranā
dukhaprad ubhaya bīc kachu baranā

verses.sa:
बिछुरत एक प्रान हरि लेहीं ।
मिलत एक दुख दारुन देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bichurat ek prān hari lehīṃ
milat ek dukh dārun dehīṃ

verses.sa:
उपजहिं एक संग जग माहीं ।
जलज जोंक जिमि गुन बिलगाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
upajahiṃ ek saṃg jag māhīṃ
jalaj joṃk jimi gun bilagāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुधा सुरा सम साधू असाधू ।
जनक एक जग जलधि अगाधू ॥
verses.tr:
sudhā surā sam sādhū asādhū
janak ek jag jaladhi agādhū

verses.sa:
भल अनभल निज निज करतूती ।
लहत सुजस अपलोक बिभूती ॥
verses.tr:
bhal anabhal nij nij karatūtī
lahat sujas apalok bibhūtī

verses.sa:
सुधा सुधाकर सुरसरि साधू ।
गरल अनल कलिमल सरि ब्याधू ॥
verses.tr:
sudhā sudhākar surasari sādhū
garal anal kalimal sari byādhū

verses.sa:
गुन अवगुन जानत सब कोई ।
जो जेहि भाव नीक तेहि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
gun avagun jānat sab koī
jo jehi bhāv nīk tehi soī

verses.sa:
भलो भलाइहि पै लहइ लहइ निचाइहि नीचु ।
सुधा सराहिअ अमरताँ गरल सराहिअ मीचु ॥
verses.tr:
bhalo bhalāihi pai lahai lahai nicāihi nīcu
sudhā sarāhia amaratām̐ garal sarāhia mīcu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I have performed the role of supplication, nor will they forget, their part. However carefully you may ‘bring up a crow, it will still be a crow anda thief. I propitiate at once the feet of saints and sinners, who each give pain, but with a difference: for the first kill by absence, while,the second torture’ by their presence: as opposite as a lotus and a leech, though both alike are produced in water. Good and bad thus resemble nectar and intoxicating drink, which were both begotten by the one great ocean: each by its own acts attains to pre-eminence; the one fn honour, the other in dishonour; compare with the good, ambrosia, or the moon, or the Ganges; and with the bad, poison, or fire, or the river Karmness. Virtueand vice are known to all; but whatever is to a man’s taste that seemeth him good.
The good aim at goodness, and the vile at vileness; ambrosia is esteemed for giving immortality, and poison for causing death.

sections.label: Doha 6
sections.name: जड़ चेतन गुन दोषमय बिस्व कीन्ह करतार

verses.sa:
खल अघ अगुन साधू गुन गाहा ।
उभय अपार उदधि अवगाहा ॥
verses.tr:
khal agh agun sādhū gun gāhā
ubhaya apār udadhi avagāhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहि तें कछु गुन दोष बखाने ।
संग्रह त्याग न बिनु पहिचाने ॥
verses.tr:
tehi teṃ kachu gun doṣ bakhāne
saṃgrah tyāg na binu pahicāne

verses.sa:
भलेउ पोच सब बिधि उपजाए ।
गनि गुन दोष बेद बिलगाए ॥
verses.tr:
bhaleu poc sab bidhi upajāe
gani gun doṣ bed bilagāe

verses.sa:
कहहिं बेद इतिहास पुराना ।
बिधि प्रपंचु गुन अवगुन साना ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ bed itihās purānā
bidhi prapaṃcu gun avagun sānā

verses.sa:
दुख सुख पाप पुन्य दिन राती ।
साधु असाधु सुजाति कुजाती ॥
verses.tr:
dukh sukh pāp punya din rātī
sādhu asādhu sujāti kujātī

verses.sa:
दानव देव ऊँच अरु नीचू ।
अमिअ सुजीवनु माहुरु मीचू ॥
verses.tr:
dānav dev ūm̐c aru nīcū
amia sujīvanu māhuru mīcū

verses.sa:
माया ब्रह्म जीव जगदीसा ।
लच्छि अलच्छि रंक अवनीसा ॥
verses.tr:
māyā brahm jīv jagadīsā
lacchi alacchi raṃk avanīsā

verses.sa:
कासी मग सुरसरि क्रमनासा ।
मरु मारव महिदेव गवासा ॥
verses.tr:
kāsī mag surasari kramanāsā
maru mārav mahidev gavāsā

verses.sa:
सरग नरक अनुराग बिरागा ।
निगमागम गुन दोष बिभागा ॥
verses.tr:
sarag narak anurāg birāgā
nigamāgam gun doṣ bibhāgā

verses.sa:
जड़ चेतन गुन दोषमय बिस्व कीन्ह करतार ।
संत हंस गुन गहहिं पय परिहरि बारि बिकार ॥
verses.tr:
jar̤ cetan gun doṣamaya bisv kīnh karatār
saṃt haṃs gun gahahiṃ paya parihari bāri bikār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Why enumerate the faults and defects of the bad and the virtues of the good? both are a boundless and unfathomable ocean. Hence occasionylly virtue is reckoned as vice,

“improperly and from want of discrimination. For God hath created both, but it is the Veda that has distinguished one from the other. The heroic legends and the Puranas also, no less than the Vedas, recognize every kind of good and evil as creatures of the Creator: pain and pleasure; sin and religious merit; night and day; saint and sinner; high caste and low caste; demons and gods; great and small; ambrosia and Jife; poison and death; the visible world and the invisible God; life and the lord of life; rich and poor; the beggar and the king; K&si and Magadhe?; the Ganges and the Karamnase; the desert of Marwar and the rich plain of Melwa; the Brahmans and the butcher: heaven and hell; sensual passion and asceticism; the Vedas and the Tantras, and every variety of good and evil.
The Creator has made the universe to consist of things animate and inanimate; good and evil; a saint like a swan extracts the milk of goodness and rejects the worthless water.

sections.label: Doha 7
sections.name: ग्रह भेषज जल पवन पट पाइ कुजोग सुजोग

verses.sa:
अस बिबेक जब देइ बिधाता ।
तब तजि दोष गुनहिं मनु राता ॥
verses.tr:
as bibek jab dei bidhātā
tab taji doṣ gunahiṃ manu rātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
काल सुभाउ करम बरिआई ।
भलेउ प्रकृति बस चुकइ भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
kāl subhāu karam bariāī
bhaleu prakṛti bas cukai bhalāī

verses.sa:
सो सुधारि हरिजन जिमि लेहीं ।
दलि दुख दोष बिमल जसु देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
so sudhāri harijan jimi lehīṃ
dali dukh doṣ bimal jasu dehīṃ

verses.sa:
खलउ करहिं भल पाइ सुसंगू ।
मिटइ न मलिन सुभाउ अभंगू ॥
verses.tr:
khalau karahiṃ bhal pāi susaṃgū
miṭai na malin subhāu abhaṃgū

verses.sa:
लखि सुबेष जग बंचक जेऊ ।
बेष प्रताप पूजिअहिं तेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi subeṣ jag baṃcak jeū
beṣ pratāp pūjiahiṃ teū

verses.sa:
उधरहिं अंत न होइ निबाहू ।
कालनेमि जिमि रावन राहू ॥
verses.tr:
udharahiṃ aṃt na hoi nibāhū
kālanemi jimi rāvan rāhū

verses.sa:
किएहुँ कुबेष साधु सनमानू ।
जिमि जग जामवंत हनुमानू ॥
verses.tr:
kiehum̐ kubeṣ sādhu sanamānū
jimi jag jāmavaṃt hanumānū

verses.sa:
हानि कुसंग सुसंगति लाहू ।
लोकहुँ बेद बिदित सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
hāni kusaṃg susaṃgati lāhū
lokahum̐ bed bidit sab kāhū

verses.sa:
गगन चढ़इ रज पवन प्रसंगा ।
कीचहिं मिलइ नीच जल संगा ॥
verses.tr:
gagan car̤hai raj pavan prasaṃgā
kīcahiṃ milai nīc jal saṃgā

verses.sa:
साधु असाधु सदन सुक सारीं ।
सुमिरहिं राम देहिं गनि गारी ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu asādhu sadan suk sārīṃ
sumirahiṃ rām dehiṃ gani gārī

verses.sa:
धूम कुसंगति कारिख होई ।
लिखिअ पुरान मंजु मसि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
dhūm kusaṃgati kārikh hoī
likhia purān maṃju masi soī

verses.sa:
सोइ जल अनल अनिल संघाता ।
होइ जलद जग जीवन दाता ॥
verses.tr:
soi jal anal anil saṃghātā
hoi jalad jag jīvan dātā

verses.sa:
ग्रह भेषज जल पवन पट पाइ कुजोग सुजोग ।
होहि कुबस्तु सुबस्तु जग लखहिं सुलच्छन लोग ॥
verses.tr:
grah bheṣaj jal pavan paṭ pāi kujog sujog
hohi kubastu subastu jag lakhahiṃ sulacchan log
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सम प्रकास तम पाख दुहुँ नाम भेद बिधि कीन्ह ।
ससि सोषक पोषक समुझि जग जस अपजस दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
sam prakās tam pākh duhum̐ nām bhed bidhi kīnh
sasi soṣak poṣak samujhi jag jas apajas dīnh

verses.sa:
जड़ चेतन जग जीव जत सकल राममय जानि ।
बंदउँ सब के पद कमल सदा जोरि जुग पानि ॥
verses.tr:
jar̤ cetan jag jīv jat sakal rāmamaya jāni
baṃdaum̐ sab ke pad kamal sadā jori jug pāni

verses.sa:
देव दनुज नर नाग खग प्रेत पितर गंधर्ब ।
बंदउँ किंनर रजनिचर कृपा करहु अब सर्ब ॥
verses.tr:
dev danuj nar nāg khag pret pitar gaṃdharb
baṃdaum̐ kiṃnar rajanicar kṛpā karahu ab sarb

trans: When the Creator gives men this faculty of judgment they abandon error and become enamoured of the truth; but conquered by time, temperament, or fate, even the good, asa result of their humanity, may err from virtue; but Hari takes their body—so to speak—and corrects it, and, removing all sorrow and sin, cleanses it and glorifies them. If the bad through intercourse with the good dv good, their inherent badness is not effaced. An impostor of fair outward show may be honoured on account of his garb, but in the end he is exposed and does not succeed, like Kalanemi, or Ravan, or Rahu. The good are honoured, not withstanding their mean appearance, like bear Jamavant or. the monkey Hanum^n. Bad company is loss, and good company is gain; this is a truth recognized both by the world and the Veda. In company with the wind the dust flies heavenwards; if it joins water, it becomes mud and sinks. According to the character of the house in which a parrot or maina is trained, it learns either to repeat the name of Rama or to give abuse. With the ignorant, soot is mere refuse; but it may make good ink, and be used even for copying a Purana; while water, fire, and air combined become an earth-refresbing rain-cloud.;

fhe planets, medicines. water, air, clothes, all are good or bad things according as their sccompaniments are good or bad; and people observe this distinction. Both lunar fortnights are equal as regards darkness and light; but a difference in name has been wisely made, and as the moon waxes or wanes the fortnight is held in high or low esteem. Knowing that the whole universe, whether animate or inanimate, is pervaded by the spirit of Rama, I reverence with clasped hands the lotus feet of all gods, giants, men, serpents, birds, ghosts, departed ancestors, (tandharvas, Kinnaras, demons of the night—I pray ye all be gracious to me. ed 3

sections.label: Doha 8
sections.name: भाग छोट अभिलाषु बड़ करउँ एक बिस्वास

verses.sa:
आकर चारि लाख चौरासी ।
जाति जीव जल थल नभ बासी ॥
verses.tr:
ākar cāri lākh caurāsī
jāti jīv jal thal nabh bāsī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सीय राममय सब जग जानी ।
करउँ प्रनाम जोरि जुग पानी ॥
verses.tr:
sīya rāmamaya sab jag jānī
karaum̐ pranām jori jug pānī

verses.sa:
जानि कृपाकर किंकर मोहू ।
सब मिलि करहु छाड़ि छल छोहू ॥
verses.tr:
jāni kṛpākar kiṃkar mohū
sab mili karahu chār̤i chal chohū

verses.sa:
निज बुधि बल भरोस मोहि नाहीं ।
तातें बिनय करउँ सब पाही ॥
verses.tr:
nij budhi bal bharos mohi nāhīṃ
tāteṃ binaya karaum̐ sab pāhī

verses.sa:
करन चहउँ रघुपति गुन गाहा ।
लघु मति मोरि चरित अवगाहा ॥
verses.tr:
karan cahaum̐ raghupati gun gāhā
laghu mati mori carit avagāhā

verses.sa:
सूझ न एकउ अंग उपाऊ ।
मन मति रंक मनोरथ राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sūjh na ekau aṃg upāū
man mati raṃk manorath rāū

verses.sa:
मति अति नीच ऊँचि रुचि आछी ।
चहिअ अमिअ जग जुरइ न छाछी ॥
verses.tr:
mati ati nīc ūm̐ci ruci āchī
cahia amia jag jurai na chāchī

verses.sa:
छमिहहिं सज्जन मोरि ढिठाई ।
सुनिहहिं बालबचन मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
chamihahiṃ sajjan mori ḍhiṭhāī
sunihahiṃ bālabacan man lāī

verses.sa:
जौ बालक कह तोतरि बाता ।
सुनहिं मुदित मन पितु अरु माता ॥
verses.tr:
jau bālak kah totari bātā
sunahiṃ mudit man pitu aru mātā

verses.sa:
हँसिहहि कूर कुटिल कुबिचारी ।
जे पर दूषन भूषनधारी ॥
verses.tr:
ham̐sihahi kūr kuṭil kubicārī
je par dūṣan bhūṣanadhārī

verses.sa:
निज कवित केहि लाग न नीका ।
सरस होउ अथवा अति फीका ॥
verses.tr:
nij kavit kehi lāg na nīkā
saras hou athavā ati phīkā

verses.sa:
जे पर भनिति सुनत हरषाही ।
ते बर पुरुष बहुत जग नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je par bhaniti sunat haraṣāhī
te bar puruṣ bahut jag nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जग बहु नर सर सरि सम भाई ।
जे निज बाढ़ि बढ़हिं जल पाई ॥
verses.tr:
jag bahu nar sar sari sam bhāī
je nij bār̤hi bar̤hahiṃ jal pāī

verses.sa:
सज्जन सकृत सिंधु सम कोई ।
देखि पूर बिधु बाढ़इ जोई ॥
verses.tr:
sajjan sakṛt siṃdhu sam koī
dekhi pūr bidhu bār̤hai joī

verses.sa:
भाग छोट अभिलाषु बड़ करउँ एक बिस्वास ।
पैहहिं सुख सुनि सुजन सब खल करहहिं उपहास ॥
verses.tr:
bhāg choṭ abhilāṣu bar̤ karaum̐ ek bisvās
paihahiṃ sukh suni sujan sab khal karahahiṃ upahās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By four modes of birth are produced 84 lakhs of species inhabiting the air, the water and the earth. With clasped hand I perform an act of adoration, recognizing the whole world as pervaded by the spirit of Sita and Rama. In your compassion regard me as your servant, and dissembling no longer, be kind and affectionate. Ihave no confidence in the strength of my own wisdom, and therefore I supplicate you all, I would narrate the great deeds of Raghupati, but my ability is little and his acts unfathomable. I am conscious that I have no skill or capacity; my intellect in short is beggarly, while my ambition is imperial; 1 am thirsting for nectar, when not even skim-milk is to be had. «Good people, all pardon my presumption and listen to my childish babbling, as a father and mother delight to hear the lisping prattle of their little one. Perverse and malignant Fools may laugh, who pick out faults in others wherewith to adorn themselves. Every one is pleased with his own rhymes, whether they be pungent or insipid; but those who praise another’s voice are good men, of whom there are few in the world; there are many enough like the rivers, which on getting a rainfall swell out a flood of their own, but barely one like the generous ocean, which swells on beholding the fulness of the moon.
My lot is low, my purpose high, hut Iam confident of one thing, that the good will be gratified to hear me, though fools may laugh.

sections.label: Doha 9
sections.name: भनिति मोरि सब गुन रहित बिस्व बिदित गुन एक

verses.sa:
खल परिहास होइ हित मोरा ।
काक कहहिं कलकंठ कठोरा ॥
verses.tr:
khal parihās hoi hit morā
kāk kahahiṃ kalakaṃṭh kaṭhorā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हंसहि बक दादुर चातकही ।
हँसहिं मलिन खल बिमल बतकही ॥
verses.tr:
haṃsahi bak dādur cātakahī
ham̐sahiṃ malin khal bimal batakahī

verses.sa:
कबित रसिक न राम पद नेहू ।
तिन्ह कहँ सुखद हास रस एहू ॥
verses.tr:
kabit rasik na rām pad nehū
tinh kaham̐ sukhad hās ras ehū

verses.sa:
भाषा भनिति भोरि मति मोरी ।
हँसिबे जोग हँसें नहिं खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
bhāṣā bhaniti bhori mati morī
ham̐sibe jog ham̐seṃ nahiṃ khorī

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद प्रीति न सामुझि नीकी ।
तिन्हहि कथा सुनि लागहि फीकी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad prīti na sāmujhi nīkī
tinhahi kathā suni lāgahi phīkī

verses.sa:
हरि हर पद रति मति न कुतरकी ।
तिन्ह कहुँ मधुर कथा रघुवर की ॥
verses.tr:
hari har pad rati mati na kutarakī
tinh kahum̐ madhur kathā raghuvar kī

verses.sa:
राम भगति भूषित जियँ जानी ।
सुनिहहिं सुजन सराहि सुबानी ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati bhūṣit jiyam̐ jānī
sunihahiṃ sujan sarāhi subānī

verses.sa:
कबि न होउँ नहिं बचन प्रबीनू ।
सकल कला सब बिद्या हीनू ॥
verses.tr:
kabi na houm̐ nahiṃ bacan prabīnū
sakal kalā sab bidyā hīnū

verses.sa:
आखर अरथ अलंकृति नाना ।
छंद प्रबंध अनेक बिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
ākhar arath alaṃkṛti nānā
chaṃd prabaṃdh anek bidhānā

verses.sa:
भाव भेद रस भेद अपारा ।
कबित दोष गुन बिबिध प्रकारा ॥
verses.tr:
bhāv bhed ras bhed apārā
kabit doṣ gun bibidh prakārā

verses.sa:
कबित बिबेक एक नहिं मोरें ।
सत्य कहउँ लिखि कागद कोरे ॥
verses.tr:
kabit bibek ek nahiṃ moreṃ
satya kahaum̐ likhi kāgad kore

verses.sa:
भनिति मोरि सब गुन रहित बिस्व बिदित गुन एक ।
सो बिचारि सुनिहहिं सुमति जिन्ह कें बिमल बिवेक ॥
verses.tr:
bhaniti mori sab gun rahit bisv bidit gun ek
so bicāri sunihahiṃ sumati jinh keṃ bimal bivek
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The laughter of fools will be grateful to me; the crow calls the koil’s voice harsh. The goose ridicules the swan, and the frog the chd'ax;so the low and vile abuse pure verse. As they have no taste for poetry nor love for Rama, Iam glad that they should laugh. If my homely speech and poor wit are fit subjects for laughter, let them laugh; it is no fault of mine. If they have no understanding of

true devotion to Lord, the tale will seem insipid enough: but to the true and orthodox worshippers of Hari and Hara the story of Raghubar will be sweet as honey. The singer’s devotion to Ram will by itself be sufficient embellish-ment to make the good hear and praise the melody. Though no poet, nor clever, nor accomplished; though unskilled in every art and science; though all the elegant devices of letters and rhetoric, the countless variations of metre, the infinite divisions of sentiment and style, and all the defects and excellences of verse, and the gift to distinguish between them are unknown to me. I declare and record it ‘on a fair white sheet — Doha 13.
That though my style has not a single charm of its own, it has a charm known throughout the world, which men of discernment will ponder as they read—

sections.label: Doha 10
sections.name: प्रिय लागिहि अति सबहि मम भनिति राम जस संग

verses.sa:
एहि महँ रघुपति नाम उदारा ।
अति पावन पुरान श्रुति सारा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi maham̐ raghupati nām udārā
ati pāvan purān śruti sārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मंगल भवन अमंगल हारी ।
उमा सहित जेहि जपत पुरारी ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal bhavan amaṃgal hārī
umā sahit jehi japat purārī

verses.sa:
भनिति बिचित्र सुकबि कृत जोऊ ।
राम नाम बिनु सोह न सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bhaniti bicitr sukabi kṛt joū
rām nām binu soh na soū

verses.sa:
बिधुबदनी सब भाँति सँवारी ।
सोन न बसन बिना बर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhubadanī sab bhām̐ti sam̐vārī
son na basan binā bar nārī

verses.sa:
सब गुन रहित कुकबि कृत बानी ।
राम नाम जस अंकित जानी ॥
verses.tr:
sab gun rahit kukabi kṛt bānī
rām nām jas aṃkit jānī

verses.sa:
सादर कहहिं सुनहिं बुध ताही ।
मधुकर सरिस संत गुनग्राही ॥
verses.tr:
sādar kahahiṃ sunahiṃ budh tāhī
madhukar saris saṃt gunagrāhī

verses.sa:
जदपि कबित रस एकउ नाही ।
राम प्रताप प्रकट एहि माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi kabit ras ekau nāhī
rām pratāp prakaṭ ehi māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सोइ भरोस मोरें मन आवा ।
केहिं न सुसंग बडप्पनु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
soi bharos moreṃ man āvā
kehiṃ na susaṃg baḍappanu pāvā

verses.sa:
धूमउ तजइ सहज करुआई ।
अगरु प्रसंग सुगंध बसाई ॥
verses.tr:
dhūmau tajai sahaj karuāī
agaru prasaṃg sugaṃdh basāī

verses.sa:
भनिति भदेस बस्तु भलि बरनी ।
राम कथा जग मंगल करनी ॥
verses.tr:
bhaniti bhades bastu bhali baranī
rām kathā jag maṃgal karanī

verses.sa: मंगल करनि कलि मल हरनि तुलसी कथा रघुनाथ की ॥
verses.tr: maṃgal karani kali mal harani tulasī kathā raghunāth kī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: गति कूर कबिता सरित की ज्यों सरित पावन पाथ की ॥
verses.tr: gati kūr kabitā sarit kī jyoṃ sarit pāvan pāth kī

verses.sa: प्रभु सुजस संगति भनिति भलि होइहि सुजन मन भावनी ॥
verses.tr: prabhu sujas saṃgati bhaniti bhali hoihi sujan man bhāvanī

verses.sa: भव अंग भूति मसान की सुमिरत सुहावनि पावनी ॥
verses.tr: bhav aṃg bhūti masān kī sumirat suhāvani pāvanī

verses.sa:
प्रिय लागिहि अति सबहि मम भनिति राम जस संग ।
दारु बिचारु कि करइ कोउ बंदिअ मलय प्रसंग ॥
verses.tr:
priya lāgihi ati sabahi mam bhaniti rām jas saṃg
dāru bicāru ki karai kou baṃdia malaya prasaṃg
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
स्याम सुरभि पय बिसद अति गुनद करहिं सब पान ।
गिरा ग्राम्य सिय राम जस गावहिं सुनहिं सुजान ॥
verses.tr:
syām surabhi paya bisad ati gunad karahiṃ sab pān
girā grāmya siya rām jas gāvahiṃ sunahiṃ sujān

trans: The gracious name of Raghupati; all-purifying essence of the PurAnas and the Veda, abode of all that is auspicious, destroyer of all that is inauspicious, ever murmured in prayer by Uma and the great Tripurari. The most elegant composition of the most talented poet has no real beauty if the name of Rama is not in it: in the same way us a lovely woman adorned with the richest Jewels is vile if unclothed. But the most worthless production of the fecblest versifier, if adorned with the name of Rama, is heard and repeated with reverence by the wise, who extract what is good in it, like bees gathering honey: though the poetry has nota single merit, the glory of Rama is manifested thereby. This is the confidence which has possessed my soul; is there anything which good company fails to exalt? Thus smoke forgets its natural puogency and in incense yields a sweet scent. My Language is that in vulgar use, but my subject is the -highest, the story of Rama, enrapturing the world.
How pure and blest Siva’s breast show the vile stains of earth So my poor song flows bright and strong illumed by Rama'’s worth.

From its connection with the glory of Rama, my verse will be most grateful to every one. Any wood that comes from the Malaya sandal-groves is valued; who considers what kind of wood it is Though a cow be black, its milk is pure and wholesome, and all men drink it; and 60, though my speech is rough, it tellsthe glory of Sita and Rama, and will therefore be heard and repeated with pleasure by sensible people.

sections.label: Doha 11
sections.name: जुगुति बेधि पुनि पोहिअहिं रामचरित बर ताग

verses.sa:
मनि मानिक मुकुता छबि जैसी ।
अहि गिरि गज सिर सोह न तैसी ॥
verses.tr:
mani mānik mukutā chabi jaisī
ahi giri gaj sir soh na taisī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नृप किरीट तरुनी तनु पाई ।
लहहिं सकल सोभा अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp kirīṭ tarunī tanu pāī
lahahiṃ sakal sobhā adhikāī

verses.sa:
तैसेहिं सुकबि कबित बुध कहहीं ।
उपजहिं अनत अनत छबि लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
taisehiṃ sukabi kabit budh kahahīṃ
upajahiṃ anat anat chabi lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
भगति हेतु बिधि भवन बिहाई ।
सुमिरत सारद आवति धाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati hetu bidhi bhavan bihāī
sumirat sārad āvati dhāī

verses.sa:
राम चरित सर बिनु अन्हवाएँ ।
सो श्रम जाइ न कोटि उपाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
rām carit sar binu anhavāem̐
so śram jāi na koṭi upāem̐

verses.sa:
कबि कोबिद अस हृदयँ बिचारी ।
गावहिं हरि जस कलि मल हारी ॥
verses.tr:
kabi kobid as hṛdayam̐ bicārī
gāvahiṃ hari jas kali mal hārī

verses.sa:
कीन्हें प्राकृत जन गुन गाना ।
सिर धुनि गिरा लगत पछिताना ॥
verses.tr:
kīnheṃ prākṛt jan gun gānā
sir dhuni girā lagat pachitānā

verses.sa:
हृदय सिंधु मति सीप समाना ।
स्वाति सारदा कहहिं सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdaya siṃdhu mati sīp samānā
svāti sāradā kahahiṃ sujānā

verses.sa:
जौं बरषइ बर बारि बिचारू ।
होहिं कबित मुकुतामनि चारू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ baraṣai bar bāri bicārū
hohiṃ kabit mukutāmani cārū

verses.sa:
जुगुति बेधि पुनि पोहिअहिं रामचरित बर ताग ।
पहिरहिं सज्जन बिमल उर सोभा अति अनुराग ॥
verses.tr:
juguti bedhi puni pohiahiṃ rāmacarit bar tāg
pahirahiṃ sajjan bimal ur sobhā ati anurāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: So long as the diamond remains in the serpent’s head, the ruby on the mountain top, or the pearl in its elephant’s brow, they are all without beauty; but in a king’s diadem or on a lovely woman they become beautiful exceedingly. Similarly, as wise men tell, poetry is born of one faculty, but beautified by another; for it is in answer to pious prayer that the Muse leaves her heavenly abode and speeds to earth; without immersion in the fountain of Rama's deeds all labour and trouble count for nothing. An intelligent poet understands this, and sings only of Hari, the redeemer, and his virtues. To recount the doings of common people is mere idle beating of the head, which the Muse loathes. Genius is, as it were,a shell io the sea of the soul, waiting for the October rain of inspiration; if a gracious shower falls, each drop becomes a lovely pearl of poetry.
Then dexterously pierced and strung together on the thread of Rama’s adventures, they form a beautiful chain to be worn on a good man’s breast.

sections.label: Doha 12
sections.name: सारद सेस महेस बिधि आगम निगम पुरान

verses.sa:
जे जनमे कलिकाल कराला ।
करतब बायस बेष मराला ॥
verses.tr:
je janame kalikāl karālā
karatab bāyas beṣ marālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चलत कुपंथ बेद मग छाँड़े ।
कपट कलेवर कलि मल भाँड़ें ॥
verses.tr:
calat kupaṃth bed mag chām̐r̤e
kapaṭ kalevar kali mal bhām̐r̤eṃ

verses.sa:
बंचक भगत कहाइ राम के ।
किंकर कंचन कोह काम के ॥
verses.tr:
baṃcak bhagat kahāi rām ke
kiṃkar kaṃcan koh kām ke

verses.sa:
तिन्ह महँ प्रथम रेख जग मोरी ।
धींग धरमध्वज धंधक धोरी ॥
verses.tr:
tinh maham̐ pratham rekh jag morī
dhīṃg dharamadhvaj dhaṃdhak dhorī

verses.sa:
जौं अपने अवगुन सब कहऊँ ।
बाढ़इ कथा पार नहिं लहऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ apane avagun sab kahaūm̐
bār̤hai kathā pār nahiṃ lahaūm̐

verses.sa:
ताते मैं अति अलप बखाने ।
थोरे महुँ जानिहहिं सयाने ॥
verses.tr:
tāte maiṃ ati alap bakhāne
thore mahum̐ jānihahiṃ sayāne

verses.sa:
समुझि बिबिधि बिधि बिनती मोरी ।
कोउ न कथा सुनि देइहि खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi bibidhi bidhi binatī morī
kou na kathā suni deihi khorī

verses.sa:
एतेहु पर करिहहिं जे असंका ।
मोहि ते अधिक ते जड़ मति रंका ॥
verses.tr:
etehu par karihahiṃ je asaṃkā
mohi te adhik te jar̤ mati raṃkā

verses.sa:
कबि न होउँ नहिं चतुर कहावउँ ।
मति अनुरूप राम गुन गावउँ ॥
verses.tr:
kabi na houm̐ nahiṃ catur kahāvaum̐
mati anurūp rām gun gāvaum̐

verses.sa:
कहँ रघुपति के चरित अपारा ।
कहँ मति मोरि निरत संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
kaham̐ raghupati ke carit apārā
kaham̐ mati mori nirat saṃsārā

verses.sa:
जेहिं मारुत गिरि मेरु उड़ाहीं ।
कहहु तूल केहि लेखे माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ mārut giri meru ur̤āhīṃ
kahahu tūl kehi lekhe māhīṃ

verses.sa:
समुझत अमित राम प्रभुताई ।
करत कथा मन अति कदराई ॥
verses.tr:
samujhat amit rām prabhutāī
karat kathā man ati kadarāī

verses.sa:
सारद सेस महेस बिधि आगम निगम पुरान ।
नेति नेति कहि जासु गुन करहिं निरंतर गान ॥
verses.tr:
sārad ses mahes bidhi āgam nigam purān
neti neti kahi jāsu gun karahiṃ niraṃtar gān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Men born in this grim iron age are outwardly swans, but inwardly as black as crows; walking in evil paths, abandoning the Veda!, embodiments of falsehood, vessels of impurity, hypocrites, professing devotion to Rama, but

slaves of gold, of passion, and of lust. Among them I give the first place to myself, a hypocrite, alas! of the very first rank; but were I to tell all my vices, the list would so grow that it would have no end. I have therefore said but very little, but a word is enough for the wise. Let none of my hearers blame me for offering so many apologies; whoever is troubled in mind by them is more stupid and dull of wit than I am myself. Though I am no poet, and have no pretensions to cleverness, I sing as best I can the virtues of Rama. How unfathomable his actions, how shallow my poor world-entangled intellect Before the strong wind that could uproot Mount Meru, of what account is such a mere flock of cotton as I am When I think of Rama’s infinite majesty I tremble as I write.
For Sarasvati, Sesh-nag, Siva and Brahma, the Shastras, the Veda, the PurAnas, all are unceasingly singing his perfection, yet fail to declare it.

sections.label: Doha 13
sections.name: अति अपार जे सरित बर जौं नृप सेतु कराहिं

verses.sa:
सब जानत प्रभु प्रभुता सोई ।
तदपि कहें बिनु रहा न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
sab jānat prabhu prabhutā soī
tadapi kaheṃ binu rahā na koī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तहाँ बेद अस कारन राखा ।
भजन प्रभाउ भाँति बहु भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
tahām̐ bed as kāran rākhā
bhajan prabhāu bhām̐ti bahu bhāṣā

verses.sa:
एक अनीह अरूप अनामा ।
अज सच्चिदानंद पर धामा ॥
verses.tr:
ek anīh arūp anāmā
aj saccidānaṃd par dhāmā

verses.sa:
ब्यापक बिस्वरूप भगवाना ।
तेहिं धरि देह चरित कृत नाना ॥
verses.tr:
byāpak bisvarūp bhagavānā
tehiṃ dhari deh carit kṛt nānā

verses.sa:
सो केवल भगतन हित लागी ।
परम कृपाल प्रनत अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
so keval bhagatan hit lāgī
param kṛpāl pranat anurāgī

verses.sa:
जेहि जन पर ममता अति छोहू ।
जेहिं करुना करि कीन्ह न कोहू ॥
verses.tr:
jehi jan par mamatā ati chohū
jehiṃ karunā kari kīnh na kohū

verses.sa:
गई बहोर गरीब नेवाजू ।
सरल सबल साहिब रघुराजू ॥
verses.tr:
gaī bahor garīb nevājū
saral sabal sāhib raghurājū

verses.sa:
बुध बरनहिं हरि जस अस जानी ।
करहि पुनीत सुफल निज बानी ॥
verses.tr:
budh baranahiṃ hari jas as jānī
karahi punīt suphal nij bānī

verses.sa:
तेहिं बल मैं रघुपति गुन गाथा ।
कहिहउँ नाइ राम पद माथा ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ bal maiṃ raghupati gun gāthā
kahihaum̐ nāi rām pad māthā

verses.sa:
मुनिन्ह प्रथम हरि कीरति गाई ।
तेहिं मग चलत सुगम मोहि भाई ॥
verses.tr:
muninh pratham hari kīrati gāī
tehiṃ mag calat sugam mohi bhāī

verses.sa:
अति अपार जे सरित बर जौं नृप सेतु कराहिं ।
चढि पिपीलिकउ परम लघु बिनु श्रम पारहि जाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
ati apār je sarit bar jauṃ nṛp setu karāhiṃ
caḍhi pipīlikau param laghu binu śram pārahi jāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All know the greatness of the lord to be thus unutterable, yet none can refrain from attempting to expound it. For this reason the Veda also has declared many different modes of effectual worship. There is one God, passionless, formless, uncreated, the universal soul, the supreme spirit, the all-pervading, whose shadow is the world; who has become incarnate and does many things, only for the love that he bears to his faithful people; all-gracious and compassionate to the humble; who in his mercy ever refrains from anger against those whom he loves and knows to be his own: restorer of the past; protector of the poor; all-good, all-powerful, the lord Raghuraj. In this belief the wise sing the glory of Hari, and their sewg thus becomes holy and meritorious. I, too, bowing my head to Rama 3 feet, am emboldened to sing his fame, following a path which has been made easy by the divine bards who have trodden it before me.;
As when once a king has prepared a bridge over a broad
stream, an ant, insignificant as it is, is able to cross without
difficulty e g

sections.label: Doha 14
sections.name: सरल कबित कीरति बिमल सोइ आदरहिं सुजान

verses.sa:
एहि प्रकार बल मनहि देखाई ।
करिहउँ रघुपति कथा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
ehi prakār bal manahi dekhāī
karihaum̐ raghupati kathā suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्यास आदि कबि पुंगव नाना ।
जिन्ह सादर हरि सुजस बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
byās ādi kabi puṃgav nānā
jinh sādar hari sujas bakhānā

verses.sa:
चरन कमल बंदउँ तिन्ह केरे ।
पुरवहुँ सकल मनोरथ मेरे ॥
verses.tr:
caran kamal baṃdaum̐ tinh kere
puravahum̐ sakal manorath mere

verses.sa:
कलि के कबिन्ह करउँ परनामा ।
जिन्ह बरने रघुपति गुन ग्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
kali ke kabinh karaum̐ paranāmā
jinh barane raghupati gun grāmā

verses.sa:
जे प्राकृत कबि परम सयाने ।
भाषाँ जिन्ह हरि चरित बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
je prākṛt kabi param sayāne
bhāṣām̐ jinh hari carit bakhāne

verses.sa:
भए जे अहहिं जे होइहहिं आगें ।
प्रनवउँ सबहिं कपट सब त्यागें ॥
verses.tr:
bhae je ahahiṃ je hoihahiṃ āgeṃ
pranavaum̐ sabahiṃ kapaṭ sab tyāgeṃ

verses.sa:
होहु प्रसन्न देहु बरदानू ।
साधु समाज भनिति सनमानू ॥
verses.tr:
hohu prasann dehu baradānū
sādhu samāj bhaniti sanamānū

verses.sa:
जो प्रबंध बुध नहिं आदरहीं ।
सो श्रम बादि बाल कबि करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jo prabaṃdh budh nahiṃ ādarahīṃ
so śram bādi bāl kabi karahīṃ

verses.sa:
कीरति भनिति भूति भलि सोई ।
सुरसरि सम सब कहँ हित होई ॥
verses.tr:
kīrati bhaniti bhūti bhali soī
surasari sam sab kaham̐ hit hoī

verses.sa:
राम सुकीरति भनिति भदेसा ।
असमंजस अस मोहि अँदेसा ॥
verses.tr:
rām sukīrati bhaniti bhadesā
asamaṃjas as mohi am̐desā

verses.sa:
तुम्हरी कृपा सुलभ सोउ मोरे ।
सिअनि सुहावनि टाट पटोरे ॥
verses.tr:
tumharī kṛpā sulabh sou more
siani suhāvani ṭāṭ paṭore

verses.sa:
सरल कबित कीरति बिमल सोइ आदरहिं सुजान ।
सहज बयर बिसराइ रिपु जो सुनि करहिं बखान ॥
verses.tr:
saral kabit kīrati bimal soi ādarahiṃ sujān
sahaj bayar bisarāi ripu jo suni karahiṃ bakhān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सो न होइ बिनु बिमल मति मोहि मति बल अति थोर ।
करहु कृपा हरि जस कहउँ पुनि पुनि करउँ निहोर ॥
verses.tr:
so na hoi binu bimal mati mohi mati bal ati thor
karahu kṛpā hari jas kahaum̐ puni puni karaum̐ nihor

verses.sa:
कबि कोबिद रघुबर चरित मानस मंजु मराल ।
बाल बिनय सुनि सुरुचि लखि मोपर होहु कृपाल ॥
verses.tr:
kabi kobid raghubar carit mānas maṃju marāl
bāl binaya suni suruci lakhi mopar hohu kṛpāl

verses.sa:
बंदउँ मुनि पद कंजु रामायन जेहिं निरमयउ ।
सखर सुकोमल मंजु दोष रहित दूषन सहित ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ muni pad kaṃju rāmāyan jehiṃ niramayau
sakhar sukomal maṃju doṣ rahit dūṣan sahit

verses.sa:
बंदउँ चारिउ बेद भव बारिधि बोहित सरिस ।
जिन्हहि न सपनेहुँ खेद बरनत रघुबर बिसद जसु ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ cāriu bed bhav bāridhi bohit saris
jinhahi na sapanehum̐ khed baranat raghubar bisad jasu

verses.sa:
बंदउँ बिधि पद रेनु भव सागर जेहि कीन्ह जहँ ।
संत सुधा ससि धेनु प्रगटे खल बिष बारुनी ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ bidhi pad renu bhav sāgar jehi kīnh jaham̐
saṃt sudhā sasi dhenu pragaṭe khal biṣ bārunī

verses.sa:
बिबुध बिप्र बुध ग्रह चरन बंदि कहउँ कर जोरि ।
होइ प्रसन्न पुरवहु सकल मंजु मनोरथ मोरि ॥
verses.tr:
bibudh bipr budh grah caran baṃdi kahaum̐ kar jori
hoi prasann puravahu sakal maṃju manorath mori

trans: In this manner re-assuring myself, I undertake to recount Rama’s charming adventures, as they have been reverently told by Vydsa and the other great poets, whose lotus feet I adore, praying, Fulfil ye my desire. I reverence also the poets of these latter days, who have sung of Raghupati, bards of high intelligence, who have written in Prakrit and the vulgar tongue. All who have been in time past, or who now are, or who hereafter shall be, I bow to all in the utmost good faith and sincerity. Be propitious and grant this boon, that in assemblies of good men my song may be honoured If the good and wise will not honour it, the silly poet has had all his labour in vain. The only fame, or poetry, or power, that is of any worth, is that which like Ganges water is good for all. The incongruity between Rama’s glory and my rude speech makes me hesitate; but by your favour all will turn out well; for even coarse cloth, if embroi-dered with silk, becomes beautiful. Be kind enough to think of this, and my style will then match the excellence of my theme.

A clear style and an exalted theme are both commend-able; and when they are combined, an enemy even, forgetting his natural hostility, will repeat the strain. But such a combination is not to be acquired without genius, and genius I have none; so again and again I beg of you to bear with me while I sing the glory of Hari. The great poets are like the swans sporting in the Manassa Lake of Hari's deeds; look on me as a well-meaning child and make allowances.

I reverence the lotus feet of the great sage who composed the Ramayana, smooth strains on rough topics, and faultless, though a story of the faulty.!| I reverence the Vedas which are like a boat in which to cross the ocean of existence, without ever dreaming of weariness, while recounting Rama's excellent glory. I reverence the dust on the feet of Brahma, creator of this ocean-like world, from which have been produced men, good and bad; as of old from the same source came at once ambrosia, the moon, and the cow Kamadhenn, and also poison and intoxicating liquor.
Reverencing with clasped hands gods, Brahmans, philosophers, and sages, I pray—* Be gracious to me and accomplish all my fair desire.’

sections.label: Doha 15
sections.name: सपनेहुँ साचेहुँ मोहि पर जौं हर गौरि पसाउ

verses.sa:
पुनि बंदउँ सारद सुरसरिता ।
जुगल पुनीत मनोहर चरिता ॥
verses.tr:
puni baṃdaum̐ sārad surasaritā
jugal punīt manohar caritā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मज्जन पान पाप हर एका ।
कहत सुनत एक हर अबिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
majjan pān pāp har ekā
kahat sunat ek har abibekā

verses.sa:
गुर पितु मातु महेस भवानी ।
प्रनवउँ दीनबंधु दिन दानी ॥
verses.tr:
gur pitu mātu mahes bhavānī
pranavaum̐ dīnabaṃdhu din dānī

verses.sa:
सेवक स्वामि सखा सिय पी के ।
हित निरुपधि सब बिधि तुलसीके ॥
verses.tr:
sevak svāmi sakhā siya pī ke
hit nirupadhi sab bidhi tulasīke

verses.sa:
कलि बिलोकि जग हित हर गिरिजा ।
साबर मंत्र जाल जिन्ह सिरिजा ॥
verses.tr:
kali biloki jag hit har girijā
sābar maṃtr jāl jinh sirijā

verses.sa:
अनमिल आखर अरथ न जापू ।
प्रगट प्रभाउ महेस प्रतापू ॥
verses.tr:
anamil ākhar arath na jāpū
pragaṭ prabhāu mahes pratāpū

verses.sa:
सो उमेस मोहि पर अनुकूला ।
करिहिं कथा मुद मंगल मूला ॥
verses.tr:
so umes mohi par anukūlā
karihiṃ kathā mud maṃgal mūlā

verses.sa:
सुमिरि सिवा सिव पाइ पसाऊ ।
बरनउँ रामचरित चित चाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri sivā siv pāi pasāū
baranaum̐ rāmacarit cit cāū

verses.sa:
भनिति मोरि सिव कृपाँ बिभाती ।
ससि समाज मिलि मनहुँ सुराती ॥
verses.tr:
bhaniti mori siv kṛpām̐ bibhātī
sasi samāj mili manahum̐ surātī

verses.sa:
जे एहि कथहि सनेह समेता ।
कहिहहिं सुनिहहिं समुझि सचेता ॥
verses.tr:
je ehi kathahi saneh sametā
kahihahiṃ sunihahiṃ samujhi sacetā

verses.sa:
होइहहिं राम चरन अनुरागी ।
कलि मल रहित सुमंगल भागी ॥
verses.tr:
hoihahiṃ rām caran anurāgī
kali mal rahit sumaṃgal bhāgī

verses.sa:
सपनेहुँ साचेहुँ मोहि पर जौं हर गौरि पसाउ ।
तौ फुर होउ जो कहेउँ सब भाषा भनिति प्रभाउ ॥
verses.tr:
sapanehum̐ sācehum̐ mohi par jauṃ har gauri pasāu
tau phur hou jo kaheum̐ sab bhāṣā bhaniti prabhāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again I reverence the Sarasvati and the Ganges. both holy and beautiful streams cleansing sin by a single draught or immersion, whose name as soon as uttered or heard at once removes error. I[ adore as I would my guru, or my natural parents, Siva and Parvati, protectors of the humble, daily benefactors, servants and courtiers in attendance on Sita’s lord and in every way Tulsi's true friends; who, in their benevolence and considering the degeneracy of the times, have themselves composed many spells in a barbarous language, incoherent syllables and unintelligible mutterings, mysterious revelations of the great Siva. By his patronage I may make my story an agreeable one, and by meditating on Siva and Parvati may relate Rama's adventures in a way that will give pleasure. Itis only by his favour that my verse can be beautified, us a dark night by the moonand stars. Whoever in a devout spirit, with intelligence and attention, hears or repeats this Lay of mine, be shall become full of true love for Rama, and, cleansed from worldly stains, shall enjoy heavenly felicity.
Whether I nm awake or dreaming, if Siva and Gauri grant me their favour, all that I say shall] come true as to the effect of my song, though it be in the vulgar tongue.

sections.label: Doha 16
sections.name: बंदउँ अवध भुआल सत्य प्रेम जेहि राम पद

verses.sa:
बंदउँ अवध पुरी अति पावनि ।
सरजू सरि कलि कलुष नसावनि ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ avadh purī ati pāvani
sarajū sari kali kaluṣ nasāvani
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रनवउँ पुर नर नारि बहोरी ।
ममता जिन्ह पर प्रभुहि न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
pranavaum̐ pur nar nāri bahorī
mamatā jinh par prabhuhi na thorī

verses.sa:
सिय निंदक अघ ओघ नसाए ।
लोक बिसोक बनाइ बसाए ॥
verses.tr:
siya niṃdak agh ogh nasāe
lok bisok banāi basāe

verses.sa:
बंदउँ कौसल्या दिसि प्राची ।
कीरति जासु सकल जग माची ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ kausalyā disi prācī
kīrati jāsu sakal jag mācī

verses.sa:
प्रगटेउ जहँ रघुपति ससि चारू ।
बिस्व सुखद खल कमल तुसारू ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭeu jaham̐ raghupati sasi cārū
bisv sukhad khal kamal tusārū

verses.sa:
दसरथ राउ सहित सब रानी ।
सुकृत सुमंगल मूरति मानी ॥
verses.tr:
dasarath rāu sahit sab rānī
sukṛt sumaṃgal mūrati mānī

verses.sa:
करउँ प्रनाम करम मन बानी ।
करहु कृपा सुत सेवक जानी ॥
verses.tr:
karaum̐ pranām karam man bānī
karahu kṛpā sut sevak jānī

verses.sa:
जिन्हहि बिरचि बड़ भयउ बिधाता ।
महिमा अवधि राम पितु माता ॥
verses.tr:
jinhahi biraci bar̤ bhayau bidhātā
mahimā avadhi rām pitu mātā

verses.sa:
बंदउँ अवध भुआल सत्य प्रेम जेहि राम पद ।
बिछुरत दीनदयाल प्रिय तनु तृन इव परिहरेउ ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ avadh bhuāl satya prem jehi rām pad
bichurat dīnadayāl priya tanu tṛn iv parihareu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I reverence the holy city of Ayodhya and the river Sarju, cleansing from allearthly impurity. I salute also the inhabitants of the city, for whom the Lord had no little affection; seeing that he ignored all the sin of Sita’s calumniator and set men’s minds at rest. I reverence Kausalya, eastern heaven, from which glory was diffused over the whole world; whence Raghupati arose as a lovely moon, giving joy to the world, but blighting like a frost the lotus leaves of vice. To King Dasarath and all his queens, incarnations of virtue and felicity, I make obeisance in word, deed and heart, saying ‘Be gracious to me as to a servant of your son, O parents of Rama, that come of greatness, ye in whose creation the creator surpassed himself.’
I reverence the King of Avadh, who had such true love for Rama's feet that, when parted from his lord, his life snapped and parted too like a straw.

sections.label: Doha 17
sections.name: प्रनवउँ पवनकुमार खल बन पावक ग्यानधन

verses.sa:
प्रनवउँ परिजन सहित बिदेहू ।
जाहि राम पद गूढ़ सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
pranavaum̐ parijan sahit bidehū
jāhi rām pad gūr̤h sanehū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जोग भोग महँ राखेउ गोई ।
राम बिलोकत प्रगटेउ सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jog bhog maham̐ rākheu goī
rām bilokat pragaṭeu soī

verses.sa:
प्रनवउँ प्रथम भरत के चरना ।
जासु नेम ब्रत जाइ न बरना ॥
verses.tr:
pranavaum̐ pratham bharat ke caranā
jāsu nem brat jāi na baranā

verses.sa:
राम चरन पंकज मन जासू ।
लुबुध मधुप इव तजइ न पासू ॥
verses.tr:
rām caran paṃkaj man jāsū
lubudh madhup iv tajai na pāsū

verses.sa:
बंदउँ लछिमन पद जलजाता ।
सीतल सुभग भगत सुख दाता ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ lachiman pad jalajātā
sītal subhag bhagat sukh dātā

verses.sa:
रघुपति कीरति बिमल पताका ।
दंड समान भयउ जस जाका ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati kīrati bimal patākā
daṃḍ samān bhayau jas jākā

verses.sa:
सेष सहस्त्रसीस जग कारन ।
जो अवतरेउ भूमि भय टारन ॥
verses.tr:
seṣ sahastrasīs jag kāran
jo avatareu bhūmi bhaya ṭāran

verses.sa:
सदा सो सानुकूल रह मो पर ।
कृपासिंधु सौमित्रि गुनाकर ॥
verses.tr:
sadā so sānukūl rah mo par
kṛpāsiṃdhu saumitri gunākar

verses.sa:
रिपुसूदन पद कमल नमामी ।
सूर सुसील भरत अनुगामी ॥
verses.tr:
ripusūdan pad kamal namāmī
sūr susīl bharat anugāmī

verses.sa:
महावीर बिनवउँ हनुमाना ।
राम जासु जस आप बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
mahāvīr binavaum̐ hanumānā
rām jāsu jas āp bakhānā

verses.sa:
प्रनवउँ पवनकुमार खल बन पावक ग्यानधन ।
जासु हृदय आगार बसहिं राम सर चाप धर ॥
verses.tr:
pranavaum̐ pavanakumār khal ban pāvak gyānadhan
jāsu hṛdaya āgār basahiṃ rām sar cāp dhar
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I salute the King of Videha, with a]] his court, who had the greatest affection for Rama; though he concealed his devotion under royal state, yet it broke out as soon as he saw him. Then, next, I throw myself at the feet of Bharat, whose constancy and devotion surpass description; whose soul like a bee thirsting for sweets was ever hovering round the lotus feet of Rama. I reverence too the lotus feet of Lakshman, cool, comely and source of delight to their worshippers, whose glory is as it were the standard for the display of Rama's pure emblazonment. Thou who to remove the terrors of the world didst become incarnate in the form of the thousand-headed serpent for the sake of the universe, be ever propitious to me, O son of Sumitra, ocean of compassion, storehouse of perfection. 1 bow also to Ripustidan (i.e., Satrughna), the generous hero, Bharat’s constant companion; and to the conqueror Hanuman, whose glory has been told by Rama himself€.
The Son of the Wind, of profound intelligence, like a consuming fire in the forest of vice, in whose heart Rama, equipped with bow and arrows, has established his home.

sections.label: Doha 18
sections.name: गिरा अरथ जल बीचि सम कहिअत भिन्न न भिन्न

verses.sa:
कपिपति रीछ निसाचर राजा ।
अंगदादि जे कीस समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
kapipati rīch nisācar rājā
aṃgadādi je kīs samājā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बंदउँ सब के चरन सुहाए ।
अधम सरीर राम जिन्ह पाए ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ sab ke caran suhāe
adham sarīr rām jinh pāe

verses.sa:
रघुपति चरन उपासक जेते ।
खग मृग सुर नर असुर समेते ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati caran upāsak jete
khag mṛg sur nar asur samete

verses.sa:
बंदउँ पद सरोज सब केरे ।
जे बिनु काम राम के चेरे ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ pad saroj sab kere
je binu kām rām ke cere

verses.sa:
सुक सनकादि भगत मुनि नारद ।
जे मुनिबर बिग्यान बिसारद ॥
verses.tr:
suk sanakādi bhagat muni nārad
je munibar bigyān bisārad

verses.sa:
प्रनवउँ सबहिं धरनि धरि सीसा ।
करहु कृपा जन जानि मुनीसा ॥
verses.tr:
pranavaum̐ sabahiṃ dharani dhari sīsā
karahu kṛpā jan jāni munīsā

verses.sa:
जनकसुता जग जननि जानकी ।
अतिसय प्रिय करुना निधान की ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā jag janani jānakī
atisaya priya karunā nidhān kī

verses.sa:
ताके जुग पद कमल मनावउँ ।
जासु कृपाँ निरमल मति पावउँ ॥
verses.tr:
tāke jug pad kamal manāvaum̐
jāsu kṛpām̐ niramal mati pāvaum̐

verses.sa:
पुनि मन बचन कर्म रघुनायक ।
चरन कमल बंदउँ सब लायक ॥
verses.tr:
puni man bacan karm raghunāyak
caran kamal baṃdaum̐ sab lāyak

verses.sa:
राजिवनयन धरें धनु सायक ।
भगत बिपति भंजन सुख दायक ॥
verses.tr:
rājivanayan dhareṃ dhanu sāyak
bhagat bipati bhaṃjan sukh dāyak

verses.sa:
गिरा अरथ जल बीचि सम कहिअत भिन्न न भिन्न ।
बदउँ सीता राम पद जिन्हहि परम प्रिय खिन्न ॥
verses.tr:
girā arath jal bīci sam kahiat bhinn na bhinn
badaum̐ sītā rām pad jinhahi param priya khinn
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The monkey lord, the king of bears and demons, Angad and all the monkey host, I throw myself at the benign Feet of them all, for though contemptible in appearance they yet found Rama. I worship all his faithful servants—whether birds, beasts, gods, men or demons—all his unselfish adherents. I worship Sukadeva, Sanat-komera, Narad, and the other sages of excellent renown, putting my head to the ground and crying: ‘My lords, be gracious to your servant.’ I propitiate the lotus feet of Janak’s daughter, Jenki, mother of the world, best beloved of the Fountain of Mercy; by whose grace I may attain to unclouded intelligence. Again in heart, in word and deed I worship the all-worthy feet of Raghunath; the glance of whose lotus eyes, like an arrow from the bow, rejoices his votaries by destroying all their misfortunes.

As a word and its meaning are inseparable, and aaa wave cannot be distinguished from the water of which it is composed, the difference being only in the name; so with Rama and Sita, the refuge of the distressed, whom I adore,

sections.label: Doha 19
sections.name: बरषा रितु रघुपति भगति तुलसी सालि सुदास

verses.sa:
बंदउँ नाम राम रघुवर को ।
हेतु कृसानु भानु हिमकर को ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ nām rām raghuvar ko
hetu kṛsānu bhānu himakar ko
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिधि हरि हरमय बेद प्रान सो ।
अगुन अनूपम गुन निधान सो ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi hari haramaya bed prān so
agun anūpam gun nidhān so

verses.sa:
महामंत्र जोइ जपत महेसू ।
कासीं मुकुति हेतु उपदेसू ॥
verses.tr:
mahāmaṃtr joi japat mahesū
kāsīṃ mukuti hetu upadesū

verses.sa:
महिमा जासु जान गनराउ ।
प्रथम पूजिअत नाम प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā jāsu jān ganarāu
pratham pūjiat nām prabhāū

verses.sa:
जान आदिकबि नाम प्रतापू ।
भयउ सुद्ध करि उलटा जापू ॥
verses.tr:
jān ādikabi nām pratāpū
bhayau suddh kari ulaṭā jāpū

verses.sa:
सहस नाम सम सुनि सिव बानी ।
जपि जेई पिय संग भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
sahas nām sam suni siv bānī
japi jeī piya saṃg bhavānī

verses.sa:
हरषे हेतु हेरि हर ही को ।
किय भूषन तिय भूषन ती को ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe hetu heri har hī ko
kiya bhūṣan tiya bhūṣan tī ko

verses.sa:
नाम प्रभाउ जान सिव नीको ।
कालकूट फलु दीन्ह अमी को ॥
verses.tr:
nām prabhāu jān siv nīko
kālakūṭ phalu dīnh amī ko

verses.sa: बरषा रितु रघुपति भगति तुलसी सालि सुदास ॥
verses.tr: baraṣā ritu raghupati bhagati tulasī sāli sudās
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: राम नाम बर बरन जुग सावन भादव मास ॥
verses.tr: rām nām bar baran jug sāvan bhādav mās

trans: I adore the name of Rama as borne by Raghubar,' the source of all light, whether of the fire, or the sun, or the moon; substance of the triune god; vital breath of the Veda; the passionless; the incomparable; the source of all good; the great spell muttered by Mahadeva and enjoined by him as necessary to salvation even at Kasi. By confessing its power, Ganes obtain the first place among the gods; by its

_ power, though he muttered it backwards, the great poet Valmiki attained to purity; by its repetition, after she had heard from Siva that it was equal to a thousand names, Bhavani was able to join her husband; while he, Mahadeva, in his delight on beholding her simple faith, assumed the woman, making that ornament of her sex the ornament of his own body. Again, it was by the power of this name that the poison swallowed by Mahadeva was converted into ambrosia.
Devotion to Rama is for the faithful Tulsi Das like the rainy season for the rice-field; the two glorious consonants in Rama’s name are like the months of S^wan and Bhadog.

sections.label: Doha 20
sections.name: एकु छत्रु एकु मुकुटमनि सब बरननि पर जोउ

verses.sa:
आखर मधुर मनोहर दोऊ ।
बरन बिलोचन जन जिय जोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ākhar madhur manohar doū
baran bilocan jan jiya joū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुमिरत सुलभ सुखद सब काहू ।
लोक लाहु परलोक निबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sumirat sulabh sukhad sab kāhū
lok lāhu paralok nibāhū

verses.sa:
कहत सुनत सुमिरत सुठि नीके ।
राम लखन सम प्रिय तुलसी के ॥
verses.tr:
kahat sunat sumirat suṭhi nīke
rām lakhan sam priya tulasī ke

verses.sa:
बरनत बरन प्रीति बिलगाती ।
ब्रह्म जीव सम सहज सँघाती ॥
verses.tr:
baranat baran prīti bilagātī
brahm jīv sam sahaj sam̐ghātī

verses.sa:
नर नारायन सरिस सुभ्राता ।
जग पालक बिसेषि जन त्राता ॥
verses.tr:
nar nārāyan saris subhrātā
jag pālak biseṣi jan trātā

verses.sa:
भगति सुतिय कल करन बिभूषन ।
जग हित हेतु बिमल बिधु पूषन ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati sutiya kal karan bibhūṣan
jag hit hetu bimal bidhu pūṣan

verses.sa:
स्वाद तोष सम सुगति सुधा के ।
कमठ सेष सम धर बसुधा के ॥
verses.tr:
svād toṣ sam sugati sudhā ke
kamaṭh seṣ sam dhar basudhā ke

verses.sa:
जन मन मंजु कंज मधुकर से ।
जीह जसोमति हरि हलधर से ॥
verses.tr:
jan man maṃju kaṃj madhukar se
jīh jasomati hari haladhar se

verses.sa:
एकु छत्रु एकु मुकुटमनि सब बरननि पर जोउ ।
तुलसी रघुबर नाम के बरन बिराजत दोउ ॥
verses.tr:
eku chatru eku mukuṭamani sab baranani par jou
tulasī raghubar nām ke baran birājat dou
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Two sweet and gracious syllables, the eyes as it were of the soul, easy to remember, satisfying every wish,a gain in this world and felicity in the next; most delightful to utter, to hear, or to remember; as dear to Tulsi as the inseparable Rama and Lukshman. My love is inflamed as I speak of these mystic syllables, as intimately connected as the universal soul and the soul of man; twin brothers like Nara and Narayan; preservers of the world; redeemers of the elect; bright jewels in the ears of beauteous Faith; pure and beneficent as the sun and the moon; like sweetness and contentment; the inseparable attributes of ambrosia; like the tortoise and serpent, supporters of the world; like the bee and lotus of a pious soul; and as sweet to the tongue as Hari and Balarama were sweet to Jasoda.
Like a royal umbrella and jewelled diadem over all the other letters of the alphabet shine the two consonants in Rama's name.”

sections.label: Doha 21
sections.name: राम नाम मनिदीप धरु जीह देहरी द्वार

verses.sa:
समुझत सरिस नाम अरु नामी ।
प्रीति परसपर प्रभु अनुगामी ॥
verses.tr:
samujhat saris nām aru nāmī
prīti parasapar prabhu anugāmī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाम रूप दुइ ईस उपाधी ।
अकथ अनादि सुसामुझि साधी ॥
verses.tr:
nām rūp dui īs upādhī
akath anādi susāmujhi sādhī

verses.sa:
को बड़ छोट कहत अपराधू ।
सुनि गुन भेद समुझिहहिं साधू ॥
verses.tr:
ko bar̤ choṭ kahat aparādhū
suni gun bhed samujhihahiṃ sādhū

verses.sa:
देखिअहिं रूप नाम आधीना ।
रूप ग्यान नहिं नाम बिहीना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhiahiṃ rūp nām ādhīnā
rūp gyān nahiṃ nām bihīnā

verses.sa:
रूप बिसेष नाम बिनु जानें ।
करतल गत न परहिं पहिचानें ॥
verses.tr:
rūp biseṣ nām binu jāneṃ
karatal gat na parahiṃ pahicāneṃ

verses.sa:
सुमिरिअ नाम रूप बिनु देखें ।
आवत हृदयँ सनेह बिसेषें ॥
verses.tr:
sumiria nām rūp binu dekheṃ
āvat hṛdayam̐ saneh biseṣeṃ

verses.sa:
नाम रूप गति अकथ कहानी ।
समुझत सुखद न परति बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
nām rūp gati akath kahānī
samujhat sukhad na parati bakhānī

verses.sa:
अगुन सगुन बिच नाम सुसाखी ।
उभय प्रबोधक चतुर दुभाषी ॥
verses.tr:
agun sagun bic nām susākhī
ubhaya prabodhak catur dubhāṣī

verses.sa:
राम नाम मनिदीप धरु जीह देहरी द्वार ।
तुलसी भीतर बाहेरहुँ जौं चाहसि उजिआर ॥
verses.tr:
rām nām manidīp dharu jīh deharī dvār
tulasī bhītar bāherahum̐ jauṃ cāhasi ujiār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: A name may be regarded as equivalent to what is named, the connection being such as subsists between a master and servant. Both name and form are shadows of the lord, who, rightly understood, is unspeakable and uncreated. They are sometimes wrongly distinguished as greater and less, but the wise will understand my explanation of the difference between them. See, now, the form is subordinate to the name, for without the name you cannot come toa knowledge of the form; if the very form be in your hand, still without knowing the name it is not recognized; but meditate on the name without seeing the form, and your soul is filled with devotion. The mystery of name and form is unspeakable and cannot be told, but delightful to those who have intuition of it; the name acting as a witness between the material and immaterial form of the deity, and being a guide and interpreter to both.
Place the name of Rama as a jewelled lamp at the door of your lips and there will be light, as you will, both inside and ont.

sections.label: Doha 22
sections.name: सकल कामना हीन जे राम भगति रस लीन

verses.sa:
नाम जीहँ जपि जागहिं जोगी ।
बिरति बिरंचि प्रपंच बियोगी ॥
verses.tr:
nām jīham̐ japi jāgahiṃ jogī
birati biraṃci prapaṃc biyogī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मसुखहि अनुभवहिं अनूपा ।
अकथ अनामय नाम न रूपा ॥
verses.tr:
brahmasukhahi anubhavahiṃ anūpā
akath anāmaya nām na rūpā

verses.sa:
जाना चहहिं गूढ़ गति जेऊ ।
नाम जीहँ जपि जानहिं तेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jānā cahahiṃ gūr̤h gati jeū
nām jīham̐ japi jānahiṃ teū

verses.sa:
साधक नाम जपहिं लय लाएँ ।
होहिं सिद्ध अनिमादिक पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
sādhak nām japahiṃ laya lāem̐
hohiṃ siddh animādik pāem̐

verses.sa:
जपहिं नामु जन आरत भारी ।
मिटहिं कुसंकट होहिं सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
japahiṃ nāmu jan ārat bhārī
miṭahiṃ kusaṃkaṭ hohiṃ sukhārī

verses.sa:
राम भगत जग चारि प्रकारा ।
सुकृती चारिउ अनघ उदारा ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagat jag cāri prakārā
sukṛtī cāriu anagh udārā

verses.sa:
चहू चतुर कहुँ नाम अधारा ।
ग्यानी प्रभुहि बिसेषि पिआरा ॥
verses.tr:
cahū catur kahum̐ nām adhārā
gyānī prabhuhi biseṣi piārā

verses.sa:
चहुँ जुग चहुँ श्रुति ना प्रभाऊ ।
कलि बिसेषि नहिं आन उपाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
cahum̐ jug cahum̐ śruti nā prabhāū
kali biseṣi nahiṃ ān upāū

verses.sa:
सकल कामना हीन जे राम भगति रस लीन ।
नाम सुप्रेम पियूष हद तिन्हहुँ किए मन मीन ॥
verses.tr:
sakal kāmanā hīn je rām bhagati ras līn
nām suprem piyūṣ had tinhahum̐ kie man mīn
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As bis tongue repeats this name, the ascetic wakes to life, his thoughts free from passion and all detached from the world; he enjoys the incomparable felicity of God, who is unspeakable, unblemished, without either name or. form. Those who would understand mysteries, by repeating this name understand them; the religious who repeat this name absorbed in contemplation, become workers of miracles and acquire the power of rendering themselves invisible and the like; those who repeat it when burdened with affliction are freed from their troubles and become happy. Thus there are in the world four kinds of Rama-worshippers, all four good, holy, and beneficent; but of these four sages they are the most dear to the lord who wisely rely upon his name. His name is great in the four Vedas and in all the ages of the world, but in this fourth age especially there is no other hope. Doha 26.
Free from sensual passions and absorbed in devout affection to Rama, the soul disports itself like a fish in the ambrosia] lake of his beloved name.

sections.label: Doha 23
sections.name: निरगुन तें एहि भाँति बड़ नाम प्रभाउ अपार

verses.sa:
अगुन सगुन दुइ ब्रह्म सरूपा ।
अकथ अगाध अनादि अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
agun sagun dui brahm sarūpā
akath agādh anādi anūpā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोरें मत बड़ नामु दुहू तें ।
किए जेहिं जुग निज बस निज बूतें ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ mat bar̤ nāmu duhū teṃ
kie jehiṃ jug nij bas nij būteṃ

verses.sa:
प्रोढ़ि सुजन जनि जानहिं जन की ।
कहउँ प्रतीति प्रीति रुचि मन की ॥
verses.tr:
pror̤hi sujan jani jānahiṃ jan kī
kahaum̐ pratīti prīti ruci man kī

verses.sa:
एकु दारुगत देखिअ एकू ।
पावक सम जुग ब्रह्म बिबेकू ॥
verses.tr:
eku dārugat dekhia ekū
pāvak sam jug brahm bibekū

verses.sa:
उभय अगम जुग सुगम नाम तें ।
कहेउँ नामु बड़ ब्रह्म राम तें ॥
verses.tr:
ubhaya agam jug sugam nām teṃ
kaheum̐ nāmu bar̤ brahm rām teṃ

verses.sa:
ब्यापकु एकु ब्रह्म अबिनासी ।
सत चेतन धन आनँद रासी ॥
verses.tr:
byāpaku eku brahm abināsī
sat cetan dhan ānam̐d rāsī

verses.sa:
अस प्रभु हृदयँ अछत अबिकारी ।
सकल जीव जग दीन दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
as prabhu hṛdayam̐ achat abikārī
sakal jīv jag dīn dukhārī

verses.sa:
नाम निरूपन नाम जतन तें ।
सोउ प्रगटत जिमि मोल रतन तें ॥
verses.tr:
nām nirūpan nām jatan teṃ
sou pragaṭat jimi mol ratan teṃ

verses.sa:
निरगुन तें एहि भाँति बड़ नाम प्रभाउ अपार ।
कहउँ नामु बड़ राम तें निज बिचार अनुसार ॥
verses.tr:
niragun teṃ ehi bhām̐ti bar̤ nām prabhāu apār
kahaum̐ nāmu bar̤ rām teṃ nij bicār anusār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Supreme may be regarded either as unconditioned or as incarnate; under either aspect it is unspeakable, unfathomable, without beginning and without parallel. To roy mind the name is greater than both, for it has prevailed to bring both under its sway. My friends must not take this as an exaggeration on my part, for I say it confidently and with sincere devotion. This dual distinction of the Supreme is like the two kinds of fire, which is either potential in the wood or visible externally; each is in itself unapproachable but is easily approached by means of the name; and therefore I say that the name is greater than either. Brahm or Rama. For the one immortal, true, sentient, complete, and blissful Brahm is all-pervading; yet though such an unchangeable lord isin our very soul, the whole creation is in slavery and wretchedness, till he is revealed in definite shape, and is energized by the name; as a jewel is not valued till it is so called gm»
Thus the virtue of the name is infinite and transcends ie rere and in my judgment is greater than Rama imselt.

sections.label: Doha 24
sections.name: सबरी गीध सुसेवकनि सुगति दीन्हि रघुनाथ

verses.sa:
राम भगत हित नर तनु धारी ।
सहि संकट किए साधु सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagat hit nar tanu dhārī
sahi saṃkaṭ kie sādhu sukhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नामु सप्रेम जपत अनयासा ।
भगत होहिं मुद मंगल बासा ॥
verses.tr:
nāmu saprem japat anayāsā
bhagat hohiṃ mud maṃgal bāsā

verses.sa:
राम एक तापस तिय तारी ।
नाम कोटि खल कुमति सुधारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām ek tāpas tiya tārī
nām koṭi khal kumati sudhārī

verses.sa:
रिषि हित राम सुकेतुसुता की ।
सहित सेन सुत कीन्ह बिबाकी ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi hit rām suketusutā kī
sahit sen sut kīnh bibākī

verses.sa:
सहित दोष दुख दास दुरासा ।
दलइ नामु जिमि रबि निसि नासा ॥
verses.tr:
sahit doṣ dukh dās durāsā
dalai nāmu jimi rabi nisi nāsā

verses.sa:
भंजेउ राम आपु भव चापू ।
भव भय भंजन नाम प्रतापू ॥
verses.tr:
bhaṃjeu rām āpu bhav cāpū
bhav bhaya bhaṃjan nām pratāpū

verses.sa:
दंडक बनु प्रभु कीन्ह सुहावन ।
जन मन अमित नाम किए पावन ॥
verses.tr:
daṃḍak banu prabhu kīnh suhāvan
jan man amit nām kie pāvan

verses.sa:
निसिचर निकर दले रघुनंदन ।
नामु सकल कलि कलुष निकंदन ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar nikar dale raghunaṃdan
nāmu sakal kali kaluṣ nikaṃdan

verses.sa:
सबरी गीध सुसेवकनि सुगति दीन्हि रघुनाथ ।
नाम उधारे अमित खल बेद बिदित गुन गाथ ॥
verses.tr:
sabarī gīdh susevakani sugati dīnhi raghunāth
nām udhāre amit khal bed bidit gun gāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: From the love that he bore to his followers, Rama took the form of a man and by himself enduring misery secured their happiness. By incessantly and devoutly repeating his name, all the faithful may attain to felicity. Rama himself redeemed only one woman, the ascetic's wife; but his name has corrected the errors of millions of sinners. To gratify the Rishi Visvamitra, Rama wrought the destruction of Suketu’s daughter Teraka with her son Mericha and his army; but as the sun puts anend to night, so his name has scattered all crime and pain and despair. In his own person RAma broke the bow of Siva, but his glorious name has broken the fear of death; the Lord himself restored to life only the forest of Dandaka, but his name has sanctified countless generations; the son of Raghu destroyed many demons, but his name has destroyed all the evil of the world.
Raghunath conferred immortality on Savari and the vulture Jateyut and his other faithful servants; but his name, precious theme of the Vedas, has delivered innumerable wretches.

sections.label: Doha 25
sections.name: ब्रह्म राम तें नामु बड़ बर दायक बर दानि

verses.sa:
राम सुकंठ बिभीषन दोऊ ।
राखे सरन जान सबु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rām sukaṃṭh bibhīṣan doū
rākhe saran jān sabu koū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाम गरीब अनेक नेवाजे ।
लोक बेद बर बिरिद बिराजे ॥
verses.tr:
nām garīb anek nevāje
lok bed bar birid birāje

verses.sa:
राम भालु कपि कटकु बटोरा ।
सेतु हेतु श्रमु कीन्ह न थोरा ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhālu kapi kaṭaku baṭorā
setu hetu śramu kīnh na thorā

verses.sa:
नामु लेत भवसिंधु सुखाहीं ।
करहु बिचारु सुजन मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nāmu let bhavasiṃdhu sukhāhīṃ
karahu bicāru sujan man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
राम सकुल रन रावनु मारा ।
सीय सहित निज पुर पगु धारा ॥
verses.tr:
rām sakul ran rāvanu mārā
sīya sahit nij pur pagu dhārā

verses.sa:
राजा रामु अवध रजधानी ।
गावत गुन सुर मुनि बर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
rājā rāmu avadh rajadhānī
gāvat gun sur muni bar bānī

verses.sa:
सेवक सुमिरत नामु सप्रीती ।
बिनु श्रम प्रबल मोह दलु जीती ॥
verses.tr:
sevak sumirat nāmu saprītī
binu śram prabal moh dalu jītī

verses.sa:
फिरत सनेहँ मगन सुख अपनें ।
नाम प्रसाद सोच नहिं सपनें ॥
verses.tr:
phirat saneham̐ magan sukh apaneṃ
nām prasād soc nahiṃ sapaneṃ

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म राम तें नामु बड़ बर दायक बर दानि ।
रामचरित सत कोटि महँ लिय महेस जियँ जानि ॥
verses.tr:
brahm rām teṃ nāmu bar̤ bar dāyak bar dāni
rāmacarit sat koṭi maham̐ liya mahes jiyam̐ jāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama, as all men know, extended his protection to
Sugriva and Vibhishan; but his name has protected
and redeem her.

rds which cannot be preserved in the trans-the couplet the word bhava is to be taken as second half it means life or rather death, since, according to Hindu ideas, all eonscious life is merely a preparation for inevitable death, Compare Milton’s expression:—“ This earthly toad of death called life, which us from life doth sever,”

countless supplicants, shining forth gloriously in the world and Veda. Rama assembled a host of bears and monkeys, and even then kd no little trouble to build his bridge; his name can dry up the ocean of life; meditate thereon, O ye faithful. Rama killed in battle Ravan and all his family, _and returned with Sita to his own city, a king to Avadh, his capital, while gods and saints hymned his praises; but his servants, if only they affectionately meditate on his name, have no difficulty in vanquishing the whole army of error, and absorbed in devotion live at ease without even a dream of sorrow.
The name is greater than either Brahm or Rama, and is the best gift of the best giver; this Mahadeva knew when he selected it from the hundred crores of verses in the Ramayana.

sections.label: Doha 26
sections.name: नामु राम को कलपतरु कलि कल्यान निवासु

verses.sa:
नाम प्रसाद संभु अबिनासी ।
साजु अमंगल मंगल रासी ॥
verses.tr:
nām prasād saṃbhu abināsī
sāju amaṃgal maṃgal rāsī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुक सनकादि सिद्ध मुनि जोगी ।
नाम प्रसाद ब्रह्मसुख भोगी ॥
verses.tr:
suk sanakādi siddh muni jogī
nām prasād brahmasukh bhogī

verses.sa:
नारद जानेउ नाम प्रतापू ।
जग प्रिय हरि हरि हर प्रिय आपू ॥
verses.tr:
nārad jāneu nām pratāpū
jag priya hari hari har priya āpū

verses.sa:
नामु जपत प्रभु कीन्ह प्रसादू ।
भगत सिरोमनि भे प्रहलादू ॥
verses.tr:
nāmu japat prabhu kīnh prasādū
bhagat siromani bhe prahalādū

verses.sa:
ध्रुवँ सगलानि जपेउ हरि नाऊँ ।
पायउ अचल अनूपम ठाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
dhruvam̐ sagalāni japeu hari nāūm̐
pāyau acal anūpam ṭhāūm̐

verses.sa:
सुमिरि पवनसुत पावन नामू ।
अपने बस करि राखे रामू ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri pavanasut pāvan nāmū
apane bas kari rākhe rāmū

verses.sa:
अपतु अजामिलु गजु गनिकाऊ ।
भए मुकुत हरि नाम प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
apatu ajāmilu gaju ganikāū
