bhae mukut hari nām prabhāū

verses.sa:
कहौं कहाँ लगि नाम बड़ाई ।
रामु न सकहिं नाम गुन गाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahauṃ kahām̐ lagi nām bar̤āī
rāmu na sakahiṃ nām gun gāī

verses.sa:
नामु राम को कलपतरु कलि कल्यान निवासु ।
जो सुमिरत भयो भाँग तें तुलसी तुलसीदासु ॥
verses.tr:
nāmu rām ko kalapataru kali kalyān nivāsu
jo sumirat bhayo bhām̐g teṃ tulasī tulasīdāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By the power of this name the blessed god of curst attire, even the great Siva, acquired immortality; by the power of this name Sukadeva, Sanat-kumdra, and all saints, sages, and ascetics have enjoyed heavenly raptures: Narad too acknowledged its power, himself as dear to Hara and Hari as Hari is dear to the world; by repeating this name Prahlad, through the Lord’s grace, became the crown of the faithful.’ Dhruva in his distress repeated the name of Hari, and was rewarded by a fixed and incomparable station in the heavens; by meditating on his holy name Hanuman won and kept the affection of Rama; by the power of Hari’s name Ajemil and the elephant and the harlot all three obtained salvation; why further extend the list not even the incarnate Rama could exhaust it.

The name of Rama is as the tree of paradise, the centre of all that is good in this wicked world; and whoever meditates upon it becomes (says Tulsi Das) transformed as it were from a vile hemp-stick into a sweet-smelling tulsi plant.

sections.label: Doha 27
sections.name: राम नाम नरकेसरी कनककसिपु कलिकाल

verses.sa:
चहुँ जुग तीनि काल तिहुँ लोका ।
भए नाम जपि जीव बिसोका ॥
verses.tr:
cahum̐ jug tīni kāl tihum̐ lokā
bhae nām japi jīv bisokā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बेद पुरान संत मत एहू ।
सकल सुकृत फल राम सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
bed purān saṃt mat ehū
sakal sukṛt phal rām sanehū

verses.sa:
ध्यानु प्रथम जुग मखबिधि दूजें ।
द्वापर परितोषत प्रभु पूजें ॥
verses.tr:
dhyānu pratham jug makhabidhi dūjeṃ
dvāpar paritoṣat prabhu pūjeṃ

verses.sa:
कलि केवल मल मूल मलीना ।
पाप पयोनिधि जन मन मीना ॥
verses.tr:
kali keval mal mūl malīnā
pāp payonidhi jan man mīnā

verses.sa:
नाम कामतरु काल कराला ।
सुमिरत समन सकल जग जाला ॥
verses.tr:
nām kāmataru kāl karālā
sumirat saman sakal jag jālā

verses.sa:
राम नाम कलि अभिमत दाता ।
हित परलोक लोक पितु माता ॥
verses.tr:
rām nām kali abhimat dātā
hit paralok lok pitu mātā

verses.sa:
नहिं कलि करम न भगति बिबेकू ।
राम नाम अवलंबन एकू ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ kali karam na bhagati bibekū
rām nām avalaṃban ekū

verses.sa:
कालनेमि कलि कपट निधानू ।
नाम सुमति समरथ हनुमानू ॥
verses.tr:
kālanemi kali kapaṭ nidhānū
nām sumati samarath hanumānū

verses.sa:
राम नाम नरकेसरी कनककसिपु कलिकाल ।
जापक जन प्रहलाद जिमि पालिहि दलि सुरसाल ॥
verses.tr:
rām nām narakesarī kanakakasipu kalikāl
jāpak jan prahalād jimi pālihi dali surasāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In all four ages of the world; in all time, past, present, or future; in the three spheres of earth, heaven and hell; any creature that repeats this name becomes blessed. This is the verdict of the Veda, Purdnas and all the saints— that love of Rama is the fruit of all virtue. In the first age, contemplation; in the second age, sacrifice; in the Dyapar age, temple-worship was the appointed prgpitiation; but in this vile and impure iron age, where the soul of man floats like a fish in an ocean of sin, in these femmgul times; the name is the only tree of life, and by madidatintwoe it all commotion is stilled In these evil days neither good deeds, nor piety, nor spiritual wisdom is of any avail, but only the name of Rama: his name is as it were the wisdom and the might of Hanuman to expose and destroy the K4lanemi-like wiles of the wicked world. Dohe 31.

sections.label: Doha 28
sections.name: सठ सेवक की प्रीति रुचि रखिहहिं राम कृपालु

verses.sa:
भायँ कुभायँ अनख आलसहूँ ।
नाम जपत मंगल दिसि दसहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
bhāyam̐ kubhāyam̐ anakh ālasahūm̐
nām japat maṃgal disi dasahūm̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुमिरि सो नाम राम गुन गाथा ।
करउँ नाइ रघुनाथहि माथा ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri so nām rām gun gāthā
karaum̐ nāi raghunāthahi māthā

verses.sa:
मोरि सुधारिहि सो सब भाँती ।
जासु कृपा नहिं कृपाँ अघाती ॥
verses.tr:
mori sudhārihi so sab bhām̐tī
jāsu kṛpā nahiṃ kṛpām̐ aghātī

verses.sa:
राम सुस्वामि कुसेवकु मोसो ।
निज दिसि दैखि दयानिधि पोसो ॥
verses.tr:
rām susvāmi kusevaku moso
nij disi daikhi dayānidhi poso

verses.sa:
लोकहुँ बेद सुसाहिब रीतीं ।
बिनय सुनत पहिचानत प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
lokahum̐ bed susāhib rītīṃ
binaya sunat pahicānat prītī

verses.sa:
गनी गरीब ग्रामनर नागर ।
पंडित मूढ़ मलीन उजागर ॥
verses.tr:
ganī garīb grāmanar nāgar
paṃḍit mūr̤h malīn ujāgar

verses.sa:
सुकबि कुकबि निज मति अनुहारी ।
नृपहि सराहत सब नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
sukabi kukabi nij mati anuhārī
nṛpahi sarāhat sab nar nārī

verses.sa:
साधु सुजान सुसील नृपाला ।
ईस अंस भव परम कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu sujān susīl nṛpālā
īs aṃs bhav param kṛpālā

verses.sa:
सुनि सनमानहिं सबहि सुबानी ।
भनिति भगति नति गति पहिचानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni sanamānahiṃ sabahi subānī
bhaniti bhagati nati gati pahicānī

verses.sa:
यह प्राकृत महिपाल सुभाऊ ।
जान सिरोमनि कोसलराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
yah prākṛt mahipāl subhāū
jān siromani kosalarāū

verses.sa:
रीझत राम सनेह निसोतें ।
को जग मंद मलिनमति मोतें ॥
verses.tr:
rījhat rām saneh nisoteṃ
ko jag maṃd malinamati moteṃ

verses.sa:
सठ सेवक की प्रीति रुचि रखिहहिं राम कृपालु ।
उपल किए जलजान जेहिं सचिव सुमति कपि भालु ॥
verses.tr:
saṭh sevak kī prīti ruci rakhihahiṃ rām kṛpālu
upal kie jalajān jehiṃ saciv sumati kapi bhālu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
हौहु कहावत सबु कहत राम सहत उपहास ।
साहिब सीतानाथ सो सेवक तुलसीदास ॥
verses.tr:
hauhu kahāvat sabu kahat rām sahat upahās
sāhib sītānāth so sevak tulasīdās

trans: As narsinh was manifested to destroy the enemy of heaven, Hiranya-kasipu, and protect Prahlad, so is Rama's name for the destruction of the world and protection of the pious.

By repeating this name, whether in joy or in sadness, in action or in repose, bliss is diffused all around. Meditating upon it and bowing my head to Raghunath, I compose these lays in his honour; he will correct all my defects, whose mercy is mercy inexhaustible. Thou art my good lord, I thy poor servant; bear this in mind and graciously protect me. The world and scripture alike declare these to be the characteristics of a good master, that he hears prayer and acknowledges affection. Rich or poor, villager or citizen, learned or unlearned, pure or impure, good poet or bad poet, all according to their ability extol their king as being good, amiable, and gracious, lord of incomparable compassion; and he hears and accepts their honest attempts, recognizing in their words both devotion and a measure of ability. This is the way with earthly kings, and Rama is their crown: he is satisfied with simple piety, though in one who is duller and feebler of intellect even than I am.

sections.label: Doha 29
sections.name: प्रभु तरु तर कपि डार पर ते किए आपु समान

verses.sa:
अति बड़ि मोरि ढिठाई खोरी ।
सुनि अघ नरकहुँ नाक सकोरी ॥
verses.tr:
ati bar̤i mori ḍhiṭhāī khorī
suni agh narakahum̐ nāk sakorī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
समुझि सहम मोहि अपडर अपनें ।
सो सुधि राम कीन्हि नहिं सपनें ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi saham mohi apaḍar apaneṃ
so sudhi rām kīnhi nahiṃ sapaneṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि अवलोकि सुचित चख चाही ।
भगति मोरि मति स्वामि सराही ॥
verses.tr:
suni avaloki sucit cakh cāhī
bhagati mori mati svāmi sarāhī

verses.sa:
कहत नसाइ होइ हियँ नीकी ।
रीझत राम जानि जन जी की ॥
verses.tr:
kahat nasāi hoi hiyam̐ nīkī
rījhat rām jāni jan jī kī

verses.sa:
रहति न प्रभु चित चूक किए की ।
करत सुरति सय बार हिए की ॥
verses.tr:
rahati na prabhu cit cūk kie kī
karat surati saya bār hie kī

verses.sa:
जेहिं अघ बधेउ ब्याध जिमि बाली ।
फिरि सुकंठ सोइ कीन्ह कुचाली ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ agh badheu byādh jimi bālī
phiri sukaṃṭh soi kīnh kucālī

verses.sa:
सोइ करतूति बिभीषन केरी ।
सपनेहुँ सो न राम हियँ हेरी ॥
verses.tr:
soi karatūti bibhīṣan kerī
sapanehum̐ so na rām hiyam̐ herī

verses.sa:
ते भरतहि भेंटत सनमाने ।
राजसभाँ रघुबीर बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
te bharatahi bheṃṭat sanamāne
rājasabhām̐ raghubīr bakhāne

verses.sa: प्रभु तरु तर कपि डार पर ते किए आपु समान ॥
verses.tr: prabhu taru tar kapi ḍār par te kie āpu samān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: तुलसी कहूँ न राम से साहिब सीलनिधान ॥
verses.tr: tulasī kahūm̐ na rām se sāhib sīlanidhān

verses.sa:
राम निकाईं रावरी है सबही को नीक ।
जों यह साँची है सदा तौ नीको तुलसीक ॥
verses.tr:
rām nikāīṃ rāvarī hai sabahī ko nīk
joṃ yah sām̐cī hai sadā tau nīko tulasīk

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि निज गुन दोष कहि सबहि बहुरि सिरु नाइ ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिसद जसु सुनि कलि कलुष नसाइ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi nij gun doṣ kahi sabahi bahuri siru nāi
baranaum̐ raghubar bisad jasu suni kali kaluṣ nasāi

trans: ~., The merciful Rama will regard the love and zeal of his poor servant, he who made a ship out of rock and wise ministers out of monkeys and bears; although I am a byword, and every one says Rama is exposed to ridicnle, in that he, being such a lord, has such a servant as Tulsi Das. Chaupdi 29. My presumption is indeed very sad and villainous enough to disgust hell itself; I am quite aware of this and tremble to think of it; but Rama never dreamt of taking notice. The lord listened and with his own eyes attentively considered my faith, and thereupon applauded my devout intention. Though my story is spoilt by the telling, Rama is satisfied and accounts it good, since the will is good. The lord is not mindful of a chance fault, but on every occasion he considers the heart. Thus the very crime for which be like a huntsman killed Bali was iv turn the sin of Sugriva, and again of Vibhishan; but in their case Rama did not dream of censure, but honoured them both at his meeting with Bharat and commended in open court.

The monkeys too that scrambled up in the boughs of the tree under which the lord sat, even these he held dear as himself: says Tulsi, there is no master so generous as Rama. O Rama, thy goodness is good to all, and if so, then good to Tulsi also. Thus declaring my merits and defects and again bowing my head to all, 1 proceed to tell the glorious acts of Raghubar, by the sound of which all the sin of the world is effaced.

sections.label: Doha 30
sections.name: मै पुनि निज गुर सन सुनी कथा सो सूकरखेत

verses.sa:
जागबलिक जो कथा सुहाई ।
भरद्वाज मुनिबरहि सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāgabalik jo kathā suhāī
bharadvāj munibarahi sunāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहिहउँ सोइ संबाद बखानी ।
सुनहुँ सकल सज्जन सुखु मानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahihaum̐ soi saṃbād bakhānī
sunahum̐ sakal sajjan sukhu mānī

verses.sa:
संभु कीन्ह यह चरित सुहावा ।
बहुरि कृपा करि उमहि सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu kīnh yah carit suhāvā
bahuri kṛpā kari umahi sunāvā

verses.sa:
सोइ सिव कागभुसुंडिहि दीन्हा ।
राम भगत अधिकारी चीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
soi siv kāgabhusuṃḍihi dīnhā
rām bhagat adhikārī cīnhā

verses.sa:
तेहि सन जागबलिक पुनि पावा ।
तिन्ह पुनि भरद्वाज प्रति गावा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi san jāgabalik puni pāvā
tinh puni bharadvāj prati gāvā

verses.sa:
ते श्रोता बकता समसीला ।
सवँदरसी जानहिं हरिलीला ॥
verses.tr:
te śrotā bakatā samasīlā
savam̐darasī jānahiṃ harilīlā

verses.sa:
जानहिं तीनि काल निज ग्याना ।
करतल गत आमलक समाना ॥
verses.tr:
jānahiṃ tīni kāl nij gyānā
karatal gat āmalak samānā

verses.sa:
औरउ जे हरिभगत सुजाना ।
कहहिं सुनहिं समुझहिं बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
aurau je haribhagat sujānā
kahahiṃ sunahiṃ samujhahiṃ bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
मै पुनि निज गुर सन सुनी कथा सो सूकरखेत ।
समुझी नहि तसि बालपन तब अति रहेउँ अचेत ॥
verses.tr:
mai puni nij gur san sunī kathā so sūkarakhet
samujhī nahi tasi bālapan tab ati raheum̐ acet
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
श्रोता बकता ग्याननिधि कथा राम कै गूढ़ ।
किमि समुझौं मै जीव जड़ कलि मल ग्रसित बिमूढ़ ॥
verses.tr:
śrotā bakatā gyānanidhi kathā rām kai gūr̤h
kimi samujhauṃ mai jīv jar̤ kali mal grasit bimūr̤h

trans: Now listen all in friendly wise while I relate the story as I have heard it as it was communicated by Yajouvalkya to the great sage Bharadvaja. It was first of all. composed by Siva and graciously revealed to Uma, and again declared to Kaeka-bhusundi, known to be chief among the nies Rama. Fromhim Yejnavalkya received it and he recited it to Bharadvaja. These listeners and reciters were of equal virtue and had an equal insight into Hari’s sportive actions. Their intellect comprehended all time, as it were a plum in the palm of the hand. Other intelligent votaries of Hari have also in different ways heard, understood and

As for myself, I heard the story from my master at Sukar-khet (1.c., Soron)!, not understanding it, when I was quite a child and had no sense. How could such a dull creature, being both ignorant and eaten up with worldly impurities, understand so mysterious a legend and a dialogue between such sage interlocutors Chaupdi 31.

sections.label: Doha 31
sections.name: राम कथा मंदाकिनी चित्रकूट चित चारु

verses.sa:
तदपि कही गुर बारहिं बारा ।
समुझि परी कछु मति अनुसारा ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi kahī gur bārahiṃ bārā
samujhi parī kachu mati anusārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भाषाबद्ध करबि मैं सोई ।
मोरें मन प्रबोध जेहिं होई ॥
verses.tr:
bhāṣābaddh karabi maiṃ soī
moreṃ man prabodh jehiṃ hoī

verses.sa:
जस कछु बुधि बिबेक बल मेरें ।
तस कहिहउँ हियँ हरि के प्रेरें ॥
verses.tr:
jas kachu budhi bibek bal mereṃ
tas kahihaum̐ hiyam̐ hari ke prereṃ

verses.sa:
निज संदेह मोह भ्रम हरनी ।
करउँ कथा भव सरिता तरनी ॥
verses.tr:
nij saṃdeh moh bhram haranī
karaum̐ kathā bhav saritā taranī

verses.sa:
बुध बिश्राम सकल जन रंजनि ।
रामकथा कलि कलुष बिभंजनि ॥
verses.tr:
budh biśrām sakal jan raṃjani
rāmakathā kali kaluṣ bibhaṃjani

verses.sa:
रामकथा कलि पंनग भरनी ।
पुनि बिबेक पावक कहुँ अरनी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā kali paṃnag bharanī
puni bibek pāvak kahum̐ aranī

verses.sa:
रामकथा कलि कामद गाई ।
सुजन सजीवनि मूरि सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā kali kāmad gāī
sujan sajīvani mūri suhāī

verses.sa:
सोइ बसुधातल सुधा तरंगिनि ।
भय भंजनि भ्रम भेक भुअंगिनि ॥
verses.tr:
soi basudhātal sudhā taraṃgini
bhaya bhaṃjani bhram bhek bhuaṃgini

verses.sa:
असुर सेन सम नरक निकंदिनि ।
साधु बिबुध कुल हित गिरिनंदिनि ॥
verses.tr:
asur sen sam narak nikaṃdini
sādhu bibudh kul hit girinaṃdini

verses.sa:
संत समाज पयोधि रमा सी ।
बिस्व भार भर अचल छमा सी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt samāj payodhi ramā sī
bisv bhār bhar acal chamā sī

verses.sa:
जम गन मुहँ मसि जग जमुना सी ।
जीवन मुकुति हेतु जनु कासी ॥
verses.tr:
jam gan muham̐ masi jag jamunā sī
jīvan mukuti hetu janu kāsī

verses.sa:
रामहि प्रिय पावनि तुलसी सी ।
तुलसिदास हित हियँ हुलसी सी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi priya pāvani tulasī sī
tulasidās hit hiyam̐ hulasī sī

verses.sa:
सिवप्रय मेकल सैल सुता सी ।
सकल सिद्धि सुख संपति रासी ॥
verses.tr:
sivapraya mekal sail sutā sī
sakal siddhi sukh saṃpati rāsī

verses.sa:
सदगुन सुरगन अंब अदिति सी ।
रघुबर भगति प्रेम परमिति सी ॥
verses.tr:
sadagun suragan aṃb aditi sī
raghubar bhagati prem paramiti sī

verses.sa:
राम कथा मंदाकिनी चित्रकूट चित चारु ।
तुलसी सुभग सनेह बन सिय रघुबीर बिहारु ॥
verses.tr:
rām kathā maṃdākinī citrakūṭ cit cāru
tulasī subhag saneh ban siya raghubīr bihāru
verses.head: दोहा

trans: But my master repeated it time after time, till at length I understood us much as could be expected; and I now put it down in the vulgar tongue for the better comprehension of my ideas; with a heart inspired by Hari and using all the little sense, judgment, and ability that I possess. The story that I have gatell clears my own doubts as it does every other error and delusion, and is « raft on which to cross the ocean of existence. The story of Rama isa resting-place for the intellect; « universal delight; destroyer of wordly impurity; an antidote to the venom of passion; a match to enkindle the fire of wisdom; the cow of plenty in this iron age; an elixir to make good men immortal; a terrestrial stream of nectar; a destroyer of death; a snake*$o devour toad-like error; the annihilator of hell, like as Parvati on behalf of gods and saints annihilated the army of demons; like as Lakshmi was born of the sea, so conceived in the assembly of saints; immoveable as the earth that supports all the weight of creation; like the Jamun, to put to shame the angel of death; like Kasi, the saviour of all living creatures; as dear te Rama asthe pure tulsi; as dear to Tulsi Das as his own heart’s desire; as dear to Siva as the daughter of Mount Mekal (¢e., the Narmada), bestower of all perfection and prosperity; like Aditi, gracious mother of all the gods; the perfect outcome of love and devotion to Raghubar.
The story of Rama is as the river Mandekini and a good intention like Mount Chitrakut, while sincere affection is the forest where Rama and Sita disported themselves.

sections.label: Doha 32
sections.name: कुपथ कुतरक कुचालि कलि कपट दंभ पाषंड

verses.sa:
राम चरित चिंतामनि चारू ।
संत सुमति तिय सुभग सिंगारू ॥
verses.tr:
rām carit ciṃtāmani cārū
saṃt sumati tiya subhag siṃgārū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जग मंगल गुन ग्राम राम के ।
दानि मुकुति धन धरम धाम के ॥
verses.tr:
jag maṃgal gun grām rām ke
dāni mukuti dhan dharam dhām ke

verses.sa:
सदगुर ग्यान बिराग जोग के ।
बिबुध बैद भव भीम रोग के ॥
verses.tr:
sadagur gyān birāg jog ke
bibudh baid bhav bhīm rog ke

verses.sa:
जननि जनक सिय राम प्रेम के ।
बीज सकल ब्रत धरम नेम के ॥
verses.tr:
janani janak siya rām prem ke
bīj sakal brat dharam nem ke

verses.sa:
समन पाप संताप सोक के ।
प्रिय पालक परलोक लोक के ॥
verses.tr:
saman pāp saṃtāp sok ke
priya pālak paralok lok ke

verses.sa:
सचिव सुभट भूपति बिचार के ।
कुंभज लोभ उदधि अपार के ॥
verses.tr:
saciv subhaṭ bhūpati bicār ke
kuṃbhaj lobh udadhi apār ke

verses.sa:
काम कोह कलिमल करिगन के ।
केहरि सावक जन मन बन के ॥
verses.tr:
kām koh kalimal karigan ke
kehari sāvak jan man ban ke

verses.sa:
अतिथि पूज्य प्रियतम पुरारि के ।
कामद घन दारिद दवारि के ॥
verses.tr:
atithi pūjya priyatam purāri ke
kāmad ghan dārid davāri ke

verses.sa:
मंत्र महामनि बिषय ब्याल के ।
मेटत कठिन कुअंक भाल के ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtr mahāmani biṣaya byāl ke
meṭat kaṭhin kuaṃk bhāl ke

verses.sa:
हरन मोह तम दिनकर कर से ।
सेवक सालि पाल जलधर से ॥
verses.tr:
haran moh tam dinakar kar se
sevak sāli pāl jaladhar se

verses.sa:
अभिमत दानि देवतरु बर से ।
सेवत सुलभ सुखद हरि हर से ॥
verses.tr:
abhimat dāni devataru bar se
sevat sulabh sukhad hari har se

verses.sa:
सुकबि सरद नभ मन उडगन से ।
रामभगत जन जीवन धन से ॥
verses.tr:
sukabi sarad nabh man uḍagan se
rāmabhagat jan jīvan dhan se

verses.sa:
सकल सुकृत फल भूरि भोग से ।
जग हित निरुपधि साधु लोग से ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sukṛt phal bhūri bhog se
jag hit nirupadhi sādhu log se

verses.sa:
सेवक मन मानस मराल से ।
पावक गंग तंरग माल से ॥
verses.tr:
sevak man mānas marāl se
pāvak gaṃg taṃrag māl se

verses.sa:
कुपथ कुतरक कुचालि कलि कपट दंभ पाषंड ।
दहन राम गुन ग्राम जिमि इंधन अनल प्रचंड ॥
verses.tr:
kupath kutarak kucāli kali kapaṭ daṃbh pāṣaṃḍ
dahan rām gun grām jimi iṃdhan anal pracaṃḍ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
रामचरित राकेस कर सरिस सुखद सब काहु ।
सज्जन कुमुद चकोर चित हित बिसेषि बड़ लाहु ॥
verses.tr:
rāmacarit rākes kar saris sukhad sab kāhu
sajjan kumud cakor cit hit biseṣi bar̤ lāhu

trans: The legend of Rama is like the delectable wishing stone; or as @ fair jewel for the bridal adornment of saintly wise dom; His perfection is the joy of the whole world, fraught with the blessings of virtue, wealth, and eternal salvation: a true teacher of wisdom, asceticism and spiritual contem plation; like the physician of the gods to heal the fearful diseases of life; the very parent of devotion to Sita and Rama; the seed of all holy vows and practices; the destroyer of sin, of pain, and of sorrow; our guardian in this world and the next; the Prime Minister and the General of Kingly Counsel; a very Agastya!, to drink.up the illimitable ocean of desire; a young lion in the forest of life to attack the wild elephants of lust, anger, and sensual impurity; as dear to Siva as the presence of a highly honoured guest; as an abundant shower to quench the fire of meanness; a potent spell against the venom of the world; effacing from the forehead the deep brand of evil destiny; dispelling the darkness of error like the rays of the sun; like a shower on a ricefield refreshing the aridity of prayer; like the tree of paradise granting every desire; like Hariand Hara, accessible and gracious to all servants; like the starsin the clear autumn sky of the poet’s mind; like the richness of life enjoyed by Rama’s votaries; like the perfect felicity that is the reward of virtue; like the assembly of the faithful in benevolence and composure; like a swan in the pure lake of the believer’s soul; like the abundant flood of Ganga’s purifying stream..

Rama’s perfect merit is like a strong fire to consume the dry wood of schism and heresy, evil practices and worldly deceit, hypocrisy and infidelity. His acts are like the rays of the full moon that give pleasure to all,- but are specially consoling to the souls of the pious like the lotus and the chakor.

sections.label: Doha 33
sections.name: राम अनंत अनंत गुन अमित कथा बिस्तार

verses.sa:
कीन्हि प्रस्न जेहि भाँति भवानी ।
जेहि बिधि संकर कहा बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
kīnhi prasn jehi bhām̐ti bhavānī
jehi bidhi saṃkar kahā bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सो सब हेतु कहब मैं गाई ।
कथाप्रबंध बिचित्र बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
so sab hetu kahab maiṃ gāī
kathāprabaṃdh bicitr banāī

verses.sa:
जेहि यह कथा सुनी नहिं होई ।
जनि आचरजु करैं सुनि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jehi yah kathā sunī nahiṃ hoī
jani ācaraju karaiṃ suni soī

verses.sa:
कथा अलौकिक सुनहिं जे ग्यानी ।
नहिं आचरजु करहिं अस जानी ॥
verses.tr:
kathā alaukik sunahiṃ je gyānī
nahiṃ ācaraju karahiṃ as jānī

verses.sa:
रामकथा कै मिति जग नाहीं ।
असि प्रतीति तिन्ह के मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā kai miti jag nāhīṃ
asi pratīti tinh ke man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
नाना भाँति राम अवतारा ।
रामायन सत कोटि अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bhām̐ti rām avatārā
rāmāyan sat koṭi apārā

verses.sa:
कलपभेद हरिचरित सुहाए ।
भाँति अनेक मुनीसन्ह गाए ॥
verses.tr:
kalapabhed haricarit suhāe
bhām̐ti anek munīsanh gāe

verses.sa:
करिअ न संसय अस उर आनी ।
सुनिअ कथा सारद रति मानी ॥
verses.tr:
karia na saṃsaya as ur ānī
sunia kathā sārad rati mānī

verses.sa:
राम अनंत अनंत गुन अमित कथा बिस्तार ।
सुनि आचरजु न मानिहहिं जिन्ह कें बिमल बिचार ॥
verses.tr:
rām anaṃt anaṃt gun amit kathā bistār
suni ācaraju na mānihahiṃ jinh keṃ bimal bicār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All the questions that Bhavani asked, with Sankara’s replies thereto, | now proceed to give in substance, with agreeable diversity of style. No one is to be astonished if he should happen not to have heard any particular legend before. A philosopher, on hearing for the first time any marvellous acts, will feel no surprise, reasoning thus with himself; 1 know well that there is no limit in the world to the stories about Rama, for he has in various forms become incarnate, and verses of the Ramayana are some thousand millions in number; his glorious acts are of myriad diversity,
drank the whole ocean dry.
and have been sung by sages in countless ways!. So indulge no doubts, but listen reverently and devoutly.
Rama is infinite, his perfections infinite, and his legends of immeasureable expansion; men of enlightened and understanding will therefore wonder at nothing they hear.

sections.label: Doha 34
sections.name: मज्जहि सज्जन बृंद बहु पावन सरजू नीर

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सब संसय करि दूरी ।
सिर धरि गुर पद पंकज धूरी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sab saṃsaya kari dūrī
sir dhari gur pad paṃkaj dhūrī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि सबही बिनवउँ कर जोरी ।
करत कथा जेहिं लाग न खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
puni sabahī binavaum̐ kar jorī
karat kathā jehiṃ lāg na khorī

verses.sa:
सादर सिवहि नाइ अब माथा ।
बरनउँ बिसद राम गुन गाथा ॥
verses.tr:
sādar sivahi nāi ab māthā
baranaum̐ bisad rām gun gāthā

verses.sa:
संबत सोरह सै एकतीसा ।
करउँ कथा हरि पद धरि सीसा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbat sorah sai ekatīsā
karaum̐ kathā hari pad dhari sīsā

verses.sa:
नौमी भौम बार मधु मासा ।
अवधपुरीं यह चरित प्रकासा ॥
verses.tr:
naumī bhaum bār madhu māsā
avadhapurīṃ yah carit prakāsā

verses.sa:
जेहि दिन राम जनम श्रुति गावहिं ।
तीरथ सकल तहाँ चलि आवहिं ॥
verses.tr:
jehi din rām janam śruti gāvahiṃ
tīrath sakal tahām̐ cali āvahiṃ

verses.sa:
असुर नाग खग नर मुनि देवा ।
आइ करहिं रघुनायक सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
asur nāg khag nar muni devā
āi karahiṃ raghunāyak sevā

verses.sa:
जन्म महोत्सव रचहिं सुजाना ।
करहिं राम कल कीरति गाना ॥
verses.tr:
janm mahotsav racahiṃ sujānā
karahiṃ rām kal kīrati gānā

verses.sa:
मज्जहि सज्जन बृंद बहु पावन सरजू नीर ।
जपहिं राम धरि ध्यान उर सुंदर स्याम सरीर ॥
verses.tr:
majjahi sajjan bṛṃd bahu pāvan sarajū nīr
japahiṃ rām dhari dhyān ur suṃdar syām sarīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Having in this manner put away all doubt, I place on my head the dust from the lotus feet of my master, and with folded hand-making a general obeisance, that no fault may attach to my telling of the story, and bowing my head reverently before Siva, I proceed to sing of Rama’s excellent glory. In this Sambat year of 1631, I write with my head at Hari feet, on Tuesday the 9th of the sweet month of Chait, at the city of Avadh, on the day when the scriptures say Rama was born; when the spirits of all holy places there assemble, with demons, serpents, birds, men, saints, and gods, and there offer homage to RaghunAth, while the enlightened keep the great birthday festival and hymn Rama’s high glory.
Pious crows bathe in the all-purifying stream of the Sarju and murmur Rama's name, while his dark and beautiful form isimprinted on their hearts.

sections.label: Doha 35
sections.name: जस मानस जेहि बिधि भयउ जग प्रचार जेहि हेतु

verses.sa:
दरस परस मज्जन अरु पाना ।
हरइ पाप कह बेद पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
daras paras majjan aru pānā
harai pāp kah bed purānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नदी पुनीत अमित महिमा अति ।
कहि न सकइ सारद बिमलमति ॥
verses.tr:
nadī punīt amit mahimā ati
kahi na sakai sārad bimalamati

verses.sa:
राम धामदा पुरी सुहावनि ।
लोक समस्त बिदित अति पावनि ॥
verses.tr:
rām dhāmadā purī suhāvani
lok samast bidit ati pāvani

verses.sa:
चारि खानि जग जीव अपारा ।
अवध तजे तनु नहि संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
cāri khāni jag jīv apārā
avadh taje tanu nahi saṃsārā

verses.sa:
सब बिधि पुरी मनोहर जानी ।
सकल सिद्धिप्रद मंगल खानी ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi purī manohar jānī
sakal siddhiprad maṃgal khānī

verses.sa:
बिमल कथा कर कीन्ह अरंभा ।
सुनत नसाहिं काम मद दंभा ॥
verses.tr:
bimal kathā kar kīnh araṃbhā
sunat nasāhiṃ kām mad daṃbhā

verses.sa:
रामचरितमानस एहि नामा ।
सुनत श्रवन पाइअ बिश्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmacaritamānas ehi nāmā
sunat śravan pāia biśrāmā

verses.sa:
मन करि विषय अनल बन जरई ।
होइ सुखी जौ एहिं सर परई ॥
verses.tr:
man kari viṣaya anal ban jaraī
hoi sukhī jau ehiṃ sar paraī

verses.sa:
रामचरितमानस मुनि भावन ।
बिरचेउ संभु सुहावन पावन ॥
verses.tr:
rāmacaritamānas muni bhāvan
biraceu saṃbhu suhāvan pāvan

verses.sa:
त्रिबिध दोष दुख दारिद दावन ।
कलि कुचालि कुलि कलुष नसावन ॥
verses.tr:
tribidh doṣ dukh dārid dāvan
kali kucāli kuli kaluṣ nasāvan

verses.sa:
रचि महेस निज मानस राखा ।
पाइ सुसमउ सिवा सन भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
raci mahes nij mānas rākhā
pāi susamau sivā san bhāṣā

verses.sa:
तातें रामचरितमानस बर ।
धरेउ नाम हियँ हेरि हरषि हर ॥
verses.tr:
tāteṃ rāmacaritamānas bar
dhareu nām hiyam̐ heri haraṣi har

verses.sa:
कहउँ कथा सोइ सुखद सुहाई ।
सादर सुनहु सुजन मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ kathā soi sukhad suhāī
sādar sunahu sujan man lāī

verses.sa:
जस मानस जेहि बिधि भयउ जग प्रचार जेहि हेतु ।
अब सोइ कहउँ प्रसंग सब सुमिरि उमा बृषकेतु ॥
verses.tr:
jas mānas jehi bidhi bhayau jag pracār jehi hetu
ab soi kahaum̐ prasaṃg sab sumiri umā bṛṣaketu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Vedas and Purdnas declare that sin is cleansed by the mere sight or touch of this holy stream as well as by bathing in or drinking of it. Its immeasurable grandeur is indescribable even by the pure intelligence of Sarasvati. ‘The city, exalting to Rama’s heaven?, beautiful, celebrated through all worlds, is so all-purifying that countless as is the number of animate species that result from the four modes of birth, yet every individual that is freed from the body at Avadh is free for ever. Knowing it to be in every way charming, a bestower of success and a mine of auspiciousness, I there made a beginning of my sacred song, which will destroy in those who hear it the mad phrensy of lust; its mere name—lake of Rama’s acts—serves to refresh the ear, while the soul like an elephant escaping from a forest on fire with lust, plunges into it and gains relief; delight of the sages, as composed by Sambhu, holy and beautiful; consuming the three ill conditions of sin, sorrow and want; putting an end tothe evil practices and impurities of the wicked world; first made by Mahadeva and buried in deep lake of his own soul till at an auspicious moment he declared it to Uma; thus Siva looking into his own soul and rejoicing gave it the excellent name of Rama-charit-manas!. And this is the blessed legend that l repeat: hear it, good people, reverently and attentively.

Now meditating upon Uma and upon him who has a ball emblazoned on his standard (i.e. Mahadeva) I explain the connection, showing how it is a lake and in what manner it is formed, and for what reason it has spread through the world?,

sections.label: Doha 36
sections.name: सुठि सुंदर संबाद बर बिरचे बुद्धि बिचारि

verses.sa:
संभु प्रसाद सुमति हियँ हुलसी ।
रामचरितमानस कबि तुलसी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu prasād sumati hiyam̐ hulasī
rāmacaritamānas kabi tulasī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करइ मनोहर मति अनुहारी ।
सुजन सुचित सुनि लेहु सुधारी ॥
verses.tr:
karai manohar mati anuhārī
sujan sucit suni lehu sudhārī

verses.sa:
सुमति भूमि थल हृदय अगाधू ।
बेद पुरान उदधि घन साधू ॥
verses.tr:
sumati bhūmi thal hṛdaya agādhū
bed purān udadhi ghan sādhū

verses.sa:
बरषहिं राम सुजस बर बारी ।
मधुर मनोहर मंगलकारी ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣahiṃ rām sujas bar bārī
madhur manohar maṃgalakārī

verses.sa:
लीला सगुन जो कहहिं बखानी ।
सोइ स्वच्छता करइ मल हानी ॥
verses.tr:
līlā sagun jo kahahiṃ bakhānī
soi svacchatā karai mal hānī

verses.sa:
प्रेम भगति जो बरनि न जाई ।
सोइ मधुरता सुसीतलताई ॥
verses.tr:
prem bhagati jo barani na jāī
soi madhuratā susītalatāī

verses.sa:
सो जल सुकृत सालि हित होई ।
राम भगत जन जीवन सोई ॥
verses.tr:
so jal sukṛt sāli hit hoī
rām bhagat jan jīvan soī

verses.sa:
मेधा महि गत सो जल पावन ।
सकिलि श्रवन मग चलेउ सुहावन ॥
verses.tr:
medhā mahi gat so jal pāvan
sakili śravan mag caleu suhāvan

verses.sa:
भरेउ सुमानस सुथल थिराना ।
सुखद सीत रुचि चारु चिराना ॥
verses.tr:
bhareu sumānas suthal thirānā
sukhad sīt ruci cāru cirānā

verses.sa:
सुठि सुंदर संबाद बर बिरचे बुद्धि बिचारि ।
तेइ एहि पावन सुभग सर घाट मनोहर चारि ॥
verses.tr:
suṭhi suṃdar saṃbād bar birace buddhi bicāri
tei ehi pāvan subhag sar ghāṭ manohar cāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By the blessing of Sambhu a bright idea has come into the poet Tulsi’s mind regarding the lam-charit-manas, which I will state as well as I can, subject to the correction of those good people whose attention I invite. The heart iy as it were a deep place in a land of good thoughts, the” Vedas and Puranas are the sea, and the saints are as clouds, which rain down praises of Rama in sweet, grateful and auspicious showers; the sportive actions related of him are like the inherent purity and cleansing power of rain-water; while devotion, which is beyond the power of words to describe, is its sweetness and coolness. Whensuch a shower falls on the rice-fields of virtue, it gives new life to the faithful, and as its holy drops fall to the earth they are collected in the channel supplied by the ears, and flowing into the lake of the soul fill it and then settle down perma-nently, cool, beautiful and refreshing.
This pure and holy lake has four beautiful ghats, viz., the four charming dialogues contrived by divine wisdom.

sections.label: Doha 37
sections.name: पुलक बाटिका बाग बन सुख सुबिहंग बिहारु

verses.sa:
सप्त प्रबन्ध सुभग सोपाना ।
ग्यान नयन निरखत मन माना ॥
verses.tr:
sapt prabandh subhag sopānā
gyān nayan nirakhat man mānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रघुपति महिमा अगुन अबाधा ।
बरनब सोइ बर बारि अगाधा ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati mahimā agun abādhā
baranab soi bar bāri agādhā

verses.sa:
राम सीय जस सलिल सुधासम ।
उपमा बीचि बिलास मनोरम ॥
verses.tr:
rām sīya jas salil sudhāsam
upamā bīci bilās manoram

verses.sa:
पुरइनि सघन चारु चौपाई ।
जुगुति मंजु मनि सीप सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
puraini saghan cāru caupāī
juguti maṃju mani sīp suhāī

verses.sa:
छंद सोरठा सुंदर दोहा ।
सोइ बहुरंग कमल कुल सोहा ॥
verses.tr:
chaṃd soraṭhā suṃdar dohā
soi bahuraṃg kamal kul sohā

verses.sa:
अरथ अनूप सुमाव सुभासा ।
सोइ पराग मकरंद सुबासा ॥
verses.tr:
arath anūp sumāv subhāsā
soi parāg makaraṃd subāsā

verses.sa:
सुकृत पुंज मंजुल अलि माला ।
ग्यान बिराग बिचार मराला ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛt puṃj maṃjul ali mālā
gyān birāg bicār marālā

verses.sa:
धुनि अवरेब कबित गुन जाती ।
मीन मनोहर ते बहुभाँती ॥
verses.tr:
dhuni avareb kabit gun jātī
mīn manohar te bahubhām̐tī

verses.sa:
अरथ धरम कामादिक चारी ।
कहब ग्यान बिग्यान बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
arath dharam kāmādik cārī
kahab gyān bigyān bicārī

verses.sa:
नव रस जप तप जोग बिरागा ।
ते सब जलचर चारु तड़ागा ॥
verses.tr:
nav ras jap tap jog birāgā
te sab jalacar cāru tar̤āgā

verses.sa:
सुकृती साधु नाम गुन गाना ।
ते बिचित्र जल बिहग समाना ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛtī sādhu nām gun gānā
te bicitr jal bihag samānā

verses.sa:
संतसभा चहुँ दिसि अवँराई ।
श्रद्धा रितु बसंत सम गाई ॥
verses.tr:
saṃtasabhā cahum̐ disi avam̐rāī
śraddhā ritu basaṃt sam gāī

verses.sa:
भगति निरुपन बिबिध बिधाना ।
छमा दया दम लता बिताना ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati nirupan bibidh bidhānā
chamā dayā dam latā bitānā

verses.sa:
सम जम नियम फूल फल ग्याना ।
हरि पत रति रस बेद बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
sam jam niyam phūl phal gyānā
hari pat rati ras bed bakhānā

verses.sa:
औरउ कथा अनेक प्रसंगा ।
तेइ सुक पिक बहुबरन बिहंगा ॥
verses.tr:
aurau kathā anek prasaṃgā
tei suk pik bahubaran bihaṃgā

verses.sa:
पुलक बाटिका बाग बन सुख सुबिहंग बिहारु ।
माली सुमन सनेह जल सींचत लोचन चारु ॥
verses.tr:
pulak bāṭikā bāg ban sukh subihaṃg bihāru
mālī suman saneh jal sīṃcat locan cāru
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The seven Books are its beautiful flights of steps, which the eyes of the soul delight to look upon; the unqualified and unsullied greatness of Raghupati may be described asits clear and deep expanse; the glory of Rama and Sita as its ambrosial water; the similes as its pretty wavelets; the stanzas as its beautiful lotus beds; the elegance of expression as lovely mother-of-pearl: the chhands, sorathds, and couplets as many-coloured lotus flowers: the incomparable sense, sentiment, and language as the pollen, filaments and fragrance of the lotus; the exalted action as beautiful swarms of bees; the sage moral reflections as swans; the rhythm, involutions, and other poetical artifices as diverse graceful kinds of fish; the precepts regarding the four ends of life, the wise sayings, the thoughtful judgments, the nine styles of composition!, the prayers, penance, abstraction and asceticism, of which examples are given, areall beaatiful living creatures in the lake; eulogies on the faithful, the saints and the holy name are, like flocks of water-birds;

Be religious audience are like circling mango groves, and their faith like the spring season; the expositions of all the phases of devotion and of tenderness and generosity are like the trees and canopying creepers; self-denial and holy vows are their flowers, and wisdom their fruit; the love for Hari’s Feet as the sound of the Vedas: and all other stories and episodes as the parrots and cuckoos and many kinds
The hearer’s emotion is some grove, garden or parterre, where sportive birds symbolise his delight and Piety the gardener poursa stream of devotion from the water-pot of his eyes.,

sections.label: Doha 38
sections.name: जे श्रद्धा संबल रहित नहि संतन्ह कर साथ

verses.sa:
जे गावहिं यह चरित सँभारे ।
तेइ एहि ताल चतुर रखवारे ॥
verses.tr:
je gāvahiṃ yah carit sam̐bhāre
tei ehi tāl catur rakhavāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सदा सुनहिं सादर नर नारी ।
तेइ सुरबर मानस अधिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
sadā sunahiṃ sādar nar nārī
tei surabar mānas adhikārī

verses.sa:
अति खल जे बिषई बग कागा ।
एहिं सर निकट न जाहिं अभागा ॥
verses.tr:
ati khal je biṣaī bag kāgā
ehiṃ sar nikaṭ na jāhiṃ abhāgā

verses.sa:
संबुक भेक सेवार समाना ।
इहाँ न बिषय कथा रस नाना ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbuk bhek sevār samānā
ihām̐ na biṣaya kathā ras nānā

verses.sa:
तेहि कारन आवत हियँ हारे ।
कामी काक बलाक बिचारे ॥
verses.tr:
tehi kāran āvat hiyam̐ hāre
kāmī kāk balāk bicāre

verses.sa:
आवत एहिं सर अति कठिनाई ।
राम कृपा बिनु आइ न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
āvat ehiṃ sar ati kaṭhināī
rām kṛpā binu āi na jāī

verses.sa:
कठिन कुसंग कुपंथ कराला ।
तिन्ह के बचन बाघ हरि ब्याला ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭhin kusaṃg kupaṃth karālā
tinh ke bacan bāgh hari byālā

verses.sa:
गृह कारज नाना जंजाला ।
ते अति दुर्गम सैल बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
gṛh kāraj nānā jaṃjālā
te ati durgam sail bisālā

verses.sa:
बन बहु बिषम मोह मद माना ।
नदीं कुतर्क भयंकर नाना ॥
verses.tr:
ban bahu biṣam moh mad mānā
nadīṃ kutark bhayaṃkar nānā

verses.sa:
जे श्रद्धा संबल रहित नहि संतन्ह कर साथ ।
तिन्ह कहुँ मानस अगम अति जिन्हहि न प्रिय रघुनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
je śraddhā saṃbal rahit nahi saṃtanh kar sāth
tinh kahum̐ mānas agam ati jinhahi na priya raghunāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Those who diligently recite these lays are like the vigi-lant guardiansof the lake; the men and women who reverently hear them, these excellent people are like its owners. Sensual wretches are like the canes andcrows that have no part in such a pond nor ever come near it; for here are no prurient and seductive stories like snaily, frogs and scum on the water, and therefore the lustful crow and greedy crane, if they do come, are disappointed. There is much difficulty in getting to this lake, and it is only by the favour of Rama that any one reaches it. For bad company makes much steepness and difficulty in the road; their evil sayings are so many tigers, lions and serpents; the various entanglements of domestic affairs are vast insurmountable mountains; sensual desires are like a dense forest full of wild delusion; and unsonnd reasoning is a raging flood.
For those who have not the support of faith, nor the company of the saints, nor fervent love for Raghunath, for them this lake is very hard of access.

sections.label: Doha 39
sections.name: श्रोता त्रिबिध समाज पुर ग्राम नगर दुहुँ कूल

verses.sa:
जौं करि कष्ट जाइ पुनि कोई ।
जातहिं नींद जुड़ाई होई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ kari kaṣṭ jāi puni koī
jātahiṃ nīṃd jur̤āī hoī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जड़ता जाड़ बिषम उर लागा ।
गएहुँ न मज्जन पाव अभागा ॥
verses.tr:
jar̤atā jār̤ biṣam ur lāgā
gaehum̐ na majjan pāv abhāgā

verses.sa:
करि न जाइ सर मज्जन पाना ।
फिरि आवइ समेत अभिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
kari na jāi sar majjan pānā
phiri āvai samet abhimānā

verses.sa:
जौं बहोरि कोउ पूछन आवा ।
सर निंदा करि ताहि बुझावा ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ bahori kou pūchan āvā
sar niṃdā kari tāhi bujhāvā

verses.sa:
सकल बिघ्न ब्यापहि नहिं तेही ।
राम सुकृपाँ बिलोकहिं जेही ॥
verses.tr:
sakal bighn byāpahi nahiṃ tehī
rām sukṛpām̐ bilokahiṃ jehī

verses.sa:
सोइ सादर सर मज्जनु करई ।
महा घोर त्रयताप न जरई ॥
verses.tr:
soi sādar sar majjanu karaī
mahā ghor trayatāp na jaraī

verses.sa:
ते नर यह सर तजहिं न काऊ ।
जिन्ह के राम चरन भल भाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
te nar yah sar tajahiṃ na kāū
jinh ke rām caran bhal bhāū

verses.sa:
जो नहाइ चह एहिं सर भाई ।
सो सतसंग करउ मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
jo nahāi cah ehiṃ sar bhāī
so satasaṃg karau man lāī

verses.sa:
अस मानस मानस चख चाही ।
भइ कबि बुद्धि बिमल अवगाही ॥
verses.tr:
as mānas mānas cakh cāhī
bhai kabi buddhi bimal avagāhī

verses.sa:
भयउ हृदयँ आनंद उछाहू ।
उमगेउ प्रेम प्रमोद प्रबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau hṛdayam̐ ānaṃd uchāhū
umageu prem pramod prabāhū

verses.sa:
चली सुभग कबिता सरिता सो ।
राम बिमल जस जल भरिता सो ॥
verses.tr:
calī subhag kabitā saritā so
rām bimal jas jal bharitā so

verses.sa:
सरजू नाम सुमंगल मूला ।
लोक बेद मत मंजुल कूला ॥
verses.tr:
sarajū nām sumaṃgal mūlā
lok bed mat maṃjul kūlā

verses.sa:
नदी पुनीत सुमानस नंदिनि ।
कलिमल तृन तरु मूल निकंदिनि ॥
verses.tr:
nadī punīt sumānas naṃdini
kalimal tṛn taru mūl nikaṃdini

verses.sa:
श्रोता त्रिबिध समाज पुर ग्राम नगर दुहुँ कूल ।
संतसभा अनुपम अवध सकल सुमंगल मूल ॥
verses.tr:
śrotā tribidh samāj pur grām nagar duhum̐ kūl
saṃtasabhā anupam avadh sakal sumaṃgal mūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again, if any one laboriously makes his way to it, but becomes over-powered by sleep and feverishness, strange torpor and numbness settle on his soul, and though he is on the spot, the luckless wretch makes noablution, Having. neither bathed io the lake nor drunk of it he goes away in his pride, and when some one comes to inquire of him he abuses it But no difficulties deter those whom Rama regards with affection. They reverently bathe, are relieved from the fierce flames of sin, sorrow, and pain, and being sincerely devoted to Kama will never abandon itaem le my friend, you would bathe In this lake, be diligent to keep company with the good. As for myself, having thus with the mind’s eye contemplated it, my poetical faculty has become clear and profound, my heart swells with joy and rapture and overflows in a torrent of ecstatic devotion. My song pours on like a river flooded with Rama's bright renown; like the river Sarju, fountain of bliss, with piety and theology for its two fair banks; a holy stream rejoicing the pious soul (or born of the Manas lake,) sweeping away all worldly impurities like trees and roots on its bank.
The three kinds of hearers in the assembly are like the towns, villages, and hamlets on the river-side; while the saints are like the incomparable city of Avadh, full of all that is auspicious.

sections.label: Doha 40
sections.name: बालचरित चहु बंधु के बनज बिपुल बहुरंग

verses.sa:
रामभगति सुरसरितहि जाई ।
मिली सुकीरति सरजु सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
rāmabhagati surasaritahi jāī
milī sukīrati saraju suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सानुज राम समर जसु पावन ।
मिलेउ महानदु सोन सुहावन ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj rām samar jasu pāvan
mileu mahānadu son suhāvan

verses.sa:
जुग बिच भगति देवधुनि धारा ।
सोहति सहित सुबिरति बिचारा ॥
verses.tr:
jug bic bhagati devadhuni dhārā
sohati sahit subirati bicārā

verses.sa:
त्रिबिध ताप त्रासक तिमुहानी ।
राम सरुप सिंधु समुहानी ॥
verses.tr:
tribidh tāp trāsak timuhānī
rām sarup siṃdhu samuhānī

verses.sa:
मानस मूल मिली सुरसरिही ।
सुनत सुजन मन पावन करिही ॥
verses.tr:
mānas mūl milī surasarihī
sunat sujan man pāvan karihī

verses.sa:
बिच बिच कथा बिचित्र बिभागा ।
जनु सरि तीर तीर बन बागा ॥
verses.tr:
bic bic kathā bicitr bibhāgā
janu sari tīr tīr ban bāgā

verses.sa:
उमा महेस बिबाह बराती ।
ते जलचर अगनित बहुभाँती ॥
verses.tr:
umā mahes bibāh barātī
te jalacar aganit bahubhām̐tī

verses.sa:
रघुबर जनम अनंद बधाई ।
भवँर तरंग मनोहरताई ॥
verses.tr:
raghubar janam anaṃd badhāī
bhavam̐r taraṃg manoharatāī

verses.sa:
बालचरित चहु बंधु के बनज बिपुल बहुरंग ।
नृप रानी परिजन सुकृत मधुकर बारिबिहंग ॥
verses.tr:
bālacarit cahu baṃdhu ke banaj bipul bahuraṃg
nṛp rānī parijan sukṛt madhukar bāribihaṃg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The beautifal Sarju, as it were the glory of Rama has united with the Ganges of devotion; and the magnificent river Son, like the warlike power of Rama and his brother, has joined them usa third. Between the two, the Ganges stream of devotion shines clear in its wisdom and self-control, while the combined flood destroying the triple curse of humanity is absorbed in the mighty ocean of very Rama. The united stream of the Maenas-born Sarju and the Ganges purifies the pious listener, while the various tales and episodes interspersed here and there are the groves and gardens on its opposite banks; the details of the marriage and wedding procession of Uma and Siva are like the innumerable fish in the water; the joy and gladness that attended Rama’s birth are like beautiful swarmagaf bees and the ripple of the lake.
The childish sports of the four brothers are like the goodly lotus flowers; the virtuous king and queen and ‘their court like the bees and water-birds.

sections.label: Doha 41
sections.name: समन अमित उतपात सब भरतचरित जपजाग

verses.sa:
सीय स्वयंबर कथा सुहाई ।
सरित सुहावनि सो छबि छाई ॥
verses.tr:
sīya svayaṃbar kathā suhāī
sarit suhāvani so chabi chāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नदी नाव पटु प्रस्न अनेका ।
केवट कुसल उतर सबिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
nadī nāv paṭu prasn anekā
kevaṭ kusal utar sabibekā

verses.sa:
सुनि अनुकथन परस्पर होई ।
पथिक समाज सोह सरि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
suni anukathan paraspar hoī
pathik samāj soh sari soī

verses.sa:
घोर धार भृगुनाथ रिसानी ।
घाट सुबद्ध राम बर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
ghor dhār bhṛgunāth risānī
ghāṭ subaddh rām bar bānī

verses.sa:
सानुज राम बिबाह उछाहू ।
सो सुभ उमग सुखद सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj rām bibāh uchāhū
so subh umag sukhad sab kāhū

verses.sa:
कहत सुनत हरषहिं पुलकाहीं ।
ते सुकृती मन मुदित नहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahat sunat haraṣahiṃ pulakāhīṃ
te sukṛtī man mudit nahāhīṃ

verses.sa:
राम तिलक हित मंगल साजा ।
परब जोग जनु जुरे समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
rām tilak hit maṃgal sājā
parab jog janu jure samājā

verses.sa:
काई कुमति केकई केरी ।
परी जासु फल बिपति घनेरी ॥
verses.tr:
kāī kumati kekaī kerī
parī jāsu phal bipati ghanerī

verses.sa:
समन अमित उतपात सब भरतचरित जपजाग ।
कलि अघ खल अवगुन कथन ते जलमल बग काग ॥
verses.tr:
saman amit utapāt sab bharatacarit japajāg
kali agh khal avagun kathan te jalamal bag kāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The charming story of Sita’s marriage like the bright gleam of the flashing river; the many ingenious questions like the boats on the stream; the appropriate and judicious answers like the boatmen; again, the argumentative discussions show like crowding travellers; the wrath of Bhrigunath like the rushing torrent; Rama's soft speech Like the well-arranged ghdts; the marriage festivities of Kama and Lakshman like the grateful swell of the tide; the thrill of pleasure that spreads through the delighted audience like the ecstatic feelings of the virtuous bathers; the auspicious preparations for marking Rama's forehead with the tilak like the crowds assembled on holidays; and like river mud is Kaikeyi’s evil counsel, the ouuso of many calamities.

Like prayers and sacrifices effectual to remove every misfortune are Bharat’s virtuous acts; while the corrup-tions of the world and sinful men and slanderers are like the scum on the water and the cranes and crows.

sections.label: Doha 42
sections.name: अवलोकनि बोलनि मिलनि प्रीति परसपर हास

verses.sa:
कीरति सरित छहूँ रितु रूरी ।
समय सुहावनि पावनि भूरी ॥
verses.tr:
kīrati sarit chahūm̐ ritu rūrī
samaya suhāvani pāvani bhūrī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हिम हिमसैलसुता सिव ब्याहू ।
सिसिर सुखद प्रभु जनम उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
him himasailasutā siv byāhū
sisir sukhad prabhu janam uchāhū

verses.sa:
बरनब राम बिबाह समाजू ।
सो मुद मंगलमय रितुराजू ॥
verses.tr:
baranab rām bibāh samājū
so mud maṃgalamaya riturājū

verses.sa:
ग्रीषम दुसह राम बनगवनू ।
पंथकथा खर आतप पवनू ॥
verses.tr:
grīṣam dusah rām banagavanū
paṃthakathā khar ātap pavanū

verses.sa:
बरषा घोर निसाचर रारी ।
सुरकुल सालि सुमंगलकारी ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣā ghor nisācar rārī
surakul sāli sumaṃgalakārī

verses.sa:
राम राज सुख बिनय बड़ाई ।
बिसद सुखद सोइ सरद सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām rāj sukh binaya bar̤āī
bisad sukhad soi sarad suhāī

verses.sa:
सती सिरोमनि सिय गुनगाथा ।
सोइ गुन अमल अनूपम पाथा ॥
verses.tr:
satī siromani siya gunagāthā
soi gun amal anūpam pāthā

verses.sa:
भरत सुभाउ सुसीतलताई ।
सदा एकरस बरनि न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat subhāu susītalatāī
sadā ekaras barani na jāī

verses.sa:
अवलोकनि बोलनि मिलनि प्रीति परसपर हास ।
भायप भलि चहु बंधु की जल माधुरी सुबास ॥
verses.tr:
avalokani bolani milani prīti parasapar hās
bhāyap bhali cahu baṃdhu kī jal mādhurī subās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: This river of glory is beautiful in each of the six seasons, bright and holy exceedingly at all times. The story of the marriage of Siva with the daughter of the snowy mountains is like the winter; the glad rejoicings at the Lord's birth are like the dewy season; the account of the preparations for Rama’s wedding are like the delightful and auspicious spring; Rama’s intolerable banishment is like the hot weather, and story of the rough journeyings like the blazing sun and the wind; his encounters with fierce demons, by which he gladdens the hosts of heaven, are like the rains, that refresh the fields; the prosperity of his reign, his meeKness and greatness are like the clear, bountiful and lovely autumn; the recital of the virtues of Sita, that jewel of faithful wives, is as the undefiled and excellent water; the amiability of Bharat as its unvarying coolness.
Their looks and words at meeting, their mutual Love and laughter, the true fraternal affection of the four brothers, are as the water's sweet odour.

sections.label: Doha 43
sections.name: मति अनुहारि सुबारि गुन गनि मन अन्हवाइ

verses.sa:
आरति बिनय दीनता मोरी ।
लघुता ललित सुबारि न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
ārati binaya dīnatā morī
laghutā lalit subāri na thorī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अदभुत सलिल सुनत गुनकारी ।
आस पिआस मनोमल हारी ॥
verses.tr:
adabhut salil sunat gunakārī
ās piās manomal hārī

verses.sa:
राम सुप्रेमहि पोषत पानी ।
हरत सकल कलि कलुष गलानी ॥
verses.tr:
rām supremahi poṣat pānī
harat sakal kali kaluṣ galānī

verses.sa:
भव श्रम सोषक तोषक तोषा ।
समन दुरित दुख दारिद दोषा ॥
verses.tr:
bhav śram soṣak toṣak toṣā
saman durit dukh dārid doṣā

verses.sa:
काम कोह मद मोह नसावन ।
बिमल बिबेक बिराग बढ़ावन ॥
verses.tr:
kām koh mad moh nasāvan
bimal bibek birāg bar̤hāvan

verses.sa:
सादर मज्जन पान किए तें ।
मिटहिं पाप परिताप हिए तें ॥
verses.tr:
sādar majjan pān kie teṃ
miṭahiṃ pāp paritāp hie teṃ

verses.sa:
जिन्ह एहि बारि न मानस धोए ।
ते कायर कलिकाल बिगोए ॥
verses.tr:
jinh ehi bāri na mānas dhoe
te kāyar kalikāl bigoe

verses.sa:
तृषित निरखि रबि कर भव बारी ।
फिरिहहि मृग जिमि जीव दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
tṛṣit nirakhi rabi kar bhav bārī
phirihahi mṛg jimi jīv dukhārī

verses.sa:
मति अनुहारि सुबारि गुन गनि मन अन्हवाइ ।
सुमिरि भवानी संकरहि कह कबि कथा सुहाइ ॥
verses.tr:
mati anuhāri subāri gun gani man anhavāi
sumiri bhavānī saṃkarahi kah kabi kathā suhāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
अब रघुपति पद पंकरुह हियँ धरि पाइ प्रसाद ।
कहउँ जुगल मुनिबर्ज कर मिलन सुभग संबाद ॥
verses.tr:
ab raghupati pad paṃkaruh hiyam̐ dhari pāi prasād
kahaum̐ jugal munibarj kar milan subhag saṃbād

trans: My suppliant address and self-depreciation and modesty correspond to the singular lightness of£ good water, which is anything but a defect. This marvellous lymph works its effect by the mere hearing, quenching the thirst of desire and cleansing the soul of impurity; it resuscitates true love to Rama and puts an end to all the sin and sorrow of the world; draining life of its weariness; comforting with true comfort; destroying sin and pain and poverty and error; dispelling lust and passion and phrensy and infatuation, and promoting pure intelligence and detachment from the world. Those who reverently drink or bathe in this stream, from their soul is effaced all sin and distress; those who do not cleanse their heart in it are wretches whom the world has ruined, turning back, hapless creatures, like a panting deer that has seen a river in a mirage |

Thus I have declared to the best of my ability the virtues of this excellent water, and having plunged my own soul in it, and ever remembering Bhavani and Sankara, I proceed with my delectable story. I will first repeat in substance the original conversation, with the questions put by Bharadv^ja when he found the Muni Yajnavalkya; and laying my soul at the lotus feet of Raghupati and. thus securing his patronage, I will sing the meeting of the two great saints and their auspicious discourse.

sections.label: Doha 44
sections.name: ब्रह्म निरूपम धरम बिधि बरनहिं तत्त्व बिभाग

verses.sa:
भरद्वाज मुनि बसहिं प्रयागा ।
तिन्हहि राम पद अति अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
bharadvāj muni basahiṃ prayāgā
tinhahi rām pad ati anurāgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तापस सम दम दया निधाना ।
परमारथ पथ परम सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
tāpas sam dam dayā nidhānā
paramārath path param sujānā

verses.sa:
माघ मकरगत रबि जब होई ।
तीरथपतिहिं आव सब कोई ॥
verses.tr:
māgh makaragat rabi jab hoī
tīrathapatihiṃ āv sab koī

verses.sa:
देव दनुज किंनर नर श्रेनी ।
सादर मज्जहिं सकल त्रिबेनीं ॥
verses.tr:
dev danuj kiṃnar nar śrenī
sādar majjahiṃ sakal tribenīṃ

verses.sa:
पूजहि माधव पद जलजाता ।
परसि अखय बटु हरषहिं गाता ॥
verses.tr:
pūjahi mādhav pad jalajātā
parasi akhaya baṭu haraṣahiṃ gātā

verses.sa:
भरद्वाज आश्रम अति पावन ।
परम रम्य मुनिबर मन भावन ॥
verses.tr:
bharadvāj āśram ati pāvan
param ramya munibar man bhāvan

verses.sa:
तहाँ होइ मुनि रिषय समाजा ।
जाहिं जे मज्जन तीरथराजा ॥
verses.tr:
tahām̐ hoi muni riṣaya samājā
jāhiṃ je majjan tīratharājā

verses.sa:
मज्जहिं प्रात समेत उछाहा ।
कहहिं परसपर हरि गुन गाहा ॥
verses.tr:
majjahiṃ prāt samet uchāhā
kahahiṃ parasapar hari gun gāhā

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म निरूपम धरम बिधि बरनहिं तत्त्व बिभाग ।
कहहिं भगति भगवंत कै संजुत ग्यान बिराग ॥
verses.tr:
brahm nirūpam dharam bidhi baranahiṃ tattv bibhāg
kahahiṃ bhagati bhagavaṃt kai saṃjut gyān birāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At Prayag lives the saint Bharadvaja, devoted beyond measure to Rama's feet, a self-restrained ascetic full of sobriety and benevolence, supremely skilled iv divine knowledge. In the month of Magh, when the sun enters the sign of Capricorn, every one visits this chiefgpf holy places; gods, demi-gods, Kinnars, and men in troops, all devoutly bathe in the triple flood and worship the lotus feet of Mahadeva while they have the happiness of touching the imperishable fig-tree. At Bharadvaja’s hallowed hermitage—so charming a spot that even the saint loved it— is ever a concourse of seers and sages come to bathe at the holiest of all holy places; and having with gladness performed their ablutions at break of day, they converse together on the glories of Hari.
Discussing the nature of the deity, the kinds of religious observance and the classification of primordial entities; and declaring faith in God to be the epitome of wisdom and spiritual detachment!.

sections.label: Doha 45
sections.name: संत कहहि असि नीति प्रभु श्रुति पुरान मुनि गाव

verses.sa:
एहि प्रकार भरि माघ नहाहीं ।
पुनि सब निज निज आश्रम जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi prakār bhari māgh nahāhīṃ
puni sab nij nij āśram jāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रति संबत अति होइ अनंदा ।
मकर मज्जि गवनहिं मुनिबृंदा ॥
verses.tr:
prati saṃbat ati hoi anaṃdā
makar majji gavanahiṃ munibṛṃdā

verses.sa:
एक बार भरि मकर नहाए ।
सब मुनीस आश्रमन्ह सिधाए ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār bhari makar nahāe
sab munīs āśramanh sidhāe

verses.sa:
जगबालिक मुनि परम बिबेकी ।
भरव्दाज राखे पद टेकी ॥
verses.tr:
jagabālik muni param bibekī
bharavdāj rākhe pad ṭekī

verses.sa:
सादर चरन सरोज पखारे ।
अति पुनीत आसन बैठारे ॥
verses.tr:
sādar caran saroj pakhāre
ati punīt āsan baiṭhāre

verses.sa:
करि पूजा मुनि सुजस बखानी ।
बोले अति पुनीत मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā muni sujas bakhānī
bole ati punīt mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
नाथ एक संसउ बड़ मोरें ।
करगत बेदतत्व सबु तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
nāth ek saṃsau bar̤ moreṃ
karagat bedatatv sabu toreṃ

verses.sa:
कहत सो मोहि लागत भय लाजा ।
जौ न कहउँ बड़ होइ अकाजा ॥
verses.tr:
kahat so mohi lāgat bhaya lājā
jau na kahaum̐ bar̤ hoi akājā

verses.sa:
संत कहहि असि नीति प्रभु श्रुति पुरान मुनि गाव ।
होइ न बिमल बिबेक उर गुर सन किएँ दुराव ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt kahahi asi nīti prabhu śruti purān muni gāv
hoi na bimal bibek ur gur san kiem̐ durāv
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After thus bathing every day that the sun is in Capricorn, they again return each to his own cell, and every year there is a similar rejoicing when the saints meet for the annual ablution. On one occasion, when the bathing time was over, and all the holy men had left, Bharadvaja clasped by the-feet and detained the supremely wise saint Yajnavatkya, and having reverently laved his lotus feet and seated him on a pre-eminent throne, he with religious ceremony extolled the saint’s glory, and finally thus addrest him in mildest of tones, “Sir, I have a great doubt, while in your grasp are all the mysteries of the Veda; I am afraid and ashamed to speak, but if I speak not, I lose a great opportunity.
This, sir, is a maxim of all the saints, and is also declared by the Vedas and Puranas, that there is no sound wisdom in his breast who conceals aught from his ghostly father.

sections.label: Doha 46
sections.name: प्रभु सोइ राम कि अपर कोउ जाहि जपत त्रिपुरारि

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि प्रगटउँ निज मोहू ।
हरहु नाथ करि जन पर छोहू ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri pragaṭaum̐ nij mohū
harahu nāth kari jan par chohū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम नाम कर अमित प्रभावा ।
संत पुरान उपनिषद गावा ॥
verses.tr:
rām nām kar amit prabhāvā
saṃt purān upaniṣad gāvā

verses.sa:
संतत जपत संभु अबिनासी ।
सिव भगवान ग्यान गुन रासी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃtat japat saṃbhu abināsī
siv bhagavān gyān gun rāsī

verses.sa:
आकर चारि जीव जग अहहीं ।
कासीं मरत परम पद लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ākar cāri jīv jag ahahīṃ
kāsīṃ marat param pad lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
सोपि राम महिमा मुनिराया ।
सिव उपदेसु करत करि दाया ॥
verses.tr:
sopi rām mahimā munirāyā
siv upadesu karat kari dāyā

verses.sa:
रामु कवन प्रभु पूछउँ तोही ।
कहिअ बुझाइ कृपानिधि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu kavan prabhu pūchaum̐ tohī
kahia bujhāi kṛpānidhi mohī

verses.sa:
एक राम अवधेस कुमारा ।
तिन्ह कर चरित बिदित संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
ek rām avadhes kumārā
tinh kar carit bidit saṃsārā

verses.sa:
नारि बिरहँ दुखु लहेउ अपारा ।
भयहु रोषु रन रावनु मारा ॥
verses.tr:
nāri biraham̐ dukhu laheu apārā
bhayahu roṣu ran rāvanu mārā

verses.sa:
प्रभु सोइ राम कि अपर कोउ जाहि जपत त्रिपुरारि ।
सत्यधाम सर्बग्य तुम्ह कहहु बिबेकु बिचारि ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu soi rām ki apar kou jāhi japat tripurāri
satyadhām sarbagya tumh kahahu bibeku bicāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Remembering this, I lay bare my folly—take pity, my lord, on your faithful servant and dispel it. The might of Rama's name is immeasurable; 80 tell the saints, the Puranas and the Vedic commentaries; the immortal Sambhu, who is the Lord Siva, the perfection of wisdom and goodness, is ever repeating it; though all] the four groups of animate beings in the world attain to salvation if they die in his city Kasi, yet O king of saints, it is by the virtue of Rama’s name; and therefore Siva in his compassion enjoins its use. l ask of you, my lord, who is this Rama? be gracious enough to instruct me. There is one Rama, the prince of Avadh, whose acts are known throughout the world who suffered infinite distress by the loss of his wife, and waxing wrath slew Ravan in battle.
Is it this Rama, my lord, or another, whose name Tripureri is ever repeating? Ponder the matter well and tell me, O wisest and most faithful of men.

sections.label: Doha 47
sections.name: कहउँ सो मति अनुहारि अब उमा संभु संबाद

verses.sa:
जैसे मिटै मोर भ्रम भारी ।
कहहु सो कथा नाथ बिस्तारी ॥
verses.tr:
jaise miṭai mor bhram bhārī
kahahu so kathā nāth bistārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जागबलिक बोले मुसुकाई ।
तुम्हहि बिदित रघुपति प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
jāgabalik bole musukāī
tumhahi bidit raghupati prabhutāī

verses.sa:
राममगत तुम्ह मन क्रम बानी ।
चतुराई तुम्हारी मैं जानी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmamagat tumh man kram bānī
caturāī tumhārī maiṃ jānī

verses.sa:
चाहहु सुनै राम गुन गूढ़ा ।
कीन्हिहु प्रस्न मनहुँ अति मूढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
cāhahu sunai rām gun gūr̤hā
kīnhihu prasn manahum̐ ati mūr̤hā

verses.sa:
तात सुनहु सादर मनु लाई ।
कहउँ राम कै कथा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
tāt sunahu sādar manu lāī
kahaum̐ rām kai kathā suhāī

verses.sa:
महामोहु महिषेसु बिसाला ।
रामकथा कालिका कराला ॥
verses.tr:
mahāmohu mahiṣesu bisālā
rāmakathā kālikā karālā

verses.sa:
रामकथा ससि किरन समाना ।
संत चकोर करहिं जेहि पाना ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā sasi kiran samānā
saṃt cakor karahiṃ jehi pānā

verses.sa:
ऐसेइ संसय कीन्ह भवानी ।
महादेव तब कहा बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
aisei saṃsaya kīnh bhavānī
mahādev tab kahā bakhānī

verses.sa:
कहउँ सो मति अनुहारि अब उमा संभु संबाद ।
भयउ समय जेहि हेतु जेहि सुनु मुनि मिटिहि बिषाद ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ so mati anuhāri ab umā saṃbhu saṃbād
bhayau samaya jehi hetu jehi sunu muni miṭihi biṣād
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Tell me the whole history in full, my master, so that my

overpowering perplexity way be solved.” Said Yajnavalkya with a smile,—‘ All the glory of Raghupati is known to you; you are a votary of his in heart, word and deed; I under stand your stratagem. Wishing to hear the marvellous tale of Rama's achievements, you have questioned me with an affectation of great simplicity. Listen then, my son, with devout attention while I repeat the fair legend, which van-quishes every monstrous error, as dread Devi vanquished the demon Mahishasur, but which is drunk in by the saints as the light of the moon by the chakor. When a similar doubt was suggested by Bhavani, Mahadeva expounded the matter;
And I now, as best I can repeat their conversation, nothing both its time and occasion; on hearing it, my friend, all difficulties vanish.

sections.label: Doha 48
sections.name: ह्दयँ बिचारत जात हर केहि बिधि दरसनु होइ

verses.sa:
एक बार त्रेता जुग माहीं ।
संभु गए कुंभज रिषि पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār tretā jug māhīṃ
saṃbhu gae kuṃbhaj riṣi pāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
संग सती जगजननि भवानी ।
पूजे रिषि अखिलेस्वर जानी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃg satī jagajanani bhavānī
pūje riṣi akhilesvar jānī

verses.sa:
रामकथा मुनीबर्ज बखानी ।
सुनी महेस परम सुखु मानी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā munībarj bakhānī
sunī mahes param sukhu mānī

verses.sa:
रिषि पूछी हरिभगति सुहाई ।
कही संभु अधिकारी पाई ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi pūchī haribhagati suhāī
kahī saṃbhu adhikārī pāī

verses.sa:
कहत सुनत रघुपति गुन गाथा ।
कछु दिन तहाँ रहे गिरिनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
kahat sunat raghupati gun gāthā
kachu din tahām̐ rahe girināthā

verses.sa:
मुनि सन बिदा मागि त्रिपुरारी ।
चले भवन सँग दच्छकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
muni san bidā māgi tripurārī
cale bhavan sam̐g dacchakumārī

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर भंजन महिभारा ।
हरि रघुबंस लीन्ह अवतारा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar bhaṃjan mahibhārā
hari raghubaṃs līnh avatārā

verses.sa:
पिता बचन तजि राजु उदासी ।
दंडक बन बिचरत अबिनासी ॥
verses.tr:
pitā bacan taji rāju udāsī
daṃḍak ban bicarat abināsī

verses.sa:
ह्दयँ बिचारत जात हर केहि बिधि दरसनु होइ ।
गुप्त रुप अवतरेउ प्रभु गएँ जान सबु कोइ ॥
verses.tr:
hdayam̐ bicārat jāt har kehi bidhi darasanu hoi
gupt rup avatareu prabhu gaem̐ jān sabu koi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: संकर उर अति छोभु सती न जानहिं मरमु सोइ ॥
verses.tr: saṃkar ur ati chobhu satī na jānahiṃ maramu soi

verses.sa: तुलसी दरसन लोभु मन डरु लोचन लालची ॥
verses.tr: tulasī darasan lobhu man ḍaru locan lālacī

trans: Once upon a time, in the second age of the world, Sambhu visited the Rishi Agastya; with him went the mother of the world, the faithful Bhavani. The hermit made obeisance, for he recognized them as the sovereigns of the universe, and recited the story of Rama, with which Mahadeva was delighted. The hermit then asked him about true faith in Hari; and Sambhu instructed him, for he saw him to be deserving. In such converse the mountain-lord Mahadeva passed some days there, but finally took his leave and returned home with the daughter of Daksha. Now at that time there had become incarnate, in the family of Raghu, Hari the ‘destroyer of the burdens of the world, who at his father’s word sorrowfully left the throne and wandered, immortal god though he was, in the Dandaka forest.
Siva kept pondering as he went,—-‘ How can I obtain a sight of him? for every one knows that the lord has become incarnate secretly; if I visit him, every one will know who he is.’

sections.label: Doha 49
sections.name: अति विचित्र रघुपति चरित जानहिं परम सुजान

verses.sa:
रावन मरन मनुज कर जाचा ।
प्रभु बिधि बचनु कीन्ह चह साचा ॥
verses.tr:
rāvan maran manuj kar jācā
prabhu bidhi bacanu kīnh cah sācā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौं नहिं जाउँ रहइ पछितावा ।
करत बिचारु न बनत बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nahiṃ jāum̐ rahai pachitāvā
karat bicāru na banat banāvā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि भए सोचबस ईसा ।
तेहि समय जाइ दससीसा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bhae socabas īsā
tehi samaya jāi dasasīsā

verses.sa:
लीन्ह नीच मारीचहि संगा ।
भयउ तुरत सोइ कपट कुरंगा ॥
verses.tr:
līnh nīc mārīcahi saṃgā
bhayau turat soi kapaṭ kuraṃgā

verses.sa:
करि छलु मूढ़ हरी बैदेही ।
प्रभु प्रभाउ तस बिदित न तेही ॥
verses.tr:
kari chalu mūr̤h harī baidehī
prabhu prabhāu tas bidit na tehī

verses.sa:
मृग बधि बन्धु सहित हरि आए ।
आश्रमु देखि नयन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
mṛg badhi bandhu sahit hari āe
āśramu dekhi nayan jal chāe

verses.sa:
बिरह बिकल नर इव रघुराई ।
खोजत बिपिन फिरत दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
birah bikal nar iv raghurāī
khojat bipin phirat dou bhāī

verses.sa:
कबहूँ जोग बियोग न जाकें ।
देखा प्रगट बिरह दुख ताकें ॥
verses.tr:
kabahūm̐ jog biyog na jākeṃ
dekhā pragaṭ birah dukh tākeṃ

verses.sa:
अति विचित्र रघुपति चरित जानहिं परम सुजान ।
जे मतिमंद बिमोह बस हृदयँ धरहिं कछु आन ॥
verses.tr:
ati vicitr raghupati carit jānahiṃ param sujān
je matimaṃd bimoh bas hṛdayam̐ dharahiṃ kachu ān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In Sankara’s heart was a great tumult, but Sati did not comprehend the mystery; says Tulsi, the hope of an interview filled his soul with agitation and his eyes with wistfulness.

sections.label: Doha 50
sections.name: ब्रह्म जो व्यापक बिरज अज अकल अनीह अभेद

verses.sa:
संभु समय तेहि रामहि देखा ।
उपजा हियँ अति हरपु बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu samaya tehi rāmahi dekhā
upajā hiyam̐ ati harapu biseṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरि लोचन छबिसिंधु निहारी ।
कुसमय जानिन कीन्हि चिन्हारी ॥
verses.tr:
bhari locan chabisiṃdhu nihārī
kusamaya jānin kīnhi cinhārī

verses.sa:
जय सच्चिदानंद जग पावन ।
अस कहि चलेउ मनोज नसावन ॥
verses.tr:
jaya saccidānaṃd jag pāvan
as kahi caleu manoj nasāvan

verses.sa:
चले जात सिव सती समेता ।
पुनि पुनि पुलकत कृपानिकेता ॥
verses.tr:
cale jāt siv satī sametā
puni puni pulakat kṛpāniketā

verses.sa:
सतीं सो दसा संभु कै देखी ।
उर उपजा संदेहु बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
satīṃ so dasā saṃbhu kai dekhī
ur upajā saṃdehu biseṣī

verses.sa:
संकरु जगतबंद्य जगदीसा ।
सुर नर मुनि सब नावत सीसा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkaru jagatabaṃdya jagadīsā
sur nar muni sab nāvat sīsā

verses.sa:
तिन्ह नृपसुतहि नह परनामा ।
कहि सच्चिदानंद परधमा ॥
verses.tr:
tinh nṛpasutahi nah paranāmā
kahi saccidānaṃd paradhamā

verses.sa:
भए मगन छबि तासु बिलोकी ।
अजहुँ प्रीति उर रहति न रोकी ॥
verses.tr:
bhae magan chabi tāsu bilokī
ajahum̐ prīti ur rahati na rokī

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जो व्यापक बिरज अज अकल अनीह अभेद ।
सो कि देह धरि होइ नर जाहि न जानत वेद ॥
verses.tr:
brahm jo vyāpak biraj aj akal anīh abhed
so ki deh dhari hoi nar jāhi na jānat ved
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama’s ways are most mysterious; only the supremely wise can comprehend them; the dull of soul and the sensual imagine something quite different.

Then it was that Sambhu saw Rama, and great joy arose in his soul. His eyes were filled with the vision of the most beautiful, but it was no fitting time to make himself known, and he passed on exclaiming: ‘Hail, Supreme Being, redeemer of the world.’ But as he went on his way with Sati, his whole body thrilled with delight; and in Sati’s soul, when she observed her Lord's emotion, a great doubt arose,—‘ To Sankara, the universally adored and sovereign lord, gods, men and saints all bow the head; yet he has made obeisance to this prince, saluting him as the Supreme God, and is so enraptured with his beauty that it is only to-day he has felt what love is.
What! the omnipresent and unbegotten God, the creator, who has neither parts nor passions, and is no respecter of persons, whom not even the Veda can comprehend!, has he taken the form of a man?

sections.label: Doha 51
sections.name: लाग न उर उपदेसु जदपि कहेउ सिवँ बार बहु

verses.sa:
बिष्नु जो सुर हित नरतनु धारी ।
सोउ सर्बग्य जथा त्रिपुरारी ॥
verses.tr:
biṣnu jo sur hit naratanu dhārī
sou sarbagya jathā tripurārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
खोजइ सो कि अग्य इव नारी ।
ग्यानधाम श्रीपति असुरारी ॥
verses.tr:
khojai so ki agya iv nārī
gyānadhām śrīpati asurārī

verses.sa:
संभुगिरा पुनि मृषा न होई ।
सिव सर्बग्य जान सबु कोई ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhugirā puni mṛṣā na hoī
siv sarbagya jān sabu koī

verses.sa:
अस संसय मन भयउ अपारा ।
होई न हृदयँ प्रबोध प्रचारा ॥
verses.tr:
as saṃsaya man bhayau apārā
hoī na hṛdayam̐ prabodh pracārā

verses.sa:
जद्यपि प्रगट न कहेउ भवानी ।
हर अंतरजामी सब जानी ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi pragaṭ na kaheu bhavānī
har aṃtarajāmī sab jānī

verses.sa:
सुनहि सती तव नारि सुभाऊ ।
संसय अस न धरिअ उर काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sunahi satī tav nāri subhāū
saṃsaya as na dharia ur kāū

verses.sa:
जासु कथा कुभंज रिषि गाई ।
भगति जासु मैं मुनिहि सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu kathā kubhaṃj riṣi gāī
bhagati jāsu maiṃ munihi sunāī

verses.sa:
सोउ मम इष्टदेव रघुबीरा ।
सेवत जाहि सदा मुनि धीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sou mam iṣṭadev raghubīrā
sevat jāhi sadā muni dhīrā

verses.sa:
मुनि धीर जोगी सिद्ध संतत बिमल मन जेहि ध्यावहीं ।
कहि नेति निगम पुरान आगम जासु कीरति गावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
muni dhīr jogī siddh saṃtat bimal man jehi dhyāvahīṃ
kahi neti nigam purān āgam jāsu kīrati gāvahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सोइ रामु ब्यापक ब्रह्म भुवन निकाय पति माया धनी ।
अवतरेउ अपने भगत हित निजतंत्र नित रघुकुलमनि ॥
verses.tr:
soi rāmu byāpak brahm bhuvan nikāya pati māyā dhanī
avatareu apane bhagat hit nijataṃtr nit raghukulamani

verses.sa:
लाग न उर उपदेसु जदपि कहेउ सिवँ बार बहु ।
बोले बिहसि महेसु हरिमाया बलु जानि जियँ ॥
verses.tr:
lāg na ur upadesu jadapi kaheu sivam̐ bār bahu
bole bihasi mahesu harimāyā balu jāni jiyam̐
verses.head: दोहा

trans: According to what Siva says, though Vishnu in heaven's behalf assumes a human shape, he remains all-wise: yet here, as if quite at a loss, he is hunting for his wife, this fountain of wisdom, this lord of Lakshmi, this vanquisher of demons. Still Sambhu's words cannot be false, nor can his knowledge be gainsaid. Thus an infinite doubt has come into my mind, and there is no way of solving it.’ Although Bhavani did not speak out, Mahadeva can read the heart and knew her thoughts, and said,—“ Listen to me, Sati; you are just like a woman, but you should not entertain these doubts; this is that Rama, my special patron, whose story was sung by the Rishi Agastya; in whom I exhorted the saint to have faith, and who is ever worshipped by seers and sages.
To redeem his people, freely has vouchsafed with men to dwell.”
Though he spoke thus time after time, his words made no impression upon her; and at last Mahadeva, recognizing Rama’s deceptive power, smiled and said:

sections.label: Doha 52
sections.name: पुनि पुनि हृदयँ विचारु करि धरि सीता कर रुप

verses.sa:
जौं तुम्हरें मन अति संदेहू ।
तौ किन जाइ परीछा लेहू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ tumhareṃ man ati saṃdehū
tau kin jāi parīchā lehū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब लगि बैठ अहउँ बटछाहिं ।
जब लगि तुम्ह ऐहहु मोहि पाही ॥
verses.tr:
tab lagi baiṭh ahaum̐ baṭachāhiṃ
jab lagi tumh aihahu mohi pāhī

verses.sa:
जैसें जाइ मोह भ्रम भारी ।
करेहु सो जतनु बिबेक बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
jaiseṃ jāi moh bhram bhārī
karehu so jatanu bibek bicārī

verses.sa:
चलीं सती सिव आयसु पाई ।
करहिं बिचारु करौं का भाई ॥
verses.tr:
calīṃ satī siv āyasu pāī
karahiṃ bicāru karauṃ kā bhāī

verses.sa:
इहाँ संभु अस मन अनुमाना ।
दच्छसुता कहुँ नहिं कल्याना ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ saṃbhu as man anumānā
dacchasutā kahum̐ nahiṃ kalyānā

verses.sa:
मोरेहु कहें न संसय जाहीं ।
बिधी बिपरीत भलाई नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
morehu kaheṃ na saṃsaya jāhīṃ
bidhī biparīt bhalāī nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
होइहि सोइ जो राम रचि राखा ।
को करि तर्क बढ़ावै साखा ॥
verses.tr:
hoihi soi jo rām raci rākhā
ko kari tark bar̤hāvai sākhā

verses.sa:
अस कहि लगे जपन हरिनामा ।
गई सती जहँ प्रभु सुखधामा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi lage japan harināmā
gaī satī jaham̐ prabhu sukhadhāmā

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि हृदयँ विचारु करि धरि सीता कर रुप ।
आगें होइ चलि पंथ तेहि जेहिं आवत नरभूप ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni hṛdayam̐ vicāru kari dhari sītā kar rup
āgeṃ hoi cali paṃth tehi jehiṃ āvat narabhūp
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “As the doubt in your mind is so great that it will not leave you till you have put the fact to the test, I will stay here in the shade of this fig-tree till you come back to me, after having evolved some device by which to satisfy your overpowering doubt.” So Sati went by Siva's order, saying to herself —‘ Come now, what shall [ do?’ while Sambhu reflected, —“ There is mischief in store for Sati; her doubts will not yield to my arguments; truly no good can ever be brought about against the will of fate; whatever Rama has ordained will come to pass, so why spin out any longer discussion?” So saying, he began the repetition of Hari’s name, while Sati drew nigh to the Lord of grace.
After many an anxious thought she assumed the form of

sections.label: Doha 53
sections.name: राम बचन मृदु गूढ़ सुनि उपजा अति संकोचु

verses.sa: लछिमन दीख उमाकृत बेषा चकित भए भ्रम हृदयँ बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr: lachiman dīkh umākṛt beṣā cakit bhae bhram hṛdayam̐ biseṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहि न सकत कछु अति गंभीरा ।
प्रभु प्रभाउ जानत मतिधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na sakat kachu ati gaṃbhīrā
prabhu prabhāu jānat matidhīrā

verses.sa:
सती कपटु जानेउ सुरस्वामी ।
सबदरसी सब अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
satī kapaṭu jāneu surasvāmī
sabadarasī sab aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
सुमिरत जाहि मिटइ अग्याना ।
सोइ सरबग्य रामु भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
sumirat jāhi miṭai agyānā
soi sarabagya rāmu bhagavānā

verses.sa:
सती कीन्ह चह तहँहुँ दुराऊ ।
देखहु नारि सुभाव प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
satī kīnh cah taham̐hum̐ durāū
dekhahu nāri subhāv prabhāū

verses.sa:
निज माया बलु हृदयँ बखानी ।
बोले बिहसि रामु मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
nij māyā balu hṛdayam̐ bakhānī
bole bihasi rāmu mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
जोरि पानि प्रभु कीन्ह प्रनामू ।
पिता समेत लीन्ह निज नामू ॥
verses.tr:
jori pāni prabhu kīnh pranāmū
pitā samet līnh nij nāmū

verses.sa:
कहेउ बहोरि कहाँ बृषकेतू ।
बिपिन अकेलि फिरहु केहि हेतू ॥
verses.tr:
kaheu bahori kahām̐ bṛṣaketū
bipin akeli phirahu kehi hetū

verses.sa:
राम बचन मृदु गूढ़ सुनि उपजा अति संकोचु ।
सती सभीत महेस पहिं चलीं हृदयँ बड़ सोचु ॥
verses.tr:
rām bacan mṛdu gūr̤h suni upajā ati saṃkocu
satī sabhīt mahes pahiṃ calīṃ hṛdayam̐ bar̤ socu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Sita and went and stood in the way where the king of heaven was coming.

When Lakshman saw her in her disguise, he was much astonished and perplext. Wise as he was, he could say nothing, but discreetly waited for the revelation of the lord. He, the heavenly king, detected the deceit; for he sees all things alike and Knows the heart, the all-wise lord Rama, the mere thought of whom disperses error. Yet even him Sati attempted to deceive—see how inveterate woman's nature is. But Rama, acknowledging the effect of his own delusive power, with a sweet smile and folded hands saluted her, mentioning both her own name and that of her father, and added, —‘ Where is Mahadeva, and why are you wandering alone in the forest?’
When she heard these simple but profound words, a great awe came upon her and she returned to Mahadeva, full of fear and distress.

sections.label: Doha 54
sections.name: सती बिधात्री इंदिरा देखीं अमित अनूप

verses.sa:
मैं संकर कर कहा न माना ।
निज अग्यानु राम पर आना ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ saṃkar kar kahā na mānā
nij agyānu rām par ānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जाइ उतरु अब देहउँ काहा ।
उर उपजा अति दारुन दाहा ॥
verses.tr:
jāi utaru ab dehaum̐ kāhā
ur upajā ati dārun dāhā

verses.sa:
जाना राम सतीं दुखु पावा ।
निज प्रभाउ कछु प्रगटि जनावा ॥
verses.tr:
jānā rām satīṃ dukhu pāvā
nij prabhāu kachu pragaṭi janāvā

verses.sa:
सतीं दीख कौतुकु मग जाता ।
आगें रामु सहित श्री भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
satīṃ dīkh kautuku mag jātā
āgeṃ rāmu sahit śrī bhrātā

verses.sa:
फिरि चितवा पाछें प्रभु देखा ।
सहित बंधु सिय सुंदर वेषा ॥
verses.tr:
phiri citavā pācheṃ prabhu dekhā
sahit baṃdhu siya suṃdar veṣā

verses.sa:
जहँ चितवहिं तहँ प्रभु आसीना ।
सेवहिं सिद्ध मुनीस प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ citavahiṃ taham̐ prabhu āsīnā
sevahiṃ siddh munīs prabīnā

verses.sa:
देखे सिव बिधि बिष्नु अनेका ।
अमित प्रभाउ एक तें एका ॥
verses.tr:
dekhe siv bidhi biṣnu anekā
amit prabhāu ek teṃ ekā

verses.sa:
बंदत चरन करत प्रभु सेवा ।
बिबिध बेष देखे सब देवा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdat caran karat prabhu sevā
bibidh beṣ dekhe sab devā

verses.sa:
सती बिधात्री इंदिरा देखीं अमित अनूप ।
जेहिं जेहिं बेष अजादि सुर तेहि तेहि तन अनुरूप ॥
verses.tr:
satī bidhātrī iṃdirā dekhīṃ amit anūp
jehiṃ jehiṃ beṣ ajādi sur tehi tehi tan anurūp
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘I would not listen to Sankara, but must go and expose my folly to Rama; now what answer can I give?’ Her distress was most grievous. Then lima, perceiving her vexation, manifested ia part his glory, and as Sati went on her way she beheld a marvellous vision; in front of her were RAma, Situ and Lakshman; when again she looked back, there too she saw the Lord with his brother and Sita in beauteous apparel; whichever way she turned her eyes, there was the lord enthroned with saints and learned doctors ministering to him. Innumerable Sivas and Brahmans and Vishnu, each excelling in majesty, bowing at his feet and doing homage; all the host of heaven with their different attributes.
Sati too and Sarasvati and Lakshmi ir marvellous multi-licity of form, according to the various appearances assumed i their lords, Brahma, Vishnuand Mahadeva. Chaupai 55.

sections.label: Doha 55
sections.name: गई समीप महेस तब हँसि पूछी कुसलात

verses.sa:
देखे जहँ तहँ रघुपति जेते ।
सक्तिन्ह सहित सकल सुर तेते ॥
verses.tr:
dekhe jaham̐ taham̐ raghupati jete
saktinh sahit sakal sur tete
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जीव चराचर जो संसारा ।
देखे सकल अनेक प्रकारा ॥
verses.tr:
jīv carācar jo saṃsārā
dekhe sakal anek prakārā

verses.sa:
पूजहिं प्रभुहि देव बहु बेषा ।
राम रूप दूसर नहिं देखा ॥
verses.tr:
pūjahiṃ prabhuhi dev bahu beṣā
rām rūp dūsar nahiṃ dekhā

verses.sa:
अवलोके रघुपति बहुतेरे ।
सीता सहित न बेष घनेरे ॥
verses.tr:
avaloke raghupati bahutere
sītā sahit na beṣ ghanere

verses.sa:
सोइ रघुबर सोइ लछिमनु सीता ।
देखि सती अति भई सभीता ॥
verses.tr:
soi raghubar soi lachimanu sītā
dekhi satī ati bhaī sabhītā

verses.sa:
हृदय कंप तन सुधि कछु नाहीं ।
नयन मूदि बैठीं मग माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdaya kaṃp tan sudhi kachu nāhīṃ
nayan mūdi baiṭhīṃ mag māhīṃ

verses.sa:
बहुरि बिलोकेउ नयन उघारी ।
कछु न दीख तहँ दच्छकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri bilokeu nayan ughārī
kachu na dīkh taham̐ dacchakumārī

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि नाइ राम पद सीसा ।
चलीं तहाँ जहँ रहे गिरीसा ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni nāi rām pad sīsā
calīṃ tahām̐ jaham̐ rahe girīsā

verses.sa:
गई समीप महेस तब हँसि पूछी कुसलात ।
लीन्ही परीछा कवन बिधि कहहु सत्य सब बात ॥
verses.tr:
gaī samīp mahes tab ham̐si pūchī kusalāt
līnhī parīchā kavan bidhi kahahu satya sab bāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Each separate vision of Rama was attended by all the gods and their wives, and by the whole animate creation with all its multitudinous species. But while the adoring gods appeared in diverse dresses, there was no diversity of form in Rama. Though she saw many Rama, and with him an oft-repeated Sita, it was always the same Rama, the same Lakshman, and the same Sita. Sati was awe-striken as she gazed; with fluttering heart and unconscious frame she closed her eyes and sank upon the ground. ° When again she looked up, she saw nothing, and oft bowing her head at Rama’s feet, she returned to the spot where Mahadeva was waiting for her. |
When she drew near, he smiled and ask if all were well, saying, —‘ Tell me now the whole truth, how did you put him to the test?’

sections.label: Doha 56
sections.name: परम पुनीत न जाइ तजि किएँ प्रेम बड़ पापु

verses.sa:
सतीं समुझि रघुबीर प्रभाऊ ।
भय बस सिव सन कीन्ह दुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
satīṃ samujhi raghubīr prabhāū
bhaya bas siv san kīnh durāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कछु न परीछा लीन्हि गोसाई ।
कीन्ह प्रनामु तुम्हारिहि नाई ॥
verses.tr:
kachu na parīchā līnhi gosāī
kīnh pranāmu tumhārihi nāī

verses.sa:
जो तुम्ह कहा सो मृषा न होई ।
मोरें मन प्रतीति अति सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jo tumh kahā so mṛṣā na hoī
moreṃ man pratīti ati soī

verses.sa:
तब संकर देखेउ धरि ध्याना ।
सतीं जो कीन्ह चरित सब जाना ॥
verses.tr:
tab saṃkar dekheu dhari dhyānā
satīṃ jo kīnh carit sab jānā

verses.sa:
बहुरि राममायहि सिरु नावा ।
प्रेरि सतिहि जेहिं झूँठ कहावा ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri rāmamāyahi siru nāvā
preri satihi jehiṃ jhūm̐ṭh kahāvā

verses.sa:
हरि इच्छा भावी बलवाना ।
हृदयँ बिचारत संभु सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
hari icchā bhāvī balavānā
hṛdayam̐ bicārat saṃbhu sujānā

verses.sa:
सतीं कीन्ह सीता कर बेषा ।
सिव उर भयउ बिषाद बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
satīṃ kīnh sītā kar beṣā
siv ur bhayau biṣād biseṣā

verses.sa:
जौं अब करउँ सती सन प्रीती ।
मिटइ भगति पथु होइ अनीती ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ ab karaum̐ satī san prītī
miṭai bhagati pathu hoi anītī

verses.sa:
परम पुनीत न जाइ तजि किएँ प्रेम बड़ पापु ।
प्रगटि न कहत महेसु कछु हृदयँ अधिक संतापु ॥
verses.tr:
param punīt na jāi taji kiem̐ prem bar̤ pāpu
pragaṭi na kahat mahesu kachu hṛdayam̐ adhik saṃtāpu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Sati remembered the glory of the lord and in her awe concealed the truth from Siva, saying:‘ O sir, I tried no test, but like you simply made obeisance.
