जाइ बिधिहि दीन्हि सो पाती ।
बाचत प्रीति न हृदयँ समाती ॥
verses.tr:
jāi bidhihi dīnhi so pātī
bācat prīti na hṛdayam̐ samātī

verses.sa:
लगन बाचि अज सबहि सुनाई ।
हरषे मुनि सब सुर समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
lagan bāci aj sabahi sunāī
haraṣe muni sab sur samudāī

verses.sa:
सुमन बृष्टि नभ बाजन बाजे ।
मंगल कलस दसहुँ दिसि साजे ॥
verses.tr:
suman bṛṣṭi nabh bājan bāje
maṃgal kalas dasahum̐ disi sāje

verses.sa:
लगे सँवारन सकल सुर बाहन बिबिध बिमान ।
होहि सगुन मंगल सुभद करहिं अपछरा गान ॥
verses.tr:
lage sam̐vāran sakal sur bāhan bibidh bimān
hohi sagun maṃgal subhad karahiṃ apacharā gān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: And told him the whole history. When he heard of Love’s annihilation he was much distressed, but was again comforted when told of Rati's promised husband. After pondering on the majesty of Sambhu, he reverently summoned the wise men, and at once had the day fixed according to Vedic prescription, selecting an auspicious date, and planet and hour. Then he gave the letter to the seven sages, humbly falling at their feet, and they took it to Brahma, who could not contain himself for joy on reading it, but at once proclaimed it aloud. The whole company of heaven was delighted: there was music and a shower of flowers, and in every quarter festive preparations were commenced.
All the gods began adorning the different vehicles on which they. ride abroad, the Muses sung for joy, and all was bliss and happiness.

sections.label: Doha 92
sections.name: बिष्नु कहा अस बिहसि तब बोलि सकल दिसिराज

verses.sa:
सिवहि संभु गन करहिं सिंगारा ।
जटा मुकुट अहि मौरु सँवारा ॥
verses.tr:
sivahi saṃbhu gan karahiṃ siṃgārā
jaṭā mukuṭ ahi mauru sam̐vārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कुंडल कंकन पहिरे ब्याला ।
तन बिभूति पट केहरि छाला ॥
verses.tr:
kuṃḍal kaṃkan pahire byālā
tan bibhūti paṭ kehari chālā

verses.sa:
ससि ललाट सुंदर सिर गंगा ।
नयन तीनि उपबीत भुजंगा ॥
verses.tr:
sasi lalāṭ suṃdar sir gaṃgā
nayan tīni upabīt bhujaṃgā

verses.sa:
गरल कंठ उर नर सिर माला ।
असिव बेष सिवधाम कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
garal kaṃṭh ur nar sir mālā
asiv beṣ sivadhām kṛpālā

verses.sa:
कर त्रिसूल अरु डमरु बिराजा ।
चले बसहँ चढ़ि बाजहिं बाजा ॥
verses.tr:
kar trisūl aru ḍamaru birājā
cale basaham̐ car̤hi bājahiṃ bājā

verses.sa:
देखि सिवहि सुरत्रिय मुसुकाहीं ।
बर लायक दुलहिनि जग नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi sivahi suratriya musukāhīṃ
bar lāyak dulahini jag nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बिष्नु बिरंचि आदि सुरब्राता ।
चढ़ि चढ़ि बाहन चले बराता ॥
verses.tr:
biṣnu biraṃci ādi surabrātā
car̤hi car̤hi bāhan cale barātā

verses.sa:
सुर समाज सब भाँति अनूपा ।
नहिं बरात दूलह अनुरूपा ॥
verses.tr:
sur samāj sab bhām̐ti anūpā
nahiṃ barāt dūlah anurūpā

verses.sa:
बिष्नु कहा अस बिहसि तब बोलि सकल दिसिराज ।
बिलग बिलग होइ चलहु सब निज निज सहित समाज ॥
verses.tr:
biṣnu kahā as bihasi tab boli sakal disirāj
bilag bilag hoi calahu sab nij nij sahit samāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Siva’s attendants began to dress their lord, arranging his serpent-creet and crown of matted locks; with snakes for his earrings and bracelets of snakes for his wrists; his body smeared with ashes, and a lion’s skin about his loins;

- the moon on his brow, the lovely Ganges on the crown of his head, his eyes three in number, and a serpent for his Brahmanical cord; his throat black with poison; a wreath of dead men’s skulls about his breast. In such ghastly attire was arrayed the great god Siva. With trident in hand he advanced riding on a bull, while the drums beat and instruments of music were played. The female divinities all smiled to see him, and said,.“ The world has no bride worthy of such a lover.’ Vishnu and Brahma and all the company of heaven followed in the procession, each on his own carriage. ‘The gods make a fine sight,’ but still the procession is not worthy of the bridegroom.
So cried Vishnu with a smile and then commanded all the heavenly warders—‘: March separately, each one with his own retinue.

sections.label: Doha 93
sections.name: नाचहिं गावहिं गीत परम तरंगी भूत सब

verses.sa:
बर अनुहारि बरात न भाई ।
हँसी करैहहु पर पुर जाई ॥
verses.tr:
bar anuhāri barāt na bhāī
ham̐sī karaihahu par pur jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिष्नु बचन सुनि सुर मुसकाने ।
निज निज सेन सहित बिलगाने ॥
verses.tr:
biṣnu bacan suni sur musakāne
nij nij sen sahit bilagāne

verses.sa:
मनहीं मन महेसु मुसुकाहीं ।
हरि के बिंग्य बचन नहिं जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
manahīṃ man mahesu musukāhīṃ
hari ke biṃgya bacan nahiṃ jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
अति प्रिय बचन सुनत प्रिय केरे ।
भृंगिहि प्रेरि सकल गन टेरे ॥
verses.tr:
ati priya bacan sunat priya kere
bhṛṃgihi preri sakal gan ṭere

verses.sa:
सिव अनुसासन सुनि सब आए ।
प्रभु पद जलज सीस तिन्ह नाए ॥
verses.tr:
siv anusāsan suni sab āe
prabhu pad jalaj sīs tinh nāe

verses.sa:
नाना बाहन नाना बेषा ।
बिहसे सिव समाज निज देखा ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bāhan nānā beṣā
bihase siv samāj nij dekhā

verses.sa:
कोउ मुखहीन बिपुल मुख काहू ।
बिनु पद कर कोउ बहु पद बाहू ॥
verses.tr:
kou mukhahīn bipul mukh kāhū
binu pad kar kou bahu pad bāhū

verses.sa:
बिपुल नयन कोउ नयन बिहीना ।
रिष्टपुष्ट कोउ अति तनखीना ॥
verses.tr:
bipul nayan kou nayan bihīnā
riṣṭapuṣṭ kou ati tanakhīnā

verses.sa:
तन खीन कोउ अति पीन पावन कोउ अपावन गति धरें ।
भूषन कराल कपाल कर सब सद्य सोनित तन भरें ॥
verses.tr:
tan khīn kou ati pīn pāvan kou apāvan gati dhareṃ
bhūṣan karāl kapāl kar sab sadya sonit tan bhareṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
खर स्वान सुअर सृकाल मुख गन बेष अगनित को गनै ।
बहु जिनस प्रेत पिसाच जोगि जमात बरनत नहिं बनै ॥
verses.tr:
khar svān suar sṛkāl mukh gan beṣ aganit ko ganai
bahu jinas pret pisāc jogi jamāt baranat nahiṃ banai

verses.sa:
नाचहिं गावहिं गीत परम तरंगी भूत सब ।
देखत अति बिपरीत बोलहिं बचन बिचित्र बिधि ॥
verses.tr:
nācahiṃ gāvahiṃ gīt param taraṃgī bhūt sab
dekhat ati biparīt bolahiṃ bacan bicitr bidhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Otherwise on going into a strange city they will laugh and say what a sorry procession for such a bridegroom.” The gods smiled to hear this speech, and marched separately, each at the head of his own followers. Mahadeva smiled too, not understanding Hari’s joke, but taking it as a most friendly suggestion, and sent Bhringi to bring all his attendants. On receiving Siva’s order they all came and bowed the head at his lotus feet. Then Siva laughed to see the host in their motley attire, riding every kind of vehicle; some with monstrous heads, some with no head atall; some with many hands and feet, and some with none; some with great eyes, some with no eyes; some very stout, some very slim.
All, stout or slim, or foul or trim, in gruesome panoply,
With head of dog, or ass, or hog, a host no tongue can tell, Ghosts, goblins, witches, every kind denizen of hell.
All the demons went singing and dancing with wonderful contortions, such as never were seen, and uttering all sorts of strange cries.

sections.label: Doha 94
sections.name: जगदंबा जहँ अवतरी सो पुरु बरनि कि जाइ

verses.sa:
जस दूलहु तसि बनी बराता ।
कौतुक बिबिध होहिं मग जाता ॥
verses.tr:
jas dūlahu tasi banī barātā
kautuk bibidh hohiṃ mag jātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
इहाँ हिमाचल रचेउ बिताना ।
अति बिचित्र नहिं जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ himācal raceu bitānā
ati bicitr nahiṃ jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
सैल सकल जहँ लगि जग माहीं ।
लघु बिसाल नहिं बरनि सिराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sail sakal jaham̐ lagi jag māhīṃ
laghu bisāl nahiṃ barani sirāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बन सागर सब नदीं तलावा ।
हिमगिरि सब कहुँ नेवत पठावा ॥
verses.tr:
ban sāgar sab nadīṃ talāvā
himagiri sab kahum̐ nevat paṭhāvā

verses.sa:
कामरूप सुंदर तन धारी ।
सहित समाज सहित बर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
kāmarūp suṃdar tan dhārī
sahit samāj sahit bar nārī

verses.sa:
गए सकल तुहिनाचल गेहा ।
गावहिं मंगल सहित सनेहा ॥
verses.tr:
gae sakal tuhinācal gehā
gāvahiṃ maṃgal sahit sanehā

verses.sa:
प्रथमहिं गिरि बहु गृह सँवराए ।
जथाजोगु तहँ तहँ सब छाए ॥
verses.tr:
prathamahiṃ giri bahu gṛh sam̐varāe
jathājogu taham̐ taham̐ sab chāe

verses.sa:
पुर सोभा अवलोकि सुहाई ।
लागइ लघु बिरंचि निपुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
pur sobhā avaloki suhāī
lāgai laghu biraṃci nipunāī

verses.sa:
लघु लाग बिधि की निपुनता अवलोकि पुर सोभा सही ।
बन बाग कूप तड़ाग सरिता सुभग सब सक को कही ॥
verses.tr:
laghu lāg bidhi kī nipunatā avaloki pur sobhā sahī
ban bāg kūp tar̤āg saritā subhag sab sak ko kahī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: मंगल बिपुल तोरन पताका केतु गृह गृह सोहहीं ॥
verses.tr: maṃgal bipul toran patākā ketu gṛh gṛh sohahīṃ

verses.sa: बनिता पुरुष सुंदर चतुर छबि देखि मुनि मन मोहहीं ॥
verses.tr: banitā puruṣ suṃdar catur chabi dekhi muni man mohahīṃ

verses.sa:
जगदंबा जहँ अवतरी सो पुरु बरनि कि जाइ ।
रिद्धि सिद्धि संपत्ति सुख नित नूतन अधिकाइ ॥
verses.tr:
jagadaṃbā jaham̐ avatarī so puru barani ki jāi
riddhi siddhi saṃpatti sukh nit nūtan adhikāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: _ Like bridegroom, like procession—an extraordinary sight as it went along the road. There King Himechal erected a canopy more splendid than words can tell; and every hill in the world, small and great, more than man can count, and every wood and sea, river, stream and lake, all were invited to attend; and assuming forms of exquisite beauty, with all their retinue, male and female they flocked to the palace singing songs of gladness. First of all the king had built a number of guest-houses, and so tastefally arranged them, that, after a glance at the beauty of the city, the Creator of the world seemed a contemptible architect. Chhand 8.
Little seemed the world’s Creator, and his skill of nothing worth:
The city in which the great mother had taken birth surpassed description; joy, prosperity and abundance were ever on the increase.

sections.label: Doha 95
sections.name: समुझि महेस समाज सब जननि जनक मुसुकाहिं

verses.sa:
नगर निकट बरात सुनि आई ।
पुर खरभरु सोभा अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
nagar nikaṭ barāt suni āī
pur kharabharu sobhā adhikāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करि बनाव सजि बाहन नाना ।
चले लेन सादर अगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
kari banāv saji bāhan nānā
cale len sādar agavānā

verses.sa:
हियँ हरषे सुर सेन निहारी ।
हरिहि देखि अति भए सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
hiyam̐ haraṣe sur sen nihārī
harihi dekhi ati bhae sukhārī

verses.sa:
सिव समाज जब देखन लागे ।
बिडरि चले बाहन सब भागे ॥
verses.tr:
siv samāj jab dekhan lāge
biḍari cale bāhan sab bhāge

verses.sa:
धरि धीरजु तहँ रहे सयाने ।
बालक सब लै जीव पराने ॥
verses.tr:
dhari dhīraju taham̐ rahe sayāne
bālak sab lai jīv parāne

verses.sa:
गएँ भवन पूछहिं पितु माता ।
कहहिं बचन भय कंपित गाता ॥
verses.tr:
gaem̐ bhavan pūchahiṃ pitu mātā
kahahiṃ bacan bhaya kaṃpit gātā

verses.sa:
कहिअ काह कहि जाइ न बाता ।
जम कर धार किधौं बरिआता ॥
verses.tr:
kahia kāh kahi jāi na bātā
jam kar dhār kidhauṃ bariātā

verses.sa:
बरु बौराह बसहँ असवारा ।
ब्याल कपाल बिभूषन छारा ॥
verses.tr:
baru baurāh basaham̐ asavārā
byāl kapāl bibhūṣan chārā

verses.sa:
तन छार ब्याल कपाल भूषन नगन जटिल भयंकरा ।
सँग भूत प्रेत पिसाच जोगिनि बिकट मुख रजनीचरा ॥
verses.tr:
tan chār byāl kapāl bhūṣan nagan jaṭil bhayaṃkarā
sam̐g bhūt pret pisāc jogini bikaṭ mukh rajanīcarā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जो जिअत रहिहि बरात देखत पुन्य बड़ तेहि कर सही ।
देखिहि सो उमा बिबाहु घर घर बात असि लरिकन्ह कही ॥
verses.tr:
jo jiat rahihi barāt dekhat punya bar̤ tehi kar sahī
dekhihi so umā bibāhu ghar ghar bāt asi larikanh kahī

verses.sa:
समुझि महेस समाज सब जननि जनक मुसुकाहिं ।
बाल बुझाए बिबिध बिधि निडर होहु डरु नाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi mahes samāj sab janani janak musukāhiṃ
bāl bujhāe bibidh bidhi niḍar hohu ḍaru nāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When it was known that the marriage procession was close at hand, the stir in the city and the brilliancy of the decorations grew more and more. With numerous carriages and all due equipment the heralds started for the

formal reception. When they saw the army of gods they were glad of heart, and yet more so when they beheld Hari, But when they perceived Siva’s familiars, every beast they rode started back in affright. Grown men summoned up courage to stand, but the children all ran for their lives straight back home, and when their parents questioned them could only reply trembling all over,—“ What can we say? it is beyond telling; it is no marriage procession, but the army of Death; the bridegroom, a maniac, mounted on a bull; with snakes and skulls and ashes to adorn him.
The fathers and mothers smiled, for they recognized Siva’s familiars, and reassured the children in every possible way, saying, --“Do not be afraid; there is no cause for fear.”

sections.label: Doha 96
sections.name: भई बिकल अबला सकल दुखित देखि गिरिनारि

verses.sa:
लै अगवान बरातहि आए ।
दिए सबहि जनवास सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
lai agavān barātahi āe
die sabahi janavās suhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मैनाँ सुभ आरती सँवारी ।
संग सुमंगल गावहिं नारी ॥
verses.tr:
mainām̐ subh āratī sam̐vārī
saṃg sumaṃgal gāvahiṃ nārī

verses.sa:
कंचन थार सोह बर पानी ।
परिछन चली हरहि हरषानी ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃcan thār soh bar pānī
parichan calī harahi haraṣānī

verses.sa:
बिकट बेष रुद्रहि जब देखा ।
अबलन्ह उर भय भयउ बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
bikaṭ beṣ rudrahi jab dekhā
abalanh ur bhaya bhayau biseṣā

verses.sa:
भागि भवन पैठीं अति त्रासा ।
गए महेसु जहाँ जनवासा ॥
verses.tr:
bhāgi bhavan paiṭhīṃ ati trāsā
gae mahesu jahām̐ janavāsā

verses.sa:
मैना हृदयँ भयउ दुखु भारी ।
लीन्ही बोलि गिरीसकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
mainā hṛdayam̐ bhayau dukhu bhārī
līnhī boli girīsakumārī

verses.sa:
अधिक सनेहँ गोद बैठारी ।
स्याम सरोज नयन भरे बारी ॥
verses.tr:
adhik saneham̐ god baiṭhārī
syām saroj nayan bhare bārī

verses.sa:
जेहिं बिधि तुम्हहि रूपु अस दीन्हा ।
तेहिं जड़ बरु बाउर कस कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ bidhi tumhahi rūpu as dīnhā
tehiṃ jar̤ baru bāur kas kīnhā

verses.sa:
कस कीन्ह बरु बौराह बिधि जेहिं तुम्हहि सुंदरता दई ।
जो फलु चहिअ सुरतरुहिं सो बरबस बबूरहिं लागई ॥
verses.tr:
kas kīnh baru baurāh bidhi jehiṃ tumhahi suṃdaratā daī
jo phalu cahia surataruhiṃ so barabas babūrahiṃ lāgaī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: तुम्ह सहित गिरि तें गिरौं पावक जरौं जलनिधि महुँ परौं ॥
verses.tr: tumh sahit giri teṃ girauṃ pāvak jarauṃ jalanidhi mahum̐ parauṃ

verses.sa: घरु जाउ अपजसु होउ जग जीवत बिबाहु न हौं करौं ॥
verses.tr: gharu jāu apajasu hou jag jīvat bibāhu na hauṃ karauṃ

verses.sa:
भई बिकल अबला सकल दुखित देखि गिरिनारि ।
करि बिलापु रोदति बदति सुता सनेहु सँभारि ॥
verses.tr:
bhaī bikal abalā sakal dukhit dekhi girināri
kari bilāpu rodati badati sutā sanehu sam̐bhāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The heralds brought in the procession and assigned them all pleasant quarters. And Maina, having prepared an elegant sacrificial lamp, and lustrous water in a golden bowl, proceeded gladly to move it round over Siva’s head while her attendants sang festive songs. When they saw his terrible attire, the women feared greatly and ran inside the house all of a tremble. Mahadeva advanced to the guest-room and Maina, sorely grieved at heart, called her daughter, and in the most loving manner took her in her lap, while her lotus eyes overflowed with tears,—‘ To think that the Creator should have made you so beautiful, and then give you such a raving fool for a bridegroom!

How can God send sucha raving groom for such a lovely bride? What a thorn bush is our wishing-tree, the fruit for which we cried! From mountain-top, in sea or fire, 1°11 cast me down with thee; Welcome disgrace, so they be gone; this wedding ne’er shall be”
All the ladies were distrest when they saw the queen so sad, who in her deep affection for her daughter began to weep and make great lamentation, —

sections.label: Doha 97
sections.name: तेहि अवसर नारद सहित अरु रिषि सप्त समेत

verses.sa:
नारद कर मैं काह बिगारा ।
भवनु मोर जिन्ह बसत उजारा ॥
verses.tr:
nārad kar maiṃ kāh bigārā
bhavanu mor jinh basat ujārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अस उपदेसु उमहि जिन्ह दीन्हा ।
बौरे बरहि लगि तपु कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
as upadesu umahi jinh dīnhā
baure barahi lagi tapu kīnhā

verses.sa:
साचेहुँ उन्ह के मोह न माया ।
उदासीन धनु धामु न जाया ॥
verses.tr:
sācehum̐ unh ke moh na māyā
udāsīn dhanu dhāmu na jāyā

verses.sa:
पर घर घालक लाज न भीरा ।
बाझँ कि जान प्रसव कैं पीरा ॥
verses.tr:
par ghar ghālak lāj na bhīrā
bājham̐ ki jān prasav kaiṃ pīrā

verses.sa:
जननिहि बिकल बिलोकि भवानी ।
बोली जुत बिबेक मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
jananihi bikal biloki bhavānī
bolī jut bibek mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि सोचहि मति माता ।
सो न टरइ जो रचइ बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri socahi mati mātā
so na ṭarai jo racai bidhātā

verses.sa:
करम लिखा जौ बाउर नाहू ।
तौ कत दोसु लगाइअ काहू ॥
verses.tr:
karam likhā jau bāur nāhū
tau kat dosu lagāia kāhū

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सन मिटहिं कि बिधि के अंका ।
मातु ब्यर्थ जनि लेहु कलंका ॥
verses.tr:
tumh san miṭahiṃ ki bidhi ke aṃkā
mātu byarth jani lehu kalaṃkā

verses.sa:
जनि लेहु मातु कलंकु करुना परिहरहु अवसर नहीं ।
दुखु सुखु जो लिखा लिलार हमरें जाब जहँ पाउब तहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jani lehu mātu kalaṃku karunā pariharahu avasar nahīṃ
dukhu sukhu jo likhā lilār hamareṃ jāb jaham̐ pāub tahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: सुनि उमा बचन बिनीत कोमल सकल अबला सोचहीं ॥
verses.tr: suni umā bacan binīt komal sakal abalā socahīṃ

verses.sa: बहु भाँति बिधिहि लगाइ दूषन नयन बारि बिमोचहीं ॥
verses.tr: bahu bhām̐ti bidhihi lagāi dūṣan nayan bāri bimocahīṃ

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर नारद सहित अरु रिषि सप्त समेत ।
समाचार सुनि तुहिनगिरि गवने तुरत निकेत ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar nārad sahit aru riṣi sapt samet
samācār suni tuhinagiri gavane turat niket
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘What harm had I done to Narada that he should make my home desolate and give Uma such advice, to undergo penance for the sake of a mad bridegroom? In good sooth he is fancy free and passionless, an ascetic who wants neither money, nor house, nor wife, and therefore in destroying another's home he has neither shame nor compunction; for what does a barren woman know of the pangs of childbirth?”” When Bhavani saw her mother’s distress, she answered thus placidly and discreetly,-—-“ Be not troubled, my mother, with these thoughts, for God’s plans are unalterable, If fate decrees me a mad husband, then why should any one be blamed? Can you blot out the hand-writiog of the Creator Then refrain from_profitless reproaches. '
Cease from profitless reproaches, nor in vain bemoan my fate,
I must go where’er my destined joys and sorrows for me wait.”
Hearing Uma's pious answer, all her ladies felt surprise,
Much they talked of God’s injustice, while the tears bedewed their eyes.
At that time came Narada, and with him the sages (for they had heard the news), and at once betook themselves to the king’s palace.

sections.label: Doha 98
sections.name: सुनि नारद के बचन तब सब कर मिटा बिषाद

verses.sa:
तब नारद सबहि समुझावा ।
पूरुब कथाप्रसंगु सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab nārad sabahi samujhāvā
pūrub kathāprasaṃgu sunāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मयना सत्य सुनहु मम बानी ।
जगदंबा तव सुता भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
mayanā satya sunahu mam bānī
jagadaṃbā tav sutā bhavānī

verses.sa:
अजा अनादि सक्ति अबिनासिनि ।
सदा संभु अरधंग निवासिनि ॥
verses.tr:
ajā anādi sakti abināsini
sadā saṃbhu aradhaṃg nivāsini

verses.sa:
जग संभव पालन लय कारिनि ।
निज इच्छा लीला बपु धारिनि ॥
verses.tr:
jag saṃbhav pālan laya kārini
nij icchā līlā bapu dhārini

verses.sa:
जनमीं प्रथम दच्छ गृह जाई ।
नामु सती सुंदर तनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
janamīṃ pratham dacch gṛh jāī
nāmu satī suṃdar tanu pāī

verses.sa:
तहँहुँ सती संकरहि बिबाहीं ।
कथा प्रसिद्ध सकल जग माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐hum̐ satī saṃkarahi bibāhīṃ
kathā prasiddh sakal jag māhīṃ

verses.sa:
एक बार आवत सिव संगा ।
देखेउ रघुकुल कमल पतंगा ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār āvat siv saṃgā
dekheu raghukul kamal pataṃgā

verses.sa:
भयउ मोहु सिव कहा न कीन्हा ।
भ्रम बस बेषु सीय कर लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau mohu siv kahā na kīnhā
bhram bas beṣu sīya kar līnhā

verses.sa:
सिय बेषु सती जो कीन्ह तेहि अपराध संकर परिहरीं ।
हर बिरहँ जाइ बहोरि पितु कें जग्य जोगानल जरीं ॥
verses.tr:
siya beṣu satī jo kīnh tehi aparādh saṃkar pariharīṃ
har biraham̐ jāi bahori pitu keṃ jagya jogānal jarīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
अब जनमि तुम्हरे भवन निज पति लागि दारुन तपु किया ।
अस जानि संसय तजहु गिरिजा सर्बदा संकर प्रिया ॥
verses.tr:
ab janami tumhare bhavan nij pati lāgi dārun tapu kiyā
as jāni saṃsaya tajahu girijā sarbadā saṃkar priyā

verses.sa:
सुनि नारद के बचन तब सब कर मिटा बिषाद ।
छन महुँ ब्यापेउ सकल पुर घर घर यह संबाद ॥
verses.tr:
suni nārad ke bacan tab sab kar miṭā biṣād
chan mahum̐ byāpeu sakal pur ghar ghar yah saṃbād
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then Nerada instruoted them all, and recited in full the past history, saying,——'‘ Hear, O Maina my words are true; your daughter is Bhavani, the mother of the world, the everlasting female energy; without birth or beginning; Sambhu's inseparable half; the creator, supporter, and destroyer of the universe; who at will assumes the semblance of human form. First she was born in Daksha’s house, Sati by name, of excellent beauty. Then as Sati she married Sankara, and her story is famous throughout the world, how once, with Siva, she met the sun of Raghu’s lotus line (t.e., Rama), and in her infatuation was not obedient to Siva, but was beguiled into assuming the form of Sita.
For the crime of this assumption she was widowed many a day,
Till in the fire before her sire her sins were burnt away.
Now born your daughter, for her lord in penitence she stayed; And Siva aye.shall be her lord; know this, nor be dismayed,”
On hearing Naerada’s explanation the sadness of all] was dispersed, and in a moment his words were spread from. house to house throughout the city.

sections.label: Doha 99
sections.name: बहुरि मुनिन्ह हिमवंत कहुँ लगन सुनाई आइ

verses.sa:
तब मयना हिमवंतु अनंदे ।
पुनि पुनि पारबती पद बंदे ॥
verses.tr:
tab mayanā himavaṃtu anaṃde
puni puni pārabatī pad baṃde
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नारि पुरुष सिसु जुबा सयाने ।
नगर लोग सब अति हरषाने ॥
verses.tr:
nāri puruṣ sisu jubā sayāne
nagar log sab ati haraṣāne

verses.sa:
लगे होन पुर मंगलगाना ।
सजे सबहि हाटक घट नाना ॥
verses.tr:
lage hon pur maṃgalagānā
saje sabahi hāṭak ghaṭ nānā

verses.sa:
भाँति अनेक भई जेवराना ।
सूपसास्त्र जस कछु ब्यवहारा ॥
verses.tr:
bhām̐ti anek bhaī jevarānā
sūpasāstr jas kachu byavahārā

verses.sa:
सो जेवनार कि जाइ बखानी ।
बसहिं भवन जेहिं मातु भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
so jevanār ki jāi bakhānī
basahiṃ bhavan jehiṃ mātu bhavānī

verses.sa:
सादर बोले सकल बराती ।
बिष्नु बिरंचि देव सब जाती ॥
verses.tr:
sādar bole sakal barātī
biṣnu biraṃci dev sab jātī

verses.sa:
बिबिधि पाँति बैठी जेवनारा ।
लागे परुसन निपुन सुआरा ॥
verses.tr:
bibidhi pām̐ti baiṭhī jevanārā
lāge parusan nipun suārā

verses.sa:
नारिबृंद सुर जेवँत जानी ।
लगीं देन गारीं मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
nāribṛṃd sur jevam̐t jānī
lagīṃ den gārīṃ mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
गारीं मधुर स्वर देहिं सुंदरि बिंग्य बचन सुनावहीं ।
भोजनु करहिं सुर अति बिलंबु बिनोदु सुनि सचु पावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gārīṃ madhur svar dehiṃ suṃdari biṃgya bacan sunāvahīṃ
bhojanu karahiṃ sur ati bilaṃbu binodu suni sacu pāvahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जेवँत जो बढ्यो अनंदु सो मुख कोटिहूँ न परै कह्यो ।
अचवाँइ दीन्हे पान गवने बास जहँ जाको रह्यो ॥
verses.tr:
jevam̐t jo baḍhyo anaṃdu so mukh koṭihūm̐ na parai kahyo
acavām̐i dīnhe pān gavane bās jaham̐ jāko rahyo

verses.sa:
बहुरि मुनिन्ह हिमवंत कहुँ लगन सुनाई आइ ।
समय बिलोकि बिबाह कर पठए देव बोलाइ ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri muninh himavaṃt kahum̐ lagan sunāī āi
samaya biloki bibāh kar paṭhae dev bolāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then Maina and Himavant were glad and fell again and again at Parvati’sfeet. All the people of the city, whatever their age, men and women alike, were equally delighted. Songs of joy began to sound in the streets; golden vases were displayed; meats were dressed in various ways according to the rules of gastronomic science. But the banquet table in the palace inhabited by the great mother Bhavani was altogether beyond description. The marriage guests—Vishno, Brahma and all the heavenly orders— were courteously entreated and took their seats line after line. Then the skilful servers began to serve and the women, when they found the gods were sat down, began to jest and banter
in pleasant strain.
Again the sages came and reminded Himavant of the marriage; and he, seeing the time was fit, sent and summoned all the gods,

sections.label: Doha 100
sections.name: मुनि अनुसासन गनपतिहि पूजेउ संभु भवानि

verses.sa:
बोलि सकल सुर सादर लीन्हे ।
सबहि जथोचित आसन दीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
boli sakal sur sādar līnhe
sabahi jathocit āsan dīnhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बेदी बेद बिधान सँवारी ।
सुभग सुमंगल गावहिं नारी ॥
verses.tr:
bedī bed bidhān sam̐vārī
subhag sumaṃgal gāvahiṃ nārī

verses.sa:
सिंघासनु अति दिब्य सुहावा ।
जाइ न बरनि बिरंचि बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
siṃghāsanu ati dibya suhāvā
jāi na barani biraṃci banāvā

verses.sa:
बैठे सिव बिप्रन्ह सिरु नाई ।
हृदयँ सुमिरि निज प्रभु रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhe siv bipranh siru nāī
hṛdayam̐ sumiri nij prabhu raghurāī

verses.sa:
बहुरि मुनीसन्ह उमा बोलाई ।
करि सिंगारु सखीं लै आई ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri munīsanh umā bolāī
kari siṃgāru sakhīṃ lai āī

verses.sa:
देखत रूपु सकल सुर मोहे ।
बरनै छबि अस जग कबि को है ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat rūpu sakal sur mohe
baranai chabi as jag kabi ko hai

verses.sa:
जगदंबिका जानि भव भामा ।
सुरन्ह मनहिं मन कीन्ह प्रनामा ॥
verses.tr:
jagadaṃbikā jāni bhav bhāmā
suranh manahiṃ man kīnh pranāmā

verses.sa:
सुंदरता मरजाद भवानी ।
जाइ न कोटिहुँ बदन बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdaratā marajād bhavānī
jāi na koṭihum̐ badan bakhānī

verses.sa:
कोटिहुँ बदन नहिं बनै बरनत जग जननि सोभा महा ।
सकुचहिं कहत श्रुति सेष सारद मंदमति तुलसी कहा ॥
verses.tr:
koṭihum̐ badan nahiṃ banai baranat jag janani sobhā mahā
sakucahiṃ kahat śruti seṣ sārad maṃdamati tulasī kahā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: छबिखानि मातु भवानि गवनी मध्य मंडप सिव जहाँ ॥
verses.tr: chabikhāni mātu bhavāni gavanī madhya maṃḍap siv jahām̐

verses.sa: अवलोकि सकहिं न सकुच पति पद कमल मनु मधुकरु तहाँ ॥
verses.tr: avaloki sakahiṃ na sakuc pati pad kamal manu madhukaru tahām̐

verses.sa:
मुनि अनुसासन गनपतिहि पूजेउ संभु भवानि ।
कोउ सुनि संसय करै जनि सुर अनादि जियँ जानि ॥
verses.tr:
muni anusāsan ganapatihi pūjeu saṃbhu bhavāni
kou suni saṃsaya karai jani sur anādi jiyam̐ jāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Whom he courteously addressed, and assigned to each an appropriate seat. An altar was prepared according to Vedic ritual, while the women chanted festal strains; and a divinely beautiful throne was erected, the handiwork of a god, beyond description. Then Siva, after bowing to the Brahmans, took his seat, remembering in his heart his own lord, Rama. Then the sages sent for Uma, who was brought in by her handmaids, richly adorned. All the gods beholding her beauty were enraptured. What poet in the world could describe such loveliness The divinities who recognized in her the universal mother, the spouse of Mahadeva, adored her in their inmost soul—Bhavani, the crown of beauty— whose praises would still be beyond me even though I had a myriad tongues,
At the injunction of the priests, both Sambhu and Bhavani paid divine honours to Ganes. And let no one be perplexed on hearing this, but know well that they are gods from everlasting.

sections.label: Doha 101
sections.name: नाथ उमा मन प्रान सम गृहकिंकरी करेहु

verses.sa:
जसि बिबाह कै बिधि श्रुति गाई ।
महामुनिन्ह सो सब करवाई ॥
verses.tr:
jasi bibāh kai bidhi śruti gāī
mahāmuninh so sab karavāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गहि गिरीस कुस कन्या पानी ।
भवहि समरपीं जानि भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
gahi girīs kus kanyā pānī
bhavahi samarapīṃ jāni bhavānī

verses.sa:
पानिग्रहन जब कीन्ह महेसा ।
हिंयँ हरषे तब सकल सुरेसा ॥
verses.tr:
pānigrahan jab kīnh mahesā
hiṃyam̐ haraṣe tab sakal suresā

verses.sa:
बेद मंत्र मुनिबर उच्चरहीं ।
जय जय जय संकर सुर करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bed maṃtr munibar uccarahīṃ
jaya jaya jaya saṃkar sur karahīṃ

verses.sa:
बाजहिं बाजन बिबिध बिधाना ।
सुमनबृष्टि नभ भै बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
bājahiṃ bājan bibidh bidhānā
sumanabṛṣṭi nabh bhai bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
हर गिरिजा कर भयउ बिबाहू ।
सकल भुवन भरि रहा उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
har girijā kar bhayau bibāhū
sakal bhuvan bhari rahā uchāhū

verses.sa:
दासीं दास तुरग रथ नागा ।
धेनु बसन मनि बस्तु बिभागा ॥
verses.tr:
dāsīṃ dās turag rath nāgā
dhenu basan mani bastu bibhāgā

verses.sa:
अन्न कनकभाजन भरि जाना ।
दाइज दीन्ह न जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
ann kanakabhājan bhari jānā
dāij dīnh na jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
दाइज दियो बहु भाँति पुनि कर जोरि हिमभूधर कह्यो ।
का देउँ पूरनकाम संकर चरन पंकज गहि रह्यो ॥
verses.tr:
dāij diyo bahu bhām̐ti puni kar jori himabhūdhar kahyo
kā deum̐ pūranakām saṃkar caran paṃkaj gahi rahyo
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सिवँ कृपासागर ससुर कर संतोषु सब भाँतिहिं कियो ।
पुनि गहे पद पाथोज मयनाँ प्रेम परिपूरन हियो ॥
verses.tr:
sivam̐ kṛpāsāgar sasur kar saṃtoṣu sab bhām̐tihiṃ kiyo
puni gahe pad pāthoj mayanām̐ prem paripūran hiyo

verses.sa:
नाथ उमा मन प्रान सम गृहकिंकरी करेहु ।
छमेहु सकल अपराध अब होइ प्रसन्न बरु देहु ॥
verses.tr:
nāth umā man prān sam gṛhakiṃkarī karehu
chamehu sakal aparādh ab hoi prasann baru dehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The whole marriage ceremony was performed by the priests in accordance with Vedic ritual, and the father, with kusa grass in his hand, took the bride and gave her to Siva. When the two had joined hands, all the gods were glad of heart; the chief priests uttered the scriptural formule, and the cry went up of “Glory, glory, glory to Sankara |” all kinds of music began to play, and flowers were rained down from heaven. Thus was accomplished the marriage of Hara and Girije amidst general rejoicing. The dowry given defies description—men-servants and maid-servants, horses, carriages, elephants, cows, raiment, jewellery, things of all sorts, and wagonloads of grain and golden vessels.
The gracious lord cheered his sad sire in every way most meet,
Then Maina came, most loving dame, and clasped his lotus feet:
‘Uma, my lord, is dear to me as my own soul; take her as one of your servants, and pardon all her offences: this is the boon I beg of your favour.”

sections.label: Doha 102
sections.name: चले संग हिमवंतु तब पहुँचावन अति हेतु

verses.sa:
बहु बिधि संभु सास समुझाई ।
गवनी भवन चरन सिरु नाई ॥
verses.tr:
bahu bidhi saṃbhu sās samujhāī
gavanī bhavan caran siru nāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जननीं उमा बोलि तब लीन्ही ।
लै उछंग सुंदर सिख दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
jananīṃ umā boli tab līnhī
lai uchaṃg suṃdar sikh dīnhī

verses.sa:
करेहु सदा संकर पद पूजा ।
नारिधरमु पति देउ न दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
karehu sadā saṃkar pad pūjā
nāridharamu pati deu na dūjā

verses.sa:
बचन कहत भरे लोचन बारी ।
बहुरि लाइ उर लीन्हि कुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
bacan kahat bhare locan bārī
bahuri lāi ur līnhi kumārī

verses.sa:
कत बिधि सृजीं नारि जग माहीं ।
पराधीन सपनेहुँ सुखु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kat bidhi sṛjīṃ nāri jag māhīṃ
parādhīn sapanehum̐ sukhu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भै अति प्रेम बिकल महतारी ।
धीरजु कीन्ह कुसमय बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
bhai ati prem bikal mahatārī
dhīraju kīnh kusamaya bicārī

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि मिलति परति गहि चरना ।
परम प्रेम कछु जाइ न बरना ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni milati parati gahi caranā
param prem kachu jāi na baranā

verses.sa:
सब नारिन्ह मिलि भेटि भवानी ।
जाइ जननि उर पुनि लपटानी ॥
verses.tr:
sab nārinh mili bheṭi bhavānī
jāi janani ur puni lapaṭānī

verses.sa:
जननिहि बहुरि मिलि चली उचित असीस सब काहूँ दईं ।
फिरि फिरि बिलोकति मातु तन तब सखीं लै सिव पहिं गई ॥
verses.tr:
jananihi bahuri mili calī ucit asīs sab kāhūm̐ daīṃ
phiri phiri bilokati mātu tan tab sakhīṃ lai siv pahiṃ gaī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जाचक सकल संतोषि संकरु उमा सहित भवन चले ।
सब अमर हरषे सुमन बरषि निसान नभ बाजे भले ॥
verses.tr:
jācak sakal saṃtoṣi saṃkaru umā sahit bhavan cale
sab amar haraṣe suman baraṣi nisān nabh bāje bhale

verses.sa:
चले संग हिमवंतु तब पहुँचावन अति हेतु ।
बिबिध भाँति परितोषु करि बिदा कीन्ह बृषकेतु ॥
verses.tr:
cale saṃg himavaṃtu tab pahum̐cāvan ati hetu
bibidh bhām̐ti paritoṣu kari bidā kīnh bṛṣaketu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After Sambhu had in every possible way reassured his wife's mother, she bowed herself at his feet and went home, there called for Uma, and taking her into her lap gave her this excellent instruction,—“ Be ever obedient to Sankara; to say ‘My lord and my god’ is the sum of all wifely duty.” At these words her eyes filled with tears, and again and again she pressed her daughter to her bosom,—‘Why has God created woman in the world, seeing that she is always in a state of subjection, and never can even dream of happiness?” Though utterly distracted by motherly love, she knew it was no time to display it, and restrained herself, Running to her again and again, and falling on the ground to clasp her feet, in a transport of affection beyond all words, Bhavani said adieu to all her companions, and then: again went and clung to her mother’s breast.
Then went Himavant most lovingly to escort them, till with many words of consolation Mahadeva bid him return.

sections.label: Doha 103
sections.name: चरित सिंधु गिरिजा रमन बेद न पावहिं पारु

verses.sa:
तुरत भवन आए गिरिराई ।
सकल सैल सर लिए बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
turat bhavan āe girirāī
sakal sail sar lie bolāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आदर दान बिनय बहुमाना ।
सब कर बिदा कीन्ह हिमवाना ॥
verses.tr:
ādar dān binaya bahumānā
sab kar bidā kīnh himavānā

verses.sa:
जबहिं संभु कैलासहिं आए ।
सुर सब निज निज लोक सिधाए ॥
verses.tr:
jabahiṃ saṃbhu kailāsahiṃ āe
sur sab nij nij lok sidhāe

verses.sa:
जगत मातु पितु संभु भवानी ।
तेही सिंगारु न कहउँ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
jagat mātu pitu saṃbhu bhavānī
tehī siṃgāru na kahaum̐ bakhānī

verses.sa:
करहिं बिबिध बिधि भोग बिलासा ।
गनन्ह समेत बसहिं कैलासा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ bibidh bidhi bhog bilāsā
gananh samet basahiṃ kailāsā

verses.sa:
हर गिरिजा बिहार नित नयऊ ।
एहि बिधि बिपुल काल चलि गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
har girijā bihār nit nayaū
ehi bidhi bipul kāl cali gayaū

verses.sa:
तब जनमेउ षटबदन कुमारा ।
तारकु असुर समर जेहिं मारा ॥
verses.tr:
tab janameu ṣaṭabadan kumārā
tāraku asur samar jehiṃ mārā

verses.sa:
आगम निगम प्रसिद्ध पुराना ।
षन्मुख जन्मु सकल जग जाना ॥
verses.tr:
āgam nigam prasiddh purānā
ṣanmukh janmu sakal jag jānā

verses.sa:
जगु जान षन्मुख जन्मु कर्मु प्रतापु पुरुषारथु महा ।
तेहि हेतु मैं बृषकेतु सुत कर चरित संछेपहिं कहा ॥
verses.tr:
jagu jān ṣanmukh janmu karmu pratāpu puruṣārathu mahā
tehi hetu maiṃ bṛṣaketu sut kar carit saṃchepahiṃ kahā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
यह उमा संगु बिबाहु जे नर नारि कहहिं जे गावहीं ।
कल्यान काज बिबाह मंगल सर्बदा सुखु पावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
yah umā saṃgu bibāhu je nar nāri kahahiṃ je gāvahīṃ
kalyān kāj bibāh maṃgal sarbadā sukhu pāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
चरित सिंधु गिरिजा रमन बेद न पावहिं पारु ।
बरनै तुलसीदासु किमि अति मतिमंद गवाँरु ॥
verses.tr:
carit siṃdhu girijā raman bed na pāvahiṃ pāru
baranai tulasīdāsu kimi ati matimaṃd gavām̐ru
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then he came speedily to the palace, called all the hills and lakes, entreated them courteously with words and gifts, and allowed them to depart. They proceeded each to his own realm, and Sambhu arrived at Kailisa: How shall] I tell its delights when thus occupied by Sambhu and BhavAni, the father and mother of the world, and their attendants They began to indulge in sport and dalliance, and every day some new pleasure. Thus a length of time was passed and the six-headed child (Kartikeya) was born, who vanquished io battle the demon Taraka. His birth is sung by all the sacred books, and his deeds are known throughout the world.
The amorous doings of Girijae and her beloved are an ocean-like depth that not even the Veda can sound; how then can an ignorant clown such as Tulsi DAs succeed in describing them?

sections.label: Doha 104
sections.name: प्रथमहिं मै कहि सिव चरित बूझा मरमु तुम्हार

verses.sa:
संभु चरित सुनि सरस सुहावा ।
भरद्वाज मुनि अति सुख पावा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu carit suni saras suhāvā
bharadvāj muni ati sukh pāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बहु लालसा कथा पर बाढ़ी ।
नयनन्हि नीरु रोमावलि ठाढ़ी ॥
verses.tr:
bahu lālasā kathā par bār̤hī
nayananhi nīru romāvali ṭhār̤hī

verses.sa:
प्रेम बिबस मुख आव न बानी ।
दसा देखि हरषे मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
prem bibas mukh āv na bānī
dasā dekhi haraṣe muni gyānī

verses.sa:
अहो धन्य तव जन्मु मुनीसा ।
तुम्हहि प्रान सम प्रिय गौरीसा ॥
verses.tr:
aho dhanya tav janmu munīsā
tumhahi prān sam priya gaurīsā

verses.sa:
सिव पद कमल जिन्हहि रति नाहीं ।
रामहि ते सपनेहुँ न सोहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
siv pad kamal jinhahi rati nāhīṃ
rāmahi te sapanehum̐ na sohāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बिनु छल बिस्वनाथ पद नेहू ।
राम भगत कर लच्छन एहू ॥
verses.tr:
binu chal bisvanāth pad nehū
rām bhagat kar lacchan ehū

verses.sa:
सिव सम को रघुपति ब्रतधारी ।
बिनु अघ तजी सती असि नारी ॥
verses.tr:
siv sam ko raghupati bratadhārī
binu agh tajī satī asi nārī

verses.sa:
पनु करि रघुपति भगति देखाई ।
को सिव सम रामहि प्रिय भाई ॥
verses.tr:
panu kari raghupati bhagati dekhāī
ko siv sam rāmahi priya bhāī

verses.sa:
प्रथमहिं मै कहि सिव चरित बूझा मरमु तुम्हार ।
सुचि सेवक तुम्ह राम के रहित समस्त बिकार ॥
verses.tr:
prathamahiṃ mai kahi siv carit būjhā maramu tumhār
suci sevak tumh rām ke rahit samast bikār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the suinted Bharadvaja had heard all this pleasant and delectable history of Sambhu’s doings, he was delighted and longed to hear yet more. With overflowing ™ eyes and every limb thrilling, he was so mastered by love that his tongue could not utter a word. On seeing his condition the great sage was pleased,—‘ Blessed is thy birth, to whom Gauri’s lord is dear as life. He who loves not Siva’s lotus feet can never dream of pleasing Rama: a guileless love for Siva’s feet is the surest sign of faith in Rama. For who is go faithful to Rama as Siva, who for no fault thus left his wife Sati and made a vow, the pledge of uuswerving fidelity? And whom does Rama hold more dear than Siva?
I have begun by telling you of Siva’s deeds, knowing well your secret, that youare a true servant of Rama, without any variableness.

sections.label: Doha 105
sections.name: सिद्ध तपोधन जोगिजन सूर किंनर मुनिबृंद

verses.sa:
मैं जाना तुम्हार गुन सीला ।
कहउँ सुनहु अब रघुपति लीला ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ jānā tumhār gun sīlā
kahaum̐ sunahu ab raghupati līlā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनु मुनि आजु समागम तोरें ।
कहि न जाइ जस सुखु मन मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
sunu muni āju samāgam toreṃ
kahi na jāi jas sukhu man moreṃ

verses.sa:
राम चरित अति अमित मुनिसा ।
कहि न सकहिं सत कोटि अहीसा ॥
verses.tr:
rām carit ati amit munisā
kahi na sakahiṃ sat koṭi ahīsā

verses.sa:
तदपि जथाश्रुत कहउँ बखानी ।
सुमिरि गिरापति प्रभु धनुपानी ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi jathāśrut kahaum̐ bakhānī
sumiri girāpati prabhu dhanupānī

verses.sa:
सारद दारुनारि सम स्वामी ।
रामु सूत्रधर अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
sārad dārunāri sam svāmī
rāmu sūtradhar aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
जेहि पर कृपा करहिं जनु जानी ।
कबि उर अजिर नचावहिं बानी ॥
verses.tr:
jehi par kṛpā karahiṃ janu jānī
kabi ur ajir nacāvahiṃ bānī

verses.sa:
प्रनवउँ सोइ कृपाल रघुनाथा ।
बरनउँ बिसद तासु गुन गाथा ॥
verses.tr:
pranavaum̐ soi kṛpāl raghunāthā
baranaum̐ bisad tāsu gun gāthā

verses.sa:
परम रम्य गिरिबरु कैलासू ।
सदा जहाँ सिव उमा निवासू ॥
verses.tr:
param ramya giribaru kailāsū
sadā jahām̐ siv umā nivāsū

verses.sa:
सिद्ध तपोधन जोगिजन सूर किंनर मुनिबृंद ।
बसहिं तहाँ सुकृती सकल सेवहिं सिब सुखकंद ॥
verses.tr:
siddh tapodhan jogijan sūr kiṃnar munibṛṃd
basahiṃ tahām̐ sukṛtī sakal sevahiṃ sib sukhakaṃd
verses.head: दोहा

trans: T understand your character and disposition; listen therefore while I proceed to recount Rama's adventures. I cannot say how glad I am at this meeting with you to-day, Though Rama's deeds are beyond measure, and not a myriad serpent kings could tell them all, yet I repeat the tale as it has been revealed, after fixing my thoughts on the god with bow in hand, who is the lord of the queen of speech. For Sarasvati is as it were but a puppet, and Rama the manager who plays the hidden strings. When he finds a true believer, he graciously sets her to dance in the courtyard of the poet's fancy. To him, the merciful. Raghunath, I bow before commencing the recital of his glory. OE all mountains the most beautiful was Kailas, since Siva and Uma had made it their home: —
Saints, hermits, ascetics, gods, sinnaras, sages, and all pious souls came there to dwell and adore Mahadeva, the root of all good.

sections.label: Doha 106
sections.name: जटा मुकुट सुरसरित सिर लोचन नलिन बिसाल

verses.sa:
हरि हर बिमुख धर्म रति नाहीं ।
ते नर तहँ सपनेहुँ नहिं जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
hari har bimukh dharm rati nāhīṃ
te nar taham̐ sapanehum̐ nahiṃ jāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहि गिरि पर बट बिटप बिसाला ।
नित नूतन सुंदर सब काला ॥
verses.tr:
tehi giri par baṭ biṭap bisālā
nit nūtan suṃdar sab kālā

verses.sa:
त्रिबिध समीर सुसीतलि छाया ।
सिव बिश्राम बिटप श्रुति गाया ॥
verses.tr:
tribidh samīr susītali chāyā
siv biśrām biṭap śruti gāyā

verses.sa:
एक बार तेहि तर प्रभु गयऊ ।
तरु बिलोकि उर अति सुखु भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār tehi tar prabhu gayaū
taru biloki ur ati sukhu bhayaū

verses.sa:
निज कर डासि नागरिपु छाला ।
बैठै सहजहिं संभु कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
nij kar ḍāsi nāgaripu chālā
baiṭhai sahajahiṃ saṃbhu kṛpālā

verses.sa:
कुंद इंदु दर गौर सरीरा ।
भुज प्रलंब परिधन मुनिचीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kuṃd iṃdu dar gaur sarīrā
bhuj pralaṃb paridhan municīrā

verses.sa:
तरुन अरुन अंबुज सम चरना ।
नख दुति भगत हृदय तम हरना ॥
verses.tr:
tarun arun aṃbuj sam caranā
nakh duti bhagat hṛdaya tam haranā

verses.sa:
भुजग भूति भूषन त्रिपुरारी ।
आननु सरद चंद छबि हारी ॥
verses.tr:
bhujag bhūti bhūṣan tripurārī
ānanu sarad caṃd chabi hārī

verses.sa:
जटा मुकुट सुरसरित सिर लोचन नलिन बिसाल ।
नीलकंठ लावन्यनिधि सोह बालबिधु भाल ॥
verses.tr:
jaṭā mukuṭ surasarit sir locan nalin bisāl
nīlakaṃṭh lāvanyanidhi soh bālabidhu bhāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: But enemies of Hari and Hara, who had no love for virtue, could never even in a dream find their way to the place. On this mountain was an enormous bar tree, which no time nor season could rob of its beauty; ever stirred by soft, cool, fragrant breezes and a shade from the hottest sun; the Vitap tree famous in sacred song as Mahadeva’s
‘favourite haunt. Once on a time the lord had gone under

it, and inan excess of delight spread with his own hands his tiger-skin on the ground and there sat at ease; his body as fair in hue as the jasmine or the moon, his arms of great length, a hermit’s loth wrapt about his loins, his feet like lotus blossoms, and his toe-nails like gleams of light to dispel the darkness of faithful souls; his face more splendid than the moon io autumn: and his decorations, serpents and streaks of shes. Dohd 114.

sections.label: Doha 107
sections.name: प्रभु समरथ सर्बग्य सिव सकल कला गुन धाम

verses.sa:
बैठे सोह कामरिपु कैसें ।
धरें सरीरु सांतरसु जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhe soh kāmaripu kaiseṃ
dhareṃ sarīru sāṃtarasu jaiseṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पारबती भल अवसरु जानी ।
गई संभु पहिं मातु भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
pārabatī bhal avasaru jānī
gaī saṃbhu pahiṃ mātu bhavānī

verses.sa:
जानि प्रिया आदरु अति कीन्हा ।
बाम भाग आसनु हर दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jāni priyā ādaru ati kīnhā
bām bhāg āsanu har dīnhā

verses.sa:
बैठीं सिव समीप हरषाई ।
पूरुब जन्म कथा चित आई ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhīṃ siv samīp haraṣāī
pūrub janm kathā cit āī

verses.sa:
पति हियँ हेतु अधिक अनुमानी ।
बिहसि उमा बोलीं प्रिय बानी ॥
verses.tr:
pati hiyam̐ hetu adhik anumānī
bihasi umā bolīṃ priya bānī

verses.sa:
कथा जो सकल लोक हितकारी ।
सोइ पूछन चह सैलकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
kathā jo sakal lok hitakārī
soi pūchan cah sailakumārī

verses.sa:
बिस्वनाथ मम नाथ पुरारी ।
त्रिभुवन महिमा बिदित तुम्हारी ॥
verses.tr:
bisvanāth mam nāth purārī
tribhuvan mahimā bidit tumhārī

verses.sa:
चर अरु अचर नाग नर देवा ।
सकल करहिं पद पंकज सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
car aru acar nāg nar devā
sakal karahiṃ pad paṃkaj sevā

verses.sa: प्रभु समरथ सर्बग्य सिव सकल कला गुन धाम ॥
verses.tr: prabhu samarath sarbagya siv sakal kalā gun dhām
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: जोग ग्यान बैराग्य निधि प्रनत कलपतरु नाम ॥
verses.tr: jog gyān bairāgya nidhi pranat kalapataru nām

trans: What his twisted coils of hair for a crown; with the Ganges springing from his head; with full-orbed eyes like the lotus, and with the crescent moon on his brow; the durk-throated god shone forth in all his brilliancy.
So sat the enemy of Love, as it were Quietism embodied. Then Parvati, who is the great mother Bhavani, approached, seeing her time, In recognition of her love he received

her most courteously and enthroned her on his left side. Joyously she sat beside him and recalled her former life; and reckoning on his augmented attachment she spoke being fain to hear the salutary tale,—“ O lord of the world my lord Pureri, your greatness is known throughout all three worlds: things moving or motionless, serpents, men and gods, all do homage to your lotus feet.

You are the lord of all power and of all knowledge; the centre of art and science; the great storehouse of meditation, of wisdom and of asceticism; and your name‘is us the tree of life to the afflicted.

sections.label: Doha 108
sections.name: जौं नृप तनय त ब्रह्म किमि नारि बिरहँ मति भोरि

verses.sa:
जौं मो पर प्रसन्न सुखरासी ।
जानिअ सत्य मोहि निज दासी ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ mo par prasann sukharāsī
jānia satya mohi nij dāsī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तौं प्रभु हरहु मोर अग्याना ।
कहि रघुनाथ कथा बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
tauṃ prabhu harahu mor agyānā
kahi raghunāth kathā bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
जासु भवनु सुरतरु तर होई ।
सहि कि दरिद्र जनित दुखु सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu bhavanu surataru tar hoī
sahi ki daridr janit dukhu soī

verses.sa:
ससिभूषन अस हृदयँ बिचारी ।
हरहु नाथ मम मति भ्रम भारी ॥
verses.tr:
sasibhūṣan as hṛdayam̐ bicārī
harahu nāth mam mati bhram bhārī

verses.sa:
प्रभु जे मुनि परमारथबादी ।
कहहिं राम कहुँ ब्रह्म अनादी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu je muni paramārathabādī
kahahiṃ rām kahum̐ brahm anādī

verses.sa:
सेस सारदा बेद पुराना ।
सकल करहिं रघुपति गुन गाना ॥
verses.tr:
ses sāradā bed purānā
sakal karahiṃ raghupati gun gānā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह पुनि राम राम दिन राती ।
सादर जपहु अनँग आराती ॥
verses.tr:
tumh puni rām rām din rātī
sādar japahu anam̐g ārātī

verses.sa:
रामु सो अवध नृपति सुत सोई ।
की अज अगुन अलखगति कोई ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu so avadh nṛpati sut soī
kī aj agun alakhagati koī

verses.sa:
जौं नृप तनय त ब्रह्म किमि नारि बिरहँ मति भोरि ।
देख चरित महिमा सुनत भ्रमति बुद्धि अति मोरि ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nṛp tanaya ta brahm kimi nāri biraham̐ mati bhori
dekh carit mahimā sunat bhramati buddhi ati mori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: lf, O blissful being, I have found favour in your sight, and you know me to be your own devoted slave, then, my lord, disperse my ignorance by reciting to me the story of Rama. How can he who dwells beneath the tree of paradise know aught of sorrow that is born of want Consider, OQ moon-crowned god, and relieve my mind of this perplexity. The saints, who preach salvation, declare that Rama is the uncreated god; SeshnAg, Sarasvati, the Veda, the Puranas, all sing his praises; you too, night and day, great conqueror of Love, reverently repeat his name. Is this Rama the son of the King of Avadh, or some other uncreated, passionless, invisible Being?
If a king’s son, and so distrest by the loss of his wife,

sections.label: Doha 109
sections.name: बंदउ पद धरि धरनि सिरु बिनय करउँ कर जोरि

verses.sa:
जौं अनीह ब्यापक बिभु कोऊ ।
कबहु बुझाइ नाथ मोहि सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ anīh byāpak bibhu koū
kabahu bujhāi nāth mohi soū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अग्य जानि रिस उर जनि धरहू ।
जेहि बिधि मोह मिटै सोइ करहू ॥
verses.tr:
agya jāni ris ur jani dharahū
jehi bidhi moh miṭai soi karahū

verses.sa:
मै बन दीखि राम प्रभुताई ।
अति भय बिकल न तुम्हहि सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
mai ban dīkhi rām prabhutāī
ati bhaya bikal na tumhahi sunāī

verses.sa:
तदपि मलिन मन बोधु न आवा ।
सो फलु भली भाँति हम पावा ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi malin man bodhu na āvā
so phalu bhalī bhām̐ti ham pāvā

verses.sa:
अजहूँ कछु संसउ मन मोरे ।
करहु कृपा बिनवउँ कर जोरें ॥
verses.tr:
ajahūm̐ kachu saṃsau man more
karahu kṛpā binavaum̐ kar joreṃ

verses.sa:
प्रभु तब मोहि बहु भाँति प्रबोधा ।
नाथ सो समुझि करहु जनि क्रोधा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu tab mohi bahu bhām̐ti prabodhā
nāth so samujhi karahu jani krodhā

verses.sa:
तब कर अस बिमोह अब नाहीं ।
रामकथा पर रुचि मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tab kar as bimoh ab nāhīṃ
rāmakathā par ruci man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
कहहु पुनीत राम गुन गाथा ।
भुजगराज भूषन सुरनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu punīt rām gun gāthā
bhujagarāj bhūṣan suranāthā

verses.sa:
बंदउ पद धरि धरनि सिरु बिनय करउँ कर जोरि ।
बरनहु रघुबर बिसद जसु श्रुति सिद्धांत निचोरि ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdau pad dhari dharani siru binaya karaum̐ kar jori
baranahu raghubar bisad jasu śruti siddhāṃt nicori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: then how the Supreme God? When I compare his acts
that I see with the eulogies that I hear, my mind is completely distracted.

Instruct me, my lord, with regard to him who is the passionless, all-pervading, omnipresent god. Be not wroth at ny ignorance, but take steps to remove it. In the wood, though I was too awe-stricken to tell you, I beheld the majesty of Rama, yet my mind was so dull that I ‘did not understand, and I reaped a just reward. Again to-day I am in doubt, and with clasped hands I beg of you to compassionate me: be not angry, nor say you have been taught already; the past is past; my infatuation is gone, and I have a hearty longing to hear the sacred story of Rama's virtuous deeds. Declare it, O glory of the serpent king, great lord of heaven.
Laying my headin the dust, I worship your feet, and with folded hands entreat you to tell me all Raghubar’s excellent glory, as extracted from scripture and philosophy.

sections.label: Doha 110
sections.name: बहुरि कहहु करुनायतन कीन्ह जो अचरज राम

verses.sa:
जदपि जोषिता नहिं अधिकारी ।
दासी मन क्रम बचन तुम्हारी ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi joṣitā nahiṃ adhikārī
dāsī man kram bacan tumhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गूढ़उ तत्व न साधु दुरावहिं ।
आरत अधिकारी जहँ पावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
gūr̤hau tatv na sādhu durāvahiṃ
ārat adhikārī jaham̐ pāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
अति आरति पूछउँ सुरराया ।
रघुपति कथा कहहु करि दाया ॥
verses.tr:
ati ārati pūchaum̐ surarāyā
raghupati kathā kahahu kari dāyā

verses.sa:
प्रथम सो कारन कहहु बिचारी ।
निर्गुन ब्रह्म सगुन बपु धारी ॥
verses.tr:
pratham so kāran kahahu bicārī
nirgun brahm sagun bapu dhārī

verses.sa:
पुनि प्रभु कहहु राम अवतारा ।
बालचरित पुनि कहहु उदारा ॥
verses.tr:
puni prabhu kahahu rām avatārā
bālacarit puni kahahu udārā

verses.sa:
कहहु जथा जानकी बिबाहीं ।
राज तजा सो दूषन काहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu jathā jānakī bibāhīṃ
rāj tajā so dūṣan kāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बन बसि कीन्हे चरित अपारा ।
कहहु नाथ जिमि रावन मारा ॥
verses.tr:
ban basi kīnhe carit apārā
kahahu nāth jimi rāvan mārā

verses.sa:
राज बैठि कीन्हीं बहु लीला ।
सकल कहहु संकर सुखलीला ॥
verses.tr:
rāj baiṭhi kīnhīṃ bahu līlā
sakal kahahu saṃkar sukhalīlā

verses.sa:
बहुरि कहहु करुनायतन कीन्ह जो अचरज राम ।
प्रजा सहित रघुबंसमनि किमि गवने निज धाम ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri kahahu karunāyatan kīnh jo acaraj rām
prajā sahit raghubaṃsamani kimi gavane nij dhām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Though a woman is not entitled to initiation, yet I am in a special degree your servant; further, the saints do not forbid mystic instruction to a woman in great distress, and it is in extreme distress that a call upon you, heavenly king, for an account of Rama. First, weigh well and declare tw me the cause why the invisible Brahm assumed a visible body. Then, my lord, tell me of his incarnation and his pretty actions when a child, and how he wedded Janaki, and for what fault he left his father’s kingdom, and what he did when living in the woods, and how he slew Ravan, and how he amused himself when he recovered the throne; tel] me all about him, most amiable Sankara.
Then tell me, gracious lord, of his marvellous acts, and
how with all his subjects the jewel of Raghu’s line proceeded
to his own abode.: Chaupdi 111.

sections.label: Doha 111
sections.name: मगन ध्यानरस दंड जुग पुनि मन बाहेर कीन्ह

verses.sa:
पुनि प्रभु कहहु सो तत्व बखानी ।
जेहिं बिग्यान मगन मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
puni prabhu kahahu so tatv bakhānī
jehiṃ bigyān magan muni gyānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भगति ग्यान बिग्यान बिरागा ।
पुनि सब बरनहु सहित बिभागा ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati gyān bigyān birāgā
puni sab baranahu sahit bibhāgā

verses.sa:
औरउ राम रहस्य अनेका ।
कहहु नाथ अति बिमल बिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
aurau rām rahasya anekā
kahahu nāth ati bimal bibekā

verses.sa:
जो प्रभु मैं पूछा नहि होई ।
सोउ दयाल राखहु जनि गोई ॥
verses.tr:
jo prabhu maiṃ pūchā nahi hoī
sou dayāl rākhahu jani goī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह त्रिभुवन गुर बेद बखाना ।
आन जीव पाँवर का जाना ॥
verses.tr:
tumh tribhuvan gur bed bakhānā
ān jīv pām̐var kā jānā

verses.sa:
प्रस्न उमा कै सहज सुहाई ।
छल बिहीन सुनि सिव मन भाई ॥
verses.tr:
prasn umā kai sahaj suhāī
chal bihīn suni siv man bhāī

verses.sa:
हर हियँ रामचरित सब आए ।
प्रेम पुलक लोचन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
har hiyam̐ rāmacarit sab āe
prem pulak locan jal chāe

verses.sa:
श्रीरघुनाथ रूप उर आवा ।
परमानंद अमित सुख पावा ॥
verses.tr:
śrīraghunāth rūp ur āvā
paramānaṃd amit sukh pāvā

verses.sa:
मगन ध्यानरस दंड जुग पुनि मन बाहेर कीन्ह ।
रघुपति चरित महेस तब हरषित बरनै लीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
magan dhyānaras daṃḍ jug puni man bāher kīnh
raghupati carit mahes tab haraṣit baranai līnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Next tell me, my lord what it all means; explaining to me in full detail what is the intelligence that so absorbs the wisest saints; what is faith, and wisdom, and supreme knowledge and detachment from the world. ‘Tell me also, O lord of purest understanding, the many other mysteries connected with Rama; and if there be anything which 1 have omitted to ask, be kind enough not to suppress it. You, as the Vedas say, are the great teacher of the three worlds; what can other poor creatures know?” When Siva heard UmA's winning and guileless speech he was glad; the whole of RAma acts thronged in upon his soul, his eyes were bedewed with tears and his very limbs thrilled with rapture; for the vision of Rama filled his heart, and his ecstatic Joy was beyond measure.
For a brief space MahAdeva was lost in contemplation; then recovered himself and began with great joy to tell the tale of Jtama.

sections.label: Doha 112
sections.name: रामकृपा तें पारबति सपनेहुँ तव मन माहिं

verses.sa:
झूठेउ सत्य जाहि बिनु जानें ।
जिमि भुजंग बिनु रजु पहिचानें ॥
verses.tr:
jhūṭheu satya jāhi binu jāneṃ
jimi bhujaṃg binu raju pahicāneṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जेहि जानें जग जाइ हेराई ।
जागें जथा सपन भ्रम जाई ॥
verses.tr:
jehi jāneṃ jag jāi herāī
jāgeṃ jathā sapan bhram jāī

verses.sa:
बंदउँ बालरूप सोई रामू ।
सब सिधि सुलभ जपत जिसु नामू ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdaum̐ bālarūp soī rāmū
sab sidhi sulabh japat jisu nāmū

verses.sa:
मंगल भवन अमंगल हारी ।
द्रवउ सो दसरथ अजिर बिहारी ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal bhavan amaṃgal hārī
dravau so dasarath ajir bihārī

verses.sa:
करि प्रनाम रामहि त्रिपुरारी ।
हरषि सुधा सम गिरा उचारी ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranām rāmahi tripurārī
haraṣi sudhā sam girā ucārī

verses.sa:
धन्य धन्य गिरिराजकुमारी ।
तुम्ह समान नहिं कोउ उपकारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya dhanya girirājakumārī
tumh samān nahiṃ kou upakārī

verses.sa:
पूँछेहु रघुपति कथा प्रसंगा ।
सकल लोक जग पावनि गंगा ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chehu raghupati kathā prasaṃgā
sakal lok jag pāvani gaṃgā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह रघुबीर चरन अनुरागी ।
कीन्हहु प्रस्न जगत हित लागी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh raghubīr caran anurāgī
kīnhahu prasn jagat hit lāgī

verses.sa:
रामकृपा तें पारबति सपनेहुँ तव मन माहिं ।
सोक मोह संदेह भ्रम मम बिचार कछु नाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakṛpā teṃ pārabati sapanehum̐ tav man māhiṃ
sok moh saṃdeh bhram mam bicār kachu nāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Not to distinguish between the false and the true is like mistaking a rope for a snake; while as a dream vanishes away on awakening, so is it with those who look well and make sure. I reverence the child Rama, most easy of access to all who repeat his name. Come to me, O home of bliss and bane of woe, as when thou usedst to sport in Dasarath’s courtyard.” After thus paying homage to Rama, Tripurari began his mellifluons recital,—‘ All blessings on thee, O daughter of the mountain-king, there is no such benefactor as thou art. Thou hast asked for Rama’s history as potent as the Ganges to sanctify the world; and it is on the world’s account that thou hast asked, being thyself full of love for Rama's feet.
By the blessing of Rama, O Parvati, not even in sleep can doubt, error, delusion, or distress enter into your mind; this I know well:

sections.label: Doha 113
sections.name: रामकथा सुरधेनु सम सेवत सब सुख दानि

verses.sa:
तदपि असंका कीन्हिहु सोई ।
कहत सुनत सब कर हित होई ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi asaṃkā kīnhihu soī
kahat sunat sab kar hit hoī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिन्ह हरि कथा सुनी नहिं काना ।
श्रवन रंध्र अहिभवन समाना ॥
verses.tr:
jinh hari kathā sunī nahiṃ kānā
śravan raṃdhr ahibhavan samānā

verses.sa:
नयनन्हि संत दरस नहिं देखा ।
लोचन मोरपंख कर लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
nayananhi saṃt daras nahiṃ dekhā
locan morapaṃkh kar lekhā

verses.sa:
ते सिर कटु तुंबरि समतूला ।
जे न नमत हरि गुर पद मूला ॥
verses.tr:
te sir kaṭu tuṃbari samatūlā
je na namat hari gur pad mūlā

verses.sa:
जिन्ह हरिभगति हृदयँ नहिं आनी ।
जीवत सव समान तेइ प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
jinh haribhagati hṛdayam̐ nahiṃ ānī
jīvat sav samān tei prānī

verses.sa:
जो नहिं करइ राम गुन गाना ।
जीह सो दादुर जीह समाना ॥
verses.tr:
jo nahiṃ karai rām gun gānā
jīh so dādur jīh samānā

verses.sa:
कुलिस कठोर निठुर सोइ छाती ।
सुनि हरिचरित न जो हरषाती ॥
verses.tr:
kulis kaṭhor niṭhur soi chātī
suni haricarit na jo haraṣātī

verses.sa:
गिरिजा सुनहु राम कै लीला ।
सुर हित दनुज बिमोहनसीला ॥
verses.tr:
girijā sunahu rām kai līlā
sur hit danuj bimohanasīlā

verses.sa:
रामकथा सुरधेनु सम सेवत सब सुख दानि ।
सतसमाज सुरलोक सब को न सुनै अस जानि ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā suradhenu sam sevat sab sukh dāni
satasamāj suralok sab ko na sunai as jāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: But you have so ordered your certainty as to benefit all who speak or hear. For the ears that hear not Rama’s name are mere snake-holes; the eyes that have not seen his true vision are like the false eyes in a peacock’s tail; the heads that have not bowed at the feet of Hari’s priest are of no more worth than bitter pumpkins. They whose heart is not inspired with faith in Hari are mere animated corpses; those who sing not his praises are like croaking frogs; and hard and impenetrable as a thunderbolt is their breast who hear his deeds and take no delight in them. Listen O Girija, to the deeds of Rama, which are to gods a delight and to demons a delusion?
Who is the good man that will not listen to the story of Rama, which is like the heavenly cow, that fulfils every desire of the gods who tend it.

sections.label: Doha 114
sections.name: कहहि सुनहि अस अधम नर ग्रसे जे मोह पिसाच

verses.sa:
रामकथा सुंदर कर तारी ।
संसय बिहग उडावनिहारी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā suṃdar kar tārī
saṃsaya bihag uḍāvanihārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रामकथा कलि बिटप कुठारी ।
सादर सुनु गिरिराजकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakathā kali biṭap kuṭhārī
sādar sunu girirājakumārī

verses.sa:
राम नाम गुन चरित सुहाए ।
जनम करम अगनित श्रुति गाए ॥
verses.tr:
rām nām gun carit suhāe
janam karam aganit śruti gāe

verses.sa:
जथा अनंत राम भगवाना ।
तथा कथा कीरति गुन नाना ॥
verses.tr:
jathā anaṃt rām bhagavānā
tathā kathā kīrati gun nānā

verses.sa:
तदपि जथा श्रुत जसि मति मोरी ।
कहिहउँ देखि प्रीति अति तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi jathā śrut jasi mati morī
kahihaum̐ dekhi prīti ati torī

verses.sa:
उमा प्रस्न तव सहज सुहाई ।
सुखद संतसंमत मोहि भाई ॥
verses.tr:
umā prasn tav sahaj suhāī
sukhad saṃtasaṃmat mohi bhāī

verses.sa:
एक बात नहि मोहि सोहानी ।
जदपि मोह बस कहेहु भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
ek bāt nahi mohi sohānī
jadapi moh bas kahehu bhavānī

verses.sa:
तुम जो कहा राम कोउ आना ।
जेहि श्रुति गाव धरहिं मुनि ध्याना ॥
verses.tr:
tum jo kahā rām kou ānā
jehi śruti gāv dharahiṃ muni dhyānā

verses.sa:
कहहि सुनहि अस अधम नर ग्रसे जे मोह पिसाच ।
पाषंडी हरि पद बिमुख जानहिं झूठ न साच ॥
verses.tr:
kahahi sunahi as adham nar grase je moh pisāc
pāṣaṃḍī hari pad bimukh jānahiṃ jhūṭh na sāc
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The story of Rama is like a fair pair of cymbals to frighten away the birds of doubt, or like an axe at the root of the tree of sin; listen reverently, O daughter of the mountain-king. How sweet is the name of Rama, and his ways and his deeds; his lives and his actions are declared by the scriptures to be beyond number. And as there is no end to Rama, so the legends about him and his glory are endless: yet, seeing the greatness of your love, I will attempt to tell them to the best of my ability and as the scriptures have revealed. Your inquiries, Uma, are most becoming and profitable, such as the saints approve, and I too am_ pleased to hear: but there was one thing I did not like, though you spoke under the influence of a delusion; for you said,—‘ Is there some other Rama whom the Vedas sing, and whom sages love to contemplate?’
This is what is said by the vile wretches whom the demon of delusion has in his clutch: heretios, who are the enemies of Hari and know no difference between truth and falsehood.

sections.label: Doha 115
sections.name: अस निज हृदयँ बिचारि तजु संसय भजु राम पद

verses.sa:
अग्य अकोबिद अंध अभागी ।
काई बिषय मुकर मन लागी ॥
verses.tr:
agya akobid aṃdh abhāgī
kāī biṣaya mukar man lāgī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लंपट कपटी कुटिल बिसेषी ।
सपनेहुँ संतसभा नहिं देखी ॥
verses.tr:
laṃpaṭ kapaṭī kuṭil biseṣī
sapanehum̐ saṃtasabhā nahiṃ dekhī

verses.sa:
कहहिं ते बेद असंमत बानी ।
जिन्ह कें सूझ लाभु नहिं हानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ te bed asaṃmat bānī
jinh keṃ sūjh lābhu nahiṃ hānī

verses.sa:
मुकर मलिन अरु नयन बिहीना ।
राम रूप देखहिं किमि दीना ॥
verses.tr:
mukar malin aru nayan bihīnā
rām rūp dekhahiṃ kimi dīnā

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कें अगुन न सगुन बिबेका ।
जल्पहिं कल्पित बचन अनेका ॥
verses.tr:
jinh keṃ agun na sagun bibekā
jalpahiṃ kalpit bacan anekā

verses.sa:
हरिमाया बस जगत भ्रमाहीं ।
तिन्हहि कहत कछु अघटित नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
harimāyā bas jagat bhramāhīṃ
tinhahi kahat kachu aghaṭit nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बातुल भूत बिबस मतवारे ।
ते नहिं बोलहिं बचन बिचारे ॥
verses.tr:
bātul bhūt bibas matavāre
te nahiṃ bolahiṃ bacan bicāre

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कृत महामोह मद पाना ।
तिन् कर कहा करिअ नहिं काना ॥
verses.tr:
jinh kṛt mahāmoh mad pānā
tin kar kahā karia nahiṃ kānā

verses.sa:
अस निज हृदयँ बिचारि तजु संसय भजु राम पद ।
सुनु गिरिराज कुमारि भ्रम तम रबि कर बचन मम ॥
verses.tr:
as nij hṛdayam̐ bicāri taju saṃsaya bhaju rām pad
sunu girirāj kumāri bhram tam rabi kar bacan mam
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Ignorant, unlearned and blind reprobates; the mirror of whose mind is clouded by a film of sensuality; lustful, treacherous and desperately perverse, who have never even in a dream attained to a vision of true faith. They utter doctrines repugnant to the Veda, with no understanding of loss or gain; their glass is dim, their eyes are naught: how then can such hapless wights see the beauty of Rama? Unable to distinguish between the material and immaterial, they jabber many lying words, and under Hari’s delusive influence go utterly astray in the world; for whom no words are too strong. Wind, devilish, drunken, they can utter nothing to the purpose, and are so intoxicated with a strong delusion that no one should give ear to their ravings.
Being thus assured in your heart, discard all doubt and fall in adoration at Rama’s feet. Listen, O daughter of the mountain-king, and the sun of my words shall disperse all the mists from your soul.

sections.label: Doha 116
sections.name: पुरुष प्रसिद्ध प्रकास निधि प्रगट परावर नाथ

verses.sa:
सगुनहि अगुनहि नहिं कछु भेदा ।
गावहिं मुनि पुरान बुध बेदा ॥
verses.tr:
sagunahi agunahi nahiṃ kachu bhedā
gāvahiṃ muni purān budh bedā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अगुन अरुप अलख अज जोई ।
भगत प्रेम बस सगुन सो होई ॥
verses.tr:
agun arup alakh aj joī
bhagat prem bas sagun so hoī

verses.sa:
जो गुन रहित सगुन सोइ कैसें ।
जलु हिम उपल बिलग नहिं जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
jo gun rahit sagun soi kaiseṃ
jalu him upal bilag nahiṃ jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
जासु नाम भ्रम तिमिर पतंगा ।
तेहि किमि कहिअ बिमोह प्रसंगा ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu nām bhram timir pataṃgā
tehi kimi kahia bimoh prasaṃgā

verses.sa:
राम सच्चिदानंद दिनेसा ।
नहिं तहँ मोह निसा लवलेसा ॥
verses.tr:
rām saccidānaṃd dinesā
nahiṃ taham̐ moh nisā lavalesā

verses.sa:
सहज प्रकासरुप भगवाना ।
नहिं तहँ पुनि बिग्यान बिहाना ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj prakāsarup bhagavānā
nahiṃ taham̐ puni bigyān bihānā

verses.sa:
हरष बिषाद ग्यान अग्याना ।
जीव धर्म अहमिति अभिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣ biṣād gyān agyānā
jīv dharm ahamiti abhimānā

verses.sa:
राम ब्रह्म ब्यापक जग जाना ।
परमानन्द परेस पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
rām brahm byāpak jag jānā
paramānand pares purānā

verses.sa: पुरुष प्रसिद्ध प्रकास निधि प्रगट परावर नाथ ॥
verses.tr: puruṣ prasiddh prakās nidhi pragaṭ parāvar nāth
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: रघुकुलमनि मम स्वामि सोइ कहि सिवँ नायउ माथ ॥
verses.tr: raghukulamani mam svāmi soi kahi sivam̐ nāyau māth

trans: There is no difference between the material and the immaterial; so declare saints and sages, the Veda and the Puranas. The formless, invisible and uncreated Immaterial, out of love for the faithful, becomes materialized. How can this be In the same way as water is crystallized into ice. But how can He be subject to sensual delusion whose very name is Like the sun to disperse the darkness of error? In

Rama, who is the Supreme Being and the sun of the world, the night of delusion can have no part whatever; and in the Lord, who is himself true light, there can be no dawn of understanding; neither joy nor sorrow, knowledge nor ignorance; neither personal piety, nor the sins of vanity and pride: but Rama is the omnipresent God, the blissful Lord of all, the ancient of days;
The Great Spirit, the glorious fount of light; the Revealed, the Incomprehensible, the jewel of the family of Raghu, my own lord:”, and so saying Siva bowed the head..

sections.label: Doha 117
sections.name: रजत सीप महुँ मास जिमि जथा भानु कर बारि

verses.sa:
निज भ्रम नहिं समुझहिं अग्यानी ।
प्रभु पर मोह धरहिं जड़ प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
nij bhram nahiṃ samujhahiṃ agyānī
prabhu par moh dharahiṃ jar̤ prānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जथा गगन घन पटल निहारी ।
झाँपेउ मानु कहहिं कुबिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
jathā gagan ghan paṭal nihārī
jhām̐peu mānu kahahiṃ kubicārī

verses.sa:
चितव जो लोचन अंगुलि लाएँ ।
प्रगट जुगल ससि तेहि के भाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
citav jo locan aṃguli lāem̐
pragaṭ jugal sasi tehi ke bhāem̐

verses.sa:
उमा राम बिषइक अस मोहा ।
नभ तम धूम धूरि जिमि सोहा ॥
verses.tr:
umā rām biṣaik as mohā
nabh tam dhūm dhūri jimi sohā

verses.sa:
बिषय करन सुर जीव समेता ।
सकल एक तें एक सचेता ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaya karan sur jīv sametā
sakal ek teṃ ek sacetā

verses.sa:
सब कर परम प्रकासक जोई ।
राम अनादि अवधपति सोई ॥
verses.tr:
sab kar param prakāsak joī
rām anādi avadhapati soī

verses.sa:
जगत प्रकास्य प्रकासक रामू ।
मायाधीस ग्यान गुन धामू ॥
verses.tr:
jagat prakāsya prakāsak rāmū
māyādhīs gyān gun dhāmū

verses.sa:
जासु सत्यता तें जड माया ।
भास सत्य इव मोह सहाया ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu satyatā teṃ jaḍ māyā
bhās satya iv moh sahāyā

verses.sa:
रजत सीप महुँ मास जिमि जथा भानु कर बारि ।
जदपि मृषा तिहुँ काल सोइ भ्रम न सकइ कोउ टारि ॥
verses.tr:
rajat sīp mahum̐ mās jimi jathā bhānu kar bāri
jadapi mṛṣā tihum̐ kāl soi bhram na sakai kou ṭāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Fools do not perceive their own error, but senselessly attribute delusion to the lord; like simple folk, who, seeing a clouded sky, say that the sun itself is dim, or who gaze at the moon through their fingers and fancy they see it doubled. O Uma, delusion affects Rama in the same way as smoke, or a cloud, or dust affects the brightness of the heavens. The five objects of sense, the organs of sense, the gods of sense, as well as the soul, are all in their degree possessed of intelligence; but the great enlightener of - them all is the eternal Rama, the lord of Avadh. Whatever | in the world is susceptible of enlightenment. Rama enlightens; every delusion is subject to him: in him centre all knowledge and virtue; and by his truth the dulness of material creation shines bright as the Ideal, the senses contributing to the deception.
Though false as the gleam of a polished shell, or as a mirage caused by the sun’s rays, yet no one, at any time, past, present or future, can rid himself of the delusion.

sections.label: Doha 118
sections.name: जेहि इमि गावहि बेद बुध जाहि धरहिं मुनि ध्यान

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि जग हरि आश्रित रहई ।
जदपि असत्य देत दुख अहई ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi jag hari āśrit rahaī
jadapi asatya det dukh ahaī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौं सपनें सिर काटै कोई ।
बिनु जागें न दूरि दुख होई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ sapaneṃ sir kāṭai koī
binu jāgeṃ na dūri dukh hoī

verses.sa:
जासु कृपाँ अस भ्रम मिटि जाई ।
गिरिजा सोइ कृपाल रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu kṛpām̐ as bhram miṭi jāī
girijā soi kṛpāl raghurāī

verses.sa:
आदि अंत कोउ जासु न पावा ।
मति अनुमानि निगम अस गावा ॥
verses.tr:
ādi aṃt kou jāsu na pāvā
mati anumāni nigam as gāvā

verses.sa:
बिनु पद चलइ सुनइ बिनु काना ।
कर बिनु करम करइ बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
binu pad calai sunai binu kānā
kar binu karam karai bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
आनन रहित सकल रस भोगी ।
बिनु बानी बकता बड़ जोगी ॥
verses.tr:
ānan rahit sakal ras bhogī
binu bānī bakatā bar̤ jogī

verses.sa:
तनु बिनु परस नयन बिनु देखा ।
ग्रहइ घ्रान बिनु बास असेषा ॥
verses.tr:
tanu binu paras nayan binu dekhā
grahai ghrān binu bās aseṣā

verses.sa:
असि सब भाँति अलौकिक करनी ।
महिमा जासु जाइ नहिं बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
asi sab bhām̐ti alaukik karanī
mahimā jāsu jāi nahiṃ baranī

verses.sa: जेहि इमि गावहि बेद बुध जाहि धरहिं मुनि ध्यान ॥
verses.tr: jehi imi gāvahi bed budh jāhi dharahiṃ muni dhyān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सोइ दसरथ सुत भगत हित कोसलपति भगवान ॥
verses.tr: soi dasarath sut bhagat hit kosalapati bhagavān

trans: And such is the world in its connection with Hari: yet though unreal it can cause pain; in the same way as a man who dreams that his head is cut off, is in pain till he awakes, None can declare his beginning or his end, though holy scripture has hymned him as best it could. He moves without feet', he hears without ears, and works in manifold ways, yet without hands. Without a mouth he enjoys all tastes, and without a voice is the aptest of speakers; he can see without eyes, touch without limbs, and without a nose catch every scent. His actions are thus in every way supernatural, and his greatness is utterly beyond description.
He whom Scripture and Philosophy have thus sung, and whom the saints love to contemplate; even the Lord God; he is the son of Dasarath, the beneficent King of Kosala.

sections.label: Doha 119
sections.name: पुनि पुनि प्रभु पद कमल गहि जोरि पंकरुह पानि

verses.sa:
कासीं मरत जंतु अवलोकी ।
जासु नाम बल करउँ बिसोकी ॥
verses.tr:
kāsīṃ marat jaṃtu avalokī
jāsu nām bal karaum̐ bisokī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोइ प्रभु मोर चराचर स्वामी ।
रघुबर सब उर अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
soi prabhu mor carācar svāmī
raghubar sab ur aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
बिबसहुँ जासु नाम नर कहहीं ।
जनम अनेक रचित अघ दहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bibasahum̐ jāsu nām nar kahahīṃ
janam anek racit agh dahahīṃ

verses.sa:
सादर सुमिरन जे नर करहीं ।
भव बारिधि गोपद इव तरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sādar sumiran je nar karahīṃ
bhav bāridhi gopad iv tarahīṃ

verses.sa:
राम सो परमातमा भवानी ।
तहँ भ्रम अति अबिहित तव बानी ॥
verses.tr:
rām so paramātamā bhavānī
taham̐ bhram ati abihit tav bānī

verses.sa:
अस संसय आनत उर माहीं ।
ग्यान बिराग सकल गुन जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
as saṃsaya ānat ur māhīṃ
gyān birāg sakal gun jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि सिव के भ्रम भंजन बचना ।
मिटि गै सब कुतरक कै रचना ॥
verses.tr:
suni siv ke bhram bhaṃjan bacanā
miṭi gai sab kutarak kai racanā

verses.sa:
भइ रघुपति पद प्रीति प्रतीती ।
दारुन असंभावना बीती ॥
verses.tr:
bhai raghupati pad prīti pratītī
dārun asaṃbhāvanā bītī

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि प्रभु पद कमल गहि जोरि पंकरुह पानि ।
बोली गिरिजा बचन बर मनहुँ प्रेम रस सानि ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni prabhu pad kamal gahi jori paṃkaruh pāni
bolī girijā bacan bar manahum̐ prem ras sāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By the power of his name I exalt to the regions of the blest any creature whom I see dying at Kasi; he is the sovereign of all creation, animate and inanimate, my lord Raghubar, who reads all hearts. By repeating his name the most abandoned of sinners cancels the accumulated crimes of many previous existences;and by those who devoutly meditate upon him the ocean of life is as easily crossed as a puddle in the road. Rama, O Bhavani, is the Supreme Spirit, and the error to which you gave utterance on this point was most improper. Such doubt, when entertained in the heart, destroys knowledge, sobriety and every virtue.” On hearing Siva’s luminous exposition, the whole stracture of heresy fell to pieces; her love and devotion to Raghupati grew strong, and her sore incredulity passed away.:;
Again and again, clasping her lord’s lotus feet and suppliantly folding her hands, her whole soul overflowing with affection, Girija thus spoke and said,—

sections.label: Doha 120
sections.name: हिंयँ हरषे कामारि तब संकर सहज सुजान

verses.sa:
ससि कर सम सुनि गिरा तुम्हारी ।
मिटा मोह सरदातप भारी ॥
verses.tr:
sasi kar sam suni girā tumhārī
miṭā moh saradātap bhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तुम्ह कृपाल सबु संसउ हरेऊ ।
राम स्वरुप जानि मोहि परेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tumh kṛpāl sabu saṃsau hareū
rām svarup jāni mohi pareū

verses.sa:
नाथ कृपाँ अब गयउ बिषादा ।
सुखी भयउँ प्रभु चरन प्रसादा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth kṛpām̐ ab gayau biṣādā
sukhī bhayaum̐ prabhu caran prasādā

verses.sa:
अब मोहि आपनि किंकरि जानी ।
जदपि सहज जड नारि अयानी ॥
verses.tr:
ab mohi āpani kiṃkari jānī
jadapi sahaj jaḍ nāri ayānī

verses.sa:
प्रथम जो मैं पूछा सोइ कहहू ।
जौं मो पर प्रसन्न प्रभु अहहू ॥
verses.tr:
pratham jo maiṃ pūchā soi kahahū
jauṃ mo par prasann prabhu ahahū

verses.sa:
राम ब्रह्म चिनमय अबिनासी ।
सर्ब रहित सब उर पुर बासी ॥
verses.tr:
rām brahm cinamaya abināsī
sarb rahit sab ur pur bāsī

verses.sa:
नाथ धरेउ नरतनु केहि हेतू ।
मोहि समुझाइ कहहु बृषकेतू ॥
verses.tr:
nāth dhareu naratanu kehi hetū
mohi samujhāi kahahu bṛṣaketū

verses.sa:
उमा बचन सुनि परम बिनीता ।
रामकथा पर प्रीति पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
umā bacan suni param binītā
rāmakathā par prīti punītā

verses.sa:
हिंयँ हरषे कामारि तब संकर सहज सुजान ।
बहु बिधि उमहि प्रसंसि पुनि बोले कृपानिधान ॥
verses.tr:
hiṃyam̐ haraṣe kāmāri tab saṃkar sahaj sujān
bahu bidhi umahi prasaṃsi puni bole kṛpānidhān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सुनु सुभ कथा भवानि रामचरितमानस बिमल ।
कहा भुसुंडि बखानि सुना बिहग नायक गरुड ॥
verses.tr:
sunu subh kathā bhavāni rāmacaritamānas bimal
kahā bhusuṃḍi bakhāni sunā bihag nāyak garuḍ

verses.sa:
सो संबाद उदार जेहि बिधि भा आगें कहब ।
सुनहु राम अवतार चरित परम सुंदर अनघ ॥
verses.tr:
so saṃbād udār jehi bidhi bhā āgeṃ kahab
sunahu rām avatār carit param suṃdar anagh

verses.sa:
हरि गुन नाम अपार कथा रूप अगनित अमित ।
मैं निज मति अनुसार कहउँ उमा सादर सुनहु ॥
verses.tr:
hari gun nām apār kathā rūp aganit amit
maiṃ nij mati anusār kahaum̐ umā sādar sunahu

trans: ‘“My grievous delusion, like the feverish heat of autumn, has yielded to the moon-like spell of your voice. In your compassion you have removed all my doubt, and I now understand the very Rama. By my lord’s mercy my distress is all gone, and I am made glad by his favour. Now regarding me as your own immediate servant, though I am but a poor ignorant woman, if I have really found grace in your sight, reply to those my former questions. If Rama is the invisible and immortal God, without parts and passions, and whose temple is the heart, why did he take the form of a man? Declare and explain this to me.” On hearing Uma’s modest speech, and perceiving her sincere desire to be instructed in Rama’s history,
The all-wise Sankara, the destroyer of Kaemadeva, was glad of heart, and with many words of praise was thus pleased to speak,—

‘Listen, Bhavani, while I recite in auspicious strains the 24m-charit-manas, or pure lake of Rama’s deeds, as of old Bhusundi declared it in the hearing of Garur, the king of the birds. First I will relate the manner of their exalted converse, after which you shall hear of Rama’s incarnation and his all-glorious and sinless deeds. Hari’s virtues and names are infinite, and his history and his manifestation beyond number or measure; I tell] them as best I cun; listen, Uma with respect.

sections.label: Doha 121
sections.name: असुर मारि थापहिं सुरन्ह राखहिं निज श्रुति सेतु

verses.sa:
सुनु गिरिजा हरिचरित सुहाए ।
बिपुल बिसद निगमागम गाए ॥
verses.tr:
sunu girijā haricarit suhāe
bipul bisad nigamāgam gāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हरि अवतार हेतु जेहि होई ।
इदमित्थं कहि जाइ न सोई ॥
verses.tr:
hari avatār hetu jehi hoī
idamitthaṃ kahi jāi na soī

verses.sa:
राम अर्तक्य बुद्धि मन बानी ।
मत हमार अस सुनहि सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
rām artakya buddhi man bānī
mat hamār as sunahi sayānī

verses.sa:
तदपि संत मुनि बेद पुराना ।
जस कछु कहहिं स्वमति अनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi saṃt muni bed purānā
jas kachu kahahiṃ svamati anumānā

verses.sa:
तस मैं सुमुखि सुनावउँ तोही ।
समुझि परइ जस कारन मोही ॥
verses.tr:
tas maiṃ sumukhi sunāvaum̐ tohī
samujhi parai jas kāran mohī

verses.sa:
जब जब होइ धरम कै हानी ।
बाढहिं असुर अधम अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
jab jab hoi dharam kai hānī
bāḍhahiṃ asur adham abhimānī

verses.sa:
करहिं अनीति जाइ नहिं बरनी ।
सीदहिं बिप्र धेनु सुर धरनी ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ anīti jāi nahiṃ baranī
sīdahiṃ bipr dhenu sur dharanī

verses.sa:
तब तब प्रभु धरि बिबिध सरीरा ।
हरहि कृपानिधि सज्जन पीरा ॥
verses.tr:
tab tab prabhu dhari bibidh sarīrā
harahi kṛpānidhi sajjan pīrā

verses.sa:
असुर मारि थापहिं सुरन्ह राखहिं निज श्रुति सेतु ।
जग बिस्तारहिं बिसद जस राम जन्म कर हेतु ॥
verses.tr:
asur māri thāpahiṃ suranh rākhahiṃ nij śruti setu
jag bistārahiṃ bisad jas rām janm kar hetu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Listen, Girija, to the grateful tale of Hari's great and holy acts, ag they have been recorded in the scriptures. The cause of Hari’s incarnation is not to be dogmatically defined; for tomy mind, Bhavani, Rama is beyond the grasp of intellect, or soul, or speech; yet, as saints and sages, the Veda and the Puranas have partly and to the extent of their.capacity explained the matter, so I, fair dame, will now declare to you the cause as I understand it. Whenever virtue decays, and evil spirits, waxing strong in pride, work iniquity that cannot be told, to the confusion of Brahmans, cows, gods and earth-itself, the compassionate Lord assumes some new bodily form; relieves the distress of the faithful;
Destroys the evil spirits; reinstates the gods; maintains the way of salvation; and diffuses the brightness of his glory throughout the world. Such are the motives of Rama’s incarnations.

sections.label: Doha 122
sections.name: भए निसाचर जाइ तेइ महाबीर बलवान

verses.sa:
सोइ जस गाइ भगत भव तरहीं ।
कृपासिंधु जन हित तनु धरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
soi jas gāi bhagat bhav tarahīṃ
kṛpāsiṃdhu jan hit tanu dharahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम जनम के हेतु अनेका ।
परम बिचित्र एक तें एका ॥
verses.tr:
rām janam ke hetu anekā
param bicitr ek teṃ ekā

verses.sa:
जनम एक दुइ कहउँ बखानी ।
सावधान सुनु सुमति भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
janam ek dui kahaum̐ bakhānī
sāvadhān sunu sumati bhavānī

verses.sa:
द्वारपाल हरि के प्रिय दोऊ ।
जय अरु बिजय जान सब कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
dvārapāl hari ke priya doū
jaya aru bijaya jān sab koū

verses.sa:
बिप्र श्राप तें दूनउ भाई ।
तामस असुर देह तिन्ह पाई ॥
verses.tr:
bipr śrāp teṃ dūnau bhāī
tāmas asur deh tinh pāī

verses.sa:
कनककसिपु अरु हाटक लोचन ।
जगत बिदित सुरपति मद मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
kanakakasipu aru hāṭak locan
jagat bidit surapati mad mocan

verses.sa:
बिजई समर बीर बिख्याता ।
धरि बराह बपु एक निपाता ॥
verses.tr:
bijaī samar bīr bikhyātā
dhari barāh bapu ek nipātā

verses.sa:
होइ नरहरि दूसर पुनि मारा ।
जन प्रहलाद सुजस बिस्तारा ॥
verses.tr:
hoi narahari dūsar puni mārā
jan prahalād sujas bistārā

verses.sa:
भए निसाचर जाइ तेइ महाबीर बलवान ।
कुंभकरन रावण सुभट सुर बिजई जग जान ॥
verses.tr:
bhae nisācar jāi tei mahābīr balavān
kuṃbhakaran rāvaṇ subhaṭ sur bijaī jag jān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Singing his glory, the saints escape the waves of life, and it ie for their sake only that the Compassionate assumes a body, The causes of Rama’s incarnations have been many and various, each more wonderful than the other. I will relate one or two of his previous births, if, Bhavani, you are prepared to give me your devout attention. Hari had once two loving door-keepers, the famous Jaya and Bijaya: both brothers, in consequence of a Brahman’s curse, were born again in the form of the malignant demons Hiranya-kasipu and Hiranydeksha, who became celebrated throughout the world as the tamers of the pride of the king of heaven. Incarnate as a Boar, he triumphed in battle over the first illustrious hero and destroyed him, and again, in the Narsinh avatar, slew the second; the fame of the faithful Prahlad is widespread.
Then the evil spirits went and took birth as the bold and powerful warriors Kumbha-karn and Ravan, who, as all] the world knows, subdued even the gods.

sections.label: Doha 123
sections.name: छल करि टारेउ तासु ब्रत प्रभु सुर कारज कीन्ह

verses.sa:
मुकुत न भए हते भगवाना ।
तीनि जनम द्विज बचन प्रवाना ॥
verses.tr:
mukut na bhae hate bhagavānā
tīni janam dvij bacan pravānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एक बार तिन्ह के हित लागी ।
धरेउ सरीर भगत अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār tinh ke hit lāgī
dhareu sarīr bhagat anurāgī

verses.sa:
कस्यप अदिति तहाँ पितु माता ।
