दसरथ कौसल्या बिख्याता ॥
verses.tr:
kasyap aditi tahām̐ pitu mātā
dasarath kausalyā bikhyātā

verses.sa:
एक कलप एहि बिधि अवतारा ।
चरित्र पवित्र किए संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
ek kalap ehi bidhi avatārā
caritr pavitr kie saṃsārā

verses.sa:
एक कलप सुर देखि दुखारे ।
समर जलंधर सन सब हारे ॥
verses.tr:
ek kalap sur dekhi dukhāre
samar jalaṃdhar san sab hāre

verses.sa:
संभु कीन्ह संग्राम अपारा ।
दनुज महाबल मरइ न मारा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu kīnh saṃgrām apārā
danuj mahābal marai na mārā

verses.sa:
परम सती असुराधिप नारी ।
तेहि बल ताहि न जितहिं पुरारी ॥
verses.tr:
param satī asurādhip nārī
tehi bal tāhi na jitahiṃ purārī

verses.sa: छल करि टारेउ तासु ब्रत प्रभु सुर कारज कीन्ह ॥
verses.tr: chal kari ṭāreu tāsu brat prabhu sur kāraj kīnh
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: जब तेहि जानेउ मरम तब श्राप कोप करि दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr: jab tehi jāneu maram tab śrāp kop kari dīnh

trans: Though killed by the deity, they did not attain to salvation, for the Brahman had doomed them to three births. They then were once the cause why the cherisher of the faithful assumed a body, and at that time his parents Kasyapa and Aditi were incarnate as Dasarath and Kausalya of glorious memory. Thus it was that io that age of the world he descended from heaven and wrought saving deeds on earth. In another age, seeing the gods distrest and waging ineffectual battle with Jalandhar, Sambhu warred against him times without number, but could not subdue the valiant giant, for the exceeding virtue of his wife protected him against Purdri’s every attack.
By a stratagem the Lord broke her vow and effected the will of the gods, When she discovered the deception, then in her wrath she cursed him.

sections.label: Doha 124
sections.name: बोले बिहसि महेस तब ग्यानी मूढ़ न कोइ

verses.sa:
तासु श्राप हरि दीन्ह प्रमाना ।
कौतुकनिधि कृपाल भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu śrāp hari dīnh pramānā
kautukanidhi kṛpāl bhagavānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तहाँ जलंधर रावन भयऊ ।
रन हति राम परम पद दयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tahām̐ jalaṃdhar rāvan bhayaū
ran hati rām param pad dayaū

verses.sa:
एक जनम कर कारन एहा ।
जेहि लागि राम धरी नरदेहा ॥
verses.tr:
ek janam kar kāran ehā
jehi lāgi rām dharī naradehā

verses.sa:
प्रति अवतार कथा प्रभु केरी ।
सुनु मुनि बरनी कबिन्ह घनेरी ॥
verses.tr:
prati avatār kathā prabhu kerī
sunu muni baranī kabinh ghanerī

verses.sa:
नारद श्राप दीन्ह एक बारा ।
कलप एक तेहि लगि अवतारा ॥
verses.tr:
nārad śrāp dīnh ek bārā
kalap ek tehi lagi avatārā

verses.sa:
गिरिजा चकित भई सुनि बानी ।
नारद बिष्नुभगत पुनि ग्यानि ॥
verses.tr:
girijā cakit bhaī suni bānī
nārad biṣnubhagat puni gyāni

verses.sa:
कारन कवन श्राप मुनि दीन्हा ।
का अपराध रमापति कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
kāran kavan śrāp muni dīnhā
kā aparādh ramāpati kīnhā

verses.sa:
यह प्रसंग मोहि कहहु पुरारी ।
मुनि मन मोह आचरज भारी ॥
verses.tr:
yah prasaṃg mohi kahahu purārī
muni man moh ācaraj bhārī

verses.sa:
बोले बिहसि महेस तब ग्यानी मूढ़ न कोइ ।
जेहि जस रघुपति करहिं जब सो तस तेहि छन होइ ॥
verses.tr:
bole bihasi mahes tab gyānī mūr̤h na koi
jehi jas raghupati karahiṃ jab so tas tehi chan hoi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कहउँ राम गुन गाथ भरद्वाज सादर सुनहु ।
भव भंजन रघुनाथ भजु तुलसी तजि मान मद ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ rām gun gāth bharadvāj sādar sunahu
bhav bhaṃjan raghunāth bhaju tulasī taji mān mad

trans: And Hari did according to her curse; for though the Lord God, he is full of playfulness and of mercy. So Jalandhar was born as Ravan, and being killed in battle by Rama attained to high glory. This then was the cause of one birth and the reason why Hama thenassumed a human form. Each avater has its legend, which the poets have sung in various ways and according to tradition. ‘On one occasion it was Narad’s curse thatcaused him to become incarnate.” At this saying Girije was astounded, —‘Narad is a wise saint and a votary of Vishnu’s: what was his reason for uttering a curse? What offence had Lakshmi’s lord committed Tell me the whole story, Purdri; it is passing strange that a saint should be subject to passion.”
Then answered Mahadeva with a smile,—‘ There is neither wise nor fool; man is ever such a3 Raghupati will have him to be.
I sing the glory of Rama; listen devoutly, O Bharadvaja; and do thou, O Tulsi, put away the intoxication of pride and worship Raghunath, the destroyer of death.

sections.label: Doha 125
sections.name: सुख हाड़ लै भाग सठ स्वान निरखि मृगराज

verses.sa:
हिमगिरि गुहा एक अति पावनि ।
बह समीप सुरसरी सुहावनि ॥
verses.tr:
himagiri guhā ek ati pāvani
bah samīp surasarī suhāvani
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आश्रम परम पुनीत सुहावा ।
देखि देवरिषि मन अति भावा ॥
verses.tr:
āśram param punīt suhāvā
dekhi devariṣi man ati bhāvā

verses.sa:
निरखि सैल सरि बिपिन बिभागा ।
भयउ रमापति पद अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi sail sari bipin bibhāgā
bhayau ramāpati pad anurāgā

verses.sa:
सुमिरत हरिहि श्राप गति बाधी ।
सहज बिमल मन लागि समाधी ॥
verses.tr:
sumirat harihi śrāp gati bādhī
sahaj bimal man lāgi samādhī

verses.sa:
मुनि गति देखि सुरेस डेराना ।
कामहि बोलि कीन्ह सनमाना ॥
verses.tr:
muni gati dekhi sures ḍerānā
kāmahi boli kīnh sanamānā

verses.sa:
सहित सहाय जाहु मम हेतू ।
चकेउ हरषि हियँ जलचरकेतू ॥
verses.tr:
sahit sahāya jāhu mam hetū
cakeu haraṣi hiyam̐ jalacaraketū

verses.sa:
सुनासीर मन महुँ असि त्रासा ।
चहत देवरिषि मम पुर बासा ॥
verses.tr:
sunāsīr man mahum̐ asi trāsā
cahat devariṣi mam pur bāsā

verses.sa:
जे कामी लोलुप जग माहीं ।
कुटिल काक इव सबहि डेराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je kāmī lolup jag māhīṃ
kuṭil kāk iv sabahi ḍerāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुख हाड़ लै भाग सठ स्वान निरखि मृगराज ।
छीनि लेइ जनि जान जड़ तिमि सुरपतिहि न लाज ॥
verses.tr:
sukh hār̤ lai bhāg saṭh svān nirakhi mṛgarāj
chīni lei jani jān jar̤ timi surapatihi na lāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In the Himalaya mountains isa very sacred cave close to the holy Ganges. Seeing this pure and delightful hermitage, the divine sage Narad was greatly pleased; and as he gazed upon the beauty of the rocks and the forest glades he was filled with love to God, and as he+ thought upon Hari the curse was broken and his spotless soul fell all at once into a trance. When the king of heaven saw the sage’s state he feared, and in terms of high respect addressed himself to Kamuadeva,— “Go, 1 beg, with your assistant.” He then, the god of love, went very gladly; but in Indra’s wind was great alarm, for he thought,-—‘ [The saint would rob me of my kingdom’ All the world over, a gallant or a miser is as much afraid of interference as is a thievish
Like a wretched dog that on seeing a lion runs away with the dry bone it has io its mouth, for fear it should be taken from him, so was Indra in his shamelessness.

sections.label: Doha 126
sections.name: सहित सहाय सभीत अति मानि हारि मन मैन

verses.sa:
तेहि आश्रमहिं मदन जब गयऊ ।
निज मायाँ बसंत निरमयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tehi āśramahiṃ madan jab gayaū
nij māyām̐ basaṃt niramayaū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कुसुमित बिबिध बिटप बहुरंगा ।
कूजहिं कोकिल गुंजहि भृंगा ॥
verses.tr:
kusumit bibidh biṭap bahuraṃgā
kūjahiṃ kokil guṃjahi bhṛṃgā

verses.sa:
चली सुहावनि त्रिबिध बयारी ।
काम कृसानु बढ़ावनिहारी ॥
verses.tr:
calī suhāvani tribidh bayārī
kām kṛsānu bar̤hāvanihārī

verses.sa:
रंभादिक सुरनारि नबीना ।
सकल असमसर कला प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
raṃbhādik suranāri nabīnā
sakal asamasar kalā prabīnā

verses.sa:
करहिं गान बहु तान तरंगा ।
बहुबिधि क्रीड़हि पानि पतंगा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ gān bahu tān taraṃgā
bahubidhi krīr̤ahi pāni pataṃgā

verses.sa:
देखि सहाय मदन हरषाना ।
कीन्हेसि पुनि प्रपंच बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi sahāya madan haraṣānā
kīnhesi puni prapaṃc bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
काम कला कछु मुनिहि न ब्यापी ।
निज भयँ डरेउ मनोभव पापी ॥
verses.tr:
kām kalā kachu munihi na byāpī
nij bhayam̐ ḍareu manobhav pāpī

verses.sa:
सीम कि चाँपि सकइ कोउ तासु ।
बड़ रखवार रमापति जासू ॥
verses.tr:
sīm ki cām̐pi sakai kou tāsu
bar̤ rakhavār ramāpati jāsū

verses.sa:
सहित सहाय सभीत अति मानि हारि मन मैन ।
गहेसि जाइ मुनि चरन तब कहि सुठि आरत बैन ॥
verses.tr:
sahit sahāya sabhīt ati māni hāri man main
gahesi jāi muni caran tab kahi suṭhi ārat bain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I The curse had been pronounced by Daksha,

When Love reached the hermitage, his deceptive power created to false spring. All the trees broke out into many-coloured blossoms, there was a murmuring of cuckoos and a humming of bees. A delightful air, soft, cool and fragrant, sprung up, fanning the flame of desire; while Rambha and the other heavenly nymphs, all well skilled in the art of love, began singing songs in every variety of measure and disporting themselves in the dance with waving hands. When Love saw himself so well supported, he was glad and again manifested his creative power in diverse ways; but his devices had no effect upon the saint; and guilty Love began to tremble for himself. Who dare trespass on his bounds who has the great Ramepati for a guardian?
In dire dismay both Kamadeva and his accomplice confessed themselves defeated, and went and clasped the holy man’s feet, addressing him in accents of the deepest humility.

sections.label: Doha 127
sections.name: संभु दीन्ह उपदेस हित नहिं नारदहि सोहान

verses.sa:
भयउ न नारद मन कछु रोषा ।
कहि प्रिय बचन काम परितोषा ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau na nārad man kachu roṣā
kahi priya bacan kām paritoṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाइ चरन सिरु आयसु पाई ।
गयउ मदन तब सहित सहाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāi caran siru āyasu pāī
gayau madan tab sahit sahāī

verses.sa:
मुनि सुसीलता आपनि करनी ।
सुरपति सभाँ जाइ सब बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
muni susīlatā āpani karanī
surapati sabhām̐ jāi sab baranī

verses.sa:
सुनि सब कें मन अचरजु आवा ।
मुनिहि प्रसंसि हरिहि सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
suni sab keṃ man acaraju āvā
munihi prasaṃsi harihi siru nāvā

verses.sa:
तब नारद गवने सिव पाहीं ।
जिता काम अहमिति मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tab nārad gavane siv pāhīṃ
jitā kām ahamiti man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
मार चरित संकरहिं सुनाए ।
अतिप्रिय जानि महेस सिखाए ॥
verses.tr:
mār carit saṃkarahiṃ sunāe
atipriya jāni mahes sikhāe

verses.sa:
बार बार बिनवउँ मुनि तोहीं ।
जिमि यह कथा सुनायहु मोहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār binavaum̐ muni tohīṃ
jimi yah kathā sunāyahu mohīṃ

verses.sa:
तिमि जनि हरिहि सुनावहु कबहूँ ।
चलेहुँ प्रसंग दुराएडु तबहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
timi jani harihi sunāvahu kabahūm̐
calehum̐ prasaṃg durāeḍu tabahūm̐

verses.sa:
संभु दीन्ह उपदेस हित नहिं नारदहि सोहान ।
भारद्वाज कौतुक सुनहु हरि इच्छा बलवान ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu dīnh upades hit nahiṃ nāradahi sohān
bhāradvāj kautuk sunahu hari icchā balavān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There was no anger io Narad's soul, who in friendly terms replied to KAmadeva and reassured him. Then, bowing the head at his feet and accepting his commands, they both retired, the god and his companion; and repairing to Indra’s court there related all their own doings and the saint’s clemency. As they listened to the late all were astonished, and bowing the head to Hari extolled the saint. Then went Narad to Siva, greatly proud of his victory over Love, and told him all Love’s doings. In acknowledgment of his affection Mahadeva gave him good advice,—‘ O great saint, again and again I beg of you never to repeat to Hari this story that you have now told me: should it happen to be brought forward, keep it as dark as possible.”
Good as the advice was, it did not please Narad. O Bharadvdja, listen to the strange recital and see the strength of Hari’s will.

sections.label: Doha 128
sections.name: रूख बदन करि बचन मृदु बोले श्रीभगवान

verses.sa:
राम कीन्ह चाहहिं सोइ होई ।
करै अन्यथा अस नहिं कोई ॥
verses.tr:
rām kīnh cāhahiṃ soi hoī
karai anyathā as nahiṃ koī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
संभु बचन मुनि मन नहिं भाए ।
तब बिरंचि के लोक सिधाए ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu bacan muni man nahiṃ bhāe
tab biraṃci ke lok sidhāe

verses.sa:
एक बार करतल बर बीना ।
गावत हरि गुन गान प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār karatal bar bīnā
gāvat hari gun gān prabīnā

verses.sa:
छीरसिंधु गवने मुनिनाथा ।
जहँ बस श्रीनिवास श्रुतिमाथा ॥
verses.tr:
chīrasiṃdhu gavane munināthā
jaham̐ bas śrīnivās śrutimāthā

verses.sa:
हरषि मिले उठि रमानिकेता ।
बैठे आसन रिषिहि समेता ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi mile uṭhi ramāniketā
baiṭhe āsan riṣihi sametā

verses.sa:
बोले बिहसि चराचर राया ।
बहुते दिनन कीन्हि मुनि दाया ॥
verses.tr:
bole bihasi carācar rāyā
bahute dinan kīnhi muni dāyā

verses.sa:
काम चरित नारद सब भाषे ।
जद्यपि प्रथम बरजि सिवँ राखे ॥
verses.tr:
kām carit nārad sab bhāṣe
jadyapi pratham baraji sivam̐ rākhe

verses.sa:
अति प्रचंड रघुपति कै माया ।
जेहि न मोह अस को जग जाया ॥
verses.tr:
ati pracaṃḍ raghupati kai māyā
jehi na moh as ko jag jāyā

verses.sa:
रूख बदन करि बचन मृदु बोले श्रीभगवान ।
तुम्हरे सुमिरन तें मिटहिं मोह मार मद मान ॥
verses.tr:
rūkh badan kari bacan mṛdu bole śrībhagavān
tumhare sumiran teṃ miṭahiṃ moh mār mad mān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: What Rama wills to have done is done, and there is no

one who can alter it. As Sambhu’s words did not please the saint, he went straight to Brahma’s court, and, to the accompaniment of the famous lute that he had in his hand, sang right through the excellent song of Hari’s praises. Then he passed on to the milky ocean, where abides Vishnu, the glory of revelation. The Lord ran to meet him in great joy, and side by side they sat together. Said the sovereign of the universe with a smile,—‘ Reverend sir, ’tis long since you last did me this honour.’ Then Narad declared all Love's doings, though Siva had beforehand cautioned him; the
. deceptive power of Raghupati is so strong that there is no man living who can resist it.
Then spoke the great god, with an austere look, but in flattering terms,—“ Self-delusion and the intoxicating arrogance of love shall perish at the remembrance of your doings!.

sections.label: Doha 129
sections.name: बिरचेउ मग महुँ नगर तेहिं सत जोजन बिस्तार

verses.sa:
सुनु मुनि मोह होइ मन ताकें ।
ग्यान बिराग हृदय नहिं जाके ॥
verses.tr:
sunu muni moh hoi man tākeṃ
gyān birāg hṛdaya nahiṃ jāke
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचरज ब्रत रत मतिधीरा ।
तुम्हहि कि करइ मनोभव पीरा ॥
verses.tr:
brahmacaraj brat rat matidhīrā
tumhahi ki karai manobhav pīrā

verses.sa:
नारद कहेउ सहित अभिमाना ।
कृपा तुम्हारि सकल भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
nārad kaheu sahit abhimānā
kṛpā tumhāri sakal bhagavānā

verses.sa:
करुनानिधि मन दीख बिचारी ।
उर अंकुरेउ गरब तरु भारी ॥
verses.tr:
karunānidhi man dīkh bicārī
ur aṃkureu garab taru bhārī

verses.sa:
बेगि सो मै डारिहउँ उखारी ।
पन हमार सेवक हितकारी ॥
verses.tr:
begi so mai ḍārihaum̐ ukhārī
pan hamār sevak hitakārī

verses.sa:
मुनि कर हित मम कौतुक होई ।
अवसि उपाय करबि मै सोई ॥
verses.tr:
muni kar hit mam kautuk hoī
avasi upāya karabi mai soī

verses.sa:
तब नारद हरि पद सिर नाई ।
चले हृदयँ अहमिति अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab nārad hari pad sir nāī
cale hṛdayam̐ ahamiti adhikāī

verses.sa:
श्रीपति निज माया तब प्रेरी ।
सुनहु कठिन करनी तेहि केरी ॥
verses.tr:
śrīpati nij māyā tab prerī
sunahu kaṭhin karanī tehi kerī

verses.sa:
बिरचेउ मग महुँ नगर तेहिं सत जोजन बिस्तार ।
श्रीनिवासपुर तें अधिक रचना बिबिध प्रकार ॥
verses.tr:
biraceu mag mahum̐ nagar tehiṃ sat jojan bistār
śrīnivāsapur teṃ adhik racanā bibidh prakār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Know, O saint, that infatuation prevails in a soul that is devoid of wisdom and self-control; but what pain can Love cause to one so steadfastin asceticism as yourself?” Said Narad in his pride,—* It is all your favour, my Lord.’ The Compassionate saw into his heart and thought within himself, —‘Pride like a huge tree has sprouted in hissoul: IL must at once tear it up by the roots; ever to relieve my servants is the vow that I have made. I will surely contrive some sportive device on behalf of the saint.” Then Narad bowed his head at Hari’s feet and took his leave, swelling with pride; while Vishnu gave orders to the spirit of delusion. Listen now tohis strange contrivance.
He constructed on the road a city a hundred leagues in

sections.label: Doha 130
sections.name: आनि देखाई नारदहि भूपति राजकुमारि

verses.sa:
बसहिं नगर सुंदर नर नारी ।
जनु बहु मनसिज रति तनुधारी ॥
verses.tr:
basahiṃ nagar suṃdar nar nārī
janu bahu manasij rati tanudhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहिं पुर बसइ सीलनिधि राजा ।
अगनित हय गय सेन समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ pur basai sīlanidhi rājā
aganit haya gaya sen samājā

verses.sa:
सत सुरेस सम बिभव बिलासा ।
रूप तेज बल नीति निवासा ॥
verses.tr:
sat sures sam bibhav bilāsā
rūp tej bal nīti nivāsā

verses.sa:
बिस्वमोहनी तासु कुमारी ।
श्री बिमोह जिसु रूपु निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
bisvamohanī tāsu kumārī
śrī bimoh jisu rūpu nihārī

verses.sa:
सोइ हरिमाया सब गुन खानी ।
सोभा तासु कि जाइ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
soi harimāyā sab gun khānī
sobhā tāsu ki jāi bakhānī

verses.sa:
करइ स्वयंबर सो नृपबाला ।
आए तहँ अगनित महिपाला ॥
verses.tr:
karai svayaṃbar so nṛpabālā
āe taham̐ aganit mahipālā

verses.sa:
मुनि कौतुकी नगर तेहिं गयऊ ।
पुरबासिन्ह सब पूछत भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
muni kautukī nagar tehiṃ gayaū
purabāsinh sab pūchat bhayaū

verses.sa:
सुनि सब चरित भूपगृहँ आए ।
करि पूजा नृप मुनि बैठाए ॥
verses.tr:
suni sab carit bhūpagṛham̐ āe
kari pūjā nṛp muni baiṭhāe

verses.sa:
आनि देखाई नारदहि भूपति राजकुमारि ।
कहहु नाथ गुन दोष सब एहि के हृदयँ बिचारि ॥
verses.tr:
āni dekhāī nāradahi bhūpati rājakumāri
kahahu nāth gun doṣ sab ehi ke hṛdayam̐ bicāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: circumference, with everything more perfect than even in Vishnu’s own capital,
And inhabited by such graceful men and women that you would take them all to be incarnations of Kaemadeva and
hate is: By meditating on your triumph over Love, other men will triumpl

Rati. The king of the city, by name Sila-nidhi, had horses, elephants and troops beyond number; his royal pomp like that of a hundred Indra; himself a centre of power, policy and magnificence. His daughter Visva-mohani was so beautiful that even Lakshmi would be put to the blush and by Hari’s delusive power was in every way so exquisite that no words could describe her, As the princess was selecting a husband, kings beyond number came as suitors. The saint, too, came to the fairy city and began making inquiries. of the people. When he had heard all that was going on, he proceeded to the palace, where the king most respectfully gave him a seat, Dohd 137.

sections.label: Doha 131
sections.name: एहि अवसर चाहिअ परम सोभा रूप बिसाल

verses.sa:
देखि रूप मुनि बिरति बिसारी ।
बड़ी बार लगि रहे निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rūp muni birati bisārī
bar̤ī bār lagi rahe nihārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लच्छन तासु बिलोकि भुलाने ।
हृदयँ हरष नहिं प्रगट बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
lacchan tāsu biloki bhulāne
hṛdayam̐ haraṣ nahiṃ pragaṭ bakhāne

verses.sa:
जो एहि बरइ अमर सोइ होई ।
समरभूमि तेहि जीत न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
jo ehi barai amar soi hoī
samarabhūmi tehi jīt na koī

verses.sa:
सेवहिं सकल चराचर ताही ।
बरइ सीलनिधि कन्या जाही ॥
verses.tr:
sevahiṃ sakal carācar tāhī
barai sīlanidhi kanyā jāhī

verses.sa:
लच्छन सब बिचारि उर राखे ।
कछुक बनाइ भूप सन भाषे ॥
verses.tr:
lacchan sab bicāri ur rākhe
kachuk banāi bhūp san bhāṣe

verses.sa:
सुता सुलच्छन कहि नृप पाहीं ।
नारद चले सोच मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sutā sulacchan kahi nṛp pāhīṃ
nārad cale soc man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
करौं जाइ सोइ जतन बिचारी ।
जेहि प्रकार मोहि बरै कुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
karauṃ jāi soi jatan bicārī
jehi prakār mohi barai kumārī

verses.sa:
जप तप कछु न होइ तेहि काला ।
हे बिधि मिलइ कवन बिधि बाला ॥
verses.tr:
jap tap kachu na hoi tehi kālā
he bidhi milai kavan bidhi bālā

verses.sa:
एहि अवसर चाहिअ परम सोभा रूप बिसाल ।
जो बिलोकि रीझै कुअँरि तब मेलै जयमाल ॥
verses.tr:
ehi avasar cāhia param sobhā rūp bisāl
jo biloki rījhai kuam̐ri tab melai jayamāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: And then brought his daughter for him to see, saying,— ‘Tell me, good sir, after consideration, all that is good or bad aboat her.’ Chaupdi 131.

When Narad saw her beauty, he forgot his vow of chastity and continued long gazing upon her. Her features quite fascinated him; yet he would not in words express his heart's delight. ‘Her bridegroom must be one of the immortals, invincible in battle, reverenced by all creation; such a one must Sila-nidhi’s daughter wed.” But, though he calculated her fortune thus correctly, he kept it to himself, and after saying something or other to the king, to the effect that his daughter would be of good fortune, he went away full of anxiety, considering,—‘What scheme can I devise now, so as to make her marry me? No time is this for prayers or penance; good God, how am I to get the girl? Dohe 138.

sections.label: Doha 132
sections.name: जेहि बिधि होइहि परम हित नारद सुनहु तुम्हार

verses.sa:
हरि सन मागौं सुंदरताई ।
होइहि जात गहरु अति भाई ॥
verses.tr:
hari san māgauṃ suṃdaratāī
hoihi jāt gaharu ati bhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोरें हित हरि सम नहिं कोऊ ।
एहि अवसर सहाय सोइ होऊ ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ hit hari sam nahiṃ koū
ehi avasar sahāya soi hoū

verses.sa:
बहुबिधि बिनय कीन्हि तेहि काला ।
प्रगटेउ प्रभु कौतुकी कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
bahubidhi binaya kīnhi tehi kālā
pragaṭeu prabhu kautukī kṛpālā

verses.sa:
प्रभु बिलोकि मुनि नयन जुड़ाने ।
होइहि काजु हिएँ हरषाने ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu biloki muni nayan jur̤āne
hoihi kāju hiem̐ haraṣāne

verses.sa:
अति आरति कहि कथा सुनाई ।
करहु कृपा करि होहु सहाई ॥
verses.tr:
ati ārati kahi kathā sunāī
karahu kṛpā kari hohu sahāī

verses.sa:
आपन रूप देहु प्रभु मोही ।
आन भाँति नहिं पावौं ओही ॥
verses.tr:
āpan rūp dehu prabhu mohī
ān bhām̐ti nahiṃ pāvauṃ ohī

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि नाथ होइ हित मोरा ।
करहु सो बेगि दास मैं तोरा ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi nāth hoi hit morā
karahu so begi dās maiṃ torā

verses.sa:
निज माया बल देखि बिसाला ।
हियँ हँसि बोले दीनदयाला ॥
verses.tr:
nij māyā bal dekhi bisālā
hiyam̐ ham̐si bole dīnadayālā

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि होइहि परम हित नारद सुनहु तुम्हार ।
सोइ हम करब न आन कछु बचन न मृषा हमार ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi hoihi param hit nārad sunahu tumhār
soi ham karab na ān kachu bacan na mṛṣā hamār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I must on this occasion make myself exceedingly charming and beautiful, so that the princess may be pleased when she sees me and give me the wreath of victory.

I will ask Hari for the gift of beauty; in going to him there will be much delay; but I have no other such friend, and thisis an opportunity for him to help me.” So he offered up a fervent prayer and the merciful Lord appeared to him in a vision. ‘The saint’s eyes brightened at the sight and he rejoiced in heart, saying,‘ My object will be accomplished.’ He then with the utmost humility told his tale, and added,—'‘O, my Lord, be gracious and assist me. Bestow on me beauty equal to your own; for in no other way can I get possession of her. Make haste to accomplish my success; for lo, I am your slave.” When the Compassionate saw the mighty influence of the deception he had wrought, be smiled to himself::
“Hear, O Narad; I will assuredly bring about your highest good—that and naught else; nor shall my words prove vain.

sections.label: Doha 133
sections.name: रहे तहाँ दुइ रुद्र गन ते जानहिं सब भेउ

verses.sa:
कुपथ माग रुज ब्याकुल रोगी ।
बैद न देइ सुनहु मुनि जोगी ॥
verses.tr:
kupath māg ruj byākul rogī
baid na dei sunahu muni jogī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि हित तुम्हार मैं ठयऊ ।
कहि अस अंतरहित प्रभु भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi hit tumhār maiṃ ṭhayaū
kahi as aṃtarahit prabhu bhayaū

verses.sa:
माया बिबस भए मुनि मूढ़ा ।
समुझी नहिं हरि गिरा निगूढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
māyā bibas bhae muni mūr̤hā
samujhī nahiṃ hari girā nigūr̤hā

verses.sa:
गवने तुरत तहाँ रिषिराई ।
जहाँ स्वयंबर भूमि बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
gavane turat tahām̐ riṣirāī
jahām̐ svayaṃbar bhūmi banāī

verses.sa:
निज निज आसन बैठे राजा ।
बहु बनाव करि सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij āsan baiṭhe rājā
bahu banāv kari sahit samājā

verses.sa:
मुनि मन हरष रूप अति मोरें ।
मोहि तजि आनहि बारिहि न भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
muni man haraṣ rūp ati moreṃ
mohi taji ānahi bārihi na bhoreṃ

verses.sa:
मुनि हित कारन कृपानिधाना ।
दीन्ह कुरूप न जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
muni hit kāran kṛpānidhānā
dīnh kurūp na jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
सो चरित्र लखि काहुँ न पावा ।
नारद जानि सबहिं सिर नावा ॥
verses.tr:
so caritr lakhi kāhum̐ na pāvā
nārad jāni sabahiṃ sir nāvā

verses.sa:
रहे तहाँ दुइ रुद्र गन ते जानहिं सब भेउ ।
बिप्रबेष देखत फिरहिं परम कौतुकी तेउ ॥
verses.tr:
rahe tahām̐ dui rudr gan te jānahiṃ sab bheu
biprabeṣ dekhat phirahiṃ param kautukī teu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If a sick man in the weariness of disease ask for what will harm, mark me, holy ascetic, the physician will not grantit. In the same way will I act as is best for you.” So saying the Lord vanished. The saint was so demented by the power of the delusion that he did not understand Hari’s hidden meaning, but hastened at once to the spot where the marriage arena had been prepared. The Re&jas were seated rank upon rank, each with his retinue in grand attire. The saint thought joyfully within himself,—‘ My beauty is such that she will never leave me to wed another.’ But the merciful God, the saint’s true friend, had made him hideous beyond all description. Every one recognized him as Narad and bowed the head, knowing nothing of what had taken place.;
Now there were there two of Siva’s attendants who knew the whole secret. Dressed like Brahmans, they seemed to be spectators of the show, walking here and there and looking about.

sections.label: Doha 134
sections.name: सखीं संग लै कुअँरि तब चलि जनु राजमराल

verses.sa:
जेंहि समाज बैंठे मुनि जाई ।
हृदयँ रूप अहमिति अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
jeṃhi samāj baiṃṭhe muni jāī
hṛdayam̐ rūp ahamiti adhikāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तहँ बैठ महेस गन दोऊ ।
बिप्रबेष गति लखइ न कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ baiṭh mahes gan doū
biprabeṣ gati lakhai na koū

verses.sa:
करहिं कूटि नारदहि सुनाई ।
नीकि दीन्हि हरि सुंदरताई ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ kūṭi nāradahi sunāī
nīki dīnhi hari suṃdaratāī

verses.sa:
रीझहि राजकुअँरि छबि देखी ।
इन्हहि बरिहि हरि जानि बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
rījhahi rājakuam̐ri chabi dekhī
inhahi barihi hari jāni biseṣī

verses.sa:
मुनिहि मोह मन हाथ पराएँ ।
हँसहिं संभु गन अति सचु पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
munihi moh man hāth parāem̐
ham̐sahiṃ saṃbhu gan ati sacu pāem̐

verses.sa:
जदपि सुनहिं मुनि अटपटि बानी ।
समुझि न परइ बुद्धि भ्रम सानी ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi sunahiṃ muni aṭapaṭi bānī
samujhi na parai buddhi bhram sānī

verses.sa:
काहुँ न लखा सो चरित बिसेषा ।
सो सरूप नृपकन्याँ देखा ॥
verses.tr:
kāhum̐ na lakhā so carit biseṣā
so sarūp nṛpakanyām̐ dekhā

verses.sa:
मर्कट बदन भयंकर देही ।
देखत हृदयँ क्रोध भा तेही ॥
verses.tr:
markaṭ badan bhayaṃkar dehī
dekhat hṛdayam̐ krodh bhā tehī

verses.sa:
सखीं संग लै कुअँरि तब चलि जनु राजमराल ।
देखत फिरइ महीप सब कर सरोज जयमाल ॥
verses.tr:
sakhīṃ saṃg lai kuam̐ri tab cali janu rājamarāl
dekhat phirai mahīp sab kar saroj jayamāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Both went and sat down in the same group with the saint so proud of his beauty;and in their Brahmanical attire they attracted no notice. They say in jest so that Ndrad might hear,—‘ Hari has given this man such excellent beauty that the princess will be charmed with his appearance and will certainly wed him, taking him for Hari himself,’ The saint was so utterly subjugated by passion that Sambhu’s servants could laugh and jeer as they liked, and though he heard their mockery, his intellect was too bewildered to understand it. No one perceived the transformation save only the princess, who, on beholding him just as he was with
his monkey face and deformed body, was quite disgusted at the sight,
And with her handmaids glided like a swan through

sections.label: Doha 135
sections.name: होहु निसाचर जाइ तुम्ह कपटी पापी दोउ

verses.sa:
जेहि दिसि बैठे नारद फूली ।
सो दिसि देहि न बिलोकी भूली ॥
verses.tr:
jehi disi baiṭhe nārad phūlī
so disi dehi na bilokī bhūlī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि मुनि उकसहिं अकुलाहीं ।
देखि दसा हर गन मुसकाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni muni ukasahiṃ akulāhīṃ
dekhi dasā har gan musakāhīṃ

verses.sa:
धरि नृपतनु तहँ गयउ कृपाला ।
कुअँरि हरषि मेलेउ जयमाला ॥
verses.tr:
dhari nṛpatanu taham̐ gayau kṛpālā
kuam̐ri haraṣi meleu jayamālā

verses.sa:
दुलहिनि लै गे लच्छिनिवासा ।
नृपसमाज सब भयउ निरासा ॥
verses.tr:
dulahini lai ge lacchinivāsā
nṛpasamāj sab bhayau nirāsā

verses.sa:
मुनि अति बिकल मोंहँ मति नाठी ।
मनि गिरि गई छूटि जनु गाँठी ॥
verses.tr:
muni ati bikal moṃham̐ mati nāṭhī
mani giri gaī chūṭi janu gām̐ṭhī

verses.sa:
तब हर गन बोले मुसुकाई ।
निज मुख मुकुर बिलोकहु जाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab har gan bole musukāī
nij mukh mukur bilokahu jāī

verses.sa:
अस कहि दोउ भागे भयँ भारी ।
बदन दीख मुनि बारि निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi dou bhāge bhayam̐ bhārī
badan dīkh muni bāri nihārī

verses.sa:
बेषु बिलोकि क्रोध अति बाढ़ा ।
तिन्हहि सराप दीन्ह अति गाढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
beṣu biloki krodh ati bār̤hā
tinhahi sarāp dīnh ati gār̤hā

verses.sa:
होहु निसाचर जाइ तुम्ह कपटी पापी दोउ ।
हँसेहु हमहि सो लेहु फल बहुरि हँसेहु मुनि कोउ ॥
verses.tr:
hohu nisācar jāi tumh kapaṭī pāpī dou
ham̐sehu hamahi so lehu phal bahuri ham̐sehu muni kou
verses.head: दोहा

trans: the long line of kings with the wreath of victory in her lotus hands.

She would not let her eyes rest for a moment on the spot where Narad was sitting in his pride. The saint in his anxiety kept fidgetting about, and Siva’s attendants smiled. to see the state he was in. Then entered the Compassionate, in form as a king, and gladly the princess cast on him the garland. Thus Lakshmi’s lord carried off the bride, to the despair of the assembled kings. The saint was much disturbed; in his infatuation his reason was quite gone, like adiamond dropt out of a hole in a bag. Then Siva’s attendants said with a smile,—‘ Get a glass and look at yourself’; and having so said both ran away in great alarm. The saint looked at his reflection in the water. When he saw himself, he was furious and cursed them with a grievous curse:

sections.label: Doha 136
sections.name: असुर सुरा बिष संकरहि आपु रमा मनि चारु

verses.sa:
पुनि जल दीख रूप निज पावा ।
तदपि हृदयँ संतोष न आवा ॥
verses.tr:
puni jal dīkh rūp nij pāvā
tadapi hṛdayam̐ saṃtoṣ na āvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फरकत अधर कोप मन माहीं ।
सपदी चले कमलापति पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pharakat adhar kop man māhīṃ
sapadī cale kamalāpati pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
देहउँ श्राप कि मरिहउँ जाई ।
जगत मोर उपहास कराई ॥
verses.tr:
dehaum̐ śrāp ki marihaum̐ jāī
jagat mor upahās karāī

verses.sa:
बीचहिं पंथ मिले दनुजारी ।
संग रमा सोइ राजकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
bīcahiṃ paṃth mile danujārī
saṃg ramā soi rājakumārī

verses.sa:
बोले मधुर बचन सुरसाईं ।
मुनि कहँ चले बिकल की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
bole madhur bacan surasāīṃ
muni kaham̐ cale bikal kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन उपजा अति क्रोधा ।
माया बस न रहा मन बोधा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan upajā ati krodhā
māyā bas na rahā man bodhā

verses.sa:
पर संपदा सकहु नहिं देखी ।
तुम्हरें इरिषा कपट बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
par saṃpadā sakahu nahiṃ dekhī
tumhareṃ iriṣā kapaṭ biseṣī

verses.sa:
मथत सिंधु रुद्रहि बौरायहु ।
सुरन्ह प्रेरी बिष पान करायहु ॥
verses.tr:
mathat siṃdhu rudrahi baurāyahu
suranh prerī biṣ pān karāyahu

verses.sa:
असुर सुरा बिष संकरहि आपु रमा मनि चारु ।
स्वारथ साधक कुटिल तुम्ह सदा कपट ब्यवहारु ॥
verses.tr:
asur surā biṣ saṃkarahi āpu ramā mani cāru
svārath sādhak kuṭil tumh sadā kapaṭ byavahāru
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Looking again in the water he saw himself in his proper form; yet stillhe was not content at heart, but his lip quivered with rage, and in haste he betook himself to Vishnu. ‘Shall Iourse him or kill myself, seeing that he has made a mock of me throughout the world?’ On the way the conqueror of demons met him, and with him RAma and the princess. With a smile and in gentle tones he said, —‘ Where goes the saint, like one distracted?’ On hearing these words, his anger rose, and infatuation utterly mastered his reason;—‘You never could bear to look upon another’s prosperity; yonr envy and deceit are notorious; at the churning of the ocean you drove Siva mad and made
the gods quaff the poisoned cup.
Intoxicating liqaor was the demon’s share, and the poison was for Mahadeva; but for yourself Rameand the Kaustubha jewel. You have ever been selfish and perverse and treacherous in your dealings.

sections.label: Doha 137
sections.name: श्राप सीस धरी हरषि हियँ प्रभु बहु बिनती कीन्हि

verses.sa:
परम स्वतंत्र न सिर पर कोई ।
भावइ मनहि करहु तुम्ह सोई ॥
verses.tr:
param svataṃtr na sir par koī
bhāvai manahi karahu tumh soī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भलेहि मंद मंदेहि भल करहू ।
बिसमय हरष न हियँ कछु धरहू ॥
verses.tr:
bhalehi maṃd maṃdehi bhal karahū
bisamaya haraṣ na hiyam̐ kachu dharahū

verses.sa:
डहकि डहकि परिचेहु सब काहू ।
अति असंक मन सदा उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
ḍahaki ḍahaki paricehu sab kāhū
ati asaṃk man sadā uchāhū

verses.sa:
करम सुभासुभ तुम्हहि न बाधा ।
अब लगि तुम्हहि न काहूँ साधा ॥
verses.tr:
karam subhāsubh tumhahi na bādhā
ab lagi tumhahi na kāhūm̐ sādhā

verses.sa:
भले भवन अब बायन दीन्हा ।
पावहुगे फल आपन कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
bhale bhavan ab bāyan dīnhā
pāvahuge phal āpan kīnhā

verses.sa:
बंचेहु मोहि जवनि धरि देहा ।
सोइ तनु धरहु श्राप मम एहा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃcehu mohi javani dhari dehā
soi tanu dharahu śrāp mam ehā

verses.sa:
कपि आकृति तुम्ह कीन्हि हमारी ।
करिहहिं कीस सहाय तुम्हारी ॥
verses.tr:
kapi ākṛti tumh kīnhi hamārī
karihahiṃ kīs sahāya tumhārī

verses.sa:
मम अपकार कीन्ही तुम्ह भारी ।
नारी बिरहँ तुम्ह होब दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
mam apakār kīnhī tumh bhārī
nārī biraham̐ tumh hob dukhārī

verses.sa:
श्राप सीस धरी हरषि हियँ प्रभु बहु बिनती कीन्हि ।
निज माया कै प्रबलता करषि कृपानिधि लीन्हि ॥
verses.tr:
śrāp sīs dharī haraṣi hiyam̐ prabhu bahu binatī kīnhi
nij māyā kai prabalatā karaṣi kṛpānidhi līnhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Utterly self-willed, with no one over you, and bent on doing whatever comes into your mind; confounding the good and exalting the bad; with a heart incapable either of surprise or pleasure; trying every one with your tricks, without the slightest consideration and in mere lightness of heart. Neither good deeds nor bad in any way affect you, nor has any one up to the present ever succeeded in restraining you. Now for this fine treat that you have given me you shall receive a due return. Be born in the form in.which you have now imposed upon me; this is my curse. And as you have made me like a monkey, you shall have monkeys for helpmates; and in the same way us you have sorely wronged me, so shall you be distrest by the loss of your wife,”
The lord gladly accepted the curse, thus working the will of the gods, and in his compassion withdrew the influence of his deceptive power.

sections.label: Doha 138
sections.name: बहुबिधि मुनिहि प्रबोधि प्रभु तब भए अंतरधान

verses.sa:
जब हरि माया दूरि निवारी ।
नहिं तहँ रमा न राजकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
jab hari māyā dūri nivārī
nahiṃ taham̐ ramā na rājakumārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब मुनि अति सभीत हरि चरना ।
गहे पाहि प्रनतारति हरना ॥
verses.tr:
tab muni ati sabhīt hari caranā
gahe pāhi pranatārati haranā

verses.sa:
मृषा होउ मम श्राप कृपाला ।
मम इच्छा कह दीनदयाला ॥
verses.tr:
mṛṣā hou mam śrāp kṛpālā
mam icchā kah dīnadayālā

verses.sa:
मैं दुर्बचन कहे बहुतेरे ।
कह मुनि पाप मिटिहिं किमि मेरे ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ durbacan kahe bahutere
kah muni pāp miṭihiṃ kimi mere

verses.sa:
जपहु जाइ संकर सत नामा ।
होइहि हृदयँ तुरंत बिश्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
japahu jāi saṃkar sat nāmā
hoihi hṛdayam̐ turaṃt biśrāmā

verses.sa:
कोउ नहिं सिव समान प्रिय मोरें ।
असि परतीति तजहु जनि भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
kou nahiṃ siv samān priya moreṃ
asi paratīti tajahu jani bhoreṃ

verses.sa:
जेहि पर कृपा न करहिं पुरारी ।
सो न पाव मुनि भगति हमारी ॥
verses.tr:
jehi par kṛpā na karahiṃ purārī
so na pāv muni bhagati hamārī

verses.sa:
अस उर धरि महि बिचरहु जाई ।
अब न तुम्हहि माया निअराई ॥
verses.tr:
as ur dhari mahi bicarahu jāī
ab na tumhahi māyā niarāī

verses.sa: बहुबिधि मुनिहि प्रबोधि प्रभु तब भए अंतरधान ॥
verses.tr: bahubidhi munihi prabodhi prabhu tab bhae aṃtaradhān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सत्यलोक नारद चले करत राम गुन गान ॥
verses.tr: satyalok nārad cale karat rām gun gān

trans: When this was removed, there appeared neither Rama nor the princess; and the saint fell in great fear at the feet of Hari, ever ready to heal the sorrows of a suppliant, crying, —“ May my curse be made of no effect.” Said the gracious god,—‘ It is my will.” Said the saint,—‘I have spoken many injurious words; how shall my guilt be expiated?’ ‘“‘ Go and repeat Sankara’s hundred names, and your soul will at once be relieved. There is no one sodear to me as Siva; never let your faith in this truth be shaken. He on whom Siva will not show mercy shall never know true love to me. Think on this as you wander over the earth; the delusion haunts you no longer.”’
Having thus reassured the saint, the lord disappeared,

sections.label: Doha 139
sections.name: एक कलप एहि हेतु प्रभु लीन्ह मनुज अवतार

verses.sa:
हर गन मुनिहि जात पथ देखी ।
बिगतमोह मन हरष बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
har gan munihi jāt path dekhī
bigatamoh man haraṣ biseṣī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अति सभीत नारद पहिं आए ।
गहि पद आरत बचन सुनाए ॥
verses.tr:
ati sabhīt nārad pahiṃ āe
gahi pad ārat bacan sunāe

verses.sa:
हर गन हम न बिप्र मुनिराया ।
बड़ अपराध कीन्ह फल पाया ॥
verses.tr:
har gan ham na bipr munirāyā
bar̤ aparādh kīnh phal pāyā

verses.sa:
श्राप अनुग्रह करहु कृपाला ।
बोले नारद दीनदयाला ॥
verses.tr:
śrāp anugrah karahu kṛpālā
bole nārad dīnadayālā

verses.sa:
निसिचर जाइ होहु तुम्ह दोऊ ।
बैभव बिपुल तेज बल होऊ ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar jāi hohu tumh doū
baibhav bipul tej bal hoū

verses.sa:
भुजबल बिस्व जितब तुम्ह जहिआ ।
धरिहहिं बिष्नु मनुज तनु तहिआ ॥
verses.tr:
bhujabal bisv jitab tumh jahiā
dharihahiṃ biṣnu manuj tanu tahiā

verses.sa:
समर मरन हरि हाथ तुम्हारा ।
होइहहु मुकुत न पुनि संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
samar maran hari hāth tumhārā
hoihahu mukut na puni saṃsārā

verses.sa:
चले जुगल मुनि पद सिर नाई ।
भए निसाचर कालहि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
cale jugal muni pad sir nāī
bhae nisācar kālahi pāī

verses.sa:
एक कलप एहि हेतु प्रभु लीन्ह मनुज अवतार ।
सुर रंजन सज्जन सुखद हरि भंजन भुबि भार ॥
verses.tr:
ek kalap ehi hetu prabhu līnh manuj avatār
sur raṃjan sajjan sukhad hari bhaṃjan bhubi bhār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: and Narad took his way to Paradise, chanting Rama's praises as he went.

‘Siva’s two followers saw him on the road rejoicing and in his right mind. In great alarm they drew near, and clasping his feet made their supplication: “O great saint we arenot Brahmans, but servants of Mahadeva, and have reaped the fruit of our great sin: in your mercy remove the curse.” Said the compassionate Narad,—‘ You must both be born as demons of vast power, majesty and strength; but when you have subdued the universe by the might of your arm, Vishnu shall take upon him human form, and dying in battle at his hands you shall attain to salvation, nor ever be born again.” After bowing their head at his feet, both went their way and in due course were born as demons. Dohd 146. In one age this was the reasoniwhy the lord became incarnate, to gladden the gods, to comfort the saints, and to __ease earth of its burdens, Chaupdi 140.

sections.label: Doha 140
sections.name: सुर नर मुनि कोउ नाहिं जेहि न मोह माया प्रबल

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि जनम करम हरि केरे ।
सुंदर सुखद बिचित्र घनेरे ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi janam karam hari kere
suṃdar sukhad bicitr ghanere
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कलप कलप प्रति प्रभु अवतरहीं ।
चारु चरित नानाबिधि करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kalap kalap prati prabhu avatarahīṃ
cāru carit nānābidhi karahīṃ

verses.sa:
तब तब कथा मुनीसन्ह गाई ।
परम पुनीत प्रबंध बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab tab kathā munīsanh gāī
param punīt prabaṃdh banāī

verses.sa:
बिबिध प्रसंग अनूप बखाने ।
करहिं न सुनि आचरजु सयाने ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh prasaṃg anūp bakhāne
karahiṃ na suni ācaraju sayāne

verses.sa:
हरि अनंत हरिकथा अनंता ।
कहहिं सुनहिं बहुबिधि सब संता ॥
verses.tr:
hari anaṃt harikathā anaṃtā
kahahiṃ sunahiṃ bahubidhi sab saṃtā

verses.sa:
रामचंद्र के चरित सुहाए ।
कलप कोटि लगि जाहिं न गाए ॥
verses.tr:
rāmacaṃdr ke carit suhāe
kalap koṭi lagi jāhiṃ na gāe

verses.sa:
यह प्रसंग मैं कहा भवानी ।
हरिमायाँ मोहहिं मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
yah prasaṃg maiṃ kahā bhavānī
harimāyām̐ mohahiṃ muni gyānī

verses.sa:
प्रभु कौतुकी प्रनत हितकारी ।
सेवत सुलभ सकल दुख हारी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu kautukī pranat hitakārī
sevat sulabh sakal dukh hārī

verses.sa: सुर नर मुनि कोउ नाहिं जेहि न मोह माया प्रबल ॥
verses.tr: sur nar muni kou nāhiṃ jehi na moh māyā prabal
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: अस बिचारि मन माहिं भजिअ महामाया पतिहि ॥
verses.tr: as bicāri man māhiṃ bhajia mahāmāyā patihi

trans: Thus Hari’s births and actions are many and various, but all of them glorious and beneficent. In every age he has manifested himself and wrought many excellent works; and on each occasion great saints have sung his acts in holy strains of choicest verse, relating marvellous histories of diverse kinds, which the wise-‘hear without any amazement. For as Hari is without end, so are there endless verses about him, which are heard and repeated by scripture and the faithful. The delightful adventures of Ramchandra could not all be sung in a myriad ages. This story that I have now told, Bhavani shows how Hari’s deceptive power can infatuate even saints and sages. He, the lord, is sportive, gracious to suppliants, accessible to his servants, and a remover of all sorrow. Sorathd 15.
There is neither god, man, nor. saint whom.unreality has not infatuated. Reflect upon this and worship the great master of the unreal.

sections.label: Doha 141
sections.name: सो मैं तुम्ह सन कहउँ सबु सुनु मुनीस मन लाई

verses.sa:
अपर हेतु सुनु सैलकुमारी ।
कहउँ बिचित्र कथा बिस्तारी ॥
verses.tr:
apar hetu sunu sailakumārī
kahaum̐ bicitr kathā bistārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जेहि कारन अज अगुन अरूपा ।
ब्रह्म भयउ कोसलपुर भूपा ॥
verses.tr:
jehi kāran aj agun arūpā
brahm bhayau kosalapur bhūpā

verses.sa:
जो प्रभु बिपिन फिरत तुम्ह देखा ।
बंधु समेत धरें मुनिबेषा ॥
verses.tr:
jo prabhu bipin phirat tumh dekhā
baṃdhu samet dhareṃ munibeṣā

verses.sa:
जासु चरित अवलोकि भवानी ।
सती सरीर रहिहु बौरानी ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu carit avaloki bhavānī
satī sarīr rahihu baurānī

verses.sa:
अजहुँ न छाया मिटति तुम्हारी ।
तासु चरित सुनु भ्रम रुज हारी ॥
verses.tr:
ajahum̐ na chāyā miṭati tumhārī
tāsu carit sunu bhram ruj hārī

verses.sa:
लीला कीन्हि जो तेहिं अवतारा ।
सो सब कहिहउँ मति अनुसारा ॥
verses.tr:
līlā kīnhi jo tehiṃ avatārā
so sab kahihaum̐ mati anusārā

verses.sa:
भरद्वाज सुनि संकर बानी ।
सकुचि सप्रेम उमा मुसकानी ॥
verses.tr:
bharadvāj suni saṃkar bānī
sakuci saprem umā musakānī

verses.sa:
लगे बहुरि बरने बृषकेतू ।
सो अवतार भयउ जेहि हेतू ॥
verses.tr:
lage bahuri barane bṛṣaketū
so avatār bhayau jehi hetū

verses.sa: सो मैं तुम्ह सन कहउँ सबु सुनु मुनीस मन लाई ॥
verses.tr: so maiṃ tumh san kahaum̐ sabu sunu munīs man lāī
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: राम कथा कलि मल हरनि मंगल करनि सुहाइ ॥
verses.tr: rām kathā kali mal harani maṃgal karani suhāi

trans: Hear, O daughter’ of the Himalaya, a second reason, which I will proceed to relate at full length. why the uncreated, the passionless, the incomparable Brahm became King of Kosala. The lord, whom you saw roaming 10 the forest with his brother in hermit’s attire; at whose doings, Bhav^ni, you in Sati’s form lost your sense, and still to this day have a touch of disease; the recital of his adventures will heal all your sickness. All his sportive acts 1a that incarnation I am now about to tell as best I can.” O Bharadveja, on hearing Sankara thus speak, the modest and affectionate Uma smiled for joy, while her lord continued,—‘the cause of the incarnation.”
Iam now about to explain (listen, great saint, with attention to the delightful story of Rama, which can cleanse all the stains of the world and bring man to heaven).

sections.label: Doha 142
sections.name: होइ न बिषय बिराग भवन बसत भा चौथपन

verses.sa:
स्वायंभू मनु अरु सतरूपा ।
जिन्ह तें भै नरसृष्टि अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
svāyaṃbhū manu aru satarūpā
jinh teṃ bhai narasṛṣṭi anūpā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दंपति धरम आचरन नीका ।
अजहुँ गाव श्रुति जिन्ह कै लीका ॥
verses.tr:
daṃpati dharam ācaran nīkā
ajahum̐ gāv śruti jinh kai līkā

verses.sa:
नृप उत्तानपाद सुत तासू ।
ध्रुव हरि भगत भयउ सुत जासू ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp uttānapād sut tāsū
dhruv hari bhagat bhayau sut jāsū

verses.sa:
लघु सुत नाम प्रिय्रब्रत ताही ।
बेद पुरान प्रसंसहि जाही ॥
verses.tr:
laghu sut nām priyrabrat tāhī
bed purān prasaṃsahi jāhī

verses.sa:
देवहूति पुनि तासु कुमारी ।
जो मुनि कर्दम कै प्रिय नारी ॥
verses.tr:
devahūti puni tāsu kumārī
jo muni kardam kai priya nārī

verses.sa:
आदिदेव प्रभु दीनदयाला ।
जठर धरेउ जेहिं कपिल कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
ādidev prabhu dīnadayālā
jaṭhar dhareu jehiṃ kapil kṛpālā

verses.sa:
सांख्य सास्त्र जिन्ह प्रगट बखाना ।
तत्व बिचार निपुन भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
sāṃkhya sāstr jinh pragaṭ bakhānā
tatv bicār nipun bhagavānā

verses.sa:
तेहिं मनु राज कीन्ह बहु काला ।
प्रभु आयसु सब बिधि प्रतिपाला ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ manu rāj kīnh bahu kālā
prabhu āyasu sab bidhi pratipālā

verses.sa:
होइ न बिषय बिराग भवन बसत भा चौथपन ।
हृदयँ बहुत दुख लाग जनम गयउ हरिभगति बिनु ॥
verses.tr:
hoi na biṣaya birāg bhavan basat bhā cauthapan
hṛdayam̐ bahut dukh lāg janam gayau haribhagati binu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Manu, the son of the self-existing, had to wife Satarupa, and of them were born the whole human race; even to this day the fame of their virtue and conjugal fidelity is celebrated in the scriptures. Their son was King Uttaenapdda, who begot Hari’s faithful client Dhruva. The younger son, by name Priya-vrata, is mentioned with praise both by the Vedas and Puranas. Their daughter, Devahuti, became the devoted wife of Saint Kardama, and in her womb the eternal Lord God, in his mercy and compassion, planted Kapila, the author of the Sankhya philosophy, the divine exponent of the theory of entities. This Manu reigned a long while, keeping all God’s commandments.
But in a palace complete detachment from the senses is impracticable, Old age came upon him, and he thought

sections.label: Doha 143
sections.name: द्वादस अच्छर मंत्र पुनि जपहिं सहित अनुराग

verses.sa:
बरबस राज सुतहि तब दीन्हा ।
नारि समेत गवन बन कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
barabas rāj sutahi tab dīnhā
nāri samet gavan ban kīnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तीरथ बर नैमिष बिख्याता ।
अति पुनीत साधक सिधि दाता ॥
verses.tr:
tīrath bar naimiṣ bikhyātā
ati punīt sādhak sidhi dātā

verses.sa:
बसहिं तहाँ मुनि सिद्ध समाजा ।
तहँ हियँ हरषि चलेउ मनु राजा ॥
verses.tr:
basahiṃ tahām̐ muni siddh samājā
taham̐ hiyam̐ haraṣi caleu manu rājā

verses.sa:
पंथ जात सोहहिं मतिधीरा ।
ग्यान भगति जनु धरें सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
paṃth jāt sohahiṃ matidhīrā
gyān bhagati janu dhareṃ sarīrā

verses.sa:
पहुँचे जाइ धेनुमति तीरा ।
हरषि नहाने निरमल नीरा ॥
verses.tr:
pahum̐ce jāi dhenumati tīrā
haraṣi nahāne niramal nīrā

verses.sa:
आए मिलन सिद्ध मुनि ग्यानी ।
धरम धुरंधर नृपरिषि जानी ॥
verses.tr:
āe milan siddh muni gyānī
dharam dhuraṃdhar nṛpariṣi jānī

verses.sa:
जहँ जँह तीरथ रहे सुहाए ।
मुनिन्ह सकल सादर करवाए ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jam̐h tīrath rahe suhāe
muninh sakal sādar karavāe

verses.sa:
कृस सरीर मुनिपट परिधाना ।
सत समाज नित सुनहिं पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
kṛs sarīr munipaṭ paridhānā
sat samāj nit sunahiṃ purānā

verses.sa:
द्वादस अच्छर मंत्र पुनि जपहिं सहित अनुराग ।
बासुदेव पद पंकरुह दंपति मन अति लाग ॥
verses.tr:
dvādas acchar maṃtr puni japahiṃ sahit anurāg
bāsudev pad paṃkaruh daṃpati man ati lāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: with grief,—‘ My life has been spent without any true devotion to Hari.’

Then perforce he resigned the throne to his son, and with his queen repaired to the forest, to Naimisha, famous among all holy places as specially sacred and liberal of success, Glad of heart. King Manu sought the spot where dwelt the company of saints and sages; and as the resolute pair passed along the way they seemed incarnations of Wisdom and Faith. On reaching the bank of the Gomati, they bathed with delight in the clear stream;and there the inspired saints and sages came to meet them, recognizing in the king a champion of religion. Devoutly they took them to visit each different shrine, and with wasted body, clad in hermit’s robes, they are ever in the assembly of the faithful listening to the Puranas.
Devoutly repeating the twelve-lettered charm, and with their whole soul directed to the lotus feet of Vasudeva,

sections.label: Doha 144
sections.name: एहि बिधि बीतें बरष षट सहस बारि आहार

verses.sa:
करहिं अहार साक फल कंदा ।
सुमिरहिं ब्रह्म सच्चिदानंदा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ ahār sāk phal kaṃdā
sumirahiṃ brahm saccidānaṃdā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि हरि हेतु करन तप लागे ।
बारि अधार मूल फल त्यागे ॥
verses.tr:
puni hari hetu karan tap lāge
bāri adhār mūl phal tyāge

verses.sa:
उर अभिलाष निंरंतर होई ।
देखअ नयन परम प्रभु सोई ॥
verses.tr:
ur abhilāṣ niṃraṃtar hoī
dekhaa nayan param prabhu soī

verses.sa:
अगुन अखंड अनंत अनादी ।
जेहि चिंतहिं परमारथबादी ॥
verses.tr:
agun akhaṃḍ anaṃt anādī
jehi ciṃtahiṃ paramārathabādī

verses.sa:
नेति नेति जेहि बेद निरूपा ।
निजानंद निरुपाधि अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
neti neti jehi bed nirūpā
nijānaṃd nirupādhi anūpā

verses.sa:
संभु बिरंचि बिष्नु भगवाना ।
उपजहिं जासु अंस तें नाना ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu biraṃci biṣnu bhagavānā
upajahiṃ jāsu aṃs teṃ nānā

verses.sa:
ऐसेउ प्रभु सेवक बस अहई ।
भगत हेतु लीलातनु गहई ॥
verses.tr:
aiseu prabhu sevak bas ahaī
bhagat hetu līlātanu gahaī

verses.sa:
जौं यह बचन सत्य श्रुति भाषा ।
तौ हमार पूजहि अभिलाषा ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ yah bacan satya śruti bhāṣā
tau hamār pūjahi abhilāṣā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि बीतें बरष षट सहस बारि आहार ।
संबत सप्त सहस्त्र पुनि रहे समीर अधार ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bīteṃ baraṣ ṣaṭ sahas bāri āhār
saṃbat sapt sahastr puni rahe samīr adhār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Meditating on the Supreme Brahm, they live on leaves and fraitsand roots. Then doing penance as before Hari, they gave up roots and fruitsfor water only. In heart an endless craving, —“ O that we might see with our eyes the very God, without parts or passions; without beginning or end; whom the preachers of salvation contemplate; whom the Vedas define as the unutterable; the pure spirit, without attributes and beyond all comparison; as part of whom are produced in various forms the lords Sambhu, Brahma, and Vishnu. Yet so great a god submits to his own servants, and for their sake assumes in sport a body. If this be true, as the scriptures have declared, our desire will of a surety be accomplished.”
In this way they spent six thousand years living only on water; and then seven thousand, living only on air.

sections.label: Doha 145
sections.name: श्रवन सुधा सम बचन सुनि पुलक प्रफुल्लित गात

verses.sa:
बरष सहस दस त्यागेउ सोऊ ।
ठाढ़े रहे एक पद दोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣ sahas das tyāgeu soū
ṭhār̤he rahe ek pad doū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिधि हरि तप देखि अपारा ।
मनु समीप आए बहु बारा ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi hari tap dekhi apārā
manu samīp āe bahu bārā

verses.sa:
मागहु बर बहु भाँति लोभाए ।
परम धीर नहिं चलहिं चलाए ॥
verses.tr:
māgahu bar bahu bhām̐ti lobhāe
param dhīr nahiṃ calahiṃ calāe

verses.sa:
अस्थिमात्र होइ रहे सरीरा ।
तदपि मनाग मनहिं नहिं पीरा ॥
verses.tr:
asthimātr hoi rahe sarīrā
tadapi manāg manahiṃ nahiṃ pīrā

verses.sa:
प्रभु सर्बग्य दास निज जानी ।
गति अनन्य तापस नृप रानी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu sarbagya dās nij jānī
gati ananya tāpas nṛp rānī

verses.sa:
मागु मागु बरु भै नभ बानी ।
परम गभीर कृपामृत सानी ॥
verses.tr:
māgu māgu baru bhai nabh bānī
param gabhīr kṛpāmṛt sānī

verses.sa:
मृतक जिआवनि गिरा सुहाई ।
श्रबन रंध्र होइ उर जब आई ॥
verses.tr:
mṛtak jiāvani girā suhāī
śraban raṃdhr hoi ur jab āī

verses.sa:
ह्रष्टपुष्ट तन भए सुहाए ।
मानहुँ अबहिं भवन ते आए ॥
verses.tr:
hraṣṭapuṣṭ tan bhae suhāe
mānahum̐ abahiṃ bhavan te āe

verses.sa:
श्रवन सुधा सम बचन सुनि पुलक प्रफुल्लित गात ।
बोले मनु करि दंडवत प्रेम न हृदयँ समात ॥
verses.tr:
śravan sudhā sam bacan suni pulak praphullit gāt
bole manu kari daṃḍavat prem na hṛdayam̐ samāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: For ten thousand years they gave up even this and remained both standing on one leg. Now Brahma, Hari and Hara saw this interminable penance and repeatedly came near to Manu and tempted him, saying,—‘ Ask your boon ’; but for all their persuasion he was too steadfast to move. Though his body was reduced to a skeleton, there was not the least pain ia his soul. Then the omniscient lord knew that the king and queen were his servants and had this single object in practising such austerities. A solemn voice full of ambrosial grace sounded in the sky, saying: Ask, ask; a voice so blithe that it would wake the dead. Asit dropped upon the ears of their soul, their bodies became again as comely and stout as if they had only that day left their home.

sections.label: Doha 146
sections.name: नील सरोरुह नील मनि नील नीरधर स्याम

verses.sa:
सुनु सेवक सुरतरु सुरधेनु ।
बिधि हरि हर बंदित पद रेनू ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sevak surataru suradhenu
bidhi hari har baṃdit pad renū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सेवत सुलभ सकल सुख दायक ।
प्रनतपाल सचराचर नायक ॥
verses.tr:
sevat sulabh sakal sukh dāyak
pranatapāl sacarācar nāyak

verses.sa:
जौं अनाथ हित हम पर नेहू ।
तौ प्रसन्न होइ यह बर देहू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ anāth hit ham par nehū
tau prasann hoi yah bar dehū

verses.sa:
जो सरूप बस सिव मन माहीं ।
जेहि कारन मुनि जतन कराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jo sarūp bas siv man māhīṃ
jehi kāran muni jatan karāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जो भुसुंडि मन मानस हंसा ।
सगुन अगुन जेहि निगम प्रसंसा ॥
verses.tr:
jo bhusuṃḍi man mānas haṃsā
sagun agun jehi nigam prasaṃsā

verses.sa:
देखहिं हम सो रूप भरि लोचन ।
कृपा करहु प्रनतारति मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahiṃ ham so rūp bhari locan
kṛpā karahu pranatārati mocan

verses.sa:
दंपति बचन परम प्रिय लागे ।
मुदुल बिनीत प्रेम रस पागे ॥
verses.tr:
daṃpati bacan param priya lāge
mudul binīt prem ras pāge

verses.sa:
भगत बछल प्रभु कृपानिधाना ।
बिस्वबास प्रगटे भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
bhagat bachal prabhu kṛpānidhānā
bisvabās pragaṭe bhagavānā

verses.sa:
नील सरोरुह नील मनि नील नीरधर स्याम ।
लाजहिं तन सोभा निरखि कोटि कोटि सत काम ॥
verses.tr:
nīl saroruh nīl mani nīl nīradhar syām
lājahiṃ tan sobhā nirakhi koṭi koṭi sat kām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Hearken, O thou that art as the tree of paradise or the sacred cow to thy servants; the dust on whose feet is ever worshipped by Brahma, Hari and Hara; accessible to the faithful; bounteous of all good; protector of suppliants; lord of all creation: if, O friend of the friendless, 1 have found favour in thy sight, then in thy mercy grant me this boon: Let me with mine own eyes behold thee in that form in which thou dwellest in Siva’s breast, which the saints desire to see; the swan in the lake of Bhusundi’s soul; the sum and the negation of all attributes; the theme of the Veda: do me this grace, O thou that healest the woes of every suppliant.” This gentle, submissive and affectionate speech of the wedded pair went to the heart of the generous and merciful god; and the sovereign of the universe manifested himself,
In hue as the lotus or the sapphire; dark as a rain-

sections.label: Doha 147
sections.name: तडित बिनिंदक पीत पट उदर रेख बर तीनि

verses.sa:
सरद मयंक बदन छबि सींवा ।
चारु कपोल चिबुक दर ग्रीवा ॥
verses.tr:
sarad mayaṃk badan chabi sīṃvā
cāru kapol cibuk dar grīvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अधर अरुन रद सुंदर नासा ।
बिधु कर निकर बिनिंदक हासा ॥
verses.tr:
adhar arun rad suṃdar nāsā
bidhu kar nikar biniṃdak hāsā

verses.sa:
नव अबुंज अंबक छबि नीकी ।
चितवनि ललित भावँती जी की ॥
verses.tr:
nav abuṃj aṃbak chabi nīkī
citavani lalit bhāvam̐tī jī kī

verses.sa:
भुकुटि मनोज चाप छबि हारी ।
तिलक ललाट पटल दुतिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
bhukuṭi manoj cāp chabi hārī
tilak lalāṭ paṭal dutikārī

verses.sa:
कुंडल मकर मुकुट सिर भ्राजा ।
कुटिल केस जनु मधुप समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
kuṃḍal makar mukuṭ sir bhrājā
kuṭil kes janu madhup samājā

verses.sa:
उर श्रीबत्स रुचिर बनमाला ।
पदिक हार भूषन मनिजाला ॥
verses.tr:
ur śrībats rucir banamālā
padik hār bhūṣan manijālā

verses.sa:
केहरि कंधर चारु जनेउ ।
बाहु बिभूषन सुंदर तेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kehari kaṃdhar cāru janeu
bāhu bibhūṣan suṃdar teū

verses.sa:
करि कर सरि सुभग भुजदंडा ।
कटि निषंग कर सर कोदंडा ॥
verses.tr:
kari kar sari subhag bhujadaṃḍā
kaṭi niṣaṃg kar sar kodaṃḍā

verses.sa: तडित बिनिंदक पीत पट उदर रेख बर तीनि ॥
verses.tr: taḍit biniṃdak pīt paṭ udar rekh bar tīni
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: नाभि मनोहर लेति जनु जमुन भवँर छबि छीनि ॥
verses.tr: nābhi manohar leti janu jamun bhavam̐r chabi chīni

trans: cloud; of such lustrous form that a myriad Loves could not be compared to it,

With a face perfect in beauty like the autumnal moon; with lovely cheeks and chin and dimpled neck, red lips and gleaming teeth, and a nose and smile more radiant than a moonbeam; eyes bright as a lotus bud and a glance to fascinate the heart; brows surpassing Love's bow; on the forehead a sectarial mark and glistening star; golden fish in his ears and a bright crown on his head; crisp curling,hair like a swarm of bees; on his breast the Srivatsa jewel ’and a long wreath of sweet wild flowers, and jewelled adornments about his neck; a waist like a lion, a comely Brahmanical thread, and exquisite clasps upon his arms, long and round us an elephant’s trunk; with a quiver at his side and bow and arrow in his hand; *
_ His yellow apparel more lustrous than the lightning; his body charmingly dimpled, and his naval like a bee hovering over the dark wave of the Jamuna;

sections.label: Doha 148
sections.name: बोले कृपानिधान पुनि अति प्रसन्न मोहि जानि

verses.sa:
पद राजीव बरनि नहि जाहीं ।
मुनि मन मधुप बसहिं जेन्ह माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pad rājīv barani nahi jāhīṃ
muni man madhup basahiṃ jenh māhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बाम भाग सोभति अनुकूला ।
आदिसक्ति छबिनिधि जगमूला ॥
verses.tr:
bām bhāg sobhati anukūlā
ādisakti chabinidhi jagamūlā

verses.sa:
जासु अंस उपजहिं गुनखानी ।
अगनित लच्छि उमा ब्रह्मानी ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu aṃs upajahiṃ gunakhānī
aganit lacchi umā brahmānī

verses.sa:
भृकुटि बिलास जासु जग होई ।
राम बाम दिसि सीता सोई ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛkuṭi bilās jāsu jag hoī
rām bām disi sītā soī

verses.sa:
छबिसमुद्र हरि रूप बिलोकी ।
एकटक रहे नयन पट रोकी ॥
verses.tr:
chabisamudr hari rūp bilokī
ekaṭak rahe nayan paṭ rokī

verses.sa:
चितवहिं सादर रूप अनूपा ।
तृप्ति न मानहिं मनु सतरूपा ॥
verses.tr:
citavahiṃ sādar rūp anūpā
tṛpti na mānahiṃ manu satarūpā

verses.sa:
हरष बिबस तन दसा भुलानी ।
परे दंड इव गहि पद पानी ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣ bibas tan dasā bhulānī
pare daṃḍ iv gahi pad pānī

verses.sa:
सिर परसे प्रभु निज कर कंजा ।
तुरत उठाए करुनापुंजा ॥
verses.tr:
sir parase prabhu nij kar kaṃjā
turat uṭhāe karunāpuṃjā

verses.sa:
बोले कृपानिधान पुनि अति प्रसन्न मोहि जानि ।
मागहु बर जोइ भाव मन महादानि अनुमानि ॥
verses.tr:
bole kṛpānidhān puni ati prasann mohi jāni
māgahu bar joi bhāv man mahādāni anumāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: His feet beautiful beyond description, lotus haunt of the bee-like souls of the saints. On his left side shines in equal glory the Primal Energy, queen of beauty, mother of the world; of whose members are born countless Umas and R&mas and Braehmanis, all alike perfect; by the play of whose eyebrows a world flashes into existence, even Sita, enthroned at Rama's side. As Manu and Satartipa beheld this vision of Hari in all his beauty, gazing fixedly with open eyes, they adored his incomparable magnificence, nor could be satiated with the sight. Overcome with delight and transported out of themselves, they fell flat on the ground, clasping his feet in their hands. But the gracious lord putting his lotus hand upon their heads quickly raised them up,
And again said,—‘' Be assured that you have found favour with me: ask whatever boon you will, the largest gift you can think of.”

sections.label: Doha 149
sections.name: दानि सिरोमनि कृपानिधि नाथ कहउँ सतिभाउ

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन जोरि जुग पानी ।
धरि धीरजु बोली मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan jori jug pānī
dhari dhīraju bolī mṛdu bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ देखि पद कमल तुम्हारे ।
अब पूरे सब काम हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
nāth dekhi pad kamal tumhāre
ab pūre sab kām hamāre

verses.sa:
एक लालसा बड़ि उर माही ।
सुगम अगम कहि जात सो नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ek lālasā bar̤i ur māhī
sugam agam kahi jāt so nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि देत अति सुगम गोसाईं ।
अगम लाग मोहि निज कृपनाईं ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi det ati sugam gosāīṃ
agam lāg mohi nij kṛpanāīṃ

verses.sa:
जथा दरिद्र बिबुधतरु पाई ।
बहु संपति मागत सकुचाई ॥
verses.tr:
jathā daridr bibudhataru pāī
bahu saṃpati māgat sakucāī

verses.sa:
तासु प्रभा जान नहिं सोई ।
तथा हृदयँ मम संसय होई ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu prabhā jān nahiṃ soī
tathā hṛdayam̐ mam saṃsaya hoī

verses.sa:
सो तुम्ह जानहु अंतरजामी ।
पुरवहु मोर मनोरथ स्वामी ॥
verses.tr:
so tumh jānahu aṃtarajāmī
puravahu mor manorath svāmī

verses.sa:
सकुच बिहाइ मागु नृप मोहि ।
मोरें नहिं अदेय कछु तोही ॥
verses.tr:
sakuc bihāi māgu nṛp mohi
moreṃ nahiṃ adeya kachu tohī

verses.sa: दानि सिरोमनि कृपानिधि नाथ कहउँ सतिभाउ ॥
verses.tr: dāni siromani kṛpānidhi nāth kahaum̐ satibhāu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: चाहउँ तुम्हहि समान सुत प्रभु सन कवन दुराउ ॥
verses.tr: cāhaum̐ tumhahi samān sut prabhu san kavan durāu

trans: On hearing the lord’s words they clasped their hands in prayer, and taking courage thus spoke in timid accents, —‘ QO Jord, we have seen your lotus feet, and our every object has been accomplished. Yet one longing remains, and I know not whether to describe it as easy or difficult of attainment. It is easy, my master, for you to give; but so far as my meanness is concerned, it is difficult. Like a beggar who has found the wishing-tree, but trembles to ask for too good fortune, not realizing its full power, so my heart is troubled by doubt. O my god, you read all hearts and know what I wish; grant my desire.’—“ O king, fear not, but ask of me; there is nothing I would not give you.”
‘gracious lord, I will declare honestly the crowning boon; for what concealment can there be I would have a son like you,”

sections.label: Doha 150
sections.name: सोइ सुख सोइ गति सोइ भगति सोइ निज चरन सनेहु

verses.sa:
देखि प्रीति सुनि बचन अमोले ।
एवमस्तु करुनानिधि बोले ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi prīti suni bacan amole
evamastu karunānidhi bole
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आपु सरिस खोजौं कहँ जाई ।
नृप तव तनय होब मैं आई ॥
verses.tr:
āpu saris khojauṃ kaham̐ jāī
nṛp tav tanaya hob maiṃ āī

verses.sa:
सतरूपहि बिलोकि कर जोरें ।
देबि मागु बरु जो रुचि तोरे ॥
verses.tr:
satarūpahi biloki kar joreṃ
debi māgu baru jo ruci tore

verses.sa:
जो बरु नाथ चतुर नृप मागा ।
सोइ कृपाल मोहि अति प्रिय लागा ॥
verses.tr:
jo baru nāth catur nṛp māgā
soi kṛpāl mohi ati priya lāgā

verses.sa:
प्रभु परंतु सुठि होति ढिठाई ।
जदपि भगत हित तुम्हहि सोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu paraṃtu suṭhi hoti ḍhiṭhāī
jadapi bhagat hit tumhahi sohāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह ब्रह्मादि जनक जग स्वामी ।
ब्रह्म सकल उर अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh brahmādi janak jag svāmī
brahm sakal ur aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
अस समुझत मन संसय होई ।
कहा जो प्रभु प्रवान पुनि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
as samujhat man saṃsaya hoī
kahā jo prabhu pravān puni soī

verses.sa:
जे निज भगत नाथ तव अहहीं ।
जो सुख पावहिं जो गति लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je nij bhagat nāth tav ahahīṃ
jo sukh pāvahiṃ jo gati lahahīṃ

verses.sa: सोइ सुख सोइ गति सोइ भगति सोइ निज चरन सनेहु ॥
verses.tr: soi sukh soi gati soi bhagati soi nij caran sanehu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सोइ बिबेक सोइ रहनि प्रभु हमहि कृपा करि देहु ॥
verses.tr: soi bibek soi rahani prabhu hamahi kṛpā kari dehu

trans: On seeing his love and hearing his sincere words, said the Compassionate, ‘So be.” “Where can I go to find your equal?” “I myself, O king, will be born as your

son.” Then seeing Satartipa with her hands still clasped, —‘O lady, ask whatever boon you please.’ ‘O my lord, the boon my husband has wisely asked is what I too should most desire. But it is great presumption; though in your clemency you have confirmed it. You are father of all the gods, the lord of the world, the supreme spirit, the omniscient; and therefore my mind doubts; and yet the Lord’s words cannot fail. O my god, the bliss that is enjoyed and the future state that is attained by your own servants—
In your mercy grant to me even that bliss, that state, that devotion, that love to your feet, that knowledge, and that existence.”

sections.label: Doha 151
sections.name: तहँ करि भोग बिसाल तात गउँ कछु काल पुनि

verses.sa:
सुनु मृदु गूढ़ रुचिर बर रचना ।
कृपासिंधु बोले मृदु बचना ॥
verses.tr:
sunu mṛdu gūr̤h rucir bar racanā
kṛpāsiṃdhu bole mṛdu bacanā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जो कछु रुचि तुम्हेर मन माहीं ।
मैं सो दीन्ह सब संसय नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jo kachu ruci tumher man māhīṃ
maiṃ so dīnh sab saṃsaya nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मातु बिबेक अलोकिक तोरें ।
कबहुँ न मिटिहि अनुग्रह मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
mātu bibek alokik toreṃ
kabahum̐ na miṭihi anugrah moreṃ

verses.sa:
बंदि चरन मनु कहेउ बहोरी ।
अवर एक बिनति प्रभु मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdi caran manu kaheu bahorī
avar ek binati prabhu morī

verses.sa:
सुत बिषइक तव पद रति होऊ ।
मोहि बड़ मूढ़ कहै किन कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sut biṣaik tav pad rati hoū
mohi bar̤ mūr̤h kahai kin koū

verses.sa:
मनि बिनु फनि जिमि जल बिनु मीना ।
मम जीवन तिमि तुम्हहि अधीना ॥
verses.tr:
mani binu phani jimi jal binu mīnā
mam jīvan timi tumhahi adhīnā

verses.sa:
अस बरु मागि चरन गहि रहेऊ ।
एवमस्तु करुनानिधि कहेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
as baru māgi caran gahi raheū
evamastu karunānidhi kaheū

verses.sa:
अब तुम्ह मम अनुसासन मानी ।
बसहु जाइ सुरपति रजधानी ॥
verses.tr:
ab tumh mam anusāsan mānī
basahu jāi surapati rajadhānī

verses.sa:
तहँ करि भोग बिसाल तात गउँ कछु काल पुनि ।
होइहहु अवध भुआल तब मैं होब तुम्हार सुत ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ kari bhog bisāl tāt gaum̐ kachu kāl puni
hoihahu avadh bhuāl tab maiṃ hob tumhār sut
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearing this modest and deeply touching petition, the Compassionate gently replied:—‘Fear not; whatever your mind desires that [ have granted. O mother, your supernatural wisdom by my favour shall never fail.” Then again spoke Manu, bowing at his feet,—“ I too have another petition, my lord. Is there any one who will not call me fool for devoting myself to your feet simply on account of a son As a snake’s hood without a jewel, or a fish without water, so is my life dependent upon you.” Begging this boon, he remained clasping his feet till the All-merciful said,—“ Be it so: now, as I order, go and dwell at Indra’s capital.
There, father, enjoy yourself freely; and again, when some time has passed, be born as the King of Avadh, and I will be your son.

sections.label: Doha 152
sections.name: यह इतिहास पुनीत अति उमहि कही बृषकेतु

verses.sa:
इच्छामय नरबेष सँवारें ।
होइहउँ प्रगट निकेत तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
icchāmaya narabeṣ sam̐vāreṃ
hoihaum̐ pragaṭ niket tumhāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अंसन्ह सहित देह धरि ताता ।
करिहउँ चरित भगत सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
aṃsanh sahit deh dhari tātā
karihaum̐ carit bhagat sukhadātā

verses.sa:
जे सुनि सादर नर बड़भागी ।
भव तरिहहिं ममता मद त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
je suni sādar nar bar̤abhāgī
bhav tarihahiṃ mamatā mad tyāgī

verses.sa:
आदिसक्ति जेहिं जग उपजाया ।
सोउ अवतरिहि मोरि यह माया ॥
verses.tr:
ādisakti jehiṃ jag upajāyā
sou avatarihi mori yah māyā

verses.sa:
पुरउब मैं अभिलाष तुम्हारा ।
सत्य सत्य पन सत्य हमारा ॥
verses.tr:
puraub maiṃ abhilāṣ tumhārā
satya satya pan satya hamārā

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि अस कहि कृपानिधाना ।
अंतरधान भए भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni as kahi kṛpānidhānā
aṃtaradhān bhae bhagavānā

verses.sa:
दंपति उर धरि भगत कृपाला ।
तेहिं आश्रम निवसे कछु काला ॥
verses.tr:
daṃpati ur dhari bhagat kṛpālā
tehiṃ āśram nivase kachu kālā

verses.sa:
समय पाइ तनु तजि अनयासा ।
जाइ कीन्ह अमरावति बासा ॥
verses.tr:
samaya pāi tanu taji anayāsā
jāi kīnh amarāvati bāsā

verses.sa:
यह इतिहास पुनीत अति उमहि कही बृषकेतु ।
भरद्वाज सुनु अपर पुनि राम जनम कर हेतु ॥
verses.tr:
yah itihās punīt ati umahi kahī bṛṣaketu
bharadvāj sunu apar puni rām janam kar hetu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Voluntarily assuming human guise, I will manifest myself in your house, father, and, with every element of my divinity incarnate will do great deeds for the consolation of my people. Blessed are they who listen reverently; quitting the vain conceits of self they shall pass over the ocean of life, Even the Primal Energy, by whom the visible world was created, that self-same shadow of me here present, shall also become incarnate. I will accomplish your desire; true is my promise, true, aye! true.” Again and again thus saying, the compassionate lord vanished out. of sight, and the wedded pair, full of faith in the All-merciful, stayed for u while at the hermitage, and then, when their time was come, passed painlessly out of the body and took up their abode in Amaravati, the city of the immortals.
Such was the pious legend which Siva related to Uma. Hearken now, O Bharadveja, to yet another motive for Rama’s incarnation.

sections.label: Doha 153
sections.name: जब प्रतापरबि भयउ नृप फिरी दोहाई देस

verses.sa:
सुनु मुनि कथा पुनीत पुरानी ।
जो गिरिजा प्रति संभु बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu muni kathā punīt purānī
jo girijā prati saṃbhu bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिस्व बिदित एक कैकय देसू ।
सत्यकेतु तहँ बसइ नरेसू ॥
verses.tr:
bisv bidit ek kaikaya desū
satyaketu taham̐ basai naresū

verses.sa:
धरम धुरंधर नीति निधाना ।
तेज प्रताप सील बलवाना ॥
verses.tr:
dharam dhuraṃdhar nīti nidhānā
tej pratāp sīl balavānā

verses.sa:
तेहि कें भए जुगल सुत बीरा ।
सब गुन धाम महा रनधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi keṃ bhae jugal sut bīrā
sab gun dhām mahā ranadhīrā

verses.sa:
राज धनी जो जेठ सुत आही ।
नाम प्रतापभानु अस ताही ॥
verses.tr:
rāj dhanī jo jeṭh sut āhī
nām pratāpabhānu as tāhī

verses.sa:
अपर सुतहि अरिमर्दन नामा ।
भुजबल अतुल अचल संग्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
apar sutahi arimardan nāmā
bhujabal atul acal saṃgrāmā

verses.sa:
भाइहि भाइहि परम समीती ।
सकल दोष छल बरजित प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
bhāihi bhāihi param samītī
sakal doṣ chal barajit prītī

verses.sa:
जेठे सुतहि राज नृप दीन्हा ।
हरि हित आपु गवन बन कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jeṭhe sutahi rāj nṛp dīnhā
hari hit āpu gavan ban kīnhā

verses.sa:
जब प्रतापरबि भयउ नृप फिरी दोहाई देस ।
प्रजा पाल अति बेदबिधि कतहुँ नहीं अघ लेस ॥
verses.tr:
jab pratāparabi bhayau nṛp phirī dohāī des
prajā pāl ati bedabidhi katahum̐ nahīṃ agh les
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Listen, great saint, to the holy and hoary taleasit was repeated by Sambhu to Girije. There is a world-famous country called Kekaya, and Satya-keta was its king. A champion of religion; a storehouse of good policy; great in glory, magnificence, virtue and power. He had two gallant sons, staunch in fight, endowed with every good quality. The elder and the heir to the kingdom was named Prataepabhgon, and the other Ari-mardan, of unequalled strength of arm and like a rock to stand the brunt of battle. The sympathy between brother and brother was perfect, and their mutual affection without either flaw or disguisel. To the elder sun the king resigned the realm, and withdrew into the wood to devote himself to religion.
When Prataipa-bhanu became king, proclamation was made throughout all the land: Under a sovereign so skilled in sacred lord not a speck of sin will be allowed anywhere.

sections.label: Doha 154
sections.name: स्वबस बिस्व करि बाहुबल निज पुर कीन्ह प्रबेसु

verses.sa:
नृप हितकारक सचिव सयाना ।
नाम धरमरुचि सुक्र समाना ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp hitakārak saciv sayānā
nām dharamaruci sukr samānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सचिव सयान बंधु बलबीरा ।
आपु प्रतापपुंज रनधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
saciv sayān baṃdhu balabīrā
āpu pratāpapuṃj ranadhīrā

verses.sa:
सेन संग चतुरंग अपारा ।
अमित सुभट सब समर जुझारा ॥
verses.tr:
sen saṃg caturaṃg apārā
amit subhaṭ sab samar jujhārā

verses.sa:
सेन बिलोकि राउ हरषाना ।
अरु बाजे गहगहे निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
sen biloki rāu haraṣānā
aru bāje gahagahe nisānā

verses.sa:
बिजय हेतु कटकई बनाई ।
सुदिन साधि नृप चलेउ बजाई ॥
verses.tr:
bijaya hetu kaṭakaī banāī
sudin sādhi nṛp caleu bajāī

verses.sa:
जँह तहँ परीं अनेक लराईं ।
जीते सकल भूप बरिआई ॥
verses.tr:
jam̐h taham̐ parīṃ anek larāīṃ
jīte sakal bhūp bariāī

verses.sa:
सप्त दीप भुजबल बस कीन्हे ।
लै लै दंड छाड़ि नृप दीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
sapt dīp bhujabal bas kīnhe
lai lai daṃḍ chār̤i nṛp dīnheṃ

verses.sa:
सकल अवनि मंडल तेहि काला ।
एक प्रतापभानु महिपाला ॥
verses.tr:
sakal avani maṃḍal tehi kālā
ek pratāpabhānu mahipālā

verses.sa:
स्वबस बिस्व करि बाहुबल निज पुर कीन्ह प्रबेसु ।
अरथ धरम कामादि सुख सेवइ समयँ नरेसु ॥
verses.tr:
svabas bisv kari bāhubal nij pur kīnh prabesu
arath dharam kāmādi sukh sevai samayam̐ naresu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The prime minister, Dharma-ruchi, a second Sukra?, was as devoted to the king as he was wise. With a prudent counsellor, valiant kinsmen, himself a glorious leader in war, with a countless host of horse and foot, and chariots and elephants, and fighting men beyond number, all eager for the fray, the king might well rejoice as he inspected his army ‘mid the clash of tumultuous music.

Having selected an auspicious day, he marched forth with a special force, bent on universal conquest. In all his numerous battles, wherever they took place, the pride of kings was abased; all the seven continents were reduced by the might of his arm, and their princes escaped only on payment of tribute. At that time Pratapabhano became the sole monarch of the whole round world.
Having thus subdued the universe by the might of his arm, he re-entered his capital and devoted himself in turn to business, duty, love and religion.

sections.label: Doha 155
sections.name: जँह लगि कहे पुरान श्रुति एक एक सब जाग

verses.sa:
भूप प्रतापभानु बल पाई ।
कामधेनु भै भूमि सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp pratāpabhānu bal pāī
kāmadhenu bhai bhūmi suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सब दुख बरजित प्रजा सुखारी ।
धरमसील सुंदर नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
sab dukh barajit prajā sukhārī
dharamasīl suṃdar nar nārī

verses.sa:
सचिव धरमरुचि हरि पद प्रीती ।
नृप हित हेतु सिखव नित नीती ॥
verses.tr:
saciv dharamaruci hari pad prītī
nṛp hit hetu sikhav nit nītī

verses.sa:
गुर सुर संत पितर महिदेवा ।
करइ सदा नृप सब कै सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
gur sur saṃt pitar mahidevā
karai sadā nṛp sab kai sevā

verses.sa:
भूप धरम जे बेद बखाने ।
सकल करइ सादर सुख माने ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp dharam je bed bakhāne
sakal karai sādar sukh māne

verses.sa:
दिन प्रति देह बिबिध बिधि दाना ।
सुनहु सास्त्र बर बेद पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
din prati deh bibidh bidhi dānā
sunahu sāstr bar bed purānā

verses.sa:
नाना बापीं कूप तड़ागा ।
सुमन बाटिका सुंदर बागा ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bāpīṃ kūp tar̤āgā
suman bāṭikā suṃdar bāgā

verses.sa:
बिप्रभवन सुरभवन सुहाए ।
सब तीरथन्ह बिचित्र बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
biprabhavan surabhavan suhāe
sab tīrathanh bicitr banāe

verses.sa:
जँह लगि कहे पुरान श्रुति एक एक सब जाग ।
बार सहस्त्र सहस्त्र नृप किए सहित अनुराग ॥
verses.tr:
jam̐h lagi kahe purān śruti ek ek sab jāg
bār sahastr sahastr nṛp kie sahit anurāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The grateful earth, invigorated by Pratapabhanno’s sway, became a very Kemadhenn, and all his subjects, both men and women, happy and free from all annoy, grew in virtue and beauty. The minister Dharma-ruchi, devoted servant of Hari, lovingly instructed his Lord in state policy; nor did the king ever fail in due reverence either to his spiritual teacher, or the gods, or the saints, or his departed ancestors, or the Brahmans. All the duties which are enjoined upon kings inthe Veda he carefully and gladly performed; every day he made large offerings and heard the scriptures read, both the Veda and the Puranas; and he constructed many baths and wells and tanks, flower gardens and beautiful orchards, handsome monasteries and temples, and also restored every ancient shrine,
For every single sacrifice enjoined in the scriptures or the Puranas the king in his zeal performed a thousand.

sections.label: Doha 156
sections.name: नील महीधर सिखर सम देखि बिसाल बराहु

verses.sa:
हृदयँ न कछु फल अनुसंधाना ।
भूप बिबेकी परम सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ na kachu phal anusaṃdhānā
bhūp bibekī param sujānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करइ जे धरम करम मन बानी ।
बासुदेव अर्पित नृप ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
karai je dharam karam man bānī
bāsudev arpit nṛp gyānī

verses.sa:
चढ़ि बर बाजि बार एक राजा ।
मृगया कर सब साजि समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
car̤hi bar bāji bār ek rājā
mṛgayā kar sab sāji samājā

verses.sa:
बिंध्याचल गभीर बन गयऊ ।
मृग पुनीत बहु मारत भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
biṃdhyācal gabhīr ban gayaū
mṛg punīt bahu mārat bhayaū

verses.sa:
फिरत बिपिन नृप दीख बराहू ।
जनु बन दुरेउ ससिहि ग्रसि राहू ॥
verses.tr:
phirat bipin nṛp dīkh barāhū
janu ban dureu sasihi grasi rāhū

verses.sa:
बड़ बिधु नहि समात मुख माहीं ।
मनहुँ क्रोधबस उगिलत नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤ bidhu nahi samāt mukh māhīṃ
manahum̐ krodhabas ugilat nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
कोल कराल दसन छबि गाई ।
तनु बिसाल पीवर अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
kol karāl dasan chabi gāī
tanu bisāl pīvar adhikāī

verses.sa:
घुरुघुरात हय आरौ पाएँ ।
चकित बिलोकत कान उठाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
ghurughurāt haya ārau pāem̐
cakit bilokat kān uṭhāem̐

verses.sa:
नील महीधर सिखर सम देखि बिसाल बराहु ।
चपरि चलेउ हय सुटुकि नृप हाँकि न होइ निबाहु ॥
verses.tr:
nīl mahīdhar sikhar sam dekhi bisāl barāhu
capari caleu haya suṭuki nṛp hām̐ki na hoi nibāhu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In his heart there was no aiming after advantage, but such was his supreme knowledge and intelligence that he dedicated to God the whole merit of all his thoughts, words, and actions. One day he mounted his gallant steed and went, with his retinue equipt for the chase, into a dense forest of the Vindhyachal mountains and killed many fine deer. As he ranged the wood, he spied a wild boar, showing amid the foliage like Reba with the moon in his clutch; its orb too large to be containedin his mouth, though his rage will not suffer him to entirely disgorge it. The monstrous boar with its splendid tusks, as I have described them, and its vast limbs of immeasurable bulk, growled when he heard the tramp of the horse: it, too, at the sight started and pricked up its ears.
_ On seeing the huge boar, resembling some purple mountain-peak, the horse started aside, and it was only by much spurring and persuasion that the king could prevent it from breaking away.

sections.label: Doha 157
sections.name: खेद खिन्न छुद्धित तृषित राजा बाजि समेत

verses.sa:
आवत देखि अधिक रव बाजी ।
चलेउ बराह मरुत गति भाजी ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dekhi adhik rav bājī
caleu barāh marut gati bhājī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तुरत कीन्ह नृप सर संधाना ।
महि मिलि गयउ बिलोकत बाना ॥
verses.tr:
turat kīnh nṛp sar saṃdhānā
mahi mili gayau bilokat bānā

verses.sa:
तकि तकि तीर महीस चलावा ।
करि छल सुअर सरीर बचावा ॥
verses.tr:
taki taki tīr mahīs calāvā
kari chal suar sarīr bacāvā

verses.sa:
प्रगटत दुरत जाइ मृग भागा ।
रिस बस भूप चलेउ संग लागा ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭat durat jāi mṛg bhāgā
ris bas bhūp caleu saṃg lāgā

verses.sa:
गयउ दूरि घन गहन बराहू ।
जहँ नाहिन गज बाजि निबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
gayau dūri ghan gahan barāhū
jaham̐ nāhin gaj bāji nibāhū

verses.sa:
अति अकेल बन बिपुल कलेसू ।
तदपि न मृग मग तजइ नरेसू ॥
verses.tr:
ati akel ban bipul kalesū
tadapi na mṛg mag tajai naresū

verses.sa:
कोल बिलोकि भूप बड़ धीरा ।
भागि पैठ गिरिगुहाँ गभीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kol biloki bhūp bar̤ dhīrā
bhāgi paiṭh giriguhām̐ gabhīrā

verses.sa:
अगम देखि नृप अति पछिताई ।
फिरेउ महाबन परेउ भुलाई ॥
verses.tr:
agam dekhi nṛp ati pachitāī
phireu mahāban pareu bhulāī

verses.sa:
खेद खिन्न छुद्धित तृषित राजा बाजि समेत ।
खोजत ब्याकुल सरित सर जल बिनु भयउ अचेत ॥
verses.tr:
khed khinn chuddhit tṛṣit rājā bāji samet
khojat byākul sarit sar jal binu bhayau acet
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When it suw the horse coming on with speed, the beast took to flight swift as the wind, keeping close to the ground as it went, and ever regarding the shaft which the king had at once fitted to his bow. Taking steady aim he let it fly; but the boar saved himself by his wiliness, and rushed on now well in sight, and now altogether hidden, while the king in much excitement follow closely on his track. At length it reached a dense thicket impenetrable by horse or elephant, Though alone in the wood and distressed by his exertions, still the king would not abandon the chase; till the boar seeing him so determined slunk away into a deep cave. When the king perceived that there was no getting near him, he was quite sad, and moreover he had Lost his way in this hunt through so great a forest.
Hungry and thirsty and exhausted with fatigue the king and his horse kept searching in much distress for a stream or pond, and were half dead for want of water.

sections.label: Doha 158
sections.name: भूपति तृषित बिलोकि तेहिं सरबरु दीन्ह देखाइ

verses.sa:
फिरत बिपिन आश्रम एक देखा ।
तहँ बस नृपति कपट मुनिबेषा ॥
verses.tr:
phirat bipin āśram ek dekhā
taham̐ bas nṛpati kapaṭ munibeṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जासु देस नृप लीन्ह छड़ाई ।
समर सेन तजि गयउ पराई ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu des nṛp līnh char̤āī
samar sen taji gayau parāī

verses.sa:
समय प्रतापभानु कर जानी ।
आपन अति असमय अनुमानी ॥
verses.tr:
samaya pratāpabhānu kar jānī
āpan ati asamaya anumānī

verses.sa:
गयउ न गृह मन बहुत गलानी ।
मिला न राजहि नृप अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
gayau na gṛh man bahut galānī
milā na rājahi nṛp abhimānī

verses.sa:
रिस उर मारि रंक जिमि राजा ।
बिपिन बसइ तापस कें साजा ॥
verses.tr:
ris ur māri raṃk jimi rājā
bipin basai tāpas keṃ sājā

verses.sa:
तासु समीप गवन नृप कीन्हा ।
यह प्रतापरबि तेहि तब चीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu samīp gavan nṛp kīnhā
yah pratāparabi tehi tab cīnhā

verses.sa:
राउ तृषित नहि सो पहिचाना ।
देखि सुबेष महामुनि जाना ॥
verses.tr:
rāu tṛṣit nahi so pahicānā
dekhi subeṣ mahāmuni jānā
