The king of Avadh was named Dasarath, the jewel of the line of Raghu, well skilled in the Vedas, virtuous and wise, a defender of the faith, a sincere votary of Vishnu.
Kausalya and his other loving queens were all of holy life, faithful and affectionate to their lord, and full of humble devotion to Hari’s lotus feet.

sections.label: Doha 189
sections.name: तब अदृस्य भए पावक सकल सभहि समुझाइ

verses.sa:
एक बार भूपति मन माहीं ।
भै गलानि मोरें सुत नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār bhūpati man māhīṃ
bhai galāni moreṃ sut nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गुर गृह गयउ तुरत महिपाला ।
चरन लागि करि बिनय बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
gur gṛh gayau turat mahipālā
caran lāgi kari binaya bisālā

verses.sa:
निज दुख सुख सब गुरहि सुनायउ ।
कहि बसिष्ठ बहुबिधि समुझायउ ॥
verses.tr:
nij dukh sukh sab gurahi sunāyau
kahi basiṣṭh bahubidhi samujhāyau

verses.sa:
धरहु धीर होइहहिं सुत चारी ।
त्रिभुवन बिदित भगत भय हारी ॥
verses.tr:
dharahu dhīr hoihahiṃ sut cārī
tribhuvan bidit bhagat bhaya hārī

verses.sa:
सृंगी रिषहि बसिष्ठ बोलावा ।
पुत्रकाम सुभ जग्य करावा ॥
verses.tr:
sṛṃgī riṣahi basiṣṭh bolāvā
putrakām subh jagya karāvā

verses.sa:
भगति सहित मुनि आहुति दीन्हें ।
प्रगटे अगिनि चरू कर लीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati sahit muni āhuti dīnheṃ
pragaṭe agini carū kar līnheṃ

verses.sa:
जो बसिष्ठ कछु हृदयँ बिचारा ।
सकल काजु भा सिद्ध तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
jo basiṣṭh kachu hṛdayam̐ bicārā
sakal kāju bhā siddh tumhārā

verses.sa:
यह हबि बाँटि देहु नृप जाई ।
जथा जोग जेहि भाग बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
yah habi bām̐ṭi dehu nṛp jāī
jathā jog jehi bhāg banāī

verses.sa: तब अदृस्य भए पावक सकल सभहि समुझाइ ॥
verses.tr: tab adṛsya bhae pāvak sakal sabhahi samujhāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: परमानंद मगन नृप हरष न हृदयँ समाइ ॥
verses.tr: paramānaṃd magan nṛp haraṣ na hṛdayam̐ samāi

trans: One day the king was sad that he had no son, and going in haste to his guru's abode fell at his feet with many entreaties and told him all his joysand sorrows. Vasishta in reply comforted him in every way,—‘ Take courage, you will have four sons, who will be famous throughout the three worlds and rid the faithful of all their fears.” Then Vasishta summoned Saint Sringi to perform a sacrifice for the birth of a son, The saint devoutly offered the oblation, and the fire-god appeared with the offering in his hand and cried in gracious tones,—‘“I am pleased more than I can say; whatever Vasishta has imagined in his heart is all granted for your good. Take this oblation, O king, and divide it in such proportions as is proper.
Then the fire-god vanished, after telling them all of all that had to be done. The king was transported with ecstacy and could not contain himself for joy.

sections.label: Doha 190
sections.name: जोग लगन ग्रह बार तिथि सकल भए अनुकूल

verses.sa:
तबहिं रायँ प्रिय नारि बोलाईं ।
कौसल्यादि तहाँ चलि आई ॥
verses.tr:
tabahiṃ rāyam̐ priya nāri bolāīṃ
kausalyādi tahām̐ cali āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अर्ध भाग कौसल्याहि दीन्हा ।
उभय भाग आधे कर कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ardh bhāg kausalyāhi dīnhā
ubhaya bhāg ādhe kar kīnhā

verses.sa:
कैकेई कहँ नृप सो दयऊ ।
रह्यो सो उभय भाग पुनि भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kaikeī kaham̐ nṛp so dayaū
rahyo so ubhaya bhāg puni bhayaū

verses.sa:
कौसल्या कैकेई हाथ धरि ।
दीन्ह सुमित्रहि मन प्रसन्न करि ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā kaikeī hāth dhari
dīnh sumitrahi man prasann kari

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि गर्भसहित सब नारी ।
भईं हृदयँ हरषित सुख भारी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi garbhasahit sab nārī
bhaīṃ hṛdayam̐ haraṣit sukh bhārī

verses.sa:
जा दिन तें हरि गर्भहिं आए ।
सकल लोक सुख संपति छाए ॥
verses.tr:
jā din teṃ hari garbhahiṃ āe
sakal lok sukh saṃpati chāe

verses.sa:
मंदिर महँ सब राजहिं रानी ।
सोभा सील तेज की खानीं ॥
verses.tr:
maṃdir maham̐ sab rājahiṃ rānī
sobhā sīl tej kī khānīṃ

verses.sa:
सुख जुत कछुक काल चलि गयऊ ।
जेहिं प्रभु प्रगट सो अवसर भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sukh jut kachuk kāl cali gayaū
jehiṃ prabhu pragaṭ so avasar bhayaū

verses.sa:
जोग लगन ग्रह बार तिथि सकल भए अनुकूल ।
चर अरु अचर हर्षजुत राम जनम सुखमूल ॥
verses.tr:
jog lagan grah bār tithi sakal bhae anukūl
car aru acar harṣajut rām janam sukhamūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He at once sent for his loving wives, and Kausalya and the others came, To Kausalya he gave a half share, and of the remaining half he made two portions, one of which he offered to Kaikeyi; what remained he again divided into two, which he placed in the hands of Kausalya and Kaikeyi, and they gave them to SumitrA, to her great delight. In this manner all the queens became pregnant, and they grew glad of heart with exceeding joy. From the day that Hari was conceived in their womb the whole world was fulfilled with happiness and prosperity, and the queens shone resplendent in the palace, full of beauty, virtue and glory. Some little time was thus happily spent, till the day arrived for the Lord to be revealed.

Auspicious was the conjunction of the planets inan auspicious house; auspicious the moment; auspicious the day of the week and of the month; and full of delight was all creation, animate and inanimate, when Rama, father of delights, was born.

sections.label: Doha 191
sections.name: सुर समूह बिनती करि पहुँचे निज निज धाम

verses.sa:
नौमी तिथि मधु मास पुनीता ।
सुकल पच्छ अभिजित हरिप्रीता ॥
verses.tr:
naumī tithi madhu mās punītā
sukal pacch abhijit hariprītā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मध्यदिवस अति सीत न घामा ।
पावन काल लोक बिश्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
madhyadivas ati sīt na ghāmā
pāvan kāl lok biśrāmā

verses.sa:
सीतल मंद सुरभि बह बाऊ ।
हरषित सुर संतन मन चाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sītal maṃd surabhi bah bāū
haraṣit sur saṃtan man cāū

verses.sa:
बन कुसुमित गिरिगन मनिआरा ।
स्त्रवहिं सकल सरिताऽमृतधारा ॥
verses.tr:
ban kusumit girigan maniārā
stravahiṃ sakal saritā'mṛtadhārā

verses.sa:
सो अवसर बिरंचि जब जाना ।
चले सकल सुर साजि बिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
so avasar biraṃci jab jānā
cale sakal sur sāji bimānā

verses.sa:
गगन बिमल सकुल सुर जूथा ।
गावहिं गुन गंधर्ब बरूथा ॥
verses.tr:
gagan bimal sakul sur jūthā
gāvahiṃ gun gaṃdharb barūthā

verses.sa:
बरषहिं सुमन सुअंजलि साजी ।
गहगहि गगन दुंदुभी बाजी ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣahiṃ suman suaṃjali sājī
gahagahi gagan duṃdubhī bājī

verses.sa:
अस्तुति करहिं नाग मुनि देवा ।
बहुबिधि लावहिं निज निज सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
astuti karahiṃ nāg muni devā
bahubidhi lāvahiṃ nij nij sevā

verses.sa:
सुर समूह बिनती करि पहुँचे निज निज धाम ।
जगनिवास प्रभु प्रगटे अखिल लोक बिश्राम ॥
verses.tr:
sur samūh binatī kari pahum̐ce nij nij dhām
jaganivās prabhu pragaṭe akhil lok biśrām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On the ninth day of the sweet and holy month of Chait; in the bright lunar fortnight; under Abhijit, his favourite constellation; on a seasonable day neither hot nor gold, a holy time of rest for all; with soft, cool, fragrant breezes blowing; midst the delight of gods and heartfelt rapture of the saints; while the woods were full of blossoms as the hills with gems, and every river flowed a stream of nectar. When the Creator saw the time so fit, all the gods had their chariots equipped and came forth. The bright heaven was crowded with the host of them; troops of Gandharvas chanted heroic lays; flowers were rained down by handfuls; the sky resounded with the beat of kettle-drums; serpents, saints and gods hymned his praises, and each in his own fashion tendered him service.
Thus meekly did all the gods return to their several abodes when the Lord was revealed, who is the abode of the world, and in whom all the world finds rest,

sections.label: Doha 192
sections.name: बिप्र धेनु सुर संत हित लीन्ह मनुज अवतार

verses.sa:
भए प्रगट कृपाला दीनदयाला कौसल्या हितकारी ।
हरषित महतारी मुनि मन हारी अद्भुत रूप बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
bhae pragaṭ kṛpālā dīnadayālā kausalyā hitakārī
haraṣit mahatārī muni man hārī adbhut rūp bicārī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
लोचन अभिरामा तनु घनस्यामा निज आयुध भुज चारी ।
भूषन बनमाला नयन बिसाला सोभासिंधु खरारी ॥
verses.tr:
locan abhirāmā tanu ghanasyāmā nij āyudh bhuj cārī
bhūṣan banamālā nayan bisālā sobhāsiṃdhu kharārī

verses.sa:
कह दुइ कर जोरी अस्तुति तोरी केहि बिधि करौं अनंता ।
माया गुन ग्यानातीत अमाना बेद पुरान भनंता ॥
verses.tr:
kah dui kar jorī astuti torī kehi bidhi karauṃ anaṃtā
māyā gun gyānātīt amānā bed purān bhanaṃtā

verses.sa:
करुना सुख सागर सब गुन आगर जेहि गावहिं श्रुति संता ।
सो मम हित लागी जन अनुरागी भयउ प्रगट श्रीकंता ॥
verses.tr:
karunā sukh sāgar sab gun āgar jehi gāvahiṃ śruti saṃtā
so mam hit lāgī jan anurāgī bhayau pragaṭ śrīkaṃtā

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मांड निकाया निर्मित माया रोम रोम प्रति बेद कहै ।
मम उर सो बासी यह उपहासी सुनत धीर पति थिर न रहै ॥
verses.tr:
brahmāṃḍ nikāyā nirmit māyā rom rom prati bed kahai
mam ur so bāsī yah upahāsī sunat dhīr pati thir na rahai

verses.sa:
उपजा जब ग्याना प्रभु मुसकाना चरित बहुत बिधि कीन्ह चहै ।
कहि कथा सुहाई मातु बुझाई जेहि प्रकार सुत प्रेम लहै ॥
verses.tr:
upajā jab gyānā prabhu musakānā carit bahut bidhi kīnh cahai
kahi kathā suhāī mātu bujhāī jehi prakār sut prem lahai

verses.sa:
माता पुनि बोली सो मति डौली तजहु तात यह रूपा ।
कीजै सिसुलीला अति प्रियसीला यह सुख परम अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
mātā puni bolī so mati ḍaulī tajahu tāt yah rūpā
kījai sisulīlā ati priyasīlā yah sukh param anūpā

verses.sa:
सुनि बचन सुजाना रोदन ठाना होइ बालक सुरभूपा ।
यह चरित जे गावहिं हरिपद पावहिं ते न परहिं भवकूपा ॥
verses.tr:
suni bacan sujānā rodan ṭhānā hoi bālak surabhūpā
yah carit je gāvahiṃ haripad pāvahiṃ te na parahiṃ bhavakūpā

verses.sa:
बिप्र धेनु सुर संत हित लीन्ह मनुज अवतार ।
निज इच्छा निर्मित तनु माया गुन गो पार ॥
verses.tr:
bipr dhenu sur saṃt hit līnh manuj avatār
nij icchā nirmit tanu māyā gun go pār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: From Kausalya’s blessed womb the great god at last has come, in response to a lost world’s plaiat,
And she gazes with what joy on the face of her dear boy, that would rapture the soul of a saint.
A vision of delight, with his eyes so large and bright, and this body as a cloud dark and grand,
By the garland on his breast and his four arms confest Khareri, with a weapon in each hand.
With fingers locked in prayer she cries,—‘ How may I dare, O lord god immortal, thy boundless praise to tell,
Far above the world’s confusion and reason’s vain intru-sion, whom all] the scriptures witness incomprehensible.
Whom saints and holy sages have hymned through all the ages, the fountain compassion, the source of every grace,
Who aye with Lakshmi reignest, thou, even thou, now deignest to be my son and succour thy sore-tried chosen race,
Though we know by revelation, heaven and earth and all creation, in each hair upon thy body may be found,
In my arms thou sweetly dreamest, O mystery supremest, far beyond the comprehension of a sage the most _profound.”
Smiled the lord at her devotion and would fain have set in motion the magic that dazzles the crowd,
Telling all he had done and the triumphs he had won that his mother of her son might be proud.
But hurriedly she cried,—“ My soul is terrified by these marvels, disperse them from my sight;
Let me see thee as a child, disporting free and wild, for in this is my greatest delight.”
She spoke and he obeyed, and at once in fashion made as un infant began to cry.
Know that all who sing this lay, and in faith to Hari pray, shall in peace rest for ever when they die.
For the sake of Brahmans, cows and gods and saints he took birth as a man, in a body formed at his own will, be who is beyond all form, or quality, or perception of the senses.

sections.label: Doha 193
sections.name: नंदीमुख सराध करि जातकरम सब कीन्ह

verses.sa:
सुनि सिसु रुदन परम प्रिय बानी ।
संभ्रम चलि आई सब रानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni sisu rudan param priya bānī
saṃbhram cali āī sab rānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हरषित जहँ तहँ धाईं दासी ।
आनँद मगन सकल पुरबासी ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣit jaham̐ taham̐ dhāīṃ dāsī
ānam̐d magan sakal purabāsī

verses.sa:
दसरथ पुत्रजन्म सुनि काना ।
मानहुँ ब्रह्मानंद समाना ॥
verses.tr:
dasarath putrajanm suni kānā
mānahum̐ brahmānaṃd samānā

verses.sa:
परम प्रेम मन पुलक सरीरा ।
चाहत उठत करत मति धीरा ॥
verses.tr:
param prem man pulak sarīrā
cāhat uṭhat karat mati dhīrā

verses.sa:
जाकर नाम सुनत सुभ होई ।
मोरें गृह आवा प्रभु सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jākar nām sunat subh hoī
moreṃ gṛh āvā prabhu soī

verses.sa:
परमानंद पूरि मन राजा ।
कहा बोलाइ बजावहु बाजा ॥
verses.tr:
paramānaṃd pūri man rājā
kahā bolāi bajāvahu bājā

verses.sa:
गुर बसिष्ठ कहँ गयउ हँकारा ।
आए द्विजन सहित नृपद्वारा ॥
verses.tr:
gur basiṣṭh kaham̐ gayau ham̐kārā
āe dvijan sahit nṛpadvārā

verses.sa:
अनुपम बालक देखेन्हि जाई ।
रूप रासि गुन कहि न सिराई ॥
verses.tr:
anupam bālak dekhenhi jāī
rūp rāsi gun kahi na sirāī

verses.sa:
नंदीमुख सराध करि जातकरम सब कीन्ह ।
हाटक धेनु बसन मनि नृप बिप्रन्ह कहँ दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
naṃdīmukh sarādh kari jātakaram sab kīnh
hāṭak dhenu basan mani nṛp bipranh kaham̐ dīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing the delightful sound of a baby’s cries, all the queens came greatly agitated; their glad handmaids ran hither and thither and all the people of the city were drowned in joy. When Dasarath knew he had a son born, his Joy was like that of the blest in heaven; with his soul full of love and his body quivering with delight he sought to rise, but could not till he had collected himself,—“ The lord, whose very name it is bliss to hear, has come to my house.” Thus rejoicing at heart the king sent for minstrels to play, and next summoned the guru Vasishta, who came to the court with a train of Brahmans. He went and gazed upon the peerless babe, but its beauty and grace were beyond words to tell].
Then after performing the Nandi-mukh Srdddh he completed every caste observance, and the king made offerings to the Brahmans of gold, cows, plates and jewels.

sections.label: Doha 194
sections.name: गृह गृह बाज बधाव सुभ प्रगटे सुषमा कंद

verses.sa:
ध्वज पताक तोरन पुर छावा ।
कहि न जाइ जेहि भाँति बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
dhvaj patāk toran pur chāvā
kahi na jāi jehi bhām̐ti banāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुमनबृष्टि अकास तें होई ।
ब्रह्मानंद मगन सब लोई ॥
verses.tr:
sumanabṛṣṭi akās teṃ hoī
brahmānaṃd magan sab loī

verses.sa:
बृंद बृंद मिलि चलीं लोगाई ।
सहज संगार किएँ उठि धाई ॥
verses.tr:
bṛṃd bṛṃd mili calīṃ logāī
sahaj saṃgār kiem̐ uṭhi dhāī

verses.sa:
कनक कलस मंगल धरि थारा ।
गावत पैठहिं भूप दुआरा ॥
verses.tr:
kanak kalas maṃgal dhari thārā
gāvat paiṭhahiṃ bhūp duārā

verses.sa:
करि आरति नेवछावरि करहीं ।
बार बार सिसु चरनन्हि परहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kari ārati nevachāvari karahīṃ
bār bār sisu carananhi parahīṃ

verses.sa:
मागध सूत बंदिगन गायक ।
पावन गुन गावहिं रघुनायक ॥
verses.tr:
māgadh sūt baṃdigan gāyak
pāvan gun gāvahiṃ raghunāyak

verses.sa:
सर्बस दान दीन्ह सब काहू ।
जेहिं पावा राखा नहिं ताहू ॥
verses.tr:
sarbas dān dīnh sab kāhū
jehiṃ pāvā rākhā nahiṃ tāhū

verses.sa:
मृगमद चंदन कुंकुम कीचा ।
मची सकल बीथिन्ह बिच बीचा ॥
verses.tr:
mṛgamad caṃdan kuṃkum kīcā
macī sakal bīthinh bic bīcā

verses.sa:
गृह गृह बाज बधाव सुभ प्रगटे सुषमा कंद ।
हरषवंत सब जहँ तहँ नगर नारि नर बृंद ॥
verses.tr:
gṛh gṛh bāj badhāv subh pragaṭe suṣamā kaṃd
haraṣavaṃt sab jaham̐ taham̐ nagar nāri nar bṛṃd
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The city was full of flags and banners and festal wreaths arranged in a manner that defies description. Showers of flowers from heaven and every soul was rapt in bliss. There was a concourse of troopsof women who had come running io their ordinary dress just as they were at the time, with golden vases and salvers laden with things of good omen, singing as they entered the king’s court. After passing their offerings round and round over the child’s head, they strew them on the ground, and again and again throw themselves at his feet, while bards and minstrels, singing men and choristers chant the solemn praises of Raghunath. Every one made an offering of all that he had, and no one kept what was given him; while musk, sandal and saffron were thrown about in such profusion that the streets were muddy with perfumes.
In every house there was music and the jubilant shout,— ‘fountain of joy has been revealed;” and all the men and women in the city were rejoicing everywhere.

sections.label: Doha 195
sections.name: मास दिवस कर दिवस भा मरम न जानइ कोइ

verses.sa:
कैकयसुता सुमित्रा दोऊ ।
सुंदर सुत जनमत भैं ओऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kaikayasutā sumitrā doū
suṃdar sut janamat bhaiṃ oū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
वह सुख संपति समय समाजा ।
कहि न सकइ सारद अहिराजा ॥
verses.tr:
vah sukh saṃpati samaya samājā
kahi na sakai sārad ahirājā

verses.sa:
अवधपुरी सोहइ एहि भाँती ।
प्रभुहि मिलन आई जनु राती ॥
verses.tr:
avadhapurī sohai ehi bhām̐tī
prabhuhi milan āī janu rātī

verses.sa:
देखि भानू जनु मन सकुचानी ।
तदपि बनी संध्या अनुमानी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi bhānū janu man sakucānī
tadapi banī saṃdhyā anumānī

verses.sa:
अगर धूप बहु जनु अँधिआरी ।
उड़इ अभीर मनहुँ अरुनारी ॥
verses.tr:
agar dhūp bahu janu am̐dhiārī
ur̤ai abhīr manahum̐ arunārī

verses.sa:
मंदिर मनि समूह जनु तारा ।
नृप गृह कलस सो इंदु उदारा ॥
verses.tr:
maṃdir mani samūh janu tārā
nṛp gṛh kalas so iṃdu udārā

verses.sa:
भवन बेदधुनि अति मृदु बानी ।
जनु खग मूखर समयँ जनु सानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhavan bedadhuni ati mṛdu bānī
janu khag mūkhar samayam̐ janu sānī

verses.sa:
कौतुक देखि पतंग भुलाना ।
एक मास तेइँ जात न जाना ॥
verses.tr:
kautuk dekhi pataṃg bhulānā
ek mās teim̐ jāt na jānā

verses.sa:
मास दिवस कर दिवस भा मरम न जानइ कोइ ।
रथ समेत रबि थाकेउ निसा कवन बिधि होइ ॥
verses.tr:
mās divas kar divas bhā maram na jānai koi
rath samet rabi thākeu nisā kavan bidhi hoi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Both Kaikeyi and Sumitra too gave birth to a lovely boy. At that time the joy, the auspiciousness, and the crowds were more than Sarasvati or the serpent king could describe. The city of Avadh was as resplendent as it were Night going to meet her lord. The sun, abashed at the vision, faded into twilight, where the desky clouds of incense were shot through with red gleams of abir: the piles of jewels in the temples were like stars, and the golden pinnacle of the palace as the gracious moon, while the murmuring sound of the muttered Veda in the house was like the evening song of garrulous birds. Gazing upon the spectacle the sun forgot himself, and a whole month passed without his Knowing it.
The day was a month long, but the marvel was noticed of none—while the sun in his chariot stood still at gaze, how could there be any night?

sections.label: Doha 196
sections.name: मन संतोषे सबन्हि के जहँ तहँ देहि असीस

verses.sa:
यह रहस्य काहू नहिं जाना ।
दिन मनि चले करत गुनगाना ॥
verses.tr:
yah rahasya kāhū nahiṃ jānā
din mani cale karat gunagānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि महोत्सव सुर मुनि नागा ।
चले भवन बरनत निज भागा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi mahotsav sur muni nāgā
cale bhavan baranat nij bhāgā

verses.sa:
औरउ एक कहउँ निज चोरी ।
सुनु गिरिजा अति दृढ़ मति तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
aurau ek kahaum̐ nij corī
sunu girijā ati dṛr̤h mati torī

verses.sa:
काक भुसुंडि संग हम दोऊ ।
मनुजरूप जानइ नहिं कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kāk bhusuṃḍi saṃg ham doū
manujarūp jānai nahiṃ koū

verses.sa:
परमानंद प्रेमसुख फूले ।
बीथिन्ह फिरहिं मगन मन भूले ॥
verses.tr:
paramānaṃd premasukh phūle
bīthinh phirahiṃ magan man bhūle

verses.sa:
यह सुभ चरित जान पै सोई ।
कृपा राम कै जापर होई ॥
verses.tr:
yah subh carit jān pai soī
kṛpā rām kai jāpar hoī

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर जो जेहि बिधि आवा ।
दीन्ह भूप जो जेहि मन भावा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar jo jehi bidhi āvā
dīnh bhūp jo jehi man bhāvā

verses.sa:
गज रथ तुरग हेम गो हीरा ।
दीन्हे नृप नानाबिधि चीरा ॥
verses.tr:
gaj rath turag hem go hīrā
dīnhe nṛp nānābidhi cīrā

verses.sa:
मन संतोषे सबन्हि के जहँ तहँ देहि असीस ।
सकल तनय चिर जीवहुँ तुलसिदास के ईस ॥
verses.tr:
man saṃtoṣe sabanhi ke jaham̐ taham̐ dehi asīs
sakal tanaya cir jīvahum̐ tulasidās ke īs
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There was not one who observed the strange event, and at last the sun set still chanting Rama’s praises. The gods, saints and Nagas too, who had witnessed the spectacle, returned home, congratulating themselves on their good fortune. I will even tell you of a deception I practised myself; Hearken, Girije, for I know your steadfast faith. Kekabhusundi and I were there together in human form, without any one knowing it. Full of rapture, love and delight, we roamed about the streets in ecstatic unconsciousness. Only one on whom rests the mercy of R^ma can attain to the knowledge of these acts of ours. At that time the king granted every one his heart’s desire, whatever it might be that he had come for, bestowing on them elephants, carriages, horses, gold, cows, jewels and allsorts of apparel.
All were satisfied from their very heart and invoked blessings upon him, saying,—‘ May all the boys live long,’ those lords of Tulsi Das,

sections.label: Doha 197
sections.name: लच्छन धाम राम प्रिय सकल जगत आधार

verses.sa:
कछुक दिवस बीते एहि भाँती ।
जात न जानिअ दिन अरु राती ॥
verses.tr:
kachuk divas bīte ehi bhām̐tī
jāt na jānia din aru rātī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नामकरन कर अवसरु जानी ।
भूप बोलि पठए मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
nāmakaran kar avasaru jānī
bhūp boli paṭhae muni gyānī

verses.sa:
करि पूजा भूपति अस भाषा ।
धरिअ नाम जो मुनि गुनि राखा ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā bhūpati as bhāṣā
dharia nām jo muni guni rākhā

verses.sa:
इन्ह के नाम अनेक अनूपा ।
मैं नृप कहब स्वमति अनुरूपा ॥
verses.tr:
inh ke nām anek anūpā
maiṃ nṛp kahab svamati anurūpā

verses.sa:
जो आनंद सिंधु सुखरासी ।
सीकर तें त्रैलोक सुपासी ॥
verses.tr:
jo ānaṃd siṃdhu sukharāsī
sīkar teṃ trailok supāsī

verses.sa:
सो सुख धाम राम अस नामा ।
अखिल लोक दायक बिश्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
so sukh dhām rām as nāmā
akhil lok dāyak biśrāmā

verses.sa:
बिस्व भरन पोषन कर जोई ।
ताकर नाम भरत अस होई ॥
verses.tr:
bisv bharan poṣan kar joī
tākar nām bharat as hoī

verses.sa:
जाके सुमिरन तें रिपु नासा ।
नाम सत्रुहन बेद प्रकासा ॥
verses.tr:
jāke sumiran teṃ ripu nāsā
nām satruhan bed prakāsā

verses.sa:
लच्छन धाम राम प्रिय सकल जगत आधार ।
गुरु बसिष्ट तेहि राखा लछिमन नाम उदार ॥
verses.tr:
lacchan dhām rām priya sakal jagat ādhār
guru basiṣṭ tehi rākhā lachiman nām udār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In this manner some days were spent, without any one taking thought of noon or night, till the king, knowing the time had come for naming the children, sent and called the wise seer, and after reverently greeting him thus spake, — ** Holy father, be pleased to declare the names upon which you have secretly determined.” ‘Their names are many and wonderful; I will tell them, O king, to the best of my ability. The store-house of delights, the ocean of joy, by _ whose spray three worlds are gladdened, the very home of bliss, the Comforter of the universe, has for his name Rama (‘ delight ’). The bearer and supporter of the world is named Bharat (‘the supporter’), while he whose very thought brings victory over the foe is celebrated in the Veda by his name Satrughna (‘ destroyer of enemies ’).”
For the auspicious, the beloved of Rama, the stay of the whole world, was reserved by Saint Vasishta the noble name of Lakshman (‘of auspicious appearance ’).

sections.label: Doha 198
sections.name: ब्यापक ब्रह्म निरंजन निर्गुन बिगत बिनोद

verses.sa:
धरे नाम गुर हृदयँ बिचारी ।
बेद तत्व नृप तव सुत चारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhare nām gur hṛdayam̐ bicārī
bed tatv nṛp tav sut cārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मुनि धन जन सरबस सिव प्राना ।
बाल केलि तेहिं सुख माना ॥
verses.tr:
muni dhan jan sarabas siv prānā
bāl keli tehiṃ sukh mānā

verses.sa:
बारेहि ते निज हित पति जानी ।
लछिमन राम चरन रति मानी ॥
verses.tr:
bārehi te nij hit pati jānī
lachiman rām caran rati mānī

verses.sa:
भरत सत्रुहन दूनउ भाई ।
प्रभु सेवक जसि प्रीति बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat satruhan dūnau bhāī
prabhu sevak jasi prīti bar̤āī

verses.sa:
स्याम गौर सुंदर दोउ जोरी ।
निरखहिं छबि जननीं तृन तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
syām gaur suṃdar dou jorī
nirakhahiṃ chabi jananīṃ tṛn torī

verses.sa:
चारिउ सील रूप गुन धामा ।
तदपि अधिक सुखसागर रामा ॥
verses.tr:
cāriu sīl rūp gun dhāmā
tadapi adhik sukhasāgar rāmā

verses.sa:
हृदयँ अनुग्रह इंदु प्रकासा ।
सूचत किरन मनोहर हासा ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ anugrah iṃdu prakāsā
sūcat kiran manohar hāsā

verses.sa:
कबहुँ उछंग कबहुँ बर पलना ।
मातु दुलारइ कहि प्रिय ललना ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐ uchaṃg kabahum̐ bar palanā
mātu dulārai kahi priya lalanā

verses.sa:
ब्यापक ब्रह्म निरंजन निर्गुन बिगत बिनोद ।
सो अज प्रेम भगति बस कौसल्या के गोद ॥
verses.tr:
byāpak brahm niraṃjan nirgun bigat binod
so aj prem bhagati bas kausalyā ke god
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After naming them the saint pondered in heart and said,—‘O king, your four sons are the very Veda itself; the saint’s treasure; the believer’s all in all; the darling of Siva, whois delighted with their childish sports.’ Even from his earliest days Lakshman knew his dear lord and devoted himself to Rama; while the affection of the two other brothers, Bharat and Satrughna, grew also as between master and servant. In both couples one was dark, the other fair; and their mother, as she gazed upon their loveliness, would break a blade of grass to avert the evil eye. Though all four were full of amiability, beauty and intellect, yet Rama was a higher joy; his kindliness of heart was like the bright moon, which manifested itself in the radiance of a most winning smile; while now in the cradle, and now on her lap his mother fondled him and called him
her own dear darling. Doh 210. The omnipresent god, who has neither passion nor qua-

sections.label: Doha 199
sections.name: सुख संदोह मोहपर ग्यान गिरा गोतीत

verses.sa:
काम कोटि छबि स्याम सरीरा ।
नील कंज बारिद गंभीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kām koṭi chabi syām sarīrā
nīl kaṃj bārid gaṃbhīrā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अरुन चरन पकंज नख जोती ।
कमल दलन्हि बैठे जनु मोती ॥
verses.tr:
arun caran pakaṃj nakh jotī
kamal dalanhi baiṭhe janu motī

verses.sa:
रेख कुलिस धवज अंकुर सोहे ।
नूपुर धुनि सुनि मुनि मन मोहे ॥
verses.tr:
rekh kulis dhavaj aṃkur sohe
nūpur dhuni suni muni man mohe

verses.sa:
कटि किंकिनी उदर त्रय रेखा ।
नाभि गभीर जान जेहि देखा ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭi kiṃkinī udar traya rekhā
nābhi gabhīr jān jehi dekhā

verses.sa:
भुज बिसाल भूषन जुत भूरी ।
हियँ हरि नख अति सोभा रूरी ॥
verses.tr:
bhuj bisāl bhūṣan jut bhūrī
hiyam̐ hari nakh ati sobhā rūrī

verses.sa:
उर मनिहार पदिक की सोभा ।
बिप्र चरन देखत मन लोभा ॥
verses.tr:
ur manihār padik kī sobhā
bipr caran dekhat man lobhā

verses.sa:
कंबु कंठ अति चिबुक सुहाई ।
आनन अमित मदन छबि छाई ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃbu kaṃṭh ati cibuk suhāī
ānan amit madan chabi chāī

verses.sa:
दुइ दुइ दसन अधर अरुनारे ।
नासा तिलक को बरनै पारे ॥
verses.tr:
dui dui dasan adhar arunāre
nāsā tilak ko baranai pāre

verses.sa:
सुंदर श्रवन सुचारु कपोला ।
अति प्रिय मधुर तोतरे बोला ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar śravan sucāru kapolā
ati priya madhur totare bolā

verses.sa:
चिक्कन कच कुंचित गभुआरे ।
बहु प्रकार रचि मातु सँवारे ॥
verses.tr:
cikkan kac kuṃcit gabhuāre
bahu prakār raci mātu sam̐vāre

verses.sa:
पीत झगुलिआ तनु पहिराई ।
जानु पानि बिचरनि मोहि भाई ॥
verses.tr:
pīt jhaguliā tanu pahirāī
jānu pāni bicarani mohi bhāī

verses.sa:
रूप सकहिं नहिं कहि श्रुति सेषा ।
सो जानइ सपनेहुँ जेहि देखा ॥
verses.tr:
rūp sakahiṃ nahiṃ kahi śruti seṣā
so jānai sapanehum̐ jehi dekhā

verses.sa:
सुख संदोह मोहपर ग्यान गिरा गोतीत ।
दंपति परम प्रेम बस कर सिसुचरित पुनीत ॥
verses.tr:
sukh saṃdoh mohapar gyān girā gotīt
daṃpati param prem bas kar sisucarit punīt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: lity, nor sensation of pleasure, and who is from everlasting, lay a babe in Kausalya’s arms, overcome by devout affection.

With all the beauty of a myriad loves; dark of hue as the lotus or a heavy rain-cloud; the glistening nails on his rosy feet like clustered pearls on the leaves of the lily; the print of the thunderbolt, the flag and the elephant-goad dis-tinctly to be seen; the tinkling of his anklets enough to charm a saint; with girdled waist and dimpled body and deep navel, such as no one could believe who had not seen; with long arms covered with many jewels and lovely set of tiger’s claws upon his breast; with necklace of gems and sparkling amulet, and soul-ravishing print of the Brahman's feet with shell-marked neck and exquisite chin, and a face flushed with the beauty of all the loves; with wellmatched teeth and raddy lips and nose and furehead-mark beyond description; with. beautiful ears and charming cheeks and lisping prattle most delightful to hear; with eyes dark and full as the lotus, and heavy brows and a fair pendant on his forehead; with lustrous curling hair that his mother was ever delighting to stroke; with his body clothed in little yellow drawers, crawling on knees and hands upon the ground; neither scripture nor Seshnag could do justice to his beauty, nor without a vision could any one imagine it.

The a}l-blissful god, whois above the reach of delusion and transcends all intellect, speech and perception of the senses, became subject to the strong love of his parents and sported like an innocent babe.

sections.label: Doha 200
sections.name: प्रेम मगन कौसल्या निसि दिन जात न जान

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि राम जगत पितु माता ।
कोसलपुर बासिन्ह सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi rām jagat pitu mātā
kosalapur bāsinh sukhadātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिन्ह रघुनाथ चरन रति मानी ।
तिन्ह की यह गति प्रगट भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
jinh raghunāth caran rati mānī
tinh kī yah gati pragaṭ bhavānī

verses.sa:
रघुपति बिमुख जतन कर कोरी ।
कवन सकइ भव बंधन छोरी ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati bimukh jatan kar korī
kavan sakai bhav baṃdhan chorī

verses.sa:
जीव चराचर बस कै राखे ।
सो माया प्रभु सों भय भाखे ॥
verses.tr:
jīv carācar bas kai rākhe
so māyā prabhu soṃ bhaya bhākhe

verses.sa:
भृकुटि बिलास नचावइ ताही ।
अस प्रभु छाड़ि भजिअ कहु काही ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛkuṭi bilās nacāvai tāhī
as prabhu chār̤i bhajia kahu kāhī

verses.sa:
मन क्रम बचन छाड़ि चतुराई ।
भजत कृपा करिहहिं रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
man kram bacan chār̤i caturāī
bhajat kṛpā karihahiṃ raghurāī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सिसुबिनोद प्रभु कीन्हा ।
सकल नगरबासिन्ह सुख दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sisubinod prabhu kīnhā
sakal nagarabāsinh sukh dīnhā

verses.sa:
लै उछंग कबहुँक हलरावै ।
कबहुँ पालनें घालि झुलावै ॥
verses.tr:
lai uchaṃg kabahum̐k halarāvai
kabahum̐ pālaneṃ ghāli jhulāvai

verses.sa:
प्रेम मगन कौसल्या निसि दिन जात न जान ।
सुत सनेह बस माता बालचरित कर गान ॥
verses.tr:
prem magan kausalyā nisi din jāt na jān
sut saneh bas mātā bālacarit kar gān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In this way Rama, the father of the universe, showed himself the delight of the people of Kosala; and they who love their god, O Bhavani, show themselves like his earthly parents. But his enemies, though they struggle for ever, will never extricate themselves from the bonds of existence. The delusive power. that has subdued all life, whether io animate or inanimate creation, trembles before the Lord, who with the play of his eyebrows forces it to dance like a puppet. If we leave such a Lord, whom else can we supplicate? Neither in thought, word nor deed be overwise; god is merciful only to those who pray. Thus the Lord sported us a child, to the delight of all the people of the city; and now his mother would take and dandle him in her arms, and now put him down and rock him in his cradle.
So lost in love that day and night succeeded one another unobserved, while in her fondness for her boy she kept singing to him nursery songs,

sections.label: Doha 201
sections.name: देखरावा मातहि निज अदभुत रुप अखंड

verses.sa:
एक बार जननीं अन्हवाए ।
करि सिंगार पलनाँ पौढ़ाए ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār jananīṃ anhavāe
kari siṃgār palanām̐ paur̤hāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निज कुल इष्टदेव भगवाना ।
पूजा हेतु कीन्ह अस्नाना ॥
verses.tr:
nij kul iṣṭadev bhagavānā
pūjā hetu kīnh asnānā

verses.sa:
करि पूजा नैबेद्य चढ़ावा ।
आपु गई जहँ पाक बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā naibedya car̤hāvā
āpu gaī jaham̐ pāk banāvā

verses.sa:
बहुरि मातु तहवाँ चलि आई ।
भोजन करत देख सुत जाई ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri mātu tahavām̐ cali āī
bhojan karat dekh sut jāī

verses.sa:
गै जननी सिसु पहिं भयभीता ।
देखा बाल तहाँ पुनि सूता ॥
verses.tr:
gai jananī sisu pahiṃ bhayabhītā
dekhā bāl tahām̐ puni sūtā

verses.sa:
बहुरि आइ देखा सुत सोई ।
हृदयँ कंप मन धीर न होई ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri āi dekhā sut soī
hṛdayam̐ kaṃp man dhīr na hoī

verses.sa:
इहाँ उहाँ दुइ बालक देखा ।
मतिभ्रम मोर कि आन बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ uhām̐ dui bālak dekhā
matibhram mor ki ān biseṣā

verses.sa:
देखि राम जननी अकुलानी ।
प्रभु हँसि दीन्ह मधुर मुसुकानी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām jananī akulānī
prabhu ham̐si dīnh madhur musukānī

verses.sa:
देखरावा मातहि निज अदभुत रुप अखंड ।
रोम रोम प्रति लागे कोटि कोटि ब्रह्मंड ॥
verses.tr:
dekharāvā mātahi nij adabhut rup akhaṃḍ
rom rom prati lāge koṭi koṭi brahmaṃḍ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: One day his mother, after washing and dressing him, put him to sleep in his cradle, and prepared an offering for presentation to her partron divinity. When the service was over and she had made her oblation, she returned to the place where she had dressed the food; but when she came there she beheld Rama in the act of eating. In a great fright she ran to the nursery and there found the child again sleeping; but coming back once more she still saw the boy. Then she trembled and was much disturbed in mind, for she saw two children, one here and one there and was utterly bewildered; saying,—‘ Are my senses at fault, or is this a miracle?’ When Rama saw his mother’s distress, he broke out into a merry laugh,
And exhibited to her his whole marvellous form; with a myriad worlds gleaming on each individual hair of his body; Ghaupdi 207.

sections.label: Doha 202
sections.name: बार बार कौसल्या बिनय करइ कर जोरि

verses.sa:
अगनित रबि ससि सिव चतुरानन ।
बहु गिरि सरित सिंधु महि कानन ॥
verses.tr:
aganit rabi sasi siv caturānan
bahu giri sarit siṃdhu mahi kānan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
काल कर्म गुन ग्यान सुभाऊ ।
सोउ देखा जो सुना न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kāl karm gun gyān subhāū
sou dekhā jo sunā na kāū

verses.sa:
देखी माया सब बिधि गाढ़ी ।
अति सभीत जोरें कर ठाढ़ी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhī māyā sab bidhi gār̤hī
ati sabhīt joreṃ kar ṭhār̤hī

verses.sa:
देखा जीव नचावइ जाही ।
देखी भगति जो छोरइ ताही ॥
verses.tr:
dekhā jīv nacāvai jāhī
dekhī bhagati jo chorai tāhī

verses.sa:
तन पुलकित मुख बचन न आवा ।
नयन मूदि चरननि सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
tan pulakit mukh bacan na āvā
nayan mūdi caranani siru nāvā

verses.sa:
बिसमयवंत देखि महतारी ।
भए बहुरि सिसुरूप खरारी ॥
verses.tr:
bisamayavaṃt dekhi mahatārī
bhae bahuri sisurūp kharārī

verses.sa:
अस्तुति करि न जाइ भय माना ।
जगत पिता मैं सुत करि जाना ॥
verses.tr:
astuti kari na jāi bhaya mānā
jagat pitā maiṃ sut kari jānā

verses.sa:
हरि जननि बहुबिधि समुझाई ।
यह जनि कतहुँ कहसि सुनु माई ॥
verses.tr:
hari janani bahubidhi samujhāī
yah jani katahum̐ kahasi sunu māī

verses.sa: बार बार कौसल्या बिनय करइ कर जोरि ॥
verses.tr: bār bār kausalyā binaya karai kar jori
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: अब जनि कबहूँ ब्यापै प्रभु मोहि माया तोरि ॥
verses.tr: ab jani kabahūm̐ byāpai prabhu mohi māyā tori

trans: With unnumbered suns and moons, Sivas and Brahmans; with many mountains, rivers, oceans, lands and forests; with time, fate, merit, demerit nature and every power there manifested, even though unknown by name. When she beheld the awful vision she stood terror-stricken, with hands, clasped in prayer; for she saw both the life which Maya sets in motion and the faith that sets it free. With quivering body and speechless mouth she closed her eyes and bowed her head at his feet. Seeing his mother thus overpowered with amazement, Rama again assumed the form of a child. But her terror left her not, while she hymned his praises, saying,—‘I have regarded the great father as my own offspring.’ Again and again Hari exhorted his mother, —‘ See my mother, that you tell this to no one;’
And as often did Kausalya meekly reply with clasped hande,—‘ See you too, my lord, that the delusive power of yours never again visits me,’

sections.label: Doha 203
sections.name: भोजन करत चपल चित इत उत अवसरु पाइ

verses.sa:
बालचरित हरि बहुबिधि कीन्हा ।
अति अनंद दासन्ह कहँ दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
bālacarit hari bahubidhi kīnhā
ati anaṃd dāsanh kaham̐ dīnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कछुक काल बीतें सब भाई ।
बड़े भए परिजन सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
kachuk kāl bīteṃ sab bhāī
bar̤e bhae parijan sukhadāī

verses.sa:
चूड़ाकरन कीन्ह गुरु जाई ।
बिप्रन्ह पुनि दछिना बहु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
cūr̤ākaran kīnh guru jāī
bipranh puni dachinā bahu pāī

verses.sa:
परम मनोहर चरित अपारा ।
करत फिरत चारिउ सुकुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
param manohar carit apārā
karat phirat cāriu sukumārā

verses.sa:
मन क्रम बचन अगोचर जोई ।
दसरथ अजिर बिचर प्रभु सोई ॥
verses.tr:
man kram bacan agocar joī
dasarath ajir bicar prabhu soī

verses.sa:
भोजन करत बोल जब राजा ।
नहिं आवत तजि बाल समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
bhojan karat bol jab rājā
nahiṃ āvat taji bāl samājā

verses.sa:
कौसल्या जब बोलन जाई ।
ठुमकु ठुमकु प्रभु चलहिं पराई ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā jab bolan jāī
ṭhumaku ṭhumaku prabhu calahiṃ parāī

verses.sa:
निगम नेति सिव अंत न पावा ।
ताहि धरै जननी हठि धावा ॥
verses.tr:
nigam neti siv aṃt na pāvā
tāhi dharai jananī haṭhi dhāvā

verses.sa:
धूरस धूरि भरें तनु आए ।
भूपति बिहसि गोद बैठाए ॥
verses.tr:
dhūras dhūri bhareṃ tanu āe
bhūpati bihasi god baiṭhāe

verses.sa:
भोजन करत चपल चित इत उत अवसरु पाइ ।
भाजि चले किलकत मुख दधि ओदन लपटाइ ॥
verses.tr:
bhojan karat capal cit it ut avasaru pāi
bhāji cale kilakat mukh dadhi odan lapaṭāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hari indulged in every kind of childish amusement, to the great delight of his attendants; and after a little time all] the brothers grew to be big boys, gladdening every one about them. Then the guru came to perform the tonsure and again the Brahmans received large offerings. The four lads run about and divert themselves in all sorts of pretty ways; and the lord, whose thoughts, works and acts transcend every human sense, plays io Dasarath's court-yard. a£the king when at dinner called him, he would not leave his playmates and come, till Kausaly herself went for him, when he would toddle along with her as fast as he could. He whom the scripture declares to be incomprehensible, of whom Siva could find no end, is picked up by his mother and carried off in a pet, and his father with a smile takes him in his lap, though grimy all over with dust.
Quickly glancing here and there during the meal, as soon as he got achance, he would run away with a scream of delight, stuffing his mouth full of rice and curds.

sections.label: Doha 204
sections.name: कोसलपुर बासी नर नारि बृद्ध अरु बाल

verses.sa:
बालचरित अति सरल सुहाए ।
सारद सेष संभु श्रुति गाए ॥
verses.tr:
bālacarit ati saral suhāe
sārad seṣ saṃbhu śruti gāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिन कर मन इन्ह सन नहिं राता ।
ते जन बंचित किए बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
jin kar man inh san nahiṃ rātā
te jan baṃcit kie bidhātā

verses.sa:
भए कुमार जबहिं सब भ्राता ।
दीन्ह जनेऊ गुरु पितु माता ॥
verses.tr:
bhae kumār jabahiṃ sab bhrātā
dīnh janeū guru pitu mātā

verses.sa:
गुरगृहँ गए पढ़न रघुराई ।
अलप काल बिद्या सब आई ॥
verses.tr:
guragṛham̐ gae par̤han raghurāī
alap kāl bidyā sab āī

verses.sa:
जाकी सहज स्वास श्रुति चारी ।
सो हरि पढ़ यह कौतुक भारी ॥
verses.tr:
jākī sahaj svās śruti cārī
so hari par̤h yah kautuk bhārī

verses.sa:
बिद्या बिनय निपुन गुन सीला ।
खेलहिं खेल सकल नृपलीला ॥
verses.tr:
bidyā binaya nipun gun sīlā
khelahiṃ khel sakal nṛpalīlā

verses.sa:
करतल बान धनुष अति सोहा ।
देखत रूप चराचर मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
karatal bān dhanuṣ ati sohā
dekhat rūp carācar mohā

verses.sa:
जिन्ह बीथिन्ह बिहरहिं सब भाई ।
थकित होहिं सब लोग लुगाई ॥
verses.tr:
jinh bīthinh biharahiṃ sab bhāī
thakit hohiṃ sab log lugāī

verses.sa:
कोसलपुर बासी नर नारि बृद्ध अरु बाल ।
प्रानहु ते प्रिय लागत सब कहुँ राम कृपाल ॥
verses.tr:
kosalapur bāsī nar nāri bṛddh aru bāl
prānahu te priya lāgat sab kahum̐ rām kṛpāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: His pretty innocent childish sports have been sung by Sarasvati Seshnag Sambhu and the Vedas, and he whose soul does not warm to them has been brought into the world by God tono purpose. When the brothers were all grown up, the guru and their father and mother invested them with the sacred thread, and Rama went to his guru’s house to study. In a short time he mastered all knowledge. The four Vedas are but the breath of his mouth, and for him to study was a joke indeed. When they were proficient in scholarship and politeness and morality they began to practise all princely sports. With bow and arrow in hand they showed so fair that all creation was ravished at the sight, and as the brothers passed along the road every man and woman stopt to gaze at them.
Rama was gracious to all; and nota soul in Kosala, man or woman, young or old, but held him dearer than life.

sections.label: Doha 205
sections.name: ब्यापक अकल अनीह अज निर्गुन नाम न रूप

verses.sa:
बंधु सखा संग लेहिं बोलाई ।
बन मृगया नित खेलहिं जाई ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhu sakhā saṃg lehiṃ bolāī
ban mṛgayā nit khelahiṃ jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पावन मृग मारहिं जियँ जानी ।
दिन प्रति नृपहि देखावहिं आनी ॥
verses.tr:
pāvan mṛg mārahiṃ jiyam̐ jānī
din prati nṛpahi dekhāvahiṃ ānī

verses.sa:
जे मृग राम बान के मारे ।
ते तनु तजि सुरलोक सिधारे ॥
verses.tr:
je mṛg rām bān ke māre
te tanu taji suralok sidhāre

verses.sa:
अनुज सखा सँग भोजन करहीं ।
मातु पिता अग्या अनुसरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
anuj sakhā sam̐g bhojan karahīṃ
mātu pitā agyā anusarahīṃ

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि सुखी होहिं पुर लोगा ।
करहिं कृपानिधि सोइ संजोगा ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi sukhī hohiṃ pur logā
karahiṃ kṛpānidhi soi saṃjogā

verses.sa:
बेद पुरान सुनहिं मन लाई ।
आपु कहहिं अनुजन्ह समुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
bed purān sunahiṃ man lāī
āpu kahahiṃ anujanh samujhāī

verses.sa:
प्रातकाल उठि कै रघुनाथा ।
मातु पिता गुरु नावहिं माथा ॥
verses.tr:
prātakāl uṭhi kai raghunāthā
mātu pitā guru nāvahiṃ māthā

verses.sa:
आयसु मागि करहिं पुर काजा ।
देखि चरित हरषइ मन राजा ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu māgi karahiṃ pur kājā
dekhi carit haraṣai man rājā

verses.sa:
ब्यापक अकल अनीह अज निर्गुन नाम न रूप ।
भगत हेतु नाना बिधि करत चरित्र अनूप ॥
verses.tr:
byāpak akal anīh aj nirgun nām na rūp
bhagat hetu nānā bidhi karat caritr anūp
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Taking his brother with him as a companion, he would go to the forest to hunt; there selecting for death the noblest game, he every day brought and showed it to the king; and each beast, slain by his shaft, after death went straight to heaven. Taking his meals in company with his younger brother, ever obedient to his parents’ commands, the gracious god omitted nothing that could please the people. He gave his mind to hear the Vedas and Puranas and then himself taught his brother. Rising at break of day, he first saluted his parents and the priest, and then, after obtaining their sanction, busied himself with work in the city. The king was glad of heart when he saw his mode of life.
The all-pervading, indivisible, passionless, eternal God, who is without attributes, or name, or form, performs many wonders for the sake of his faithful people.,

sections.label: Doha 206
sections.name: बहुबिधि करत मनोरथ जात लागि नहिं बार

verses.sa:
यह सब चरित कहा मैं गाई ।
आगिलि कथा सुनहु मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
yah sab carit kahā maiṃ gāī
āgili kathā sunahu man lāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिस्वामित्र महामुनि ग्यानी ।
बसहि बिपिन सुभ आश्रम जानी ॥
verses.tr:
bisvāmitr mahāmuni gyānī
basahi bipin subh āśram jānī

verses.sa:
जहँ जप जग्य मुनि करही ।
अति मारीच सुबाहुहि डरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jap jagya muni karahī
ati mārīc subāhuhi ḍarahīṃ

verses.sa:
देखत जग्य निसाचर धावहि ।
करहि उपद्रव मुनि दुख पावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat jagya nisācar dhāvahi
karahi upadrav muni dukh pāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
गाधितनय मन चिंता ब्यापी ।
हरि बिनु मरहि न निसिचर पापी ॥
verses.tr:
gādhitanaya man ciṃtā byāpī
hari binu marahi na nisicar pāpī

verses.sa:
तब मुनिवर मन कीन्ह बिचारा ।
प्रभु अवतरेउ हरन महि भारा ॥
verses.tr:
tab munivar man kīnh bicārā
prabhu avatareu haran mahi bhārā

verses.sa:
एहुँ मिस देखौं पद जाई ।
करि बिनती आनौ दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
ehum̐ mis dekhauṃ pad jāī
kari binatī ānau dou bhāī

verses.sa:
ग्यान बिराग सकल गुन अयना ।
सो प्रभु मै देखब भरि नयना ॥
verses.tr:
gyān birāg sakal gun ayanā
so prabhu mai dekhab bhari nayanā

verses.sa:
बहुबिधि करत मनोरथ जात लागि नहिं बार ।
करि मज्जन सरऊ जल गए भूप दरबार ॥
verses.tr:
bahubidhi karat manorath jāt lāgi nahiṃ bār
kari majjan saraū jal gae bhūp darabār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I have now sung all these his doings; hearken attentively to the remainder of my story. The great and wise saint Visvamitra had chosen a fair hermitage in the forest, where he gave himself up to prayer, sacrifice and meditation. The demons Maricha and Subahn, on beholding the preparation, for sacrifice, feared greatly and hastened to disturb them. The saintly son of Gadhi was pained and full of thought, — ‘There is no killing these accursed demons without Hari.’ Then he retlected, —‘The Lord has become incarnate to relieve earth of its burdens. I have now an excuse for going to visit him and after entreaty made will bring back with me the two brothers. Now I will feast my eyes with the sight of him who is the abode of all knowledge, piety and goodness.”
His manifold longing brooked no delay on the road, and after bathing in the stream of the Sarju he proceeded to the king’s court.

sections.label: Doha 207
sections.name: देहु भूप मन हरषित तजहु मोह अग्यान

verses.sa:
मुनि आगमन सुना जब राजा ।
मिलन गयऊ लै बिप्र समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
muni āgaman sunā jab rājā
milan gayaū lai bipr samājā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करि दंडवत मुनिहि सनमानी ।
निज आसन बैठारेन्हि आनी ॥
verses.tr:
kari daṃḍavat munihi sanamānī
nij āsan baiṭhārenhi ānī

verses.sa:
चरन पखारि कीन्हि अति पूजा ।
मो सम आजु धन्य नहिं दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
caran pakhāri kīnhi ati pūjā
mo sam āju dhanya nahiṃ dūjā

verses.sa:
बिबिध भाँति भोजन करवावा ।
मुनिवर हृदयँ हरष अति पावा ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bhām̐ti bhojan karavāvā
munivar hṛdayam̐ haraṣ ati pāvā

verses.sa:
पुनि चरननि मेले सुत चारी ।
राम देखि मुनि देह बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
puni caranani mele sut cārī
rām dekhi muni deh bisārī

verses.sa:
भए मगन देखत मुख सोभा ।
जनु चकोर पूरन ससि लोभा ॥
verses.tr:
bhae magan dekhat mukh sobhā
janu cakor pūran sasi lobhā

verses.sa:
तब मन हरषि बचन कह राऊ ।
मुनि अस कृपा न कीन्हिहु काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tab man haraṣi bacan kah rāū
muni as kṛpā na kīnhihu kāū

verses.sa:
केहि कारन आगमन तुम्हारा ।
कहहु सो करत न लावउँ बारा ॥
verses.tr:
kehi kāran āgaman tumhārā
kahahu so karat na lāvaum̐ bārā

verses.sa:
असुर समूह सतावहिं मोही ।
मै जाचन आयउँ नृप तोही ॥
verses.tr:
asur samūh satāvahiṃ mohī
mai jācan āyaum̐ nṛp tohī

verses.sa:
अनुज समेत देहु रघुनाथा ।
निसिचर बध मैं होब सनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
anuj samet dehu raghunāthā
nisicar badh maiṃ hob sanāthā

verses.sa:
देहु भूप मन हरषित तजहु मोह अग्यान ।
धर्म सुजस प्रभु तुम्ह कौं इन्ह कहँ अति कल्यान ॥
verses.tr:
dehu bhūp man haraṣit tajahu moh agyān
dharm sujas prabhu tumh kauṃ inh kaham̐ ati kalyān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the Raja heard of the saint’s arrival, be went to meet him with a retinue of Brahmans, and prostrating himself reverently on the ground before him took and seated him on his own throne: then laved his feet and offered him religious honours, saying,—‘' There is no one so blest as I am to day; and had various kinds of food prepared for him. The great saint was highly pleased. Next, the king brought his four sons into the presence. On seeing Rama the saint forgot his detachment from the world and was as enraptured with his lovely face as is the chakor with the full moon, Then said the glad king,—‘ Reverend sir, this favour is unparalleled; what is the cause of your coming? Tell me, and I will not delay to accomplish it.” ‘There is a crew of demons that trouble me, and I am come to you, O king, with a request. Let me have Raghunath and his brothers; the demons’ death is all I desire.
Give them, O king, gladly, without any selfish folly; for

sections.label: Doha 208
sections.name: सौंपे भूप रिषिहि सुत बहु बिधि देइ असीस

verses.sa:
सुनि राजा अति अप्रिय बानी ।
हृदय कंप मुख दुति कुमुलानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni rājā ati apriya bānī
hṛdaya kaṃp mukh duti kumulānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चौथेंपन पायउँ सुत चारी ।
बिप्र बचन नहिं कहेहु बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
cautheṃpan pāyaum̐ sut cārī
bipr bacan nahiṃ kahehu bicārī

verses.sa:
मागहु भूमि धेनु धन कोसा ।
सर्बस देउँ आजु सहरोसा ॥
verses.tr:
māgahu bhūmi dhenu dhan kosā
sarbas deum̐ āju saharosā

verses.sa:
देह प्रान तें प्रिय कछु नाही ।
सोउ मुनि देउँ निमिष एक माही ॥
verses.tr:
deh prān teṃ priya kachu nāhī
sou muni deum̐ nimiṣ ek māhī

verses.sa:
सब सुत प्रिय मोहि प्रान कि नाईं ।
राम देत नहिं बनइ गोसाई ॥
verses.tr:
sab sut priya mohi prān ki nāīṃ
rām det nahiṃ banai gosāī

verses.sa:
कहँ निसिचर अति घोर कठोरा ।
कहँ सुंदर सुत परम किसोरा ॥
verses.tr:
kaham̐ nisicar ati ghor kaṭhorā
kaham̐ suṃdar sut param kisorā

verses.sa:
सुनि नृप गिरा प्रेम रस सानी ।
हृदयँ हरष माना मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni nṛp girā prem ras sānī
hṛdayam̐ haraṣ mānā muni gyānī

verses.sa:
तब बसिष्ट बहु निधि समुझावा ।
नृप संदेह नास कहँ पावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab basiṣṭ bahu nidhi samujhāvā
nṛp saṃdeh nās kaham̐ pāvā

verses.sa:
अति आदर दोउ तनय बोलाए ।
हृदयँ लाइ बहु भाँति सिखाए ॥
verses.tr:
ati ādar dou tanaya bolāe
hṛdayam̐ lāi bahu bhām̐ti sikhāe

verses.sa:
मेरे प्रान नाथ सुत दोऊ ।
तुम्ह मुनि पिता आन नहिं कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
mere prān nāth sut doū
tumh muni pitā ān nahiṃ koū

verses.sa:
सौंपे भूप रिषिहि सुत बहु बिधि देइ असीस ।
जननी भवन गए प्रभु चले नाइ पद सीस ॥
verses.tr:
sauṃpe bhūp riṣihi sut bahu bidhi dei asīs
jananī bhavan gae prabhu cale nāi pad sīs
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: पुरुषसिंह दोउ बीर हरषि चले मुनि भय हरन ॥
verses.tr: puruṣasiṃh dou bīr haraṣi cale muni bhaya haran

verses.sa: कृपासिंधु मतिधीर अखिल बिस्व कारन करन ॥
verses.tr: kṛpāsiṃdhu matidhīr akhil bisv kāran karan

trans: you it will be a meritorious and honourable act, and it will also turn out well for them.”

When the king heard this cruel request, his heart beat fast and all the brightness of his face grew dim,—‘In my old age I have begotten four sons; O sir, you have spoken without consideration. Ask of me land, cattle, goods and treasure, and I will gladly give you all I have, at once. Nothing is dearer than the life of the body; but even that I would give ina minute. All my sons are dear to me as my own soul and, O sir, Ioannot spare you Rama. What is this pretty little boy of mine against a fierce and terrible demon?” On hearing the king’s word so fraught with love, the wise saint was glad of heart. Then Vasishta much exhorted him, and the king's doubts were dispelled. Obediently he sent for the two boys and pressed them to his heart and fervently exclaimed,—‘ My two boys are my very life; but you, holy sir, are now their only father.”
The king consigned the boys to the saints, again and again blessing them. Then they went to their mother’s apartment and bowed the head at her feet.
Glad to relieve the saint of his alarm, the two lion-hearted heroes set forth, oceans of compassion, resolute of purpose, the whole world’s champions.

sections.label: Doha 209
sections.name: आयुष सब समर्पि कै प्रभु निज आश्रम आनि

verses.sa:
अरुन नयन उर बाहु बिसाला ।
नील जलज तनु स्याम तमाला ॥
verses.tr:
arun nayan ur bāhu bisālā
nīl jalaj tanu syām tamālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कटि पट पीत कसें बर भाथा ।
रुचिर चाप सायक दुहुँ हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭi paṭ pīt kaseṃ bar bhāthā
rucir cāp sāyak duhum̐ hāthā

verses.sa:
स्याम गौर सुंदर दोउ भाई ।
बिस्बामित्र महानिधि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
syām gaur suṃdar dou bhāī
bisbāmitr mahānidhi pāī

verses.sa:
प्रभु ब्रह्मन्यदेव मै जाना ।
मोहि निति पिता तजेहु भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu brahmanyadev mai jānā
mohi niti pitā tajehu bhagavānā

verses.sa:
चले जात मुनि दीन्हि दिखाई ।
सुनि ताड़का क्रोध करि धाई ॥
verses.tr:
cale jāt muni dīnhi dikhāī
suni tār̤akā krodh kari dhāī

verses.sa:
एकहिं बान प्रान हरि लीन्हा ।
दीन जानि तेहि निज पद दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ekahiṃ bān prān hari līnhā
dīn jāni tehi nij pad dīnhā

verses.sa:
तब रिषि निज नाथहि जियँ चीन्ही ।
बिद्यानिधि कहुँ बिद्या दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
tab riṣi nij nāthahi jiyam̐ cīnhī
bidyānidhi kahum̐ bidyā dīnhī

verses.sa:
जाते लाग न छुधा पिपासा ।
अतुलित बल तनु तेज प्रकासा ॥
verses.tr:
jāte lāg na chudhā pipāsā
atulit bal tanu tej prakāsā

verses.sa:
आयुष सब समर्पि कै प्रभु निज आश्रम आनि ।
कंद मूल फल भोजन दीन्ह भगति हित जानि ॥
verses.tr:
āyuṣ sab samarpi kai prabhu nij āśram āni
kaṃd mūl phal bhojan dīnh bhagati hit jāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bright-eyed, broad-chested, long of arm, dark of hue as the lotus or the tamal tree; with quiver at side pendent from a yellow sash, and in either hand arrows and a comely bow, so marched the two brothers, one dark, the other fair, the treasure that Visvamitra had acquired,—‘ I recognize the lord god Brahmanya-deva in the child who thus on my account has left his own father.” So thought the saint; and as he went he pointed out Teraka, who on hearing his voice rushed up ina fury. With asingle arrow Hari took her life, but recognizing her submission gave her a place in his own heaven. Then the saint knew he had found his lord, but*yet instructed him, the all-wise. As they travelled they felt neither hunger nor thirst; such their incomparable strength of body and glorious vigour.
After taking the Lord to his own hermitage, he made over to him every kind of weapon, and gave him herbs and roots and fruit toeat, knowing him to be ever gracious to men of holy life.

sections.label: Doha 210
sections.name: गौतम नारि श्राप बस उपल देह धरि धीर

verses.sa:
प्रात कहा मुनि सन रघुराई ।
निर्भय जग्य करहु तुम्ह जाई ॥
verses.tr:
prāt kahā muni san raghurāī
nirbhaya jagya karahu tumh jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
होम करन लागे मुनि झारी ।
आपु रहे मख कीं रखवारी ॥
verses.tr:
hom karan lāge muni jhārī
āpu rahe makh kīṃ rakhavārī

verses.sa:
सुनि मारीच निसाचर क्रोही ।
लै सहाय धावा मुनिद्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
suni mārīc nisācar krohī
lai sahāya dhāvā munidrohī

verses.sa:
बिनु फर बान राम तेहि मारा ।
सत जोजन गा सागर पारा ॥
verses.tr:
binu phar bān rām tehi mārā
sat jojan gā sāgar pārā

verses.sa:
पावक सर सुबाहु पुनि मारा ।
अनुज निसाचर कटकु सँघारा ॥
verses.tr:
pāvak sar subāhu puni mārā
anuj nisācar kaṭaku sam̐ghārā

verses.sa:
मारि असुर द्विज निर्मयकारी ।
अस्तुति करहिं देव मुनि झारी ॥
verses.tr:
māri asur dvij nirmayakārī
astuti karahiṃ dev muni jhārī

verses.sa:
तहँ पुनि कछुक दिवस रघुराया ।
रहे कीन्हि बिप्रन्ह पर दाया ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ puni kachuk divas raghurāyā
rahe kīnhi bipranh par dāyā

verses.sa:
भगति हेतु बहु कथा पुराना ।
कहे बिप्र जद्यपि प्रभु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati hetu bahu kathā purānā
kahe bipr jadyapi prabhu jānā

verses.sa:
तब मुनि सादर कहा बुझाई ।
चरित एक प्रभु देखिअ जाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab muni sādar kahā bujhāī
carit ek prabhu dekhia jāī

verses.sa:
धनुषजग्य मुनि रघुकुल नाथा ।
हरषि चले मुनिबर के साथा ॥
verses.tr:
dhanuṣajagya muni raghukul nāthā
haraṣi cale munibar ke sāthā

verses.sa:
आश्रम एक दीख मग माहीं ।
खग मृग जीव जंतु तहँ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
āśram ek dīkh mag māhīṃ
khag mṛg jīv jaṃtu taham̐ nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
पूछा मुनिहि सिला प्रभु देखी ।
सकल कथा मुनि कहा बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
pūchā munihi silā prabhu dekhī
sakal kathā muni kahā biseṣī

verses.sa:
गौतम नारि श्राप बस उपल देह धरि धीर ।
चरन कमल रज चाहति कृपा करहु रघुबीर ॥
verses.tr:
gautam nāri śrāp bas upal deh dhari dhīr
caran kamal raj cāhati kṛpā karahu raghubīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At daybreak Raghorei said to him,—“ Go and make ready the sacrifice, and fear not.” The brotherhood began preparing the oblation, while he remained to guard the sacrificial fire. On hearing of this, the demon Mericha rushed up ina fury with his army to disturb the saint. Rama smote him with a headless shaft, and he fell a hundred leagues the other side of ocean, Then he slew Subshu with an arrow of fire, while his brother routed the whole demon host. When they had thus slain the demons and restored peace to the Brahmans, the whole company of gods and SAGE CEE SE a as SE ee ee saints began to hymn their praise. There Raghorai then stayed a few days and showed kindness to the hermits, who devoutly repeated to him many legends of the Puranas, though he knew them all before. Then the saint respectfully informed him, —‘ There is a sight, my Lord, which is worth your going to see.” When Raghunath heard of the ordeal of the bow, he gladly accompanied the noble sage. On the way he spied a hermitage without bird, deer, or any living creature near it, and observing a remarkable stone inquired of the saint about it, who in reply gave him the whole history. Doha 222.

sections.label: Doha 211
sections.name: अस प्रभु दीनबंधु हरि कारन रहित दयाल

verses.sa:
परसत पद पावन सोक नसावन प्रगट भई तपपुंज सही ।
देखत रघुनायक जन सुख दायक सनमुख होइ कर जोरि रही ॥
verses.tr:
parasat pad pāvan sok nasāvan pragaṭ bhaī tapapuṃj sahī
dekhat raghunāyak jan sukh dāyak sanamukh hoi kar jori rahī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
अति प्रेम अधीरा पुलक सरीरा मुख नहिं आवइ बचन कही ।
अतिसय बड़भागी चरनन्हि लागी जुगल नयन जलधार बही ॥
verses.tr:
ati prem adhīrā pulak sarīrā mukh nahiṃ āvai bacan kahī
atisaya bar̤abhāgī carananhi lāgī jugal nayan jaladhār bahī

verses.sa:
धीरजु मन कीन्हा प्रभु कहुँ चीन्हा रघुपति कृपाँ भगति पाई ।
अति निर्मल बानीं अस्तुति ठानी ग्यानगम्य जय रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
dhīraju man kīnhā prabhu kahum̐ cīnhā raghupati kṛpām̐ bhagati pāī
ati nirmal bānīṃ astuti ṭhānī gyānagamya jaya raghurāī

verses.sa:
मै नारि अपावन प्रभु जग पावन रावन रिपु जन सुखदाई ।
राजीव बिलोचन भव भय मोचन पाहि पाहि सरनहिं आई ॥
verses.tr:
mai nāri apāvan prabhu jag pāvan rāvan ripu jan sukhadāī
rājīv bilocan bhav bhaya mocan pāhi pāhi saranahiṃ āī

verses.sa:
मुनि श्राप जो दीन्हा अति भल कीन्हा परम अनुग्रह मैं माना ।
देखेउँ भरि लोचन हरि भवमोचन इहइ लाभ संकर जाना ॥
verses.tr:
muni śrāp jo dīnhā ati bhal kīnhā param anugrah maiṃ mānā
dekheum̐ bhari locan hari bhavamocan ihai lābh saṃkar jānā

verses.sa:
बिनती प्रभु मोरी मैं मति भोरी नाथ न मागउँ बर आना ।
पद कमल परागा रस अनुरागा मम मन मधुप करै पाना ॥
verses.tr:
binatī prabhu morī maiṃ mati bhorī nāth na māgaum̐ bar ānā
pad kamal parāgā ras anurāgā mam man madhup karai pānā

verses.sa:
जेहिं पद सुरसरिता परम पुनीता प्रगट भई सिव सीस धरी ।
सोइ पद पंकज जेहि पूजत अज मम सिर धरेउ कृपाल हरी ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ pad surasaritā param punītā pragaṭ bhaī siv sīs dharī
soi pad paṃkaj jehi pūjat aj mam sir dhareu kṛpāl harī

verses.sa:
एहि भाँति सिधारी गौतम नारी बार बार हरि चरन परी ।
जो अति मन भावा सो बरु पावा गै पतिलोक अनंद भरी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bhām̐ti sidhārī gautam nārī bār bār hari caran parī
jo ati man bhāvā so baru pāvā gai patilok anaṃd bharī

verses.sa:
अस प्रभु दीनबंधु हरि कारन रहित दयाल ।
तुलसिदास सठ तेहि भजु छाड़ि कपट जंजाल ॥
verses.tr:
as prabhu dīnabaṃdhu hari kāran rahit dayāl
tulasidās saṭh tehi bhaju chār̤i kapaṭ jaṃjāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Gautuma’s wife was by a curse turned into a hard rock, and is now longing for the dust gf your lotus feet: O Raghubir, show mercy upon her.” °
At the touch so sweet of his hallowed feet, she awoke from
And meekly adored her sovereign lord, awaiting his high
With speechless tongue, limbs all unstrung, and eyes that
streamed with tears,
She fell at his feet in rapture meet, far blest above all
Then bolder grown by the favour shown with a Faith that
himself had given,
She dared to raise her hymn of praise,—‘Great Spirit,
high lord of heaven,
Save me, O save, thy succour I crave, holy god, sinful
wretch though I be,
Ravan's conquering foe,’ joy of all else below who toil
upon life’s troubled sea.
Though the saint cursed me sore in the ill days of yore,
now I hold it a blessing most sweet,
For my own eyes have seen my Redeemer, andI ween
Siva only my rapture could mete.
Witless and weak, one only boon [seek; as the bee within
the lotus loves to stay,
May my soul upon thy feet, O my god, I thee entreat, dwell in rapture never ending night and day:

Holy feet, the adoration of the lord of all creation, and source of the stream divine Which on Siva’s head descended, this day have condes- ' cended to rest and on this vile head of mine.” Thus full of jubilation, with oft-renewed prostration, did Gautama’s long Lost bride,
With the boon she most had craved, thus graciously vouchsafed, return to her husband's side.
Thus the benevolent lord Hari is compassionate beyond

sections.label: Doha 212
sections.name: सुमन बाटिका बाग बन बिपुल बिहंग निवास

verses.sa:
चले राम लछिमन मुनि संगा ।
गए जहाँ जग पावनि गंगा ॥
verses.tr:
cale rām lachiman muni saṃgā
gae jahām̐ jag pāvani gaṃgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गाधिसूनु सब कथा सुनाई ।
जेहि प्रकार सुरसरि महि आई ॥
verses.tr:
gādhisūnu sab kathā sunāī
jehi prakār surasari mahi āī

verses.sa:
तब प्रभु रिषिन्ह समेत नहाए ।
बिबिध दान महिदेवन्हि पाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab prabhu riṣinh samet nahāe
bibidh dān mahidevanhi pāe

verses.sa:
हरषि चले मुनि बृंद सहाया ।
बेगि बिदेह नगर निअराया ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi cale muni bṛṃd sahāyā
begi bideh nagar niarāyā

verses.sa:
पुर रम्यता राम जब देखी ।
हरषे अनुज समेत बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
pur ramyatā rām jab dekhī
haraṣe anuj samet biseṣī

verses.sa:
बापीं कूप सरित सर नाना ।
सलिल सुधासम मनि सोपाना ॥
verses.tr:
bāpīṃ kūp sarit sar nānā
salil sudhāsam mani sopānā

verses.sa:
गुंजत मंजु मत्त रस भृंगा ।
कूजत कल बहुबरन बिहंगा ॥
verses.tr:
guṃjat maṃju matt ras bhṛṃgā
kūjat kal bahubaran bihaṃgā

verses.sa:
बरन बरन बिकसे बन जाता ।
त्रिबिध समीर सदा सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
baran baran bikase ban jātā
tribidh samīr sadā sukhadātā

verses.sa:
सुमन बाटिका बाग बन बिपुल बिहंग निवास ।
फूलत फलत सुपल्लवत सोहत पुर चहुँ पास ॥
verses.tr:
suman bāṭikā bāg ban bipul bihaṃg nivās
phūlat phalat supallavat sohat pur cahum̐ pās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: our deserts, Worship him, says poor Tulsi Das, and cease from ujl wrangling and hypocrisy.

Rama and Lakshman accompanied the saint to the worldpurifying Ganges. Both the lord and his younger brother reverently saluted it, and ltama was delighted beyond measure, asthe son of Gadhi told hins the legend how the heavenly stream had come down upon earth. Then the Lord and the hermits performed their ablutions and the Brahmans received manifold gifts. The hermits’ champion went on his way rejoicing, and quickly, drew near to the capital of Videha. When Rama beheld the beauty of the city, he and his brother were delighted ut the many ponds and wells and rivers and streams, with water of ambrosial purity and jewelled, flights of steps; where the hum of bees, drunk with nectar, made a delicious sodnd und birdeof all kinds were softly cooing: as the lilies expanded their many-coloured petals, and a cool, soft, fragrant breeze was ever delightful.

sections.label: Doha 213
sections.name: धवल धाम मनि पुरट पट सुघटित नाना भाँति

verses.sa:
बनइ न बरनत नगर निकाई ।
जहाँ जाइ मन तहँइँ लोभाई ॥
verses.tr:
banai na baranat nagar nikāī
jahām̐ jāi man taham̐im̐ lobhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चारु बजारु बिचित्र अँबारी ।
मनिमय बिधि जनु स्वकर सँवारी ॥
verses.tr:
cāru bajāru bicitr am̐bārī
manimaya bidhi janu svakar sam̐vārī

verses.sa:
धनिक बनिक बर धनद समाना ।
बैठ सकल बस्तु लै नाना ॥
verses.tr:
dhanik banik bar dhanad samānā
baiṭh sakal bastu lai nānā

verses.sa:
चौहट सुंदर गलीं सुहाई ।
संतत रहहिं सुगंध सिंचाई ॥
verses.tr:
cauhaṭ suṃdar galīṃ suhāī
saṃtat rahahiṃ sugaṃdh siṃcāī

verses.sa:
मंगलमय मंदिर सब केरें ।
चित्रित जनु रतिनाथ चितेरें ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgalamaya maṃdir sab kereṃ
citrit janu ratināth citereṃ

verses.sa:
पुर नर नारि सुभग सुचि संता ।
धरमसील ग्यानी गुनवंता ॥
verses.tr:
pur nar nāri subhag suci saṃtā
dharamasīl gyānī gunavaṃtā

verses.sa:
अति अनूप जहँ जनक निवासू ।
बिथकहिं बिबुध बिलोकि बिलासू ॥
verses.tr:
ati anūp jaham̐ janak nivāsū
bithakahiṃ bibudh biloki bilāsū

verses.sa:
होत चकित चित कोट बिलोकी ।
सकल भुवन सोभा जनु रोकी ॥
verses.tr:
hot cakit cit koṭ bilokī
sakal bhuvan sobhā janu rokī

verses.sa:
धवल धाम मनि पुरट पट सुघटित नाना भाँति ।
सिय निवास सुंदर सदन सोभा किमि कहि जाति ॥
verses.tr:
dhaval dhām mani puraṭ paṭ sughaṭit nānā bhām̐ti
siya nivās suṃdar sadan sobhā kimi kahi jāti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On all four sides the city was bright with flower-gardens, orchards and groves, the haunt of innumerable birds and full of fruit and flowers and verdure.

The beauty of the city is not to be told; wherever one went there was something to charm the soul. Handsome bazars and gorgeous balconies all studded with jewels, as though the Creator had fashioned them with his own hand; thriving bankers and traders, very Kuvers of wealth, sitting with all their various goods displayed; fine squares and beantifulestreets, that were constantly sprinkled with fragrant waters; magnificent temples to all the yoda, as bright as if they had been painted by Kamadeva himself; all the people

“of the city, both men and women, prosperous, well-dressed, virtuous, pious, intelligent and accomplished. But Janak’s palace was such a masterpiece that the gods tired themselves with looking at it,and the mind was quite overcome by the sight of the Fort, for it seemed to have appropriated to itself all that was most beautiful in the world.
With glistening white walls and doors of gold with gems set in different devices, the exquisite mansion where Sita lived was far too lovely for words to describe.

sections.label: Doha 214
sections.name: संग सचिव सुचि भूरि भट भूसुर बर गुर ग्याति

verses.sa:
सुभग द्वार सब कुलिस कपाटा ।
भूप भीर नट मागध भाटा ॥
verses.tr:
subhag dvār sab kulis kapāṭā
bhūp bhīr naṭ māgadh bhāṭā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बनी बिसाल बाजि गज साला ।
हय गय रथ संकुल सब काला ॥
verses.tr:
banī bisāl bāji gaj sālā
haya gaya rath saṃkul sab kālā

verses.sa:
सूर सचिव सेनप बहुतेरे ।
नृपगृह सरिस सदन सब केरे ॥
verses.tr:
sūr saciv senap bahutere
nṛpagṛh saris sadan sab kere

verses.sa:
पुर बाहेर सर सारित समीपा ।
उतरे जहँ तहँ बिपुल महीपा ॥
verses.tr:
pur bāher sar sārit samīpā
utare jaham̐ taham̐ bipul mahīpā

verses.sa:
देखि अनूप एक अँवराई ।
सब सुपास सब भाँति सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi anūp ek am̐varāī
sab supās sab bhām̐ti suhāī

verses.sa:
कौसिक कहेउ मोर मनु माना ।
इहाँ रहिअ रघुबीर सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
kausik kaheu mor manu mānā
ihām̐ rahia raghubīr sujānā

verses.sa:
भलेहिं नाथ कहि कृपानिकेता ।
उतरे तहँ मुनिबृंद समेता ॥
verses.tr:
bhalehiṃ nāth kahi kṛpāniketā
utare taham̐ munibṛṃd sametā

verses.sa:
बिस्वामित्र महामुनि आए ।
समाचार मिथिलापति पाए ॥
verses.tr:
bisvāmitr mahāmuni āe
samācār mithilāpati pāe

verses.sa:
संग सचिव सुचि भूरि भट भूसुर बर गुर ग्याति ।
चले मिलन मुनिनायकहि मुदित राउ एहि भाँति ॥
verses.tr:
saṃg saciv suci bhūri bhaṭ bhūsur bar gur gyāti
cale milan munināyakahi mudit rāu ehi bhām̐ti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All the city gates were most massive with panels of adamant, and were thronged with princes and their reti-nues of mimists, bards and heralds. The vast and well-built stables were at all hours of the day crowded with horses, elephants and chariots: and the ministers, generals «and warriors all had residence in the same style as the king. Outside the city, by pool and stream, the multitudinous princes had pitched their different camps. On seeing a fine mango grove, a most agreeable and convenient spot, the descendant of Kusika excluimed,—‘ This is just what [ like, let us stay here, Raghubir,” ‘Very well my lord,” answered the gracious god; and there they alighted with all their hermit ‘train. When the king of Mithila heard the news that the great saint Visvamitra was come — ry:
Taking with him his ministers and many gallant fighting men and noble Brahmans and the chief of his kinsmen, in this fashion the king went forth rejoicing to meet the prince of sages. Chaupdi 219.

sections.label: Doha 215
sections.name: प्रेम मगन मनु जानि नृपु करि बिबेकु धरि धीर

verses.sa:
कीन्ह प्रनामु चरन धरि माथा ।
दीन्हि असीस मुदित मुनिनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh pranāmu caran dhari māthā
dīnhi asīs mudit munināthā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिप्रबृंद सब सादर बंदे ।
जानि भाग्य बड़ राउ अनंदे ॥
verses.tr:
biprabṛṃd sab sādar baṃde
jāni bhāgya bar̤ rāu anaṃde

verses.sa:
कुसल प्रस्न कहि बारहिं बारा ।
बिस्वामित्र नृपहि बैठारा ॥
verses.tr:
kusal prasn kahi bārahiṃ bārā
bisvāmitr nṛpahi baiṭhārā

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर आए दोउ भाई ।
गए रहे देखन फुलवाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar āe dou bhāī
gae rahe dekhan phulavāī

verses.sa:
स्याम गौर मृदु बयस किसोरा ।
लोचन सुखद बिस्व चित चोरा ॥
verses.tr:
syām gaur mṛdu bayas kisorā
locan sukhad bisv cit corā

verses.sa:
उठे सकल जब रघुपति आए ।
बिस्वामित्र निकट बैठाए ॥
verses.tr:
uṭhe sakal jab raghupati āe
bisvāmitr nikaṭ baiṭhāe

verses.sa:
भए सब सुखी देखि दोउ भ्राता ।
बारि बिलोचन पुलकित गाता ॥
verses.tr:
bhae sab sukhī dekhi dou bhrātā
bāri bilocan pulakit gātā

verses.sa:
मूरति मधुर मनोहर देखी ।
भयउ बिदेहु बिदेहु बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
mūrati madhur manohar dekhī
bhayau bidehu bidehu biseṣī

verses.sa:
प्रेम मगन मनु जानि नृपु करि बिबेकु धरि धीर ।
बोलेउ मुनि पद नाइ सिरु गदगद गिरा गभीर ॥
verses.tr:
prem magan manu jāni nṛpu kari bibeku dhari dhīr
boleu muni pad nāi siru gadagad girā gabhīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bowing to the ground, he made obeisance, and tho suint. gladly gave him his blessing. Then the king respectfully:. saluted all the hermit train and congratulated himself’ on ‘his good fortune. After making many inquiries;¢ to his health and welfare, Visvamitra led the king #% a seat, and at that very time arrived the two brothers who had gone to see the garden, one dark, the other Bi. in childhood’s tender bloom, the joy of all beholder’s ravishing, the senses of the whole world. When Raghupati came, all.rose and Visvamitra seated him by his side. All were charmed at the sight of the two brothers; their eyes filled with tears and their body thrilled with rapture, and the King especially was beside himself with joy on beholding their sweet and lovely appearance.; Dohd 227,
Though feeling himself overpowered with love, the king discreetly restrained himself, and bowing his head at the saint’s feet, said in suppressed accents choking with emotion—

sections.label: Doha 216
sections.name: रामु लखनु दोउ बंधुबर रूप सील बल धाम

verses.sa:
कहहु नाथ सुंदर दोउ बालक ।
मुनिकुल तिलक कि नृपकुल पालक ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu nāth suṃdar dou bālak
munikul tilak ki nṛpakul pālak
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जो निगम नेति कहि गावा ।
उभय बेष धरि की सोइ आवा ॥
verses.tr:
brahm jo nigam neti kahi gāvā
ubhaya beṣ dhari kī soi āvā

verses.sa:
सहज बिरागरुप मनु मोरा ।
थकित होत जिमि चंद चकोरा ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj birāgarup manu morā
thakit hot jimi caṃd cakorā

verses.sa:
ताते प्रभु पूछउँ सतिभाऊ ।
कहहु नाथ जनि करहु दुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tāte prabhu pūchaum̐ satibhāū
kahahu nāth jani karahu durāū

verses.sa:
इन्हहि बिलोकत अति अनुरागा ।
बरबस ब्रह्मसुखहि मन त्यागा ॥
verses.tr:
inhahi bilokat ati anurāgā
barabas brahmasukhahi man tyāgā

verses.sa:
कह मुनि बिहसि कहेहु नृप नीका ।
बचन तुम्हार न होइ अलीका ॥
verses.tr:
kah muni bihasi kahehu nṛp nīkā
bacan tumhār na hoi alīkā

verses.sa:
ए प्रिय सबहि जहाँ लगि प्रानी ।
मन मुसुकाहिं रामु सुनि बानी ॥
verses.tr:
e priya sabahi jahām̐ lagi prānī
man musukāhiṃ rāmu suni bānī

verses.sa:
रघुकुल मनि दसरथ के जाए ।
मम हित लागि नरेस पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
raghukul mani dasarath ke jāe
mam hit lāgi nares paṭhāe

verses.sa:
रामु लखनु दोउ बंधुबर रूप सील बल धाम ।
मख राखेउ सबु साखि जगु जिते असुर संग्राम ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu lakhanu dou baṃdhubar rūp sīl bal dhām
makh rākheu sabu sākhi jagu jite asur saṃgrām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Tell me, my lord, who are these two lovely children. Are they the glory of a saintly family, or the bulwarks of a kingly line or are they the twofold manifestution of the Supreme Spirit, whom scripture declares to be unutterable. My wind, ordinarily free from worldly attachment, wearies itself with gazing upon them, as the chakor in gazing upon the moon. Therefore, sir, I beg you to tell me the truth and to conceal nothing. My love grows with looking, and my soul perforce is withdrawn from divine contemplation.” Said the saint with a samile,—“ You have spoken well, O king; your word is always trae; there is not a living creature that does not love these boys.” Rama smiled to himself on hearing this. ‘They are the sons of Dasarath, the glory of the line of Raghu, and the king has sent them to help me.
Rama and Lakshman by name, these two brothers, as strong as they are good and beautiful, with their companions, protected my sacrifice and vanquished all the demons in battle.”

sections.label: Doha 217
sections.name: रिषय संग रघुबंस मनि करि भोजनु बिश्रामु

verses.sa:
मुनि तव चरन देखि कह राऊ ।
कहि न सकउँ निज पुन्य प्राभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
muni tav caran dekhi kah rāū
kahi na sakaum̐ nij punya prābhāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुंदर स्याम गौर दोउ भ्राता ।
आनँदहू के आनँद दाता ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar syām gaur dou bhrātā
ānam̐dahū ke ānam̐d dātā

verses.sa:
इन्ह कै प्रीति परसपर पावनि ।
कहि न जाइ मन भाव सुहावनि ॥
verses.tr:
inh kai prīti parasapar pāvani
kahi na jāi man bhāv suhāvani

verses.sa:
सुनहु नाथ कह मुदित बिदेहू ।
ब्रह्म जीव इव सहज सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu nāth kah mudit bidehū
brahm jīv iv sahaj sanehū

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि प्रभुहि चितव नरनाहू ।
पुलक गात उर अधिक उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni prabhuhi citav naranāhū
pulak gāt ur adhik uchāhū

verses.sa:
म्रुनिहि प्रसंसि नाइ पद सीसू ।
चलेउ लवाइ नगर अवनीसू ॥
verses.tr:
mrunihi prasaṃsi nāi pad sīsū
caleu lavāi nagar avanīsū

verses.sa:
सुंदर सदनु सुखद सब काला ।
तहाँ बासु लै दीन्ह भुआला ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar sadanu sukhad sab kālā
tahām̐ bāsu lai dīnh bhuālā

verses.sa:
करि पूजा सब बिधि सेवकाई ।
गयउ राउ गृह बिदा कराई ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā sab bidhi sevakāī
gayau rāu gṛh bidā karāī

verses.sa:
रिषय संग रघुबंस मनि करि भोजनु बिश्रामु ।
बैठे प्रभु भ्राता सहित दिवसु रहा भरि जामु ॥
verses.tr:
riṣaya saṃg raghubaṃs mani kari bhojanu biśrāmu
baiṭhe prabhu bhrātā sahit divasu rahā bhari jāmu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said the king,—“O saint, when I behold your feet I cannot tell how richly I am rewarded for any former good deeds. And these pretty twins have conferred a happiness

upon you, the supremely happy. ‘Their innocent mutual affection is indescribable in words; a delight to the inmost soul. Hear me, sir, cried the king in his rapture, it is like the natural union between the universal soul and the soul of man.” Again and again the king gazed upon the Lord with quivering body and heart bursting with emotion. Then with courteous phrase and bowed head he escorted the saint to the city and there assigned him apartments, which were bright and cheerful at all times of the day; and finally, after further homage and proffers of service, the king took his leave and returned to the palace. Dohd 229.

sections.label: Doha 218
sections.name: जाइ देखी आवहु नगरु सुख निधान दोउ भाइ

verses.sa:
लखन हृदयँ लालसा बिसेषी ।
जाइ जनकपुर आइअ देखी ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan hṛdayam̐ lālasā biseṣī
jāi janakapur āia dekhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु भय बहुरि मुनिहि सकुचाहीं ।
प्रगट न कहहिं मनहिं मुसुकाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu bhaya bahuri munihi sakucāhīṃ
pragaṭ na kahahiṃ manahiṃ musukāhīṃ

verses.sa:
राम अनुज मन की गति जानी ।
भगत बछलता हिंयँ हुलसानी ॥
verses.tr:
rām anuj man kī gati jānī
bhagat bachalatā hiṃyam̐ hulasānī

verses.sa:
परम बिनीत सकुचि मुसुकाई ।
बोले गुर अनुसासन पाई ॥
verses.tr:
param binīt sakuci musukāī
bole gur anusāsan pāī

verses.sa:
नाथ लखनु पुरु देखन चहहीं ।
प्रभु सकोच डर प्रगट न कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nāth lakhanu puru dekhan cahahīṃ
prabhu sakoc ḍar pragaṭ na kahahīṃ

verses.sa:
जौं राउर आयसु मैं पावौं ।
नगर देखाइ तुरत लै आवौ ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ rāur āyasu maiṃ pāvauṃ
nagar dekhāi turat lai āvau

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनीसु कह बचन सप्रीती ।
कस न राम तुम्ह राखहु नीती ॥
verses.tr:
suni munīsu kah bacan saprītī
kas na rām tumh rākhahu nītī

verses.sa:
धरम सेतु पालक तुम्ह ताता ।
प्रेम बिबस सेवक सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
dharam setu pālak tumh tātā
prem bibas sevak sukhadātā

verses.sa:
जाइ देखी आवहु नगरु सुख निधान दोउ भाइ ।
करहु सुफल सब के नयन सुंदर बदन देखाइ ॥
verses.tr:
jāi dekhī āvahu nagaru sukh nidhān dou bhāi
karahu suphal sab ke nayan suṃdar badan dekhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When lt4ma and the hermits had taken food and rested a little, he went and- sat down by his brother’s side: now it still wanted an hour to sunset,

And Lakshman had at heart a great longing to go and see Janak’s city; but again, for fear of his brother and respect for the saint, he said nothing out loud, but was smiling to himself. Rama understood what was passing in his mind, and being ever considerate to his followers was glad and, with a most modest and submissive smile, after begging permission of his guru to speak, said,—‘ Sir, Lakshman wishes to see the city, but out of respect for you is afraid to speak. If you will allow me, I will show him the place and quickly bring him back again.” The saint replied most affectionately, —‘O Rama how can you do aught but good; the guardian of the bridge of religion, the loving benefactor of all faithful servants?
Go, blessed pair of brothers, and see the city; gladden

sections.label: Doha 219
sections.name: रुचिर चौतनीं सुभग सिर मेचक कुंचित केस

verses.sa:
मुनि पद कमल बंदि दोउ भ्राता ।
चले लोक लोचन सुख दाता ॥
verses.tr:
muni pad kamal baṃdi dou bhrātā
cale lok locan sukh dātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बालक बृंदि देखि अति सोभा ।
लगे संग लोचन मनु लोभा ॥
verses.tr:
bālak bṛṃdi dekhi ati sobhā
lage saṃg locan manu lobhā

verses.sa:
पीत बसन परिकर कटि भाथा ।
चारु चाप सर सोहत हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
pīt basan parikar kaṭi bhāthā
cāru cāp sar sohat hāthā

verses.sa:
तन अनुहरत सुचंदन खोरी ।
स्यामल गौर मनोहर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
tan anuharat sucaṃdan khorī
syāmal gaur manohar jorī

verses.sa:
केहरि कंधर बाहु बिसाला ।
उर अति रुचिर नागमनि माला ॥
verses.tr:
kehari kaṃdhar bāhu bisālā
ur ati rucir nāgamani mālā

verses.sa:
सुभग सोन सरसीरुह लोचन ।
बदन मयंक तापत्रय मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
subhag son sarasīruh locan
badan mayaṃk tāpatraya mocan

verses.sa:
कानन्हि कनक फूल छबि देहीं ।
चितवत चितहि चोरि जनु लेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kānanhi kanak phūl chabi dehīṃ
citavat citahi cori janu lehīṃ

verses.sa:
चितवनि चारु भृकुटि बर बाँकी ।
तिलक रेखा सोभा जनु चाँकी ॥
verses.tr:
citavani cāru bhṛkuṭi bar bām̐kī
tilak rekhā sobhā janu cām̐kī

verses.sa:
रुचिर चौतनीं सुभग सिर मेचक कुंचित केस ।
नख सिख सुंदर बंधु दोउ सोभा सकल सुदेस ॥
verses.tr:
rucir cautanīṃ subhag sir mecak kuṃcit kes
nakh sikh suṃdar baṃdhu dou sobhā sakal sudes
verses.head: दोहा

trans: the eyes of all the people by the sight of your beauty.” Chaupdi 223.

After bowing at the saint’s feet they went, these two brothers, the delight of the eyes of the whole world. When the children in the market-place saw ‘their exceeding beauty their eyes and their very soul fastened greedily upon them. Clad in yellow apparel, with belt and quiver at their side, with graceful bow and arrows in hand, a lovely pair, one dark, the other fair of hue, with sandalwood tilek to match their complexion; with lion-like waist and long arms, and breast adorned with strings of elephant pearls, with shapely ears and lotus eyes, and moonlike face to assuage the three kinds of pain; with golden flowers for earrings, so beautiful as to steal the heart of every beholder; with a bewitching glance and fair arched eyebrows, and a star on the forehead that seemed beauty’s own stamp;
With jaunty cap on comely head, with black curly locks the two brothers were all-beautiful from head to foot and exquisite in every part.

sections.label: Doha 220
sections.name: बय किसोर सुषमा सदन स्याम गौर सुख घाम

verses.sa:
देखन नगरु भूपसुत आए ।
समाचार पुरबासिन्ह पाए ॥
verses.tr:
dekhan nagaru bhūpasut āe
samācār purabāsinh pāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धाए धाम काम सब त्यागी ।
मनहु रंक निधि लूटन लागी ॥
verses.tr:
dhāe dhām kām sab tyāgī
manahu raṃk nidhi lūṭan lāgī

verses.sa:
निरखि सहज सुंदर दोउ भाई ।
होहिं सुखी लोचन फल पाई ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi sahaj suṃdar dou bhāī
hohiṃ sukhī locan phal pāī

verses.sa:
जुबतीं भवन झरोखन्हि लागीं ।
निरखहिं राम रूप अनुरागीं ॥
verses.tr:
jubatīṃ bhavan jharokhanhi lāgīṃ
nirakhahiṃ rām rūp anurāgīṃ

verses.sa:
कहहिं परसपर बचन सप्रीती ।
सखि इन्ह कोटि काम छबि जीती ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ parasapar bacan saprītī
sakhi inh koṭi kām chabi jītī

verses.sa:
सुर नर असुर नाग मुनि माहीं ।
सोभा असि कहुँ सुनिअति नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sur nar asur nāg muni māhīṃ
sobhā asi kahum̐ suniati nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बिष्नु चारि भुज बिघि मुख चारी ।
बिकट बेष मुख पंच पुरारी ॥
verses.tr:
biṣnu cāri bhuj bighi mukh cārī
bikaṭ beṣ mukh paṃc purārī

verses.sa:
अपर देउ अस कोउ न आही ।
यह छबि सखि पटतरिअ जाही ॥
verses.tr:
apar deu as kou na āhī
yah chabi sakhi paṭataria jāhī

verses.sa:
बय किसोर सुषमा सदन स्याम गौर सुख घाम ।
अंग अंग पर वारिअहिं कोटि कोटि सत काम ॥
verses.tr:
baya kisor suṣamā sadan syām gaur sukh ghām
aṃg aṃg par vāriahiṃ koṭi koṭi sat kām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the citizens heard that the princes were come to see the town, they all left their business and started off like beggars to pillage a treasury. When they beheld the easy grace of the;two brothers they were glad indeed, and their eyes were rewarded.
