The maidens peeping from the windows of the houses at once fell in love with Rama’s beauty, and in amorous strain addressed one another,—‘' They surpass in beauty a thousand loves: neither among gods, nor men, nor demons, nor serpents, nor deified stains has beauty such as theirs ever been heard of. As for Vishnu with his four arms, Brahma with his four heads, and Purari with his five faces and wondrons attire, and all the other gods, there is not one in the whole universe whose beauty, my Friend, can be compared to theirs.
Of tender age, the very home of beauty, equally lovely whether dark or fair, as though a myriad loves had been ° lavished on each individual limb of their body.

sections.label: Doha 221
sections.name: बिप्रकाजु करि बंधु दोउ मग मुनिबधू उधारि

verses.sa:
कहहु सखी अस को तनुधारी ।
जो न मोह यह रूप निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu sakhī as ko tanudhārī
jo na moh yah rūp nihārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोउ सप्रेम बोली मृदु बानी ।
जो मैं सुना सो सुनहु सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
kou saprem bolī mṛdu bānī
jo maiṃ sunā so sunahu sayānī

verses.sa:
ए दोऊ दसरथ के ढोटा ।
बाल मरालन्हि के कल जोटा ॥
verses.tr:
e doū dasarath ke ḍhoṭā
bāl marālanhi ke kal joṭā

verses.sa:
मुनि कौसिक मख के रखवारे ।
जिन्ह रन अजिर निसाचर मारे ॥
verses.tr:
muni kausik makh ke rakhavāre
jinh ran ajir nisācar māre

verses.sa:
स्याम गात कल कंज बिलोचन ।
जो मारीच सुभुज मदु मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
syām gāt kal kaṃj bilocan
jo mārīc subhuj madu mocan

verses.sa:
कौसल्या सुत सो सुख खानी ।
नामु रामु धनु सायक पानी ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā sut so sukh khānī
nāmu rāmu dhanu sāyak pānī

verses.sa:
गौर किसोर बेषु बर काछें ।
कर सर चाप राम के पाछें ॥
verses.tr:
gaur kisor beṣu bar kācheṃ
kar sar cāp rām ke pācheṃ

verses.sa:
लछिमनु नामु राम लघु भ्राता ।
सुनु सखि तासु सुमित्रा माता ॥
verses.tr:
lachimanu nāmu rām laghu bhrātā
sunu sakhi tāsu sumitrā mātā

verses.sa:
बिप्रकाजु करि बंधु दोउ मग मुनिबधू उधारि ।
आए देखन चापमख सुनि हरषीं सब नारि ॥
verses.tr:
biprakāju kari baṃdhu dou mag munibadhū udhāri
āe dekhan cāpamakh suni haraṣīṃ sab nāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Tell me, friend, is there any one in human form who would not be charmed at the sight of such beauty?” Said one in gentle loving tones,—“ Hear, my dear, what I have been told. This pretty pair of young cyynets are the two sons of King Dasarath. They have protected the sacrifice of Saint Visvamitra and ‘slain in battle the invincible demons, The lovely child with dark complexion and lotus eyes, who quelled the pride of Maricha and Subahu and bears the bow and arrows in his hand, is the sweet son of Kausaly’, by name Rama. The fair youth in gallant attire, who also has bow and. arrows in hand and follows Rama, is named Lakshman and is his younger brother. Sumitra, you must know, is his mother. ~
After befriending the Brahmans, and on the road _ setting free the sage’s wife, the two brothers have come here to see the tournament.” On hearing thisal the ladies were delighted.:

sections.label: Doha 222
sections.name: नाहिं त हम कहुँ सुनहु सखि इन्ह कर दरसनु दूरि

verses.sa:
देखि राम छबि कोउ एक कहई ।
जोगु जानकिहि यह बरु अहई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām chabi kou ek kahaī
jogu jānakihi yah baru ahaī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौ सखि इन्हहि देख नरनाहू ।
पन परिहरि हठि करइ बिबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
jau sakhi inhahi dekh naranāhū
pan parihari haṭhi karai bibāhū

verses.sa:
कोउ कह ए भूपति पहिचाने ।
मुनि समेत सादर सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
kou kah e bhūpati pahicāne
muni samet sādar sanamāne

verses.sa:
सखि परंतु पनु राउ न तजई ।
बिधि बस हठि अबिबेकहि भजई ॥
verses.tr:
sakhi paraṃtu panu rāu na tajaī
bidhi bas haṭhi abibekahi bhajaī

verses.sa:
कोउ कह जौं भल अहइ बिधाता ।
सब कहँ सुनिअ उचित फलदाता ॥
verses.tr:
kou kah jauṃ bhal ahai bidhātā
sab kaham̐ sunia ucit phaladātā

verses.sa:
तौ जानकिहि मिलिहि बरु एहू ।
नाहिन आलि इहाँ संदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
tau jānakihi milihi baru ehū
nāhin āli ihām̐ saṃdehū

verses.sa:
जौ बिधि बस अस बनै सँजोगू ।
तौ कृतकृत्य होइ सब लोगू ॥
verses.tr:
jau bidhi bas as banai sam̐jogū
tau kṛtakṛtya hoi sab logū

verses.sa:
सखि हमरें आरति अति तातें ।
कबहुँक ए आवहिं एहि नातें ॥
verses.tr:
sakhi hamareṃ ārati ati tāteṃ
kabahum̐k e āvahiṃ ehi nāteṃ

verses.sa:
नाहिं त हम कहुँ सुनहु सखि इन्ह कर दरसनु दूरि ।
यह संघटु तब होइ जब पुन्य पुराकृत भूरि ॥
verses.tr:
nāhiṃ ta ham kahum̐ sunahu sakhi inh kar darasanu dūri
yah saṃghaṭu tab hoi jab punya purākṛt bhūri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said one, after regarding Rama’s beauty—‘ Here is a bridegroom worthy of Janaki. If the king does but see him, he will] abjure his vow and insist upon a marriage with them.’ Said another,—“ The king knows who they are and has received both them and the saint, with all honour. Ele has not, however, gone back from his vow, but mastered by fate persists in his folly.’ Said another,—‘ If God is good and is certain to reward every man according to his deserts, then here is the bridegroom Janaki will wed. About this, my dear, there can be no doubt. When such a union is brought about by destiny, every one will be satisfied. O friend, I am deeply moved by the thought that if this marriage takes place he will come again some time;
Otherwise there is no chance of my seeing him; it is only a long accumulation of merit in previous existences that is rewarded by such intercourse.” Chaupdi 227,

sections.label: Doha 223
sections.name: हियँ हरषहिं बरषहिं सुमन सुमुखि सुलोचनि बृंद

verses.sa:
बोली अपर कहेहु सखि नीका ।
एहिं बिआह अति हित सबहीं का ॥
verses.tr:
bolī apar kahehu sakhi nīkā
ehiṃ biāh ati hit sabahīṃ kā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोउ कह संकर चाप कठोरा ।
ए स्यामल मृदुगात किसोरा ॥
verses.tr:
kou kah saṃkar cāp kaṭhorā
e syāmal mṛdugāt kisorā

verses.sa:
सबु असमंजस अहइ सयानी ।
यह सुनि अपर कहइ मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
sabu asamaṃjas ahai sayānī
yah suni apar kahai mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
सखि इन्ह कहँ कोउ कोउ अस कहहीं ।
बड़ प्रभाउ देखत लघु अहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sakhi inh kaham̐ kou kou as kahahīṃ
bar̤ prabhāu dekhat laghu ahahīṃ

verses.sa:
परसि जासु पद पंकज धूरी ।
तरी अहल्या कृत अघ भूरी ॥
verses.tr:
parasi jāsu pad paṃkaj dhūrī
tarī ahalyā kṛt agh bhūrī

verses.sa:
सो कि रहिहि बिनु सिवधनु तोरें ।
यह प्रतीति परिहरिअ न भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
so ki rahihi binu sivadhanu toreṃ
yah pratīti pariharia na bhoreṃ

verses.sa:
जेहिं बिरंचि रचि सीय सँवारी ।
तेहिं स्यामल बरु रचेउ बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ biraṃci raci sīya sam̐vārī
tehiṃ syāmal baru raceu bicārī

verses.sa:
तासु बचन सुनि सब हरषानीं ।
ऐसेइ होउ कहहिं मुदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu bacan suni sab haraṣānīṃ
aisei hou kahahiṃ mudu bānī

verses.sa:
हियँ हरषहिं बरषहिं सुमन सुमुखि सुलोचनि बृंद ।
जाहिं जहाँ जहँ बंधु दोउ तहँ तहँ परमानंद ॥
verses.tr:
hiyam̐ haraṣahiṃ baraṣahiṃ suman sumukhi sulocani bṛṃd
jāhiṃ jahām̐ jaham̐ baṃdhu dou taham̐ taham̐ paramānaṃd
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said another,—‘ Friend, you have spoken well; this is a marriage that will please every one.” Said another, — “Siva’s bow is hard to bend, and this dark lad is of delicate frame; it is really a most unfair test.” Hearing this, another soft- voiced maiden said,—“ I have once and again heard say of them that though slight in appearance their strength is great. Touched by the dust of his lotus feet, the guilty Ahalya attained salvation: and he will never rest till he has broken the bow; this is a belief out of which I am no-how to be cheated. When the Creator fashioned Sita, he predestined for her this dark-complexioned bridegroom.” On hearing these words all were glad and softly exclaimed,—‘ May it indeed prove so.’
In their gladness of heart the bevy of fair-faced bright-

sections.label: Doha 224
sections.name: सब सिसु एहि मिस प्रेमबस परसि मनोहर गात

verses.sa:
पुर पूरब दिसि गे दोउ भाई ।
जहँ धनुमख हित भूमि बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
pur pūrab disi ge dou bhāī
jaham̐ dhanumakh hit bhūmi banāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अति बिस्तार चारु गच ढारी ।
बिमल बेदिका रुचिर सँवारी ॥
verses.tr:
ati bistār cāru gac ḍhārī
bimal bedikā rucir sam̐vārī

verses.sa:
चहुँ दिसि कंचन मंच बिसाला ।
रचे जहाँ बेठहिं महिपाला ॥
verses.tr:
cahum̐ disi kaṃcan maṃc bisālā
race jahām̐ beṭhahiṃ mahipālā

verses.sa:
तेहि पाछें समीप चहुँ पासा ।
अपर मंच मंडली बिलासा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi pācheṃ samīp cahum̐ pāsā
apar maṃc maṃḍalī bilāsā

verses.sa:
कछुक ऊँचि सब भाँति सुहाई ।
बैठहिं नगर लोग जहँ जाई ॥
verses.tr:
kachuk ūm̐ci sab bhām̐ti suhāī
baiṭhahiṃ nagar log jaham̐ jāī

verses.sa:
तिन्ह के निकट बिसाल सुहाए ।
धवल धाम बहुबरन बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
tinh ke nikaṭ bisāl suhāe
dhaval dhām bahubaran banāe

verses.sa:
जहँ बैंठैं देखहिं सब नारी ।
जथा जोगु निज कुल अनुहारी ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ baiṃṭhaiṃ dekhahiṃ sab nārī
jathā jogu nij kul anuhārī

verses.sa:
पुर बालक कहि कहि मृदु बचना ।
सादर प्रभुहि देखावहिं रचना ॥
verses.tr:
pur bālak kahi kahi mṛdu bacanā
sādar prabhuhi dekhāvahiṃ racanā

verses.sa:
सब सिसु एहि मिस प्रेमबस परसि मनोहर गात ।
तन पुलकहिं अति हरषु हियँ देखि देखि दोउ भ्रात ॥
verses.tr:
sab sisu ehi mis premabas parasi manohar gāt
tan pulakahiṃ ati haraṣu hiyam̐ dekhi dekhi dou bhrāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: eyed dames shower down flowers, and wherever the two brothers went there was all the joy of heaven.

Now they reached the eastern quarter of the city, where the lists had been prepared for the tournament. In the midst of a fair and spacious paved urea a spotless altar had been gorgeously adorned, witha broad golden platform all around for the reception of the princes, and close behind another circolar tier for the spectators, of somewhat greater height and elegantly decorated, where all the people of the city might come and sit. Close to this was another large and beautiful gallery of glistening white, painted in diverse colours, whence ladies might view the spectacle with due decorum, according to their family rank. The children politely show the two lords all the preparations, and with pleasant voice keep telling them what this ia and that is; thus, in their affection, finding 4 pretext for frequently touching their lovely person: while they thrill all over with delight as again and again they gaze on the twin brothers.

sections.label: Doha 225
sections.name: सभय सप्रेम बिनीत अति सकुच सहित दोउ भाइ

verses.sa:
सिसु सब राम प्रेमबस जाने ।
प्रीति समेत निकेत बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
sisu sab rām premabas jāne
prīti samet niket bakhāne
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निज निज रुचि सब लेंहिं बोलाई ।
सहित सनेह जाहिं दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij ruci sab leṃhiṃ bolāī
sahit saneh jāhiṃ dou bhāī

verses.sa:
राम देखावहिं अनुजहि रचना ।
कहि मृदु मधुर मनोहर बचना ॥
verses.tr:
rām dekhāvahiṃ anujahi racanā
kahi mṛdu madhur manohar bacanā

verses.sa:
लव निमेष महँ भुवन निकाया ।
रचइ जासु अनुसासन माया ॥
verses.tr:
lav nimeṣ maham̐ bhuvan nikāyā
racai jāsu anusāsan māyā

verses.sa:
भगति हेतु सोइ दीनदयाला ।
चितवत चकित धनुष मखसाला ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati hetu soi dīnadayālā
citavat cakit dhanuṣ makhasālā

verses.sa:
कौतुक देखि चले गुरु पाहीं ।
जानि बिलंबु त्रास मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kautuk dekhi cale guru pāhīṃ
jāni bilaṃbu trās man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
जासु त्रास डर कहुँ डर होई ।
भजन प्रभाउ देखावत सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu trās ḍar kahum̐ ḍar hoī
bhajan prabhāu dekhāvat soī

verses.sa:
कहि बातें मृदु मधुर सुहाईं ।
किए बिदा बालक बरिआई ॥
verses.tr:
kahi bāteṃ mṛdu madhur suhāīṃ
kie bidā bālak bariāī

verses.sa:
सभय सप्रेम बिनीत अति सकुच सहित दोउ भाइ ।
गुर पद पंकज नाइ सिर बैठे आयसु पाइ ॥
verses.tr:
sabhaya saprem binīt ati sakuc sahit dou bhāi
gur pad paṃkaj nāi sir baiṭhe āyasu pāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When they perceived that Rama was won by their devotion, they lovingly explain the different places, each according to his own fancy calling away the two brothers, who in their kindness are ever ready to come. Rama shows Lakshman everything, still talking in light and merry tone: and he, in obedience to whose fiat Maya in a moment of time created the entire universe, out of compassion to his faithful people, feigns amazement at the sight of agourney ground. When they had seen all the show, they returned to their guru in alarm at being se late: and he, by whose awe Terror itself is dismayed, thus manifests the transcendant virtue of devotion. With many kind and courteous phrases they reluctantly take have of the children;
And meekly and submissively, with mingled awe and love, they bow the head at the guru's feet: nor sit down till they obtain his permission.

sections.label: Doha 226
sections.name: उठे लखन निसि बिगत सुनि अरुनसिखा धुनि कान

verses.sa:
निसि प्रबेस मुनि आयसु दीन्हा ।
सबहीं संध्याबंदनु कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
nisi prabes muni āyasu dīnhā
sabahīṃ saṃdhyābaṃdanu kīnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहत कथा इतिहास पुरानी ।
रुचिर रजनि जुग जाम सिरानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahat kathā itihās purānī
rucir rajani jug jām sirānī

verses.sa:
मुनिबर सयन कीन्हि तब जाई ।
लगे चरन चापन दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
munibar sayan kīnhi tab jāī
lage caran cāpan dou bhāī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह के चरन सरोरुह लागी ।
करत बिबिध जप जोग बिरागी ॥
verses.tr:
jinh ke caran saroruh lāgī
karat bibidh jap jog birāgī

verses.sa:
तेइ दोउ बंधु प्रेम जनु जीते ।
गुर पद कमल पलोटत प्रीते ॥
verses.tr:
tei dou baṃdhu prem janu jīte
gur pad kamal paloṭat prīte

verses.sa:
बारबार मुनि अग्या दीन्ही ।
रघुबर जाइ सयन तब कीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
bārabār muni agyā dīnhī
raghubar jāi sayan tab kīnhī

verses.sa:
चापत चरन लखनु उर लाएँ ।
सभय सप्रेम परम सचु पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
cāpat caran lakhanu ur lāem̐
sabhaya saprem param sacu pāem̐

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि प्रभु कह सोवहु ताता ।
पौढ़े धरि उर पद जलजाता ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni prabhu kah sovahu tātā
paur̤he dhari ur pad jalajātā

verses.sa: उठे लखन निसि बिगत सुनि अरुनसिखा धुनि कान ॥
verses.tr: uṭhe lakhan nisi bigat suni arunasikhā dhuni kān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: गुर तें पहिलेहिं जगतपति जागे रामु सुजान ॥
verses.tr: gur teṃ pahilehiṃ jagatapati jāge rāmu sujān

trans: When it was dusk ‘the saint gave the word, and all performed their evening devotions, and in the recital of sacred legends spent two watches of the solemn night. Then the saint retired to his couch, and the two brothers began to shampoo his feet; they whose lotus feet the holiest of men longing to behold practise all kinds of penance and meditation, even they, these two brothers, mastered by love, affectionately shampooed their master’s lotus feet. At last when the saint had so ordered again and again, Rama himself retired to rest, while Lakshman pressed his feet to his heart and reverently caressed them with emotions of exquisite delight. Again and again the Lord said,— ‘Sleep my brother,’ and at last he laid himself down, but with the divine feet still in his lap.
When the night was spent, at the first sound of cock-

sections.label: Doha 227
sections.name: बागु तड़ागु बिलोकि प्रभु हरषे बंधु समेत

verses.sa:
सकल सौच करि जाइ नहाए ।
नित्य निबाहि मुनिहि सिर नाए ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sauc kari jāi nahāe
nitya nibāhi munihi sir nāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
समय जानि गुर आयसु पाई ।
लेन प्रसून चले दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
samaya jāni gur āyasu pāī
len prasūn cale dou bhāī

verses.sa:
भूप बागु बर देखेउ जाई ।
जहँ बसंत रितु रही लोभाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bāgu bar dekheu jāī
jaham̐ basaṃt ritu rahī lobhāī

verses.sa:
लागे बिटप मनोहर नाना ।
बरन बरन बर बेलि बिताना ॥
verses.tr:
lāge biṭap manohar nānā
baran baran bar beli bitānā

verses.sa:
नव पल्लव फल सुमान सुहाए ।
निज संपति सुर रूख लजाए ॥
verses.tr:
nav pallav phal sumān suhāe
nij saṃpati sur rūkh lajāe

verses.sa:
चातक कोकिल कीर चकोरा ।
कूजत बिहग नटत कल मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
cātak kokil kīr cakorā
kūjat bihag naṭat kal morā

verses.sa:
मध्य बाग सरु सोह सुहावा ।
मनि सोपान बिचित्र बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
madhya bāg saru soh suhāvā
mani sopān bicitr banāvā

verses.sa:
बिमल सलिलु सरसिज बहुरंगा ।
जलखग कूजत गुंजत भृंगा ॥
verses.tr:
bimal salilu sarasij bahuraṃgā
jalakhag kūjat guṃjat bhṛṃgā

verses.sa:
बागु तड़ागु बिलोकि प्रभु हरषे बंधु समेत ।
परम रम्य आरामु यहु जो रामहि सुख देत ॥
verses.tr:
bāgu tar̤āgu biloki prabhu haraṣe baṃdhu samet
param ramya ārāmu yahu jo rāmahi sukh det
verses.head: दोहा

trans: crow Lakshman arose; and next, before the saint, woke the lord of the universe, the all-wise Rama.

After performing all the customary acts of purification and going to bathe, they bowed before the guru, and by his permission went out to gather flowers, as befitted the time. As they went. they spied a beautiful garden of the king's, where reigned perpetual Spring, planted with ornamental trees of every kind, and overhung with many coloured creepers, so rich io bud and fruit and flower that in its abundance it put to shame even the trees of paradise; while the peacocks danced responsive to the music made by the feather-ed choir of chdtak, kotl parrot and chakor. In the midst of the garden a lovely lake shone bright with jewelled steps of varied designed: its pure expanse gladdened with manycoloured lotuses and the cooing of water-birds and the hum of -bees. rf
Both the lord and his brother were delighted at the sight of the lake and the garden. What a charming pleas-ance must that have been which pleased even Rama.

sections.label: Doha 228
sections.name: तासु दसा देखि सखिन्ह पुलक गात जलु नैन

verses.sa:
चहुँ दिसि चितइ पूँछि मालिगन ।
लगे लेन दल फूल मुदित मन ॥
verses.tr:
cahum̐ disi citai pūm̐chi māligan
lage len dal phūl mudit man
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर सीता तहँ आई ।
गिरिजा पूजन जननि पठाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar sītā taham̐ āī
girijā pūjan janani paṭhāī

verses.sa:
संग सखीं सब सुभग सयानी ।
गावहिं गीत मनोहर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃg sakhīṃ sab subhag sayānī
gāvahiṃ gīt manohar bānī

verses.sa:
सर समीप गिरिजा गृह सोहा ।
बरनि न जाइ देखि मनु मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
sar samīp girijā gṛh sohā
barani na jāi dekhi manu mohā

verses.sa:
मज्जनु करि सर सखिन्ह समेता ।
गई मुदित मन गौरि निकेता ॥
verses.tr:
majjanu kari sar sakhinh sametā
gaī mudit man gauri niketā

verses.sa:
पूजा कीन्हि अधिक अनुरागा ।
निज अनुरूप सुभग बरु मागा ॥
verses.tr:
pūjā kīnhi adhik anurāgā
nij anurūp subhag baru māgā

verses.sa:
एक सखी सिय संगु बिहाई ।
गई रही देखन फुलवाई ॥
verses.tr:
ek sakhī siya saṃgu bihāī
gaī rahī dekhan phulavāī

verses.sa:
तेहि दोउ बंधु बिलोके जाई ।
प्रेम बिबस सीता पहिं आई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi dou baṃdhu biloke jāī
prem bibas sītā pahiṃ āī

verses.sa:
तासु दसा देखि सखिन्ह पुलक गात जलु नैन ।
कहु कारनु निज हरष कर पूछहि सब मृदु बैन ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu dasā dekhi sakhinh pulak gāt jalu nain
kahu kāranu nij haraṣ kar pūchahi sab mṛdu bain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After looking all about and asking leave of the gardeners they began in high glee to gather leaves and flowers. At that very time Sita too came there, having been sent by her mother to visit the shrine of Girijae. With her came all her young and lovely companions, singing glad songs. Now Girija’s shrine was close to the lake, beautiful beyond description, the delight of all beholders. When she and her attendants had bathed in the pool, she approached the goddess with a glad heart and after adoration paid with much devotion begged of her a handsome and well-matched bridegroom. One of her attendant damsels, who had strayed away to look at the garden, chanced to see the two brothers and returned to Sita quite love-smitten.
When her companions observed what a state she was in, her body all ina tremble and her eyes full of tears, they asked, in gentle tones,—‘ Declare the cause of this rapture.’

sections.label: Doha 229
sections.name: सुमिरि सीय नारद बचन उपजी प्रीति पुनीत

verses.sa:
देखन बागु कुअँर दुइ आए ।
बय किसोर सब भाँति सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
dekhan bāgu kuam̐r dui āe
baya kisor sab bhām̐ti suhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
स्याम गौर किमि कहौं बखानी ।
गिरा अनयन नयन बिनु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
syām gaur kimi kahauṃ bakhānī
girā anayan nayan binu bānī

verses.sa:
सुनि हरषीं सब सखीं सयानी ।
सिय हियँ अति उतकंठा जानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni haraṣīṃ sab sakhīṃ sayānī
siya hiyam̐ ati utakaṃṭhā jānī

verses.sa:
एक कहइ नृपसुत तेइ आली ।
सुने जे मुनि सँग आए काली ॥
verses.tr:
ek kahai nṛpasut tei ālī
sune je muni sam̐g āe kālī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह निज रूप मोहनी डारी ।
कीन्ह स्वबस नगर नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
jinh nij rūp mohanī ḍārī
kīnh svabas nagar nar nārī

verses.sa:
बरनत छबि जहँ तहँ सब लोगू ।
अवसि देखिअहिं देखन जोगू ॥
verses.tr:
baranat chabi jaham̐ taham̐ sab logū
avasi dekhiahiṃ dekhan jogū

verses.sa:
तासु वचन अति सियहि सुहाने ।
दरस लागि लोचन अकुलाने ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu vacan ati siyahi suhāne
daras lāgi locan akulāne

verses.sa:
चली अग्र करि प्रिय सखि सोई ।
प्रीति पुरातन लखइ न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
calī agr kari priya sakhi soī
prīti purātan lakhai na koī

verses.sa: सुमिरि सीय नारद बचन उपजी प्रीति पुनीत ॥
verses.tr: sumiri sīya nārad bacan upajī prīti punīt
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: चकित बिलोकति सकल दिसि जनु सिसु मृगी सभीत ॥
verses.tr: cakit bilokati sakal disi janu sisu mṛgī sabhīt

trans: “There have come to see the garden two princes of tender age and charming in every way; one dark of hue, the other fair, but how can [ describe them? Voice is sightless and eyes are dumb.” All the damsels were delighted at her speech, and perceiving the intense longing in Sita’s bosom, one of them exclaimed,—* My dear, they must be the king’s sons, who, as I hear, arrived yesterday with the saint, who completely fascinated with their beauty and stole: away the hearts of all the women in the city. Every one is talking of their loveliness; we really must see them; they are worth seeing.” These words were most grateful to Sita, whose eyes were restless with longing. With her kind friend to lead the way, she followed, nor did any one know that it was an old love.
Remembering Narad’s words, she was filled with holy devotion, and anxiously turned her gaze on every side, like a startled fawn.

sections.label: Doha 230
sections.name: सिय सोभा हियँ बरनि प्रभु आपनि दसा बिचारि

verses.sa:
कंकन किंकिनि नूपुर धुनि सुनि ।
कहत लखन सन रामु हृदयँ गुनि ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃkan kiṃkini nūpur dhuni suni
kahat lakhan san rāmu hṛdayam̐ guni
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मानहुँ मदन दुंदुभी दीन्ही ।
मनसा बिस्व बिजय कहँ कीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
mānahum̐ madan duṃdubhī dīnhī
manasā bisv bijaya kaham̐ kīnhī

verses.sa:
अस कहि फिरि चितए तेहि ओरा ।
सिय मुख ससि भए नयन चकोरा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi phiri citae tehi orā
siya mukh sasi bhae nayan cakorā

verses.sa:
भए बिलोचन चारु अचंचल ।
मनहुँ सकुचि निमि तजे दिगंचल ॥
verses.tr:
bhae bilocan cāru acaṃcal
manahum̐ sakuci nimi taje digaṃcal

verses.sa:
देखि सीय सोभा सुखु पावा ।
हृदयँ सराहत बचनु न आवा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi sīya sobhā sukhu pāvā
hṛdayam̐ sarāhat bacanu na āvā

verses.sa:
जनु बिरंचि सब निज निपुनाई ।
बिरचि बिस्व कहँ प्रगटि देखाई ॥
verses.tr:
janu biraṃci sab nij nipunāī
biraci bisv kaham̐ pragaṭi dekhāī

verses.sa:
सुंदरता कहुँ सुंदर करई ।
छबिगृहँ दीपसिखा जनु बरई ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdaratā kahum̐ suṃdar karaī
chabigṛham̐ dīpasikhā janu baraī

verses.sa:
सब उपमा कबि रहे जुठारी ।
केहिं पटतरौं बिदेहकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
sab upamā kabi rahe juṭhārī
kehiṃ paṭatarauṃ bidehakumārī

verses.sa:
सिय सोभा हियँ बरनि प्रभु आपनि दसा बिचारि ।
बोले सुचि मन अनुज सन बचन समय अनुहारि ॥
verses.tr:
siya sobhā hiyam̐ barani prabhu āpani dasā bicāri
bole suci man anuj san bacan samaya anuhāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When he heard the goand of the golden bangles on her hands and feet, Rama thought within himself, and then said to Lakshman,—‘ Imagine Love triumphant over the whole world to be now sounding the kettledrum of victory.” So saying he again looked in that direction, and like the moon on the chakor, flashed Sita’s face upon his sight. His eyes became us immovably fixed as though Nimi, the winking god, had fled in confusion from his wonted post. Beholding her beauty he was enraptured; but his admiration was all within, and utterance failed him. As though the great Architect, after creating the world, had put before it in visible form all the skill with which he had fashioned it; or as if the Beautiful had been beautified into a temple of beauty and illuminated by a sudden flash of torchlight; but all the similes of the poets are stale and hackneyed; where can I find any likeness to Janaki; Dohd 242.
Dwelling in heart on Sita’s beauty and reflecting on his own good fortune, the pure-souled god thus addressed his brother in terms appropriate tu the occasion, —

sections.label: Doha 231
sections.name: करत बतकहि अनुज सन मन सिय रूप लोभान

verses.sa:
तात जनकतनया यह सोई ।
धनुषजग्य जेहि कारन होई ॥
verses.tr:
tāt janakatanayā yah soī
dhanuṣajagya jehi kāran hoī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पूजन गौरि सखीं लै आई ।
करत प्रकासु फिरइ फुलवाई ॥
verses.tr:
pūjan gauri sakhīṃ lai āī
karat prakāsu phirai phulavāī

verses.sa:
जासु बिलोकि अलोकिक सोभा ।
सहज पुनीत मोर मनु छोभा ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu biloki alokik sobhā
sahaj punīt mor manu chobhā

verses.sa:
सो सबु कारन जान बिधाता ।
फरकहिं सुभद अंग सुनु भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
so sabu kāran jān bidhātā
pharakahiṃ subhad aṃg sunu bhrātā

verses.sa:
रघुबंसिन्ह कर सहज सुभाऊ ।
मनु कुपंथ पगु धरइ न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
raghubaṃsinh kar sahaj subhāū
manu kupaṃth pagu dharai na kāū

verses.sa:
मोहि अतिसय प्रतीति मन केरी ।
जेहिं सपनेहुँ परनारि न हेरी ॥
verses.tr:
mohi atisaya pratīti man kerī
jehiṃ sapanehum̐ paranāri na herī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कै लहहिं न रिपु रन पीठी ।
नहिं पावहिं परतिय मनु डीठी ॥
verses.tr:
jinh kai lahahiṃ na ripu ran pīṭhī
nahiṃ pāvahiṃ paratiya manu ḍīṭhī

verses.sa:
मंगन लहहि न जिन्ह कै नाहीं ।
ते नरबर थोरे जग माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgan lahahi na jinh kai nāhīṃ
te narabar thore jag māhīṃ

verses.sa:
करत बतकहि अनुज सन मन सिय रूप लोभान ।
मुख सरोज मकरंद छबि करइ मधुप इव पान ॥
verses.tr:
karat batakahi anuj san man siya rūp lobhān
mukh saroj makaraṃd chabi karai madhup iv pān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘“ Brother, this is the very daughter of king Janak for whom the tournament has been ordained. She has come with her attendants to worship Gauri, and a train of light marks her path through the garden. At the sight of her divine beauty, my ordinarily placid bosom is agitated; God alone knows the cause, but of a truth, brother, my lucky side is throbbing as though for coming good fortune. It has always been a mark of the race of Raghu that they never set their heart on evil courses; and thus [ am _ confidently assured that all will be well; for I have never even in a dream looked upon another man’s wife to long after her. And rare, indeed, in the world are the men who neither turn their back upon the foe in battle nor covert their neighbour's wife, and from whom no beggar meets a rebuff.”
Thus discoursing to his brother, and with his soul | enamoured of Sita’s beauty, like a bee sucking honey from a flower, he drank in the loveliness of her face.

sections.label: Doha 232
sections.name: लताभवन तें प्रगट भे तेहि अवसर दोउ भाइ

verses.sa:
चितवहि चकित चहूँ दिसि सीता ।
कहँ गए नृपकिसोर मनु चिंता ॥
verses.tr:
citavahi cakit cahūm̐ disi sītā
kaham̐ gae nṛpakisor manu ciṃtā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जहँ बिलोक मृग सावक नैनी ।
जनु तहँ बरिस कमल सित श्रेनी ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ bilok mṛg sāvak nainī
janu taham̐ baris kamal sit śrenī

verses.sa:
लता ओट तब सखिन्ह लखाए ।
स्यामल गौर किसोर सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
latā oṭ tab sakhinh lakhāe
syāmal gaur kisor suhāe

verses.sa:
देखि रूप लोचन ललचाने ।
हरषे जनु निज निधि पहिचाने ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rūp locan lalacāne
haraṣe janu nij nidhi pahicāne

verses.sa:
थके नयन रघुपति छबि देखें ।
पलकन्हिहूँ परिहरीं निमेषें ॥
verses.tr:
thake nayan raghupati chabi dekheṃ
palakanhihūm̐ pariharīṃ nimeṣeṃ

verses.sa:
अधिक सनेहँ देह भै भोरी ।
सरद ससिहि जनु चितव चकोरी ॥
verses.tr:
adhik saneham̐ deh bhai bhorī
sarad sasihi janu citav cakorī

verses.sa:
लोचन मग रामहि उर आनी ।
दीन्हे पलक कपाट सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
locan mag rāmahi ur ānī
dīnhe palak kapāṭ sayānī

verses.sa:
जब सिय सखिन्ह प्रेमबस जानी ।
कहि न सकहिं कछु मन सकुचानी ॥
verses.tr:
jab siya sakhinh premabas jānī
kahi na sakahiṃ kachu man sakucānī

verses.sa:
लताभवन तें प्रगट भे तेहि अवसर दोउ भाइ ।
निकसे जनु जुग बिमल बिधु जलद पटल बिलगाइ ॥
verses.tr:
latābhavan teṃ pragaṭ bhe tehi avasar dou bhāi
nikase janu jug bimal bidhu jalad paṭal bilagāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Sita kept looking anxiously all round, in doubt as to where the princes had gone. Wherever fell her fawn-like glance, it seemed a rain of glistening lotus flowers. Then her companions pointed out to her under the shade of the Creepers the two lovely youths, the one dark, the other fair of hue. Her eyes, on beholding their beauty, were filled with longing and with the gladness of one who has found a long-lost treasure. Wearied with gazing upon Rama’s charms, her eyelids forgot to wink, and her whole frame was fulfilled with desire, as is the partridge when it sees the autumnal moon. Perceiving Rama into her heart by the pathway of vision, she craftily closed upon him the doors of her eyelids. When her companions saw her thus overcome, they were too much abashed to utter a word.
Then emerged the twin brothers from the shade of the arbour, like two spotless moons from a riven cloud.

sections.label: Doha 233
sections.name: केहरि कटि पट पीत धर सुषमा सील निधान

verses.sa:
सोभा सीवँ सुभग दोउ बीरा ।
नील पीत जलजाभ सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sobhā sīvam̐ subhag dou bīrā
nīl pīt jalajābh sarīrā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोरपंख सिर सोहत नीके ।
गुच्छ बीच बिच कुसुम कली के ॥
verses.tr:
morapaṃkh sir sohat nīke
gucch bīc bic kusum kalī ke

verses.sa:
भाल तिलक श्रमबिंदु सुहाए ।
श्रवन सुभग भूषन छबि छाए ॥
verses.tr:
bhāl tilak śramabiṃdu suhāe
śravan subhag bhūṣan chabi chāe

verses.sa:
बिकट भृकुटि कच घूघरवारे ।
नव सरोज लोचन रतनारे ॥
verses.tr:
bikaṭ bhṛkuṭi kac ghūgharavāre
nav saroj locan ratanāre

verses.sa:
चारु चिबुक नासिका कपोला ।
हास बिलास लेत मनु मोला ॥
verses.tr:
cāru cibuk nāsikā kapolā
hās bilās let manu molā

verses.sa:
मुखछबि कहि न जाइ मोहि पाहीं ।
जो बिलोकि बहु काम लजाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mukhachabi kahi na jāi mohi pāhīṃ
jo biloki bahu kām lajāhīṃ

verses.sa:
उर मनि माल कंबु कल गीवा ।
काम कलभ कर भुज बलसींवा ॥
verses.tr:
ur mani māl kaṃbu kal gīvā
kām kalabh kar bhuj balasīṃvā

verses.sa:
सुमन समेत बाम कर दोना ।
सावँर कुअँर सखी सुठि लोना ॥
verses.tr:
suman samet bām kar donā
sāvam̐r kuam̐r sakhī suṭhi lonā

verses.sa:
केहरि कटि पट पीत धर सुषमा सील निधान ।
देखि भानुकुलभूषनहि बिसरा सखिन्ह अपान ॥
verses.tr:
kehari kaṭi paṭ pīt dhar suṣamā sīl nidhān
dekhi bhānukulabhūṣanahi bisarā sakhinh apān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Two gallant champions, the perfection of beauty, like a white lotus and a dark, with their hair parted like a raven’s wing on their comely head, and here and there bedecked with bunches of flower-buds; their forehead bright with the tilak and beads of perspiration, and their graceful ears adorned with ornaments; with arched eyebrows and curly locks, and eyes bright asa lotus bud, with lovely chin and nose and cheeks, and a gracious smile enslaving every soul — such beauteous features as I could never describe; they would put to shame a myriad Loves. With a string of jewels on his breast, with exquisitely dimpled neck, and powerful arms, like the trunk of some young elephant in whom KAmadeva had become incarnate; with the flowers and cup of leaves in his left hand, the dark prince, O my friend, is beautiful exceedingly.
As her companions gazed upon the two glories of the Solar race, with their lion-like waist and bright yellow attire, very abodes of bliss and amiability, they lost all self-consciousness.

sections.label: Doha 234
sections.name: देखन मिस मृग बिहग तरु फिरइ बहोरि बहोरि

verses.sa:
धरि धीरजु एक आलि सयानी ।
सीता सन बोली गहि पानी ॥
verses.tr:
dhari dhīraju ek āli sayānī
sītā san bolī gahi pānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बहुरि गौरि कर ध्यान करेहू ।
भूपकिसोर देखि किन लेहू ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri gauri kar dhyān karehū
bhūpakisor dekhi kin lehū

verses.sa:
सकुचि सीयँ तब नयन उघारे ।
सनमुख दोउ रघुसिंघ निहारे ॥
verses.tr:
sakuci sīyam̐ tab nayan ughāre
sanamukh dou raghusiṃgh nihāre

verses.sa:
नख सिख देखि राम कै सोभा ।
सुमिरि पिता पनु मनु अति छोभा ॥
verses.tr:
nakh sikh dekhi rām kai sobhā
sumiri pitā panu manu ati chobhā

verses.sa:
परबस सखिन्ह लखी जब सीता ।
भयउ गहरु सब कहहि सभीता ॥
verses.tr:
parabas sakhinh lakhī jab sītā
bhayau gaharu sab kahahi sabhītā

verses.sa:
पुनि आउब एहि बेरिआँ काली ।
अस कहि मन बिहसी एक आली ॥
verses.tr:
puni āub ehi beriām̐ kālī
as kahi man bihasī ek ālī

verses.sa:
गूढ़ गिरा सुनि सिय सकुचानी ।
भयउ बिलंबु मातु भय मानी ॥
verses.tr:
gūr̤h girā suni siya sakucānī
bhayau bilaṃbu mātu bhaya mānī

verses.sa:
धरि बड़ि धीर रामु उर आने ।
फिरि अपनपउ पितुबस जाने ॥
verses.tr:
dhari bar̤i dhīr rāmu ur āne
phiri apanapau pitubas jāne

verses.sa:
देखन मिस मृग बिहग तरु फिरइ बहोरि बहोरि ।
निरखि निरखि रघुबीर छबि बाढ़इ प्रीति न थोरि ॥
verses.tr:
dekhan mis mṛg bihag taru phirai bahori bahori
nirakhi nirakhi raghubīr chabi bār̤hai prīti na thori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Yet one summoning up courage, grasped Sita by the hand and said,—‘t You can at any time meditate upon Gauri; why not now look at the princess?”” Then the modest Sita unclosed her eyes and saw before her the two scions of Raghu. As she gazed on Rama, all beautiful from head to foot, and remembered her father’s vow, she was greatly agitated. When her companions saw her thus overcome they all cried as if in alarm,—“ It is getting late;” and one added with a meaning smile,—“ We must come again at this time to-morrow.” On hearing this clever hint Sita was abashed and said, as if in fear of her mother,—‘ It is late, indeed.” Then summoning up resolution, she fixed the image of Rama in her heart and turned to go; but again she thought how entirely it all depended upon her sire, Dohe 246.
And under pretence of looking at a deer, or bird, or tree, again and again she turned her head, and each time that she beheld the beauteous Raghubir her love was augmented not a little.

sections.label: Doha 235
sections.name: पतिदेवता सुतीय महुँ मातु प्रथम तव रेख

verses.sa:
जानि कठिन सिवचाप बिसूरति ।
चली राखि उर स्यामल मूरति ॥
verses.tr:
jāni kaṭhin sivacāp bisūrati
calī rākhi ur syāmal mūrati
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु जब जात जानकी जानी ।
सुख सनेह सोभा गुन खानी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu jab jāt jānakī jānī
sukh saneh sobhā gun khānī

verses.sa:
परम प्रेममय मृदु मसि कीन्ही ।
चारु चित भीतीं लिख लीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
param premamaya mṛdu masi kīnhī
cāru cit bhītīṃ likh līnhī

verses.sa:
गई भवानी भवन बहोरी ।
बंदि चरन बोली कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
gaī bhavānī bhavan bahorī
baṃdi caran bolī kar jorī

verses.sa:
जय जय गिरिबरराज किसोरी ।
जय महेस मुख चंद चकोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jaya jaya giribararāj kisorī
jaya mahes mukh caṃd cakorī

verses.sa:
जय गज बदन षड़ानन माता ।
जगत जननि दामिनि दुति गाता ॥
verses.tr:
jaya gaj badan ṣar̤ānan mātā
jagat janani dāmini duti gātā

verses.sa:
नहिं तव आदि मध्य अवसाना ।
अमित प्रभाउ बेदु नहिं जाना ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ tav ādi madhya avasānā
amit prabhāu bedu nahiṃ jānā

verses.sa:
भव भव बिभव पराभव कारिनि ।
बिस्व बिमोहनि स्वबस बिहारिनि ॥
verses.tr:
bhav bhav bibhav parābhav kārini
bisv bimohani svabas bihārini

verses.sa:
पतिदेवता सुतीय महुँ मातु प्रथम तव रेख ।
महिमा अमित न सकहिं कहि सहस सारदा सेष ॥
verses.tr:
patidevatā sutīya mahum̐ mātu pratham tav rekh
mahimā amit na sakahiṃ kahi sahas sāradā seṣ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The thought of Siva’s unyielding bow made her wild and as she went she kept in her heart the image of the darkhued swain. When the Lord perceived that she was going, he drew in his heart with the indelible ink of love a charming sketch of her infinite beauty and virtue and blissful devotion. Again she sought Bhavani’s shrine, and after embracing her feet, thus prayed with clasped hands,— ‘“ Glory, glory, glory to thee, O daughter of the mountainking, as fixed in thy gaze on Siva’s face as is the partridge on the moon; O mother of Ganes and Kartikeya; great mother of the world; whose body is lustrous as the lightning; of whom there is neither beginning nor middle nor end; whose infinite majesty is a mystery even to the Veda; cause of the birth, continuance, and ultimate destruction of all] being; enchantress of the universe; delighting in thy own supremacy:
Among all faithful wivesand true women, thy name, O mother, holds the first place; thy immeasurable grandeur is more than a thousand Seradas and Seshnags could tell.

sections.label: Doha 236
sections.name: जानि गौरि अनुकूल सिय हिय हरषु न जाइ कहि

verses.sa:
सेवत तोहि सुलभ फल चारी ।
बरदायनी पुरारि पिआरी ॥
verses.tr:
sevat tohi sulabh phal cārī
baradāyanī purāri piārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देबि पूजि पद कमल तुम्हारे ।
सुर नर मुनि सब होहिं सुखारे ॥
verses.tr:
debi pūji pad kamal tumhāre
sur nar muni sab hohiṃ sukhāre

verses.sa:
मोर मनोरथु जानहु नीकें ।
बसहु सदा उर पुर सबही कें ॥
verses.tr:
mor manorathu jānahu nīkeṃ
basahu sadā ur pur sabahī keṃ

verses.sa:
कीन्हेउँ प्रगट न कारन तेहीं ।
अस कहि चरन गहे बैदेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kīnheum̐ pragaṭ na kāran tehīṃ
as kahi caran gahe baidehīṃ

verses.sa:
बिनय प्रेम बस भई भवानी ।
खसी माल मूरति मुसुकानी ॥
verses.tr:
binaya prem bas bhaī bhavānī
khasī māl mūrati musukānī

verses.sa:
सादर सियँ प्रसादु सिर धरेऊ ।
बोली गौरि हरषु हियँ भरेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sādar siyam̐ prasādu sir dhareū
bolī gauri haraṣu hiyam̐ bhareū

verses.sa:
सुनु सिय सत्य असीस हमारी ।
पूजिहि मन कामना तुम्हारी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu siya satya asīs hamārī
pūjihi man kāmanā tumhārī

verses.sa:
नारद बचन सदा सुचि साचा ।
सो बरु मिलिहि जाहिं मनु राचा ॥
verses.tr:
nārad bacan sadā suci sācā
so baru milihi jāhiṃ manu rācā

verses.sa:
मनु जाहिं राचेउ मिलिहि सो बरु सहज सुंदर साँवरो ।
करुना निधान सुजान सीलु सनेहु जानत रावरो ॥
verses.tr:
manu jāhiṃ rāceu milihi so baru sahaj suṃdar sām̐varo
karunā nidhān sujān sīlu sanehu jānat rāvaro
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
एहि भाँति गौरि असीस सुनि सिय सहित हियँ हरषीं अली ।
तुलसी भवानिहि पूजि पुनि पुनि मुदित मन मंदिर चली ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bhām̐ti gauri asīs suni siya sahit hiyam̐ haraṣīṃ alī
tulasī bhavānihi pūji puni puni mudit man maṃdir calī

verses.sa:
जानि गौरि अनुकूल सिय हिय हरषु न जाइ कहि ।
मंजुल मंगल मूल बाम अंग फरकन लगे ॥
verses.tr:
jāni gauri anukūl siya hiya haraṣu na jāi kahi
maṃjul maṃgal mūl bām aṃg pharakan lage
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The four-fold rewards of life are easy of attainment by thy servants, O granter of boons, beloved of Triparari; and all, O goddess, who adore thy lotus feet, are made happy, whether they be gods or men, or saints. Thou knowest well my heart’s desire, for in the heart of man thou ever dwellest: there is no need that I declare it aloud to thee.” So saying, Sita embraced her feet. Bhavani was moved by her humility and devotion; the image smiled and a garland dropt. Reverently Sita clasped to her bosom the divine gift, and Gauri herself with a heart full of joy thus spoke,—“ Hearken, Sita; my blessing is effectual; your heart’s desire shall be accomplished. Narad’s words are ever truth itself; the bridegroom upon whom your soul is set shall, indeed, be yours.

The dark-complexioned youth, upon whose innate beauty your soul is set, shall indeed be yours. The All-merciful in his wisdom knows your loving disposition.” On hearing Gauri pronounce this blessing, Sita and her companions were glad of heart, and in their delight (says Tulsi) returned again and again to the temple to adore the goddess.
Finding Gauri so gracious, Sita was more glad of heart than words can tell; and as an auspicious omen, her left side, the seat of good fortune, began to throb.

sections.label: Doha 237
sections.name: जनमु सिंधु पुनि बंधु बिषु दिन मलीन सकलंक

verses.sa:
हृदयँ सराहत सीय लोनाई ।
गुर समीप गवने दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ sarāhat sīya lonāī
gur samīp gavane dou bhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम कहा सबु कौसिक पाहीं ।
सरल सुभाउ छुअत छल नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām kahā sabu kausik pāhīṃ
saral subhāu chuat chal nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुमन पाइ मुनि पूजा कीन्ही ।
पुनि असीस दुहु भाइन्ह दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
suman pāi muni pūjā kīnhī
puni asīs duhu bhāinh dīnhī

verses.sa:
सुफल मनोरथ होहुँ तुम्हारे ।
रामु लखनु सुनि भए सुखारे ॥
verses.tr:
suphal manorath hohum̐ tumhāre
rāmu lakhanu suni bhae sukhāre

verses.sa:
करि भोजनु मुनिबर बिग्यानी ।
लगे कहन कछु कथा पुरानी ॥
verses.tr:
kari bhojanu munibar bigyānī
lage kahan kachu kathā purānī

verses.sa:
बिगत दिवसु गुरु आयसु पाई ।
संध्या करन चले दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bigat divasu guru āyasu pāī
saṃdhyā karan cale dou bhāī

verses.sa:
प्राची दिसि ससि उयउ सुहावा ।
सिय मुख सरिस देखि सुखु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
prācī disi sasi uyau suhāvā
siya mukh saris dekhi sukhu pāvā

verses.sa:
बहुरि बिचारु कीन्ह मन माहीं ।
सीय बदन सम हिमकर नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri bicāru kīnh man māhīṃ
sīya badan sam himakar nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जनमु सिंधु पुनि बंधु बिषु दिन मलीन सकलंक ।
सिय मुख समता पाव किमि चंदु बापुरो रंक ॥
verses.tr:
janamu siṃdhu puni baṃdhu biṣu din malīn sakalaṃk
siya mukh samatā pāv kimi caṃdu bāpuro raṃk
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The two brothers returned to their guru, inwardly praising Sita’s loveliness; and Rama related to him all that had taken place being simplicity itself and utterly devoid of all guile. The saint took the flowers and performed his devotions, and then imparted his blessing to the two brothers, saying,—“ May your desire be accomplished.” Rama and Lakshman gladdened at the words. Then, after taking food, the saintly sage began the recital of sacred legends. When the day was spent, they first asked his permission and then went out to perform their evening duties. The glorious moon was rising in the eastern sky, and its orb reminded them of Sita’s lovely face; but afterwards they thus reasoned within themselves,—“ The queen of night is not to be compared with Sita;
For she was born of the restless Ocean, with poison for a brother, and by day she is dim and obscure, how then can such a poor feeble creature be matched with the lovely Nita.

sections.label: Doha 238
sections.name: अरुनोदयँ सकुचे कुमुद उडगन जोति मलीन

verses.sa:
घटइ बढ़इ बिरहनि दुखदाई ।
ग्रसइ राहु निज संधिहिं पाई ॥
verses.tr:
ghaṭai bar̤hai birahani dukhadāī
grasai rāhu nij saṃdhihiṃ pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोक सिकप्रद पंकज द्रोही ।
अवगुन बहुत चंद्रमा तोही ॥
verses.tr:
kok sikaprad paṃkaj drohī
avagun bahut caṃdramā tohī

verses.sa:
बैदेही मुख पटतर दीन्हे ।
होइ दोष बड़ अनुचित कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
baidehī mukh paṭatar dīnhe
hoi doṣ bar̤ anucit kīnhe

verses.sa:
सिय मुख छबि बिधु ब्याज बखानी ।
गुरु पहिं चले निसा बड़ि जानी ॥
verses.tr:
siya mukh chabi bidhu byāj bakhānī
guru pahiṃ cale nisā bar̤i jānī

verses.sa:
करि मुनि चरन सरोज प्रनामा ।
आयसु पाइ कीन्ह बिश्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
kari muni caran saroj pranāmā
āyasu pāi kīnh biśrāmā

verses.sa:
बिगत निसा रघुनायक जागे ।
बंधु बिलोकि कहन अस लागे ॥
verses.tr:
bigat nisā raghunāyak jāge
baṃdhu biloki kahan as lāge

verses.sa:
उदउ अरुन अवलोकहु ताता ।
पंकज कोक लोक सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
udau arun avalokahu tātā
paṃkaj kok lok sukhadātā

verses.sa:
बोले लखनु जोरि जुग पानी ।
प्रभु प्रभाउ सूचक मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
bole lakhanu jori jug pānī
prabhu prabhāu sūcak mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
अरुनोदयँ सकुचे कुमुद उडगन जोति मलीन ।
जिमि तुम्हार आगमन सुनि भए नृपति बलहीन ॥
verses.tr:
arunodayam̐ sakuce kumud uḍagan joti malīn
jimi tumhār āgaman suni bhae nṛpati balahīn
verses.head: दोहा

trans: She waxes and wanes, is the curse of love-sick maids, and is devoured by Rahu whenever the appointed time comes round; she causes anguish to the chakwa and whithers the lotus; O moon, thou art full of faults. It ig a great sin and highly improper to compare Janak’s daughter to thee.” Thus, finding in the moon a pretext for extolling Sita’s beauty, they returned to their guru, the night being now far advanced, and after bowing themselves at his feet and obtaining his permission they retired to rest. When the night was over, Raghundyak arose and, looking towards his brother, thus began to say,—“ See, brother, the day has dawned to the delight of the lotus, the chakwa and all mankind.” Then said Lakshman in gentle tones and with folded hands, declaring the glory of the Lord, —
“Atthe dawn of day the lily fades and the brightness of the stars is dimmed, so at the news of your coming all the princes waxed faint;

sections.label: Doha 239
sections.name: सतानंदपद बंदि प्रभु बैठे गुर पहिं जाइ

verses.sa:
नृप सब नखत करहिं उजिआरी ।
टारि न सकहिं चाप तम भारी ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp sab nakhat karahiṃ ujiārī
ṭāri na sakahiṃ cāp tam bhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कमल कोक मधुकर खग नाना ।
हरषे सकल निसा अवसाना ॥
verses.tr:
kamal kok madhukar khag nānā
haraṣe sakal nisā avasānā

verses.sa:
ऐसेहिं प्रभु सब भगत तुम्हारे ।
होइहहिं टूटें धनुष सुखारे ॥
verses.tr:
aisehiṃ prabhu sab bhagat tumhāre
hoihahiṃ ṭūṭeṃ dhanuṣ sukhāre

verses.sa:
उयउ भानु बिनु श्रम तम नासा ।
दुरे नखत जग तेजु प्रकासा ॥
verses.tr:
uyau bhānu binu śram tam nāsā
dure nakhat jag teju prakāsā

verses.sa:
रबि निज उदय ब्याज रघुराया ।
प्रभु प्रतापु सब नृपन्ह दिखाया ॥
verses.tr:
rabi nij udaya byāj raghurāyā
prabhu pratāpu sab nṛpanh dikhāyā

verses.sa:
तव भुज बल महिमा उदघाटी ।
प्रगटी धनु बिघटन परिपाटी ॥
verses.tr:
tav bhuj bal mahimā udaghāṭī
pragaṭī dhanu bighaṭan paripāṭī

verses.sa:
बंधु बचन सुनि प्रभु मुसुकाने ।
होइ सुचि सहज पुनीत नहाने ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhu bacan suni prabhu musukāne
hoi suci sahaj punīt nahāne

verses.sa:
नित्यक्रिया करि गुरु पहिं आए ।
चरन सरोज सुभग सिर नाए ॥
verses.tr:
nityakriyā kari guru pahiṃ āe
caran saroj subhag sir nāe

verses.sa:
सतानंदु तब जनक बोलाए ।
कौसिक मुनि पहिं तुरत पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
satānaṃdu tab janak bolāe
kausik muni pahiṃ turat paṭhāe

verses.sa:
जनक बिनय तिन्ह आइ सुनाई ।
हरषे बोलि लिए दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
janak binaya tinh āi sunāī
haraṣe boli lie dou bhāī

verses.sa:
सतानंदपद बंदि प्रभु बैठे गुर पहिं जाइ ।
चलहु तात मुनि कहेउ तब पठवा जनक बोलाइ ॥
verses.tr:
satānaṃdapad baṃdi prabhu baiṭhe gur pahiṃ jāi
calahu tāt muni kaheu tab paṭhavā janak bolāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: For bright though they be as the planets, they cannot master the night-black bow. The lotus, the chakwa, the bee, and every bird—all rejoice in night’s defeat; and so, O lord, all your votaries will be glad when the bow is broken. Sunrise is an easy triumph over darkness: the con-stellations retire and light flashes upon the world. O Raghurai, the sun in its rising shows the chiefs in a figure the majesty of their lord, and your mighty arms are as it ‘were the pass in the eastern mountain through which is manifested the spectacle of the broken bow.” The Lord smiled to hear his brother’s speech. The All-pure then performed the daily rites of purification and bathed and, after observance of the prescribed ceremonies, presented himself before the guru and bowed his comely head at his feet. Then Janak summoned Satanand and sent him in haste to Visvamitra. He came and declared his sovereign’s message, and also called for the two brothers.
After reverently saluting Satadnand, the Lord’ went and sat down by his guru, who said,—‘Come, my son, Janak has sent for you.

sections.label: Doha 240
sections.name: कहि मृदु बचन बिनीत तिन्ह बैठारे नर नारि

verses.sa:
सीय स्वयंबरु देखिअ जाई ।
ईसु काहि धौं देइ बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
sīya svayaṃbaru dekhia jāī
īsu kāhi dhauṃ dei bar̤āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लखन कहा जस भाजनु सोई ।
नाथ कृपा तव जापर होई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan kahā jas bhājanu soī
nāth kṛpā tav jāpar hoī

verses.sa:
हरषे मुनि सब सुनि बर बानी ।
दीन्हि असीस सबहिं सुखु मानी ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe muni sab suni bar bānī
dīnhi asīs sabahiṃ sukhu mānī

verses.sa:
पुनि मुनिबृंद समेत कृपाला ।
देखन चले धनुषमख साला ॥
verses.tr:
puni munibṛṃd samet kṛpālā
dekhan cale dhanuṣamakh sālā

verses.sa:
रंगभूमि आए दोउ भाई ।
असि सुधि सब पुरबासिन्ह पाई ॥
verses.tr:
raṃgabhūmi āe dou bhāī
asi sudhi sab purabāsinh pāī

verses.sa:
चले सकल गृह काज बिसारी ।
बाल जुबान जरठ नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
cale sakal gṛh kāj bisārī
bāl jubān jaraṭh nar nārī

verses.sa:
देखी जनक भीर भै भारी ।
सुचि सेवक सब लिए हँकारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhī janak bhīr bhai bhārī
suci sevak sab lie ham̐kārī

verses.sa:
तुरत सकल लोगन्ह पहिं जाहू ।
आसन उचित देहू सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
turat sakal loganh pahiṃ jāhū
āsan ucit dehū sab kāhū

verses.sa:
कहि मृदु बचन बिनीत तिन्ह बैठारे नर नारि ।
उत्तम मध्यम नीच लघु निज निज थल अनुहारि ॥
verses.tr:
kahi mṛdu bacan binīt tinh baiṭhāre nar nāri
uttam madhyam nīc laghu nij nij thal anuhāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: You must go and see Sita’s nuptials, and who is the happy man whom heaven will honour.” Said Lakshman, —* His

will be the glory, my lord, upon whom your favour rests.” The saints were glad to hear this seemly speech, and all with much effusion gave their blessing. Then the gracious god, attended by all the saintly throng, sallied forth to witness the tournament. No sooner had they reached the arena than the news spread all over the city, and every one put away his work and came thronging in, men and women, young and old, and even children in arms. When Janak saw the enormous crowd he gave orders to his practised servitors, —*' Go
round at once to all the people and marshal them to their proper seats.”
With courteous phrase they respectfully seated them all both men and women, according to their respective rank, whether noble, burgher or chur.

sections.label: Doha 241
sections.name: नारि बिलोकहिं हरषि हियँ निज निज रुचि अनुरूप

verses.sa:
राजकुअँर तेहि अवसर आए ।
मनहुँ मनोहरता तन छाए ॥
verses.tr:
rājakuam̐r tehi avasar āe
manahum̐ manoharatā tan chāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गुन सागर नागर बर बीरा ।
सुंदर स्यामल गौर सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
gun sāgar nāgar bar bīrā
suṃdar syāmal gaur sarīrā

verses.sa:
राज समाज बिराजत रूरे ।
उडगन महुँ जनु जुग बिधु पूरे ॥
verses.tr:
rāj samāj birājat rūre
uḍagan mahum̐ janu jug bidhu pūre

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कें रही भावना जैसी ।
प्रभु मूरति तिन्ह देखी तैसी ॥
verses.tr:
jinh keṃ rahī bhāvanā jaisī
prabhu mūrati tinh dekhī taisī

verses.sa:
देखहिं रूप महा रनधीरा ।
मनहुँ बीर रसु धरें सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahiṃ rūp mahā ranadhīrā
manahum̐ bīr rasu dhareṃ sarīrā

verses.sa:
डरे कुटिल नृप प्रभुहि निहारी ।
मनहुँ भयानक मूरति भारी ॥
verses.tr:
ḍare kuṭil nṛp prabhuhi nihārī
manahum̐ bhayānak mūrati bhārī

verses.sa:
रहे असुर छल छोनिप बेषा ।
तिन्ह प्रभु प्रगट कालसम देखा ॥
verses.tr:
rahe asur chal chonip beṣā
tinh prabhu pragaṭ kālasam dekhā

verses.sa:
पुरबासिन्ह देखे दोउ भाई ।
नरभूषन लोचन सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
purabāsinh dekhe dou bhāī
narabhūṣan locan sukhadāī

verses.sa:
नारि बिलोकहिं हरषि हियँ निज निज रुचि अनुरूप ।
जनु सोहत सिंगार धरि मूरति परम अनूप ॥
verses.tr:
nāri bilokahiṃ haraṣi hiyam̐ nij nij ruci anurūp
janu sohat siṃgār dhari mūrati param anūp
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then stept forth the two princes like beauty beautified, graceful and accomplished champions, one dark, the other fair, but both charming: resplendent in the assembly of princes like two full moons in a circle of stars. Every spectator seemed to see in them an embodiment of his own conception: the princes beheld a gallant warrior, as it were the Heroic incarnate: the wicked kings trembled at the sight of the Lord, as a visible presentment of the Terrible; the demons in their princely disguise thought they saw the image of Death: while the citizens regarded the twin brothers as the glory of manhood, a delight to the eyes.
The women with joy of heart saw what each loved most, as it were a bright vision of the Erotic in utterly incomparable form.

sections.label: Doha 242
sections.name: राजत राज समाज महुँ कोसलराज किसोर

verses.sa:
बिदुषन्ह प्रभु बिराटमय दीसा ।
बहु मुख कर पग लोचन सीसा ॥
verses.tr:
biduṣanh prabhu birāṭamaya dīsā
bahu mukh kar pag locan sīsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जनक जाति अवलोकहिं कैसैं ।
सजन सगे प्रिय लागहिं जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
janak jāti avalokahiṃ kaisaiṃ
sajan sage priya lāgahiṃ jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
सहित बिदेह बिलोकहिं रानी ।
सिसु सम प्रीति न जाति बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
sahit bideh bilokahiṃ rānī
sisu sam prīti na jāti bakhānī

verses.sa:
जोगिन्ह परम तत्वमय भासा ।
सांत सुद्ध सम सहज प्रकासा ॥
verses.tr:
joginh param tatvamaya bhāsā
sāṃt suddh sam sahaj prakāsā

verses.sa:
हरिभगतन्ह देखे दोउ भ्राता ।
इष्टदेव इव सब सुख दाता ॥
verses.tr:
haribhagatanh dekhe dou bhrātā
iṣṭadev iv sab sukh dātā

verses.sa:
रामहि चितव भायँ जेहि सीया ।
सो सनेहु सुखु नहिं कथनीया ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi citav bhāyam̐ jehi sīyā
so sanehu sukhu nahiṃ kathanīyā

verses.sa:
उर अनुभवति न कहि सक सोऊ ।
कवन प्रकार कहै कबि कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ur anubhavati na kahi sak soū
kavan prakār kahai kabi koū

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि रहा जाहि जस भाऊ ।
तेहिं तस देखेउ कोसलराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi rahā jāhi jas bhāū
tehiṃ tas dekheu kosalarāū

verses.sa:
राजत राज समाज महुँ कोसलराज किसोर ।
सुंदर स्यामल गौर तन बिस्व बिलोचन चोर ॥
verses.tr:
rājat rāj samāj mahum̐ kosalarāj kisor
suṃdar syāmal gaur tan bisv bilocan cor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By sages the Lord was seen in his divine majesty with many faces and hands and feet and eyes and heads, And how did he appear to Janak's family group? Like a noble kinsman and friend. The queen, no less than the king, regarded him with unspeakable love like a dear child: to

mystics he shone forth as eternal Truth, the placid radiance of unruffled Quietism; while to the pious the two brothers, appeared as their own benignant patron saint. But as for Sita, when she gazed on Rama, her love and joy were unspeakable; if she could not utter the emotion of her heart, how can any poet declare it? Thus according to the ruling passion of each individual spectator, were the Kosala princes seen by each,
Resplendent in the midst of the royal circle in their contrasted beauty, stealing the eyes of the whole universe.

sections.label: Doha 243
sections.name: कुंजर मनि कंठा कलित उरन्हि तुलसिका माल

verses.sa:
सहज मनोहर मूरति दोऊ ।
कोटि काम उपमा लघु सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj manohar mūrati doū
koṭi kām upamā laghu soū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सरद चंद निंदक मुख नीके ।
नीरज नयन भावते जी के ॥
verses.tr:
sarad caṃd niṃdak mukh nīke
nīraj nayan bhāvate jī ke

verses.sa:
चितवत चारु मार मनु हरनी ।
भावति हृदय जाति नहीं बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
citavat cāru mār manu haranī
bhāvati hṛdaya jāti nahīṃ baranī

verses.sa:
कल कपोल श्रुति कुंडल लोला ।
चिबुक अधर सुंदर मृदु बोला ॥
verses.tr:
kal kapol śruti kuṃḍal lolā
cibuk adhar suṃdar mṛdu bolā

verses.sa:
कुमुदबंधु कर निंदक हाँसा ।
भृकुटी बिकट मनोहर नासा ॥
verses.tr:
kumudabaṃdhu kar niṃdak hām̐sā
bhṛkuṭī bikaṭ manohar nāsā

verses.sa:
भाल बिसाल तिलक झलकाहीं ।
कच बिलोकि अलि अवलि लजाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bhāl bisāl tilak jhalakāhīṃ
kac biloki ali avali lajāhīṃ

verses.sa:
पीत चौतनीं सिरन्हि सुहाई ।
कुसुम कलीं बिच बीच बनाईं ॥
verses.tr:
pīt cautanīṃ siranhi suhāī
kusum kalīṃ bic bīc banāīṃ

verses.sa:
रेखें रुचिर कंबु कल गीवाँ ।
जनु त्रिभुवन सुषमा की सीवाँ ॥
verses.tr:
rekheṃ rucir kaṃbu kal gīvām̐
janu tribhuvan suṣamā kī sīvām̐

verses.sa:
कुंजर मनि कंठा कलित उरन्हि तुलसिका माल ।
बृषभ कंध केहरि ठवनि बल निधि बाहु बिसाल ॥
verses.tr:
kuṃjar mani kaṃṭhā kalit uranhi tulasikā māl
bṛṣabh kaṃdh kehari ṭhavani bal nidhi bāhu bisāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Both with such facile grace of form that a myriad Loves were all too mean a compurison: with beaming ‘face, that would put to shame the autumnal moon, and irresistibly charming lotus eyes; with a glance so unspeakably winning that it would rob Love of all his pride; with rounded cheeks and ears adorned with pendulous gems; with beautiful chin and lips and sweet voice; with a smile more radiant than the light of the moon, and arched eyebrows and delicate nose; a broad forehead with glittering tilak, and clustering locks with which no swarm of bees could vie; with yellow turban on their shapely head, dotted here and there with flower-buds; with exquisite neck, marked with a triple line, enclosing as it were the bliss of the three spheres of ereation.
Adorned with a necklace of elephant pearlsand a tulsi garland on their breast; with the shoulder of a bull and the gait of a lion, and long arms very models of strength.

sections.label: Doha 244
sections.name: सब मंचन्ह ते मंचु एक सुंदर बिसद बिसाल

verses.sa:
कटि तूनीर पीत पट बाँधे ।
कर सर धनुष बाम बर काँधे ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭi tūnīr pīt paṭ bām̐dhe
kar sar dhanuṣ bām bar kām̐dhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पीत जग्य उपबीत सुहाए ।
नख सिख मंजु महाछबि छाए ॥
verses.tr:
pīt jagya upabīt suhāe
nakh sikh maṃju mahāchabi chāe

verses.sa:
देखि लोग सब भए सुखारे ।
एकटक लोचन चलत न तारे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi log sab bhae sukhāre
ekaṭak locan calat na tāre

verses.sa:
हरषे जनकु देखि दोउ भाई ।
मुनि पद कमल गहे तब जाई ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe janaku dekhi dou bhāī
muni pad kamal gahe tab jāī

verses.sa:
करि बिनती निज कथा सुनाई ।
रंग अवनि सब मुनिहि देखाई ॥
verses.tr:
kari binatī nij kathā sunāī
raṃg avani sab munihi dekhāī

verses.sa:
जहँ जहँ जाहि कुअँर बर दोऊ ।
तहँ तहँ चकित चितव सबु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jaham̐ jāhi kuam̐r bar doū
taham̐ taham̐ cakit citav sabu koū

verses.sa:
निज निज रुख रामहि सबु देखा ।
कोउ न जान कछु मरमु बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij rukh rāmahi sabu dekhā
kou na jān kachu maramu biseṣā

verses.sa:
भलि रचना मुनि नृप सन कहेऊ ।
राजाँ मुदित महासुख लहेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bhali racanā muni nṛp san kaheū
rājām̐ mudit mahāsukh laheū

verses.sa:
सब मंचन्ह ते मंचु एक सुंदर बिसद बिसाल ।
मुनि समेत दोउ बंधु तहँ बैठारे महिपाल ॥
verses.tr:
sab maṃcanh te maṃcu ek suṃdar bisad bisāl
muni samet dou baṃdhu taham̐ baiṭhāre mahipāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By their side a quiver slung from a yellow brace; with arrows in hand and bow on their Left shoulder; with a charming Brahmanical cord, also of yellow tint, and, in short, beautiful from head to foot, beauty all over. Every one who saw them was made happy, nor could for a minute take his eyes off them. Janak, too, rejoiced to behold the two brothers. Then went he tothe saint and embraced his feet, and differentially related to him all his past history, and showed the hermits the place marked out for the games. Whenever the two gallant princes turned, all men’s eyes were dazzled; each saw in Rama what he himself most admired, without understanding that it was a special miracle. The saint told the king the arrangements were perfect, and the king was thereby highly gratified.
{s a pearl supposed to be found in the projection tk Ate elephant. Reel 8 on the forehead of an
There was one tier of seats bright, spacious and beautiful above all the rest, and here the Rajd seated the saint and the two brothers.

sections.label: Doha 245
sections.name: सीय बिआहबि राम गरब दूरि करि नृपन्ह के

verses.sa:
प्रभुहि देखि सब नृप हिंयँ हारे ।
जनु राकेस उदय भएँ तारे ॥
verses.tr:
prabhuhi dekhi sab nṛp hiṃyam̐ hāre
janu rākes udaya bhaem̐ tāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
असि प्रतीति सब के मन माहीं ।
राम चाप तोरब सक नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
asi pratīti sab ke man māhīṃ
rām cāp torab sak nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बिनु भंजेहुँ भव धनुषु बिसाला ।
मेलिहि सीय राम उर माला ॥
verses.tr:
binu bhaṃjehum̐ bhav dhanuṣu bisālā
melihi sīya rām ur mālā

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि गवनहु घर भाई ।
जसु प्रतापु बलु तेजु गवाँई ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri gavanahu ghar bhāī
jasu pratāpu balu teju gavām̐ī

verses.sa:
बिहसे अपर भूप सुनि बानी ।
जे अबिबेक अंध अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
bihase apar bhūp suni bānī
je abibek aṃdh abhimānī

verses.sa:
तोरेहुँ धनुषु ब्याहु अवगाहा ।
बिनु तोरें को कुअँरि बिआहा ॥
verses.tr:
torehum̐ dhanuṣu byāhu avagāhā
binu toreṃ ko kuam̐ri biāhā

verses.sa:
एक बार कालउ किन होऊ ।
सिय हित समर जितब हम सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār kālau kin hoū
siya hit samar jitab ham soū

verses.sa:
यह सुनि अवर महिप मुसकाने ।
धरमसील हरिभगत सयाने ॥
verses.tr:
yah suni avar mahip musakāne
dharamasīl haribhagat sayāne

verses.sa: सीय बिआहबि राम गरब दूरि करि नृपन्ह के ॥
verses.tr: sīya biāhabi rām garab dūri kari nṛpanh ke
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: जीति को सक संग्राम दसरथ के रन बाँकुरे ॥
verses.tr: jīti ko sak saṃgrām dasarath ke ran bām̐kure

trans: At the sight of the Lord all the chiefs grew sick at heart, like the stars at the rising of the full moon; for they felt inwardly assured that beyond all doubt Rama would succeed in bending the bow; or even if he did not break the massy beam, that Sita would still bestow upon’ him the garland of victory. And so thinking, sir, they turned homewards, abandoning all glory of victory and pride of strength. There were other kings, blind and insolent fools, who mocked at such words and cried, —“ To break the bow and win the bride is a difficulty!, but unless it be broken how can the bride be won Should Death himself for once come forth against us, him too would we conquer in battle for Sita’s sake.” Hearing this there were other kings who smiled, good, pious and sensible men, and said, —
“Rama will certainly marry Sita, to the discomfiture of those proud princes; for who can conquer in battle Dasarath’s gallant sons?

sections.label: Doha 246
sections.name: जानि सुअवसरु सीय तब पठई जनक बोलाई

verses.sa:
ब्यर्थ मरहु जनि गाल बजाई ।
मन मोदकन्हि कि भूख बुताई ॥
verses.tr:
byarth marahu jani gāl bajāī
man modakanhi ki bhūkh butāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सिख हमारि सुनि परम पुनीता ।
जगदंबा जानहु जियँ सीता ॥
verses.tr:
sikh hamāri suni param punītā
jagadaṃbā jānahu jiyam̐ sītā

verses.sa:
जगत पिता रघुपतिहि बिचारी ।
भरि लोचन छबि लेहु निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
jagat pitā raghupatihi bicārī
bhari locan chabi lehu nihārī

verses.sa:
सुंदर सुखद सकल गुन रासी ।
ए दोउ बंधु संभु उर बासी ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar sukhad sakal gun rāsī
e dou baṃdhu saṃbhu ur bāsī

verses.sa:
सुधा समुद्र समीप बिहाई ।
मृगजलु निरखि मरहु कत धाई ॥
verses.tr:
sudhā samudr samīp bihāī
mṛgajalu nirakhi marahu kat dhāī

verses.sa:
करहु जाइ जा कहुँ जोई भावा ।
हम तौ आजु जनम फलु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
karahu jāi jā kahum̐ joī bhāvā
ham tau āju janam phalu pāvā

verses.sa:
अस कहि भले भूप अनुरागे ।
रूप अनूप बिलोकन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi bhale bhūp anurāge
rūp anūp bilokan lāge

verses.sa:
देखहिं सुर नभ चढ़े बिमाना ।
बरषहिं सुमन करहिं कल गाना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahiṃ sur nabh car̤he bimānā
baraṣahiṃ suman karahiṃ kal gānā

verses.sa:
जानि सुअवसरु सीय तब पठई जनक बोलाई ।
चतुर सखीं सुंदर सकल सादर चलीं लवाईं ॥
verses.tr:
jāni suavasaru sīya tab paṭhaī janak bolāī
catur sakhīṃ suṃdar sakal sādar calīṃ lavāīṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Why thus scoff and throw away your lives to no purpose; imagined sweets stop no man’s hunger. Listen to this my solemn warning: be inwardly assured that Sita is the mother, and Rama the father of the universe, and feast your eyes to the full on their beauty. These two brothers, so lovely, so gracious, so full of every excellence, have their home in Sambhu’s heart. Why, when you have a sea of ambrosia at hand, should you leave it to run upon your death in pursuit of a mirage? But do ye what seemeth you good: we have to-day reaped our life's reward.” So saying the good kings turned to gaze with affection on the picture of incomparable beauty; while in heaven the gods mounted their chariots to behold the spectacle, and showered down flowers and uttered songs of joy.
Then-seeing the fitness of the time, Janak sent and summoned Sita; and obediently she came, with all her lovely and accomplished attendants.

sections.label: Doha 247
sections.name: एहि बिधि उपजै लच्छि जब सुंदरता सुख मूल

verses.sa:
सिय सोभा नहिं जाइ बखानी ।
जगदंबिका रूप गुन खानी ॥
verses.tr:
siya sobhā nahiṃ jāi bakhānī
jagadaṃbikā rūp gun khānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
उपमा सकल मोहि लघु लागीं ।
प्राकृत नारि अंग अनुरागीं ॥
verses.tr:
upamā sakal mohi laghu lāgīṃ
prākṛt nāri aṃg anurāgīṃ

verses.sa:
सिय बरनिअ तेइ उपमा देई ।
कुकबि कहाइ अजसु को लेई ॥
verses.tr:
siya barania tei upamā deī
kukabi kahāi ajasu ko leī

verses.sa:
जौ पटतरिअ तीय सम सीया ।
जग असि जुबति कहाँ कमनीया ॥
verses.tr:
jau paṭataria tīya sam sīyā
jag asi jubati kahām̐ kamanīyā

verses.sa:
गिरा मुखर तन अरध भवानी ।
रति अति दुखित अतनु पति जानी ॥
verses.tr:
girā mukhar tan aradh bhavānī
rati ati dukhit atanu pati jānī

verses.sa:
बिष बारुनी बंधु प्रिय जेही ।
कहिअ रमासम किमि बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
biṣ bārunī baṃdhu priya jehī
kahia ramāsam kimi baidehī

verses.sa:
जौ छबि सुधा पयोनिधि होई ।
परम रूपमय कच्छप सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jau chabi sudhā payonidhi hoī
param rūpamaya kacchap soī

verses.sa:
सोभा रजु मंदरु सिंगारू ।
मथै पानि पंकज निज मारू ॥
verses.tr:
sobhā raju maṃdaru siṃgārū
mathai pāni paṃkaj nij mārū

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि उपजै लच्छि जब सुंदरता सुख मूल ।
तदपि सकोच समेत कबि कहहिं सीय समतूल ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi upajai lacchi jab suṃdaratā sukh mūl
tadapi sakoc samet kabi kahahiṃ sīya samatūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Her beauty isnot to be told: seeing that she is the mother of the world, the perfection of all grace and goodness, every comparison seems to me unworthy of her and appropriate only to mortal woman. In describing Sita, to what can she be likened, or what can the poet name that will not rather do her dishonour? If I should liken her to other women, where is there on earth any nymph 80 lovable; or, if 1 look to the denizens of heaven, Sarasvati is a chatterer; Bhavani has only half a body; Rati is in sore distress on account of her disfleshed lord; and as for Lakshmi, the twinbirth of poison and strong drink, how can Sita be compared to her Even though the ocean of ambrosia were the Beautiful, and the tortoise Grace, the rope being Fascination, and Mount Meru the amorous sentiment, while Love with his own lotus hand played the part of churner;
Even then, though Lakshmi the source of all beauty end bliss, had thus been born, still the poet would shrink from saying that she could be compared to Sita.

sections.label: Doha 248
sections.name: गुरजन लाज समाजु बड़ देखि सीय सकुचानि

verses.sa:
चलिं संग लै सखीं सयानी ।
गावत गीत मनोहर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
caliṃ saṃg lai sakhīṃ sayānī
gāvat gīt manohar bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोह नवल तनु सुंदर सारी ।
जगत जननि अतुलित छबि भारी ॥
verses.tr:
soh naval tanu suṃdar sārī
jagat janani atulit chabi bhārī

verses.sa:
भूषन सकल सुदेस सुहाए ।
अंग अंग रचि सखिन्ह बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
bhūṣan sakal sudes suhāe
aṃg aṃg raci sakhinh banāe

verses.sa:
रंगभूमि जब सिय पगु धारी ।
देखि रूप मोहे नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
raṃgabhūmi jab siya pagu dhārī
dekhi rūp mohe nar nārī

verses.sa:
हरषि सुरन्ह दुंदुभीं बजाई ।
बरषि प्रसून अपछरा गाई ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi suranh duṃdubhīṃ bajāī
baraṣi prasūn apacharā gāī

verses.sa:
पानि सरोज सोह जयमाला ।
अवचट चितए सकल भुआला ॥
verses.tr:
pāni saroj soh jayamālā
avacaṭ citae sakal bhuālā

verses.sa:
सीय चकित चित रामहि चाहा ।
भए मोहबस सब नरनाहा ॥
verses.tr:
sīya cakit cit rāmahi cāhā
bhae mohabas sab naranāhā

verses.sa:
मुनि समीप देखे दोउ भाई ।
लगे ललकि लोचन निधि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
muni samīp dekhe dou bhāī
lage lalaki locan nidhi pāī

verses.sa: गुरजन लाज समाजु बड़ देखि सीय सकुचानि ॥
verses.tr: gurajan lāj samāju bar̤ dekhi sīya sakucāni
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: लागि बिलोकन सखिन्ह तन रघुबीरहि उर आनि ॥
verses.tr: lāgi bilokan sakhinh tan raghubīrahi ur āni

trans: She came, and with her attendant-maids, singing sweet-voiced songs: the mother of creation, of incomparable beauty; her delicate frame veiled in a fair white robe, and with a profusion of brilliant and tasteful ornaments, with which her maidens had bedecked her every limb. When she set her foot within the lists, all beholders, men and women alike, were fascinated by her charms; the gods in their delight sounded their kettledrums and rained down flowers midst the singing of the apsrarasas. The wreath ot victory sparkled in her hands as she cast a hurried glance on the assembled kings, with anxious heart looking for Rama. Nota king but was love-smitten. But by the saint
sat the two brothers and on them she fell with her greedy eyes a8 upon a rich treasure.
Shrinking into herself from awe of the reverend fathers and at the sight of vast assemblage, she turned her eyes Upon:

sections.label: Doha 249
sections.name: बोले बंदी बचन बर सुनहु सकल महिपाल

verses.sa:
राम रूपु अरु सिय छबि देखें ।
नर नारिन्ह परिहरीं निमेषें ॥
verses.tr:
rām rūpu aru siya chabi dekheṃ
nar nārinh pariharīṃ nimeṣeṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोचहिं सकल कहत सकुचाहीं ।
बिधि सन बिनय करहिं मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
socahiṃ sakal kahat sakucāhīṃ
bidhi san binaya karahiṃ man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
हरु बिधि बेगि जनक जड़ताई ।
मति हमारि असि देहि सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
haru bidhi begi janak jar̤atāī
mati hamāri asi dehi suhāī

verses.sa:
बिनु बिचार पनु तजि नरनाहु ।
सीय राम कर करै बिबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
binu bicār panu taji naranāhu
sīya rām kar karai bibāhū

verses.sa:
जग भल कहहि भाव सब काहू ।
हठ कीन्हे अंतहुँ उर दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
jag bhal kahahi bhāv sab kāhū
haṭh kīnhe aṃtahum̐ ur dāhū

verses.sa:
एहिं लालसाँ मगन सब लोगू ।
बरु साँवरो जानकी जोगू ॥
verses.tr:
ehiṃ lālasām̐ magan sab logū
baru sām̐varo jānakī jogū

verses.sa:
तब बंदीजन जनक बौलाए ।
बिरिदावली कहत चलि आए ॥
verses.tr:
tab baṃdījan janak baulāe
biridāvalī kahat cali āe

verses.sa:
कह नृप जाइ कहहु पन मोरा ।
चले भाट हियँ हरषु न थोरा ॥
verses.tr:
kah nṛp jāi kahahu pan morā
cale bhāṭ hiyam̐ haraṣu na thorā

verses.sa:
बोले बंदी बचन बर सुनहु सकल महिपाल ।
पन बिदेह कर कहहिं हम भुजा उठाइ बिसाल ॥
verses.tr:
bole baṃdī bacan bar sunahu sakal mahipāl
pan bideh kar kahahiṃ ham bhujā uṭhāi bisāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: her attendants, though at the same time she drew all Rama into her soul.

Not a man or woman, who beheld the beauty of Rama and the loveliness of Sita, could close his eyes for a second: bat all thought with dismay of the king’s vow and in their heart made supplication to Brahma,—" O God, quickly remove Janak’s obstinacy and make him right-minded as myself. Let the king have no hesitation about breaking his vow and giving Sita in marriage to Rama: the world will approve, and we all shall be pleased; but obstinacy, if persisted in, will at the last be as a consuming fire in his bosom.” All were absorbed in the same ardent desire, say ing,—“ The dark youth is the match for Sita.” Then Janak summoned the heralds, who as they came proclaimed his state and dignity, and bade them go and declare his vow. They went, but in their heart was little joy.
The heralds cried aloud,—“ Hearken, all ye princes: we announce to you sovereign’s vow, and with upraised hands call heaven to witness it.

sections.label: Doha 250
sections.name: तमकि धरहिं धनु मूढ़ नृप उठइ न चलहिं लजाइ

verses.sa:
नृप भुजबल बिधु सिवधनु राहू ।
गरुअ कठोर बिदित सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp bhujabal bidhu sivadhanu rāhū
garua kaṭhor bidit sab kāhū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रावनु बानु महाभट भारे ।
देखि सरासन गवँहिं सिधारे ॥
verses.tr:
rāvanu bānu mahābhaṭ bhāre
dekhi sarāsan gavam̐hiṃ sidhāre

verses.sa:
सोइ पुरारि कोदंडु कठोरा ।
राज समाज आजु जोइ तोरा ॥
verses.tr:
soi purāri kodaṃḍu kaṭhorā
rāj samāj āju joi torā

verses.sa:
त्रिभुवन जय समेत बैदेही ।
बिनहिं बिचार बरइ हठि तेही ॥
verses.tr:
tribhuvan jaya samet baidehī
binahiṃ bicār barai haṭhi tehī

verses.sa:
सुनि पन सकल भूप अभिलाषे ।
भटमानी अतिसय मन माखे ॥
verses.tr:
suni pan sakal bhūp abhilāṣe
bhaṭamānī atisaya man mākhe

verses.sa:
परिकर बाँधि उठे अकुलाई ।
चले इष्टदेवन्ह सिर नाई ॥
verses.tr:
parikar bām̐dhi uṭhe akulāī
cale iṣṭadevanh sir nāī

verses.sa:
तमकि ताकि तकि सिवधनु धरहीं ।
उठइ न कोटि भाँति बलु करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tamaki tāki taki sivadhanu dharahīṃ
uṭhai na koṭi bhām̐ti balu karahīṃ

verses.sa:
जिन्ह के कछु बिचारु मन माहीं ।
चाप समीप महीप न जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jinh ke kachu bicāru man māhīṃ
cāp samīp mahīp na jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तमकि धरहिं धनु मूढ़ नृप उठइ न चलहिं लजाइ ।
मनहुँ पाइ भट बाहुबलु अधिकु अधिकु गरुआइ ॥
verses.tr:
tamaki dharahiṃ dhanu mūr̤h nṛp uṭhai na calahiṃ lajāi
manahum̐ pāi bhaṭ bāhubalu adhiku adhiku garuāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Though your mighty arms be as the moon, yet Siva’s famous bow isas terrible and unyielding as Rahu. When RAvan and Baenaesur saw it—albeit sturdy champions—they ieft and went their way. Here is now the great god’s massy beam, and whoever in this royal assembly shall today bend it shall be renowned in heaven and earth and hell, and at once without hesitation shall receivein marriage the hand of the king’s daughter.” When they heard the vow, all the kings were full of eagerness — insolent warriors, savage of soul—and girding up their loins they rose in haste, bowing their heads, ere they commenced, before their patron god. With flushed face and many a close look, they essay the divine bow: but though they put forth all their strength in a thousand different ways they cannot move it. ‘Those, indeed, who had any sense at all did not go near it.
After straining at the bow—those foolish kings—without being able to stir it, they retire in confusion, as though it had gathered strength by in turn absorbing the force of each successive warrior.

sections.label: Doha 251
sections.name: कुअँरि मनोहर बिजय बड़ि कीरति अति कमनीय

verses.sa:
भूप सहस दस एकहि बारा ।
लगे उठावन टरइ न टारा ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp sahas das ekahi bārā
lage uṭhāvan ṭarai na ṭārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
डगइ न संभु सरासन कैसें ।
कामी बचन सती मनु जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
ḍagai na saṃbhu sarāsan kaiseṃ
kāmī bacan satī manu jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
सब नृप भए जोगु उपहासी ।
जैसें बिनु बिराग संन्यासी ॥
verses.tr:
sab nṛp bhae jogu upahāsī
jaiseṃ binu birāg saṃnyāsī

verses.sa:
कीरति बिजय बीरता भारी ।
चले चाप कर बरबस हारी ॥
verses.tr:
kīrati bijaya bīratā bhārī
cale cāp kar barabas hārī

verses.sa:
श्रीहत भए हारि हियँ राजा ।
बैठे निज निज जाइ समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
śrīhat bhae hāri hiyam̐ rājā
baiṭhe nij nij jāi samājā

verses.sa:
नृपन्ह बिलोकि जनकु अकुलाने ।
बोले बचन रोष जनु साने ॥
verses.tr:
nṛpanh biloki janaku akulāne
bole bacan roṣ janu sāne

verses.sa:
दीप दीप के भूपति नाना ।
आए सुनि हम जो पनु ठाना ॥
verses.tr:
dīp dīp ke bhūpati nānā
āe suni ham jo panu ṭhānā

verses.sa:
देव दनुज धरि मनुज सरीरा ।
बिपुल बीर आए रनधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
dev danuj dhari manuj sarīrā
bipul bīr āe ranadhīrā

verses.sa:
कुअँरि मनोहर बिजय बड़ि कीरति अति कमनीय ।
पावनिहार बिरंचि जनु रचेउ न धनु दमनीय ॥
verses.tr:
kuam̐ri manohar bijaya bar̤i kīrati ati kamanīya
pāvanihār biraṃci janu raceu na dhanu damanīya
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Next ten thousand kings all at once attempted to raise it, but it was not to be moved and yielding as little as a virtuous wife at the words of a gallant. All the princes appeared as ridiculous as a hermit who has no religion. Their mighty glory and renown and heroism were utterly worsted by the bow, and with much confusion of face and sadness of heart they went and took again each his own, place in the assembly. When Janak saw the kings thus dismayed, he cried aloud as it were in anger,—,“ Hearing the vow that I had made, many kings have come from diverse realms, with gods and demons in human form, stalwart heroes, staunch in fight.:
A lovely bride, a grand triumph and splendid renown are the prize, but God, it seems, has not created the man who can break the bow and win it. —,

sections.label: Doha 252
sections.name: कहि न सकत रघुबीर डर लगे बचन जनु बान

verses.sa:
कहहु काहि यहु लाभु न भावा ।
काहुँ न संकर चाप चढ़ावा ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu kāhi yahu lābhu na bhāvā
kāhum̐ na saṃkar cāp car̤hāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रहउ चढ़ाउब तोरब भाई ।
तिलु भरि भूमि न सके छड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
rahau car̤hāub torab bhāī
tilu bhari bhūmi na sake char̤āī

verses.sa:
अब जनि कोउ माखै भट मानी ।
बीर बिहीन मही मैं जानी ॥
verses.tr:
ab jani kou mākhai bhaṭ mānī
bīr bihīn mahī maiṃ jānī

verses.sa:
तजहु आस निज निज गृह जाहू ।
लिखा न बिधि बैदेहि बिबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
tajahu ās nij nij gṛh jāhū
likhā na bidhi baidehi bibāhū

verses.sa:
सुकृत जाइ जौं पनु परिहरऊँ ।
कुअँरि कुआरि रहउ का करऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛt jāi jauṃ panu pariharaūm̐
kuam̐ri kuāri rahau kā karaūm̐

verses.sa:
जो जनतेउँ बिनु भट भुबि भाई ।
तौ पनु करि होतेउँ न हँसाई ॥
verses.tr:
jo janateum̐ binu bhaṭ bhubi bhāī
tau panu kari hoteum̐ na ham̐sāī

verses.sa:
जनक बचन सुनि सब नर नारी ।
देखि जानकिहि भए दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
janak bacan suni sab nar nārī
dekhi jānakihi bhae dukhārī

verses.sa:
माखे लखनु कुटिल भइँ भौंहें ।
रदपट फरकत नयन रिसौंहें ॥
verses.tr:
mākhe lakhanu kuṭil bhaim̐ bhauṃheṃ
radapaṭ pharakat nayan risauṃheṃ

verses.sa:
कहि न सकत रघुबीर डर लगे बचन जनु बान ।
नाइ राम पद कमल सिरु बोले गिरा प्रमान ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na sakat raghubīr ḍar lage bacan janu bān
nāi rām pad kamal siru bole girā pramān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Tell me now who was dissatisfied with the guerdon or, refused to try his strength cn Siva’s bow, but let alone lift-ing and breaking, sirs, there was not one of you who could stir it even a grain’s breadth from the ground. Now let no proud warrior wax wroth if I assert there is not a man left on earth. Give up all hope and turn your faces homewards: it is God’s will that Sita isnot to be married. IE T break my vow, all my religious merit is gone; the girl must remain a maid; what can I do Had I known, sirs, that there were no men inthe world, I would not have made myself a laughing-stock by recording such a vow.” Every man and woman who heard Janak’s words and looked at a^naki were sad; but Lakshman “was furious: his eyes flashed, his lips quivered and his brows were knit.
But for fear of his brother he could not speak, though the taunt pierced his heart like an arrow. Yet at last, bow- ing his head at Rama lotus feet, he thus spoke in dignified tones:—.

sections.label: Doha 253
sections.name: तोरौं छत्रक दंड जिमि तव प्रताप बल नाथ

verses.sa:
रघुबंसिन्ह महुँ जहँ कोउ होई ।
तेहिं समाज अस कहइ न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
raghubaṃsinh mahum̐ jaham̐ kou hoī
tehiṃ samāj as kahai na koī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कही जनक जसि अनुचित बानी ।
बिद्यमान रघुकुल मनि जानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahī janak jasi anucit bānī
bidyamān raghukul mani jānī

verses.sa:
सुनहु भानुकुल पंकज भानू ।
कहउँ सुभाउ न कछु अभिमानू ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu bhānukul paṃkaj bhānū
kahaum̐ subhāu na kachu abhimānū

verses.sa:
जौ तुम्हारि अनुसासन पावौं ।
कंदुक इव ब्रह्मांड उठावौं ॥
verses.tr:
jau tumhāri anusāsan pāvauṃ
kaṃduk iv brahmāṃḍ uṭhāvauṃ

verses.sa:
काचे घट जिमि डारौं फोरी ।
सकउँ मेरु मूलक जिमि तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kāce ghaṭ jimi ḍārauṃ phorī
sakaum̐ meru mūlak jimi torī

verses.sa:
तव प्रताप महिमा भगवाना ।
को बापुरो पिनाक पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
tav pratāp mahimā bhagavānā
ko bāpuro pināk purānā

verses.sa:
नाथ जानि अस आयसु होऊ ।
कौतुकु करौं बिलोकिअ सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
nāth jāni as āyasu hoū
kautuku karauṃ bilokia soū

verses.sa:
कमल नाल जिमि चाफ चढ़ावौं ।
जोजन सत प्रमान लै धावौं ॥
verses.tr:
kamal nāl jimi cāph car̤hāvauṃ
jojan sat pramān lai dhāvauṃ

verses.sa:
तोरौं छत्रक दंड जिमि तव प्रताप बल नाथ ।
जौं न करौं प्रभु पद सपथ कर न धरौं धनु भाथ ॥
verses.tr:
torauṃ chatrak daṃḍ jimi tav pratāp bal nāth
jauṃ na karauṃ prabhu pad sapath kar na dharauṃ dhanu bhāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘““May there never be repeated in any assembly, where even the lowest of the family of Ragha is present, such a scandalous speech as that now uttered by Janak in the presence of the greatest of the clan. Hearken, thou sun of the lotus-like solar race; I state the simple truth, without any vain boasting; if only I have thy permission, I will lift the round world with as much ease as marble, and will break it in pieces like an ill-baked potter's vessel, and tear up Mount Meru like a potherb. Before thy infinite majesty, O my lord god whatis this wretched old bow Only give me an order and see what an exhibition I will make. I will take up the bow as though it were a lotus stalk, and will run a hundred leagues with it to convince you.
Inspired by thy presence, my lord, I will snap it like the stick of an umbrella; or if I swear by thy holy feet never to take bow in hand again.”

sections.label: Doha 254
sections.name: उदित उदयगिरि मंच पर रघुबर बालपतंग

verses.sa:
लखन सकोप बचन जे बोले ।
डगमगानि महि दिग्गज डोले ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan sakop bacan je bole
ḍagamagāni mahi diggaj ḍole
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सकल लोक सब भूप डेराने ।
सिय हियँ हरषु जनकु सकुचाने ॥
verses.tr:
sakal lok sab bhūp ḍerāne
siya hiyam̐ haraṣu janaku sakucāne

verses.sa:
गुर रघुपति सब मुनि मन माहीं ।
मुदित भए पुनि पुनि पुलकाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gur raghupati sab muni man māhīṃ
mudit bhae puni puni pulakāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सयनहिं रघुपति लखनु नेवारे ।
प्रेम समेत निकट बैठारे ॥
verses.tr:
sayanahiṃ raghupati lakhanu nevāre
prem samet nikaṭ baiṭhāre

verses.sa:
बिस्वामित्र समय सुभ जानी ।
बोले अति सनेहमय बानी ॥
verses.tr:
bisvāmitr samaya subh jānī
bole ati sanehamaya bānī

verses.sa:
उठहु राम भंजहु भवचापा ।
मेटहु तात जनक परितापा ॥
verses.tr:
uṭhahu rām bhaṃjahu bhavacāpā
meṭahu tāt janak paritāpā

verses.sa:
सुनि गुरु बचन चरन सिरु नावा ।
हरषु बिषादु न कछु उर आवा ॥
verses.tr:
suni guru bacan caran siru nāvā
haraṣu biṣādu na kachu ur āvā

verses.sa:
ठाढ़े भए उठि सहज सुभाएँ ।
ठवनि जुबा मृगराजु लजाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
ṭhār̤he bhae uṭhi sahaj subhāem̐
ṭhavani jubā mṛgarāju lajāem̐

verses.sa:
उदित उदयगिरि मंच पर रघुबर बालपतंग ।
बिकसे संत सरोज सब हरषे लोचन भृंग ॥
verses.tr:
udit udayagiri maṃc par raghubar bālapataṃg
bikase saṃt saroj sab haraṣe locan bhṛṃg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As Lakshman thus spoke in his wrath, earth shook and. its elephant supporters tottered; the whole assembly and all the kings were struck with terror; Sita was glad of heart and Janak was ashamed; while the saint and Rama and all the hermits were enraptured and quivered all over with excitement.
