Then Rama with a sign checked Lakshman, and lovingly made him sit beside him, while Visvamitra, perceiving the fitness of the time, spoke in gentle and affectionate tones,—“ Up Rama, break this bow of Siva’s and relieve Janak, my son, of his affliction.” On hearing the guru’s words he bowed his head at his feet, and without joy or sorrow in his _ soul rose and stood upright in all his native grace, lordly in gait as a young lion. Dohe 264.
As Raghubar ascended the stage, like the sun climbing the mountains of the east, the hearts of the saints expanded like the lotus, and their eyes were glad as bees at the return of day.

sections.label: Doha 255
sections.name: रामहि प्रेम समेत लखि सखिन्ह समीप बोलाइ

verses.sa:
नृपन्ह केरि आसा निसि नासी ।
बचन नखत अवली न प्रकासी ॥
verses.tr:
nṛpanh keri āsā nisi nāsī
bacan nakhat avalī na prakāsī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मानी महिप कुमुद सकुचाने ।
कपटी भूप उलूक लुकाने ॥
verses.tr:
mānī mahip kumud sakucāne
kapaṭī bhūp ulūk lukāne

verses.sa:
भए बिसोक कोक मुनि देवा ।
बरिसहिं सुमन जनावहिं सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
bhae bisok kok muni devā
barisahiṃ suman janāvahiṃ sevā

verses.sa:
गुर पद बंदि सहित अनुरागा ।
राम मुनिन्ह सन आयसु मागा ॥
verses.tr:
gur pad baṃdi sahit anurāgā
rām muninh san āyasu māgā

verses.sa:
सहजहिं चले सकल जग स्वामी ।
मत्त मंजु बर कुंजर गामी ॥
verses.tr:
sahajahiṃ cale sakal jag svāmī
matt maṃju bar kuṃjar gāmī

verses.sa:
चलत राम सब पुर नर नारी ।
पुलक पूरि तन भए सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
calat rām sab pur nar nārī
pulak pūri tan bhae sukhārī

verses.sa:
बंदि पितर सुर सुकृत सँभारे ।
जौं कछु पुन्य प्रभाउ हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdi pitar sur sukṛt sam̐bhāre
jauṃ kachu punya prabhāu hamāre

verses.sa:
तौ सिवधनु मृनाल की नाईं ।
तोरहुँ राम गनेस गोसाईं ॥
verses.tr:
tau sivadhanu mṛnāl kī nāīṃ
torahum̐ rām ganes gosāīṃ

verses.sa:
रामहि प्रेम समेत लखि सखिन्ह समीप बोलाइ ।
सीता मातु सनेह बस बचन कहइ बिलखाइ ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi prem samet lakhi sakhinh samīp bolāi
sītā mātu saneh bas bacan kahai bilakhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The dark hopes of the kings vanished like the night, and like the serried stars their vaunts waxed feeble: the arrogant shrivelled up like the lilies, and the false slunk away like the owls; saints and gods, like the chakwa, were relieved of their distress and rained down flowers in token of homage. After affectionately reverencing the guru’s feet and asking permission of the holy fathers, the lord of all creation quickly stepped forth, with the tread of a majestic elephant when inflamed with love. As he moved, every man and woman in the city quivered all over their body with delight, worshipping the | spirits of their ancestors and the gods, and recalling their own past good deeds, saying,—“ If my virtuous acts be of any avail, O father Ganes, may Rama snap the bow as it were a lotus-stalk.”
After lovingly gazing upon Rama, Sita’s mother bade her attendants draw near, and thus spoke with affectionate anxiety,— 7

sections.label: Doha 256
sections.name: मंत्र परम लघु जासु बस बिधि हरि हर सुर सर्ब

verses.sa:
सखि सब कौतुक देखनिहारे ।
जेठ कहावत हितू हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
sakhi sab kautuk dekhanihāre
jeṭh kahāvat hitū hamāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोउ न बुझाइ कहइ गुर पाहीं ।
ए बालक असि हठ भलि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kou na bujhāi kahai gur pāhīṃ
e bālak asi haṭh bhali nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
रावन बान छुआ नहिं चापा ।
हारे सकल भूप करि दापा ॥
verses.tr:
rāvan bān chuā nahiṃ cāpā
hāre sakal bhūp kari dāpā

verses.sa:
सो धनु राजकुअँर कर देहीं ।
बाल मराल कि मंदर लेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
so dhanu rājakuam̐r kar dehīṃ
bāl marāl ki maṃdar lehīṃ

verses.sa:
भूप सयानप सकल सिरानी ।
सखि बिधि गति कछु जाति न जानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp sayānap sakal sirānī
sakhi bidhi gati kachu jāti na jānī

verses.sa:
बोली चतुर सखी मृदु बानी ।
तेजवंत लघु गनिअ न रानी ॥
verses.tr:
bolī catur sakhī mṛdu bānī
tejavaṃt laghu gania na rānī

verses.sa:
कहँ कुंभज कहँ सिंधु अपारा ।
सोषेउ सुजसु सकल संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
kaham̐ kuṃbhaj kaham̐ siṃdhu apārā
soṣeu sujasu sakal saṃsārā

verses.sa:
रबि मंडल देखत लघु लागा ।
उदयँ तासु तिभुवन तम भागा ॥
verses.tr:
rabi maṃḍal dekhat laghu lāgā
udayam̐ tāsu tibhuvan tam bhāgā

verses.sa:
मंत्र परम लघु जासु बस बिधि हरि हर सुर सर्ब ।
महामत्त गजराज कहुँ बस कर अंकुस खर्ब ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtr param laghu jāsu bas bidhi hari har sur sarb
mahāmatt gajarāj kahum̐ bas kar aṃkus kharb
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Girls, every one is bent on seeing the show, and as for saying what would be for my good, there is no one who will tell the king plainly:—These are two mere boys; this excessive obstinacy for yours is wrong; Ravan and Bandsur could not touch the bow, and the kings with all their pride were conquered by it; how then give it into the hands of these boy-princes? As well might a cygnet carry off Mount Meru. All the king’s good sense is clean gone: Ah, girls, god’s ways are inscrutable.” A sharp-witted maiden gently answered,— O queen, the glorious are never to be lightly regarded. Consider the weakness of Agastya and the boundlessness of ocean; yet he drained it dry, and his fame has spread through the world. Again, the orb of the sun is small] to look at, but—at its rising—darkness is expelled from heaven and earth and hell. *
A charm is a very little thing, yet it overpowers Brahma and Vishnu and Mahddevaand all the gods; and a mere

sections.label: Doha 257
sections.name: देखि देखि रघुबीर तन सुर मनाव धरि धीर

verses.sa:
काम कुसुम धनु सायक लीन्हे ।
सकल भुवन अपने बस कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
kām kusum dhanu sāyak līnhe
sakal bhuvan apane bas kīnhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देबि तजिअ संसउ अस जानी ।
भंजब धनुष रामु सुनु रानी ॥
verses.tr:
debi tajia saṃsau as jānī
bhaṃjab dhanuṣ rāmu sunu rānī

verses.sa:
सखी बचन सुनि भै परतीती ।
मिटा बिषादु बढ़ी अति प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
sakhī bacan suni bhai paratītī
miṭā biṣādu bar̤hī ati prītī

verses.sa:
तब रामहि बिलोकि बैदेही ।
सभय हृदयँ बिनवति जेहि तेही ॥
verses.tr:
tab rāmahi biloki baidehī
sabhaya hṛdayam̐ binavati jehi tehī

verses.sa:
मनहीं मन मनाव अकुलानी ।
होहु प्रसन्न महेस भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
manahīṃ man manāv akulānī
hohu prasann mahes bhavānī

verses.sa:
करहु सफल आपनि सेवकाई ।
करि हितु हरहु चाप गरुआई ॥
verses.tr:
karahu saphal āpani sevakāī
kari hitu harahu cāp garuāī

verses.sa:
गननायक बरदायक देवा ।
आजु लगें कीन्हिउँ तुअ सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
gananāyak baradāyak devā
āju lageṃ kīnhium̐ tua sevā

verses.sa:
बार बार बिनती सुनि मोरी ।
करहु चाप गुरुता अति थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār binatī suni morī
karahu cāp gurutā ati thorī

verses.sa: देखि देखि रघुबीर तन सुर मनाव धरि धीर ॥
verses.tr: dekhi dekhi raghubīr tan sur manāv dhari dhīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: भरे बिलोचन प्रेम जल पुलकावली सरीर ॥
verses.tr: bhare bilocan prem jal pulakāvalī sarīr

trans: goad governs the mightiest and most furious elephant.

Love, too, though his how and arrows are but of flowers, has brought the whole world under subjection. Fear not then lady, but hearken to me—Rama will assuredly break the bow.” She took heart at these words of her attendant, her despondency ceased and her desire was enlarged. Then Sita with her eyes fixed on Rama, implored with anxious heart each god in turn, praying to them in her inward soul,—'' Be gracious to me, 0 Mahadeva and Bhavani, and reward my service by kindly lightening the weight of the bow O divine Ganes, granter of boons, it is with a view to to-day that I have done your service. Hearken to my oftrepeated supplication, and reduce the weight of the bow to a mere trifle.”
OFt glancing at Raghubir’s form, and taking courage from her heaven-ward prayers, her eyes were filled with tears of love, and her whole body was in a tremor.

sections.label: Doha 258
sections.name: प्रभुहि चितइ पुनि चितव महि राजत लोचन लोल

verses.sa:
नीकें निरखि नयन भरि सोभा ।
पितु पनु सुमिरि बहुरि मनु छोभा ॥
verses.tr:
nīkeṃ nirakhi nayan bhari sobhā
pitu panu sumiri bahuri manu chobhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अहह तात दारुनि हठ ठानी ।
समुझत नहिं कछु लाभु न हानी ॥
verses.tr:
ahah tāt dāruni haṭh ṭhānī
samujhat nahiṃ kachu lābhu na hānī

verses.sa:
सचिव सभय सिख देइ न कोई ।
बुध समाज बड़ अनुचित होई ॥
verses.tr:
saciv sabhaya sikh dei na koī
budh samāj bar̤ anucit hoī

verses.sa:
कहँ धनु कुलिसहु चाहि कठोरा ।
कहँ स्यामल मृदुगात किसोरा ॥
verses.tr:
kaham̐ dhanu kulisahu cāhi kaṭhorā
kaham̐ syāmal mṛdugāt kisorā

verses.sa:
बिधि केहि भाँति धरौं उर धीरा ।
सिरस सुमन कन बेधिअ हीरा ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi kehi bhām̐ti dharauṃ ur dhīrā
siras suman kan bedhia hīrā

verses.sa:
सकल सभा कै मति भै भोरी ।
अब मोहि संभुचाप गति तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sabhā kai mati bhai bhorī
ab mohi saṃbhucāp gati torī

verses.sa:
निज जड़ता लोगन्ह पर डारी ।
होहि हरुअ रघुपतिहि निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
nij jar̤atā loganh par ḍārī
hohi harua raghupatihi nihārī

verses.sa:
अति परिताप सीय मन माही ।
लव निमेष जुग सब सय जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ati paritāp sīya man māhī
lav nimeṣ jug sab saya jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रभुहि चितइ पुनि चितव महि राजत लोचन लोल ।
खेलत मनसिज मीन जुग जनु बिधु मंडल डोल ॥
verses.tr:
prabhuhi citai puni citav mahi rājat locan lol
khelat manasij mīn jug janu bidhu maṃḍal ḍol
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With fixed gaze she devoured his beauty, and then, as she remembered her father’s vow, her soul was troubled— ‘Alas, my father, for your cruel] resolve, made without any regard to good or evil consequences; not a minister but was afraid to give advice—the more the pity—in the great conclave of counsellors. Here is a bow as firm as adamant, and here a little dark-hued prince of tender frame. O god how can I maintain my faith?—Is it possible for a delicate siris flower to transpierce a diamond? The judgment of the whole assembly has gone astray; now, O bow of Sambhu, thou art the only hope left me; impart thy own heaviness to the crowd, and grow light thyself at once at the sight of Rama.” So great was the agitation of Sita’s soul that an instant of time passed as slowly as an aye.
As she looks, now at the Lord, and now at the ground, her tremulous eyes so glisten, as it were love’s two fish disporting themselves in the orb of the moon.

sections.label: Doha 259
sections.name: लखन लखेउ रघुबंसमनि ताकेउ हर कोदंडु

verses.sa:
गिरा अलिनि मुख पंकज रोकी ।
प्रगट न लाज निसा अवलोकी ॥
verses.tr:
girā alini mukh paṃkaj rokī
pragaṭ na lāj nisā avalokī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लोचन जलु रह लोचन कोना ।
जैसे परम कृपन कर सोना ॥
verses.tr:
locan jalu rah locan konā
jaise param kṛpan kar sonā

verses.sa:
सकुची ब्याकुलता बड़ि जानी ।
धरि धीरजु प्रतीति उर आनी ॥
verses.tr:
sakucī byākulatā bar̤i jānī
dhari dhīraju pratīti ur ānī

verses.sa:
तन मन बचन मोर पनु साचा ।
रघुपति पद सरोज चितु राचा ॥
verses.tr:
tan man bacan mor panu sācā
raghupati pad saroj citu rācā

verses.sa:
तौ भगवानु सकल उर बासी ।
करिहिं मोहि रघुबर कै दासी ॥
verses.tr:
tau bhagavānu sakal ur bāsī
karihiṃ mohi raghubar kai dāsī

verses.sa:
जेहि कें जेहि पर सत्य सनेहू ।
सो तेहि मिलइ न कछु संहेहू ॥
verses.tr:
jehi keṃ jehi par satya sanehū
so tehi milai na kachu saṃhehū

verses.sa:
प्रभु तन चितइ प्रेम तन ठाना ।
कृपानिधान राम सबु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu tan citai prem tan ṭhānā
kṛpānidhān rām sabu jānā

verses.sa:
सियहि बिलोकि तकेउ धनु कैसे ।
चितव गरुरु लघु ब्यालहि जैसे ॥
verses.tr:
siyahi biloki takeu dhanu kaise
citav garuru laghu byālahi jaise

verses.sa:
लखन लखेउ रघुबंसमनि ताकेउ हर कोदंडु ।
पुलकि गात बोले बचन चरन चापि ब्रह्मांडु ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan lakheu raghubaṃsamani tākeu har kodaṃḍu
pulaki gāt bole bacan caran cāpi brahmāṃḍu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In her lotus mouth her bee-like voice lies bound; for modesty, like night, allows it not. In the corner of her eye stood a tear-drop, like a miser’s buried hoard. Abashed by the consciousness of extreme excitement, she yet summoned up courage and confidence,—“ If there is any truth ia me at all and I am really enamoured of Raghupati's lotus feet, then the Lord God, who knoweth all men’s hearts, will make me Rama's handmaid; for wherever there is true affection of soul to soul, union will follow beyond a doubt.” With her eyes fixed upon the lord she recorded this loving vow; and he, the most merciful, comprehended it all. After looking at Sita he cast a glance at the bow, as Garur might glance at a poor little snake.
When Lakshman perceived that the glory of his race had his eye fixed upon the bow, he thrilled with emotion, and striking the earth with his foot, cried thus alond,—

sections.label: Doha 260
sections.name: राम बिलोके लोग सब चित्र लिखे से देखि

verses.sa:
दिसकुंजरहु कमठ अहि कोला ।
धरहु धरनि धरि धीर न डोला ॥
verses.tr:
disakuṃjarahu kamaṭh ahi kolā
dharahu dharani dhari dhīr na ḍolā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रामु चहहिं संकर धनु तोरा ।
होहु सजग सुनि आयसु मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu cahahiṃ saṃkar dhanu torā
hohu sajag suni āyasu morā

verses.sa:
चाप सपीप रामु जब आए ।
नर नारिन्ह सुर सुकृत मनाए ॥
verses.tr:
cāp sapīp rāmu jab āe
nar nārinh sur sukṛt manāe

verses.sa:
सब कर संसउ अरु अग्यानू ।
मंद महीपन्ह कर अभिमानू ॥
verses.tr:
sab kar saṃsau aru agyānū
maṃd mahīpanh kar abhimānū

verses.sa:
भृगुपति केरि गरब गरुआई ।
सुर मुनिबरन्ह केरि कदराई ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛgupati keri garab garuāī
sur munibaranh keri kadarāī

verses.sa:
सिय कर सोचु जनक पछितावा ।
रानिन्ह कर दारुन दुख दावा ॥
verses.tr:
siya kar socu janak pachitāvā
rāninh kar dārun dukh dāvā

verses.sa:
संभुचाप बड बोहितु पाई ।
चढे जाइ सब संगु बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhucāp baḍ bohitu pāī
caḍhe jāi sab saṃgu banāī

verses.sa:
राम बाहुबल सिंधु अपारू ।
चहत पारु नहि कोउ कड़हारू ॥
verses.tr:
rām bāhubal siṃdhu apārū
cahat pāru nahi kou kar̤ahārū

verses.sa:
राम बिलोके लोग सब चित्र लिखे से देखि ।
चितई सीय कृपायतन जानी बिकल बिसेषि ॥
verses.tr:
rām biloke log sab citr likhe se dekhi
citaī sīya kṛpāyatan jānī bikal biseṣi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Ye elephant warders, ye tortoise, serpent and boar, hold fast the earth with a will that it shake not, for Rama is about to break the great bow; hearken to my order and be ready.”” When Rama drew near to the bow, the people all supplicated the gods by their past good deeds. The doubts and errors of the crowd, the arrogance of the foolish kings the proud pretentions of Parasurem the terror of all the gods and saints, the distress of Sita, the regrets of Janak, the burning anguish of the queens, were all heaped together on the bow as on a raft, while Rama's strength of arm was the boundless ocean that had to be crossed, and with no helmsman to essay it.
Rama first looked at the crowd, who all stood dumb and still as statues; then the gracious Lord turned from them to Sita, and perceived her yet deeper concern;

sections.label: Doha 261
sections.name: संकर चापु जहाजु सागरु रघुबर बाहुबलु

verses.sa:
देखी बिपुल बिकल बैदेही ।
निमिष बिहात कलप सम तेही ॥
verses.tr:
dekhī bipul bikal baidehī
nimiṣ bihāt kalap sam tehī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तृषित बारि बिनु जो तनु त्यागा ।
मुएँ करइ का सुधा तड़ागा ॥
verses.tr:
tṛṣit bāri binu jo tanu tyāgā
muem̐ karai kā sudhā tar̤āgā

verses.sa:
का बरषा सब कृषी सुखानें ।
समय चुकें पुनि का पछितानें ॥
verses.tr:
kā baraṣā sab kṛṣī sukhāneṃ
samaya cukeṃ puni kā pachitāneṃ

verses.sa:
अस जियँ जानि जानकी देखी ।
प्रभु पुलके लखि प्रीति बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
as jiyam̐ jāni jānakī dekhī
prabhu pulake lakhi prīti biseṣī

verses.sa:
गुरहि प्रनामु मनहि मन कीन्हा ।
अति लाघवँ उठाइ धनु लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
gurahi pranāmu manahi man kīnhā
ati lāghavam̐ uṭhāi dhanu līnhā

verses.sa:
दमकेउ दामिनि जिमि जब लयऊ ।
पुनि नभ धनु मंडल सम भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
damakeu dāmini jimi jab layaū
puni nabh dhanu maṃḍal sam bhayaū

verses.sa:
लेत चढ़ावत खैंचत गाढ़ें ।
काहुँ न लखा देख सबु ठाढ़ें ॥
verses.tr:
let car̤hāvat khaiṃcat gār̤heṃ
kāhum̐ na lakhā dekh sabu ṭhār̤heṃ

verses.sa:
तेहि छन राम मध्य धनु तोरा ।
भरे भुवन धुनि घोर कठोरा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi chan rām madhya dhanu torā
bhare bhuvan dhuni ghor kaṭhorā

verses.sa:
भरे भुवन घोर कठोर रव रबि बाजि तजि मारगु चले ।
चिक्करहिं दिग्गज डोल महि अहि कोल कूरुम कलमले ॥
verses.tr:
bhare bhuvan ghor kaṭhor rav rabi bāji taji māragu cale
cikkarahiṃ diggaj ḍol mahi ahi kol kūrum kalamale
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सुर असुर मुनि कर कान दीन्हें सकल बिकल बिचारहीं ।
कोदंड खंडेउ राम तुलसी जयति बचन उचारही ॥
verses.tr:
sur asur muni kar kān dīnheṃ sakal bikal bicārahīṃ
kodaṃḍ khaṃḍeu rām tulasī jayati bacan ucārahī

verses.sa:
संकर चापु जहाजु सागरु रघुबर बाहुबलु ।
बूड़ सो सकल समाजु चढ़ा जो प्रथमहिं मोह बस ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkar cāpu jahāju sāgaru raghubar bāhubalu
būr̤ so sakal samāju car̤hā jo prathamahiṃ moh bas
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Perceived her to be so terribly agitated that a moment of time seemed an age in passing. Ifa man die of thirst for want of water, when he is once dead, of what use to him is a Lake of nectar What good is the rain when the crop is dead? or what avails regret when a chance has once been lost Thinking thus to himself as he gazed at Janaki, the Lord was enraptured at the sight of her singular devotion, and after making a reverential obeisance to his guru, he took up the bow with most superlative ease; as he grasped it in his hand, it gleamed like a flash of lightning; and again as he bent it, it seemed like the vault of heaven. Though all stood looking on, before any one could see, he had lifted it from the ground and raised it aloft and drawn it tight, and in a moment broken it in halves; the awful crash re-echoed through the world.

So awful a crash re-echoed through the world that the horses of the Sun started from their course, the elephants of thefour quarters groaned, earth shook, the great serpent, the boar and the tortoise tottered. Gods, demons and saints put their hands to their ears, and all began anxiously to consider the cause; but when they learnt that Rama had broken the bow, they uttered shouts of Victory.
All the deluded crowd who had gone on board ‘the Siva’s bow’ were drowned in the waves of Rama’s might.

sections.label: Doha 262
sections.name: बंदी मागध सूतगन बिरुद बदहिं मतिधीर

verses.sa:
प्रभु दोउ चापखंड महि डारे ।
देखि लोग सब भए सुखारे ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu dou cāpakhaṃḍ mahi ḍāre
dekhi log sab bhae sukhāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोसिकरुप पयोनिधि पावन ।
प्रेम बारि अवगाहु सुहावन ॥
verses.tr:
kosikarup payonidhi pāvan
prem bāri avagāhu suhāvan

verses.sa:
रामरूप राकेसु निहारी ।
बढ़त बीचि पुलकावलि भारी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmarūp rākesu nihārī
bar̤hat bīci pulakāvali bhārī

verses.sa:
बाजे नभ गहगहे निसाना ।
देवबधू नाचहिं करि गाना ॥
verses.tr:
bāje nabh gahagahe nisānā
devabadhū nācahiṃ kari gānā

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मादिक सुर सिद्ध मुनीसा ।
प्रभुहि प्रसंसहि देहिं असीसा ॥
verses.tr:
brahmādik sur siddh munīsā
prabhuhi prasaṃsahi dehiṃ asīsā

verses.sa:
बरिसहिं सुमन रंग बहु माला ।
गावहिं किंनर गीत रसाला ॥
verses.tr:
barisahiṃ suman raṃg bahu mālā
gāvahiṃ kiṃnar gīt rasālā

verses.sa:
रही भुवन भरि जय जय बानी ।
धनुषभंग धुनि जात न जानी ॥
verses.tr:
rahī bhuvan bhari jaya jaya bānī
dhanuṣabhaṃg dhuni jāt na jānī

verses.sa:
मुदित कहहिं जहँ तहँ नर नारी ।
भंजेउ राम संभुधनु भारी ॥
verses.tr:
mudit kahahiṃ jaham̐ taham̐ nar nārī
bhaṃjeu rām saṃbhudhanu bhārī

verses.sa:
बंदी मागध सूतगन बिरुद बदहिं मतिधीर ।
करहिं निछावरि लोग सब हय गय धन मनि चीर ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdī māgadh sūtagan birud badahiṃ matidhīr
karahiṃ nichāvari log sab haya gaya dhan mani cīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Lord tossed upon the ground the two broken pieces of the bow, and at the sight the multitude rejoiced. Visvamitra’s love, like the clear unfathomed depth of ocean, swelled to the highest tide of ecstasy under the full moon influence of Rama’s presence. There wasa jubilant noise of music in the sky; the heavenly nymphs danced and sang; Brahma and all the gods and deified saints and sages praised and blessed the hero and rained down wreaths of many-coloured flowers; the kinnars sung melodious strains; and the shout of ‘Victory, Victory,’ re-echoed throughout the world. The noise that followed the breaking of the bow defies description. Everywhere the people in their joy kept saying, —‘ Rama has broken the great bow.”
Bards, minstrels and rhapsodists raise their loud-voiced pans, and all the people lavish offerings of horses, elephants, money, jewels and raiment.

sections.label: Doha 263
sections.name: संग सखीं सुदंर चतुर गावहिं मंगलचार

verses.sa:
झाँझि मृदंग संख सहनाई ।
भेरि ढोल दुंदुभी सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
jhām̐jhi mṛdaṃg saṃkh sahanāī
bheri ḍhol duṃdubhī suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बाजहिं बहु बाजने सुहाए ।
जहँ तहँ जुबतिन्ह मंगल गाए ॥
verses.tr:
bājahiṃ bahu bājane suhāe
jaham̐ taham̐ jubatinh maṃgal gāe

verses.sa:
सखिन्ह सहित हरषी अति रानी ।
सूखत धान परा जनु पानी ॥
verses.tr:
sakhinh sahit haraṣī ati rānī
sūkhat dhān parā janu pānī

verses.sa:
जनक लहेउ सुखु सोचु बिहाई ।
पैरत थकें थाह जनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
janak laheu sukhu socu bihāī
pairat thakeṃ thāh janu pāī

verses.sa:
श्रीहत भए भूप धनु टूटे ।
जैसें दिवस दीप छबि छूटे ॥
verses.tr:
śrīhat bhae bhūp dhanu ṭūṭe
jaiseṃ divas dīp chabi chūṭe

verses.sa:
सीय सुखहि बरनिअ केहि भाँती ।
जनु चातकी पाइ जलु स्वाती ॥
verses.tr:
sīya sukhahi barania kehi bhām̐tī
janu cātakī pāi jalu svātī

verses.sa:
रामहि लखनु बिलोकत कैसें ।
ससिहि चकोर किसोरकु जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi lakhanu bilokat kaiseṃ
sasihi cakor kisoraku jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
सतानंद तब आयसु दीन्हा ।
सीताँ गमनु राम पहिं कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
satānaṃd tab āyasu dīnhā
sītām̐ gamanu rām pahiṃ kīnhā

verses.sa:
संग सखीं सुदंर चतुर गावहिं मंगलचार ।
गवनी बाल मराल गति सुषमा अंग अपार ॥
verses.tr:
saṃg sakhīṃ sudaṃr catur gāvahiṃ maṃgalacār
gavanī bāl marāl gati suṣamā aṃg apār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There was a clash of cymbals, tabors, conches, clarions, sackbuts, drums, kettledrums and all kinds of music; and in every place were choirs of women singing auspicious strains. The queen with her attendants was as glad asa parched rice-field at a fall of rain; Janak was as pleased

and free of care as a tired swimmer on reaching a shallow; the kings were as confounded at the breaking of the bow as alamp is dimmed at dawn of day; but Sita’s gladness can only be compared to that of the chdtaki on finding a rain-drop in October; while Lakshman fixed his eyes on Rama as the chakor on the moon. The Satanand gave the word and Sita advanced to Rama.
Graceful in motion as a swan, and of infinite beauty in every limb; and with her came her fair and sprightly companions, who raise the glad marriage song.

sections.label: Doha 264
sections.name: रघुबर उर जयमाल देखि देव बरिसहिं सुमन

verses.sa:
सखिन्ह मध्य सिय सोहति कैसे ।
छबिगन मध्य महाछबि जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
sakhinh madhya siya sohati kaise
chabigan madhya mahāchabi jaiseṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कर सरोज जयमाल सुहाई ।
बिस्व बिजय सोभा जेहिं छाई ॥
verses.tr:
kar saroj jayamāl suhāī
bisv bijaya sobhā jehiṃ chāī

verses.sa:
तन सकोचु मन परम उछाहू ।
गूढ़ प्रेमु लखि परइ न काहू ॥
verses.tr:
tan sakocu man param uchāhū
gūr̤h premu lakhi parai na kāhū

verses.sa:
जाइ समीप राम छबि देखी ।
रहि जनु कुँअरि चित्र अवरेखी ॥
verses.tr:
jāi samīp rām chabi dekhī
rahi janu kum̐ari citr avarekhī

verses.sa:
चतुर सखीं लखि कहा बुझाई ।
पहिरावहु जयमाल सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
catur sakhīṃ lakhi kahā bujhāī
pahirāvahu jayamāl suhāī

verses.sa:
सुनत जुगल कर माल उठाई ।
प्रेम बिबस पहिराइ न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunat jugal kar māl uṭhāī
prem bibas pahirāi na jāī

verses.sa:
सोहत जनु जुग जलज सनाला ।
ससिहि सभीत देत जयमाला ॥
verses.tr:
sohat janu jug jalaj sanālā
sasihi sabhīt det jayamālā

verses.sa:
गावहिं छबि अवलोकि सहेली ।
सियँ जयमाल राम उर मेली ॥
verses.tr:
gāvahiṃ chabi avaloki sahelī
siyam̐ jayamāl rām ur melī

verses.sa:
रघुबर उर जयमाल देखि देव बरिसहिं सुमन ।
सकुचे सकल भुआल जनु बिलोकि रबि कुमुदगन ॥
verses.tr:
raghubar ur jayamāl dekhi dev barisahiṃ suman
sakuce sakal bhuāl janu biloki rabi kumudagan
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Resplendent in their midst as the Queen of Love among the loves, she held in her lotus hand the fair wreath of victory, enriched as it were with the spoils of world-wide triumph. With modest air, but rapture in her soul, her interior devotion was withdrawn from sight. As she drew near and beheld Rama’s beauty, she stood motionless like a figure on the wall, till a watchful attendant roused her, saying. —‘ Invest him with the ennobling wreath,’ At the word she raised the wreath with both her hands, but was too much overcome by emotion to drop it; till as the lotus, flower and stalk, shrinks at the moonlight, so her hand and arm drooped in the glory of his moon-like face. At the sight of his beauty her handmaids break into song, while Sita let fall the wreath upon his breast.
When the gods saw the wreath resting on his breast they showered down flowers; and the kings all shrunk into nothing, like lilies at the rising of the sun.

sections.label: Doha 265
sections.name: गौतम तिय गति सुरति करि नहिं परसति पग पानि

verses.sa:
पुर अरु ब्योम बाजने बाजे ।
खल भए मलिन साधु सब राजे ॥
verses.tr:
pur aru byom bājane bāje
khal bhae malin sādhu sab rāje
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुर किंनर नर नाग मुनीसा ।
जय जय जय कहि देहिं असीसा ॥
verses.tr:
sur kiṃnar nar nāg munīsā
jaya jaya jaya kahi dehiṃ asīsā

verses.sa:
नाचहिं गावहिं बिबुध बधूटीं ।
बार बार कुसुमांजलि छूटीं ॥
verses.tr:
nācahiṃ gāvahiṃ bibudh badhūṭīṃ
bār bār kusumāṃjali chūṭīṃ

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ बिप्र बेदधुनि करहीं ।
बंदी बिरदावलि उच्चरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ bipr bedadhuni karahīṃ
baṃdī biradāvali uccarahīṃ

verses.sa:
महि पाताल नाक जसु ब्यापा ।
राम बरी सिय भंजेउ चापा ॥
verses.tr:
mahi pātāl nāk jasu byāpā
rām barī siya bhaṃjeu cāpā

verses.sa:
करहिं आरती पुर नर नारी ।
देहिं निछावरि बित्त बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ āratī pur nar nārī
dehiṃ nichāvari bitt bisārī

verses.sa:
सोहति सीय राम कै जौरी ।
छबि सिंगारु मनहुँ एक ठोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sohati sīya rām kai jaurī
chabi siṃgāru manahum̐ ek ṭhorī

verses.sa:
सखीं कहहिं प्रभुपद गहु सीता ।
करति न चरन परस अति भीता ॥
verses.tr:
sakhīṃ kahahiṃ prabhupad gahu sītā
karati na caran paras ati bhītā

verses.sa:
गौतम तिय गति सुरति करि नहिं परसति पग पानि ।
मन बिहसे रघुबंसमनि प्रीति अलौकिक जानि ॥
verses.tr:
gautam tiya gati surati kari nahiṃ parasati pag pāni
man bihase raghubaṃsamani prīti alaukik jāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Both in the city and in heaven there were sounds of music; the bad were saddened, and the good were glad. Gods, kinnars, men, serpents and saints uttered blessings and shouts of victory, ‘The heavenly nymphs danced and sung, and flowers fell in constant showers. In every place were Brahmans muttering Vedic texts, and rhapsodists reciting lays of praise. Earth, hell and heaven were pervaded with the glad news,—‘Rama has broken the bow and will wed Sita.” The men and women of the city light votive torches and, regardless of their substance, scatter gifts in profusion. Sita by Rama’s side was as resplendent as if Beauty and Love had met together. Her companions whisper, —‘ Embrace your lord’s feet:’ but in excess of fear she dares not touch them.
She touches them not with her hands, remembering the fate of Gautama’s wife; and Rama smiled inwardly at this proof of her supernatural devotion.

sections.label: Doha 266
sections.name: देखहु रामहि नयन भरि तजि इरिषा मदु कोहु

verses.sa:
तब सिय देखि भूप अभिलाषे ।
कूर कपूत मूढ़ मन माखे ॥
verses.tr:
tab siya dekhi bhūp abhilāṣe
kūr kapūt mūr̤h man mākhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
उठि उठि पहिरि सनाह अभागे ।
जहँ तहँ गाल बजावन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
uṭhi uṭhi pahiri sanāh abhāge
jaham̐ taham̐ gāl bajāvan lāge

verses.sa:
लेहु छड़ाइ सीय कह कोऊ ।
धरि बाँधहु नृप बालक दोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
lehu char̤āi sīya kah koū
dhari bām̐dhahu nṛp bālak doū

verses.sa:
तोरें धनुषु चाड़ नहिं सरई ।
जीवत हमहि कुअँरि को बरई ॥
verses.tr:
toreṃ dhanuṣu cār̤ nahiṃ saraī
jīvat hamahi kuam̐ri ko baraī

verses.sa:
जौं बिदेहु कछु करै सहाई ।
जीतहु समर सहित दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ bidehu kachu karai sahāī
jītahu samar sahit dou bhāī

verses.sa:
साधु भूप बोले सुनि बानी ।
राजसमाजहि लाज लजानी ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu bhūp bole suni bānī
rājasamājahi lāj lajānī

verses.sa:
बलु प्रतापु बीरता बड़ाई ।
नाक पिनाकहि संग सिधाई ॥
verses.tr:
balu pratāpu bīratā bar̤āī
nāk pinākahi saṃg sidhāī

verses.sa:
सोइ सूरता कि अब कहुँ पाई ।
असि बुधि तौ बिधि मुहँ मसि लाई ॥
verses.tr:
soi sūratā ki ab kahum̐ pāī
asi budhi tau bidhi muham̐ masi lāī

verses.sa:
देखहु रामहि नयन भरि तजि इरिषा मदु कोहु ।
लखन रोषु पावकु प्रबल जानि सलभ जनि होहु ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahu rāmahi nayan bhari taji iriṣā madu kohu
lakhan roṣu pāvaku prabal jāni salabh jani hohu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then, as they looked on Sita, the kings were inflamed with desire, and waxed wroth of soul—frantic degenerate fools— and sprung up—the wretches—and donned their armour and began a general chorus of abuse,—‘Come now, let us carry off Sita and overthrow and bind fast these two princes; though he has broken the bow, he has not yet gained his end; for who shall marry Sita while we still live? IE the king give them any assistance, we will rout him in battle as well as the two brothers.” When the good kings heard these words they answered and put the whole assembly to shame,—‘ The glory of your might and greatness of your strength were disgraced for ever at the breaking of*the bow. Is that the might of which ye now boast, or have ye since acquired something new? Was it not thus that ye reckoned afore, when God so blackened your fuces?
Cease from envy and arrogance and folly; feast your eyes upon Rama; and be not like a moth in the fierce flame of Lakshman’s wrath.

sections.label: Doha 267
sections.name: अरुन नयन भृकुटी कुटिल चितवत नृपन्ह सकोप

verses.sa:
बैनतेय बलि जिमि चह कागू ।
जिमि ससु चहै नाग अरि भागू ॥
verses.tr:
bainateya bali jimi cah kāgū
jimi sasu cahai nāg ari bhāgū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिमि चह कुसल अकारन कोही ।
सब संपदा चहै सिवद्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
jimi cah kusal akāran kohī
sab saṃpadā cahai sivadrohī

verses.sa:
लोभी लोलुप कल कीरति चहई ।
अकलंकता कि कामी लहई ॥
verses.tr:
lobhī lolup kal kīrati cahaī
akalaṃkatā ki kāmī lahaī

verses.sa:
हरि पद बिमुख परम गति चाहा ।
तस तुम्हार लालचु नरनाहा ॥
verses.tr:
hari pad bimukh param gati cāhā
tas tumhār lālacu naranāhā

verses.sa:
कोलाहलु सुनि सीय सकानी ।
सखीं लवाइ गईं जहँ रानी ॥
verses.tr:
kolāhalu suni sīya sakānī
sakhīṃ lavāi gaīṃ jaham̐ rānī

verses.sa:
रामु सुभायँ चले गुरु पाहीं ।
सिय सनेहु बरनत मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu subhāyam̐ cale guru pāhīṃ
siya sanehu baranat man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
रानिन्ह सहित सोचबस सीया ।
अब धौं बिधिहि काह करनीया ॥
verses.tr:
rāninh sahit socabas sīyā
ab dhauṃ bidhihi kāh karanīyā

verses.sa:
भूप बचन सुनि इत उत तकहीं ।
लखनु राम डर बोलि न सकहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bacan suni it ut takahīṃ
lakhanu rām ḍar boli na sakahīṃ

verses.sa:
अरुन नयन भृकुटी कुटिल चितवत नृपन्ह सकोप ।
मनहुँ मत्त गजगन निरखि सिंघकिसोरहि चोप ॥
verses.tr:
arun nayan bhṛkuṭī kuṭil citavat nṛpanh sakop
manahum̐ matt gajagan nirakhi siṃghakisorahi cop
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Like a crow who would rob the king of the birds of an offering; or a rat who would Spoil a lion; 48 a man who is passionate without cause and yet wishes for peace of mind; as a reviler of Siva who wishes for happiness and _prosperity; as a greedy and covetous man who wishes for fair fame, and as a gallant who would have no scandal; as an enemy of God who wishes to be saved; such is your desire, O ye kings.” When Sita heard the tumult, she was afraid, and with her companions went away to the queen, while Rama composedly joined the guru, talking to himself of Sita’s affection. Sita and the queen were much distrest, saying,— ‘“ What is it God would have now?” And at the sound of the voices of the kings they looked helplessly up and down. For fear of Rama Lakshman could not speak.
With fiery eyes and knitted brows he cast a furious look at the kings, like a lion's whelp watching to spring on a herd of wild elephants.

sections.label: Doha 268
sections.name: सांत बेषु करनी कठिन बरनि न जाइ सरुप

verses.sa:
खरभरु देखि बिकल पुर नारीं ।
सब मिलि देहिं महीपन्ह गारीं ॥
verses.tr:
kharabharu dekhi bikal pur nārīṃ
sab mili dehiṃ mahīpanh gārīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहिं अवसर सुनि सिव धनु भंगा ।
आयसु भृगुकुल कमल पतंगा ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ avasar suni siv dhanu bhaṃgā
āyasu bhṛgukul kamal pataṃgā

verses.sa:
देखि महीप सकल सकुचाने ।
बाज झपट जनु लवा लुकाने ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi mahīp sakal sakucāne
bāj jhapaṭ janu lavā lukāne

verses.sa:
गौरि सरीर भूति भल भ्राजा ।
भाल बिसाल त्रिपुंड बिराजा ॥
verses.tr:
gauri sarīr bhūti bhal bhrājā
bhāl bisāl tripuṃḍ birājā

verses.sa:
सीस जटा ससिबदनु सुहावा ।
रिसबस कछुक अरुन होइ आवा ॥
verses.tr:
sīs jaṭā sasibadanu suhāvā
risabas kachuk arun hoi āvā

verses.sa:
भृकुटी कुटिल नयन रिस राते ।
सहजहुँ चितवत मनहुँ रिसाते ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛkuṭī kuṭil nayan ris rāte
sahajahum̐ citavat manahum̐ risāte

verses.sa:
बृषभ कंध उर बाहु बिसाला ।
चारु जनेउ माल मृगछाला ॥
verses.tr:
bṛṣabh kaṃdh ur bāhu bisālā
cāru janeu māl mṛgachālā

verses.sa:
कटि मुनि बसन तून दुइ बाँधें ।
धनु सर कर कुठारु कल काँधें ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭi muni basan tūn dui bām̐dheṃ
dhanu sar kar kuṭhāru kal kām̐dheṃ

verses.sa:
सांत बेषु करनी कठिन बरनि न जाइ सरुप ।
धरि मुनितनु जनु बीर रसु आयउ जहँ सब भूप ॥
verses.tr:
sāṃt beṣu karanī kaṭhin barani na jāi sarup
dhari munitanu janu bīr rasu āyau jaham̐ sab bhūp
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Seeing the tumult, the people were all distrest and joined in reproaching the kings. Then it was that the sun of the lotus race of Bhrigu (Parasurdm) arrived, for he had heard of the breaking of the bow. At the sight of him the kings all cowered down, as a partridge shrinking beneath the swoop of a hawk. OF pallid hue and well bestreaked with ashes; with the three horizontal lines sacred to Siva conspicuous ov his broad forehead; with the hair on his head bound in a knot; and his moon-like face flushed with the furnace fire of smouldering wrath; with frowning brows and eyes inflamed with passion; he casts a quick and furious glance around. With bull-l:ke shoulders and mighty chest and arms; with fair sacrificial cord and string of beads and deerskin with an anchorite’s dress about his loins and two quivers slung by his side; with bow and arrows in hand, and his sharp axe upon his shoulder.
In his saintly attire and savage mien a figure beyond description, as though the Heroic had taken the form of a hermit; so he drew near to the kings.

sections.label: Doha 269
sections.name: बहुरि बिलोकि बिदेह सन कहहु काह अति भीर

verses.sa:
देखत भृगुपति बेषु कराला ।
उठे सकल भय बिकल भुआला ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat bhṛgupati beṣu karālā
uṭhe sakal bhaya bikal bhuālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पितु समेत कहि कहि निज नामा ।
लगे करन सब दंड प्रनामा ॥
verses.tr:
pitu samet kahi kahi nij nāmā
lage karan sab daṃḍ pranāmā

verses.sa:
जेहि सुभायँ चितवहिं हितु जानी ।
सो जानइ जनु आइ खुटानी ॥
verses.tr:
jehi subhāyam̐ citavahiṃ hitu jānī
so jānai janu āi khuṭānī

verses.sa:
जनक बहोरि आइ सिरु नावा ।
सीय बोलाइ प्रनामु करावा ॥
verses.tr:
janak bahori āi siru nāvā
sīya bolāi pranāmu karāvā

verses.sa:
आसिष दीन्हि सखीं हरषानीं ।
निज समाज लै गई सयानीं ॥
verses.tr:
āsiṣ dīnhi sakhīṃ haraṣānīṃ
nij samāj lai gaī sayānīṃ

verses.sa:
बिस्वामित्रु मिले पुनि आई ।
पद सरोज मेले दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bisvāmitru mile puni āī
pad saroj mele dou bhāī

verses.sa:
रामु लखनु दसरथ के ढोटा ।
दीन्हि असीस देखि भल जोटा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu lakhanu dasarath ke ḍhoṭā
dīnhi asīs dekhi bhal joṭā

verses.sa:
रामहि चितइ रहे थकि लोचन ।
रूप अपार मार मद मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi citai rahe thaki locan
rūp apār mār mad mocan

verses.sa: बहुरि बिलोकि बिदेह सन कहहु काह अति भीर ॥
verses.tr: bahuri biloki bideh san kahahu kāh ati bhīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: पूछत जानि अजान जिमि ब्यापेउ कोपु सरीर ॥
verses.tr: pūchat jāni ajān jimi byāpeu kopu sarīr

trans: When they beheld his ghastly attire, they all rose in consternation, each mentioning his own and his father’s name, and fell prostrate on the ground before him; and even those on whom he cast a kindly glance thought their life had come to an end. Then came Janak and bowed his head and called for Sita also to pay him homage. He bestowed upon her his blessing, and her glad companions escorted her back to her own apartments. Next came Visvamitra to salute him, and placed the two boys at his feet, saying,— as These are Rama and Lakshman, Dasarath’s sons.’ He admired the well-matched pair and blessed them, with his eyes long fixed upon Rama's incomparable beauty, which would humble the pride even of Love himself.
Then be turned and said to Videha,—‘Why all this crowd?” Asking as though he did not know, while his whole body was bursting with passion.

sections.label: Doha 270
sections.name: सभय बिलोके लोग सब जानि जानकी भीरु

verses.sa:
समाचार कहि जनक सुनाए ।
जेहि कारन महीप सब आए ॥
verses.tr:
samācār kahi janak sunāe
jehi kāran mahīp sab āe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन फिरि अनत निहारे ।
देखे चापखंड महि डारे ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan phiri anat nihāre
dekhe cāpakhaṃḍ mahi ḍāre

verses.sa:
अति रिस बोले बचन कठोरा ।
कहु जड़ जनक धनुष कै तोरा ॥
verses.tr:
ati ris bole bacan kaṭhorā
kahu jar̤ janak dhanuṣ kai torā

verses.sa:
बेगि देखाउ मूढ़ न त आजू ।
उलटउँ महि जहँ लहि तव राजू ॥
verses.tr:
begi dekhāu mūr̤h na ta ājū
ulaṭaum̐ mahi jaham̐ lahi tav rājū

verses.sa:
अति डरु उतरु देत नृपु नाहीं ।
कुटिल भूप हरषे मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ati ḍaru utaru det nṛpu nāhīṃ
kuṭil bhūp haraṣe man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुर मुनि नाग नगर नर नारी ।
सोचहिं सकल त्रास उर भारी ॥
verses.tr:
sur muni nāg nagar nar nārī
socahiṃ sakal trās ur bhārī

verses.sa:
मन पछिताति सीय महतारी ।
बिधि अब सँवरी बात बिगारी ॥
verses.tr:
man pachitāti sīya mahatārī
bidhi ab sam̐varī bāt bigārī

verses.sa:
भृगुपति कर सुभाउ सुनि सीता ।
अरध निमेष कलप सम बीता ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛgupati kar subhāu suni sītā
aradh nimeṣ kalap sam bītā

verses.sa:
सभय बिलोके लोग सब जानि जानकी भीरु ।
हृदयँ न हरषु बिषादु कछु बोले श्रीरघुबीरु ॥
verses.tr:
sabhaya biloke log sab jāni jānakī bhīru
hṛdayam̐ na haraṣu biṣādu kachu bole śrīraghubīru
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Janak told him the whole history and the reason why the kings assembled. After hearing his reply he again looked away and spied the fragments of the bow lying on the ground. In a mighty passion he cried in furious tones, — ‘Tell me now, Janak, you fool who has broken the bow? Show him to me at once, or this very day | will overthrow the whole of your dominion.” In his excess of fear the king could give no answer: the wicked suitors were glad of heart; gods, saints, serpents and all the people of the city were full of anxiety and profound alarm; Sita’s mother was lamenting,—“ God has now undone all that had just been done so well;” and Sita when she heard of Bhrigupati’s character felt half a minute pass like an age.
Seeing the people’s consternation and Januki’s anxiety,

sections.label: Doha 271
sections.name: रे नृप बालक कालबस बोलत तोहि न सँमार

verses.sa:
नाथ संभुधनु भंजनिहारा ।
होइहि केउ एक दास तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth saṃbhudhanu bhaṃjanihārā
hoihi keu ek dās tumhārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आयसु काह कहिअ किन मोही ।
सुनि रिसाइ बोले मुनि कोही ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu kāh kahia kin mohī
suni risāi bole muni kohī

verses.sa:
सेवकु सो जो करै सेवकाई ।
अरि करनी करि करिअ लराई ॥
verses.tr:
sevaku so jo karai sevakāī
ari karanī kari karia larāī

verses.sa:
सुनहु राम जेहिं सिवधनु तोरा ।
सहसबाहु सम सो रिपु मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu rām jehiṃ sivadhanu torā
sahasabāhu sam so ripu morā

verses.sa:
सो बिलगाउ बिहाइ समाजा ।
न त मारे जैहहिं सब राजा ॥
verses.tr:
so bilagāu bihāi samājā
na ta māre jaihahiṃ sab rājā

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन लखन मुसुकाने ।
बोले परसुधरहि अपमाने ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan lakhan musukāne
bole parasudharahi apamāne

verses.sa:
बहु धनुहीं तोरीं लरिकाईं ।
कबहुँ न असि रिस कीन्हि गोसाईं ॥
verses.tr:
bahu dhanuhīṃ torīṃ larikāīṃ
kabahum̐ na asi ris kīnhi gosāīṃ

verses.sa:
एहि धनु पर ममता केहि हेतू ।
सुनि रिसाइ कह भृगुकुलकेतू ॥
verses.tr:
ehi dhanu par mamatā kehi hetū
suni risāi kah bhṛgukulaketū

verses.sa: रे नृप बालक कालबस बोलत तोहि न सँमार ॥
verses.tr: re nṛp bālak kālabas bolat tohi na sam̐mār
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: धनुही सम तिपुरारि धनु बिदित सकल संसार ॥
verses.tr: dhanuhī sam tipurāri dhanu bidit sakal saṃsār

trans: the imperturbable Raghubir thus spoke and said, — Chaupai 275.

‘My Lord, the bow has probably got broken by some one of your servants, What are your orders? Why not tell me?” At this the furious saint was yet more incensed and cried, —* A servant is one who does service, but he who does the deeds of an enemy must be fought. Hearken, Rama, whoever it was who broke Siva’s bow is as much my enemy as was Sabasrabehu. Separate him from among the assembly, or else every one of these kings shall be killed.” When Lakshman heard the saint's words, he smiled and said to him in a tone of contempt,—“ O sir, I have broken many a bow as a child, and you were never before thus angry: why were you so fond of this bow in particular?” Parasurem replied in a fury, —
“Ah! death-doomed prince, ig there no stopping your tongue? Would you compare to a common bow the great bow of Siva, that is famous throughout the world?”

sections.label: Doha 272
sections.name: मातु पितहि जनि सोचबस करसि महीसकिसोर

verses.sa:
लखन कहा हँसि हमरें जाना ।
सुनहु देव सब धनुष समाना ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan kahā ham̐si hamareṃ jānā
sunahu dev sab dhanuṣ samānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
का छति लाभु जून धनु तौरें ।
देखा राम नयन के भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
kā chati lābhu jūn dhanu taureṃ
dekhā rām nayan ke bhoreṃ

verses.sa:
छुअत टूट रघुपतिहु न दोसू ।
मुनि बिनु काज करिअ कत रोसू ॥
verses.tr:
chuat ṭūṭ raghupatihu na dosū
muni binu kāj karia kat rosū

verses.sa:
बोले चितइ परसु की ओरा ।
रे सठ सुनेहि सुभाउ न मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
bole citai parasu kī orā
re saṭh sunehi subhāu na morā

verses.sa:
बालकु बोलि बधउँ नहिं तोही ।
केवल मुनि जड़ जानहि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
bālaku boli badhaum̐ nahiṃ tohī
keval muni jar̤ jānahi mohī

verses.sa:
बाल ब्रह्मचारी अति कोही ।
बिस्व बिदित छत्रियकुल द्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
bāl brahmacārī ati kohī
bisv bidit chatriyakul drohī

verses.sa:
भुजबल भूमि भूप बिनु कीन्ही ।
बिपुल बार महिदेवन्ह दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
bhujabal bhūmi bhūp binu kīnhī
bipul bār mahidevanh dīnhī

verses.sa:
सहसबाहु भुज छेदनिहारा ।
परसु बिलोकु महीपकुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
sahasabāhu bhuj chedanihārā
parasu biloku mahīpakumārā

verses.sa:
मातु पितहि जनि सोचबस करसि महीसकिसोर ।
गर्भन्ह के अर्भक दलन परसु मोर अति घोर ॥
verses.tr:
mātu pitahi jani socabas karasi mahīsakisor
garbhanh ke arbhak dalan parasu mor ati ghor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said Lakshman with a smile,—‘I thought, holy sir, that all bows alike. What gain or what loss can there be in the breaking of a worn-out bow? Rama by mistake took it for a new one, and directly he touched it, it snapped in two: but it was no fault of his; why then, reverend sir, be so angry for no cause?’ He answered, with. a glance at his axe,—‘Fool, have you never heard of my temper? I do not slay you because, as I say, you are but a child. You in your folly take me for a mere recluse: and from my childhood an ascetic I am, but a fiery one and the terror of the whole Kshatriya race, as is known throughout the world. By the might of my arm I have made earth kingless, and time after time have bestowed her upon the Brahmans. See here, you king's son, the axe with which I lopped of Subasrabehu’s thousand arms.
Do not bring distress upon your father and mother: °

sections.label: Doha 273
sections.name: जो बिलोकि अनुचित कहेउँ छमहु महामुनि धीर

verses.sa:
बिहसि लखनु बोले मृदु बानी ।
अहो मुनीसु महा भटमानी ॥
verses.tr:
bihasi lakhanu bole mṛdu bānī
aho munīsu mahā bhaṭamānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि मोहि देखाव कुठारू ।
चहत उड़ावन फूँकि पहारू ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni mohi dekhāv kuṭhārū
cahat ur̤āvan phūm̐ki pahārū

verses.sa:
इहाँ कुम्हड़बतिया कोउ नाहीं ।
जे तरजनी देखि मरि जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ kumhar̤abatiyā kou nāhīṃ
je tarajanī dekhi mari jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
देखि कुठारु सरासन बाना ।
मैं कछु कहा सहित अभिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi kuṭhāru sarāsan bānā
maiṃ kachu kahā sahit abhimānā

verses.sa:
भृगुसुत समुझि जनेउ बिलोकी ।
जो कछु कहहु सहउँ रिस रोकी ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛgusut samujhi janeu bilokī
jo kachu kahahu sahaum̐ ris rokī

verses.sa:
सुर महिसुर हरिजन अरु गाई ।
हमरें कुल इन्ह पर न सुराई ॥
verses.tr:
sur mahisur harijan aru gāī
hamareṃ kul inh par na surāī

verses.sa:
बधें पापु अपकीरति हारें ।
मारतहूँ पा परिअ तुम्हारें ॥
verses.tr:
badheṃ pāpu apakīrati hāreṃ
māratahūm̐ pā paria tumhāreṃ

verses.sa:
कोटि कुलिस सम बचनु तुम्हारा ।
ब्यर्थ धरहु धनु बान कुठारा ॥
verses.tr:
koṭi kulis sam bacanu tumhārā
byarth dharahu dhanu bān kuṭhārā

verses.sa:
जो बिलोकि अनुचित कहेउँ छमहु महामुनि धीर ।
सुनि सरोष भृगुबंसमनि बोले गिरा गभीर ॥
verses.tr:
jo biloki anucit kaheum̐ chamahu mahāmuni dhīr
suni saroṣ bhṛgubaṃsamani bole girā gabhīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: my cruel axe has ripped up even unborn infants in the womb.”

Lakshman replied with a quiet smile,—‘Ah holy sir, you think yourself a great warrior indeed, and keep brandishing your axe before me, as if with a mere puff of breath you could blow away a mountain. Buatlam not a kumhar blossom that droops as soon as it sees a finger raised against it When I perceived your axe and quiver and arrows, I spoke a little hanghtily; but now that I see by your Brehmanical thread that you are of Bhrigu’s line, say what you like and I will bear it patiently. In my family there is no waging battle against gods or Brahmans, ar devotees, or cows; for to kill them is a crime, and to be overcome by them a disgrace; and therefore I must throw myself at your feet, even though you strike me. Your curse is as awful as
a million thunderbolts, and your axe and bow and arrows are unnecessary.
; Purdon me, great and reverend sage, for anything improper that I said when I first saw you.” ‘The glory of Bhriga’s race cried furiously in his deep toned voice, —

sections.label: Doha 274
sections.name: सूर समर करनी करहिं कहि न जनावहिं आपु

verses.sa:
कौसिक सुनहु मंद यहु बालकु ।
कुटिल कालबस निज कुल घालकु ॥
verses.tr:
kausik sunahu maṃd yahu bālaku
kuṭil kālabas nij kul ghālaku
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भानु बंस राकेस कलंकू ।
निपट निरंकुस अबुध असंकू ॥
verses.tr:
bhānu baṃs rākes kalaṃkū
nipaṭ niraṃkus abudh asaṃkū

verses.sa:
काल कवलु होइहि छन माहीं ।
कहउँ पुकारि खोरि मोहि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kāl kavalu hoihi chan māhīṃ
kahaum̐ pukāri khori mohi nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्ह हटकउ जौं चहहु उबारा ।
कहि प्रतापु बलु रोषु हमारा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh haṭakau jauṃ cahahu ubārā
kahi pratāpu balu roṣu hamārā

verses.sa:
लखन कहेउ मुनि सुजस तुम्हारा ।
तुम्हहि अछत को बरनै पारा ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan kaheu muni sujas tumhārā
tumhahi achat ko baranai pārā

verses.sa:
अपने मुँह तुम्ह आपनि करनी ।
बार अनेक भाँति बहु बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
apane mum̐h tumh āpani karanī
bār anek bhām̐ti bahu baranī

verses.sa:
नहिं संतोषु त पुनि कछु कहहू ।
जनि रिस रोकि दुसह दुख सहहू ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ saṃtoṣu ta puni kachu kahahū
jani ris roki dusah dukh sahahū

verses.sa:
बीरब्रती तुम्ह धीर अछोभा ।
गारी देत न पावहु सोभा ॥
verses.tr:
bīrabratī tumh dhīr achobhā
gārī det na pāvahu sobhā

verses.sa:
सूर समर करनी करहिं कहि न जनावहिं आपु ।
बिद्यमान रन पाइ रिपु कायर कथहिं प्रतापु ॥
verses.tr:
sūr samar karanī karahiṃ kahi na janāvahiṃ āpu
bidyamān ran pāi ripu kāyar kathahiṃ pratāpu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Hearken, son of Kusika; this child is demented;: a perverse and death doomed destroyer of his own house; a dark spot on the moon-like brightness of the Solar race; utterly ungovernable, senseless and reckless. Another moment and he shall be a mouthful in the jaws of death, and I loudly protest it is no fault of mine. Take him away, if you would save him, and teach him my glory and might and the fierceness of my temper.” Said Lakshman,—* So long as you live, father, who else can tell your fame so well? With your own mouth you have many times and in many ways declared your own doings. If you are not yet satisfied, tell them over again, and do not distress yourself beyond, endurance by putting any restraint upon your passion. But if you are really a resolute and dauntless warrior, there is no honour to be get by abuse.
Heroes perform valiant deeds in fight, but do not themselves publish them: cowards finding afoe before them in the battle talk very large, as you.

sections.label: Doha 275
sections.name: गाधिसूनु कह हृदयँ हँसि मुनिहि हरिअरइ सूझ

verses.sa:
तुम्ह तौ कालु हाँक जनु लावा ।
बार बार मोहि लागि बोलावा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh tau kālu hām̐k janu lāvā
bār bār mohi lāgi bolāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनत लखन के बचन कठोरा ।
परसु सुधारि धरेउ कर घोरा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat lakhan ke bacan kaṭhorā
parasu sudhāri dhareu kar ghorā

verses.sa:
अब जनि देइ दोसु मोहि लोगू ।
कटुबादी बालकु बधजोगू ॥
verses.tr:
ab jani dei dosu mohi logū
kaṭubādī bālaku badhajogū

verses.sa:
बाल बिलोकि बहुत मैं बाँचा ।
अब यहु मरनिहार भा साँचा ॥
verses.tr:
bāl biloki bahut maiṃ bām̐cā
ab yahu maranihār bhā sām̐cā

verses.sa:
कौसिक कहा छमिअ अपराधू ।
बाल दोष गुन गनहिं न साधू ॥
verses.tr:
kausik kahā chamia aparādhū
bāl doṣ gun ganahiṃ na sādhū

verses.sa:
खर कुठार मैं अकरुन कोही ।
आगें अपराधी गुरुद्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
khar kuṭhār maiṃ akarun kohī
āgeṃ aparādhī gurudrohī

verses.sa:
उतर देत छोड़उँ बिनु मारें ।
केवल कौसिक सील तुम्हारें ॥
verses.tr:
utar det chor̤aum̐ binu māreṃ
keval kausik sīl tumhāreṃ

verses.sa:
न त एहि काटि कुठार कठोरें ।
गुरहि उरिन होतेउँ श्रम थोरें ॥
verses.tr:
na ta ehi kāṭi kuṭhār kaṭhoreṃ
gurahi urin hoteum̐ śram thoreṃ

verses.sa:
गाधिसूनु कह हृदयँ हँसि मुनिहि हरिअरइ सूझ ।
अयमय खाँड न ऊखमय अजहुँ न बूझ अबूझ ॥
verses.tr:
gādhisūnu kah hṛdayam̐ ham̐si munihi hariarai sūjh
ayamaya khām̐ḍ na ūkhamaya ajahum̐ na būjh abūjh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Now would terrify me with your repeated cries of Death.” On hearing Lakshman’s rude speech he closed his hand upon his terrible axe,—“ After this let no man blame me; this sharp-tongued boy deserves his death. I have spared him long on account of his being a child, but now of a truth he is as good as dead.” Said Visvamitra,—‘“ Pardon his offence; the wise regard not the faults or merits of children.” “T have axe in hand and am pitiless in my wrath; he is moreover guilty: and has injured my guru. Yet though this be my answer, I will still spare his life, though solely out of regard for you, Visvamitra. But for you I had cut him in pieces with my terrible axe, and thus easily have paid my guru his due.”

Said the son of Gadhi, smiling to hitnself, —“ Everything looks green to the saint’s eyes; though Rama has to-day broken the bow as though it were a stick of sugarcane, still he has not the sense to understand.”

sections.label: Doha 276
sections.name: लखन उतर आहुति सरिस भृगुबर कोपु कृसानु

verses.sa:
कहेउ लखन मुनि सीलु तुम्हारा ।
को नहि जान बिदित संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
kaheu lakhan muni sīlu tumhārā
ko nahi jān bidit saṃsārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
माता पितहि उरिन भए नीकें ।
गुर रिनु रहा सोचु बड़ जीकें ॥
verses.tr:
mātā pitahi urin bhae nīkeṃ
gur rinu rahā socu bar̤ jīkeṃ

verses.sa:
सो जनु हमरेहि माथे काढ़ा ।
दिन चलि गए ब्याज बड़ बाढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
so janu hamarehi māthe kār̤hā
din cali gae byāj bar̤ bār̤hā

verses.sa:
अब आनिअ ब्यवहरिआ बोली ।
तुरत देउँ मैं थैली खोली ॥
verses.tr:
ab ānia byavahariā bolī
turat deum̐ maiṃ thailī kholī

verses.sa:
सुनि कटु बचन कुठार सुधारा ।
हाय हाय सब सभा पुकारा ॥
verses.tr:
suni kaṭu bacan kuṭhār sudhārā
hāya hāya sab sabhā pukārā

verses.sa:
भृगुबर परसु देखावहु मोही ।
बिप्र बिचारि बचउँ नृपद्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛgubar parasu dekhāvahu mohī
bipr bicāri bacaum̐ nṛpadrohī

verses.sa:
मिले न कबहुँ सुभट रन गाढ़े ।
द्विज देवता घरहि के बाढ़े ॥
verses.tr:
mile na kabahum̐ subhaṭ ran gār̤he
dvij devatā gharahi ke bār̤he

verses.sa:
अनुचित कहि सब लोग पुकारे ।
रघुपति सयनहिं लखनु नेवारे ॥
verses.tr:
anucit kahi sab log pukāre
raghupati sayanahiṃ lakhanu nevāre

verses.sa:
लखन उतर आहुति सरिस भृगुबर कोपु कृसानु ।
बढ़त देखि जल सम बचन बोले रघुकुलभानु ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan utar āhuti saris bhṛgubar kopu kṛsānu
bar̤hat dekhi jal sam bacan bole raghukulabhānu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said Lakshman, —“ Is there any one, Father, ignorant of your honour? it is notorious throughout the world. You have well paid the debt you owed to your father and mother; but it was a great distress to you to be still in debt to your guru. You ible SS transferred the account to me, but the interest by lapse of time has become very heavy. So you must bring forward the original creditor, and then, sir, I will at once open my purse.” When he heard these bitter words he grasped his axe, and all the people cried —Alack, alack “O Bhrigu-bar, you still keep showing me your axe, but, regicide as you are, I only spare you on account of your being u Brahman. You have never yet mea real staunch fighting man, and, most reverend sir, you are a great man only in your own house.” They all cried out,—‘ How very wrong; ‘and Rama gave Lakshman a sign to be quiet.
Lakshman’s words were like oil on the fire of Bhrigapati’s wrath; till, seeing the flame increase, RAma quenched it with the flood of admonition, —

sections.label: Doha 277
sections.name: लखन कहेउ हँसि सुनहु मुनि क्रोधु पाप कर मूल

verses.sa:
नाथ करहु बालक पर छोहू ।
सूध दूधमुख करिअ न कोहू ॥
verses.tr:
nāth karahu bālak par chohū
sūdh dūdhamukh karia na kohū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौं पै प्रभु प्रभाउ कछु जाना ।
तौ कि बराबरि करत अयाना ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pai prabhu prabhāu kachu jānā
tau ki barābari karat ayānā

verses.sa:
जौं लरिका कछु अचगरि करहीं ।
गुर पितु मातु मोद मन भरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ larikā kachu acagari karahīṃ
gur pitu mātu mod man bharahīṃ

verses.sa:
करिअ कृपा सिसु सेवक जानी ।
तुम्ह सम सील धीर मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
karia kṛpā sisu sevak jānī
tumh sam sīl dhīr muni gyānī

verses.sa:
राम बचन सुनि कछुक जुड़ाने ।
कहि कछु लखनु बहुरि मुसकाने ॥
verses.tr:
rām bacan suni kachuk jur̤āne
kahi kachu lakhanu bahuri musakāne

verses.sa:
हँसत देखि नख सिख रिस ब्यापी ।
राम तोर भ्राता बड़ पापी ॥
verses.tr:
ham̐sat dekhi nakh sikh ris byāpī
rām tor bhrātā bar̤ pāpī

verses.sa:
गौर सरीर स्याम मन माहीं ।
कालकूटमुख पयमुख नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gaur sarīr syām man māhīṃ
kālakūṭamukh payamukh nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सहज टेढ़ अनुहरइ न तोही ।
नीचु मीचु सम देख न मौहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj ṭer̤h anuharai na tohī
nīcu mīcu sam dekh na mauhīṃ

verses.sa:
लखन कहेउ हँसि सुनहु मुनि क्रोधु पाप कर मूल ।
जेहि बस जन अनुचित करहिं चरहिं बिस्व प्रतिकूल ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan kaheu ham̐si sunahu muni krodhu pāp kar mūl
jehi bas jan anucit karahiṃ carahiṃ bisv pratikūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘“ My lord, have compassion on a child, and wreak not your wrath on such an unweaned infant: if he had any idea of your glorious power, how could he be so foolish as to put himself on an equality with you? When a child commits any naughtiness, its guru and father and mother arein raptures atit. Have pity then on the boy, who is really one of your clients; for thus it becometh a saint, so patient and wise as you are.’ On hearing Rama’s words he cooled down a little but again Lakshman said something with a smile, and seeing him smile he flushed all over with rage,—‘Rama, your brother is too wicked; though fair in outward hue, he is black at heart, and it is not mother’s milk but poison that his lips have sucked, Perverse by nature, he neither takes after you nor regards me.”
Said Lakshman with a smile,—'' Hearken, © saint, passion is the root of sin; those who are under its influence do unseemly things and set themselves against every one.

sections.label: Doha 278
sections.name: सुनि लछिमन बिहसे बहुरि नयन तरेरे राम

verses.sa:
मैं तुम्हार अनुचर मुनिराया ।
परिहरि कोपु करिअ अब दाया ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ tumhār anucar munirāyā
parihari kopu karia ab dāyā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
टूट चाप नहिं जुरहि रिसाने ।
बैठिअ होइहिं पाय पिराने ॥
verses.tr:
ṭūṭ cāp nahiṃ jurahi risāne
baiṭhia hoihiṃ pāya pirāne

verses.sa:
जौ अति प्रिय तौ करिअ उपाई ।
जोरिअ कोउ बड़ गुनी बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
jau ati priya tau karia upāī
joria kou bar̤ gunī bolāī

verses.sa:
बोलत लखनहिं जनकु डेराहीं ।
मष्ट करहु अनुचित भल नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bolat lakhanahiṃ janaku ḍerāhīṃ
maṣṭ karahu anucit bhal nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
थर थर कापहिं पुर नर नारी ।
छोट कुमार खोट बड़ भारी ॥
verses.tr:
thar thar kāpahiṃ pur nar nārī
choṭ kumār khoṭ bar̤ bhārī

verses.sa:
भृगुपति सुनि सुनि निरभय बानी ।
रिस तन जरइ होइ बल हानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛgupati suni suni nirabhaya bānī
ris tan jarai hoi bal hānī

verses.sa:
बोले रामहि देइ निहोरा ।
बचउँ बिचारि बंधु लघु तोरा ॥
verses.tr:
bole rāmahi dei nihorā
bacaum̐ bicāri baṃdhu laghu torā

verses.sa:
मनु मलीन तनु सुंदर कैसें ।
बिष रस भरा कनक घटु जैसैं ॥
verses.tr:
manu malīn tanu suṃdar kaiseṃ
biṣ ras bharā kanak ghaṭu jaisaiṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि लछिमन बिहसे बहुरि नयन तरेरे राम ।
गुर समीप गवने सकुचि परिहरि बानी बाम ॥
verses.tr:
suni lachiman bihase bahuri nayan tarere rām
gur samīp gavane sakuci parihari bānī bām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I am one of your followers, reverend sir; put away your wrath «and show mercy upon me. - Anger will not mend the broken bow; pray sit down, you must be tired of standing. If you were so very fond of it, devise a plan for getting it mended and call in some skilful workman.” Janak was frightened at Lakshman’s words,—‘ Be quiet; such frowardness is not right.’ The citizens all shook and trembled: to think so small a boy could be so naughty. As Bhrigupati heard his fearless words his whole body was on fire with rage, and he became quite helpless, and in a tone of entreaty cried to Rama,—-“ See if you can manage this little brother of yours; 30 fair without and foul within; he resembles a golden jar full of poison.”
At this Lakshman smiled, but Itama gave him a look of reproof and submissively approached the guru, putting away all petulance of speech.

sections.label: Doha 279
sections.name: गर्भ स्त्रवहिं अवनिप रवनि सुनि कुठार गति घोर

verses.sa:
अति बिनीत मृदु सीतल बानी ।
बोले रामु जोरि जुग पानी ॥
verses.tr:
ati binīt mṛdu sītal bānī
bole rāmu jori jug pānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनहु नाथ तुम्ह सहज सुजाना ।
बालक बचनु करिअ नहिं काना ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu nāth tumh sahaj sujānā
bālak bacanu karia nahiṃ kānā

verses.sa:
बररै बालक एकु सुभाऊ ।
इन्हहि न संत बिदूषहिं काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bararai bālak eku subhāū
inhahi na saṃt bidūṣahiṃ kāū

verses.sa:
तेहिं नाहीं कछु काज बिगारा ।
अपराधी में नाथ तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ nāhīṃ kachu kāj bigārā
aparādhī meṃ nāth tumhārā

verses.sa:
कृपा कोपु बधु बँधब गोसाईं ।
मो पर करिअ दास की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpā kopu badhu bam̐dhab gosāīṃ
mo par karia dās kī nāī

verses.sa:
कहिअ बेगि जेहि बिधि रिस जाई ।
मुनिनायक सोइ करौं उपाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahia begi jehi bidhi ris jāī
munināyak soi karauṃ upāī

verses.sa:
कह मुनि राम जाइ रिस कैसें ।
अजहुँ अनुज तव चितव अनैसें ॥
verses.tr:
kah muni rām jāi ris kaiseṃ
ajahum̐ anuj tav citav anaiseṃ

verses.sa:
एहि के कंठ कुठारु न दीन्हा ।
तौ मैं काह कोपु करि कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi ke kaṃṭh kuṭhāru na dīnhā
tau maiṃ kāh kopu kari kīnhā

verses.sa:
गर्भ स्त्रवहिं अवनिप रवनि सुनि कुठार गति घोर ।
परसु अछत देखउँ जिअत बैरी भूपकिसोर ॥
verses.tr:
garbh stravahiṃ avanip ravani suni kuṭhār gati ghor
parasu achat dekhaum̐ jiat bairī bhūpakisor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Clasping his two hands together and speaking in most modest, gentle and placid tones, he said Hearken, my lord, you were born a sage; pay no heed then to the words ofa child. Boys are like gnats: no wise man will ever trouble himself about them. Nor is it be who has done the mischief;1, my lord, am the offender. Be pleased, your reverence, to visit everything on me, your servant, whether it be favour or anger, or death or bonds. Tell me quickly the means, O king of saints, by which your passion may be assuaged.” Said the saint,—“O Rama, how can my passion be assuaged Your brother has to-day set me at nought, and yet I have not struck off his head with my axe what then have I done in anger?
When they heard of the fierce doings of my axe, the proudest queens were seized with untimely pains of labour; my axe is still here, and yet I see this princeling, my enemy, alive.

sections.label: Doha 280
sections.name: परसुरामु तब राम प्रति बोले उर अति क्रोधु

verses.sa:
बहइ न हाथु दहइ रिस छाती ।
भा कुठारु कुंठित नृपघाती ॥
verses.tr:
bahai na hāthu dahai ris chātī
bhā kuṭhāru kuṃṭhit nṛpaghātī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भयउ बाम बिधि फिरेउ सुभाऊ ।
मोरे हृदयँ कृपा कसि काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau bām bidhi phireu subhāū
more hṛdayam̐ kṛpā kasi kāū

verses.sa:
आजु दया दुखु दुसह सहावा ।
सुनि सौमित्र बिहसि सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
āju dayā dukhu dusah sahāvā
suni saumitr bihasi siru nāvā

verses.sa:
बाउ कृपा मूरति अनुकूला ।
बोलत बचन झरत जनु फूला ॥
verses.tr:
bāu kṛpā mūrati anukūlā
bolat bacan jharat janu phūlā

verses.sa:
जौं पै कृपाँ जरिहिं मुनि गाता ।
क्रोध भएँ तनु राख बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pai kṛpām̐ jarihiṃ muni gātā
krodh bhaem̐ tanu rākh bidhātā

verses.sa:
देखु जनक हठि बालक एहू ।
कीन्ह चहत जड़ जमपुर गेहू ॥
verses.tr:
dekhu janak haṭhi bālak ehū
kīnh cahat jar̤ jamapur gehū

verses.sa:
बेगि करहु किन आँखिन्ह ओटा ।
देखत छोट खोट नृप ढोटा ॥
verses.tr:
begi karahu kin ām̐khinh oṭā
dekhat choṭ khoṭ nṛp ḍhoṭā

verses.sa:
बिहसे लखनु कहा मन माहीं ।
मूदें आँखि कतहुँ कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bihase lakhanu kahā man māhīṃ
mūdeṃ ām̐khi katahum̐ kou nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
परसुरामु तब राम प्रति बोले उर अति क्रोधु ।
संभु सरासनु तोरि सठ करसि हमार प्रबोधु ॥
verses.tr:
parasurāmu tab rām prati bole ur ati krodhu
saṃbhu sarāsanu tori saṭh karasi hamār prabodhu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: My hand moves not, though passion consumes my breast my regicide axe has become blunted. Fate is against me; my nature is changed: for when was I ever pitiful before? To-day by.heaven’s will I have suffered intolerable pain.” On hearing this, the son of Sumitra smiled and bowed his head,—‘ Even your pity is like a blast of wind and the words you speak would strip a tree +of its blossoms. Ifa saint's body is thus parched even by pity, God help him when he is angry.” ‘See now, Janak, keep this child away; he is bent in his folly on visiting the realms of death. Why do you not at once take him out of my sight, this little prince; so small to look at and yet so wicked?” Lakshman laughed and said to the saint,—‘ Shut your eyes and you will see nothing.’
Then said Parasuram in tones of fury to Rama,—

sections.label: Doha 281
sections.name: प्रभुहि सेवकहि समरु कस तजहु बिप्रबर रोसु

verses.sa:
बंधु कहइ कटु संमत तोरें ।
तू छल बिनय करसि कर जोरें ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhu kahai kaṭu saṃmat toreṃ
tū chal binaya karasi kar joreṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करु परितोषु मोर संग्रामा ।
नाहिं त छाड़ कहाउब रामा ॥
verses.tr:
karu paritoṣu mor saṃgrāmā
nāhiṃ ta chār̤ kahāub rāmā

verses.sa:
छलु तजि करहि समरु सिवद्रोही ।
बंधु सहित न त मारउँ तोही ॥
verses.tr:
chalu taji karahi samaru sivadrohī
baṃdhu sahit na ta māraum̐ tohī

verses.sa:
भृगुपति बकहिं कुठार उठाएँ ।
मन मुसकाहिं रामु सिर नाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛgupati bakahiṃ kuṭhār uṭhāem̐
man musakāhiṃ rāmu sir nāem̐

verses.sa:
गुनह लखन कर हम पर रोषू ।
कतहुँ सुधाइहु ते बड़ दोषू ॥
verses.tr:
gunah lakhan kar ham par roṣū
katahum̐ sudhāihu te bar̤ doṣū

verses.sa:
टेढ़ जानि सब बंदइ काहू ।
बक्र चंद्रमहि ग्रसइ न राहू ॥
verses.tr:
ṭer̤h jāni sab baṃdai kāhū
bakr caṃdramahi grasai na rāhū

verses.sa:
राम कहेउ रिस तजिअ मुनीसा ।
कर कुठारु आगें यह सीसा ॥
verses.tr:
rām kaheu ris tajia munīsā
kar kuṭhāru āgeṃ yah sīsā

verses.sa:
जेंहिं रिस जाइ करिअ सोइ स्वामी ।
मोहि जानि आपन अनुगामी ॥
verses.tr:
jeṃhiṃ ris jāi karia soi svāmī
mohi jāni āpan anugāmī

verses.sa:
प्रभुहि सेवकहि समरु कस तजहु बिप्रबर रोसु ।
बेषु बिलोकें कहेसि कछु बालकहू नहिं दोसु ॥
verses.tr:
prabhuhi sevakahi samaru kas tajahu biprabar rosu
beṣu bilokeṃ kahesi kachu bālakahū nahiṃ dosu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Wretch, after breaking Siva’s bow do you now teach me? Chaupai 285.

It is at your suggestion your brother utters these sarcasms. and your humility and folded hands are a mockery Give me my satisfaction in combat, or forswear your name of Rama. You enemy of Siva, have done with and your brother too.” Flushed with passion he raised his axe on high, but Rama only smiled’ and bowed,— * Though the fault is Lakshman’s your wrath is against me; it is sometimes a great mistake to be good and upright; for every one is afraid of the crooked, in the same way as Rahu does not attack the crescent moon. Cease, 0 great saint, from your wrath.” Said Rama,—“ Your axe is in your hand and my head isin front of you; do anything, sir, that will tend to pacify you, for I am your servant.
And how can a servant fight his master?O holy Brahman, restrain your wrath; whatever the boy may have said after looking at your dress, he meant no harm by it,

sections.label: Doha 282
sections.name: बार बार मुनि बिप्रबर कहा राम सन राम

verses.sa:
देखि कुठार बान धनु धारी ।
भै लरिकहि रिस बीरु बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi kuṭhār bān dhanu dhārī
bhai larikahi ris bīru bicārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नामु जान पै तुम्हहि न चीन्हा ।
बंस सुभायँ उतरु तेंहिं दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
nāmu jān pai tumhahi na cīnhā
baṃs subhāyam̐ utaru teṃhiṃ dīnhā

verses.sa:
जौं तुम्ह औतेहु मुनि की नाईं ।
पद रज सिर सिसु धरत गोसाईं ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ tumh autehu muni kī nāīṃ
pad raj sir sisu dharat gosāīṃ

verses.sa:
छमहु चूक अनजानत केरी ।
चहिअ बिप्र उर कृपा घनेरी ॥
verses.tr:
chamahu cūk anajānat kerī
cahia bipr ur kṛpā ghanerī

verses.sa:
हमहि तुम्हहि सरिबरि कसि नाथा ।
कहहु न कहाँ चरन कहँ माथा ॥
verses.tr:
hamahi tumhahi saribari kasi nāthā
kahahu na kahām̐ caran kaham̐ māthā

verses.sa:
राम मात्र लघु नाम हमारा ।
परसु सहित बड़ नाम तोहारा ॥
verses.tr:
rām mātr laghu nām hamārā
parasu sahit bar̤ nām tohārā

verses.sa:
देव एकु गुनु धनुष हमारें ।
नव गुन परम पुनीत तुम्हारें ॥
verses.tr:
dev eku gunu dhanuṣ hamāreṃ
nav gun param punīt tumhāreṃ

verses.sa:
सब प्रकार हम तुम्ह सन हारे ।
छमहु बिप्र अपराध हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
sab prakār ham tumh san hāre
chamahu bipr aparādh hamāre

verses.sa:
बार बार मुनि बिप्रबर कहा राम सन राम ।
बोले भृगुपति सरुष हसि तहूँ बंधु सम बाम ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār muni biprabar kahā rām san rām
bole bhṛgupati saruṣ hasi tahūm̐ baṃdhu sam bām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: For seeing you equipt with axe and bow and arrows, the child took you for a knight and challenged you; for though he knew your name, he did not recognize your person, and answered you according to your lineage. If you had come asa Religious, he would have put the dust of your Holiness’s feet upon his head. Forgive the mistake of one who did not know you; a Brahman's heart should Le all mercy. What equality, my lord, can there be between you and me? We are as far apart as head and feet. [I am called simply Rama. You have the long name of ‘Rama of the axe.’ I have only one string to my bow, while you have all the ~ holy nine. In every way I am your inferior; 98 a Brahman, pardon my offence.”
Again and again did Rama intreat his namesake, addressing him by his titles of ‘Saint’ and ‘Holy Brahman,’ till Bhrigupati exclaimed in his rage:—You are as perverse as your brother.

sections.label: Doha 283
sections.name: जौं हम निदरहिं बिप्र बदि सत्य सुनहु भृगुनाथ

verses.sa:
निपटहिं द्विज करि जानहि मोही ।
मैं जस बिप्र सुनावउँ तोही ॥
verses.tr:
nipaṭahiṃ dvij kari jānahi mohī
maiṃ jas bipr sunāvaum̐ tohī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चाप स्त्रुवा सर आहुति जानू ।
कोप मोर अति घोर कृसानु ॥
verses.tr:
cāp struvā sar āhuti jānū
kop mor ati ghor kṛsānu

verses.sa:
समिधि सेन चतुरंग सुहाई ।
महा महीप भए पसु आई ॥
verses.tr:
samidhi sen caturaṃg suhāī
mahā mahīp bhae pasu āī

verses.sa:
मै एहि परसु काटि बलि दीन्हे ।
समर जग्य जप कोटिन्ह कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
mai ehi parasu kāṭi bali dīnhe
samar jagya jap koṭinh kīnhe

verses.sa:
मोर प्रभाउ बिदित नहिं तोरें ।
बोलसि निदरि बिप्र के भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
mor prabhāu bidit nahiṃ toreṃ
bolasi nidari bipr ke bhoreṃ

verses.sa:
भंजेउ चापु दापु बड़ बाढ़ा ।
अहमिति मनहुँ जीति जगु ठाढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
bhaṃjeu cāpu dāpu bar̤ bār̤hā
ahamiti manahum̐ jīti jagu ṭhār̤hā

verses.sa:
राम कहा मुनि कहहु बिचारी ।
रिस अति बड़ि लघु चूक हमारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām kahā muni kahahu bicārī
ris ati bar̤i laghu cūk hamārī

verses.sa:
छुअतहिं टूट पिनाक पुराना ।
मैं कहि हेतु करौं अभिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
chuatahiṃ ṭūṭ pināk purānā
maiṃ kahi hetu karauṃ abhimānā

verses.sa:
जौं हम निदरहिं बिप्र बदि सत्य सुनहु भृगुनाथ ।
तौ अस को जग सुभटु जेहि भय बस नावहिं माथ ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ ham nidarahiṃ bipr badi satya sunahu bhṛgunāth
tau as ko jag subhaṭu jehi bhaya bas nāvahiṃ māth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: You persist in taking me for a Brahman; I will tell you now what kind of a Brahman Iam. My bow is my sacrificial ladle, my arrow the oblation, and my wrath the blazing fire; armies fully equipt with horses and chariots and elephants and footmen are the fuel, and mighty kings are the victims for oblation whom I have cut in pieces with this axe; thus have I celebrated countless sacrifices of war all over the world. To you my glory is unknown, and you address me contemptuously, taking me for a mere Brahman. Now that you have broken the bow, your pride has increased enormously, and you put yourself forward in your
arrogance as universal conqueror,” Said Rama:—“ O saint, think before you speak; your anger is excessive; my fault is a trifling one. The old bow broke at a touch. What reason have I to be proud?
Hear the truth, O Bhrigunath; you say [ set you at nought when I treat you with the respect due to a Brahman; but is there any warrior to whom I would bow my head in fear?

sections.label: Doha 284
sections.name: जाना राम प्रभाउ तब पुलक प्रफुल्लित गात

verses.sa:
देव दनुज भूपति भट नाना ।
समबल अधिक होउ बलवाना ॥
verses.tr:
dev danuj bhūpati bhaṭ nānā
samabal adhik hou balavānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौं रन हमहि पचारै कोऊ ।
लरहिं सुखेन कालु किन होऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ ran hamahi pacārai koū
larahiṃ sukhen kālu kin hoū

verses.sa:
छत्रिय तनु धरि समर सकाना ।
कुल कलंकु तेहिं पावँर आना ॥
verses.tr:
chatriya tanu dhari samar sakānā
kul kalaṃku tehiṃ pāvam̐r ānā

verses.sa:
कहउँ सुभाउ न कुलहि प्रसंसी ।
कालहु डरहिं न रन रघुबंसी ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ subhāu na kulahi prasaṃsī
kālahu ḍarahiṃ na ran raghubaṃsī

verses.sa:
बिप्रबंस कै असि प्रभुताई ।
अभय होइ जो तुम्हहि डेराई ॥
verses.tr:
biprabaṃs kai asi prabhutāī
abhaya hoi jo tumhahi ḍerāī

verses.sa:
सुनु मृदु गूढ़ बचन रघुपति के ।
उघरे पटल परसुधर मति के ॥
verses.tr:
sunu mṛdu gūr̤h bacan raghupati ke
ughare paṭal parasudhar mati ke

verses.sa:
राम रमापति कर धनु लेहू ।
खैंचहु मिटै मोर संदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
rām ramāpati kar dhanu lehū
khaiṃcahu miṭai mor saṃdehū

verses.sa:
देत चापु आपुहिं चलि गयऊ ।
परसुराम मन बिसमय भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
det cāpu āpuhiṃ cali gayaū
parasurām man bisamaya bhayaū

verses.sa:
जाना राम प्रभाउ तब पुलक प्रफुल्लित गात ।
जोरि पानि बोले बचन ह्दयँ न प्रेमु अमात ॥
verses.tr:
jānā rām prabhāu tab pulak praphullit gāt
jori pāni bole bacan hdayam̐ na premu amāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Any god, demon, king or warrior, whether my equal in strength or my superior, who will challenge me to combat, him would I gladly meet, or even Death himself. For one who is born of warrior caste and yet shirks the battle isa disgrace to his lineage and a contemptible wretch. I state what is only a characteristic of my race and make no idle boast; there is not a descendant of Raghu who would fear to meet in battle even Death himself; but so great is the power of Brahmanical descent that he fears you, who fears nought else. * On hearing this calm and profound speech of Rama's, the eyes of the soul of the axe-bearer were opened:—‘Q Rama, take and draw this bow of Vishnu’s and let my doubts be ended.” As he gave it, the bow strung itself of its own accord; then was Parasuram amaz: ed at heart.
He acknowledged the power of Rama; bis whole frame quivered with excitement; and his heart bursting with love, he thus spake with clasped hands:—

sections.label: Doha 285
sections.name: देवन्ह दीन्हीं दुंदुभीं प्रभु पर बरषहिं फूल

verses.sa:
जय रघुबंस बनज बन भानू ।
गहन दनुज कुल दहन कृसानु ॥
verses.tr:
jaya raghubaṃs banaj ban bhānū
gahan danuj kul dahan kṛsānu
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जय सुर बिप्र धेनु हितकारी ।
जय मद मोह कोह भ्रम हारी ॥
verses.tr:
jaya sur bipr dhenu hitakārī
jaya mad moh koh bhram hārī

verses.sa:
बिनय सील करुना गुन सागर ।
जयति बचन रचना अति नागर ॥
verses.tr:
binaya sīl karunā gun sāgar
jayati bacan racanā ati nāgar

verses.sa:
सेवक सुखद सुभग सब अंगा ।
जय सरीर छबि कोटि अनंगा ॥
verses.tr:
sevak sukhad subhag sab aṃgā
jaya sarīr chabi koṭi anaṃgā

verses.sa:
करौं काह मुख एक प्रसंसा ।
जय महेस मन मानस हंसा ॥
verses.tr:
karauṃ kāh mukh ek prasaṃsā
jaya mahes man mānas haṃsā

verses.sa:
अनुचित बहुत कहेउँ अग्याता ।
छमहु छमामंदिर दोउ भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
anucit bahut kaheum̐ agyātā
chamahu chamāmaṃdir dou bhrātā

verses.sa:
कहि जय जय जय रघुकुलकेतू ।
भृगुपति गए बनहि तप हेतू ॥
verses.tr:
kahi jaya jaya jaya raghukulaketū
bhṛgupati gae banahi tap hetū

verses.sa:
अपभयँ कुटिल महीप डेराने ।
जहँ तहँ कायर गवँहिं पराने ॥
verses.tr:
apabhayam̐ kuṭil mahīp ḍerāne
jaham̐ taham̐ kāyar gavam̐hiṃ parāne

verses.sa:
देवन्ह दीन्हीं दुंदुभीं प्रभु पर बरषहिं फूल ।
हरषे पुर नर नारि सब मिटी मोहमय सूल ॥
verses.tr:
devanh dīnhīṃ duṃdubhīṃ prabhu par baraṣahiṃ phūl
haraṣe pur nar nāri sab miṭī mohamaya sūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Glory to the Sun of the lotus race of Raghu, to the fire that consumes the serried ranks of the demons; glory to the friend of gods, Brahmans and kine; glory to the dispeller of the delusions induced by pride, ignorance and passion; glory to him whose piety, amiability, and compassion are fathomless as ocean; glory to him who is unrivalled in the art of speech, the rewarder of service, the all-beautiful of form, more gracious of person than a myriad Loves. How can I with one tongue declare his praise, who is as it were the divine swan in the hyperboreal lake of Mahadeva’s soul In my ignorance I have said much that was unseemly; but pardon me, yet twin brothers, mercy’s shrine.” Still repeating as he went:— Glory, glory, glory, to the mighty Rama,’ Bhrigupati withdrew to the forest to practise penance. The wicked kings were self-dismayed and trembled, and fled—the cowards—in all directions, without a word.
The gods sounded their kettledrums and rained down flowers on the Lord; and all the people of the city rejoiced, now that the thorn of fear and error had been extracted from their heart.

sections.label: Doha 286
sections.name: तदपि जाइ तुम्ह करहु अब जथा बंस ब्यवहारु

verses.sa:
अति गहगहे बाजने बाजे ।
सबहिं मनोहर मंगल साजे ॥
verses.tr:
ati gahagahe bājane bāje
sabahiṃ manohar maṃgal sāje
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जूथ जूथ मिलि सुमुख सुनयनीं ।
करहिं गान कल कोकिलबयनी ॥
verses.tr:
jūth jūth mili sumukh sunayanīṃ
karahiṃ gān kal kokilabayanī

verses.sa:
सुखु बिदेह कर बरनि न जाई ।
जन्मदरिद्र मनहुँ निधि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
sukhu bideh kar barani na jāī
janmadaridr manahum̐ nidhi pāī

verses.sa:
गत त्रास भइ सीय सुखारी ।
जनु बिधु उदयँ चकोरकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
gat trās bhai sīya sukhārī
janu bidhu udayam̐ cakorakumārī

verses.sa:
जनक कीन्ह कौसिकहि प्रनामा ।
प्रभु प्रसाद धनु भंजेउ रामा ॥
verses.tr:
janak kīnh kausikahi pranāmā
prabhu prasād dhanu bhaṃjeu rāmā

verses.sa:
मोहि कृतकृत्य कीन्ह दुहुँ भाईं ।
अब जो उचित सो कहिअ गोसाई ॥
verses.tr:
mohi kṛtakṛtya kīnh duhum̐ bhāīṃ
ab jo ucit so kahia gosāī

verses.sa:
कह मुनि सुनु नरनाथ प्रबीना ।
रहा बिबाहु चाप आधीना ॥
verses.tr:
kah muni sunu naranāth prabīnā
rahā bibāhu cāp ādhīnā

verses.sa:
टूटतहीं धनु भयउ बिबाहू ।
सुर नर नाग बिदित सब काहु ॥
verses.tr:
ṭūṭatahīṃ dhanu bhayau bibāhū
sur nar nāg bidit sab kāhu

verses.sa:
तदपि जाइ तुम्ह करहु अब जथा बंस ब्यवहारु ।
बूझि बिप्र कुलबृद्ध गुर बेद बिदित आचारु ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi jāi tumh karahu ab jathā baṃs byavahāru
būjhi bipr kulabṛddh gur bed bidit ācāru
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There was a tumultuous clash of instruments of music and a display of all things pleasant and auspicious. Troops of fair faced, bright-eyed maidens joined in song with voices of exquisite melody. Janak’s delight was beyond description, as that of a born beggar who has found a treasure; and Nita relieved of her fears, was as glad as a young partridge at the rising of the moon. The king made obeisance before Visvamitra, saying:—“ It is by my lord’s favour that Rama has broken the bow. These two brothers have gained me my purpose; tell me now, reverend sir, what is becomes me to do.” Said the saint:—‘Hearken, wise king; the marriage was dependent on the bow, and took effect directly the bow broke; this is well known to every one, whether god, man or Naga.
Still, go and perform according to family usage whatever practices are prescribed ia the Veda, after cansultation with the Brahmans and elders and your own guru;

sections.label: Doha 287
sections.name: हरित मनिन्ह के पत्र फल पदुमराग के फूल

verses.sa:
दूत अवधपुर पठवहु जाई ।
आनहिं नृप दसरथहि बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
dūt avadhapur paṭhavahu jāī
ānahiṃ nṛp dasarathahi bolāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मुदित राउ कहि भलेहिं कृपाला ।
पठए दूत बोलि तेहि काला ॥
verses.tr:
mudit rāu kahi bhalehiṃ kṛpālā
paṭhae dūt boli tehi kālā

verses.sa:
बहुरि महाजन सकल बोलाए ।
आइ सबन्हि सादर सिर नाए ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri mahājan sakal bolāe
āi sabanhi sādar sir nāe

verses.sa:
हाट बाट मंदिर सुरबासा ।
नगरु सँवारहु चारिहुँ पासा ॥
verses.tr:
hāṭ bāṭ maṃdir surabāsā
nagaru sam̐vārahu cārihum̐ pāsā

verses.sa:
हरषि चले निज निज गृह आए ।
पुनि परिचारक बोलि पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi cale nij nij gṛh āe
puni paricārak boli paṭhāe

verses.sa:
रचहु बिचित्र बितान बनाई ।
सिर धरि बचन चले सचु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
racahu bicitr bitān banāī
sir dhari bacan cale sacu pāī

verses.sa:
पठए बोलि गुनी तिन्ह नाना ।
जे बितान बिधि कुसल सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
paṭhae boli gunī tinh nānā
je bitān bidhi kusal sujānā

verses.sa:
बिधिहि बंदि तिन्ह कीन्ह अरंभा ।
बिरचे कनक कदलि के खंभा ॥
verses.tr:
bidhihi baṃdi tinh kīnh araṃbhā
birace kanak kadali ke khaṃbhā

verses.sa:
हरित मनिन्ह के पत्र फल पदुमराग के फूल ।
रचना देखि बिचित्र अति मनु बिरंचि कर भूल ॥
verses.tr:
harit maninh ke patr phal padumarāg ke phūl
racanā dekhi bicitr ati manu biraṃci kar bhūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: And despatch a herald to Avadh to invite king Dasarath” The princes responded gladly:—‘ Tis well, gracious sir,’ and sent a messenger to Avadh that very moment, Then he summoned all the burghers, who came every one of them, and humbly bowing before him received the order:— ‘Decorate all the markets and streets and temples and shrines in all four quarters of the city.” They returned in joy, each to his own house. Then he called up his own servants and instructed them:—“ Have all kinds of pavilions made and erected.” ‘They obeyed in all gladness and sent word to the different artificers who were skilful in the gonstruction of canopies and triumphal arches; and they, after invoking Brahma, set to work and made pillars of gold in the shape of plantain trees,
With leaves and fruit of emeralds and ruby flowers; such a gorgeous show that the Creator was quite disconcerted at the sight.

sections.label: Doha 288
sections.name: सौरभ पल्लव सुभग सुठि किए नीलमनि कोरि

verses.sa:
बेनि हरित मनिमय सब कीन्हे ।
सरल सपरब परहिं नहिं चीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
beni harit manimaya sab kīnhe
saral saparab parahiṃ nahiṃ cīnhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कनक कलित अहिबेल बनाई ।
लखि नहि परइ सपरन सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
kanak kalit ahibel banāī
lakhi nahi parai saparan suhāī

verses.sa:
तेहि के रचि पचि बंध बनाए ।
बिच बिच मुकता दाम सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
tehi ke raci paci baṃdh banāe
bic bic mukatā dām suhāe

verses.sa:
मानिक मरकत कुलिस पिरोजा ।
चीरि कोरि पचि रचे सरोजा ॥
verses.tr:
mānik marakat kulis pirojā
cīri kori paci race sarojā

verses.sa:
किए भृंग बहुरंग बिहंगा ।
गुंजहिं कूजहिं पवन प्रसंगा ॥
verses.tr:
kie bhṛṃg bahuraṃg bihaṃgā
guṃjahiṃ kūjahiṃ pavan prasaṃgā

verses.sa:
सुर प्रतिमा खंभन गढ़ी काढ़ी ।
मंगल द्रब्य लिएँ सब ठाढ़ी ॥
verses.tr:
sur pratimā khaṃbhan gar̤hī kār̤hī
maṃgal drabya liem̐ sab ṭhār̤hī

verses.sa:
चौंकें भाँति अनेक पुराईं ।
सिंधुर मनिमय सहज सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
cauṃkeṃ bhām̐ti anek purāīṃ
siṃdhur manimaya sahaj suhāī

verses.sa: सौरभ पल्लव सुभग सुठि किए नीलमनि कोरि ॥
verses.tr: saurabh pallav subhag suṭhi kie nīlamani kori
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: हेम बौर मरकत घवरि लसत पाटमय डोरि ॥
verses.tr: hem baur marakat ghavari lasat pāṭamaya ḍori

trans: The rods all encrusted with emeralds, and so like in form and colour!, that no one could tell them from real, with betel leaves fashioned in gold so bright and glistening that no one could look at them. Then they worked up the leaves into wreaths, with strings of beautiful pearls inserted here and there, and after much cutting and grav-ing and in laying made lotuses of mosaic with rubies, emeralds, diamonds and turqnoises. Bees, too, they made and birds of varied plumage, which buzzed and whistled in the rustling breeze; and on the pillars they sculptured figures of the gods all standing erect with things of good omen in their hands.
