Squares were drawn on the ground and filled in with diverse devices made of elephant pearls of exquisite beauty.
There were also made most lovely mango-boughs of graven sapphires with blossoms of gold, while clusters of emerald fruit glistened on silken cords.

sections.label: Doha 289
sections.name: बसइ नगर जेहि लच्छ करि कपट नारि बर बेषु

verses.sa:
रचे रुचिर बर बंदनिबारे ।
मनहुँ मनोभवँ फंद सँवारे ॥
verses.tr:
race rucir bar baṃdanibāre
manahum̐ manobhavam̐ phaṃd sam̐vāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मंगल कलस अनेक बनाए ।
ध्वज पताक पट चमर सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal kalas anek banāe
dhvaj patāk paṭ camar suhāe

verses.sa:
दीप मनोहर मनिमय नाना ।
जाइ न बरनि बिचित्र बिताना ॥
verses.tr:
dīp manohar manimaya nānā
jāi na barani bicitr bitānā

verses.sa:
जेहिं मंडप दुलहिनि बैदेही ।
सो बरनै असि मति कबि केही ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ maṃḍap dulahini baidehī
so baranai asi mati kabi kehī

verses.sa:
दूलहु रामु रूप गुन सागर ।
सो बितानु तिहुँ लोक उजागर ॥
verses.tr:
dūlahu rāmu rūp gun sāgar
so bitānu tihum̐ lok ujāgar

verses.sa:
जनक भवन कै सौभा जैसी ।
गृह गृह प्रति पुर देखिअ तैसी ॥
verses.tr:
janak bhavan kai saubhā jaisī
gṛh gṛh prati pur dekhia taisī

verses.sa:
जेहिं तेरहुति तेहि समय निहारी ।
तेहि लघु लगहिं भुवन दस चारी ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ terahuti tehi samaya nihārī
tehi laghu lagahiṃ bhuvan das cārī

verses.sa:
जो संपदा नीच गृह सोहा ।
सो बिलोकि सुरनायक मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
jo saṃpadā nīc gṛh sohā
so biloki suranāyak mohā

verses.sa: बसइ नगर जेहि लच्छ करि कपट नारि बर बेषु ॥
verses.tr: basai nagar jehi lacch kari kapaṭ nāri bar beṣu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: तेहि पुर कै सोभा कहत सकुचहिं सारद सेषु ॥
verses.tr: tehi pur kai sobhā kahat sakucahiṃ sārad seṣu

trans: Next they made charming festoons as it were Love’s own nooses and many golden vases with silken flags and banners and waving chauris and elegant lamps all studded with gems, It is impossible to describe the various pavilions and in particular the one intended for the royal bride; what poet would have the hardihood to attempt its desorip-tion while the canopy for Rama, the bridegroom, the
an elephant,’ another reading is sindar, ‘vermilion,’ but ct, since the chauks or squares, to which reference is ays marked out with some white Material, ordinaril

though in a king’s palace strings of pearls might be substituted, centre of all beauty and perfection, flashed its radiance through all three worlds. In every house throughout the city there was the same splendour as in Janak’s palace; any one who then saw Tirhut there was nothing in the fourteen spheres to compare with it, and the prosperous appearance of the very meanest house was enough to fascinate even the king of heaven.
For the magnificence of the city wherein dwelt the goddess Lakshmi, in disguise as a woman, was more than even Serade or Seshnag could tell.

sections.label: Doha 290
sections.name: कुसल प्रानप्रिय बंधु दोउ अहहिं कहहु केहिं देस

verses.sa:
पहुँचे दूत राम पुर पावन ।
हरषे नगर बिलोकि सुहावन ॥
verses.tr:
pahum̐ce dūt rām pur pāvan
haraṣe nagar biloki suhāvan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भूप द्वार तिन्ह खबरि जनाई ।
दसरथ नृप सुनि लिए बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp dvār tinh khabari janāī
dasarath nṛp suni lie bolāī

verses.sa:
करि प्रनामु तिन्ह पाती दीन्ही ।
मुदित महीप आपु उठि लीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranāmu tinh pātī dīnhī
mudit mahīp āpu uṭhi līnhī

verses.sa:
बारि बिलोचन बाचत पाँती ।
पुलक गात आई भरि छाती ॥
verses.tr:
bāri bilocan bācat pām̐tī
pulak gāt āī bhari chātī

verses.sa:
रामु लखनु उर कर बर चीठी ।
रहि गए कहत न खाटी मीठी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu lakhanu ur kar bar cīṭhī
rahi gae kahat na khāṭī mīṭhī

verses.sa:
पुनि धरि धीर पत्रिका बाँची ।
हरषी सभा बात सुनि साँची ॥
verses.tr:
puni dhari dhīr patrikā bām̐cī
haraṣī sabhā bāt suni sām̐cī

verses.sa:
खेलत रहे तहाँ सुधि पाई ।
आए भरतु सहित हित भाई ॥
verses.tr:
khelat rahe tahām̐ sudhi pāī
āe bharatu sahit hit bhāī

verses.sa:
पूछत अति सनेहँ सकुचाई ।
तात कहाँ तें पाती आई ॥
verses.tr:
pūchat ati saneham̐ sakucāī
tāt kahām̐ teṃ pātī āī

verses.sa:
कुसल प्रानप्रिय बंधु दोउ अहहिं कहहु केहिं देस ।
सुनि सनेह साने बचन बाची बहुरि नरेस ॥
verses.tr:
kusal prānapriya baṃdhu dou ahahiṃ kahahu kehiṃ des
suni saneh sāne bacan bācī bahuri nares
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the heralds arrived at Rama’s sacred birthplace, they rejoiced to see the beauty of the city. At the royal gate they sent in word, and King Dasarath at once summoned them to his presence. With a profound salutation they delivered the letter, and the king in his joy rose to receive it. As he read it his eyes filled with tears, his body quivered all over, and his heart seemed bursting. With Rama and Lakshman in his soul and their dear letter in his hand, he could not utter a word either good or bad. At last, taking courage, he read the letter, and all] the court rejoiced to hear the certain news. Now Bharat was playing about, and on hearing the tidings he, nay, the two brothers, came and with the utmost modesty and affection asked —‘' Father, where has the letter come {rom.
Is all well with my two dear brothers Tell me what country they are in.” On hearing these loving words the king again read the letter.

sections.label: Doha 291
sections.name: सुनहु महीपति मुकुट मनि तुम्ह सम धन्य न कोउ

verses.sa:
सुनि पाती पुलके दोउ भ्राता ।
अधिक सनेहु समात न गाता ॥
verses.tr:
suni pātī pulake dou bhrātā
adhik sanehu samāt na gātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रीति पुनीत भरत कै देखी ।
सकल सभाँ सुखु लहेउ बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
prīti punīt bharat kai dekhī
sakal sabhām̐ sukhu laheu biseṣī

verses.sa:
तब नृप दूत निकट बैठारे ।
मधुर मनोहर बचन उचारे ॥
verses.tr:
tab nṛp dūt nikaṭ baiṭhāre
madhur manohar bacan ucāre

verses.sa:
भैया कहहु कुसल दोउ बारे ।
तुम्ह नीकें निज नयन निहारे ॥
verses.tr:
bhaiyā kahahu kusal dou bāre
tumh nīkeṃ nij nayan nihāre

verses.sa:
स्यामल गौर धरें धनु भाथा ।
बय किसोर कौसिक मुनि साथा ॥
verses.tr:
syāmal gaur dhareṃ dhanu bhāthā
baya kisor kausik muni sāthā

verses.sa:
पहिचानहु तुम्ह कहहु सुभाऊ ।
प्रेम बिबस पुनि पुनि कह राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
pahicānahu tumh kahahu subhāū
prem bibas puni puni kah rāū

verses.sa:
जा दिन तें मुनि गए लवाई ।
तब तें आजु साँचि सुधि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
jā din teṃ muni gae lavāī
tab teṃ āju sām̐ci sudhi pāī

verses.sa:
कहहु बिदेह कवन बिधि जाने ।
सुनि प्रिय बचन दूत मुसकाने ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu bideh kavan bidhi jāne
suni priya bacan dūt musakāne

verses.sa:
सुनहु महीपति मुकुट मनि तुम्ह सम धन्य न कोउ ।
रामु लखनु जिन्ह के तनय बिस्व बिभूषन दोउ ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu mahīpati mukuṭ mani tumh sam dhanya na kou
rāmu lakhanu jinh ke tanaya bisv bibhūṣan dou
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing it the two brothers trembled all over with irrepressible joy, and the whole court was charmed to see Bharat’s holy devotion. Then the king seated the messengers close by him and said in sweet and winning tones:—‘' Tell me, friend are the two boys well Have you really seen them with your own eyes?” *“ One is dark, the other fair; both are equipt with bow and quiver,

and are of tender age, and with them is Saint Visvamitra.” Said the king again and again in his overpowering love:— You know them, it is clear; tell me now of their state; for from the day that saint took them away till now I have had no definite news of them. Tell me how Janak knew them.” At these fond words the messengers smiled:— Dohe 299.
“Hearken, O jewel and crown of kings; there is no man so blest as you, who have for sons Rama and Lakshman, who are the glory of the whole world.

sections.label: Doha 292
sections.name: तहाँ राम रघुबंस मनि सुनिअ महा महिपाल

verses.sa:
पूछन जोगु न तनय तुम्हारे ।
पुरुषसिंघ तिहु पुर उजिआरे ॥
verses.tr:
pūchan jogu na tanaya tumhāre
puruṣasiṃgh tihu pur ujiāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिन्ह के जस प्रताप कें आगे ।
ससि मलीन रबि सीतल लागे ॥
verses.tr:
jinh ke jas pratāp keṃ āge
sasi malīn rabi sītal lāge

verses.sa:
तिन्ह कहँ कहिअ नाथ किमि चीन्हे ।
देखिअ रबि कि दीप कर लीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
tinh kaham̐ kahia nāth kimi cīnhe
dekhia rabi ki dīp kar līnhe

verses.sa:
सीय स्वयंबर भूप अनेका ।
समिटे सुभट एक तें एका ॥
verses.tr:
sīya svayaṃbar bhūp anekā
samiṭe subhaṭ ek teṃ ekā

verses.sa:
संभु सरासनु काहुँ न टारा ।
हारे सकल बीर बरिआरा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu sarāsanu kāhum̐ na ṭārā
hāre sakal bīr bariārā

verses.sa:
तीनि लोक महँ जे भटमानी ।
सभ कै सकति संभु धनु भानी ॥
verses.tr:
tīni lok maham̐ je bhaṭamānī
sabh kai sakati saṃbhu dhanu bhānī

verses.sa:
सकइ उठाइ सरासुर मेरू ।
सोउ हियँ हारि गयउ करि फेरू ॥
verses.tr:
sakai uṭhāi sarāsur merū
sou hiyam̐ hāri gayau kari pherū

verses.sa:
जेहि कौतुक सिवसैलु उठावा ।
सोउ तेहि सभाँ पराभउ पावा ॥
verses.tr:
jehi kautuk sivasailu uṭhāvā
sou tehi sabhām̐ parābhau pāvā

verses.sa:
तहाँ राम रघुबंस मनि सुनिअ महा महिपाल ।
भंजेउ चाप प्रयास बिनु जिमि गज पंकज नाल ॥
verses.tr:
tahām̐ rām raghubaṃs mani sunia mahā mahipāl
bhaṃjeu cāp prayās binu jimi gaj paṃkaj nāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There is no need to ask your sons who they are; lionhearted heroes who irradiate the three spheres. Before their glory and renown the moon is dim and the sun is cold. Why say, my lord, how they were recognized? Does one take a lamp in his hand in order to see the sun? The countless kings at Sita’s marriage, great warriors as they were, all shrunk away one after the other; for not one of them could stir Sambhu’s bow, but all failed, those mighty princes. The power of the haughtiest champions in the three worlds was crushed by it. Though Bandsur could uproot Mount Meru, even he confessed himself beaten, and retired after pacing around it; and he who in sport uplifted Kailes (i. e., Ravan) was worsted in this assembly.
Then Rama, the jewel of Raghu’s line (hearken, O sovereign Lord) snapped the bow with as little effort as an elephant would put forth in breaking the stalk of a lotus.

sections.label: Doha 293
sections.name: तब उठि भूप बसिष्ठ कहुँ दीन्हि पत्रिका जाइ

verses.sa:
सुनि सरोष भृगुनायकु आए ।
बहुत भाँति तिन्ह आँखि देखाए ॥
verses.tr:
suni saroṣ bhṛgunāyaku āe
bahut bhām̐ti tinh ām̐khi dekhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि राम बलु निज धनु दीन्हा ।
करि बहु बिनय गवनु बन कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām balu nij dhanu dīnhā
kari bahu binaya gavanu ban kīnhā

verses.sa:
राजन रामु अतुलबल जैसें ।
तेज निधान लखनु पुनि तैसें ॥
verses.tr:
rājan rāmu atulabal jaiseṃ
tej nidhān lakhanu puni taiseṃ

verses.sa:
कंपहि भूप बिलोकत जाकें ।
जिमि गज हरि किसोर के ताकें ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃpahi bhūp bilokat jākeṃ
jimi gaj hari kisor ke tākeṃ

verses.sa:
देव देखि तव बालक दोऊ ।
अब न आँखि तर आवत कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
dev dekhi tav bālak doū
ab na ām̐khi tar āvat koū

verses.sa:
दूत बचन रचना प्रिय लागी ।
प्रेम प्रताप बीर रस पागी ॥
verses.tr:
dūt bacan racanā priya lāgī
prem pratāp bīr ras pāgī

verses.sa:
सभा समेत राउ अनुरागे ।
दूतन्ह देन निछावरि लागे ॥
verses.tr:
sabhā samet rāu anurāge
dūtanh den nichāvari lāge

verses.sa:
कहि अनीति ते मूदहिं काना ।
धरमु बिचारि सबहिं सुख माना ॥
verses.tr:
kahi anīti te mūdahiṃ kānā
dharamu bicāri sabahiṃ sukh mānā

verses.sa:
तब उठि भूप बसिष्ठ कहुँ दीन्हि पत्रिका जाइ ।
कथा सुनाई गुरहि सब सादर दूत बोलाइ ॥
verses.tr:
tab uṭhi bhūp basiṣṭh kahum̐ dīnhi patrikā jāi
kathā sunāī gurahi sab sādar dūt bolāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At these tidings Parasurem came in a fury, and after much brow-beating gave Rama his own bow to test his strength, then suppliantly withdrew to the woods. Nor is Rama more conspicuous in his unequalled might than is the all-glorious Lakshman, at sight of whom the kings tremble, as an elephant before a young lion. Nb one who sees your two sons, sir, can regard anything else on earth.” At this eloquent and affectionate speech of the heralds, so loving, grand and heroic, the king and his court were much moved, and began to offer them lavish gifts; but they closed their ears, crying,—“Not so, not so;”’ and all were charmed to see their integrity.
Then the king rose and went and gave the letter to Vasishta, and after relating all the circumstances to the guru sent courteously for the envoys.

sections.label: Doha 294
sections.name: चलहु बेगि सुनि गुर बचन भलेहिं नाथ सिरु नाइ

verses.sa:
सुनि बोले गुर अति सुखु पाई ।
पुन्य पुरुष कहुँ महि सुख छाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni bole gur ati sukhu pāī
punya puruṣ kahum̐ mahi sukh chāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिमि सरिता सागर महुँ जाहीं ।
जद्यपि ताहि कामना नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jimi saritā sāgar mahum̐ jāhīṃ
jadyapi tāhi kāmanā nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तिमि सुख संपति बिनहिं बोलाएँ ।
धरमसील पहिं जाहिं सुभाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
timi sukh saṃpati binahiṃ bolāem̐
dharamasīl pahiṃ jāhiṃ subhāem̐

verses.sa:
तुम्ह गुर बिप्र धेनु सुर सेबी ।
तसि पुनीत कौसल्या देबी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh gur bipr dhenu sur sebī
tasi punīt kausalyā debī

verses.sa:
सुकृती तुम्ह समान जग माहीं ।
भयउ न है कोउ होनेउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛtī tumh samān jag māhīṃ
bhayau na hai kou honeu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्ह ते अधिक पुन्य बड़ काकें ।
राजन राम सरिस सुत जाकें ॥
verses.tr:
tumh te adhik punya bar̤ kākeṃ
rājan rām saris sut jākeṃ

verses.sa:
बीर बिनीत धरम ब्रत धारी ।
गुन सागर बर बालक चारी ॥
verses.tr:
bīr binīt dharam brat dhārī
gun sāgar bar bālak cārī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह कहुँ सर्ब काल कल्याना ।
सजहु बरात बजाइ निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
tumh kahum̐ sarb kāl kalyānā
sajahu barāt bajāi nisānā

verses.sa:
चलहु बेगि सुनि गुर बचन भलेहिं नाथ सिरु नाइ ।
भूपति गवने भवन तब दूतन्ह बासु देवाइ ॥
verses.tr:
calahu begi suni gur bacan bhalehiṃ nāth siru nāi
bhūpati gavane bhavan tab dūtanh bāsu devāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After hearing them the saint was highly pleased aod suid:—“ To a good man the world ie full of happiness. As rivers run into the sea, though it has no greed for them, so joy and prosperity come unasked and of their own accord to a virtuous soul. Strict in the performance of your duties to your guru and to Brahmans and kine and gods, and your queen Kausalya no Less devout than yourself; you have no equals for piety in the whole world, either now or in the past, nor hereafter shall have. Who, O king, can be more blest than you, who have a son like Rama; nay, four heroic sons, all equally obedient, religious and amiable. Happy, indeed, are you for all time. Prepare the marriage procession to sound of masic.
Go quickly.” On hearing the saint's commands the king bowed in assent, and hastened to the palace, after assigning quarters to the heralds.

sections.label: Doha 295
sections.name: जाचक लिए हँकारि दीन्हि निछावरि कोटि बिधि

verses.sa:
राजा सबु रनिवास बोलाई ।
जनक पत्रिका बाचि सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
rājā sabu ranivās bolāī
janak patrikā bāci sunāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि संदेसु सकल हरषानीं ।
अपर कथा सब भूप बखानीं ॥
verses.tr:
suni saṃdesu sakal haraṣānīṃ
apar kathā sab bhūp bakhānīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रेम प्रफुल्लित राजहिं रानी ।
मनहुँ सिखिनि सुनि बारिद बनी ॥
verses.tr:
prem praphullit rājahiṃ rānī
manahum̐ sikhini suni bārid banī

verses.sa:
मुदित असीस देहिं गुरु नारीं ।
अति आनंद मगन महतारीं ॥
verses.tr:
mudit asīs dehiṃ guru nārīṃ
ati ānaṃd magan mahatārīṃ

verses.sa:
लेहिं परस्पर अति प्रिय पाती ।
हृदयँ लगाइ जुड़ावहिं छाती ॥
verses.tr:
lehiṃ paraspar ati priya pātī
hṛdayam̐ lagāi jur̤āvahiṃ chātī

verses.sa:
राम लखन कै कीरति करनी ।
बारहिं बार भूपबर बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
rām lakhan kai kīrati karanī
bārahiṃ bār bhūpabar baranī

verses.sa:
मुनि प्रसादु कहि द्वार सिधाए ।
रानिन्ह तब महिदेव बोलाए ॥
verses.tr:
muni prasādu kahi dvār sidhāe
rāninh tab mahidev bolāe

verses.sa:
दिए दान आनंद समेता ।
चले बिप्रबर आसिष देता ॥
verses.tr:
die dān ānaṃd sametā
cale biprabar āsiṣ detā

verses.sa:
जाचक लिए हँकारि दीन्हि निछावरि कोटि बिधि ।
चिरु जीवहुँ सुत चारि चक्रबर्ति दसरत्थ के ॥
verses.tr:
jācak lie ham̐kāri dīnhi nichāvari koṭi bidhi
ciru jīvahum̐ sut cāri cakrabarti dasaratth ke
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then he culled all the ladies of the seraglio and read aloud’to them Janak’s Jetter—all rejoiced greatly at the news. He then told them all the verbal message; and both himself and the queens were as enraptured with delight as a peacock at the sound of approaching rain. The guru’s wives in their joy invoked the blessings of heaven, and the queenmother was completely overwhelmed with ecstasy. They take the dear letter from one another, and press it to their bosom to cool as it were their burning heart. Again and again ere he turned to the door, the king repeated the glory and the exploits both of Rama and Lakshman, adding,— “It is all by the saint’s good favour.’ Then the ladies sent for the Brahmans and joyfully made them offerings, for which the holy men returned their blessings.
Next they called together the beggars and lavished every kind of gift upon them:—*‘! May the four sons of the Emperor Dasarath live for ever:”’

sections.label: Doha 296
sections.name: मंगलमय निज निज भवन लोगन्ह रचे बनाइ

verses.sa:
कहत चले पहिरें पट नाना ।
हरषि हने गहगहे निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
kahat cale pahireṃ paṭ nānā
haraṣi hane gahagahe nisānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
समाचार सब लोगन्ह पाए ।
लागे घर घर होने बधाए ॥
verses.tr:
samācār sab loganh pāe
lāge ghar ghar hone badhāe

verses.sa:
भुवन चारि दस भरा उछाहू ।
जनकसुता रघुबीर बिआहू ॥
verses.tr:
bhuvan cāri das bharā uchāhū
janakasutā raghubīr biāhū

verses.sa:
सुनि सुभ कथा लोग अनुरागे ।
मग गृह गलीं सँवारन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
suni subh kathā log anurāge
mag gṛh galīṃ sam̐vāran lāge

verses.sa:
जद्यपि अवध सदैव सुहावनि ।
राम पुरी मंगलमय पावनि ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi avadh sadaiv suhāvani
rām purī maṃgalamaya pāvani

verses.sa:
तदपि प्रीति कै प्रीति सुहाई ।
मंगल रचना रची बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi prīti kai prīti suhāī
maṃgal racanā racī banāī

verses.sa:
ध्वज पताक पट चामर चारु ।
छावा परम बिचित्र बजारू ॥
verses.tr:
dhvaj patāk paṭ cāmar cāru
chāvā param bicitr bajārū

verses.sa:
कनक कलस तोरन मनि जाला ।
हरद दूब दधि अच्छत माला ॥
verses.tr:
kanak kalas toran mani jālā
harad dūb dadhi acchat mālā

verses.sa:
मंगलमय निज निज भवन लोगन्ह रचे बनाइ ।
बीथीं सीचीं चतुरसम चौकें चारु पुराइ ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgalamaya nij nij bhavan loganh race banāi
bīthīṃ sīcīṃ caturasam caukeṃ cāru purāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Thus they shoutedas they left, attired in raiment of many colours. There was a jubilant clamour of music and in every house, as the news spread among the people, there were joyous congratulations. The fourteen spheres were fulfilled with delight at the marriage of Raghubir with the daughter of Janak. When they heard the glad tidings, the citizens were enraptured and began decorating the roads and houses and streets; for although Avadh in itself was a charming place, and clean and pure as being Rama's home, yet as the natural outcome of its love it garnished and adorned itself still more with festal decorations, Silken flags and banners and graceful chauris crested the gay bazar: and at every turn were golden jars and festoons of netted pearls and heaps of turmeric, dub grass, curds, rice, and garlands of flowers.
Every one decorated his house; the streets were duly

sections.label: Doha 297
sections.name: सोभा दसरथ भवन कइ को कबि बरनै पार

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ जूथ जूथ मिलि भामिनि ।
सजि नव सप्त सकल दुति दामिनि ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ jūth jūth mili bhāmini
saji nav sapt sakal duti dāmini
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिधुबदनीं मृग सावक लोचनि ।
निज सरुप रति मानु बिमोचनि ॥
verses.tr:
bidhubadanīṃ mṛg sāvak locani
nij sarup rati mānu bimocani

verses.sa:
गावहिं मंगल मंजुल बानीं ।
सुनिकल रव कलकंठि लजानीं ॥
verses.tr:
gāvahiṃ maṃgal maṃjul bānīṃ
sunikal rav kalakaṃṭhi lajānīṃ

verses.sa:
भूप भवन किमि जाइ बखाना ।
बिस्व बिमोहन रचेउ बिताना ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bhavan kimi jāi bakhānā
bisv bimohan raceu bitānā

verses.sa:
मंगल द्रब्य मनोहर नाना ।
राजत बाजत बिपुल निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal drabya manohar nānā
rājat bājat bipul nisānā

verses.sa:
कतहुँ बिरिद बंदी उच्चरहीं ।
कतहुँ बेद धुनि भूसुर करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
katahum̐ birid baṃdī uccarahīṃ
katahum̐ bed dhuni bhūsur karahīṃ

verses.sa:
गावहिं सुंदरि मंगल गीता ।
लै लै नामु रामु अरु सीता ॥
verses.tr:
gāvahiṃ suṃdari maṃgal gītā
lai lai nāmu rāmu aru sītā

verses.sa:
बहुत उछाहु भवनु अति थोरा ।
मानहुँ उमगि चला चहु ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
bahut uchāhu bhavanu ati thorā
mānahum̐ umagi calā cahu orā

verses.sa:
सोभा दसरथ भवन कइ को कबि बरनै पार ।
जहाँ सकल सुर सीस मनि राम लीन्ह अवतार ॥
verses.tr:
sobhā dasarath bhavan kai ko kabi baranai pār
jahām̐ sakal sur sīs mani rām līnh avatār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: watered, and every square was filled in with some tasteful design.

Troops of girls assembled at different places, who had practised all the sixteen kinds of female adornment brilliant -as the lightning, with moon-like face and fawn-like eyes, and beauty enough to rob even Love of his pride; singing auspicious strains with voice so melodious that the cuckoo was put to shame on hearing the sweet sound. How is the king’s palace to be described? The pavilion they set up
the following rhymes:—

omen was displayed, and every kind of music was heard. Here were rhapsodists chanting songs of praise; here were Brahmans muttering Vedic spells; while lovely women carolled joyous songs, ever dwelling on the names of Rama and Sita, The joy was so great that the palace was too small for it, and it overflowed on all four sides.
What poet can describe in full the magnificence of the palace of Dasarath, in which Rama, the glory of highest heaven, had taken birth?

sections.label: Doha 298
sections.name: छरे छबीले छयल सब सूर सुजान नबीन

verses.sa:
भूप भरत पुनि लिए बोलाई ।
हय गय स्यंदन साजहु जाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bharat puni lie bolāī
haya gaya syaṃdan sājahu jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चलहु बेगि रघुबीर बराता ।
सुनत पुलक पूरे दोउ भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
calahu begi raghubīr barātā
sunat pulak pūre dou bhrātā

verses.sa:
भरत सकल साहनी बोलाए ।
आयसु दीन्ह मुदित उठि धाए ॥
verses.tr:
bharat sakal sāhanī bolāe
āyasu dīnh mudit uṭhi dhāe

verses.sa:
रचि रुचि जीन तुरग तिन्ह साजे ।
बरन बरन बर बाजि बिराजे ॥
verses.tr:
raci ruci jīn turag tinh sāje
baran baran bar bāji birāje

verses.sa:
सुभग सकल सुठि चंचल करनी ।
अय इव जरत धरत पग धरनी ॥
verses.tr:
subhag sakal suṭhi caṃcal karanī
aya iv jarat dharat pag dharanī

verses.sa:
नाना जाति न जाहिं बखाने ।
निदरि पवनु जनु चहत उड़ाने ॥
verses.tr:
nānā jāti na jāhiṃ bakhāne
nidari pavanu janu cahat ur̤āne

verses.sa:
तिन्ह सब छयल भए असवारा ।
भरत सरिस बय राजकुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
tinh sab chayal bhae asavārā
bharat saris baya rājakumārā

verses.sa:
सब सुंदर सब भूषनधारी ।
कर सर चाप तून कटि भारी ॥
verses.tr:
sab suṃdar sab bhūṣanadhārī
kar sar cāp tūn kaṭi bhārī

verses.sa:
छरे छबीले छयल सब सूर सुजान नबीन ।
जुग पदचर असवार प्रति जे असिकला प्रबीन ॥
verses.tr:
chare chabīle chayal sab sūr sujān nabīn
jug padacar asavār prati je asikalā prabīn
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king next called Bharat:—“ Go and prepare horses and elephants and chariots and start at once for Raghubir’s marriage procession.” When they heard this order, both brothers were fultof excitment. Bharat sent for all the chief officers and issued his commands, and. they rose in joy and haste to perform them. First they made gorgeous trappings for the horses. Of different colours were the gallant steeds, but all well-proportioned and mettlesome, touching the ground with their feet as lightly as though it were red-hot iron. I cannot tell all the various breeds; they would race the wind and outstrip it. The princes who mounted them were all like Bharat, graceful, and gorgeously attired, with bow and arrows in hand and well-filled quiver at their side.
Slim, elegant and litbesome youths, bat expert warriors all; and with each knight were two footmen well skilled in sword-play.

sections.label: Doha 299
sections.name: चढ़ि चढ़ि रथ बाहेर नगर लागी जुरन बरात

verses.sa:
बाँधे बिरद बीर रन गाढ़े ।
निकसि भए पुर बाहेर ठाढ़े ॥
verses.tr:
bām̐dhe birad bīr ran gār̤he
nikasi bhae pur bāher ṭhār̤he
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फेरहिं चतुर तुरग गति नाना ।
हरषहिं सुनि सुनि पवन निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
pherahiṃ catur turag gati nānā
haraṣahiṃ suni suni pavan nisānā

verses.sa:
रथ सारथिन्ह बिचित्र बनाए ।
ध्वज पताक मनि भूषन लाए ॥
verses.tr:
rath sārathinh bicitr banāe
dhvaj patāk mani bhūṣan lāe

verses.sa:
चवँर चारु किंकिन धुनि करही ।
भानु जान सोभा अपहरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
cavam̐r cāru kiṃkin dhuni karahī
bhānu jān sobhā apaharahīṃ

verses.sa:
सावँकरन अगनित हय होते ।
ते तिन्ह रथन्ह सारथिन्ह जोते ॥
verses.tr:
sāvam̐karan aganit haya hote
te tinh rathanh sārathinh jote

verses.sa:
सुंदर सकल अलंकृत सोहे ।
जिन्हहि बिलोकत मुनि मन मोहे ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar sakal alaṃkṛt sohe
jinhahi bilokat muni man mohe

verses.sa:
जे जल चलहिं थलहि की नाई ।
टाप न बूड़ बेग अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
je jal calahiṃ thalahi kī nāī
ṭāp na būr̤ beg adhikāī

verses.sa:
अस्त्र सस्त्र सबु साजु बनाई ।
रथी सारथिन्ह लिए बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
astr sastr sabu sāju banāī
rathī sārathinh lie bolāī

verses.sa:
चढ़ि चढ़ि रथ बाहेर नगर लागी जुरन बरात ।
होत सगुन सुन्दर सबहि जो जेहि कारज जात ॥
verses.tr:
car̤hi car̤hi rath bāher nagar lāgī juran barāt
hot sagun sundar sabahi jo jehi kāraj jāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Full of high resolve, the warriors staunch io fight sallied forth and halted outside the city, putting their welltrained steeds through all their paces and rejoicing in the clash of tabor and drum. The charioteers had made their cars equally gorgeous with flags and banners and jewelled adornments, with elegant chauris and tinkling bells, so as to outdo in splendour the chariot of the Sun. Innumer able were the black-eared horses!, which the grooms yoked
1A horse to be fit for sacrifice must have black ears.

to these chariots, and all were so beautiful and richly caparisoned that even a saint would be enraptured at the sight; skimming the surface of the water like dry land nor, sinking even hoof-deep, so marvellous their speed. After completing their equipment of armour and weapons, the charioteers gave word to their masters.
Who all mounted in turn, and the procession began to form outside the city; all, whatever the object on which they were bent, were met by auspicious omens.

sections.label: Doha 300
sections.name: सब कें उर निर्भर हरषु पूरित पुलक सरीर

verses.sa:
कलित करिबरन्हि परीं अँबारीं ।
कहि न जाहिं जेहि भाँति सँवारीं ॥
verses.tr:
kalit karibaranhi parīṃ am̐bārīṃ
kahi na jāhiṃ jehi bhām̐ti sam̐vārīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चले मत्तगज घंट बिराजी ।
मनहुँ सुभग सावन घन राजी ॥
verses.tr:
cale mattagaj ghaṃṭ birājī
manahum̐ subhag sāvan ghan rājī

verses.sa:
बाहन अपर अनेक बिधाना ।
सिबिका सुभग सुखासन जाना ॥
verses.tr:
bāhan apar anek bidhānā
sibikā subhag sukhāsan jānā

verses.sa:
तिन्ह चढ़ि चले बिप्रबर बृन्दा ।
जनु तनु धरें सकल श्रुति छंदा ॥
verses.tr:
tinh car̤hi cale biprabar bṛndā
janu tanu dhareṃ sakal śruti chaṃdā

verses.sa:
मागध सूत बंदि गुनगायक ।
चले जान चढ़ि जो जेहि लायक ॥
verses.tr:
māgadh sūt baṃdi gunagāyak
cale jān car̤hi jo jehi lāyak

verses.sa:
बेसर ऊँट बृषभ बहु जाती ।
चले बस्तु भरि अगनित भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
besar ūm̐ṭ bṛṣabh bahu jātī
cale bastu bhari aganit bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
कोटिन्ह काँवरि चले कहारा ।
बिबिध बस्तु को बरनै पारा ॥
verses.tr:
koṭinh kām̐vari cale kahārā
bibidh bastu ko baranai pārā

verses.sa:
चले सकल सेवक समुदाई ।
निज निज साजु समाजु बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
cale sakal sevak samudāī
nij nij sāju samāju banāī

verses.sa:
सब कें उर निर्भर हरषु पूरित पुलक सरीर ।
कबहिं देखिबे नयन भरि रामु लखनू दोउ बीर ॥
verses.tr:
sab keṃ ur nirbhar haraṣu pūrit pulak sarīr
kabahiṃ dekhibe nayan bhari rāmu lakhanū dou bīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On the magnificent elephants were splendid canopies wrought in a manner beyond all description. As the mighty elephants moved, the bells clanged like the thunder from the clouds in the grateful month of S^wan. And other vehicles were there of many kinds; elegant pdlkis and sedans and cyaches, wherein were seated companies of noble Brahmans, incarnations as it were of all the hymns of the Veda. The genealogists and bards and minstrels and rhapsodists were mounted on other cars according to their rank; while mules and camels and oxen of every breed were laden with all sorts of baggage; there were also millions of porters with burdens slung across their shoulders; but who could enumerate such an_ endless
list of things and the crowd of servants, each with his own, set of appliances?
All were glad and fearless of heart, and were quivering with excitement in every limb, saying:—‘t When shall we feast our eyes with the sight of the two heroes, Rama and Lakshman?”

sections.label: Doha 301
sections.name: तेहिं रथ रुचिर बसिष्ठ कहुँ हरषि चढ़ाइ नरेसु

verses.sa:
गरजहिं गज घंटा धुनि घोरा ।
रथ रव बाजि हिंस चहु ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
garajahiṃ gaj ghaṃṭā dhuni ghorā
rath rav bāji hiṃs cahu orā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निदरि घनहि घुर्म्मरहिं निसाना ।
निज पराइ कछु सुनिअ न काना ॥
verses.tr:
nidari ghanahi ghurmmarahiṃ nisānā
nij parāi kachu sunia na kānā

verses.sa:
महा भीर भूपति के द्वारें ।
रज होइ जाइ पषान पबारें ॥
verses.tr:
mahā bhīr bhūpati ke dvāreṃ
raj hoi jāi paṣān pabāreṃ

verses.sa:
चढ़ी अटारिन्ह देखहिं नारीं ।
लिंएँ आरती मंगल थारी ॥
verses.tr:
car̤hī aṭārinh dekhahiṃ nārīṃ
liṃem̐ āratī maṃgal thārī

verses.sa:
गावहिं गीत मनोहर नाना ।
अति आनंदु न जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
gāvahiṃ gīt manohar nānā
ati ānaṃdu na jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
तब सुमंत्र दुइ स्पंदन साजी ।
जोते रबि हय निंदक बाजी ॥
verses.tr:
tab sumaṃtr dui spaṃdan sājī
jote rabi haya niṃdak bājī

verses.sa:
दोउ रथ रुचिर भूप पहिं आने ।
नहिं सारद पहिं जाहिं बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
dou rath rucir bhūp pahiṃ āne
nahiṃ sārad pahiṃ jāhiṃ bakhāne

verses.sa:
राज समाजु एक रथ साजा ।
दूसर तेज पुंज अति भ्राजा ॥
verses.tr:
rāj samāju ek rath sājā
dūsar tej puṃj ati bhrājā

verses.sa:
तेहिं रथ रुचिर बसिष्ठ कहुँ हरषि चढ़ाइ नरेसु ।
आपु चढ़ेउ स्पंदन सुमिरि हर गुर गौरि गनेसु ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ rath rucir basiṣṭh kahum̐ haraṣi car̤hāi naresu
āpu car̤heu spaṃdan sumiri har gur gauri ganesu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The elephants’ bells clanged with a fearful din; on all sides there was a creaking of wheels and a neighing of horses; the drums would drown a tempest’s roar, and no one could hear himself speak or any one else. At the king’s gate was such an enormous crowd that the stone pavement was all trodden into dust. Women mounted on the upper story viewed the sight, with festal torches and salvers in their hands, and carolled melodious songs in an ecstasy of joy beyond description. Then Sumanta made ready two chariots and yoked them with steeds that would outrun the horses of the Sun, and brought them in all their beauty before the king —not Sarada herself could do them justice —the one was for the royal retinue, but the other was still more splendid.
This the king first caused Vasishta to mount, and then himself ascended, with his thoughts fixed upon Hara, his guru, Gauri, and Ganes.

sections.label: Doha 302
sections.name: तुरग नचावहिं कुँअर बर अकनि मृदंग निसान

verses.sa:
सहित बसिष्ठ सोह नृप कैसें ।
सुर गुर संग पुरंदर जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
sahit basiṣṭh soh nṛp kaiseṃ
sur gur saṃg puraṃdar jaiseṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करि कुल रीति बेद बिधि राऊ ।
देखि सबहि सब भाँति बनाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kari kul rīti bed bidhi rāū
dekhi sabahi sab bhām̐ti banāū

verses.sa:
सुमिरि रामु गुर आयसु पाई ।
चले महीपति संख बजाई ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri rāmu gur āyasu pāī
cale mahīpati saṃkh bajāī

verses.sa:
हरषे बिबुध बिलोकि बराता ।
बरषहिं सुमन सुमंगल दाता ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe bibudh biloki barātā
baraṣahiṃ suman sumaṃgal dātā

verses.sa:
भयउ कोलाहल हय गय गाजे ।
ब्योम बरात बाजने बाजे ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau kolāhal haya gaya gāje
byom barāt bājane bāje

verses.sa:
सुर नर नारि सुमंगल गाई ।
सरस राग बाजहिं सहनाई ॥
verses.tr:
sur nar nāri sumaṃgal gāī
saras rāg bājahiṃ sahanāī

verses.sa:
घंट घंटि धुनि बरनि न जाहीं ।
सरव करहिं पाइक फहराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ghaṃṭ ghaṃṭi dhuni barani na jāhīṃ
sarav karahiṃ pāik phaharāhīṃ

verses.sa:
करहिं बिदूषक कौतुक नाना ।
हास कुसल कल गान सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ bidūṣak kautuk nānā
hās kusal kal gān sujānā

verses.sa: तुरग नचावहिं कुँअर बर अकनि मृदंग निसान ॥
verses.tr: turag nacāvahiṃ kum̐ar bar akani mṛdaṃg nisān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: नागर नट चितवहिं चकित डगहिं न ताल बँधान ॥
verses.tr: nāgar naṭ citavahiṃ cakit ḍagahiṃ na tāl bam̐dhān

trans: _ By Vasishta’s side the king shone forth us Purandara beside Vrihaspati. After performing every ceremony prescribed either by family usage or the Veda, and inspecting whatever had been done, he sallied forth to the blast of the conch shell, after obtaining the permission of his guru, and with his thoughts fixed on Rama. The beneficent gods rejoiced to see the procession and rained down flowers. There was a confused uproar, horses neighing, elephants trampeting, and drums beating, both in the sky and on the line of march. Women and goddesses alike broke out in songs of joy, while tuneful clarions played in sweet accord.

There was an indescribable clamour of bells, both great and small. The foot soldiers leaped and danced as if challenging attack; the jesters practised all kinds of buffoonery, provoking laughter with facetious songs.
Gallant youths make their steeds curvet to the measured beat of tabors and kettledrums; accomplished dancers note with surprise that they never make a step out of time.

sections.label: Doha 303
sections.name: मंगलमय कल्यानमय अभिमत फल दातार

verses.sa:
बनइ न बरनत बनी बराता ।
होहिं सगुन सुंदर सुभदाता ॥
verses.tr:
banai na baranat banī barātā
hohiṃ sagun suṃdar subhadātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चारा चाषु बाम दिसि लेई ।
मनहुँ सकल मंगल कहि देई ॥
verses.tr:
cārā cāṣu bām disi leī
manahum̐ sakal maṃgal kahi deī

verses.sa:
दाहिन काग सुखेत सुहावा ।
नकुल दरसु सब काहूँ पावा ॥
verses.tr:
dāhin kāg sukhet suhāvā
nakul darasu sab kāhūm̐ pāvā

verses.sa:
सानुकूल बह त्रिबिध बयारी ।
सघट सवाल आव बर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
sānukūl bah tribidh bayārī
saghaṭ savāl āv bar nārī

verses.sa:
लोवा फिरि फिरि दरसु देखावा ।
सुरभी सनमुख सिसुहि पिआवा ॥
verses.tr:
lovā phiri phiri darasu dekhāvā
surabhī sanamukh sisuhi piāvā

verses.sa:
मृगमाला फिरि दाहिनि आई ।
मंगल गन जनु दीन्हि देखाई ॥
verses.tr:
mṛgamālā phiri dāhini āī
maṃgal gan janu dīnhi dekhāī

verses.sa:
छेमकरी कह छेम बिसेषी ।
स्यामा बाम सुतरु पर देखी ॥
verses.tr:
chemakarī kah chem biseṣī
syāmā bām sutaru par dekhī

verses.sa:
सनमुख आयउ दधि अरु मीना ।
कर पुस्तक दुइ बिप्र प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
sanamukh āyau dadhi aru mīnā
kar pustak dui bipr prabīnā

verses.sa:
मंगलमय कल्यानमय अभिमत फल दातार ।
जनु सब साचे होन हित भए सगुन एक बार ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgalamaya kalyānamaya abhimat phal dātār
janu sab sāce hon hit bhae sagun ek bār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: But it is useless attempting to describe the procession. Every omen that occurred was fair and auspicious. On the left side a blue-necked jay was picking up food as if to announce the very highest good fortune; on a fair field on the right were a crow and a mangzs in the sight of all; a grateful breeze breathed soft and cool and fragrant; a woman was seen with a pitcher and child; a fox showed himself winding about; and in front a cow was suckling its calf; a herd of deer came out on the right, an indication of everything good; a Braehmani-kite promised all success; also a sydma bird perched on a tree to the left; a man was
‘met bearing curds and fish; and two learned Brahmans with books in ¢heir bands. Doha 310.
Every good and auspicious omen, and every bestower of desired reward, seemed all to have met at once as if to verify themselves.

sections.label: Doha 304
sections.name: आवत जानि बरात बर सुनि गहगहे निसान

verses.sa:
मंगल सगुन सुगम सब ताकें ।
सगुन ब्रह्म सुंदर सुत जाकें ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal sagun sugam sab tākeṃ
sagun brahm suṃdar sut jākeṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम सरिस बरु दुलहिनि सीता ।
समधी दसरथु जनकु पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
rām saris baru dulahini sītā
samadhī dasarathu janaku punītā

verses.sa:
सुनि अस ब्याहु सगुन सब नाचे ।
अब कीन्हे बिरंचि हम साँचे ॥
verses.tr:
suni as byāhu sagun sab nāce
ab kīnhe biraṃci ham sām̐ce

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि कीन्ह बरात पयाना ।
हय गय गाजहिं हने निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi kīnh barāt payānā
haya gaya gājahiṃ hane nisānā

verses.sa:
आवत जानि भानुकुल केतू ।
सरितन्हि जनक बँधाए सेतू ॥
verses.tr:
āvat jāni bhānukul ketū
saritanhi janak bam̐dhāe setū

verses.sa:
बीच बीच बर बास बनाए ।
सुरपुर सरिस संपदा छाए ॥
verses.tr:
bīc bīc bar bās banāe
surapur saris saṃpadā chāe

verses.sa:
असन सयन बर बसन सुहाए ।
पावहिं सब निज निज मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
asan sayan bar basan suhāe
pāvahiṃ sab nij nij man bhāe

verses.sa:
नित नूतन सुख लखि अनुकूले ।
सकल बरातिन्ह मंदिर भूले ॥
verses.tr:
nit nūtan sukh lakhi anukūle
sakal barātinh maṃdir bhūle

verses.sa:
आवत जानि बरात बर सुनि गहगहे निसान ।
सजि गज रथ पदचर तुरग लेन चले अगवान ॥
verses.tr:
āvat jāni barāt bar suni gahagahe nisān
saji gaj rath padacar turag len cale agavān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Every good and auspicious omen was ready at hand for him whose glorious son was the incarnate God,-a bridegroom like Rama, matched with such a bride as Sita, and with the pious Dasarath and Janak for the two parents. When they heard of the marriage, all the good omens began to dance and say:—' Now at last the Creator has really made us to be what our name denotes.” In this manner the procession set forth, with noise of horses and elephants and beat of drums. When Janak, the glory of the Solar race, heard of its approach, he had all the rivers bridged, and at different stages had convenient rest-houses erected, which vied in splendour with the city of heaven and were supplied everything that one could desire—beds, food and linen. Ever discovering some new charm, all the travellers forgot their own home.
When it was known that the procession was close at hand, and the beating of the drums was heard, a deputation went out to meet it, with elephants and chariots and foot.and horse.

sections.label: Doha 305
sections.name: हरषि परसपर मिलन हित कछुक चले बगमेल

verses.sa:
कनक कलस भरि कोपर थारा ।
भाजन ललित अनेक प्रकारा ॥
verses.tr:
kanak kalas bhari kopar thārā
bhājan lalit anek prakārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरे सुधासम सब पकवाने ।
नाना भाँति न जाहिं बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
bhare sudhāsam sab pakavāne
nānā bhām̐ti na jāhiṃ bakhāne

verses.sa:
फल अनेक बर बस्तु सुहाईं ।
हरषि भेंट हित भूप पठाईं ॥
verses.tr:
phal anek bar bastu suhāīṃ
haraṣi bheṃṭ hit bhūp paṭhāīṃ

verses.sa:
भूषन बसन महामनि नाना ।
खग मृग हय गय बहुबिधि जाना ॥
verses.tr:
bhūṣan basan mahāmani nānā
khag mṛg haya gaya bahubidhi jānā

verses.sa:
मंगल सगुन सुगंध सुहाए ।
बहुत भाँति महिपाल पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal sagun sugaṃdh suhāe
bahut bhām̐ti mahipāl paṭhāe

verses.sa:
दधि चिउरा उपहार अपारा ।
भरि भरि काँवरि चले कहारा ॥
verses.tr:
dadhi ciurā upahār apārā
bhari bhari kām̐vari cale kahārā

verses.sa:
अगवानन्ह जब दीखि बराता ।
उर आनंदु पुलक भर गाता ॥
verses.tr:
agavānanh jab dīkhi barātā
ur ānaṃdu pulak bhar gātā

verses.sa:
देखि बनाव सहित अगवाना ।
मुदित बरातिन्ह हने निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi banāv sahit agavānā
mudit barātinh hane nisānā

verses.sa:
हरषि परसपर मिलन हित कछुक चले बगमेल ।
जनु आनंद समुद्र दुइ मिलत बिहाइ सुबेल ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi parasapar milan hit kachuk cale bagamel
janu ānaṃd samudr dui milat bihāi subel
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Beautiful golden vases and trays and salvers and costly dishes of every kind, laden with cakes as sweet as nectar and of indescribable variety, with much luscious fruit.and, in short, everything of the best, did the king in his glad- Hess send as an offering. Ornaments, wearing apparel, jewels of all kinds, birds, deer, horses, elephants, carriages of every ‘description, wel!-omened spices, delicious perfumes, these, too, did the king send, and there was a train of porters with their baskets full of curds and parched rice and other light entremets. When the deputation saw the wedding guests, their soul was full of raptare
amd their body quivered with excitement; awhile the guests were no less charmed by the preparations made for their reception and beat their drums.
_ For a little they joined their ranks and marched in their Joy as one body for the sake of company; like oceans of bliss that had burst their bounds and come together.

sections.label: Doha 306
sections.name: सिधि सब सिय आयसु अकनि गईं जहाँ जनवास

verses.sa:
बरषि सुमन सुर सुंदरि गावहिं ।
मुदित देव दुंदुभीं बजावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣi suman sur suṃdari gāvahiṃ
mudit dev duṃdubhīṃ bajāvahiṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बस्तु सकल राखीं नृप आगें ।
बिनय कीन्ह तिन्ह अति अनुरागें ॥
verses.tr:
bastu sakal rākhīṃ nṛp āgeṃ
binaya kīnh tinh ati anurāgeṃ

verses.sa:
प्रेम समेत रायँ सबु लीन्हा ।
भै बकसीस जाचकन्हि दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
prem samet rāyam̐ sabu līnhā
bhai bakasīs jācakanhi dīnhā

verses.sa:
करि पूजा मान्यता बड़ाई ।
जनवासे कहुँ चले लवाई ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā mānyatā bar̤āī
janavāse kahum̐ cale lavāī

verses.sa:
बसन बिचित्र पाँवड़े परहीं ।
देखि धनहु धन मदु परिहरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
basan bicitr pām̐var̤e parahīṃ
dekhi dhanahu dhan madu pariharahīṃ

verses.sa:
अति सुंदर दीन्हेउ जनवासा ।
जहँ सब कहुँ सब भाँति सुपासा ॥
verses.tr:
ati suṃdar dīnheu janavāsā
jaham̐ sab kahum̐ sab bhām̐ti supāsā

verses.sa:
जानी सियँ बरात पुर आई ।
कछु निज महिमा प्रगटि जनाई ॥
verses.tr:
jānī siyam̐ barāt pur āī
kachu nij mahimā pragaṭi janāī

verses.sa:
हृदयँ सुमिरि सब सिद्धि बोलाई ।
भूप पहुनई करन पठाई ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ sumiri sab siddhi bolāī
bhūp pahunaī karan paṭhāī

verses.sa:
सिधि सब सिय आयसु अकनि गईं जहाँ जनवास ।
लिएँ संपदा सकल सुख सुरपुर भोग बिलास ॥
verses.tr:
sidhi sab siya āyasu akani gaīṃ jahām̐ janavās
liem̐ saṃpadā sakal sukh surapur bhog bilās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The nymphs of heaven rained down flowers and sang, the glad gods beat their drams. The offerings were all set out before the king, with a humble and affectionate address. The king graciously accepted them and bestowed them incharity on the poor. Then with religious honours and hymns of praise they conducted him to the guestchambers, The cloths spread as carpets for King Dasarath to tread upon were so gorgeous that the god of wealth on seeing them could boast no longer. The gods rained down flowers and shouted Victory, Victory. The apartments assigned were most beautiful and supplied with every kind of comfort. When Sita knew that the procession had arrived in the city, she manifested her greatness to a slight extent, and with thoughtful heart called up the eight Siddhis, or wonder-working spirits, and sent them to arrange for the king’s reception.
Obedient to her command, they repaired to the recep-tionhall, taking with them every kind of luxury and comfort and the joys and delights of heaven.

sections.label: Doha 307
sections.name: भूप बिलोके जबहिं मुनि आवत सुतन्ह समेत

verses.sa:
निज निज बास बिलोकि बराती ।
सुर सुख सकल सुलभ सब भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij bās biloki barātī
sur sukh sakal sulabh sab bhām̐tī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिभव भेद कछु कोउ न जाना ।
सकल जनक कर करहिं बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
bibhav bhed kachu kou na jānā
sakal janak kar karahiṃ bakhānā

verses.sa:
सिय महिमा रघुनायक जानी ।
हरषे हृदयँ हेतु पहिचानी ॥
verses.tr:
siya mahimā raghunāyak jānī
haraṣe hṛdayam̐ hetu pahicānī

verses.sa:
पितु आगमनु सुनत दोउ भाई ।
हृदयँ न अति आनंदु अमाई ॥
verses.tr:
pitu āgamanu sunat dou bhāī
hṛdayam̐ na ati ānaṃdu amāī

verses.sa:
सकुचन्ह कहि न सकत गुरु पाहीं ।
पितु दरसन लालचु मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sakucanh kahi na sakat guru pāhīṃ
pitu darasan lālacu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
बिस्वामित्र बिनय बड़ि देखी ।
उपजा उर संतोषु बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
bisvāmitr binaya bar̤i dekhī
upajā ur saṃtoṣu biseṣī

verses.sa:
हरषि बंधु दोउ हृदयँ लगाए ।
पुलक अंग अंबक जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi baṃdhu dou hṛdayam̐ lagāe
pulak aṃg aṃbak jal chāe

verses.sa:
चले जहाँ दसरथु जनवासे ।
मनहुँ सरोबर तकेउ पिआसे ॥
verses.tr:
cale jahām̐ dasarathu janavāse
manahum̐ sarobar takeu piāse

verses.sa:
भूप बिलोके जबहिं मुनि आवत सुतन्ह समेत ।
उठे हरषि सुखसिंधु महुँ चले थाह सी लेत ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp biloke jabahiṃ muni āvat sutanh samet
uṭhe haraṣi sukhasiṃdhu mahum̐ cale thāh sī let
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Each guest on going to see his apartment found ita veritable paradise; no, one, however, had an inkling of the mysterious power that had been exerted, but took it all as Janak's doing. Rama alone recognized the influence of Sita and rejoiced at this proof of her love. When the two brothers heard of their father’s arrival they could not -contain themselves for joy, but were too modest to speak to their guru, though they longed greatly to see their sire again. Visvamitra perceived their humility, which filled his soul with contentment, and took. the two brothers to his bosom with quivering body and eyes bedewed with tears. They went then to Dasarath’s mansion, like thirsting travellers who have spied a pool.
When the king saw the saint coming with the two boys, he rose in joy and advanced to meet them, like one who feels his footing in a deep flood of bliss.

sections.label: Doha 308
sections.name: पुरजन परिजन जातिजन जाचक मंत्री मीत

verses.sa:
मुनिहि दंडवत कीन्ह महीसा ।
बार बार पद रज धरि सीसा ॥
verses.tr:
munihi daṃḍavat kīnh mahīsā
bār bār pad raj dhari sīsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कौसिक राउ लिये उर लाई ।
कहि असीस पूछी कुसलाई ॥
verses.tr:
kausik rāu liye ur lāī
kahi asīs pūchī kusalāī

verses.sa:
पुनि दंडवत करत दोउ भाई ।
देखि नृपति उर सुखु न समाई ॥
verses.tr:
puni daṃḍavat karat dou bhāī
dekhi nṛpati ur sukhu na samāī

verses.sa:
सुत हियँ लाइ दुसह दुख मेटे ।
मृतक सरीर प्रान जनु भेंटे ॥
verses.tr:
sut hiyam̐ lāi dusah dukh meṭe
mṛtak sarīr prān janu bheṃṭe

verses.sa:
पुनि बसिष्ठ पद सिर तिन्ह नाए ।
प्रेम मुदित मुनिबर उर लाए ॥
verses.tr:
puni basiṣṭh pad sir tinh nāe
prem mudit munibar ur lāe

verses.sa:
बिप्र बृंद बंदे दुहुँ भाईं ।
मन भावती असीसें पाईं ॥
verses.tr:
bipr bṛṃd baṃde duhum̐ bhāīṃ
man bhāvatī asīseṃ pāīṃ

verses.sa:
भरत सहानुज कीन्ह प्रनामा ।
लिए उठाइ लाइ उर रामा ॥
verses.tr:
bharat sahānuj kīnh pranāmā
lie uṭhāi lāi ur rāmā

verses.sa:
हरषे लखन देखि दोउ भ्राता ।
मिले प्रेम परिपूरित गाता ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe lakhan dekhi dou bhrātā
mile prem paripūrit gātā

verses.sa:
पुरजन परिजन जातिजन जाचक मंत्री मीत ।
मिले जथाबिधि सबहि प्रभु परम कृपाल बिनीत ॥
verses.tr:
purajan parijan jātijan jācak maṃtrī mīt
mile jathābidhi sabahi prabhu param kṛpāl binīt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He prostrated himself before the saint, again and again sprinkling on his head the dust of his feet. Visvamitra took him to his bosom and blessed him and enquired after his welfare. Then the two brothers prostrated themselves. The king on seeing them could not contain himself for joy, but took his boys to his heart, and forgetting the intolerable pain, of the past seemed like a dead man restored to life. Then they bowed their head at Vasishtha’s feet, who also embraced them most affectionately; and in turn they saluted all the Brahmansand received their welcome blessings. ‘They greeted Bharat too and his younger brother Satrughna, who at once raised up Rama and embraced him, and no less rejoiced to see Lakshman again. Thus they all inet together with a display of the utmost affection.
The all merciful and gracious lord had an appropriate greeting for all, whether citizens, or attendants, or kinsmen, beggars, or ministers, or friends.

sections.label: Doha 309
sections.name: रामु सीय सोभा अवधि सुकृत अवधि दोउ राज

verses.sa:
रामहि देखि बरात जुड़ानी ।
प्रीति कि रीति न जाति बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi dekhi barāt jur̤ānī
prīti ki rīti na jāti bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नृप समीप सोहहिं सुत चारी ।
जनु धन धरमादिक तनुधारी ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp samīp sohahiṃ sut cārī
janu dhan dharamādik tanudhārī

verses.sa:
सुतन्ह समेत दसरथहि देखी ।
मुदित नगर नर नारि बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
sutanh samet dasarathahi dekhī
mudit nagar nar nāri biseṣī

verses.sa:
सुमन बरिसि सुर हनहिं निसाना ।
नाकनटीं नाचहिं करि गाना ॥
verses.tr:
suman barisi sur hanahiṃ nisānā
nākanaṭīṃ nācahiṃ kari gānā

verses.sa:
सतानंद अरु बिप्र सचिव गन ।
मागध सूत बिदुष बंदीजन ॥
verses.tr:
satānaṃd aru bipr saciv gan
māgadh sūt biduṣ baṃdījan

verses.sa:
सहित बरात राउ सनमाना ।
आयसु मागि फिरे अगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
sahit barāt rāu sanamānā
āyasu māgi phire agavānā

verses.sa:
प्रथम बरात लगन तें आई ।
तातें पुर प्रमोदु अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
pratham barāt lagan teṃ āī
tāteṃ pur pramodu adhikāī

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मानंदु लोग सब लहहीं ।
बढ़हुँ दिवस निसि बिधि सन कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
brahmānaṃdu log sab lahahīṃ
bar̤hahum̐ divas nisi bidhi san kahahīṃ

verses.sa:
रामु सीय सोभा अवधि सुकृत अवधि दोउ राज ।
जहँ जहँ पुरजन कहहिं अस मिलि नर नारि समाज ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu sīya sobhā avadhi sukṛt avadhi dou rāj
jaham̐ jaham̐ purajan kahahiṃ as mili nar nāri samāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At the sight of Rama the wedding guests were repaid for their toilsome journey, and their demonstrations of love were beyond all telling. Beside their royal father the four boys seemed as incarnations of the four great ends of life. All the people of the city were delighted beyond measure at the sight of Dasarath and his sons; the gods rained down flowers and beat their drums; the nymphs of heaven danced and sang. Satdnand with the Brahmans and ministers of state and the rhapsodists and bards and players and minstrels, who had come in deputation, after duly reverencing the king and the marriage guests, received permission to return. The whole city was exceedingly delighted that the procession had come before the day fixed for the wedding, and
were supremely happy, praying God to lengthen the days and nights:—
“Rama and Sita are the perfection of beauty, and the two kings the perfection of virtue;” thus would say all the people of the city whenever they happened to meet:—

sections.label: Doha 310
sections.name: बारहिं बार सनेह बस जनक बोलाउब सीय

verses.sa:
जनक सुकृत मूरति बैदेही ।
दसरथ सुकृत रामु धरें देही ॥
verses.tr:
janak sukṛt mūrati baidehī
dasarath sukṛt rāmu dhareṃ dehī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
इन्ह सम काँहु न सिव अवराधे ।
काहिं न इन्ह समान फल लाधे ॥
verses.tr:
inh sam kām̐hu na siv avarādhe
kāhiṃ na inh samān phal lādhe

verses.sa:
इन्ह सम कोउ न भयउ जग माहीं ।
है नहिं कतहूँ होनेउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
inh sam kou na bhayau jag māhīṃ
hai nahiṃ katahūm̐ honeu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
हम सब सकल सुकृत कै रासी ।
भए जग जनमि जनकपुर बासी ॥
verses.tr:
ham sab sakal sukṛt kai rāsī
bhae jag janami janakapur bāsī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह जानकी राम छबि देखी ।
को सुकृती हम सरिस बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
jinh jānakī rām chabi dekhī
ko sukṛtī ham saris biseṣī

verses.sa:
पुनि देखब रघुबीर बिआहू ।
लेब भली बिधि लोचन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
puni dekhab raghubīr biāhū
leb bhalī bidhi locan lāhū

verses.sa:
कहहिं परसपर कोकिलबयनीं ।
एहि बिआहँ बड़ लाभु सुनयनीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ parasapar kokilabayanīṃ
ehi biāham̐ bar̤ lābhu sunayanīṃ

verses.sa:
बड़ें भाग बिधि बात बनाई ।
नयन अतिथि होइहहिं दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤eṃ bhāg bidhi bāt banāī
nayan atithi hoihahiṃ dou bhāī

verses.sa:
बारहिं बार सनेह बस जनक बोलाउब सीय ।
लेन आइहहिं बंधु दोउ कोटि काम कमनीय ॥
verses.tr:
bārahiṃ bār saneh bas janak bolāub sīya
len āihahiṃ baṃdhu dou koṭi kām kamanīya
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Sita is the incarnation of Janak’s merit and Rama of Dasarath’s: no one has equalled them in devotion to Sita, nor has any one obtained such a reward as they have. And all we must be everything that is good, seeing that we have been born into the world as Janak’s citizens and have beheld the beauty of Janaki and Rama; who is so super-latively blest as we ure and we have yet to see Rama's wedding, of all sights the best worth seeing.’ So, too, sweet-voiced maidens whispered ta one another:—* This marriage, my dear, will be a great treat. God has brought ° about un event of signal felicity in lodging those two brothers in the guest-chambers of our eyes.
Many and many atime will Janak lovingly send for Sita, and the two brothers, beautiful as a myriad Loves, will come to fetch her. —

sections.label: Doha 311
sections.name: कहहिं परस्पर नारि बारि बिलोचन पुलक तन

verses.sa:
बिबिध भाँति होइहि पहुनाई ।
प्रिय न काहि अस सासुर माई ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bhām̐ti hoihi pahunāī
priya na kāhi as sāsur māī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब तब राम लखनहि निहारी ।
होइहहिं सब पुर लोग सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
tab tab rām lakhanahi nihārī
hoihahiṃ sab pur log sukhārī

verses.sa:
सखि जस राम लखनकर जोटा ।
तैसेइ भूप संग दुइ ढोटा ॥
verses.tr:
sakhi jas rām lakhanakar joṭā
taisei bhūp saṃg dui ḍhoṭā

verses.sa:
स्याम गौर सब अंग सुहाए ।
ते सब कहहिं देखि जे आए ॥
verses.tr:
syām gaur sab aṃg suhāe
te sab kahahiṃ dekhi je āe

verses.sa:
कहा एक मैं आजु निहारे ।
जनु बिरंचि निज हाथ सँवारे ॥
verses.tr:
kahā ek maiṃ āju nihāre
janu biraṃci nij hāth sam̐vāre

verses.sa:
भरतु रामही की अनुहारी ।
सहसा लखि न सकहिं नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu rāmahī kī anuhārī
sahasā lakhi na sakahiṃ nar nārī

verses.sa:
लखनु सत्रुसूदनु एकरूपा ।
नख सिख ते सब अंग अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
lakhanu satrusūdanu ekarūpā
nakh sikh te sab aṃg anūpā

verses.sa:
मन भावहिं मुख बरनि न जाहीं ।
उपमा कहुँ त्रिभुवन कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
man bhāvahiṃ mukh barani na jāhīṃ
upamā kahum̐ tribhuvan kou nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
उपमा न कोउ कह दास तुलसी कतहुँ कबि कोबिद कहैं ।
बल बिनय बिद्या सील सोभा सिंधु इन्ह से एइ अहैं ॥
verses.tr:
upamā na kou kah dās tulasī katahum̐ kabi kobid kahaiṃ
bal binaya bidyā sīl sobhā siṃdhu inh se ei ahaiṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: पुर नारि सकल पसारि अंचल बिधिहि बचन सुनावहीं ॥
verses.tr: pur nāri sakal pasāri aṃcal bidhihi bacan sunāvahīṃ

verses.sa: ब्याहिअहुँ चारिउ भाइ एहिं पुर हम सुमंगल गावहीं ॥
verses.tr: byāhiahum̐ cāriu bhāi ehiṃ pur ham sumaṃgal gāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
कहहिं परस्पर नारि बारि बिलोचन पुलक तन ।
सखि सबु करब पुरारि पुन्य पयोनिधि भूप दोउ ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ paraspar nāri bāri bilocan pulak tan
sakhi sabu karab purāri punya payonidhi bhūp dou
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There will be all kinds of hospitable entertainments; who, dear girl, would not rejoice in such a father-in-law? Every one in the place will be delighted at the sight of Rama and Lakshman; and now two other lads, my friends, have come with the king, who are a match even for them; one dark, the other fair, but beautiful in every limb, so says every one who has seen them.” Said one in reply: “I saw them to-day, and thought God must have made them with his own hands. Hama and Bharat are so much alike that neither man nor woman could without looking close tell one from the other; while again Lakshman and Satrughna are also one in appearance, perfectly beautiful in every limb from head to foot; the soul would fain express its rapture, but language fails it, for there is nothing comparable to them in all the three spheres of creation.
No poet, however ingenious, says Tulsi Das, could find aught comparable to them; for so unbounded is their

strength, their courtesy, their knowledge, their amiability and their beauty, that they have no peers but themselves. All the women in the city, spreading out their garments, made prayer to Brahma, —“ May all four brothers be married here, and may we sing their wedding song.”
Said the damsels tv one another with streaming eyes and quivering body:—‘ Friends, the two kings are of such boundless religious merit that for their sake Mahadeva will bring it all about.”

sections.label: Doha 312
sections.name: धेनुधूरि बेला बिमल सकल सुमंगल मूल

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सकल मनोरथ करहीं ।
आनँद उमगि उमगि उर भरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sakal manorath karahīṃ
ānam̐d umagi umagi ur bharahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जे नृप सीय स्वयंबर आए ।
देखि बंधु सब तिन्ह सुख पाए ॥
verses.tr:
je nṛp sīya svayaṃbar āe
dekhi baṃdhu sab tinh sukh pāe

verses.sa:
कहत राम जसु बिसद बिसाला ।
निज निज भवन गए महिपाला ॥
verses.tr:
kahat rām jasu bisad bisālā
nij nij bhavan gae mahipālā

verses.sa:
गए बीति कुछ दिन एहि भाँती ।
प्रमुदित पुरजन सकल बराती ॥
verses.tr:
gae bīti kuch din ehi bhām̐tī
pramudit purajan sakal barātī

verses.sa:
मंगल मूल लगन दिनु आवा ।
हिम रितु अगहनु मासु सुहावा ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal mūl lagan dinu āvā
him ritu agahanu māsu suhāvā

verses.sa:
ग्रह तिथि नखतु जोगु बर बारू ।
लगन सोधि बिधि कीन्ह बिचारू ॥
verses.tr:
grah tithi nakhatu jogu bar bārū
lagan sodhi bidhi kīnh bicārū

verses.sa:
पठै दीन्हि नारद सन सोई ।
गनी जनक के गनकन्ह जोई ॥
verses.tr:
paṭhai dīnhi nārad san soī
ganī janak ke ganakanh joī

verses.sa:
सुनी सकल लोगन्ह यह बाता ।
कहहिं जोतिषी आहिं बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
sunī sakal loganh yah bātā
kahahiṃ jotiṣī āhiṃ bidhātā

verses.sa:
धेनुधूरि बेला बिमल सकल सुमंगल मूल ।
बिप्रन्ह कहेउ बिदेह सन जानि सगुन अनुकुल ॥
verses.tr:
dhenudhūri belā bimal sakal sumaṃgal mūl
bipranh kaheu bideh san jāni sagun anukul
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In like manner they all expressed their desire, while their full heart overflowed with rapture. When the kings, who had come as Sita’s suitors, saw the brothers, they all rejoiced and returned to their own homes, extolling Rama’s high and spotless fame. In this fashion several days were spent, to the joy alike of citizens and guests. At length the auspicious day arrived, in the cold season, in the pleasant month of Aghan. The Creator himself had carefully fixed the date, when the sign of the zodiac, the age of the moon, the conjunction of the stars and the day of the week were one and all propitious. Of this he sent word through Narad, and it was the very same that Janak’s wise men had calculated. All the people on hearing this fact declared their astrologers to be very gods,
It was towards sunset!, the clearest and most delightful hour of the day, that the Brahmans apprized Videha's king that the auspicious time had arrived.

sections.label: Doha 313
sections.name: भाग्य बिभव अवधेस कर देखि देव ब्रह्मादि

verses.sa:
उपरोहितहि कहेउ नरनाहा ।
अब बिलंब कर कारनु काहा ॥
verses.tr:
uparohitahi kaheu naranāhā
ab bilaṃb kar kāranu kāhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सतानंद तब सचिव बोलाए ।
मंगल सकल साजि सब ल्याए ॥
verses.tr:
satānaṃd tab saciv bolāe
maṃgal sakal sāji sab lyāe

verses.sa:
संख निसान पनव बहु बाजे ।
मंगल कलस सगुन सुभ साजे ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkh nisān panav bahu bāje
maṃgal kalas sagun subh sāje

verses.sa:
सुभग सुआसिनि गावहिं गीता ।
करहिं बेद धुनि बिप्र पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
subhag suāsini gāvahiṃ gītā
karahiṃ bed dhuni bipr punītā

verses.sa:
लेन चले सादर एहि भाँती ।
गए जहाँ जनवास बराती ॥
verses.tr:
len cale sādar ehi bhām̐tī
gae jahām̐ janavās barātī

verses.sa:
कोसलपति कर देखि समाजू ।
अति लघु लाग तिन्हहि सुरराजू ॥
verses.tr:
kosalapati kar dekhi samājū
ati laghu lāg tinhahi surarājū

verses.sa:
भयउ समउ अब धारिअ पाऊ ।
यह सुनि परा निसानहिं घाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau samau ab dhāria pāū
yah suni parā nisānahiṃ ghāū

verses.sa:
गुरहि पूछि करि कुल बिधि राजा ।
चले संग मुनि साधु समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
gurahi pūchi kari kul bidhi rājā
cale saṃg muni sādhu samājā

verses.sa:
भाग्य बिभव अवधेस कर देखि देव ब्रह्मादि ।
लगे सराहन सहस मुख जानि जनम निज बादि ॥
verses.tr:
bhāgya bibhav avadhes kar dekhi dev brahmādi
lage sarāhan sahas mukh jāni janam nij bādi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The monarch cried to the family priest:—‘What is now the cause of delay? At once Sat^nand summoned the ministers, who all came hearing festal vases: conches, drums, and tabors sounded; all decked their vases in auspicious wise: graceful damsels sang songs, and holy Brahmans murmured Vedic texts. In this manner they went with all ceremony to the visitors’ camp, and on beholding the king of Kosala’s retinue it seemed to them that Indra was of much less glory. ‘“ The hour has come, be pleased to start.” At this the drums gave a thundering beat. After consulting his guru and performing the family rites, the king and the saint sallied forth with all their host.
Brahma and all the other gods, on beholding the pomp and magnificence of Avadh’s king, began to extol him with a thousand tongues and declare their own life to have been wasted.

sections.label: Doha 314
sections.name: सिवँ समुझाए देव सब जनि आचरज भुलाहु

verses.sa:
सुरन्ह सुमंगल अवसरु जाना ।
बरषहिं सुमन बजाइ निसाना ॥
verses.tr:
suranh sumaṃgal avasaru jānā
baraṣahiṃ suman bajāi nisānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सिव ब्रह्मादिक बिबुध बरूथा ।
चढ़े बिमानन्हि नाना जूथा ॥
verses.tr:
siv brahmādik bibudh barūthā
car̤he bimānanhi nānā jūthā

verses.sa:
प्रेम पुलक तन हृदयँ उछाहू ।
चले बिलोकन राम बिआहू ॥
verses.tr:
prem pulak tan hṛdayam̐ uchāhū
cale bilokan rām biāhū

verses.sa:
देखि जनकपुरु सुर अनुरागे ।
निज निज लोक सबहिं लघु लागे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi janakapuru sur anurāge
nij nij lok sabahiṃ laghu lāge

verses.sa:
चितवहिं चकित बिचित्र बिताना ।
रचना सकल अलौकिक नाना ॥
verses.tr:
citavahiṃ cakit bicitr bitānā
racanā sakal alaukik nānā

verses.sa:
नगर नारि नर रूप निधाना ।
सुघर सुधरम सुसील सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
nagar nāri nar rūp nidhānā
sughar sudharam susīl sujānā

verses.sa:
तिन्हहि देखि सब सुर सुरनारीं ।
भए नखत जनु बिधु उजिआरीं ॥
verses.tr:
tinhahi dekhi sab sur suranārīṃ
bhae nakhat janu bidhu ujiārīṃ

verses.sa:
बिधिहि भयह आचरजु बिसेषी ।
निज करनी कछु कतहुँ न देखी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhihi bhayah ācaraju biseṣī
nij karanī kachu katahum̐ na dekhī

verses.sa:
सिवँ समुझाए देव सब जनि आचरज भुलाहु ।
हृदयँ बिचारहु धीर धरि सिय रघुबीर बिआहु ॥
verses.tr:
sivam̐ samujhāe dev sab jani ācaraj bhulāhu
hṛdayam̐ bicārahu dhīr dhari siya raghubīr biāhu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Seeing the auspiciousness of the time, the deities rained down flowers and beat their drums. Siva and Brahma and all the host of heaven mounted their chariots and came in crowds to see. Rama’s wedding, their heart and every limb throbbing and quivering with excess of love. They were so charmed with Janak’s capital that their own realms seemed to them as nothing worth. They gaze with astonishment at the pavilions and all the marvellous decorations; at the men and women so beautiful and well-formed, so good and amiable and intelligent, before whom all the gods and goddesses seemed like the stars at the rising of the full moon. Above all was Brahma astounded at finding his own handiwork nowhere.
But Siva admonished them all:—“ Lo not give way to such surprise; recover yourselves and reflect that this is the marriage of Sita and Raghubir.

sections.label: Doha 315
sections.name: राम रूपु नख सिख सुभग बारहिं बार निहारि

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कर नामु लेत जग माहीं ।
सकल अमंगल मूल नसाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jinh kar nāmu let jag māhīṃ
sakal amaṃgal mūl nasāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करतल होहिं पदारथ चारी ।
तेइ सिय रामु कहेउ कामारी ॥
verses.tr:
karatal hohiṃ padārath cārī
tei siya rāmu kaheu kāmārī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि संभु सुरन्ह समुझावा ।
पुनि आगें बर बसह चलावा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi saṃbhu suranh samujhāvā
puni āgeṃ bar basah calāvā

verses.sa:
देवन्ह देखे दसरथु जाता ।
महामोद मन पुलकित गाता ॥
verses.tr:
devanh dekhe dasarathu jātā
mahāmod man pulakit gātā

verses.sa:
साधु समाज संग महिदेवा ।
जनु तनु धरें करहिं सुख सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu samāj saṃg mahidevā
janu tanu dhareṃ karahiṃ sukh sevā

verses.sa:
सोहत साथ सुभग सुत चारी ।
जनु अपबरग सकल तनुधारी ॥
verses.tr:
sohat sāth subhag sut cārī
janu apabarag sakal tanudhārī

verses.sa:
मरकत कनक बरन बर जोरी ।
देखि सुरन्ह भै प्रीति न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
marakat kanak baran bar jorī
dekhi suranh bhai prīti na thorī

verses.sa:
पुनि रामहि बिलोकि हियँ हरषे ।
नृपहि सराहि सुमन तिन्ह बरषे ॥
verses.tr:
puni rāmahi biloki hiyam̐ haraṣe
nṛpahi sarāhi suman tinh baraṣe

verses.sa:
राम रूपु नख सिख सुभग बारहिं बार निहारि ।
पुलक गात लोचन सजल उमा समेत पुरारि ॥
verses.tr:
rām rūpu nakh sikh subhag bārahiṃ bār nihāri
pulak gāt locan sajal umā samet purāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The mere mention of whose name destroys all that is evil in the world; in whose hand are the four great ends of human life; such are Sita and Rama, says Love's destroyer.” When Sambhu had thus admonished the gods, he again urged on his noble ball. Beholding Dasarath march forth, their soul was full of joy and -their limbs trembled. The crowd of saints and Br&ebmans who accompanied him seemed like incarnate gods ministering to him. In the midst shone forth the beautiful boys as it were final Beatitude manifested in its four pbases. As they gazed on the pair, of golden and sapphire hue, the gods were moved with violent love, and especially were they delighted at the sight of Rama, and glorified the king and rained down flowers.
Again and again as Umeand Mahadeva fixed their gaze upon Rama,. all-perfect in beauty from head to foot, their body trembled and their eyes filled with tears.

sections.label: Doha 316
sections.name: प्रभु मनसहिं लयलीन मनु चलत बाजि छबि पाव

verses.sa:
केकि कंठ दुति स्यामल अंगा ।
तड़ित बिनिंदक बसन सुरंगा ॥
verses.tr:
keki kaṃṭh duti syāmal aṃgā
tar̤it biniṃdak basan suraṃgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्याह बिभूषन बिबिध बनाए ।
मंगल सब सब भाँति सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
byāh bibhūṣan bibidh banāe
maṃgal sab sab bhām̐ti suhāe

verses.sa:
सरद बिमल बिधु बदनु सुहावन ।
नयन नवल राजीव लजावन ॥
verses.tr:
sarad bimal bidhu badanu suhāvan
nayan naval rājīv lajāvan

verses.sa:
सकल अलौकिक सुंदरताई ।
कहि न जाइ मनहीं मन भाई ॥
verses.tr:
sakal alaukik suṃdaratāī
kahi na jāi manahīṃ man bhāī

verses.sa:
बंधु मनोहर सोहहिं संगा ।
जात नचावत चपल तुरंगा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhu manohar sohahiṃ saṃgā
jāt nacāvat capal turaṃgā

verses.sa:
राजकुअँर बर बाजि देखावहिं ।
बंस प्रसंसक बिरिद सुनावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
rājakuam̐r bar bāji dekhāvahiṃ
baṃs prasaṃsak birid sunāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
जेहि तुरंग पर रामु बिराजे ।
गति बिलोकि खगनायकु लाजे ॥
verses.tr:
jehi turaṃg par rāmu birāje
gati biloki khaganāyaku lāje

verses.sa:
कहि न जाइ सब भाँति सुहावा ।
बाजि बेषु जनु काम बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na jāi sab bhām̐ti suhāvā
bāji beṣu janu kām banāvā

verses.sa:
जनु बाजि बेषु बनाइ मनसिजु राम हित अति सोहई ।
आपनें बय बल रूप गुन गति सकल भुवन बिमोहई ॥
verses.tr:
janu bāji beṣu banāi manasiju rām hit ati sohaī
āpaneṃ baya bal rūp gun gati sakal bhuvan bimohaī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जगमगत जीनु जराव जोति सुमोति मनि मानिक लगे ।
किंकिनि ललाम लगामु ललित बिलोकि सुर नर मुनि ठगे ॥
verses.tr:
jagamagat jīnu jarāv joti sumoti mani mānik lage
kiṃkini lalām lagāmu lalit biloki sur nar muni ṭhage

verses.sa:
प्रभु मनसहिं लयलीन मनु चलत बाजि छबि पाव ।
भूषित उड़गन तड़ित घनु जनु बर बरहि नचाव ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu manasahiṃ layalīn manu calat bāji chabi pāv
bhūṣit ur̤agan tar̤it ghanu janu bar barahi nacāv
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On his body, dark asa peacock’s glistening neck his bright raiment outshone the lightning; his wedding adornments of every kind were most exquisitely fashioned: his face more lustrous than a cloudless autumn moon; his eyes more brilliant than the lotus; his beauty, in short, so marvellous that no words can describe how it moved the soul. By his side shone forth his charming brother, making his mettlesome steed plunge and bound on the way, as also did all the attendant princes; while the family birds recited the glories of their line. As the king of the birds noted the action of the horse that Rama bestrode, he blush-ed for shame; for its beauty was beyond all telling, as it might be Kamadeva himself in equine disguise.

As though Kamadeva himself in his love for Rama had assumed an equine disguise, of such resplendent beauty as to charm all creation with his youth and vigour and form and points and paces. A saddle flashed its splendours on his back, thick set with pearls and rubies; bridle too and band gleamed bright with jewels that dazzled the gaze of men, saints and gods.

Obedient in every movement to the will of its lord, the gallant steed was as beautiful as a peacock, that dances in response to a thunder-cloud, whose dark mass is irradiated by the stars of heaven and the fitful lightniag.

sections.label: Doha 317
sections.name: सजि आरती अनेक बिधि मंगल सकल सँवारि

verses.sa:
जेहिं बर बाजि रामु असवारा ।
तेहि सारदउ न बरनै पारा ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ bar bāji rāmu asavārā
tehi sāradau na baranai pārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
संकरु राम रूप अनुरागे ।
नयन पंचदस अति प्रिय लागे ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkaru rām rūp anurāge
nayan paṃcadas ati priya lāge

verses.sa:
हरि हित सहित रामु जब जोहे ।
रमा समेत रमापति मोहे ॥
verses.tr:
hari hit sahit rāmu jab johe
ramā samet ramāpati mohe

verses.sa:
निरखि राम छबि बिधि हरषाने ।
आठइ नयन जानि पछिताने ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi rām chabi bidhi haraṣāne
āṭhai nayan jāni pachitāne

verses.sa:
सुर सेनप उर बहुत उछाहू ।
बिधि ते डेवढ़ लोचन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sur senap ur bahut uchāhū
bidhi te ḍevar̤h locan lāhū

verses.sa:
रामहि चितव सुरेस सुजाना ।
गौतम श्रापु परम हित माना ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi citav sures sujānā
gautam śrāpu param hit mānā

verses.sa:
देव सकल सुरपतिहि सिहाहीं ।
आजु पुरंदर सम कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dev sakal surapatihi sihāhīṃ
āju puraṃdar sam kou nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मुदित देवगन रामहि देखी ।
नृपसमाज दुहुँ हरषु बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
mudit devagan rāmahi dekhī
nṛpasamāj duhum̐ haraṣu biseṣī

verses.sa:
अति हरषु राजसमाज दुहु दिसि दुंदुभीं बाजहिं घनी ।
बरषहिं सुमन सुर हरषि कहि जय जयति जय रघुकुलमनी ॥
verses.tr:
ati haraṣu rājasamāj duhu disi duṃdubhīṃ bājahiṃ ghanī
baraṣahiṃ suman sur haraṣi kahi jaya jayati jaya raghukulamanī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
एहि भाँति जानि बरात आवत बाजने बहु बाजहीं ।
रानि सुआसिनि बोलि परिछनि हेतु मंगल साजहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bhām̐ti jāni barāt āvat bājane bahu bājahīṃ
rāni suāsini boli parichani hetu maṃgal sājahīṃ

verses.sa:
सजि आरती अनेक बिधि मंगल सकल सँवारि ।
चलीं मुदित परिछनि करन गजगामिनि बर नारि ॥
verses.tr:
saji āratī anek bidhi maṃgal sakal sam̐vāri
calīṃ mudit parichani karan gajagāmini bar nāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bat not Sarade herself could do justice to the noble steed on which Rama rode. Sankara was enchanted with his beauty, and congratulated himself on having fifteen eyes. When Hari affectionately gazed on Rama he and

Lakshmi were both equally charmed; while Brahma rejoiced to behold his beauty, and regretted that he had only eight eyes. Kartikeya exulted greatly that in the matter of eyes he was half as well off again as Brahma. When wise Indra looked at Rama, he thought Gautam’s curse a great blessing; and all the gods broke out in Indra’s praise, saying:— ‘To-day there is no one like him.’ All heaven was delighted at the sight of Rama, and there was joy above measure in the court of both the kings.

There was exceeding joy in both royal courts; the wel-kin resounded with multitudinous kettledrums; the gods rained down flowers and shouted in their joy,—Glory, glory, glory to Raghu’s noble son.” In this manner when they learnt that the procession was approaching all sorts of music began to play, and the queen gave orders to her handmaids to prepare the auspicious materials for the lustral rite.
With many lights and torches and festal preparations of every kind, a bevy of graceful dames proceeded joyously to celebrate the lustral rite.

sections.label: Doha 318
sections.name: जो सुख भा सिय मातु मन देखि राम बर बेषु

verses.sa:
बिधुबदनीं सब सब मृगलोचनि ।
सब निज तन छबि रति मदु मोचनि ॥
verses.tr:
bidhubadanīṃ sab sab mṛgalocani
sab nij tan chabi rati madu mocani
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पहिरें बरन बरन बर चीरा ।
सकल बिभूषन सजें सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
pahireṃ baran baran bar cīrā
sakal bibhūṣan sajeṃ sarīrā

verses.sa:
सकल सुमंगल अंग बनाएँ ।
करहिं गान कलकंठि लजाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sumaṃgal aṃg banāem̐
karahiṃ gān kalakaṃṭhi lajāem̐

verses.sa:
कंकन किंकिनि नूपुर बाजहिं ।
चालि बिलोकि काम गज लाजहिं ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃkan kiṃkini nūpur bājahiṃ
cāli biloki kām gaj lājahiṃ

verses.sa:
बाजहिं बाजने बिबिध प्रकारा ।
नभ अरु नगर सुमंगलचारा ॥
verses.tr:
bājahiṃ bājane bibidh prakārā
nabh aru nagar sumaṃgalacārā

verses.sa:
सची सारदा रमा भवानी ।
जे सुरतिय सुचि सहज सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
sacī sāradā ramā bhavānī
je suratiya suci sahaj sayānī

verses.sa:
कपट नारि बर बेष बनाई ।
मिलीं सकल रनिवासहिं जाई ॥
verses.tr:
kapaṭ nāri bar beṣ banāī
milīṃ sakal ranivāsahiṃ jāī

verses.sa:
करहिं गान कल मंगल बानीं ।
हरष बिबस सब काहुँ न जानी ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ gān kal maṃgal bānīṃ
haraṣ bibas sab kāhum̐ na jānī

verses.sa:
को जान केहि आनंद बस सब ब्रह्मु बर परिछन चली ।
कल गान मधुर निसान बरषहिं सुमन सुर सोभा भली ॥
verses.tr:
ko jān kehi ānaṃd bas sab brahmu bar parichan calī
kal gān madhur nisān baraṣahiṃ suman sur sobhā bhalī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: आनंदकंदु बिलोकि दूलहु सकल हियँ हरषित भई ॥
verses.tr: ānaṃdakaṃdu biloki dūlahu sakal hiyam̐ haraṣit bhaī

verses.sa: अंभोज अंबक अंबु उमगि सुअंग पुलकावलि छई ॥
verses.tr: aṃbhoj aṃbak aṃbu umagi suaṃg pulakāvali chaī

verses.sa:
जो सुख भा सिय मातु मन देखि राम बर बेषु ।
सो न सकहिं कहि कलप सत सहस सारदा सेषु ॥
verses.tr:
jo sukh bhā siya mātu man dekhi rām bar beṣu
so na sakahiṃ kahi kalap sat sahas sāradā seṣu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With fawn-like eyes and face of moon-like brightness, each one was beautiful enough to rob Rati all self-conceit. Attired in costly garments of different colours, covered all over with ornaments and rendered beautiful in every limb, they sang more melodiously than the koil to the music of the bells on their wrists and waist and feet, as they moved, with all the undulating grace of a wild elephant. All kinds of music played, and there _ Were rejoicings both in heaven and in the city. Indrani, Serada, Lakshmi and Bhavani the wisests of all the queens of heaven, assumed the disguise of woman’s form and flocked to the king's seraglio, singing delightfully with divine voice; and for joy there was no one who recognized them.

In their ecstatic joy as they went to receive the bridegroom with melodious song and sweet music, who could tell who was who The gods showered down flowers and everything was delightful. As they gazed upon the bridegroom, the source of bliss, they were all glad of heart, their lotus eyes overflowed with tears and their every limb quivered with raptare.
The joy of Sita’s mother on the beholding Rama's gallant appearance was more than a thousand Seradas and Seshnags could tell in a hundred ages.

sections.label: Doha 319
sections.name: नाऊ बारी भाट नट राम निछावरि पाइ

verses.sa:
नयन नीरु हटि मंगल जानी ।
परिछनि करहिं मुदित मन रानी ॥
verses.tr:
nayan nīru haṭi maṃgal jānī
parichani karahiṃ mudit man rānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बेद बिहित अरु कुल आचारू ।
कीन्ह भली बिधि सब ब्यवहारू ॥
verses.tr:
bed bihit aru kul ācārū
kīnh bhalī bidhi sab byavahārū

verses.sa:
पंच सबद धुनि मंगल गाना ।
पट पाँवड़े परहिं बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
paṃc sabad dhuni maṃgal gānā
paṭ pām̐var̤e parahiṃ bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
करि आरती अरघु तिन्ह दीन्हा ।
राम गमनु मंडप तब कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
kari āratī araghu tinh dīnhā
rām gamanu maṃḍap tab kīnhā

verses.sa:
दसरथु सहित समाज बिराजे ।
बिभव बिलोकि लोकपति लाजे ॥
verses.tr:
dasarathu sahit samāj birāje
bibhav biloki lokapati lāje

verses.sa:
समयँ समयँ सुर बरषहिं फूला ।
सांति पढ़हिं महिसुर अनुकूला ॥
verses.tr:
samayam̐ samayam̐ sur baraṣahiṃ phūlā
sāṃti par̤hahiṃ mahisur anukūlā

verses.sa:
नभ अरु नगर कोलाहल होई ।
आपनि पर कछु सुनइ न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
nabh aru nagar kolāhal hoī
āpani par kachu sunai na koī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि रामु मंडपहिं आए ।
अरघु देइ आसन बैठाए ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi rāmu maṃḍapahiṃ āe
araghu dei āsan baiṭhāe

verses.sa: बैठारि आसन आरती करि निरखि बरु सुखु पावहीं ॥
verses.tr: baiṭhāri āsan āratī kari nirakhi baru sukhu pāvahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: मनि बसन भूषन भूरि वारहिं नारि मंगल गावहीं ॥
verses.tr: mani basan bhūṣan bhūri vārahiṃ nāri maṃgal gāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मादि सुरबर बिप्र बेष बनाइ कौतुक देखहीं ।
अवलोकि रघुकुल कमल रबि छबि सुफल जीवन लेखहीं ॥
verses.tr:
brahmādi surabar bipr beṣ banāi kautuk dekhahīṃ
avaloki raghukul kamal rabi chabi suphal jīvan lekhahīṃ

verses.sa:
नाऊ बारी भाट नट राम निछावरि पाइ ।
मुदित असीसहिं नाइ सिर हरषु न हृदयँ समाइ ॥
verses.tr:
nāū bārī bhāṭ naṭ rām nichāvari pāi
mudit asīsahiṃ nāi sir haraṣu na hṛdayam̐ samāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Restraining her tears out of regard for the suspicious-ness of the event, the queen with gladness of heart performed the lustral rite, and deligently completed the entire ceremony in accordance with Vedic prescription and family usage. The five kinds of music were accompanied by festal chanting, and rich carpets of different sorts were spread upon the ground. After the lustral rite and the oblation Rama proceeded to the pavilion. So great was the splendour and magnificence of Dasarath and his retinue that Indra was put to shame by it. From time to time the gods rained down flowers, while the Brahmans repeated the appropriate propitiatory texts. There was much jubilation on the earth and in heaven that no one could hear himself speak, much Less any one else. In this manner
Rama entered the pavilion, where the libation was offered and he was conducted to his throne.

When the bridegroom was seated on the throne and the lustral rite was performed, all rejoiced at the sight, scattering around him jewels and raiment and ornaments in profusion, while women sang festal songs. Brahma and all the other gods disguised as noble Brahmans witnessed the spectacle, and as they gazed on the glorious sun of the lotus race of Raghu, reckoned it the happiest moment of their life.

The barber and torch maker and singers and dancers, who gathered up the offerings that had been scattered about Rama, bowed their head and invoked blessings upon him from a heart that was bursting with joy.

sections.label: Doha 320
sections.name: बामदेव आदिक रिषय पूजे मुदित महीस

verses.sa:
मिले जनकु दसरथु अति प्रीतीं ।
करि बैदिक लौकिक सब रीतीं ॥
verses.tr:
mile janaku dasarathu ati prītīṃ
kari baidik laukik sab rītīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मिलत महा दोउ राज बिराजे ।
उपमा खोजि खोजि कबि लाजे ॥
verses.tr:
milat mahā dou rāj birāje
upamā khoji khoji kabi lāje

verses.sa:
लही न कतहुँ हारि हियँ मानी ।
इन्ह सम एइ उपमा उर आनी ॥
verses.tr:
lahī na katahum̐ hāri hiyam̐ mānī
inh sam ei upamā ur ānī

verses.sa:
सामध देखि देव अनुरागे ।
सुमन बरषि जसु गावन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
sāmadh dekhi dev anurāge
suman baraṣi jasu gāvan lāge

verses.sa:
जगु बिरंचि उपजावा जब तें ।
देखे सुने ब्याह बहु तब तें ॥
verses.tr:
jagu biraṃci upajāvā jab teṃ
dekhe sune byāh bahu tab teṃ

verses.sa:
सकल भाँति सम साजु समाजू ।
सम समधी देखे हम आजू ॥
verses.tr:
sakal bhām̐ti sam sāju samājū
sam samadhī dekhe ham ājū

verses.sa:
देव गिरा सुनि सुंदर साँची ।
प्रीति अलौकिक दुहु दिसि माची ॥
verses.tr:
dev girā suni suṃdar sām̐cī
prīti alaukik duhu disi mācī

verses.sa:
देत पाँवड़े अरघु सुहाए ।
सादर जनकु मंडपहिं ल्याए ॥
verses.tr:
det pām̐var̤e araghu suhāe
sādar janaku maṃḍapahiṃ lyāe

verses.sa: मंडपु बिलोकि बिचीत्र रचनाँ रुचिरताँ मुनि मन हरे ॥
verses.tr: maṃḍapu biloki bicītr racanām̐ ruciratām̐ muni man hare
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: निज पानि जनक सुजान सब कहुँ आनि सिंघासन धरे ॥
verses.tr: nij pāni janak sujān sab kahum̐ āni siṃghāsan dhare

verses.sa:
कुल इष्ट सरिस बसिष्ट पूजे बिनय करि आसिष लही ।
कौसिकहि पूजत परम प्रीति कि रीति तौ न परै कही ॥
verses.tr:
kul iṣṭ saris basiṣṭ pūje binaya kari āsiṣ lahī
kausikahi pūjat param prīti ki rīti tau na parai kahī

verses.sa:
बामदेव आदिक रिषय पूजे मुदित महीस ।
दिए दिब्य आसन सबहि सब सन लही असीस ॥
verses.tr:
bāmadev ādik riṣaya pūje mudit mahīs
die dibya āsan sabahi sab san lahī asīs
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Janak and Dasarath joined most affectionately in the observance of every custom, whether religious or secular; and the royal pair were so glorious a sight that the poet, searching whereto to liken them and finding nothing, must acknowledge himself defeated and admit that they were comparable only to themselves. The gods beheld with delight the two fathers and rained down flowers and sang their praises:—‘ Since Brahma first created the world, we have seen and heard of many marriages, but never till this day have we seen a match so perfect in all respeots, and two such well-matched fathers.” At the sound of this voice from heaven so gracious and yet so true, there was on both sides a marvellous access of love. Janak led the way with due honours to the pavilion, offering libations and unrolling a carpet as he went.

Beholdiog the beauty of the manifold decorations of the pavilion, even the saints were astonished; but the wise Janak with his own hands conducted them all to their seats. Paying the same honour and respect to Vasishta as to his own patron divinity, he received his blessing; but the supreme devotion with which he greeted Visvamitra was of a kind that surpasses description.
With great joy the king did homage to Vamadeva too and the other saints, and gave them all exalted thrones and received their blessing.

sections.label: Doha 321
sections.name: रामचंद्र मुख चंद्र छबि लोचन चारु चकोर

verses.sa:
बहुरि कीन्ह कोसलपति पूजा ।
जानि ईस सम भाउ न दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri kīnh kosalapati pūjā
jāni īs sam bhāu na dūjā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कीन्ह जोरि कर बिनय बड़ाई ।
कहि निज भाग्य बिभव बहुताई ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh jori kar binaya bar̤āī
kahi nij bhāgya bibhav bahutāī

verses.sa:
पूजे भूपति सकल बराती ।
समधि सम सादर सब भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
pūje bhūpati sakal barātī
samadhi sam sādar sab bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
आसन उचित दिए सब काहू ।
कहौं काह मूख एक उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
āsan ucit die sab kāhū
kahauṃ kāh mūkh ek uchāhū

verses.sa:
सकल बरात जनक सनमानी ।
दान मान बिनती बर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
sakal barāt janak sanamānī
dān mān binatī bar bānī

verses.sa:
