बिधि हरि हरु दिसिपति दिनराऊ ।
जे जानहिं रघुबीर प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi hari haru disipati dinarāū
je jānahiṃ raghubīr prabhāū

verses.sa:
कपट बिप्र बर बेष बनाएँ ।
कौतुक देखहिं अति सचु पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
kapaṭ bipr bar beṣ banāem̐
kautuk dekhahiṃ ati sacu pāem̐

verses.sa:
पूजे जनक देव सम जानें ।
दिए सुआसन बिनु पहिचानें ॥
verses.tr:
pūje janak dev sam jāneṃ
die suāsan binu pahicāneṃ

verses.sa:
पहिचान को केहि जान सबहिं अपान सुधि भोरी भई ।
आनंद कंदु बिलोकि दूलहु उभय दिसि आनँद मई ॥
verses.tr:
pahicān ko kehi jān sabahiṃ apān sudhi bhorī bhaī
ānaṃd kaṃdu biloki dūlahu ubhaya disi ānam̐d maī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सुर लखे राम सुजान पूजे मानसिक आसन दए ।
अवलोकि सीलु सुभाउ प्रभु को बिबुध मन प्रमुदित भए ॥
verses.tr:
sur lakhe rām sujān pūje mānasik āsan dae
avaloki sīlu subhāu prabhu ko bibudh man pramudit bhae

verses.sa:
रामचंद्र मुख चंद्र छबि लोचन चारु चकोर ।
करत पान सादर सकल प्रेमु प्रमोदु न थोर ॥
verses.tr:
rāmacaṃdr mukh caṃdr chabi locan cāru cakor
karat pān sādar sakal premu pramodu na thor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again he did homage to the lord of Kosala, taking him to be the peer of Mahadeva, yea, none other; with clasped hands in humble phrase extolling him and enlarging on his own marvellous good fortune. Then to all the weddingguests he paid the same homage in every respect us to the bridegroom's father, and assigned them all appropriate seats. How can I with my one tongue describe all the pageant. With gifts and compliments and profuse apologies Janak did the honours to all his guests Brahma, Vishnu, Mahadeva, the eight guardians of the world' and the god of day, who knew Raghubir’s glory, disguised themselves as learned Brahmans and were delighted spectators of the festivities, Janak, though he recognized them not, paid them homage as gods and led them to exalted seats.

Who could tell who was who, when there was no one who could answer even for himself. As they gazed on the bridegroom, the root of joy, joy was diffused on all sides. When he saw the gods, the all-wise Rama assigned them what seats they fancied; and the heavenly powers were delighted to behold the gracious manner of their lord.
As the partridge drinks in the light of the moon, so their eyes reverently drank in the beauty of Rama's face with the utmost rapture.

sections.label: Doha 322
sections.name: सोहति बनिता बृंद महुँ सहज सुहावनि सीय

verses.sa:
समउ बिलोकि बसिष्ठ बोलाए ।
सादर सतानंदु सुनि आए ॥
verses.tr:
samau biloki basiṣṭh bolāe
sādar satānaṃdu suni āe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बेगि कुअँरि अब आनहु जाई ।
चले मुदित मुनि आयसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
begi kuam̐ri ab ānahu jāī
cale mudit muni āyasu pāī

verses.sa:
रानी सुनि उपरोहित बानी ।
प्रमुदित सखिन्ह समेत सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
rānī suni uparohit bānī
pramudit sakhinh samet sayānī

verses.sa:
बिप्र बधू कुलबृद्ध बोलाईं ।
करि कुल रीति सुमंगल गाईं ॥
verses.tr:
bipr badhū kulabṛddh bolāīṃ
kari kul rīti sumaṃgal gāīṃ

verses.sa:
नारि बेष जे सुर बर बामा ।
सकल सुभायँ सुंदरी स्यामा ॥
verses.tr:
nāri beṣ je sur bar bāmā
sakal subhāyam̐ suṃdarī syāmā

verses.sa:
तिन्हहि देखि सुखु पावहिं नारीं ।
बिनु पहिचानि प्रानहु ते प्यारीं ॥
verses.tr:
tinhahi dekhi sukhu pāvahiṃ nārīṃ
binu pahicāni prānahu te pyārīṃ

verses.sa:
बार बार सनमानहिं रानी ।
उमा रमा सारद सम जानी ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār sanamānahiṃ rānī
umā ramā sārad sam jānī

verses.sa:
सीय सँवारि समाजु बनाई ।
मुदित मंडपहिं चलीं लवाई ॥
verses.tr:
sīya sam̐vāri samāju banāī
mudit maṃḍapahiṃ calīṃ lavāī

verses.sa:
चलि ल्याइ सीतहि सखीं सादर सजि सुमंगल भामिनीं ।
नवसप्त साजें सुंदरी सब मत्त कुंजर गामिनीं ॥
verses.tr:
cali lyāi sītahi sakhīṃ sādar saji sumaṃgal bhāminīṃ
navasapt sājeṃ suṃdarī sab matt kuṃjar gāminīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
कल गान सुनि मुनि ध्यान त्यागहिं काम कोकिल लाजहीं ।
मंजीर नूपुर कलित कंकन ताल गती बर बाजहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kal gān suni muni dhyān tyāgahiṃ kām kokil lājahīṃ
maṃjīr nūpur kalit kaṃkan tāl gatī bar bājahīṃ

verses.sa:
सोहति बनिता बृंद महुँ सहज सुहावनि सीय ।
छबि ललना गन मध्य जनु सुषमा तिय कमनीय ॥
verses.tr:
sohati banitā bṛṃd mahum̐ sahaj suhāvani sīya
chabi lalanā gan madhya janu suṣamā tiya kamanīya
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Perceiving that the time had arrived, Vasishta called, and Satanand came with ready obedience. ‘Go now and quickly bring the bride.” On receiving this order the saint went gladly, and on hearing his message the queen with all her attendants was delighted, and sent for the Brahman ladies and the elders of the tribe, and with songs of joy performed all the family rites. The goddesses, who were disguised as women, were all so amiable and lovely, in the first bloom of their youth,' that the Ladies were charmed to see them, and, though not recognizing them, held them more dear than life. Again and again the queen did them honour accounting them equals of Uma, Rama and Serada. After dressing Sita and forming io procession they joyously conducted her to the pavilion.

Reverently and with auspicious pomp her attendant ladies conducted Sita, each of them of lovely form and superbly adorned, moving with the voluptuous grace of a young elephant. At the sound of their melodious strains the saints forgot their meditations, the god of love and the koil were abashed; while the bells on their anklets and gleaming girdles rang out with the cymbals and a delightful accompaniment as they moved.
Among her maidens Sita shines forth in native loveliness, like Bliss personified among the Graces.

sections.label: Doha 323
sections.name: होम समय तनु धरि अनलु अति सुख आहुति लेहिं

verses.sa:
सिय सुंदरता बरनि न जाई ।
लघु मति बहुत मनोहरताई ॥
verses.tr:
siya suṃdaratā barani na jāī
laghu mati bahut manoharatāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आवत दीखि बरातिन्ह सीता ।
रूप रासि सब भाँति पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dīkhi barātinh sītā
rūp rāsi sab bhām̐ti punītā

verses.sa:
सबहि मनहिं मन किए प्रनामा ।
देखि राम भए पूरनकामा ॥
verses.tr:
sabahi manahiṃ man kie pranāmā
dekhi rām bhae pūranakāmā

verses.sa:
हरषे दसरथ सुतन्ह समेता ।
कहि न जाइ उर आनँदु जेता ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe dasarath sutanh sametā
kahi na jāi ur ānam̐du jetā

verses.sa:
सुर प्रनामु करि बरसहिं फूला ।
मुनि असीस धुनि मंगल मूला ॥
verses.tr:
sur pranāmu kari barasahiṃ phūlā
muni asīs dhuni maṃgal mūlā

verses.sa:
गान निसान कोलाहलु भारी ।
प्रेम प्रमोद मगन नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
gān nisān kolāhalu bhārī
prem pramod magan nar nārī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सीय मंडपहिं आई ।
प्रमुदित सांति पढ़हिं मुनिराई ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sīya maṃḍapahiṃ āī
pramudit sāṃti par̤hahiṃ munirāī

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर कर बिधि ब्यवहारू ।
दुहुँ कुलगुर सब कीन्ह अचारू ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar kar bidhi byavahārū
duhum̐ kulagur sab kīnh acārū

verses.sa:
आचारु करि गुर गौरि गनपति मुदित बिप्र पुजावहीं ।
सुर प्रगटि पूजा लेहिं देहिं असीस अति सुखु पावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ācāru kari gur gauri ganapati mudit bipr pujāvahīṃ
sur pragaṭi pūjā lehiṃ dehiṃ asīs ati sukhu pāvahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
मधुपर्क मंगल द्रब्य जो जेहि समय मुनि मन महुँ चहैं ।
भरे कनक कोपर कलस सो सब लिएहिं परिचारक रहैं ॥
verses.tr:
madhupark maṃgal drabya jo jehi samaya muni man mahum̐ cahaiṃ
bhare kanak kopar kalas so sab liehiṃ paricārak rahaiṃ

verses.sa:
कुल रीति प्रीति समेत रबि कहि देत सबु सादर कियो ।
एहि भाँति देव पुजाइ सीतहि सुभग सिंघासनु दियो ॥
verses.tr:
kul rīti prīti samet rabi kahi det sabu sādar kiyo
ehi bhām̐ti dev pujāi sītahi subhag siṃghāsanu diyo

verses.sa: सिय राम अवलोकनि परसपर प्रेम काहु न लखि परै ॥
verses.tr: siya rām avalokani parasapar prem kāhu na lakhi parai

verses.sa: मन बुद्धि बर बानी अगोचर प्रगट कबि कैसें करै ॥
verses.tr: man buddhi bar bānī agocar pragaṭ kabi kaiseṃ karai

verses.sa:
होम समय तनु धरि अनलु अति सुख आहुति लेहिं ।
बिप्र बेष धरि बेद सब कहि बिबाह बिधि देहिं ॥
verses.tr:
hom samaya tanu dhari analu ati sukh āhuti lehiṃ
bipr beṣ dhari bed sab kahi bibāh bidhi dehiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Her beauty is indescribable, so great is it and so little my wit. When the wedding guests saw her approach, so exquisitely charming and every way divine, they all did homage to her from their inmost soul. At the sight of her, Rama was filled with love, and Dasarath and his sons were glad of heart beyond all telling. The gods did homage and rained down flowers; the saints gave their blessings in auspicious wise; there was a confused noise of singing and playing and general rejoicing throughout the city. In this manner Sita arrived at the pavilion, while the great saints joyously recited the set forms of prayer and the two family gurus performed all the due rites and ceremonies.

After the ceremonies the gurus directed the glad Brahmans to worship Gauri and Ganes: the gods in visible form accepted the homage and gave their blessing, which they received with joy. Whatever dainty dish or condiment any holy man fancied at any time was at once supplied him by the table attendants in plates and bowls of gold. Having reverently and dutifully performed all family rites in accordance with the Sun-god’s prescription, and offered homage to the gods, they conducted Sita to her glorious throne. The mutual love with which Sita and Rama regarded each other was too much to look upon; it exceeds all sense, or intelligence, or speech, or perception; how then can the poet express it?
At the time of the burnt sacrifice, the Fire-god in person most graciously accepted the oblation, and all the

sections.label: Doha 324
sections.name: जय धुनि बंदी बेद धुनि मंगल गान निसान

verses.sa:
जनक पाटमहिषी जग जानी ।
सीय मातु किमि जाइ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
janak pāṭamahiṣī jag jānī
sīya mātu kimi jāi bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुजसु सुकृत सुख सुदंरताई ।
सब समेटि बिधि रची बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
sujasu sukṛt sukh sudaṃratāī
sab sameṭi bidhi racī banāī

verses.sa:
समउ जानि मुनिबरन्ह बोलाई ।
सुनत सुआसिनि सादर ल्याई ॥
verses.tr:
samau jāni munibaranh bolāī
sunat suāsini sādar lyāī

verses.sa:
जनक बाम दिसि सोह सुनयना ।
हिमगिरि संग बनि जनु मयना ॥
verses.tr:
janak bām disi soh sunayanā
himagiri saṃg bani janu mayanā

verses.sa:
कनक कलस मनि कोपर रूरे ।
सुचि सुंगध मंगल जल पूरे ॥
verses.tr:
kanak kalas mani kopar rūre
suci suṃgadh maṃgal jal pūre

verses.sa:
निज कर मुदित रायँ अरु रानी ।
धरे राम के आगें आनी ॥
verses.tr:
nij kar mudit rāyam̐ aru rānī
dhare rām ke āgeṃ ānī

verses.sa:
पढ़हिं बेद मुनि मंगल बानी ।
गगन सुमन झरि अवसरु जानी ॥
verses.tr:
par̤hahiṃ bed muni maṃgal bānī
gagan suman jhari avasaru jānī

verses.sa:
बरु बिलोकि दंपति अनुरागे ।
पाय पुनीत पखारन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
baru biloki daṃpati anurāge
pāya punīt pakhāran lāge

verses.sa:
लागे पखारन पाय पंकज प्रेम तन पुलकावली ।
नभ नगर गान निसान जय धुनि उमगि जनु चहुँ दिसि चली ॥
verses.tr:
lāge pakhāran pāya paṃkaj prem tan pulakāvalī
nabh nagar gān nisān jaya dhuni umagi janu cahum̐ disi calī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जे पद सरोज मनोज अरि उर सर सदैव बिराजहीं ।
जे सकृत सुमिरत बिमलता मन सकल कलि मल भाजहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je pad saroj manoj ari ur sar sadaiv birājahīṃ
je sakṛt sumirat bimalatā man sakal kali mal bhājahīṃ

verses.sa:
जे परसि मुनिबनिता लही गति रही जो पातकमई ।
मकरंदु जिन्ह को संभु सिर सुचिता अवधि सुर बरनई ॥
verses.tr:
je parasi munibanitā lahī gati rahī jo pātakamaī
makaraṃdu jinh ko saṃbhu sir sucitā avadhi sur baranaī

verses.sa:
करि मधुप मन मुनि जोगिजन जे सेइ अभिमत गति लहैं ।
ते पद पखारत भाग्यभाजनु जनकु जय जय सब कहै ॥
verses.tr:
kari madhup man muni jogijan je sei abhimat gati lahaiṃ
te pad pakhārat bhāgyabhājanu janaku jaya jaya sab kahai

verses.sa:
बर कुअँरि करतल जोरि साखोचारु दोउ कुलगुर करैं ।
भयो पानिगहनु बिलोकि बिधि सुर मनुज मुनि आँनद भरैं ॥
verses.tr:
bar kuam̐ri karatal jori sākhocāru dou kulagur karaiṃ
bhayo pānigahanu biloki bidhi sur manuj muni ām̐nad bharaiṃ

verses.sa:
सुखमूल दूलहु देखि दंपति पुलक तन हुलस्यो हियो ।
करि लोक बेद बिधानु कन्यादानु नृपभूषन कियो ॥
verses.tr:
sukhamūl dūlahu dekhi daṃpati pulak tan hulasyo hiyo
kari lok bed bidhānu kanyādānu nṛpabhūṣan kiyo

verses.sa:
हिमवंत जिमि गिरिजा महेसहि हरिहि श्री सागर दई ।
तिमि जनक रामहि सिय समरपी बिस्व कल कीरति नई ॥
verses.tr:
himavaṃt jimi girijā mahesahi harihi śrī sāgar daī
timi janak rāmahi siya samarapī bisv kal kīrati naī

verses.sa:
क्यों करै बिनय बिदेहु कियो बिदेहु मूरति सावँरी ।
करि होम बिधिवत गाँठि जोरी होन लागी भावँरी ॥
verses.tr:
kyoṃ karai binaya bidehu kiyo bidehu mūrati sāvam̐rī
kari hom bidhivat gām̐ṭhi jorī hon lāgī bhāvam̐rī

verses.sa:
जय धुनि बंदी बेद धुनि मंगल गान निसान ।
सुनि हरषहिं बरषहिं बिबुध सुरतरु सुमन सुजान ॥
verses.tr:
jaya dhuni baṃdī bed dhuni maṃgal gān nisān
suni haraṣahiṃ baraṣahiṃ bibudh surataru suman sujān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Vedas in the guise of Brahmans uttered the marriage formularies.

What words can describe Janak's illustrious queen-consort, Sita’s mother, in whose composition the Creator had combined the perfection of glory, piety, happiness and beauty? At the due time the saints called her, and she came responsive to the summons with her attendant maidens. Then shone forth Sunayana at Janak's left hand, as Maina beside Himalaya. With their own hands the glad king and queen take and place before Rama golden vases and costly jewelled trays full of holy water and delicious perfumes. The saints with auspicious voice recite the Veda, and at the proper time the heaven rains flowers, while the father and mother of the bride look on ia rapture and begin to wash the holy feet.

Their whole frame quivering with excess of love, they began to lave the lotus feet; while both in heaven and in the city there were singing and music and shouts of victory bursting forth and overflowing in all directions The lotus feet that ever gleam in the lake of Siva’s bosom; by meditating upon which for a single moment every impurity of the soul and defilement of this wicked world is removed; by whose touch the sage’s guilty wife attained salvation; whose honeyed fragrance, as the gods declare, is ever present on Sambhu's head; on which the bee-like soul of saints and ascetics ever dwells ere they reach the heaven of their desire; these holy feet are bathed by Janak, ‘midst the glad acclaim of all. The two family priests join the hands of the bride and bridegroom and recite their descent. The mystic union is completed, and at the sight Brahma and all gods and men and saints were full of joy. As the bride’s parents gazed on the gracious bridegroom, both their soul and body were raptured with delight; and having completed every family «and scriptural observance, the glorious monarch gave his daughter to her Lord. As Himalaya gave Girije to Mahadeva, and as Ocean gave Lakshmi to Vishnu, in like manner did Janak bestow Sita on Rama, and creation was glorified anew. After stationing the happy pair on one spot (the bride so fair of hue, the groom so dark) and performing the sacrifice with all due rite, and tying the knot, the circumambulation commenced.
At the sound of the huzzas and minstrelsy and the recitation of the Veda and the auspicious chanting and the music, the all-wise gods were delighted and rained down flowers from the tree of paradise.

sections.label: Doha 325
sections.name: मुदित अवधपति सकल सुत बधुन्ह समेत निहारि

verses.sa:
कुअँरु कुअँरि कल भावँरि देहीं ।
नयन लाभु सब सादर लेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kuam̐ru kuam̐ri kal bhāvam̐ri dehīṃ
nayan lābhu sab sādar lehīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जाइ न बरनि मनोहर जोरी ।
जो उपमा कछु कहौं सो थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jāi na barani manohar jorī
jo upamā kachu kahauṃ so thorī

verses.sa:
राम सीय सुंदर प्रतिछाहीं ।
जगमगात मनि खंभन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām sīya suṃdar pratichāhīṃ
jagamagāt mani khaṃbhan māhīṃ

verses.sa:
मनहुँ मदन रति धरि बहु रूपा ।
देखत राम बिआहु अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
manahum̐ madan rati dhari bahu rūpā
dekhat rām biāhu anūpā

verses.sa:
दरस लालसा सकुच न थोरी ।
प्रगटत दुरत बहोरि बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
daras lālasā sakuc na thorī
pragaṭat durat bahori bahorī

verses.sa:
भए मगन सब देखनिहारे ।
जनक समान अपान बिसारे ॥
verses.tr:
bhae magan sab dekhanihāre
janak samān apān bisāre

verses.sa:
प्रमुदित मुनिन्ह भावँरी फेरी ।
नेगसहित सब रीति निबेरीं ॥
verses.tr:
pramudit muninh bhāvam̐rī pherī
negasahit sab rīti niberīṃ

verses.sa:
राम सीय सिर सेंदुर देहीं ।
सोभा कहि न जाति बिधि केहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām sīya sir seṃdur dehīṃ
sobhā kahi na jāti bidhi kehīṃ

verses.sa:
अरुन पराग जलजु भरि नीकें ।
ससिहि भूष अहि लोभ अमी कें ॥
verses.tr:
arun parāg jalaju bhari nīkeṃ
sasihi bhūṣ ahi lobh amī keṃ

verses.sa:
बहुरि बसिष्ठ दीन्ह अनुसासन ।
बरु दुलहिनि बैठे एक आसन ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri basiṣṭh dīnh anusāsan
baru dulahini baiṭhe ek āsan

verses.sa:
बैठे बरासन रामु जानकि मुदित मन दसरथु भए ।
तनु पुलक पुनि पुनि देखि अपनें सुकृत सुरतरु फल नए ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhe barāsan rāmu jānaki mudit man dasarathu bhae
tanu pulak puni puni dekhi apaneṃ sukṛt surataru phal nae
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
भरि भुवन रहा उछाहु राम बिबाहु भा सबहीं कहा ।
केहि भाँति बरनि सिरात रसना एक यहु मंगलु महा ॥
verses.tr:
bhari bhuvan rahā uchāhu rām bibāhu bhā sabahīṃ kahā
kehi bhām̐ti barani sirāt rasanā ek yahu maṃgalu mahā

verses.sa:
तब जनक पाइ बसिष्ठ आयसु ब्याह साज सँवारि कै ।
माँडवी श्रुतिकीरति उरमिला कुअँरि लईं हँकारि के ॥
verses.tr:
tab janak pāi basiṣṭh āyasu byāh sāj sam̐vāri kai
mām̐ḍavī śrutikīrati uramilā kuam̐ri laīṃ ham̐kāri ke

verses.sa:
कुसकेतु कन्या प्रथम जो गुन सील सुख सोभामई ।
सब रीति प्रीति समेत करि सो ब्याहि नृप भरतहि दई ॥
verses.tr:
kusaketu kanyā pratham jo gun sīl sukh sobhāmaī
sab rīti prīti samet kari so byāhi nṛp bharatahi daī

verses.sa:
जानकी लघु भगिनी सकल सुंदरि सिरोमनि जानि कै ।
सो तनय दीन्ही ब्याहि लखनहि सकल बिधि सनमानि कै ॥
verses.tr:
jānakī laghu bhaginī sakal suṃdari siromani jāni kai
so tanaya dīnhī byāhi lakhanahi sakal bidhi sanamāni kai

verses.sa:
जेहि नामु श्रुतकीरति सुलोचनि सुमुखि सब गुन आगरी ।
सो दई रिपुसूदनहि भूपति रूप सील उजागरी ॥
verses.tr:
jehi nāmu śrutakīrati sulocani sumukhi sab gun āgarī
so daī ripusūdanahi bhūpati rūp sīl ujāgarī

verses.sa:
अनुरुप बर दुलहिनि परस्पर लखि सकुच हियँ हरषहीं ।
सब मुदित सुंदरता सराहहिं सुमन सुर गन बरषहीं ॥
verses.tr:
anurup bar dulahini paraspar lakhi sakuc hiyam̐ haraṣahīṃ
sab mudit suṃdaratā sarāhahiṃ suman sur gan baraṣahīṃ

verses.sa:
सुंदरी सुंदर बरन्ह सह सब एक मंडप राजहीं ।
जनु जीव उर चारिउ अवस्था बिमुन सहित बिराजहीं ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdarī suṃdar baranh sah sab ek maṃḍap rājahīṃ
janu jīv ur cāriu avasthā bimun sahit birājahīṃ

verses.sa:
मुदित अवधपति सकल सुत बधुन्ह समेत निहारि ।
जनु पार महिपाल मनि क्रियन्ह सहित फल चारि ॥
verses.tr:
mudit avadhapati sakal sut badhunh samet nihāri
janu pār mahipāl mani kriyanh sahit phal cāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The bride and bridegroom with measured paces pers formed the circumambulation, while all present feasted their adoring gaze on the spectacle. The beauty of the happy pair is not to be described; whatever comparison might be suggested would fall short of the reality. The lovely images of Rama and Sita were reflected in the jewelled pillars, and sparkled like incarnations of Kamadeva and Rati, who had come to witness Rama's glorious wedding and, from mingled curiosity and bashfalness, at one moment showed themselves openly and at another retired out of sight. All the spectators were enraptured and like Janak forgot all about themselves Joyously the saints bade them pace the circle round; the rite was accomplished and the marriage offerings made. Rama applied the vermilion to Sita’s forehead, brilliant beyond all description; and his arm seemed like a serpent thirsting for ambrosia, as it decorated her moonlike face with the red powder that filled his lotus hand. Then by Vasishta’s direction the bride and bridegroom took their seat together.

When Rama and Janaki took their seat, Dasarath’s soul was rejoiced and his frame quivered with emotion, as again and again he fixed his gaze upon themand saw as it were his own virtue like the tree of paradise blossoming anew. There was rejoicing all over the world at the news of Rama's wedding, how can it be described I have but one tongue in my head, while the joy had no bounds. Then Janak, having received Vasishta’s order, provided all things necessary for the marriage ceremonial, and summoned the three maidens, Mendavi, Sratikirti, and Urmile, After affectionately performing every rite, the king gave first to Bharat in marriage the beautiful and accomplished daughter of Kusaketu. Then next with all honour Janak bestowed upon Lakshman Janaki’s lovely younger sister; and finally gave away to Ripu-stidan the bright-eyed and charming Srutikirti, no Less amiable than beautiful. As bride and bridegroom modestly gazed on each other and noticed the contrast!, they were glad of heart; while every one delightedly applauded the beauty of the scene, and the gods rained down flowers. All equally beautiful, though diverse in hue, they shone resplendent iu the pavilion, as though the "four states of life with their several lords had met in one living soal.
The king of Avadh gazed with delight on his four sons and their brides; as though that jewel of monarchs had in them realized the four methods of religion and the four cognate ends of life.

sections.label: Doha 326
sections.name: पुनि पुनि रामहि चितव सिय सकुचति मनु सकुचै न

verses.sa:
जसि रघुबीर ब्याह बिधि बरनी ।
सकल कुअँर ब्याहे तेहिं करनी ॥
verses.tr:
jasi raghubīr byāh bidhi baranī
sakal kuam̐r byāhe tehiṃ karanī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहि न जाइ कछु दाइज भूरी ।
रहा कनक मनि मंडपु पूरी ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na jāi kachu dāij bhūrī
rahā kanak mani maṃḍapu pūrī

verses.sa:
कंबल बसन बिचित्र पटोरे ।
भाँति भाँति बहु मोल न थोरे ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃbal basan bicitr paṭore
bhām̐ti bhām̐ti bahu mol na thore

verses.sa:
गज रथ तुरग दास अरु दासी ।
धेनु अलंकृत कामदुहा सी ॥
verses.tr:
gaj rath turag dās aru dāsī
dhenu alaṃkṛt kāmaduhā sī

verses.sa:
बस्तु अनेक करिअ किमि लेखा ।
कहि न जाइ जानहिं जिन्ह देखा ॥
verses.tr:
bastu anek karia kimi lekhā
kahi na jāi jānahiṃ jinh dekhā

verses.sa:
लोकपाल अवलोकि सिहाने ।
लीन्ह अवधपति सबु सुखु माने ॥
verses.tr:
lokapāl avaloki sihāne
līnh avadhapati sabu sukhu māne

verses.sa:
दीन्ह जाचकन्हि जो जेहि भावा ।
उबरा सो जनवासेहिं आवा ॥
verses.tr:
dīnh jācakanhi jo jehi bhāvā
ubarā so janavāsehiṃ āvā

verses.sa:
तब कर जोरि जनकु मृदु बानी ।
बोले सब बरात सनमानी ॥
verses.tr:
tab kar jori janaku mṛdu bānī
bole sab barāt sanamānī

verses.sa:
सनमानि सकल बरात आदर दान बिनय बड़ाइ कै ।
प्रमुदित महा मुनि बृंद बंदे पूजि प्रेम लड़ाइ कै ॥
verses.tr:
sanamāni sakal barāt ādar dān binaya bar̤āi kai
pramudit mahā muni bṛṃd baṃde pūji prem lar̤āi kai
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सिरु नाइ देव मनाइ सब सन कहत कर संपुट किएँ ।
सुर साधु चाहत भाउ सिंधु कि तोष जल अंजलि दिएँ ॥
verses.tr:
siru nāi dev manāi sab san kahat kar saṃpuṭ kiem̐
sur sādhu cāhat bhāu siṃdhu ki toṣ jal aṃjali diem̐

verses.sa:
कर जोरि जनकु बहोरि बंधु समेत कोसलराय सों ।
बोले मनोहर बयन सानि सनेह सील सुभाय सों ॥
verses.tr:
kar jori janaku bahori baṃdhu samet kosalarāya soṃ
bole manohar bayan sāni saneh sīl subhāya soṃ

verses.sa:
संबंध राजन रावरें हम बड़े अब सब बिधि भए ।
एहि राज साज समेत सेवक जानिबे बिनु गथ लए ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbaṃdh rājan rāvareṃ ham bar̤e ab sab bidhi bhae
ehi rāj sāj samet sevak jānibe binu gath lae

verses.sa:
ए दारिका परिचारिका करि पालिबीं करुना नई ।
अपराधु छमिबो बोलि पठए बहुत हौं ढीट्यो कई ॥
verses.tr:
e dārikā paricārikā kari pālibīṃ karunā naī
aparādhu chamibo boli paṭhae bahut hauṃ ḍhīṭyo kaī

verses.sa:
पुनि भानुकुलभूषन सकल सनमान निधि समधी किए ।
कहि जाति नहिं बिनती परस्पर प्रेम परिपूरन हिए ॥
verses.tr:
puni bhānukulabhūṣan sakal sanamān nidhi samadhī kie
kahi jāti nahiṃ binatī paraspar prem paripūran hie

verses.sa:
बृंदारका गन सुमन बरिसहिं राउ जनवासेहि चले ।
दुंदुभी जय धुनि बेद धुनि नभ नगर कौतूहल भले ॥
verses.tr:
bṛṃdārakā gan suman barisahiṃ rāu janavāsehi cale
duṃdubhī jaya dhuni bed dhuni nabh nagar kautūhal bhale

verses.sa:
तब सखीं मंगल गान करत मुनीस आयसु पाइ कै ।
दूलह दुलहिनिन्ह सहित सुंदरि चलीं कोहबर ल्याइ कै ॥
verses.tr:
tab sakhīṃ maṃgal gān karat munīs āyasu pāi kai
dūlah dulahininh sahit suṃdari calīṃ kohabar lyāi kai

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि रामहि चितव सिय सकुचति मनु सकुचै न ।
हरत मनोहर मीन छबि प्रेम पिआसे नैन ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni rāmahi citav siya sakucati manu sakucai na
harat manohar mīn chabi prem piāse nain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All the princes were married with the same rites as I have described for RAma. The enormous dowry was beyond description; the whole pavilion was full of gold and jewels. Shawls, robes and silks of kinds in the greatest profusion and of immense value; elephants, chariots, horses, menservants, and cows with gilded horns and hoofs, as beautiful as the cow of plenty; things so many that no one could count them, nor credit their number if he had not seen them, At the sight the guardians of the world broke out into praises of the dowry, and Avadh’s king received it all most graciously. To every one who asked was given whatever he desired, and what remained over was taken to the guests’ quarters. Then with folded hands and bated breath Janak courteously entreated all the bridegroom’s party.

After courteously entreating all] the marriage guests with high ceremony, gifts, apologies and compliments, he joyfully proceeded with much devotion to do his humble homage to the saintly. throng. With bowed head he propitiated the gods, and thus, with hands clasped in prayer, addressed them all, “Gods and saints desire only a good will; can Ocean’s wants be satisfied by a libation of a few drops?” 2 Again with clasped hands Janak and his brother spoke to the king of Kosala, with winning words full of love andamiability:— “QO king, I am greatly ennobled by your alliance; know that my realm and all that I have is freely yours to command. Take these girls as your hand-maidens and graciously protect

‘them, and pardon me my sin and presumption in inviting you.” The glory of the Solar race in turn addressed his royal cousin in terms of highest honour; their courtesy was past all telling, and the love that overflowed their hearts, The deities rained down flowers as the monarch proceeded. to the guest-chamber, midst the crash of kettledrums, the muttered recitation of the Veda, and glad rejoicings both on earth and in heaven. Then by the saint’s command and singing auspicious strains as they went, the fair ladies of the court conducted to the marriage pavilion the bridegrooms and their brides.
Again and again did Sita gaze upon Rama with modest mien, but full of confidence at heart; and her eyes athirst with love outshone the fish in Kamadeva’s blazon.

sections.label: Doha 327
sections.name: सहित बधूटिन्ह कुअँर सब तब आए पितु पास

verses.sa:
स्याम सरीरु सुभायँ सुहावन ।
सोभा कोटि मनोज लजावन ॥
verses.tr:
syām sarīru subhāyam̐ suhāvan
sobhā koṭi manoj lajāvan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जावक जुत पद कमल सुहाए ।
मुनि मन मधुप रहत जिन्ह छाए ॥
verses.tr:
jāvak jut pad kamal suhāe
muni man madhup rahat jinh chāe

verses.sa:
पीत पुनीत मनोहर धोती ।
हरति बाल रबि दामिनि जोती ॥
verses.tr:
pīt punīt manohar dhotī
harati bāl rabi dāmini jotī

verses.sa:
कल किंकिनि कटि सूत्र मनोहर ।
बाहु बिसाल बिभूषन सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
kal kiṃkini kaṭi sūtr manohar
bāhu bisāl bibhūṣan suṃdar

verses.sa:
पीत जनेउ महाछबि देई ।
कर मुद्रिका चोरि चितु लेई ॥
verses.tr:
pīt janeu mahāchabi deī
kar mudrikā cori citu leī

verses.sa:
सोहत ब्याह साज सब साजे ।
उर आयत उरभूषन राजे ॥
verses.tr:
sohat byāh sāj sab sāje
ur āyat urabhūṣan rāje

verses.sa:
पिअर उपरना काखासोती ।
दुहुँ आँचरन्हि लगे मनि मोती ॥
verses.tr:
piar uparanā kākhāsotī
duhum̐ ām̐caranhi lage mani motī

verses.sa:
नयन कमल कल कुंडल काना ।
बदनु सकल सौंदर्ज निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
nayan kamal kal kuṃḍal kānā
badanu sakal sauṃdarj nidhānā

verses.sa:
सुंदर भृकुटि मनोहर नासा ।
भाल तिलकु रुचिरता निवासा ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar bhṛkuṭi manohar nāsā
bhāl tilaku ruciratā nivāsā

verses.sa:
सोहत मौरु मनोहर माथे ।
मंगलमय मुकुता मनि गाथे ॥
verses.tr:
sohat mauru manohar māthe
maṃgalamaya mukutā mani gāthe

verses.sa:
गाथे महामनि मौर मंजुल अंग सब चित चोरहीं ।
पुर नारि सुर सुंदरीं बरहि बिलोकि सब तिन तोरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gāthe mahāmani maur maṃjul aṃg sab cit corahīṃ
pur nāri sur suṃdarīṃ barahi biloki sab tin torahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
मनि बसन भूषन वारि आरति करहिं मंगल गावहिं ।
सुर सुमन बरिसहिं सूत मागध बंदि सुजसु सुनावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mani basan bhūṣan vāri ārati karahiṃ maṃgal gāvahiṃ
sur suman barisahiṃ sūt māgadh baṃdi sujasu sunāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
कोहबरहिं आने कुँअर कुँअरि सुआसिनिन्ह सुख पाइ कै ।
अति प्रीति लौकिक रीति लागीं करन मंगल गाइ कै ॥
verses.tr:
kohabarahiṃ āne kum̐ar kum̐ari suāsininh sukh pāi kai
ati prīti laukik rīti lāgīṃ karan maṃgal gāi kai

verses.sa:
लहकौरि गौरि सिखाव रामहि सीय सन सारद कहैं ।
रनिवासु हास बिलास रस बस जन्म को फलु सब लहैं ॥
verses.tr:
lahakauri gauri sikhāv rāmahi sīya san sārad kahaiṃ
ranivāsu hās bilās ras bas janm ko phalu sab lahaiṃ

verses.sa:
निज पानि मनि महुँ देखिअति मूरति सुरूपनिधान की ।
चालति न भुजबल्ली बिलोकनि बिरह भय बस जानकी ॥
verses.tr:
nij pāni mani mahum̐ dekhiati mūrati surūpanidhān kī
cālati na bhujaballī bilokani birah bhaya bas jānakī

verses.sa:
कौतुक बिनोद प्रमोदु प्रेमु न जाइ कहि जानहिं अलीं ।
बर कुअँरि सुंदर सकल सखीं लवाइ जनवासेहि चलीं ॥
verses.tr:
kautuk binod pramodu premu na jāi kahi jānahiṃ alīṃ
bar kuam̐ri suṃdar sakal sakhīṃ lavāi janavāsehi calīṃ

verses.sa:
तेहि समय सुनिअ असीस जहँ तहँ नगर नभ आनँदु महा ।
चिरु जिअहुँ जोरीं चारु चारयो मुदित मन सबहीं कहा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi samaya sunia asīs jaham̐ taham̐ nagar nabh ānam̐du mahā
ciru jiahum̐ jorīṃ cāru cārayo mudit man sabahīṃ kahā

verses.sa:
जोगीन्द्र सिद्ध मुनीस देव बिलोकि प्रभु दुंदुभि हनी ।
चले हरषि बरषि प्रसून निज निज लोक जय जय जय भनी ॥
verses.tr:
jogīndr siddh munīs dev biloki prabhu duṃdubhi hanī
cale haraṣi baraṣi prasūn nij nij lok jaya jaya jaya bhanī

verses.sa:
सहित बधूटिन्ह कुअँर सब तब आए पितु पास ।
सोभा मंगल मोद भरि उमगेउ जनु जनवास ॥
verses.tr:
sahit badhūṭinh kuam̐r sab tab āe pitu pās
sobhā maṃgal mod bhari umageu janu janavās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Dark in hue and full of untaught grace, his beauty put to shame a myriad Loves; his lac-stained feet gleamed like some lotus, the haunt of bee-like saintly souls; his pure and lustrous yellow robe outshone the rising sun or lightning-flash; and the little bells on his waistbelt made delicious tinkling; long were his arms and clasped with glittering bangles his yellow janeo set him off to perfection; his signet ring would ravish all hearts; lustrous were all his many wedding adornments and the starsand collara on his broad breast; across his shoulders a yellow scarf with fringe of gems and pearls; with lotus eyes and bright pendants from his ears and a face the very store-house of beauty; lovely brows and charming nose and on his forehead a most bewitching spot, while on his head the auspicious marriage-crown shone glorious with knotted pearls and gems.

The knotted gems and the crown and his comely person ravished all hearts; and not a woman or goddess in heaven or earth who did not break a blade of grass at the sight of his beauty. After scattering round about him jewels and raiment and adornments they perform the Lustral rite, singing auspicious songs, while the gods rain down flowers, and bards, minstrels and rhapsodists declare his glory.

When the bride and bridegroom entered the marriage pavilion, great was the joy of the attendants, who with festive-songs and in most lovingwise began to perform the accustomed observances. Gauri herself taught Rama, and Saerade told Sita how to manage the mess of rice-milk; and all the ladies of the seraglio were so taken with the merry sport that they reckoned it the happiest moment of their lives. When Janaki saw in the gems on her fingers the reflection of the all-beautiful, she dared not move her eyes or lithesome arm for fear of Losing his presence. The rapture of delight, the ecstasy of love surpassed all telling; only those happy dames could comprehend it who escorted the bride and bridegroom to the guest-bouse. Then might be heard on all sides blessings and great exultation in heaven and on earth and a universal shout of joy:—‘Long life to the four happy couples.’

Hermits, saints and sages, the gods too on beholding their lord, sounded their kettledrums and returned in gladness, each to his own realm, raining down flowers and crying ‘Victory’. Then the four princes with their brides approached their father, and such was the glory, the felicity and the rapture that it seemed to overflow the court like a torrent.

sections.label: Doha 328
sections.name: सूपोदन सुरभी सरपि सुंदर स्वादु पुनीत

verses.sa:
पुनि जेवनार भई बहु भाँती ।
पठए जनक बोलाइ बराती ॥
verses.tr:
puni jevanār bhaī bahu bhām̐tī
paṭhae janak bolāi barātī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
परत पाँवड़े बसन अनूपा ।
सुतन्ह समेत गवन कियो भूपा ॥
verses.tr:
parat pām̐var̤e basan anūpā
sutanh samet gavan kiyo bhūpā

verses.sa:
सादर सबके पाय पखारे ।
जथाजोगु पीढ़न्ह बैठारे ॥
verses.tr:
sādar sabake pāya pakhāre
jathājogu pīr̤hanh baiṭhāre

verses.sa:
धोए जनक अवधपति चरना ।
सीलु सनेहु जाइ नहिं बरना ॥
verses.tr:
dhoe janak avadhapati caranā
sīlu sanehu jāi nahiṃ baranā

verses.sa:
बहुरि राम पद पंकज धोए ।
जे हर हृदय कमल महुँ गोए ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri rām pad paṃkaj dhoe
je har hṛdaya kamal mahum̐ goe

verses.sa:
तीनिउ भाई राम सम जानी ।
धोए चरन जनक निज पानी ॥
verses.tr:
tīniu bhāī rām sam jānī
dhoe caran janak nij pānī

verses.sa:
आसन उचित सबहि नृप दीन्हे ।
बोलि सूपकारी सब लीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
āsan ucit sabahi nṛp dīnhe
boli sūpakārī sab līnhe

verses.sa:
सादर लगे परन पनवारे ।
कनक कील मनि पान सँवारे ॥
verses.tr:
sādar lage paran panavāre
kanak kīl mani pān sam̐vāre

verses.sa:
सूपोदन सुरभी सरपि सुंदर स्वादु पुनीत ।
छन महुँ सब कें परुसि गे चतुर सुआर बिनीत ॥
verses.tr:
sūpodan surabhī sarapi suṃdar svādu punīt
chan mahum̐ sab keṃ parusi ge catur suār binīt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again there was a magnificient banquet, to which Janak sent and invited all the visitors. Carpets of richest stuff were spread as the king sallied forth with his sons. After reverently washing his guests’ feet, he seated them all according to their rank. First Janak bathed the feet of Avadh’s lord with a loving devotion past all telling; then he bathed Rama’s lotus feet, feet ever enshrined in Mahadeva’s heart; and, also with his own hands, bathed the feet of the three brothers, regarding them as Rama’s peers. To all the king assigned appropriate seats, and then gave his orders to the cooks, who with due ceremony set out the dishes, made all of jewels instead of leaves, and stitched with golden pins.
The quick and obsequious waiting-men passed round, and ina moment every guest was supplied with rice and condiments and fragrant butter, and everything luscious and savoury and nice.

sections.label: Doha 329
sections.name: देइ पान पूजे जनक दसरथु सहित समाज

verses.sa:
पंच कवल करि जेवन लअगे ।
गारि गान सुनि अति अनुरागे ॥
verses.tr:
paṃc kaval kari jevan laage
gāri gān suni ati anurāge
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भाँति अनेक परे पकवाने ।
सुधा सरिस नहिं जाहिं बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
bhām̐ti anek pare pakavāne
sudhā saris nahiṃ jāhiṃ bakhāne

verses.sa:
परुसन लगे सुआर सुजाना ।
बिंजन बिबिध नाम को जाना ॥
verses.tr:
parusan lage suār sujānā
biṃjan bibidh nām ko jānā

verses.sa:
चारि भाँति भोजन बिधि गाई ।
एक एक बिधि बरनि न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
cāri bhām̐ti bhojan bidhi gāī
ek ek bidhi barani na jāī

verses.sa:
छरस रुचिर बिंजन बहु जाती ।
एक एक रस अगनित भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
charas rucir biṃjan bahu jātī
ek ek ras aganit bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
जेवँत देहिं मधुर धुनि गारी ।
लै लै नाम पुरुष अरु नारी ॥
verses.tr:
jevam̐t dehiṃ madhur dhuni gārī
lai lai nām puruṣ aru nārī

verses.sa:
समय सुहावनि गारि बिराजा ।
हँसत राउ सुनि सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
samaya suhāvani gāri birājā
ham̐sat rāu suni sahit samājā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सबहीं भौजनु कीन्हा ।
आदर सहित आचमनु दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sabahīṃ bhaujanu kīnhā
ādar sahit ācamanu dīnhā

verses.sa:
देइ पान पूजे जनक दसरथु सहित समाज ।
जनवासेहि गवने मुदित सकल भूप सिरताज ॥
verses.tr:
dei pān pūje janak dasarathu sahit samāj
janavāsehi gavane mudit sakal bhūp siratāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After making the five oblations, they began to eat listening with delight the -while to allusive songs. There were confections of many kinds, sweeter than nectar or than words can tell, which the well-trained waiters handed round, and such an infinite variety of sauces that no one could remember all their names, with food of the four kinds mentioned in the sacred books and an_ indescribable variety of each kind, and seasoning of the six flavours, and each flavour exhibited in a countless number of dishes. As the banquet proceeded, jests were bandied about in pleasant wise, and not a man or woman but heard his name brought in. Louder and broader grew the raillery of the festive hour, and the king and the whole assembly were moved to laughter as they listened. In this manner they all feasted, then punctiliously rinsed out the mouth:
And Janak in due form presented Dasarath and all his guests with pan, and the glorious king then retired to his own apartment.

sections.label: Doha 330
sections.name: बामदेउ अरु देवरिषि बालमीकि जाबालि

verses.sa:
नित नूतन मंगल पुर माहीं ।
निमिष सरिस दिन जामिनि जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nit nūtan maṃgal pur māhīṃ
nimiṣ saris din jāmini jāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बड़े भोर भूपतिमनि जागे ।
जाचक गुन गन गावन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤e bhor bhūpatimani jāge
jācak gun gan gāvan lāge

verses.sa:
देखि कुअँर बर बधुन्ह समेता ।
किमि कहि जात मोदु मन जेता ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi kuam̐r bar badhunh sametā
kimi kahi jāt modu man jetā

verses.sa:
प्रातक्रिया करि गे गुरु पाहीं ।
महाप्रमोदु प्रेमु मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prātakriyā kari ge guru pāhīṃ
mahāpramodu premu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
करि प्रनाम पूजा कर जोरी ।
बोले गिरा अमिअँ जनु बोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranām pūjā kar jorī
bole girā amiam̐ janu borī

verses.sa:
तुम्हरी कृपाँ सुनहु मुनिराजा ।
भयउँ आजु मैं पूरनकाजा ॥
verses.tr:
tumharī kṛpām̐ sunahu munirājā
bhayaum̐ āju maiṃ pūranakājā

verses.sa:
अब सब बिप्र बोलाइ गोसाईं ।
देहु धेनु सब भाँति बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
ab sab bipr bolāi gosāīṃ
dehu dhenu sab bhām̐ti banāī

verses.sa:
सुनि गुर करि महिपाल बड़ाई ।
पुनि पठए मुनि बृंद बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni gur kari mahipāl bar̤āī
puni paṭhae muni bṛṃd bolāī

verses.sa:
बामदेउ अरु देवरिषि बालमीकि जाबालि ।
आए मुनिबर निकर तब कौसिकादि तपसालि ॥
verses.tr:
bāmadeu aru devariṣi bālamīki jābāli
āe munibar nikar tab kausikādi tapasāli
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There was ever some new rejoicing in the city, and the whole day and night seemed gone like a minute. At early dawn the best of monarchs woke, and mendicants began to chant his praises. As he gazed upon the gallant princes and their brides, the rapture of his soul was beyond all telling. After performing his morning devotions he went to his guru, with his heart full of love and exultation and clasping his hands in prayer bowed before him and said with a voice of mellifluous sweetness:—*‘Hearken, king of saints; it is by your favour that to-day my toils have been rewarded. Now holy father, summon the BrAhmans and present them all with cows with costly adornments.” On hearing these words the guru much applauded the king, and sent to summon the whole saintly throng.
Then came Vamadeva and Narad and Valmiki and Jabali and Visvamitra and all the other great saints and ascetics.

sections.label: Doha 331
sections.name: बार बार कौसिक चरन सीसु नाइ कह राउ

verses.sa:
दंड प्रनाम सबहि नृप कीन्हे ।
पूजि सप्रेम बरासन दीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
daṃḍ pranām sabahi nṛp kīnhe
pūji saprem barāsan dīnhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चारि लच्छ बर धेनु मगाई ।
कामसुरभि सम सील सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
cāri lacch bar dhenu magāī
kāmasurabhi sam sīl suhāī

verses.sa:
सब बिधि सकल अलंकृत कीन्हीं ।
मुदित महिप महिदेवन्ह दीन्हीं ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi sakal alaṃkṛt kīnhīṃ
mudit mahip mahidevanh dīnhīṃ

verses.sa:
करत बिनय बहु बिधि नरनाहू ।
लहेउँ आजु जग जीवन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
karat binaya bahu bidhi naranāhū
laheum̐ āju jag jīvan lāhū

verses.sa:
पाइ असीस महीसु अनंदा ।
लिए बोलि पुनि जाचक बृंदा ॥
verses.tr:
pāi asīs mahīsu anaṃdā
lie boli puni jācak bṛṃdā

verses.sa:
कनक बसन मनि हय गय स्यंदन ।
दिए बूझि रुचि रबिकुलनंदन ॥
verses.tr:
kanak basan mani haya gaya syaṃdan
die būjhi ruci rabikulanaṃdan

verses.sa:
चले पढ़त गावत गुन गाथा ।
जय जय जय दिनकर कुल नाथा ॥
verses.tr:
cale par̤hat gāvat gun gāthā
jaya jaya jaya dinakar kul nāthā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि राम बिआह उछाहू ।
सकइ न बरनि सहस मुख जाहू ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi rām biāh uchāhū
sakai na barani sahas mukh jāhū

verses.sa:
बार बार कौसिक चरन सीसु नाइ कह राउ ।
यह सबु सुखु मुनिराज तव कृपा कटाच्छ पसाउ ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār kausik caran sīsu nāi kah rāu
yah sabu sukhu munirāj tav kṛpā kaṭācch pasāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king threw himself upon the ground before them all and ‘worshipped them, and then conducted them to seats, of honour. Next he sent for 4,00, cows, all as gentle and beautiful as the cow of paradise, and after decorating them in every possible way bestowed them with great joy upon the saints, with many a phrase of studied humility declaring it to be the happiest day of his whole life. On receiving their blessing the king, the pride of the solar race, rejoiced, and next sent for all the begging fraternity and gave them, according as each desired, gold, or apparel, or jewels, or horses, or elephants, or chariots. They all left loudly telling and: singing his praises:—‘glory, glory, glory to the lord of the Sun-gods's race.’ Such were the‘ rejoicings at Rama’s beyond all that could be told even had I a thousand tongues.
Again and again the lord bowed his head at Visvamitra’s feet:—‘' All this happiness, O king of saints, is the result of your benignant regard.”

sections.label: Doha 332
sections.name: अवधनाथु चाहत चलन भीतर करहु जनाउ

verses.sa:
जनक सनेहु सीलु करतूती ।
नृपु सब भाँति सराह बिभूती ॥
verses.tr:
janak sanehu sīlu karatūtī
nṛpu sab bhām̐ti sarāh bibhūtī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दिन उठि बिदा अवधपति मागा ।
राखहिं जनकु सहित अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
din uṭhi bidā avadhapati māgā
rākhahiṃ janaku sahit anurāgā

verses.sa:
नित नूतन आदरु अधिकाई ।
दिन प्रति सहस भाँति पहुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
nit nūtan ādaru adhikāī
din prati sahas bhām̐ti pahunāī

verses.sa:
नित नव नगर अनंद उछाहू ।
दसरथ गवनु सोहाइ न काहू ॥
verses.tr:
nit nav nagar anaṃd uchāhū
dasarath gavanu sohāi na kāhū

verses.sa:
बहुत दिवस बीते एहि भाँती ।
जनु सनेह रजु बँधे बराती ॥
verses.tr:
bahut divas bīte ehi bhām̐tī
janu saneh raju bam̐dhe barātī

verses.sa:
कौसिक सतानंद तब जाई ।
कहा बिदेह नृपहि समुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
kausik satānaṃd tab jāī
kahā bideh nṛpahi samujhāī

verses.sa:
अब दसरथ कहँ आयसु देहू ।
जद्यपि छाड़ि न सकहु सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
ab dasarath kaham̐ āyasu dehū
jadyapi chār̤i na sakahu sanehū

verses.sa:
भलेहिं नाथ कहि सचिव बोलाए ।
कहि जय जीव सीस तिन्ह नाए ॥
verses.tr:
bhalehiṃ nāth kahi saciv bolāe
kahi jaya jīv sīs tinh nāe

verses.sa:
अवधनाथु चाहत चलन भीतर करहु जनाउ ।
भए प्रेमबस सचिव सुनि बिप्र सभासद राउ ॥
verses.tr:
avadhanāthu cāhat calan bhītar karahu janāu
bhae premabas saciv suni bipr sabhāsad rāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: King Dasarath spent the whole night extolling Janak’s affection and amiability god magnificence; every day on rising be asked permission to return home, but Janak would lovingly detain him. ‘There was constantly some new fete in his honour, and every day athousand different kinds of entertainment. ‘The rejoicings in the city never flagged, and no one liked to think of Dasarath’s departure. In this manner many days were spent, and the guests were fast bound by the cords of Love, till Visvamitra and Sat^nand went and told Videha’s lord:—“ You must now let Dasarath take his leave, even though you cannot part with your love for him.” The king replied: —‘ It is well,’ and summoned his ministers, who came and bowed the head crying:—‘ All hail!’
‘Make it known in the palace that Avadh’s lord wishes to depart.” At these words the ministers, Brahmans, couo-sellers and princes were greatly moved.

sections.label: Doha 333
sections.name: दाइज अमित न सकिअ कहि दीन्ह बिदेहँ बहोरि

verses.sa:
पुरबासी सुनि चलिहि बराता ।
बूझत बिकल परस्पर बाता ॥
verses.tr:
purabāsī suni calihi barātā
būjhat bikal paraspar bātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सत्य गवनु सुनि सब बिलखाने ।
मनहुँ साँझ सरसिज सकुचाने ॥
verses.tr:
satya gavanu suni sab bilakhāne
manahum̐ sām̐jh sarasij sakucāne

verses.sa:
जहँ जहँ आवत बसे बराती ।
तहँ तहँ सिद्ध चला बहु भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jaham̐ āvat base barātī
taham̐ taham̐ siddh calā bahu bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
बिबिध भाँति मेवा पकवाना ।
भोजन साजु न जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bhām̐ti mevā pakavānā
bhojan sāju na jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
भरि भरि बसहँ अपार कहारा ।
पठई जनक अनेक सुसारा ॥
verses.tr:
bhari bhari basaham̐ apār kahārā
paṭhaī janak anek susārā

verses.sa:
तुरग लाख रथ सहस पचीसा ।
सकल सँवारे नख अरु सीसा ॥
verses.tr:
turag lākh rath sahas pacīsā
sakal sam̐vāre nakh aru sīsā

verses.sa:
मत्त सहस दस सिंधुर साजे ।
जिन्हहि देखि दिसिकुंजर लाजे ॥
verses.tr:
matt sahas das siṃdhur sāje
jinhahi dekhi disikuṃjar lāje

verses.sa:
कनक बसन मनि भरि भरि जाना ।
महिषीं धेनु बस्तु बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
kanak basan mani bhari bhari jānā
mahiṣīṃ dhenu bastu bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
दाइज अमित न सकिअ कहि दीन्ह बिदेहँ बहोरि ।
जो अवलोकत लोकपति लोक संपदा थोरि ॥
verses.tr:
dāij amit na sakia kahi dīnh bideham̐ bahori
jo avalokat lokapati lok saṃpadā thori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “: When it was noised in the city that the guests were leaving, every one anxiously asked his neighbour if it were afact. When they heard they were actually going all were as unhappy as a lotus that fades in the evening. Every place where the visitors had put up on their arrival was crowded with parting presents!, fruits and confections of every kind, and dishes too various for description. A multitude of porters laden with wearing apparel and cooks beyond number were sent by Janak with 1,00, horses and 25, chariots all exquisitely finished throughout, with 10, powerful elephants duly caparisoned, at sight of which earth's. guardian elephants would feel ashamed of themselves, besides wagons full of gold and raiment and jewels; buffaloes also and cows, and things of all kinds.
The dowry moreover, given by Videha's king was immeasurable and beyond all telling; and Indra, had he seen it, would have thought the riches of the universe as nothing in comparison.,.

sections.label: Doha 334
sections.name: तेहि अवसर भाइन्ह सहित रामु भानु कुल केतु

verses.sa:
सबु समाजु एहि भाँति बनाई ।
जनक अवधपुर दीन्ह पठाई ॥
verses.tr:
sabu samāju ehi bhām̐ti banāī
janak avadhapur dīnh paṭhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चलिहि बरात सुनत सब रानीं ।
बिकल मीनगन जनु लघु पानीं ॥
verses.tr:
calihi barāt sunat sab rānīṃ
bikal mīnagan janu laghu pānīṃ

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि सीय गोद करि लेहीं ।
देइ असीस सिखावनु देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni sīya god kari lehīṃ
dei asīs sikhāvanu dehīṃ

verses.sa:
होएहु संतत पियहि पिआरी ।
चिरु अहिबात असीस हमारी ॥
verses.tr:
hoehu saṃtat piyahi piārī
ciru ahibāt asīs hamārī

verses.sa:
सासु ससुर गुर सेवा करेहू ।
पति रुख लखि आयसु अनुसरेहू ॥
verses.tr:
sāsu sasur gur sevā karehū
pati rukh lakhi āyasu anusarehū

verses.sa:
अति सनेह बस सखीं सयानी ।
नारि धरम सिखवहिं मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
ati saneh bas sakhīṃ sayānī
nāri dharam sikhavahiṃ mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
सादर सकल कुअँरि समुझाई ।
रानिन्ह बार बार उर लाई ॥
verses.tr:
sādar sakal kuam̐ri samujhāī
rāninh bār bār ur lāī

verses.sa:
बहुरि बहुरि भेटहिं महतारीं ।
कहहिं बिरंचि रचीं कत नारीं ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri bahuri bheṭahiṃ mahatārīṃ
kahahiṃ biraṃci racīṃ kat nārīṃ

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर भाइन्ह सहित रामु भानु कुल केतु ।
चले जनक मंदिर मुदित बिदा करावन हेतु ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar bhāinh sahit rāmu bhānu kul ketu
cale janak maṃdir mudit bidā karāvan hetu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the whole equipage had been thus arranged, Janak despatched it to Avadh. On hearing that the guests were about to start, all the queens were as unhappy 48 fish when water falls. Again and again they clasped Sita to their bosom and blessed and exhorted her, saying: “May you ever be beloved by your husband, and with him live a long and happy life; this is my blessing. Be obedient to your new father and mother and guru, and regarding your lord’s displeasure’ do as he bids.” Her sweet-voiced companions, too, in their overpowering affection reminded her of woman’s crowning duty. Again and

tobably stands for sidhya ‘auspicious,’ though it again after thus duly admonishing them the queens clasped the four brides to their bosom, and time after time, in the midst of their maternal embraces, exclaimed:—' Why has God made women?’ > ig
; Theo came the joyous Rama, the glory of the Solar race, with his brothers, to Janak’s palace to take leave.

sections.label: Doha 335
sections.name: रूप सिंधु सब बंधु लखि हरषि उठा रनिवासु

verses.sa:
चारिअ भाइ सुभायँ सुहाए ।
नगर नारि नर देखन धाए ॥
verses.tr:
cāria bhāi subhāyam̐ suhāe
nagar nāri nar dekhan dhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोउ कह चलन चहत हहिं आजू ।
कीन्ह बिदेह बिदा कर साजू ॥
verses.tr:
kou kah calan cahat hahiṃ ājū
kīnh bideh bidā kar sājū

verses.sa:
लेहु नयन भरि रूप निहारी ।
प्रिय पाहुने भूप सुत चारी ॥
verses.tr:
lehu nayan bhari rūp nihārī
priya pāhune bhūp sut cārī

verses.sa:
को जानै केहि सुकृत सयानी ।
नयन अतिथि कीन्हे बिधि आनी ॥
verses.tr:
ko jānai kehi sukṛt sayānī
nayan atithi kīnhe bidhi ānī

verses.sa:
मरनसीलु जिमि पाव पिऊषा ।
सुरतरु लहै जनम कर भूखा ॥
verses.tr:
maranasīlu jimi pāv piūṣā
surataru lahai janam kar bhūkhā

verses.sa:
पाव नारकी हरिपदु जैसें ।
इन्ह कर दरसनु हम कहँ तैसे ॥
verses.tr:
pāv nārakī haripadu jaiseṃ
inh kar darasanu ham kaham̐ taise

verses.sa:
निरखि राम सोभा उर धरहू ।
निज मन फनि मूरति मनि करहू ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi rām sobhā ur dharahū
nij man phani mūrati mani karahū

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सबहि नयन फलु देता ।
गए कुअँर सब राज निकेता ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sabahi nayan phalu detā
gae kuam̐r sab rāj niketā

verses.sa:
रूप सिंधु सब बंधु लखि हरषि उठा रनिवासु ।
करहि निछावरि आरती महा मुदित मन सासु ॥
verses.tr:
rūp siṃdhu sab baṃdhu lakhi haraṣi uṭhā ranivāsu
karahi nichāvari āratī mahā mudit man sāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All the people of the city, whether men or women, ran to see the four brothers so lovely and so unaffected. Said one:—‘ To-day they have made up their mind to go, and Janak has completed all the preparations for their departure; so feast your eyes on their beauty for the last time. All four princes have been most welcome visitors; who can say; friend, what we have done to deserve that god should bring our eyes such guests. Like a man at the point of death who is given ambrosia; or as one who has been hungry all his life and discovers the tree of paradise; or as one of the damned in hell who approaches Hari’s feet, so am I after seeing them. Gaze upon Rama’s beauty and treasure his image in your heart, as it were the jewel in a serpent’s hood.” In this manner the princes gladdened the eyes of all as they proceeded to the palace.
The ladies all rose in their joys they beheld their exquisite beauty; and the mothers of the brides, in token of their delight, pass the lustral lamp around their heads and scatter gifts.

sections.label: Doha 336
sections.name: तुम्ह परिपूरन काम जान सिरोमनि भावप्रिय

verses.sa:
देखि राम छबि अति अनुरागीं ।
प्रेमबिबस पुनि पुनि पद लागीं ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām chabi ati anurāgīṃ
premabibas puni puni pad lāgīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रही न लाज प्रीति उर छाई ।
सहज सनेहु बरनि किमि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
rahī na lāj prīti ur chāī
sahaj sanehu barani kimi jāī

verses.sa:
भाइन्ह सहित उबटि अन्हवाए ।
छरस असन अति हेतु जेवाँए ॥
verses.tr:
bhāinh sahit ubaṭi anhavāe
charas asan ati hetu jevām̐e

verses.sa:
बोले रामु सुअवसरु जानी ।
सील सनेह सकुचमय बानी ॥
verses.tr:
bole rāmu suavasaru jānī
sīl saneh sakucamaya bānī

verses.sa:
राउ अवधपुर चहत सिधाए ।
बिदा होन हम इहाँ पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
rāu avadhapur cahat sidhāe
bidā hon ham ihām̐ paṭhāe

verses.sa:
मातु मुदित मन आयसु देहू ।
बालक जानि करब नित नेहू ॥
verses.tr:
mātu mudit man āyasu dehū
bālak jāni karab nit nehū

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन बिलखेउ रनिवासू ।
बोलि न सकहिं प्रेमबस सासू ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan bilakheu ranivāsū
boli na sakahiṃ premabas sāsū

verses.sa:
हृदयँ लगाइ कुअँरि सब लीन्ही ।
पतिन्ह सौंपि बिनती अति कीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ lagāi kuam̐ri sab līnhī
patinh sauṃpi binatī ati kīnhī

verses.sa:
करि बिनय सिय रामहि समरपी जोरि कर पुनि पुनि कहै ।
बलि जाँउ तात सुजान तुम्ह कहुँ बिदित गति सब की अहै ॥
verses.tr:
kari binaya siya rāmahi samarapī jori kar puni puni kahai
bali jām̐u tāt sujān tumh kahum̐ bidit gati sab kī ahai
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
परिवार पुरजन मोहि राजहि प्रानप्रिय सिय जानिबी ।
तुलसीस सीलु सनेहु लखि निज किंकरी करि मानिबी ॥
verses.tr:
parivār purajan mohi rājahi prānapriya siya jānibī
tulasīs sīlu sanehu lakhi nij kiṃkarī kari mānibī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह परिपूरन काम जान सिरोमनि भावप्रिय ।
जन गुन गाहक राम दोष दलन करुनायतन ॥
verses.tr:
tumh paripūran kām jān siromani bhāvapriya
jan gun gāhak rām doṣ dalan karunāyatan
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Full of love at the vision of Rama's beauty, the affectionately fall at his feet again and again, nor are conscious of shame, so rapt is their soul in devotion and an involuntary attachment beyond all description. After bathing him and his brothers and rubbing his body with cosmetics, they lovingly entertain him at a banquet of the six flavours. Then seeing that the time had come, Rama said to them in the most amiable, loving and modest tone: “The king is desirous of starting for Avadh and has sent us to take leave of you. © mother, be pleased to give me your commands and ever regard me with affection as your own child.” At these words the queens grieved sore and were too overcome by love to speak a word, but clasped their daughters to their bosom and then meekly gave them to their lords.

Meekly her mother surrendered Sita to Rama, crying again and again with hands clasped in prayer:—‘Ah, my son, you, | ween, are all-wise, and to you are apparent the thought of all men. Know well that Sita is dear as life to the king and myself, nay, to all her kinsfolk and all the people of the city; consider her amiability and her affection and accept her as your own servant.
You are the fullness of desire, the crown of wisdom, the beloved of the universe, quick to recognize merit in your votaries, destroyer of evil, Rama the all merciful.”

sections.label: Doha 337
sections.name: प्रेमबिबस नर नारि सब सखिन्ह सहित रनिवासु

verses.sa:
अस कहि रही चरन गहि रानी ।
प्रेम पंक जनु गिरा समानी ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi rahī caran gahi rānī
prem paṃk janu girā samānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि सनेहसानी बर बानी ।
बहुबिधि राम सासु सनमानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni sanehasānī bar bānī
bahubidhi rām sāsu sanamānī

verses.sa:
राम बिदा मागत कर जोरी ।
कीन्ह प्रनामु बहोरि बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
rām bidā māgat kar jorī
kīnh pranāmu bahori bahorī

verses.sa:
पाइ असीस बहुरि सिरु नाई ।
भाइन्ह सहित चले रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
pāi asīs bahuri siru nāī
bhāinh sahit cale raghurāī

verses.sa:
मंजु मधुर मूरति उर आनी ।
भई सनेह सिथिल सब रानी ॥
verses.tr:
maṃju madhur mūrati ur ānī
bhaī saneh sithil sab rānī

verses.sa:
पुनि धीरजु धरि कुअँरि हँकारी ।
बार बार भेटहिं महतारीं ॥
verses.tr:
puni dhīraju dhari kuam̐ri ham̐kārī
bār bār bheṭahiṃ mahatārīṃ

verses.sa:
पहुँचावहिं फिरि मिलहिं बहोरी ।
बढ़ी परस्पर प्रीति न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
pahum̐cāvahiṃ phiri milahiṃ bahorī
bar̤hī paraspar prīti na thorī

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि मिलत सखिन्ह बिलगाई ।
बाल बच्छ जिमि धेनु लवाई ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni milat sakhinh bilagāī
bāl bacch jimi dhenu lavāī

verses.sa:
प्रेमबिबस नर नारि सब सखिन्ह सहित रनिवासु ।
मानहुँ कीन्ह बिदेहपुर करुनाँ बिरहँ निवासु ॥
verses.tr:
premabibas nar nāri sab sakhinh sahit ranivāsu
mānahum̐ kīnh bidehapur karunām̐ biraham̐ nivāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: So saying, the queens still clung to his feet and their voice seemed lost as it were in the quickstands of love. On hearing their most affectionate address, Rama showed them the highest honour, and with clasped hands begged his conge again and again making them obeisance. When he had received their blessing, he bowed once more and then with his brothers took his leave. Treasuring up his sweet and gracious image in their heart, the queens at first seemed paralyzed by excess of love: bat summoning up courage they called their daughters and again and again gave them a maternal embrace: then leading them a few steps would take them to their arms yet again with ever-growing mutual love. Time after time they left their attendants
for yet one more last embrace, asa heifer not yet weaned from the cow.
Kvery one in the palace, attendant and all, were so overpowered by emotion that it seemed as though they had

sections.label: Doha 338
sections.name: प्रेमबिबस परिवारु सबु जानि सुलगन नरेस

verses.sa:
सुक सारिका जानकी ज्याए ।
कनक पिंजरन्हि राखि पढ़ाए ॥
verses.tr:
suk sārikā jānakī jyāe
kanak piṃjaranhi rākhi par̤hāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्याकुल कहहिं कहाँ बैदेही ।
सुनि धीरजु परिहरइ न केही ॥
verses.tr:
byākul kahahiṃ kahām̐ baidehī
suni dhīraju pariharai na kehī

verses.sa:
भए बिकल खग मृग एहि भाँति ।
मनुज दसा कैसें कहि जाती ॥
verses.tr:
bhae bikal khag mṛg ehi bhām̐ti
manuj dasā kaiseṃ kahi jātī

verses.sa:
बंधु समेत जनकु तब आए ।
प्रेम उमगि लोचन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhu samet janaku tab āe
prem umagi locan jal chāe

verses.sa:
सीय बिलोकि धीरता भागी ।
रहे कहावत परम बिरागी ॥
verses.tr:
sīya biloki dhīratā bhāgī
rahe kahāvat param birāgī

verses.sa:
लीन्हि राँय उर लाइ जानकी ।
मिटी महामरजाद ग्यान की ॥
verses.tr:
līnhi rām̐ya ur lāi jānakī
miṭī mahāmarajād gyān kī

verses.sa:
समुझावत सब सचिव सयाने ।
कीन्ह बिचारु न अवसर जाने ॥
verses.tr:
samujhāvat sab saciv sayāne
kīnh bicāru na avasar jāne

verses.sa:
बारहिं बार सुता उर लाई ।
सजि सुंदर पालकीं मगाई ॥
verses.tr:
bārahiṃ bār sutā ur lāī
saji suṃdar pālakīṃ magāī

verses.sa:
प्रेमबिबस परिवारु सबु जानि सुलगन नरेस ।
कुँअरि चढ़ाई पालकिन्ह सुमिरे सिद्धि गनेस ॥
verses.tr:
premabibas parivāru sabu jāni sulagan nares
kum̐ari car̤hāī pālakinh sumire siddhi ganes
verses.head: दोहा

trans: made the city of Videha the very home of piteousness and lovers’ partings.;

The pet parrots and mainas, that Janaki had kept in golden cages and taught to speak, cry in their agitation:— ‘Where is the princes?’ and, on hearing, which of them was not robbed of all peace of mind? When birds and beasts were thus distrest, how can the feelings of the people be told’ Then came Janak with his brother (Kusa-dhvaja) overflowing with love and his eyes full of tears. As he gazed upon Sita, all his courage deserted him and his eminent asceticism lasted but in name. As he clasped Janaki to his bosom the stronghold of his stern philosophy was broken down. All his wise counsellors admonished him; and seeing the unfitness of the time he recovered himself, and again and again taking his daughter to his heart he ordered a gorgeous palki to be got ready.

The whole court was overpowered with emotion, when the king, perceiving that theauspicious moment had arrived, ' seated the bride in the palki, with his thoughts intent upon Ganes, the author of success.

sections.label: Doha 339
sections.name: सुर प्रसून बरषहि हरषि करहिं अपछरा गान

verses.sa:
बहुबिधि भूप सुता समुझाई ।
नारिधरमु कुलरीति सिखाई ॥
verses.tr:
bahubidhi bhūp sutā samujhāī
nāridharamu kularīti sikhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दासीं दास दिए बहुतेरे ।
सुचि सेवक जे प्रिय सिय केरे ॥
verses.tr:
dāsīṃ dās die bahutere
suci sevak je priya siya kere

verses.sa:
सीय चलत ब्याकुल पुरबासी ।
होहिं सगुन सुभ मंगल रासी ॥
verses.tr:
sīya calat byākul purabāsī
hohiṃ sagun subh maṃgal rāsī

verses.sa:
भूसुर सचिव समेत समाजा ।
संग चले पहुँचावन राजा ॥
verses.tr:
bhūsur saciv samet samājā
saṃg cale pahum̐cāvan rājā

verses.sa:
समय बिलोकि बाजने बाजे ।
रथ गज बाजि बरातिन्ह साजे ॥
verses.tr:
samaya biloki bājane bāje
rath gaj bāji barātinh sāje

verses.sa:
दसरथ बिप्र बोलि सब लीन्हे ।
दान मान परिपूरन कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
dasarath bipr boli sab līnhe
dān mān paripūran kīnhe

verses.sa:
चरन सरोज धूरि धरि सीसा ।
मुदित महीपति पाइ असीसा ॥
verses.tr:
caran saroj dhūri dhari sīsā
mudit mahīpati pāi asīsā

verses.sa:
सुमिरि गजाननु कीन्ह पयाना ।
मंगलमूल सगुन भए नाना ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri gajānanu kīnh payānā
maṃgalamūl sagun bhae nānā

verses.sa:
सुर प्रसून बरषहि हरषि करहिं अपछरा गान ।
चले अवधपति अवधपुर मुदित बजाइ निसान ॥
verses.tr:
sur prasūn baraṣahi haraṣi karahiṃ apacharā gān
cale avadhapati avadhapur mudit bajāi nisān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The monarch gave his daughter much advice and instructed her in the whole duty of women and in family customs. He bestowed upon her many men-servants and maid-servants and all her own favourite attendants. As she went on her way the citizens were in distress, but all good signs and auspicious omens were forthcoming. Brahman's and ministers with all their retinue joined company to escort the Raja. The wedding-guests made ready their chariots and elephants and horses, and there was a tumultuous noise of music. Then Dasarath called up all the Brahmans and gratified them with gifts and compliments, and putting the dust of their lotus feet upon his head rejoiced—great king as he was—to obtain their benison. As he set forthon his way with his thoughts on Ganes, every omen of good occurred.
The gods rained down flowers, the heavenly nymphs sang for joy, as the king of Avadh set forth for his capital ’midst the clash of jubilant music.

sections.label: Doha 340
sections.name: कोसलपति समधी सजन सनमाने सब भाँति

verses.sa:
नृप करि बिनय महाजन फेरे ।
सादर सकल मागने टेरे ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp kari binaya mahājan phere
sādar sakal māgane ṭere
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भूषन बसन बाजि गज दीन्हे ।
प्रेम पोषि ठाढ़े सब कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
bhūṣan basan bāji gaj dīnhe
prem poṣi ṭhār̤he sab kīnhe

verses.sa:
बार बार बिरिदावलि भाषी ।
फिरे सकल रामहि उर राखी ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār biridāvali bhāṣī
phire sakal rāmahi ur rākhī

verses.sa:
बहुरि बहुरि कोसलपति कहहीं ।
जनकु प्रेमबस फिरै न चहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri bahuri kosalapati kahahīṃ
janaku premabas phirai na cahahīṃ

verses.sa:
पुनि कह भूपति बचन सुहाए ।
फिरिअ महीस दूरि बड़ि आए ॥
verses.tr:
puni kah bhūpati bacan suhāe
phiria mahīs dūri bar̤i āe

verses.sa:
राउ बहोरि उतरि भए ठाढ़े ।
प्रेम प्रबाह बिलोचन बाढ़े ॥
verses.tr:
rāu bahori utari bhae ṭhār̤he
prem prabāh bilocan bār̤he

verses.sa:
तब बिदेह बोले कर जोरी ।
बचन सनेह सुधाँ जनु बोरी ॥
verses.tr:
tab bideh bole kar jorī
bacan saneh sudhām̐ janu borī

verses.sa:
करौ कवन बिधि बिनय बनाई ।
महाराज मोहि दीन्हि बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
karau kavan bidhi binaya banāī
mahārāj mohi dīnhi bar̤āī

verses.sa:
कोसलपति समधी सजन सनमाने सब भाँति ।
मिलनि परसपर बिनय अति प्रीति न हृदयँ समाति ॥
verses.tr:
kosalapati samadhī sajan sanamāne sab bhām̐ti
milani parasapar binaya ati prīti na hṛdayam̐ samāti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Courteously the king dismissed the burghers and reverently bade all the mendicants approach and bestowed upon them ornaments and clothes and horses and elephants, and affectionately cherishing them made them stand up before him. After again and again reciting his praises they turned

home with Rama in their heart. Though Kosala’s lord spoke time after time, Janak in his exceeding love would not turn back. Once more said the king in gracious tones:— ‘I beg you to turn back, sire; you have come a great distance.’ At last he dismounted and remained standing, his eyes overflowing with love’s torrent. Then said Videba’s Lord with folded hands and in a voice fraught with the ambrosia of affection:—‘How can I fitly express my unworthiness, on whom my lord has conferred such high honoar?”
Kosala’s king in return showed the profoundest respect to the father of the bride and his retinue; and as they embraced with mutual courtesy their heart could not contain the love they felt.

sections.label: Doha 341
sections.name: नयन बिषय मो कहुँ भयउ सो समस्त सुख मूल

verses.sa:
मुनि मंडलिहि जनक सिरु नावा ।
आसिरबादु सबहि सन पावा ॥
verses.tr:
muni maṃḍalihi janak siru nāvā
āsirabādu sabahi san pāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सादर पुनि भेंटे जामाता ।
रूप सील गुन निधि सब भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
sādar puni bheṃṭe jāmātā
rūp sīl gun nidhi sab bhrātā

verses.sa:
जोरि पंकरुह पानि सुहाए ।
बोले बचन प्रेम जनु जाए ॥
verses.tr:
jori paṃkaruh pāni suhāe
bole bacan prem janu jāe

verses.sa:
राम करौ केहि भाँति प्रसंसा ।
मुनि महेस मन मानस हंसा ॥
verses.tr:
rām karau kehi bhām̐ti prasaṃsā
muni mahes man mānas haṃsā

verses.sa:
करहिं जोग जोगी जेहि लागी ।
कोहु मोहु ममता मदु त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ jog jogī jehi lāgī
kohu mohu mamatā madu tyāgī

verses.sa:
ब्यापकु ब्रह्मु अलखु अबिनासी ।
चिदानंदु निरगुन गुनरासी ॥
verses.tr:
byāpaku brahmu alakhu abināsī
cidānaṃdu niragun gunarāsī

verses.sa:
मन समेत जेहि जान न बानी ।
तरकि न सकहिं सकल अनुमानी ॥
verses.tr:
man samet jehi jān na bānī
taraki na sakahiṃ sakal anumānī

verses.sa:
महिमा निगमु नेति कहि कहई ।
जो तिहुँ काल एकरस रहई ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā nigamu neti kahi kahaī
jo tihum̐ kāl ekaras rahaī

verses.sa:
नयन बिषय मो कहुँ भयउ सो समस्त सुख मूल ।
सबइ लाभु जग जीव कहँ भएँ ईसु अनुकुल ॥
verses.tr:
nayan biṣaya mo kahum̐ bhayau so samast sukh mūl
sabai lābhu jag jīv kaham̐ bhaem̐ īsu anukul
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Janak bowed his head to the throng of saints and received a blessing from all. Next he reverently saluted his sons-in-law, the four brothers, each a treasure of beauty, amiability and accomplishments: and clasping his gracious lotus hands he cried in accents begotten of love:—“ O Rama how can I tell thy praise; swan of the Manas lake of the saints and Mahadeva’s souls; for whose sake ascetics practise their asceticism; devoid of anger, infatuation, selfishness and pride; the all-pervading Brahm, the invisible, the immortal, the supreme spirit, at once the sum and negation of all qualities; whom neither words nor fancy can portray whom all philosophy fails to expound; whose greatness the divine oracles declare unutterable, and who remainest the selfsame in all] time, past, present, or future?
Source of every joy, thou hast revealed thyself to my material vision; for nothing in the world is beyond the reach of him to whom God is propitious.

sections.label: Doha 342
sections.name: मिले लखन रिपुसूदनहि दीन्हि असीस महीस

verses.sa:
सबहि भाँति मोहि दीन्हि बड़ाई ।
निज जन जानि लीन्ह अपनाई ॥
verses.tr:
sabahi bhām̐ti mohi dīnhi bar̤āī
nij jan jāni līnh apanāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
होहिं सहस दस सारद सेषा ।
करहिं कलप कोटिक भरि लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
hohiṃ sahas das sārad seṣā
karahiṃ kalap koṭik bhari lekhā

verses.sa:
मोर भाग्य राउर गुन गाथा ।
कहि न सिराहिं सुनहु रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
mor bhāgya rāur gun gāthā
kahi na sirāhiṃ sunahu raghunāthā

verses.sa:
मै कछु कहउँ एक बल मोरें ।
तुम्ह रीझहु सनेह सुठि थोरें ॥
verses.tr:
mai kachu kahaum̐ ek bal moreṃ
tumh rījhahu saneh suṭhi thoreṃ

verses.sa:
बार बार मागउँ कर जोरें ।
मनु परिहरै चरन जनि भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār māgaum̐ kar joreṃ
manu pariharai caran jani bhoreṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि बर बचन प्रेम जनु पोषे ।
पूरनकाम रामु परितोषे ॥
verses.tr:
suni bar bacan prem janu poṣe
pūranakām rāmu paritoṣe

verses.sa:
करि बर बिनय ससुर सनमाने ।
पितु कौसिक बसिष्ठ सम जाने ॥
verses.tr:
kari bar binaya sasur sanamāne
pitu kausik basiṣṭh sam jāne

verses.sa:
बिनती बहुरि भरत सन कीन्ही ।
मिलि सप्रेमु पुनि आसिष दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
binatī bahuri bharat san kīnhī
mili sapremu puni āsiṣ dīnhī

verses.sa:
मिले लखन रिपुसूदनहि दीन्हि असीस महीस ।
भए परस्पर प्रेमबस फिरि फिरि नावहिं सीस ॥
verses.tr:
mile lakhan ripusūdanahi dīnhi asīs mahīs
bhae paraspar premabas phiri phiri nāvahiṃ sīs
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Thou hast magnified me in every way, and recognizing me as one of thy servants hast made me thy very own. Not ten thousand Saeradas and Seshnags, though they kept up their count for a myriad ages, could tell all my good fortune or thy perfections; know this, O Raghunath; yet I have somewhat to say—for I have this ground of confidence that thou art easily appeased by the slightest evidence of affeotion —and therefore time after time I implore with clasped hands that never may my soul he deluded into deserting thy feet.” On hearing these excellent sentiments, the true birth of devotion, even Rama, in whom all pleasure ever dwells, was pleased and with much courtesy saluted his father-in-law, holding him equal to his own sire, or Visvamitra, or Vasishta Next he bowed himself before Bharat and affectionately embraced him and gave him his blessing.
Then the king embraced and blessed both Lakshman and Satrughna, and all again and again bowed the head, being overpowered with mutual love.

sections.label: Doha 343
sections.name: बीच बीच बर बास करि मग लोगन्ह सुख देत

verses.sa:
बार बार करि बिनय बड़ाई ।
रघुपति चले संग सब भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār kari binaya bar̤āī
raghupati cale saṃg sab bhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जनक गहे कौसिक पद जाई ।
चरन रेनु सिर नयनन्ह लाई ॥
verses.tr:
janak gahe kausik pad jāī
caran renu sir nayananh lāī

verses.sa:
सुनु मुनीस बर दरसन तोरें ।
अगमु न कछु प्रतीति मन मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
sunu munīs bar darasan toreṃ
agamu na kachu pratīti man moreṃ

verses.sa:
जो सुखु सुजसु लोकपति चहहीं ।
करत मनोरथ सकुचत अहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jo sukhu sujasu lokapati cahahīṃ
karat manorath sakucat ahahīṃ

verses.sa:
सो सुखु सुजसु सुलभ मोहि स्वामी ।
सब सिधि तव दरसन अनुगामी ॥
verses.tr:
so sukhu sujasu sulabh mohi svāmī
sab sidhi tav darasan anugāmī

verses.sa:
कीन्हि बिनय पुनि पुनि सिरु नाई ।
फिरे महीसु आसिषा पाई ॥
verses.tr:
kīnhi binaya puni puni siru nāī
phire mahīsu āsiṣā pāī

verses.sa:
चली बरात निसान बजाई ।
मुदित छोट बड़ सब समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
calī barāt nisān bajāī
mudit choṭ bar̤ sab samudāī

verses.sa:
रामहि निरखि ग्राम नर नारी ।
पाइ नयन फलु होहिं सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi nirakhi grām nar nārī
pāi nayan phalu hohiṃ sukhārī

verses.sa:
बीच बीच बर बास करि मग लोगन्ह सुख देत ।
अवध समीप पुनीत दिन पहुँची आइ जनेत ॥
verses.tr:
bīc bīc bar bās kari mag loganh sukh det
avadh samīp punīt din pahum̐cī āi janet
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At last, after many courtesies and flattering speeches, Rama and his brothers proceeded on their way. ‘Then went Janak and clasped Visvamitra by the feet and put the dust of his feet on his head and eyes:—‘' Hearken, ( greatest of saints; now that I have seen you, I am persuaded that nothing is beyond my attainment. Such bliss and glory as the sovereigns of the universe might desire, though they would be ashamed to express their longing, has all, my lord, been brought within my reach, for all prosperity follows upon seeing you.’ After again and again humbly bowing the head, the king received his blessing and took leave. The marriage procession set forth to the sound of music, and the whole popalace, great and small, were all enraptured and, as they gazed upon [tama and feasted their eyes upon him, were happy for life.
Halting at convenient stages on the road, to the great delight of the people, the procession, on an auspicious day drew near to Avadh.

sections.label: Doha 344
sections.name: बिबिध भाँति मंगल कलस गृह गृह रचे सँवारि

verses.sa:
हने निसान पनव बर बाजे ।
भेरि संख धुनि हय गय गाजे ॥
verses.tr:
hane nisān panav bar bāje
bheri saṃkh dhuni haya gaya gāje
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
झाँझि बिरव डिंडमीं सुहाई ।
सरस राग बाजहिं सहनाई ॥
verses.tr:
jhām̐jhi birav ḍiṃḍamīṃ suhāī
saras rāg bājahiṃ sahanāī

verses.sa:
पुर जन आवत अकनि बराता ।
मुदित सकल पुलकावलि गाता ॥
verses.tr:
pur jan āvat akani barātā
mudit sakal pulakāvali gātā

verses.sa:
निज निज सुंदर सदन सँवारे ।
हाट बाट चौहट पुर द्वारे ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij suṃdar sadan sam̐vāre
hāṭ bāṭ cauhaṭ pur dvāre

verses.sa:
गलीं सकल अरगजाँ सिंचाई ।
जहँ तहँ चौकें चारु पुराई ॥
verses.tr:
galīṃ sakal aragajām̐ siṃcāī
jaham̐ taham̐ caukeṃ cāru purāī

verses.sa:
बना बजारु न जाइ बखाना ।
तोरन केतु पताक बिताना ॥
verses.tr:
banā bajāru na jāi bakhānā
toran ketu patāk bitānā

verses.sa:
सफल पूगफल कदलि रसाला ।
रोपे बकुल कदंब तमाला ॥
verses.tr:
saphal pūgaphal kadali rasālā
rope bakul kadaṃb tamālā

verses.sa:
लगे सुभग तरु परसत धरनी ।
मनिमय आलबाल कल करनी ॥
verses.tr:
lage subhag taru parasat dharanī
manimaya ālabāl kal karanī

verses.sa:
बिबिध भाँति मंगल कलस गृह गृह रचे सँवारि ।
सुर ब्रह्मादि सिहाहिं सब रघुबर पुरी निहारि ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bhām̐ti maṃgal kalas gṛh gṛh race sam̐vāri
sur brahmādi sihāhiṃ sab raghubar purī nihāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Midst the beat of kettledrums and noise of many tabors and sackbuts and conches, and a din of horses and elephants, and clash of cymbals and drums and aweet-tuned clarions, when the citizens heard the procession coming, they were all in a tremor of delight, and every one began to decorate his own house and the markets and streets and squares and gates of the city. The whole roadway was watered with perfumes: on every side were festal squares filled in with elegant devices; the show in the bazar was beyond all telling, with wreaths and flags and banners and canopies. Trees of the areca-nut and the plantain and the mango, the mdlsart, the kedamb and the tamdla, were transplanted all laden with fruit, and grew into fine trees as soon as they touched the soil, being set in jewelled screens of exquisite workmanship. Dohe 349.
In house after house festal vases of every kind were ranged in order, and Brahma and all the gods were delighted as they gazed upon’the city of tama.

sections.label: Doha 345
sections.name: दिए दान बिप्रन्ह बिपुल पूजि गनेस पुरारी

verses.sa:
भूप भवन तेहि अवसर सोहा ।
रचना देखि मदन मनु मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bhavan tehi avasar sohā
racanā dekhi madan manu mohā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मंगल सगुन मनोहरताई ।
रिधि सिधि सुख संपदा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal sagun manoharatāī
ridhi sidhi sukh saṃpadā suhāī

verses.sa:
जनु उछाह सब सहज सुहाए ।
तनु धरि धरि दसरथ दसरथ गृहँ छाए ॥
verses.tr:
janu uchāh sab sahaj suhāe
tanu dhari dhari dasarath dasarath gṛham̐ chāe

verses.sa:
देखन हेतु राम बैदेही ।
कहहु लालसा होहि न केही ॥
verses.tr:
dekhan hetu rām baidehī
kahahu lālasā hohi na kehī

verses.sa:
जुथ जूथ मिलि चलीं सुआसिनि ।
निज छबि निदरहिं मदन बिलासनि ॥
verses.tr:
juth jūth mili calīṃ suāsini
nij chabi nidarahiṃ madan bilāsani

verses.sa:
सकल सुमंगल सजें आरती ।
गावहिं जनु बहु बेष भारती ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sumaṃgal sajeṃ āratī
gāvahiṃ janu bahu beṣ bhāratī

verses.sa:
भूपति भवन कोलाहलु होई ।
जाइ न बरनि समउ सुखु सोई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūpati bhavan kolāhalu hoī
jāi na barani samau sukhu soī

verses.sa:
कौसल्यादि राम महतारीं ।
प्रेम बिबस तन दसा बिसारीं ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyādi rām mahatārīṃ
prem bibas tan dasā bisārīṃ

verses.sa:
दिए दान बिप्रन्ह बिपुल पूजि गनेस पुरारी ।
प्रमुदित परम दरिद्र जनु पाइ पदारथ चारि ॥
verses.tr:
die dān bipranh bipul pūji ganes purārī
pramudit param daridr janu pāi padārath cāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At that time the king’s palace was so resplendent that the god of love was distracted by the sight of such magnificence, It was as though everything auspicious and of good omen and all beauty, all plenteousness and prosperity and joy and felicity and gladness had come in bodily form to visit King Dasarath. There wasa universal longing to geta sight of Rama and Janaki. Troops of fair women were crowding together, each exceeding in loveliness the Lovegod’s queen, all with festal offerings and torches and singing, as it were so many Sarasvati. The rejoicings in the palace at that glad time are beyond all description. Rtdm’s mother Kausalya and the other queens were too overcome with love to think about themselves.
They bestowed large gifts upon the Br^hmans, after worshipping Ganes and Mahadeva, and were as rejoiced as Poverty would be on finding the four great prizes of life.

sections.label: Doha 346
sections.name: कनक थार भरि मंगलन्हि कमल करन्हि लिएँ मात

verses.sa:
मोद प्रमोद बिबस सब माता ।
चलहिं न चरन सिथिल भए गाता ॥
verses.tr:
mod pramod bibas sab mātā
calahiṃ na caran sithil bhae gātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम दरस हित अति अनुरागीं ।
परिछनि साजु सजन सब लागीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām daras hit ati anurāgīṃ
parichani sāju sajan sab lāgīṃ

verses.sa:
बिबिध बिधान बाजने बाजे ।
मंगल मुदित सुमित्राँ साजे ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bidhān bājane bāje
maṃgal mudit sumitrām̐ sāje

verses.sa:
हरद दूब दधि पल्लव फूला ।
पान पूगफल मंगल मूला ॥
verses.tr:
harad dūb dadhi pallav phūlā
pān pūgaphal maṃgal mūlā

verses.sa:
अच्छत अंकुर लोचन लाजा ।
मंजुल मंजरि तुलसि बिराजा ॥
verses.tr:
acchat aṃkur locan lājā
maṃjul maṃjari tulasi birājā

verses.sa:
छुहे पुरट घट सहज सुहाए ।
मदन सकुन जनु नीड़ बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
chuhe puraṭ ghaṭ sahaj suhāe
madan sakun janu nīr̤ banāe

verses.sa:
सगुन सुंगध न जाहिं बखानी ।
मंगल सकल सजहिं सब रानी ॥
verses.tr:
sagun suṃgadh na jāhiṃ bakhānī
maṃgal sakal sajahiṃ sab rānī

verses.sa:
रचीं आरतीं बहुत बिधाना ।
मुदित करहिं कल मंगल गाना ॥
verses.tr:
racīṃ āratīṃ bahut bidhānā
mudit karahiṃ kal maṃgal gānā

verses.sa:
कनक थार भरि मंगलन्हि कमल करन्हि लिएँ मात ।
चलीं मुदित परिछनि करन पुलक पल्लवित गात ॥
verses.tr:
kanak thār bhari maṃgalanhi kamal karanhi liem̐ māt
calīṃ mudit parichani karan pulak pallavit gāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bach royal mother was so overcome with love and delight that her feet refused to walk and the whole body was paralyzed. Greatly longing for a sight of Rama, they all began preparing the lustral lamps. Instruments of music were played in various modes, as the glad Sumitra arranged her auspicious offering of turmeric, dub grass, curds, sprigs and flowers, pan, betelnut and well-favoured roots, rice, blades of wheat, yellow pigment, parched grain, and bunches of the graceful ‘ist in embossed golden vases, so exquisitely beautiful that they seemed like nests made for Love's own birdlings. The auspicious offerings and the perfumes were beyond all telling; there was nothing of good omen which each one of the queens had not prepared. With lustral lights arranged ia various devices they sing for joy: melodious festal strains.
With golden salvers io their Lotus hands, laden with their offerings, and their body quivering with emotion, the queens go forth with joy to perform the lustration.

sections.label: Doha 347
sections.name: होहिं सगुन बरषहिं सुमन सुर दुंदुभीं बजाइ

verses.sa:
धूप धूम नभु मेचक भयऊ ।
सावन घन घमंडु जनु ठयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
dhūp dhūm nabhu mecak bhayaū
sāvan ghan ghamaṃḍu janu ṭhayaū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुरतरु सुमन माल सुर बरषहिं ।
मनहुँ बलाक अवलि मनु करषहिं ॥
verses.tr:
surataru suman māl sur baraṣahiṃ
manahum̐ balāk avali manu karaṣahiṃ

verses.sa:
मंजुल मनिमय बंदनिवारे ।
मनहुँ पाकरिपु चाप सँवारे ॥
verses.tr:
maṃjul manimaya baṃdanivāre
manahum̐ pākaripu cāp sam̐vāre

verses.sa:
प्रगटहिं दुरहिं अटन्ह पर भामिनि ।
चारु चपल जनु दमकहिं दामिनि ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭahiṃ durahiṃ aṭanh par bhāmini
cāru capal janu damakahiṃ dāmini

verses.sa:
दुंदुभि धुनि घन गरजनि घोरा ।
जाचक चातक दादुर मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
duṃdubhi dhuni ghan garajani ghorā
jācak cātak dādur morā

verses.sa:
सुर सुगन्ध सुचि बरषहिं बारी ।
सुखी सकल ससि पुर नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
sur sugandh suci baraṣahiṃ bārī
sukhī sakal sasi pur nar nārī

verses.sa:
समउ जानी गुर आयसु दीन्हा ।
पुर प्रबेसु रघुकुलमनि कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
samau jānī gur āyasu dīnhā
pur prabesu raghukulamani kīnhā

verses.sa:
सुमिरि संभु गिरजा गनराजा ।
मुदित महीपति सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri saṃbhu girajā ganarājā
mudit mahīpati sahit samājā

verses.sa:
होहिं सगुन बरषहिं सुमन सुर दुंदुभीं बजाइ ।
बिबुध बधू नाचहिं मुदित मंजुल मंगल गाइ ॥
verses.tr:
hohiṃ sagun baraṣahiṃ suman sur duṃdubhīṃ bajāi
bibudh badhū nācahiṃ mudit maṃjul maṃgal gāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The heaven wus darkened with the fumes of incense, as though overhung with Savan’s densest thunderclouds: the gods rained down garlands of flowers from the tree of paradise which seemed to the beholders as cranes in graceful flight; the lustrous jewelled festoons resembled the rainbow; the maidens on the house-tops, now in sight and now out of sight, were like the fitful flashes of lightning; the beat of the drums was as the crash of thunder; the beggars us clamorous, as the cuckoos and the frogs and peacocks; the sweet perfumes were as copious showers of rain, and all} the people of the city like the freshened pastures. Seeing that the time had arrived, the guru gave the word, and the glory of Raghu’s line made his entry into the city, mindful at heart of Sambhu and Girja and Ganes, and exulting greatly, he and all his retinue.
Every omen was auspicious; the gods beat their drums and rained down flowers, while the heavenly nymphs danced for joy and sang jubilant songs of triumph.

sections.label: Doha 348
sections.name: एहि बिधि सबही देत सुखु आए राजदुआर

verses.sa:
मागध सूत बंदि नट नागर ।
गावहिं जसु तिहु लोक उजागर ॥
verses.tr:
māgadh sūt baṃdi naṭ nāgar
gāvahiṃ jasu tihu lok ujāgar
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जय धुनि बिमल बेद बर बानी ।
दस दिसि सुनिअ सुमंगल सानी ॥
verses.tr:
jaya dhuni bimal bed bar bānī
