das disi sunia sumaṃgal sānī

verses.sa:
बिपुल बाजने बाजन लागे ।
नभ सुर नगर लोग अनुरागे ॥
verses.tr:
bipul bājane bājan lāge
nabh sur nagar log anurāge

verses.sa:
बने बराती बरनि न जाहीं ।
महा मुदित मन सुख न समाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bane barātī barani na jāhīṃ
mahā mudit man sukh na samāhīṃ

verses.sa:
पुरबासिन्ह तब राय जोहारे ।
देखत रामहि भए सुखारे ॥
verses.tr:
purabāsinh tab rāya johāre
dekhat rāmahi bhae sukhāre

verses.sa:
करहिं निछावरि मनिगन चीरा ।
बारि बिलोचन पुलक सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ nichāvari manigan cīrā
bāri bilocan pulak sarīrā

verses.sa:
आरति करहिं मुदित पुर नारी ।
हरषहिं निरखि कुँअर बर चारी ॥
verses.tr:
ārati karahiṃ mudit pur nārī
haraṣahiṃ nirakhi kum̐ar bar cārī

verses.sa:
सिबिका सुभग ओहार उघारी ।
देखि दुलहिनिन्ह होहिं सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
sibikā subhag ohār ughārī
dekhi dulahininh hohiṃ sukhārī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सबही देत सुखु आए राजदुआर ।
मुदित मातु परुछनि करहिं बधुन्ह समेत कुमार ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sabahī det sukhu āe rājaduār
mudit mātu paruchani karahiṃ badhunh samet kumār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bards, minstrels, rhapsodists, mimes and players chanted his glory that irradiatesthe three spheres. In all ten regions of the heaven might be heard loud shouts of victory intermingled with the religious intoning of the Veda. All kinds of music played, and gods in heaven and men ov earth were alike enraptured. The magnificence of the procession was past all telling, and the joy was more than heart could contain. ‘The citizens made a profound obeisance to the king, and then were gladdened by a sight of Rama. They scatter around him jewels and vestments, with their eyes full of tears and their body all

tremulous with excitement. Their wives move over his head the lustral lightsand rejoice greatly to behold the four noble princes; but when they lifted the curtain of the well-appointed palki and saw the brides, they were still more glad.
In this manner, to the delight of all, they arrived at the gate of the palace, where the glad queens waved the lustral lights over the princes and their brides.

sections.label: Doha 349
sections.name: निगम नीति कुल रीति करि अरघ पाँवड़े देत

verses.sa:
करहिं आरती बारहिं बारा ।
प्रेमु प्रमोदु कहै को पारा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ āratī bārahiṃ bārā
premu pramodu kahai ko pārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भूषन मनि पट नाना जाती ।
करही निछावरि अगनित भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
bhūṣan mani paṭ nānā jātī
karahī nichāvari aganit bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
बधुन्ह समेत देखि सुत चारी ।
परमानंद मगन महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
badhunh samet dekhi sut cārī
paramānaṃd magan mahatārī

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि सीय राम छबि देखी ।
मुदित सफल जग जीवन लेखी ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni sīya rām chabi dekhī
mudit saphal jag jīvan lekhī

verses.sa:
सखीं सीय मुख पुनि पुनि चाही ।
गान करहिं निज सुकृत सराही ॥
verses.tr:
sakhīṃ sīya mukh puni puni cāhī
gān karahiṃ nij sukṛt sarāhī

verses.sa:
बरषहिं सुमन छनहिं छन देवा ।
नाचहिं गावहिं लावहिं सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣahiṃ suman chanahiṃ chan devā
nācahiṃ gāvahiṃ lāvahiṃ sevā

verses.sa:
देखि मनोहर चारिउ जोरीं ।
सारद उपमा सकल ढँढोरीं ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi manohar cāriu jorīṃ
sārad upamā sakal ḍham̐ḍhorīṃ

verses.sa:
देत न बनहिं निपट लघु लागी ।
एकटक रहीं रूप अनुरागीं ॥
verses.tr:
det na banahiṃ nipaṭ laghu lāgī
ekaṭak rahīṃ rūp anurāgīṃ

verses.sa:
निगम नीति कुल रीति करि अरघ पाँवड़े देत ।
बधुन्ह सहित सुत परिछि सब चलीं लवाइ निकेत ॥
verses.tr:
nigam nīti kul rīti kari aragh pām̐var̤e det
badhunh sahit sut parichi sab calīṃ lavāi niket
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Time after time they perform the ceremony in a rapture of love that is beyond all words. They scatter around in boundless profusion gold and silver ornaments and gems and silks of every kind, and as they gaze on their four sons and their brides, are overwhelmed with the bliss of heaven. Again and again as they regard the beauty of Rama and Sita, they think with joy that this is the happiest moment of their life. As her companions look again and again into Sita’s face they sing and exult over their good fortune. Every moment the gods rain down flowers, midst dancing and singing and obsequious homage. Seeing four such charming couples, Serade looked up all her similes, but not one would do, all seemed unworthy, and she could only stand at gaze enchanted with their loveliness.

After performing all the rites prescribed by the Veda o family usage, they conduct their sons and their brides to the palace; sprinkling Lustral water, spreading carpets in the way, and waving torches.

sections.label: Doha 350
sections.name: एहि सुख ते सत कोटि गुन पावहिं मातु अनंदु

verses.sa:
चारि सिंघासन सहज सुहाए ।
जनु मनोज निज हाथ बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
cāri siṃghāsan sahaj suhāe
janu manoj nij hāth banāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तिन्ह पर कुअँरि कुअँर बैठारे ।
सादर पाय पुनित पखारे ॥
verses.tr:
tinh par kuam̐ri kuam̐r baiṭhāre
sādar pāya punit pakhāre

verses.sa:
धूप दीप नैबेद बेद बिधि ।
पूजे बर दुलहिनि मंगलनिधि ॥
verses.tr:
dhūp dīp naibed bed bidhi
pūje bar dulahini maṃgalanidhi

verses.sa:
बारहिं बार आरती करहीं ।
ब्यजन चारु चामर सिर ढरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bārahiṃ bār āratī karahīṃ
byajan cāru cāmar sir ḍharahīṃ

verses.sa:
बस्तु अनेक निछावर होहीं ।
भरीं प्रमोद मातु सब सोहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bastu anek nichāvar hohīṃ
bharīṃ pramod mātu sab sohīṃ

verses.sa:
पावा परम तत्व जनु जोगीं ।
अमृत लहेउ जनु संतत रोगीं ॥
verses.tr:
pāvā param tatv janu jogīṃ
amṛt laheu janu saṃtat rogīṃ

verses.sa:
जनम रंक जनु पारस पावा ।
अंधहि लोचन लाभु सुहावा ॥
verses.tr:
janam raṃk janu pāras pāvā
aṃdhahi locan lābhu suhāvā

verses.sa:
मूक बदन जनु सारद छाई ।
मानहुँ समर सूर जय पाई ॥
verses.tr:
mūk badan janu sārad chāī
mānahum̐ samar sūr jaya pāī

verses.sa: एहि सुख ते सत कोटि गुन पावहिं मातु अनंदु ॥
verses.tr: ehi sukh te sat koṭi gun pāvahiṃ mātu anaṃdu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: भाइन्ह सहित बिआहि घर आए रघुकुलचंदु ॥
verses.tr: bhāinh sahit biāhi ghar āe raghukulacaṃdu

verses.sa:
लोक रीत जननी करहिं बर दुलहिनि सकुचाहिं ।
मोदु बिनोदु बिलोकि बड़ रामु मनहिं मुसकाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
lok rīt jananī karahiṃ bar dulahini sakucāhiṃ
modu binodu biloki bar̤ rāmu manahiṃ musakāhiṃ

trans: After souting the brides and their grooms on four thrones so magnificent that they seemed as if made by love's own hands, they proceeded reverently to lave their sacred feet and to do them homage—all holy asthey were— with incense and lights and oblations in ‘accordance with Vedic ritual. Time after time they pass the torch around and wave over their head gorgeous fans and chaurts and scatter profuse gifts; for each royal mother was as full of exultation asa devotee who has obtained beatitude; ora man sick all his life who has gotten an elixir; or a born beggar who has found the philosopher’s stone; or a blind man restored to sight; or a dumb man endued with eloquence; or a warrior who has triumphed in battle.

Greater by a hundred million times than their joy was the rapture of the queens, when Rama and his brothers returned home married. As the royal matrons performed the accustomed ceremonies, the brides and their grooms were much confused, but Rama smiled to himself on beholding their joy and delight.

sections.label: Doha 351
sections.name: देंहिं असीस जोहारि सब गावहिं गुन गन गाथ

verses.sa:
देव पितर पूजे बिधि नीकी ।
पूजीं सकल बासना जी की ॥
verses.tr:
dev pitar pūje bidhi nīkī
pūjīṃ sakal bāsanā jī kī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सबहिं बंदि मागहिं बरदाना ।
भाइन्ह सहित राम कल्याना ॥
verses.tr:
sabahiṃ baṃdi māgahiṃ baradānā
bhāinh sahit rām kalyānā

verses.sa:
अंतरहित सुर आसिष देहीं ।
मुदित मातु अंचल भरि लेंहीं ॥
verses.tr:
aṃtarahit sur āsiṣ dehīṃ
mudit mātu aṃcal bhari leṃhīṃ

verses.sa:
भूपति बोलि बराती लीन्हे ।
जान बसन मनि भूषन दीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
bhūpati boli barātī līnhe
jān basan mani bhūṣan dīnhe

verses.sa:
आयसु पाइ राखि उर रामहि ।
मुदित गए सब निज निज धामहि ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu pāi rākhi ur rāmahi
mudit gae sab nij nij dhāmahi

verses.sa:
पुर नर नारि सकल पहिराए ।
घर घर बाजन लगे बधाए ॥
verses.tr:
pur nar nāri sakal pahirāe
ghar ghar bājan lage badhāe

verses.sa:
जाचक जन जाचहि जोइ जोई ।
प्रमुदित राउ देहिं सोइ सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jācak jan jācahi joi joī
pramudit rāu dehiṃ soi soī

verses.sa:
सेवक सकल बजनिआ नाना ।
पूरन किए दान सनमाना ॥
verses.tr:
sevak sakal bajaniā nānā
pūran kie dān sanamānā

verses.sa:
देंहिं असीस जोहारि सब गावहिं गुन गन गाथ ।
तब गुर भूसुर सहित गृहँ गवनु कीन्ह नरनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
deṃhiṃ asīs johāri sab gāvahiṃ gun gan gāth
tab gur bhūsur sahit gṛham̐ gavanu kīnh naranāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In due fashion they did homage tothe wvods and the spirits of their ancestors, and every imagination of the heart was satisfied. Humbly they begged of all the highest boon, namely, the prosperity of Rama and his brothers, and the gods unseen conferred their blessing. The matrons in their joy took them to their bosom, while the king sent for all who had joined in the procession and gave them carriages and raiment and jewels and ornaments. Then, on receiving permission, and still cherishing the image of Rama io their heart, they returned in joy each to his own abode. All the people of the city, both men and women, were clad in festal attire, and in every home was a noise of jubilant music. Anything that a beggar begged was at once bestowed upon him by the glad king, and every attendant and every minstrel band was overwhelmed with gifts and compliments.
All profoundly bowing invoke blessing upon him and sing his praises, as the king with his guru and the Brahmans proceeded to the palace.

sections.label: Doha 352
sections.name: बधुन्ह समेत कुमार सब रानिन्ह सहित महीसु

verses.sa:
जो बसिष्ठ अनुसासन दीन्ही ।
लोक बेद बिधि सादर कीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
jo basiṣṭh anusāsan dīnhī
lok bed bidhi sādar kīnhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भूसुर भीर देखि सब रानी ।
सादर उठीं भाग्य बड़ जानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūsur bhīr dekhi sab rānī
sādar uṭhīṃ bhāgya bar̤ jānī

verses.sa:
पाय पखारि सकल अन्हवाए ।
पूजि भली बिधि भूप जेवाँए ॥
verses.tr:
pāya pakhāri sakal anhavāe
pūji bhalī bidhi bhūp jevām̐e

verses.sa:
आदर दान प्रेम परिपोषे ।
देत असीस चले मन तोषे ॥
verses.tr:
ādar dān prem paripoṣe
det asīs cale man toṣe

verses.sa:
बहु बिधि कीन्हि गाधिसुत पूजा ।
नाथ मोहि सम धन्य न दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
bahu bidhi kīnhi gādhisut pūjā
nāth mohi sam dhanya na dūjā

verses.sa:
कीन्हि प्रसंसा भूपति भूरी ।
रानिन्ह सहित लीन्हि पग धूरी ॥
verses.tr:
kīnhi prasaṃsā bhūpati bhūrī
rāninh sahit līnhi pag dhūrī

verses.sa:
भीतर भवन दीन्ह बर बासु ।
मन जोगवत रह नृप रनिवासू ॥
verses.tr:
bhītar bhavan dīnh bar bāsu
man jogavat rah nṛp ranivāsū

verses.sa:
पूजे गुर पद कमल बहोरी ।
कीन्हि बिनय उर प्रीति न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
pūje gur pad kamal bahorī
kīnhi binaya ur prīti na thorī

verses.sa:
बधुन्ह समेत कुमार सब रानिन्ह सहित महीसु ।
पुनि पुनि बंदत गुर चरन देत असीस मुनीसु ॥
verses.tr:
badhunh samet kumār sab rāninh sahit mahīsu
puni puni baṃdat gur caran det asīs munīsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Under Vasishta’s directions he reverently performed every ceremony prescribed either by usage or the Veda. The queens, on seeing the throng of Brahmans, thought themselves most highly favoured and rose to greet them. After bathing their feet and doing them all due homage, the king feasted them ata banquet and loaded them with affectionate civilities and gifts. Greatful at heart, they blessed him at parting. To the son of Gadhi he paid special homage, saying:—‘ My lord, there is no man in the world so blest as I am;’ and with many other flattering speeches both he and his queens took of the dust of his feet. Next he assigned him a splendid apartment within the palace; the king and his royal consorts alike watching his every wish, Again he adored his lotus feet with the greatest humility and devotion.
The princes and their brides, the king and his royal consorts, again and again did reverence to the guru’s feet and received the holy man’s blessing.

sections.label: Doha 353
sections.name: चले निसान बजाइ सुर निज निज पुर सुख पाइ

verses.sa:
बिनय कीन्हि उर अति अनुरागें ।
सुत संपदा राखि सब आगें ॥
verses.tr:
binaya kīnhi ur ati anurāgeṃ
sut saṃpadā rākhi sab āgeṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नेगु मागि मुनिनायक लीन्हा ।
आसिरबादु बहुत बिधि दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
negu māgi munināyak līnhā
āsirabādu bahut bidhi dīnhā

verses.sa:
उर धरि रामहि सीय समेता ।
हरषि कीन्ह गुर गवनु निकेता ॥
verses.tr:
ur dhari rāmahi sīya sametā
haraṣi kīnh gur gavanu niketā

verses.sa:
बिप्रबधू सब भूप बोलाई ।
चैल चारु भूषन पहिराई ॥
verses.tr:
biprabadhū sab bhūp bolāī
cail cāru bhūṣan pahirāī

verses.sa:
बहुरि बोलाइ सुआसिनि लीन्हीं ।
रुचि बिचारि पहिरावनि दीन्हीं ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri bolāi suāsini līnhīṃ
ruci bicāri pahirāvani dīnhīṃ

verses.sa:
नेगी नेग जोग सब लेहीं ।
रुचि अनुरुप भूपमनि देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
negī neg jog sab lehīṃ
ruci anurup bhūpamani dehīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रिय पाहुने पूज्य जे जाने ।
भूपति भली भाँति सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
priya pāhune pūjya je jāne
bhūpati bhalī bhām̐ti sanamāne

verses.sa:
देव देखि रघुबीर बिबाहू ।
बरषि प्रसून प्रसंसि उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
dev dekhi raghubīr bibāhū
baraṣi prasūn prasaṃsi uchāhū

verses.sa:
चले निसान बजाइ सुर निज निज पुर सुख पाइ ।
कहत परसपर राम जसु प्रेम न हृदयँ समाइ ॥
verses.tr:
cale nisān bajāi sur nij nij pur sukh pāi
kahat parasapar rām jasu prem na hṛdayam̐ samāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With humility of heart and deep devotion he placed before him his sons and everything that he possessed. But the great saint asked only for the accustomed offering, and invoking upon him every blessing set out with joy on his homeward way, with the image of Rama and Sita impressed upon his heart. ‘Then were summoned the Brahman dames and the elders ‘of the tribe and invested with fair robes and ornaments; aud next the younger ladies of the house!, who too were presented with dresses such as each most fancied. Every person with any claim to be remembered received from the jewel of kings suitable remembrance according to his taste, while more dear and honoured friends were overwhelmed with courtesies. The gods, who witnessed Raghubir’s marriage, rained down flowers as they applauded the spectacle,
And with beat of drum returned each to his own realm; all highly delighted and talking to one another of Rama's glory with irrepressible rapture.

sections.label: Doha 354
sections.name: सुतन्ह समेत नहाइ नृप बोलि बिप्र गुर ग्याति

verses.sa:
सब बिधि सबहि समदि नरनाहू ।
रहा हृदयँ भरि पूरि उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi sabahi samadi naranāhū
rahā hṛdayam̐ bhari pūri uchāhū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जहँ रनिवासु तहाँ पगु धारे ।
सहित बहूटिन्ह कुअँर निहारे ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ ranivāsu tahām̐ pagu dhāre
sahit bahūṭinh kuam̐r nihāre

verses.sa:
लिए गोद करि मोद समेता ।
को कहि सकइ भयउ सुखु जेता ॥
verses.tr:
lie god kari mod sametā
ko kahi sakai bhayau sukhu jetā

verses.sa:
बधू सप्रेम गोद बैठारीं ।
बार बार हियँ हरषि दुलारीं ॥
verses.tr:
badhū saprem god baiṭhārīṃ
bār bār hiyam̐ haraṣi dulārīṃ

verses.sa:
देखि समाजु मुदित रनिवासू ।
सब कें उर अनंद कियो बासू ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi samāju mudit ranivāsū
sab keṃ ur anaṃd kiyo bāsū

verses.sa:
कहेउ भूप जिमि भयउ बिबाहू ।
सुनि हरषु होत सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
kaheu bhūp jimi bhayau bibāhū
suni haraṣu hot sab kāhū

verses.sa:
जनक राज गुन सीलु बड़ाई ।
प्रीति रीति संपदा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
janak rāj gun sīlu bar̤āī
prīti rīti saṃpadā suhāī

verses.sa:
बहुबिधि भूप भाट जिमि बरनी ।
रानीं सब प्रमुदित सुनि करनी ॥
verses.tr:
bahubidhi bhūp bhāṭ jimi baranī
rānīṃ sab pramudit suni karanī

verses.sa:
सुतन्ह समेत नहाइ नृप बोलि बिप्र गुर ग्याति ।
भोजन कीन्ह अनेक बिधि घरी पंच गइ राति ॥
verses.tr:
sutanh samet nahāi nṛp boli bipr gur gyāti
bhojan kīnh anek bidhi gharī paṃc gai rāti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: _ The king showed every one all possible honour, and with a heart full to overflowing of gladness proceeded to the private apartments, and then gazing upon the princes and their brides took them to his bosom ina rapturous embrace and with a joy beyond all telling. Seating his little daughters in his lap in a most affectionate manner, he again and again caressed them with gladness of heart. All

bridesmaid in the west; and the word might be so translated, were it not the ladies of the harem were charmed at the sight, and their soul was filled with happiness and exaltation, while they listened with delight to the king’s account of the marriage and his praises of King Janak’s virtue and amiability, and the kindness of his reception and _ his, generous magnificence. The king told it all like a hired encomiast, and the queens were enraptured when they heard of all that had been done.
After bathing with his sons the king summoned his guru's kinsmen and entertained them at a sumptuous banquet till five hours of the night were spent.

sections.label: Doha 355
sections.name: लरिका श्रमित उनीद बस सयन करावहु जाइ

verses.sa:
मंगलगान करहिं बर भामिनि ।
भै सुखमूल मनोहर जामिनि ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgalagān karahiṃ bar bhāmini
bhai sukhamūl manohar jāmini
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अँचइ पान सब काहूँ पाए ।
स्त्रग सुगंध भूषित छबि छाए ॥
verses.tr:
am̐cai pān sab kāhūm̐ pāe
strag sugaṃdh bhūṣit chabi chāe

verses.sa:
रामहि देखि रजायसु पाई ।
निज निज भवन चले सिर नाई ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi dekhi rajāyasu pāī
nij nij bhavan cale sir nāī

verses.sa:
प्रेम प्रमोद बिनोदु बढ़ाई ।
समउ समाजु मनोहरताई ॥
verses.tr:
prem pramod binodu bar̤hāī
samau samāju manoharatāī

verses.sa:
कहि न सकहि सत सारद सेसू ।
बेद बिरंचि महेस गनेसू ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na sakahi sat sārad sesū
bed biraṃci mahes ganesū

verses.sa:
सो मै कहौं कवन बिधि बरनी ।
भूमिनागु सिर धरइ कि धरनी ॥
verses.tr:
so mai kahauṃ kavan bidhi baranī
bhūmināgu sir dharai ki dharanī

verses.sa:
नृप सब भाँति सबहि सनमानी ।
कहि मृदु बचन बोलाई रानी ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp sab bhām̐ti sabahi sanamānī
kahi mṛdu bacan bolāī rānī

verses.sa:
बधू लरिकनीं पर घर आईं ।
राखेहु नयन पलक की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
badhū larikanīṃ par ghar āīṃ
rākhehu nayan palak kī nāī

verses.sa:
लरिका श्रमित उनीद बस सयन करावहु जाइ ।
अस कहि गे बिश्रामगृहँ राम चरन चितु लाइ ॥
verses.tr:
larikā śramit unīd bas sayan karāvahu jāi
as kahi ge biśrāmagṛham̐ rām caran citu lāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Lovely women sang joyous songs, and the night was one of exquisite happiness. As they rose from their seats, all were presented with pdn and decorated with beautiful and sweet-scented garlands; then after one more look at Rama and bowing the head they received the royal permission to retire each to his own abode. The display of love and rapturous delight and the beauty of the court at that time was more than could be told by a hundred Sdradas or Seshnags or by the Veda, or Brahma, or Mahadeva, or Ganes: how then can I till it, any more than an earthly serpent could support the world on its head? After showing every one the highest honour, the king in gentle tones addressed the queens:—‘ The brides are but children, and have come to a strange house; watch over them as closely as the eyelid guards the eye.
Go and put them to bed. for they are tired and sleepy.’ And so saying he retired to his own couch with his thoughts intent or Rama’s feet.

sections.label: Doha 356
sections.name: घोर निसाचर बिकट भट समर गनहिं नहिं काहु

verses.sa:
भूप बचन सुनि सहज सुहाए ।
जरित कनक मनि पलँग डसाए ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bacan suni sahaj suhāe
jarit kanak mani palam̐g ḍasāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुभग सुरभि पय फेन समाना ।
कोमल कलित सुपेतीं नाना ॥
verses.tr:
subhag surabhi paya phen samānā
komal kalit supetīṃ nānā

verses.sa:
उपबरहन बर बरनि न जाहीं ।
स्त्रग सुगंध मनिमंदिर माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
upabarahan bar barani na jāhīṃ
strag sugaṃdh manimaṃdir māhīṃ

verses.sa:
रतनदीप सुठि चारु चँदोवा ।
कहत न बनइ जान जेहिं जोवा ॥
verses.tr:
ratanadīp suṭhi cāru cam̐dovā
kahat na banai jān jehiṃ jovā

verses.sa:
सेज रुचिर रचि रामु उठाए ।
प्रेम समेत पलँग पौढ़ाए ॥
verses.tr:
sej rucir raci rāmu uṭhāe
prem samet palam̐g paur̤hāe

verses.sa:
अग्या पुनि पुनि भाइन्ह दीन्ही ।
निज निज सेज सयन तिन्ह कीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
agyā puni puni bhāinh dīnhī
nij nij sej sayan tinh kīnhī

verses.sa:
देखि स्याम मृदु मंजुल गाता ।
कहहिं सप्रेम बचन सब माता ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi syām mṛdu maṃjul gātā
kahahiṃ saprem bacan sab mātā

verses.sa:
मारग जात भयावनि भारी ।
केहि बिधि तात ताड़का मारी ॥
verses.tr:
mārag jāt bhayāvani bhārī
kehi bidhi tāt tār̤akā mārī

verses.sa: घोर निसाचर बिकट भट समर गनहिं नहिं काहु ॥
verses.tr: ghor nisācar bikaṭ bhaṭ samar ganahiṃ nahiṃ kāhu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: मारे सहित सहाय किमि खल मारीच सुबाहु ॥
verses.tr: māre sahit sahāya kimi khal mārīc subāhu

trans: On hearing the king’s kind words, they made ready the bed, which was of gold and set with gems, with various rich coverings as soft and white as the froth of milk, and pillows finer than words can tell. In the jewelled chamber were sweet-scented garlands, and a beautiful canopy fash-ing with lustrous gems which defied description; no one who had not seen it could imagine it. When they had prepared this exquisite couch, they took up Rama and lovingly laid him down upon it, who again and again had to tell his brothers to leave him before they too retired to rest. On seeing his dark little body, so soft and delicate, the fond mothers cried:—“O my son, how could you Kill on the way the terrible monster Teraka? -
How were you able to slay those savage demons, those ferocious warriors, who in battle held no man of any account, the vile Mericha and Subehu and all their host 7

sections.label: Doha 357
sections.name: राम प्रतोषीं मातु सब कहि बिनीत बर बैन

verses.sa:
मुनि प्रसाद बलि तात तुम्हारी ।
ईस अनेक करवरें टारी ॥
verses.tr:
muni prasād bali tāt tumhārī
īs anek karavareṃ ṭārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मख रखवारी करि दुहुँ भाई ।
गुरु प्रसाद सब बिद्या पाई ॥
verses.tr:
makh rakhavārī kari duhum̐ bhāī
guru prasād sab bidyā pāī

verses.sa:
मुनितय तरी लगत पग धूरी ।
कीरति रही भुवन भरि पूरी ॥
verses.tr:
munitaya tarī lagat pag dhūrī
kīrati rahī bhuvan bhari pūrī

verses.sa:
कमठ पीठि पबि कूट कठोरा ।
नृप समाज महुँ सिव धनु तोरा ॥
verses.tr:
kamaṭh pīṭhi pabi kūṭ kaṭhorā
nṛp samāj mahum̐ siv dhanu torā

verses.sa:
बिस्व बिजय जसु जानकि पाई ।
आए भवन ब्याहि सब भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bisv bijaya jasu jānaki pāī
āe bhavan byāhi sab bhāī

verses.sa:
सकल अमानुष करम तुम्हारे ।
केवल कौसिक कृपाँ सुधारे ॥
verses.tr:
sakal amānuṣ karam tumhāre
keval kausik kṛpām̐ sudhāre

verses.sa:
आजु सुफल जग जनमु हमारा ।
देखि तात बिधुबदन तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
āju suphal jag janamu hamārā
dekhi tāt bidhubadan tumhārā

verses.sa:
जे दिन गए तुम्हहि बिनु देखें ।
ते बिरंचि जनि पारहिं लेखें ॥
verses.tr:
je din gae tumhahi binu dekheṃ
te biraṃci jani pārahiṃ lekheṃ

verses.sa:
राम प्रतोषीं मातु सब कहि बिनीत बर बैन ।
सुमिरि संभु गुर बिप्र पद किए नीदबस नैन ॥
verses.tr:
rām pratoṣīṃ mātu sab kahi binīt bar bain
sumiri saṃbhu gur bipr pad kie nīdabas nain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: _ It was by the saint’s favour, I vow, my son, that God averted from you countless calamities, while you and your brother guarded the sacrifice; and by your guru’s blessing you acquired all knowledge. At the touch of the dust of your feet the hermit’s wife attained to salvation: the whole world is filled with your glory: in the assembly of princes you broke Siva’s bow, though lord as a tortoise-shel or a thunderbolt; you have won universal glory and renown and Janaki for your bride, and have now with your brothers returned home married. All}] your actions are more than human; it is only by Visvamitra’s good favour that you have prospered. To-day my birth into the world has borne fruit, now that I see your moon-like face, my son. The days
that were spent without seeing you, God ought not to take into account at all.”
Rama in most modest phrase reassured the royal dames, and meditating on the feet of Sambhu and his guru and all] Brahmans, he closed his eyes in sleep.

sections.label: Doha 358
sections.name: कीन्ह सौच सब सहज सुचि सरित पुनीत नहाइ

verses.sa:
नीदउँ बदन सोह सुठि लोना ।
मनहुँ साँझ सरसीरुह सोना ॥
verses.tr:
nīdaum̐ badan soh suṭhi lonā
manahum̐ sām̐jh sarasīruh sonā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
घर घर करहिं जागरन नारीं ।
देहिं परसपर मंगल गारीं ॥
verses.tr:
ghar ghar karahiṃ jāgaran nārīṃ
dehiṃ parasapar maṃgal gārīṃ

verses.sa:
पुरी बिराजति राजति रजनी ।
रानीं कहहिं बिलोकहु सजनी ॥
verses.tr:
purī birājati rājati rajanī
rānīṃ kahahiṃ bilokahu sajanī

verses.sa:
सुंदर बधुन्ह सासु लै सोई ।
फनिकन्ह जनु सिरमनि उर गोई ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar badhunh sāsu lai soī
phanikanh janu siramani ur goī

verses.sa:
प्रात पुनीत काल प्रभु जागे ।
अरुनचूड़ बर बोलन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
prāt punīt kāl prabhu jāge
arunacūr̤ bar bolan lāge

verses.sa:
बंदि मागधन्हि गुनगन गाए ।
पुरजन द्वार जोहारन आए ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdi māgadhanhi gunagan gāe
purajan dvār johāran āe

verses.sa:
बंदि बिप्र सुर गुर पितु माता ।
पाइ असीस मुदित सब भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdi bipr sur gur pitu mātā
pāi asīs mudit sab bhrātā

verses.sa:
जननिन्ह सादर बदन निहारे ।
भूपति संग द्वार पगु धारे ॥
verses.tr:
jananinh sādar badan nihāre
bhūpati saṃg dvār pagu dhāre

verses.sa:
कीन्ह सौच सब सहज सुचि सरित पुनीत नहाइ ।
प्रातक्रिया करि तात पहिं आए चारिउ भाइ ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh sauc sab sahaj suci sarit punīt nahāi
prātakriyā kari tāt pahiṃ āe cāriu bhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As he slept, his pretty and piquant little mouth gleamed like a red lotus, half closed at eventide. In every house women kept vigil and jested with one another in auspicious wise. The city was so brilliant, nay, so brilliant the night itself that, the queens cried ‘See, girls, see.”” The matrons slept with the beauteous brides enfolded in their arms, as lovingly as a serpent would clasp to his bosom the precious jewel from inside its head. At the holy hour of dawn the lord awoke, ere Chanticleer had well begun to crow. Minstrels and bards, proclaimed his praises and the citizens flocked to the gate to do himhomage. The four brothers saluted the Brahmans, the gods, their guru, and their father and mother, and gladly received their blessing and while the queens reverentially gazed upon their advanced with the king to the door.
Pure though they were in themselves, they performed all the customary ablutions and bathed in the holy river

sections.label: Doha 359
sections.name: मंगल मोद उछाह नित जाहिं दिवस एहि भाँति

verses.sa:
भूप बिलोकि लिए उर लाई ।
बैठै हरषि रजायसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp biloki lie ur lāī
baiṭhai haraṣi rajāyasu pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि रामु सब सभा जुड़ानी ।
लोचन लाभ अवधि अनुमानी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rāmu sab sabhā jur̤ānī
locan lābh avadhi anumānī

verses.sa:
पुनि बसिष्टु मुनि कौसिक आए ।
सुभग आसनन्हि मुनि बैठाए ॥
verses.tr:
puni basiṣṭu muni kausik āe
subhag āsananhi muni baiṭhāe

verses.sa:
सुतन्ह समेत पूजि पद लागे ।
निरखि रामु दोउ गुर अनुरागे ॥
verses.tr:
sutanh samet pūji pad lāge
nirakhi rāmu dou gur anurāge

verses.sa:
कहहिं बसिष्टु धरम इतिहासा ।
सुनहिं महीसु सहित रनिवासा ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ basiṣṭu dharam itihāsā
sunahiṃ mahīsu sahit ranivāsā

verses.sa:
मुनि मन अगम गाधिसुत करनी ।
मुदित बसिष्ट बिपुल बिधि बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
muni man agam gādhisut karanī
mudit basiṣṭ bipul bidhi baranī

verses.sa:
बोले बामदेउ सब साँची ।
कीरति कलित लोक तिहुँ माची ॥
verses.tr:
bole bāmadeu sab sām̐cī
kīrati kalit lok tihum̐ mācī

verses.sa:
सुनि आनंदु भयउ सब काहू ।
राम लखन उर अधिक उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
suni ānaṃdu bhayau sab kāhū
rām lakhan ur adhik uchāhū

verses.sa:
मंगल मोद उछाह नित जाहिं दिवस एहि भाँति ।
उमगी अवध अनंद भरि अधिक अधिक अधिकाति ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal mod uchāh nit jāhiṃ divas ehi bhām̐ti
umagī avadh anaṃd bhari adhik adhik adhikāti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: and completed their morning devotions ere they returned to their sire.

The king on seeing them took them to his bosom. Then at his command they gladly seated themselves. The whole court was rejoiced at the sight of Rama, and accounted their eyes supremely blest. Then came saints Vasishta and Visvamitra and were conducted to exalted thrones. Father and sons reverently adored their feet, and both the holy men rejoiced aa they gazed on Rama. Vasishta recited sacred legends, while the monarch and his queens listened. He told with joy in diffuse strain of all the doings of Gaedhi’s son which surpass even the imagination of the saints. Cried Vamadeva:—‘ The tale is true; its fame has become renowned through the three worlds.” All -who heard were glad, but in Rama and Lakshman’s heart there was exceeding joy.
Thus passed the days in perpetual delight, happiness and festivity; and the whole of Avadh was full to overflowing with bliss that was ever on the increase.

sections.label: Doha 360
sections.name: राम रूपु भूपति भगति ब्याहु उछाहु अनंदु

verses.sa:
सुदिन सोधि कल कंकन छौरे ।
मंगल मोद बिनोद न थोरे ॥
verses.tr:
sudin sodhi kal kaṃkan chaure
maṃgal mod binod na thore
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नित नव सुखु सुर देखि सिहाहीं ।
अवध जन्म जाचहिं बिधि पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nit nav sukhu sur dekhi sihāhīṃ
avadh janm jācahiṃ bidhi pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बिस्वामित्रु चलन नित चहहीं ।
राम सप्रेम बिनय बस रहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bisvāmitru calan nit cahahīṃ
rām saprem binaya bas rahahīṃ

verses.sa:
दिन दिन सयगुन भूपति भाऊ ।
देखि सराह महामुनिराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
din din sayagun bhūpati bhāū
dekhi sarāh mahāmunirāū

verses.sa:
मागत बिदा राउ अनुरागे ।
सुतन्ह समेत ठाढ़ भे आगे ॥
verses.tr:
māgat bidā rāu anurāge
sutanh samet ṭhār̤h bhe āge

verses.sa:
नाथ सकल संपदा तुम्हारी ।
मैं सेवकु समेत सुत नारी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sakal saṃpadā tumhārī
maiṃ sevaku samet sut nārī

verses.sa:
करब सदा लरिकनः पर छोहू ।
दरसन देत रहब मुनि मोहू ॥
verses.tr:
karab sadā larikanaḥ par chohū
darasan det rahab muni mohū

verses.sa:
अस कहि राउ सहित सुत रानी ।
परेउ चरन मुख आव न बानी ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi rāu sahit sut rānī
pareu caran mukh āv na bānī

verses.sa:
दीन्ह असीस बिप्र बहु भाँती ।
चले न प्रीति रीति कहि जाती ॥
verses.tr:
dīnh asīs bipr bahu bhām̐tī
cale na prīti rīti kahi jātī

verses.sa:
रामु सप्रेम संग सब भाई ।
आयसु पाइ फिरे पहुँचाई ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu saprem saṃg sab bhāī
āyasu pāi phire pahum̐cāī

verses.sa:
राम रूपु भूपति भगति ब्याहु उछाहु अनंदु ।
जात सराहत मनहिं मन मुदित गाधिकुलचंदु ॥
verses.tr:
rām rūpu bhūpati bhagati byāhu uchāhu anaṃdu
jāt sarāhat manahiṃ man mudit gādhikulacaṃdu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Affer calculating an auspicious day, they loosened the -string on the wrist with no little solemnity and rejoicing. The gods, beholding the constant succession of delight, were in raptures and begged of Brahma that they might be born at Avadh. Visvamitra was always wishing to take leave, but was persuaded by Rama's affectionate entreaties to stay on. Day after day, seeing the king’s devotion and the excellence of his nature, the great saint was loud in his praises. When he asked permission to go, the king was greatly moved and with his sons stood before him io the way, saying:—“ My lord, all that I have is yours, and I, my sons, and my wives are your servants; be ever gracious to these boys and allow me tosee you.” So saying the king with his sons and his queens fell at his feet, and speech failed his tongue. The Brahman invoked upon him every kind of blessing and set forth amidst a display of affection that is past all] telling, Rama and _ his brothers lovingly escorting him till they received orders to return.
The moon of Gadhi’s race went on his way rejoicing and praising to himself the beauty of Rama, the piety of the king and the magnificence of the marriage Festivities.

sections.label: Doha 361
sections.name: सिय रघुबीर बिबाहु जे सप्रेम गावहिं सुनहिं

verses.sa:
बामदेव रघुकुल गुर ग्यानी ।
बहुरि गाधिसुत कथा बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
bāmadev raghukul gur gyānī
bahuri gādhisut kathā bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि सुजसु मनहिं मन राऊ ।
बरनत आपन पुन्य प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni sujasu manahiṃ man rāū
baranat āpan punya prabhāū

verses.sa:
बहुरे लोग रजायसु भयऊ ।
सुतन्ह समेत नृपति गृहँ गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bahure log rajāyasu bhayaū
sutanh samet nṛpati gṛham̐ gayaū

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ राम ब्याहु सबु गावा ।
सुजसु पुनीत लोक तिहुँ छावा ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ rām byāhu sabu gāvā
sujasu punīt lok tihum̐ chāvā

verses.sa:
आए ब्याहि रामु घर जब तें ।
बसइ अनंद अवध सब तब तें ॥
verses.tr:
āe byāhi rāmu ghar jab teṃ
basai anaṃd avadh sab tab teṃ

verses.sa:
प्रभु बिबाहँ जस भयउ उछाहू ।
सकहिं न बरनि गिरा अहिनाहू ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu bibāham̐ jas bhayau uchāhū
sakahiṃ na barani girā ahināhū

verses.sa:
कबिकुल जीवनु पावन जानी ।
राम सीय जसु मंगल खानी ॥
verses.tr:
kabikul jīvanu pāvan jānī
rām sīya jasu maṃgal khānī

verses.sa:
तेहि ते मैं कछु कहा बखानी ।
करन पुनीत हेतु निज बानी ॥
verses.tr:
tehi te maiṃ kachu kahā bakhānī
karan punīt hetu nij bānī

verses.sa:
निज गिरा पावनि करन कारन राम जसु तुलसी कह्यो ।
रघुबीर चरित अपार बारिधि पारु कबि कौनें लह्यो ॥
verses.tr:
nij girā pāvani karan kāran rām jasu tulasī kahyo
raghubīr carit apār bāridhi pāru kabi kauneṃ lahyo
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
उपबीत ब्याह उछाह मंगल सुनि जे सादर गावहीं ।
बैदेहि राम प्रसाद ते जन सर्बदा सुखु पावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
upabīt byāh uchāh maṃgal suni je sādar gāvahīṃ
baidehi rām prasād te jan sarbadā sukhu pāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
सिय रघुबीर बिबाहु जे सप्रेम गावहिं सुनहिं ।
तिन्ह कहुँ सदा उछाहु मंगलायतन राम जसु ॥
verses.tr:
siya raghubīr bibāhu je saprem gāvahiṃ sunahiṃ
tinh kahum̐ sadā uchāhu maṃgalāyatan rām jasu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Vamadeva, the learned guru of the house of Raghu, again told the story of Gadhi’s son. As he listened to the saint’s high fame, the king thought to himself how effiea-cious his own good deeds had been. At his command the crowd dispersed, while the king and his sons entered the palace. Everywhere the glory of Rama’s wedding was sung, and his holy fame was diffused through the three worlds. From the day that Rama brought his wife home, all delight made its home at Avadh. The rejoicings attendant on the lord’s marriage were more than the tongue of the serpent king could tell, but knowing the praises of Rama and Sita to bea mine of auspiciousness and the very life and salvation of the race of poets, I too have tried to sing them, in the hope of thus sanctifying my song.

For the purpose of sanctifying his song has Tulsi told of Rama’s glory; but the acts of Raghubir are a boundless ocean that no poet can traverse. All pious souls, that devoutly hear or recite the auspicious festivities that accompanied RAma's investiture with the sacred thread and his marriage, shall] by his and Vaidehi’s favour attain to everlasting felicity, Blessing on the lord of Himalaya’s daughter, from whom have learnt my song: all who hearken to Hari’s deeds acquire a constant access of devotion and incomparable faith. The loveof Raghubir’s feet, like a flood, extinguishes at once the fire of covetousness; and in this assurance Tulsi Das devotes his every thought and word and act to Hari’s praise,
The times are evil; the body is stained with filth; there is but one remedy; he only is wise who so thinketh and in faith meditates upon Hari.

Have a hearty love for Hari’s feet, discarding all vanities; much time has been spent in sleep; awake from the darkness of delusion. Whoever with love and reverence listens to the tale of Rama and Sita’s marriage stall be happy for ever, for Kama’s praises are an unfailing joy.
